verses.textZh: 起初，神创造天地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 起初，神创造天地。
verses.textZhCuv: 起初，神创造天地。
verses.textEnNiv: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.textEn: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

verses.textZh: 地是空虚混沌；深渊上一片黑暗；神的灵运行在水面上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地是空虚混沌；深渊上一片黑暗；神的灵运行在水面上。
verses.textZhCuv: 地是空虚混沌，渊面黑暗；神的灵运行在水面上。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.
verses.textEnEsv: The earth was without form and void, and darkness was over the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the face of the waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth was without form, and void; and darkness was on the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the face of the waters.
verses.textEnNlt: The earth was formless and empty, and darkness covered the deep waters. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
verses.textEnNasb: And the earth was a formless and desolate emptiness, and darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
verses.textEn: Now the earth was formless and empty, darkness was over the surface of the deep, and the Spirit of God was hovering over the waters.

verses.textZh: 神说："要有光！"就有了光。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："要有光！"就有了光。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「要有光」，就有了光。
verses.textEnNiv: And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said, "Let there be light"; and there was light.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, " Let there be light"; and there was light.
verses.textEn: And God said, "Let there be light," and there was light.

verses.textZh: 神看光是好的，他就把光暗分开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神看光是好的，他就把光暗分开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神看光是好的，就把光暗分开了。
verses.textEnNiv: God saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.
verses.textEnEsv: And God saw that the light was good. And God separated the light from the darkness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God saw the light, that itwas good; and God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.textEnNlt: And God saw that the light was good. Then he separated the light from the darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: God saw that the light was good; and God separated the light from the darkness.
verses.textEn: God saw that the light was good, and he separated the light from the darkness.

verses.textZh: 神称光为昼，称暗为夜。有晚上，有早晨；这是第一日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神称光为昼，称暗为夜。有晚上，有早晨；这是第一日。
verses.textZhCuv: 神称光为「昼」，称暗为「夜」。有晚上，有早晨，这是头一日。
verses.textEnNiv: God called the light "day," and the darkness he called "night." And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.
verses.textEnEsv: God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And there was evening and there was morning, the first day.
verses.textEnNkjv: God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. So the evening and the morning were the first day.
verses.textEnNlt: God called the light "day" and the darkness "night." And evening passed and morning came, marking the first day.
verses.textEnNasb: God called the light "day," and the darkness He called "night." And there was evening and there was morning, one day.
verses.textEn: God called the light "day," and the darkness he called "night." And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.

verses.textZh: 神说："众水之间要有穹苍，把水和水分开！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："众水之间要有穹苍，把水和水分开！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「诸水之间要有空气，将水分为上下。」
verses.textEnNiv: And God said, "Let there be a vault between the waters to separate water from water."
verses.textEnEsv: And God said, "Let there be an expanse in the midst of the waters, and let it separate the waters from the waters."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said, "Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters."
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "Let there be a space between the waters, to separate the waters of the heavens from the waters of the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, "Let there be an expanse in the midst of the waters, and let it separate the waters from the waters."
verses.textEn: And God said, "Let there be a vault between the waters to separate water from water."

verses.textZh: 神造了穹苍，把穹苍以下的水和穹苍以上的水分开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神造了穹苍，把穹苍以下的水和穹苍以上的水分开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神就造出空气，将空气以下的水、空气以上的水分开了。事就这样成了。
verses.textEnNiv: So God made the vault and separated the water under the vault from the water above it. And it was so.
verses.textEnEsv: And God made the expanse and separated the waters that were under the expanse from the waters that were above the expanse. And it was so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament; and it was so.
verses.textEnNlt: And that is what happened. God made this space to separate the waters of the earth from the waters of the heavens.
verses.textEnNasb: God made the expanse, and separated the waters that were below the expanse from the waters that were above the expanse; and it was so.
verses.textEn: So God made the vault and separated the water under the vault from the water above it. And it was so.

verses.textZh: 神称穹苍为天。有晚上，有早晨；这是第二日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神称穹苍为天。有晚上，有早晨；这是第二日。
verses.textZhCuv: 神称空气为「天」。有晚上，有早晨，是第二日。
verses.textEnNiv: God called the vault "sky." And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.
verses.textEnEsv: And God called the expanse Heaven. And there was evening and there was morning, the second day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God called the firmament Heaven. So the evening and the morning were the second day.
verses.textEnNlt: God called the space "sky." And evening passed and morning came, marking the second day.
verses.textEnNasb: God called the expanse "heaven." And there was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.textEn: God called the vault "sky." And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.

verses.textZh: 神说："天下的水要聚在一处，使旱地露出来！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："天下的水要聚在一处，使旱地露出来！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「天下的水要聚在一处，使旱地露出来。」事就这样成了。
verses.textEnNiv: And God said, "Let the water under the sky be gathered to one place, and let dry ground appear." And it was so.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said, "Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together into one place, and let the dry land appear." And it was so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said, "Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together into one place, and let the dry land appear"; and it was so.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "Let the waters beneath the sky flow together into one place, so dry ground may appear." And that is what happened.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, "Let the waters below the heavens be gathered into one place, and let the dry land appear"; and it was so.
verses.textEn: And God said, "Let the water under the sky be gathered to one place, and let dry ground appear." And it was so.

verses.textZh: 神称旱地为地，称水的聚处为海。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神称旱地为地，称水的聚处为海。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 神称旱地为「地」，称水的聚处为「海」。神看着是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: God called the dry ground "land," and the gathered waters he called "seas." And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnEsv: God called the dry land Earth, and the waters that were gathered together he called Seas. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God called the dry land Earth, and the gathering together of the waters He called Seas. And God saw that itwas good.
verses.textEnNlt: God called the dry ground "land" and the waters "seas." And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNasb: And God called the dry land "earth," and the gathering of the waters He called "seas"; and God saw that it was good.
verses.textEn: God called the dry ground "land," and the gathered waters he called "seas." And God saw that it was good.

verses.textZh: 神说："地上要长出青草、结种子的蔬菜和结果子的树木，各从其类，在地上的果子都包着核！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："地上要长出青草、结种子的蔬菜和结果子的树木，各从其类，在地上的果子都包着核！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「地要发生青草和结种子的菜蔬，并结果子的树木，各从其类，果子都包着核。」事就这样成了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said, "Let the land produce vegetation: seed-bearing plants and trees on the land that bear fruit with seed in it, according to their various kinds." And it was so.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said, "Let the earth sprout vegetation, plants yielding seed, and fruit trees bearing fruit in which is their seed, each according to its kind, on the earth." And it was so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said, "Let the earth bring forth grass, the herb that yields seed, and the fruit tree that yields fruit according to its kind, whose seed is in itself, on the earth"; and it was so.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "Let the land sprout with vegetation—every sort of seed-bearing plant, and trees that grow seed-bearing fruit. These seeds will then produce the kinds of plants and trees from which they came." And that is what happened.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, "Let the earth sprout vegetation, plants yielding seed, and fruit trees on the earth bearing fruit according to their kind with seed in them"; and it was so.
verses.textEn: Then God said, "Let the land produce vegetation: seed-bearing plants and trees on the land that bear fruit with seed in it, according to their various kinds." And it was so.

verses.textZh: 于是，地上长出了青草和结种子的蔬菜，各从其类；又长出结果子的树木，各从其类，果子都包着核。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，地上长出了青草和结种子的蔬菜，各从其类；又长出结果子的树木，各从其类，果子都包着核。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是地发生了青草和结种子的菜蔬，各从其类；并结果子的树木，各从其类；果子都包着核。神看着是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: The land produced vegetation: plants bearing seed according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed in it according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnEsv: The earth brought forth vegetation, plants yielding seed according to their own kinds, and trees bearing fruit in which is their seed, each according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the earth brought forth grass, the herb that yields seed according to its kind, and the tree that yields fruit, whose seed is in itself according to its kind. And God saw that itwas good.
verses.textEnNlt: The land produced vegetation—all sorts of seed-bearing plants, and trees with seed-bearing fruit. Their seeds produced plants and trees of the same kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNasb: The earth produced vegetation, plants yielding seed according to their kind, and trees bearing fruit with seed in them, according to their kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.textEn: The land produced vegetation: plants bearing seed according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed in it according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.

verses.textZh: 有晚上，有早晨；这是第三日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有晚上，有早晨；这是第三日。
verses.textZhCuv: 有晚上，有早晨，是第三日。
verses.textEnNiv: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was evening and there was morning, the third day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the evening and the morning were the third day.
verses.textEnNlt: And evening passed and morning came, marking the third day.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.textEn: And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.

verses.textZh: 神说："在天上穹苍中，要有光体来分昼夜；这些光体要作为记号，定节令、日子和年岁；
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："在天上穹苍中，要有光体来分昼夜；这些光体要作为记号，定节令、日子和年岁；
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「天上要有光体，可以分昼夜，作记号，定节令、日子、年岁，
verses.textEnNiv: And God said, "Let there be lights in the vault of the sky to separate the day from the night, and let them serve as signs to mark sacred times, and days and years,
verses.textEnEsv: And God said, "Let there be lights in the expanse of the heavens to separate the day from the night. And let them be for signs and for seasons, and for days and years,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said, "Let there be lights in the firmament of the heavens to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs and seasons, and for days and years;
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "Let lights appear in the sky to separate the day from the night. Let them be signs to mark the seasons, days, and years.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, "Let there be lights in the expanse of the heavens to separate the day from the night, and they shall serve as signs and for seasons, and for days and years;
verses.textEn: And God said, "Let there be lights in the vault of the sky to separate the day from the night, and let them serve as signs to mark sacred times, and days and years,

verses.textZh: 它们要在天上穹苍中发光，照耀地上！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它们要在天上穹苍中发光，照耀地上！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 并要发光在天空，普照在地上。」事就这样成了。
verses.textEnNiv: and let them be lights in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth." And it was so.
verses.textEnEsv: and let them be lights in the expanse of the heavens to give light upon the earth." And it was so.
verses.textEnNkjv: and let them be for lights in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth"; and it was so.
verses.textEnNlt: Let these lights in the sky shine down on the earth." And that is what happened.
verses.textEnNasb: and they shall serve as lights in the expanse of the heavens to give light on the earth"; and it was so.
verses.textEn: and let them be lights in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth." And it was so.

verses.textZh: 于是，神造了两个大光体，大的管昼，小的管夜；又造了星星。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，神造了两个大光体，大的管昼，小的管夜；又造了星星。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是神造了两个大光，大的管昼，小的管夜，又造众星，
verses.textEnNiv: God made two great lights—the greater light to govern the day and the lesser light to govern the night. He also made the stars.
verses.textEnEsv: And God made the two great lights—the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night—and the stars.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. Hemade the stars also.
verses.textEnNlt: God made two great lights—the larger one to govern the day, and the smaller one to govern the night. He also made the stars.
verses.textEnNasb: God made the two great lights, the greater light to govern the day, and the lesser light to govern the night; He made the stars also.
verses.textEn: God made two great lights—the greater light to govern the day and the lesser light to govern the night. He also made the stars.

verses.textZh: 神把这些光体安放在天上穹苍中，照耀地上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神把这些光体安放在天上穹苍中，照耀地上，
verses.textZhCuv: 就把这些光摆列在天空，普照在地上，
verses.textEnNiv: God set them in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth,
verses.textEnEsv: And God set them in the expanse of the heavens to give light on the earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: God set them in the firmament of the heavens to give light on the earth,
verses.textEnNlt: God set these lights in the sky to light the earth,
verses.textEnNasb: God placed them in the expanse of the heavens to give light on the earth,
verses.textEn: God set them in the vault of the sky to give light on the earth,

verses.textZh: 管昼夜，分光暗。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 管昼夜，分光暗。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 管理昼夜，分别明暗。神看着是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: to govern the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnEsv: to rule over the day and over the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNkjv: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. And God saw that itwas good.
verses.textEnNlt: to govern the day and night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNasb: and to govern the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness; and God saw that it was good.
verses.textEn: to govern the day and the night, and to separate light from darkness. And God saw that it was good.

verses.textZh: 有晚上，有早晨；这是第四日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有晚上，有早晨；这是第四日。
verses.textZhCuv: 有晚上，有早晨，是第四日。
verses.textEnNiv: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was evening and there was morning, the fourth day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the evening and the morning were the fourth day.
verses.textEnNlt: And evening passed and morning came, marking the fourth day.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.textEn: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.

verses.textZh: 神说："水要滋长生物；地上和天空之中，要有雀鸟飞翔！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："水要滋长生物；地上和天空之中，要有雀鸟飞翔！"
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「水要多多滋生有生命的物；要有雀鸟飞在地面以上，天空之中。」
verses.textEnNiv: And God said, "Let the water teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of the sky."
verses.textEnEsv: And God said, "Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the expanse of the heavens."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said, "Let the waters abound with an abundance of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the face of the firmament of the heavens."
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "Let the waters swarm with fish and other life. Let the skies be filled with birds of every kind."
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, "Let the waters teem with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the heavens."
verses.textEn: And God said, "Let the water teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of the sky."

verses.textZh: 于是，神创造了大鱼和在水中滋生各种能活动的生物，各从其类；又创造了各种有翅膀的飞鸟，各从其类。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，神创造了大鱼和在水中滋生各种能活动的生物，各从其类；又创造了各种有翅膀的飞鸟，各从其类。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 神就造出大鱼和水中所滋生各样有生命的动物，各从其类；又造出各样飞鸟，各从其类。神看着是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: So God created the great creatures of the sea and every living thing with which the water teems and that moves about in it, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnEsv: So God created the great sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarm, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNkjv: So God created great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters abounded, according to their kind, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that itwas good.
verses.textEnNlt: So God created great sea creatures and every living thing that scurries and swarms in the water, and every sort of bird—each producing offspring of the same kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNasb: And God created the great sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, according to their kind, and every winged bird according to its kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.textEn: So God created the great creatures of the sea and every living thing with which the water teems and that moves about in it, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.

verses.textZh: 神就赐福给牠们，说："要繁衍增多，充满海洋；雀鸟也要在地上增多！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神就赐福给牠们，说："要繁衍增多，充满海洋；雀鸟也要在地上增多！"
verses.textZhCuv: 神就赐福给这一切，说：「滋生繁多，充满海中的水；雀鸟也要多生在地上。」
verses.textEnNiv: God blessed them and said, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the water in the seas, and let the birds increase on the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: And God blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And God blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then God blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply. Let the fish fill the seas, and let the birds multiply on the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: God blessed them, saying, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth."
verses.textEn: God blessed them and said, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the water in the seas, and let the birds increase on the earth."

verses.textZh: 有晚上，有早晨；这是第五日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有晚上，有早晨；这是第五日。
verses.textZhCuv: 有晚上，有早晨，是第五日。
verses.textEnNiv: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.
verses.textEnEsv: And there was evening and there was morning, the fifth day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the evening and the morning were the fifth day.
verses.textEnNlt: And evening passed and morning came, marking the fifth day.
verses.textEnNasb: And there was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.textEn: And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.

verses.textZh: 神说："地上要生出活物来，各从其类；牲畜、爬行的动物和地上的野兽，各从其类！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："地上要生出活物来，各从其类；牲畜、爬行的动物和地上的野兽，各从其类！"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「地要生出活物来，各从其类；牲畜、昆虫、野兽，各从其类。」事就这样成了。
verses.textEnNiv: And God said, "Let the land produce living creatures according to their kinds: the livestock, the creatures that move along the ground, and the wild animals, each according to its kind." And it was so.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said, "Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds—livestock and creeping things and beasts of the earth according to their kinds." And it was so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said, "Let the earth bring forth the living creature according to its kind: cattle and creeping thing and beast of the earth, each according to its kind"; and it was so.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "Let the earth produce every sort of animal, each producing offspring of the same kind—livestock, small animals that scurry along the ground, and wild animals." And that is what happened.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, "Let the earth produce living creatures according to their kind: livestock and crawling things and animals of the earth according to their kind"; and it was so.
verses.textEn: And God said, "Let the land produce living creatures according to their kinds: the livestock, the creatures that move along the ground, and the wild animals, each according to its kind." And it was so.

verses.textZh: 于是，神造了地上的野兽，各从其类；牲畜，各从其类；地上各种爬行的动物，各从其类。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，神造了地上的野兽，各从其类；牲畜，各从其类；地上各种爬行的动物，各从其类。神看这是好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是神造出野兽，各从其类；牲畜，各从其类；地上一切昆虫，各从其类。神看着是好的。
verses.textEnNiv: God made the wild animals according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and all the creatures that move along the ground according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnEsv: And God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds and the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that creeps on the ground according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God made the beast of the earth according to its kind, cattle according to its kind, and everything that creeps on the earth according to its kind. And God saw that itwas good.
verses.textEnNlt: God made all sorts of wild animals, livestock, and small animals, each able to produce offspring of the same kind. And God saw that it was good.
verses.textEnNasb: God made the animals of the earth according to their kind, and the livestock according to their kind, and everything that crawls on the ground according to its kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.textEn: God made the wild animals according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and all the creatures that move along the ground according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.

verses.textZh: 神说："我们要照着我们的形象，按着我们的样式造人；使他们管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟、地上的牲畜，以及全地，和地上所有爬行的生物！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："我们要照着我们的形象，按着我们的样式造人；使他们管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟、地上的牲畜，以及全地，和地上所有爬行的生物！"
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「我们要照着我们的形象、按着我们的样式造人，使他们管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟、地上的牲畜，和全地，并地上所爬的一切昆虫。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said, "Let us make mankind in our image, in our likeness, so that they may rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky, over the livestock and all the wild animals, and over all the creatures that move along the ground."
verses.textEnEsv: Then God said, "Let us make man in our image, after our likeness. And let them have dominion over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the heavens and over the livestock and over all the earth and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said, "Let Us make man in Our image, according to Our likeness; let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over the cattle, over all the earth and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "Let us make human beings in our image, to be like us. They will reign over the fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, the livestock, all the wild animals on the earth, and the small animals that scurry along the ground."
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, " Let Us make mankind in Our image, according to Our likeness; and let them rule over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the sky and over the livestock and over all the earth, and over every crawling thing that crawls on the earth."
verses.textEn: Then God said, "Let us make mankind in our image, in our likeness, so that they may rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky, over the livestock and all the wild animals, and over all the creatures that move along the ground."

verses.textZh: 于是，神照着自己的形象创造人；就是照着神的形象创造了他；他所创造的有男有女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，神照着自己的形象创造人；就是照着神的形象创造了他；他所创造的有男有女。
verses.textZhCuv: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。
verses.textEnNiv: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verses.textEnEsv: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him; male and female he created them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
verses.textEnNlt: So God created human beings in his own image. In the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verses.textEnNasb: So God created man in His own image, in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
verses.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.

verses.textZh: 神就赐福给他们，对他们说："要繁衍增多，充满这地，征服它；也要管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟和地上所有走动的生物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神就赐福给他们，对他们说："要繁衍增多，充满这地，征服它；也要管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟和地上所有走动的生物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神就赐福给他们，又对他们说：「要生养众多，遍满地面，治理这地，也要管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟，和地上各样行动的活物。」
verses.textEnNiv: God blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky and over every living creature that moves on the ground."
verses.textEnEsv: And God blessed them. And God said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it, and have dominion over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the heavens and over every living thing that moves on the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God blessed them, and God said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply; fill the earth and subdue it; have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, and over every living thing that moves on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then God blessed them and said, "Be fruitful and multiply. Fill the earth and govern it. Reign over the fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, and all the animals that scurry along the ground."
verses.textEnNasb: God blessed them; and God said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it; and rule over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the sky and over every living thing that moves on the earth."
verses.textEn: God blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number; fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky and over every living creature that moves on the ground."

verses.textZh: 神说："看哪！我把全地上结种子的各样蔬菜，和一切果树上有种子的果子，都赐给你们作食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："看哪！我把全地上结种子的各样蔬菜，和一切果树上有种子的果子，都赐给你们作食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「看哪，我将遍地上一切结种子的菜蔬和一切树上所结有核的果子全赐给你们作食物。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said, "I give you every seed-bearing plant on the face of the whole earth and every tree that has fruit with seed in it. They will be yours for food.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said, "Behold, I have given you every plant yielding seed that is on the face of all the earth, and every tree with seed in its fruit. You shall have them for food.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God said, "See, I have given you every herb that yields seed which is on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit yields seed; to you it shall be for food.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "Look! I have given you every seed-bearing plant throughout the earth and all the fruit trees for your food.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said, "Behold, I have given you every plant yielding seed that is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree which has fruit yielding seed; it shall be food for you;
verses.textEn: Then God said, "I give you every seed-bearing plant on the face of the whole earth and every tree that has fruit with seed in it. They will be yours for food.

verses.textZh: 至于地上的各种野兽，空中的各种飞鸟，和地上爬行有生命的各种活物，我把一切青草蔬菜赐给牠们作食物。"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于地上的各种野兽，空中的各种飞鸟，和地上爬行有生命的各种活物，我把一切青草蔬菜赐给牠们作食物。"事就这样成了。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟，并各样爬在地上有生命的物，我将青草赐给它们作食物。」事就这样成了。
verses.textEnNiv: And to all the beasts of the earth and all the birds in the sky and all the creatures that move along the ground—everything that has the breath of life in it—I give every green plant for food." And it was so.
verses.textEnEsv: And to every beast of the earth and to every bird of the heavens and to everything that creeps on the earth, everything that has the breath of life, I have given every green plant for food." And it was so.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also, to every beast of the earth, to every bird of the air, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which thereis life, Ihavegiven every green herb for food"; and it was so.
verses.textEnNlt: And I have given every green plant as food for all the wild animals, the birds in the sky, and the small animals that scurry along the ground—everything that has life." And that is what happened.
verses.textEnNasb: and to every animal of the earth and to every bird of the sky and to everything that moves on the earth which has life, I have given every green plant for food"; and it was so.
verses.textEn: And to all the beasts of the earth and all the birds in the sky and all the creatures that move along the ground—everything that has the breath of life in it—I give every green plant for food." And it was so.

verses.textZh: 神看他所造的一切都很好。有晚上，有早晨；这是第六日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神看他所造的一切都很好。有晚上，有早晨；这是第六日。
verses.textZhCuv: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，有早晨，是第六日。
verses.textEnNiv: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.
verses.textEnEsv: And God saw everything that he had made, and behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God saw everything that He had made, and indeed itwas very good. So the evening and the morning were the sixth day.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God looked over all he had made, and he saw that it was very good! And evening passed and morning came, marking the sixth day.
verses.textEnNasb: And God saw all that He had made, and behold, it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
verses.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.

verses.textZh: 这样，天地万物都造齐了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，天地万物都造齐了。
verses.textZhCuv: 天地万物都造齐了。
verses.textEnNiv: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the host of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the heavens and the earth, and all the host of them, were finished.
verses.textEnNlt: So the creation of the heavens and the earth and everything in them was completed.
verses.textEnNasb: And so the heavens and the earth were completed, and all their heavenly lights.
verses.textEn: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.

verses.textZh: 第七日，神完成了他所作的工；在第七日神歇了他所作的一切工。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第七日，神完成了他所作的工；在第七日神歇了他所作的一切工。
verses.textZhCuv: 到第七日，神造物的工已经完毕，就在第七日歇了他一切的工，安息了。
verses.textEnNiv: By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested from all his work.
verses.textEnEsv: And on the seventh day God finished his work that he had done, and he rested on the seventh day from all his work that he had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And on the seventh day God ended His work which He had done, and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.
verses.textEnNlt: On the seventh day God had finished his work of creation, so he rested from all his work.
verses.textEnNasb: By the seventh day God completed His work which He had done, and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done.
verses.textEn: By the seventh day God had finished the work he had been doing; so on the seventh day he rested from all his work.

verses.textZh: 神赐福第七日，把它分别为圣，因为在这一日，神停了他一切所创造的工，歇息了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神赐福第七日，把它分别为圣，因为在这一日，神停了他一切所创造的工，歇息了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神赐福给第七日，定为圣日；因为在这日，神歇了他一切创造的工，就安息了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creating that he had done.
verses.textEnEsv: So God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it God rested from all his work that he had done in creation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because in it He rested from all His work which God had created and made.
verses.textEnNlt: And God blessed the seventh day and declared it holy, because it was the day when he rested from all his work of creation.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it, because on it He rested from all His work which God had created and made.
verses.textEn: Then God blessed the seventh day and made it holy, because on it he rested from all the work of creating that he had done.

verses.textZh: 这是创造天地的起源：耶和华神造天地的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是创造天地的起源：耶和华神造天地的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 创造天地的来历，在耶和华神造天地的日子，乃是这样，
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, when the Lord God made the earth and the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the history of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made the earth and the heavens,
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of the creation of the heavens and the earth. When the Lord God made the earth and the heavens,
verses.textEnNasb: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that the Lord God made earth and heaven.
verses.textEn: This is the account of the heavens and the earth when they were created, when the Lord God made the earth and the heavens.

verses.textZh: 原野上还没有树木，田间的蔬菜还没有长起来，因为耶和华神还没有降雨在地上，也没有人耕种土地；
verses.textZhCnvs: 原野上还没有树木，田间的蔬菜还没有长起来，因为耶和华神还没有降雨在地上，也没有人耕种土地；
verses.textZhCuv: 野地还没有草木，田间的菜蔬还没有长起来；因为耶和华神还没有降雨在地上，也没有人耕地，
verses.textEnNiv: Now no shrub had yet appeared on the earth and no plant had yet sprung up, for the Lord God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no one to work the ground,
verses.textEnEsv: When no bush of the field was yet in the land and no small plant of the field had yet sprung up—for the Lord God had not caused it to rain on the land, and there was no man to work the ground,
verses.textEnNkjv: before any plant of the field was in the earth and before any herb of the field had grown. For the Lord God had not caused it to rain on the earth, and therewas no man to till the ground;
verses.textEnNlt: neither wild plants nor grains were growing on the earth. For the Lord God had not yet sent rain to water the earth, and there were no people to cultivate the soil.
verses.textEnNasb: Now no shrub of the field was yet on the earth, and no plant of the field had yet sprouted, for the Lord God had not sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to cultivate the ground.
verses.textEn: Now no shrub had yet appeared on the earth and no plant had yet sprung up, for the Lord God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no one to work the ground,

verses.textZh: 不过有雾气从地面上升，滋润全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过有雾气从地面上升，滋润全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 但有雾气从地上腾，滋润遍地。
verses.textEnNiv: but streams came up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: and a mist was going up from the land and was watering the whole face of the ground—
verses.textEnNkjv: but a mist went up from the earth and watered the whole face of the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, springs came up from the ground and watered all the land.
verses.textEnNasb: But a mist used to rise from the earth and water the whole surface of the ground.
verses.textEn: but streams came up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神用地上的尘土造成人形，把生气吹进他的鼻孔里，那人就成了有生命的活人，名叫亚当。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神用地上的尘土造成人形，把生气吹进他的鼻孔里，那人就成了有生命的活人，名叫亚当。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神用地上的尘土造人，将生气吹在他鼻孔里，他就成了有灵的活人，名叫亚当。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.
verses.textEnEsv: then the Lord God formed the man of dust from the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living creature.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living being.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord God formed the man from the dust of the ground. He breathed the breath of life into the man’s nostrils, and the man became a living person.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord God formed the man of dust from the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and the man became a living person.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord God formed a man from the dust of the ground and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and the man became a living being.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神在东方的伊甸，栽了一个园子，把他所造的人放在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神在东方的伊甸，栽了一个园子，把他所造的人放在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神在东方的伊甸立了一个园子，把所造的人安置在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Lord God had planted a garden in the east, in Eden; and there he put the man he had formed.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord God planted a garden eastward in Eden, and there He put the man whom He had formed.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord God planted a garden in Eden in the east, and there he placed the man he had made.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God planted a garden toward the east, in Eden; and there He placed the man whom He had formed.
verses.textEn: Now the Lord God had planted a garden in the east, in Eden; and there he put the man he had formed.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神使各样的树从地上长起来，能悦人的眼目，也好作食物。园子中间又有生命树，和知善恶树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神使各样的树从地上长起来，能悦人的眼目，也好作食物。园子中间又有生命树，和知善恶树。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神使各样的树从地里长出来，可以悦人的眼目，其上的果子好作食物。园子当中又有生命树和分别善恶的树。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord God made all kinds of trees grow out of the ground—trees that were pleasing to the eye and good for food. In the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.textEnEsv: And out of the ground the Lord God made to spring up every tree that is pleasant to the sight and good for food. The tree of life was in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: And out of the ground the Lord God made every tree grow that is pleasant to the sight and good for food. The tree of life was also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord God made all sorts of trees grow up from the ground—trees that were beautiful and that produced delicious fruit. In the middle of the garden he placed the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.textEnNasb: Out of the ground the Lord God caused every tree to grow that is pleasing to the sight and good for food; the tree of life was also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
verses.textEn: The Lord God made all kinds of trees grow out of the ground—trees that were pleasing to the eye and good for food. In the middle of the garden were the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

verses.textZh: 有一条河从伊甸流出来，灌溉那园子；从那里分支，成了四道河的源头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一条河从伊甸流出来，灌溉那园子；从那里分支，成了四道河的源头。
verses.textZhCuv: 有河从伊甸流出来，滋润那园子，从那里分为四道：
verses.textEnNiv: A river watering the garden flowed from Eden; from there it was separated into four headwaters.
verses.textEnEsv: A river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and there it divided and became four rivers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a river went out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it parted and became four riverheads.
verses.textEnNlt: A river flowed from the land of Eden, watering the garden and then dividing into four branches.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it divided and became four rivers.
verses.textEn: A river watering the garden flowed from Eden; from there it was separated into four headwaters.

verses.textZh: 第一道河名叫比逊，就是环绕哈腓拉全地的，在那里有金子；
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一道河名叫比逊，就是环绕哈腓拉全地的，在那里有金子；
verses.textZhCuv: 第一道名叫比逊，就是环绕哈腓拉全地的。在那里有金子，
verses.textEnNiv: The name of the first is the Pishon; it winds through the entire land of Havilah, where there is gold.
verses.textEnEsv: The name of the first is the Pishon. It is the one that flowed around the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of the first is Pishon; it is the one which skirts the whole land of Havilah, where thereis gold.
verses.textEnNlt: The first branch, called the Pishon, flowed around the entire land of Havilah, where gold is found.
verses.textEnNasb: The name of the first is Pishon; it flows around the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
verses.textEn: The name of the first is the Pishon; it winds through the entire land of Havilah, where there is gold.

verses.textZh: 那地的金子是好的；在那里也有红玉和玛瑙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地的金子是好的；在那里也有红玉和玛瑙。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且那地的金子是好的；在那里又有珍珠和红玛瑙。
verses.textEnNiv: (The gold of that land is good; aromatic resin and onyx are also there.)
verses.textEnEsv: And the gold of that land is good; bdellium and onyx stone are there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and the onyx stone are there.
verses.textEnNlt: The gold of that land is exceptionally pure; aromatic resin and onyx stone are also found there.
verses.textEnNasb: The gold of that land is good; the bdellium and the onyx stone are there as well.
verses.textEn: (The gold of that land is good; aromatic resin and onyx are also there.)

verses.textZh: 第二道河名叫基训，就是环绕古实全地的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二道河名叫基训，就是环绕古实全地的。
verses.textZhCuv: 第二道河名叫基训，就是环绕古实全地的。
verses.textEnNiv: The name of the second river is the Gihon; it winds through the entire land of Cush.
verses.textEnEsv: The name of the second river is the Gihon. It is the one that flowed around the whole land of Cush.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of the second river is Gihon; it is the one which goes around the whole land of Cush.
verses.textEnNlt: The second branch, called the Gihon, flowed around the entire land of Cush.
verses.textEnNasb: The name of the second river is Gihon; it flows around the whole land of Cush.
verses.textEn: The name of the second river is the Gihon; it winds through the entire land of Cush.

verses.textZh: 第三道河名叫底格里斯河 ，就是流向亚述东边的。第四道河就是幼发拉底河 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三道河名叫底格里斯河 ，就是流向亚述东边的。第四道河就是幼发拉底河 。
verses.textZhCuv: 第三道河名叫底格里斯，流在亚述的东边。第四道河就是幼发拉底河。
verses.textEnNiv: The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Ashur. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
verses.textEnEsv: And the name of the third river is the Tigris, which flows east of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
verses.textEnNkjv: The name of the third river is Hiddekel; it is the one which goes toward the east of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.
verses.textEnNlt: The third branch, called the Tigris, flowed east of the land of Asshur. The fourth branch is called the Euphrates.
verses.textEnNasb: The name of the third river is Tigris; it flows east of Assyria. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.
verses.textEn: The name of the third river is the Tigris; it runs along the east side of Ashur. And the fourth river is the Euphrates.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神把那人安置在伊甸园里，叫他耕种和看守那园子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神把那人安置在伊甸园里，叫他耕种和看守那园子。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理，看守。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to work it and keep it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to tend and keep it.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord God placed the man in the Garden of Eden to tend and watch over it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate it and tend it.
verses.textEn: The Lord God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神吩咐那人说："园中各样树上的果子，你都可以吃；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神吩咐那人说："园中各样树上的果子，你都可以吃；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神吩咐他说：「园中各样树上的果子，你可以随意吃，
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord God commanded the man, "You are free to eat from any tree in the garden;
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, "You may surely eat of every tree of the garden,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, "Of every tree of the garden you may freely eat;
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord God warned him, "You may freely eat the fruit of every tree in the garden—
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord God commanded the man, saying, "From any tree of the garden you may freely eat;
verses.textEn: And the Lord God commanded the man, "You are free to eat from any tree in the garden;

verses.textZh: 只是那知善恶树的果子，你不可吃；因为你吃的时候，你必要死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是那知善恶树的果子，你不可吃；因为你吃的时候，你必要死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是分别善恶树上的果子，你不可吃，因为你吃的日子必定死！」
verses.textEnNiv: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for when you eat from it you will certainly die."
verses.textEnEsv: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die."
verses.textEnNkjv: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die."
verses.textEnNlt: except the tree of the knowledge of good and evil. If you eat its fruit, you are sure to die."
verses.textEnNasb: but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for on the day that you eat from it you will certainly die."
verses.textEn: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, for when you eat from it you will certainly die."

verses.textZh: 耶和华神说："那人独居不好，我要为他造个和他相配的帮手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神说："那人独居不好，我要为他造个和他相配的帮手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神说：「那人独居不好，我要为他造一个配偶帮助他。」
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord God said, "It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a helper fit for him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord God said, "Itis not good that man should be alone; I will make him a helper comparable to him."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper who is just right for him."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone; I will make him a helper suitable for him."
verses.textEn: The Lord God said, "It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make a helper suitable for him."

verses.textZh: 耶和华神用泥土造了野地的各样野兽，和空中的各样飞鸟，把牠们都带到那人面前，看他给牠们叫甚么名字；那人怎样叫各样有生命的活物，那就是牠的名字。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神用泥土造了野地的各样野兽，和空中的各样飞鸟，把牠们都带到那人面前，看他给牠们叫甚么名字；那人怎样叫各样有生命的活物，那就是牠的名字。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神用土所造成的野地各样走兽和空中各样飞鸟都带到那人面前，看他叫什么。那人怎样叫各样的活物，那就是它的名字。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Lord God had formed out of the ground all the wild animals and all the birds in the sky. He brought them to the man to see what he would name them; and whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.
verses.textEnEsv: Now out of the ground the Lord God had formed every beast of the field and every bird of the heavens and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. And whatever the man called every living creature, that was its name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Out of the ground the Lord God formed every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and brought them to Adam to see what he would call them. And whatever Adam called each living creature, that was its name.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord God formed from the ground all the wild animals and all the birds of the sky. He brought them to the man to see what he would call them, and the man chose a name for each one.
verses.textEnNasb: And out of the ground the Lord God formed every animal of the field and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them; and whatever the man called a living creature, that was its name.
verses.textEn: Now the Lord God had formed out of the ground all the wild animals and all the birds in the sky. He brought them to the man to see what he would name them; and whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.

verses.textZh: 那人就给各样牲畜、空中的雀鸟，和野地的各样走兽起了名字；只是那人没有遇见一个和他相配的帮手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人就给各样牲畜、空中的雀鸟，和野地的各样走兽起了名字；只是那人没有遇见一个和他相配的帮手。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人便给一切牲畜和空中飞鸟、野地走兽都起了名；只是那人没有遇见配偶帮助他。
verses.textEnNiv: So the man gave names to all the livestock, the birds in the sky and all the wild animals. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.
verses.textEnEsv: The man gave names to all livestock and to the birds of the heavens and to every beast of the field. But for Adam there was not found a helper fit for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Adam gave names to all cattle, to the birds of the air, and to every beast of the field. But for Adam there was not found a helper comparable to him.
verses.textEnNlt: He gave names to all the livestock, all the birds of the sky, and all the wild animals. But still there was no helper just right for him.
verses.textEnNasb: The man gave names to all the livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field, but for Adam there was not found a helper suitable for him.
verses.textEn: So the man gave names to all the livestock, the birds in the sky and all the wild animals. But for Adam no suitable helper was found.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神使那人沉睡。他熟睡的时候，耶和华神取了他的一根肋骨，又使肉在原处复合。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神使那人沉睡。他熟睡的时候，耶和华神取了他的一根肋骨，又使肉在原处复合。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神使他沉睡，他就睡了；于是取下他的一条肋骨，又把肉合起来。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep; and while he was sleeping, he took one of the man’s ribs and then closed up the place with flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and while he slept took one of his ribs and closed up its place with flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall on Adam, and he slept; and He took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. While the man slept, the Lord God took out one of the man’s ribs and closed up the opening.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon the man, and he slept; then He took one of his ribs and closed up the flesh at that place.
verses.textEn: So the Lord God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep; and while he was sleeping, he took one of the man’s ribs and then closed up the place with flesh.

verses.textZh: 然后，耶和华神用从那人身上所取的肋骨，造了一个女人，带她到那人面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，耶和华神用从那人身上所取的肋骨，造了一个女人，带她到那人面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神就用那人身上所取的肋骨造成一个女人，领她到那人跟前。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord God made a woman from the rib he had taken out of the man, and he brought her to the man.
verses.textEnEsv: And the rib that the Lord God had taken from the man he made into a woman and brought her to the man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the rib which the Lord God had taken from man He made into a woman, and He brought her to the man.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord God made a woman from the rib, and he brought her to the man.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord God fashioned into a woman the rib which He had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord God made a woman from the rib he had taken out of the man, and he brought her to the man.

verses.textZh: 那人说： "这是我骨中的骨， 肉中的肉； 她当称为女人， 因她是从男人身上取出来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人说： "这是我骨中的骨， 肉中的肉； 她当称为女人， 因她是从男人身上取出来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人说： 这是我骨中的骨， 肉中的肉， 可以称她为「女人」， 因为她是从「男人」身上取出来的。
verses.textEnNiv: The man said, "This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for she was taken out of man."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the man said, "This at last is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Adam said: "This is now bone of my bones And flesh of my flesh; She shall be called Woman, Because she was taken out of Man."
verses.textEnNlt: "At last!" the man exclaimed. "This one is bone from my bone, and flesh from my flesh! She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken from ‘man.’"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the man said, "At last this is bone of my bones, And flesh of my flesh; She shall be called ‘woman,’ Because she was taken out of man."
verses.textEn: The man said, "This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called ‘woman,’ for she was taken out of man."

verses.textZh: 因此人要离开父母，和妻子连合，二人成为一体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此人要离开父母，和妻子连合，二人成为一体。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore a man shall leave his father and his mother and hold fast to his wife, and they shall become one flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and they shall become one flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: This explains why a man leaves his father and mother and is joined to his wife, and the two are united into one.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason a man shall leave his father and his mother, and be joined to his wife; and they shall become one flesh.
verses.textEn: That is why a man leaves his father and mother and is united to his wife, and they become one flesh.

verses.textZh: 那时，夫妻二人赤身露体，彼此都不觉得羞耻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，夫妻二人赤身露体，彼此都不觉得羞耻。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时夫妻二人赤身露体，并不羞耻。
verses.textEnNiv: Adam and his wife were both naked, and they felt no shame.
verses.textEnEsv: And the man and his wife were both naked and were not ashamed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the man and his wife were both naked, but they felt no shame.
verses.textEnNasb: And the man and his wife were both naked, but they were not ashamed.
verses.textEn: Adam and his wife were both naked, and they felt no shame.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华神所造野地所有的活物中，蛇是最狡猾的。蛇对女人说："神真的说过，你们不可吃园中任何树上的果子吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华神所造野地所有的活物中，蛇是最狡猾的。蛇对女人说："神真的说过，你们不可吃园中任何树上的果子吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神所造的，惟有蛇比田野一切的活物更狡猾。蛇对女人说：「神岂是真说不许你们吃园中所有树上的果子吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the serpent was more crafty than any of the wild animals the Lord God had made. He said to the woman, "Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden’?"
verses.textEnEsv: Now the serpent was more crafty than any other beast of the field that the Lord God had made. He said to the woman, "Did God actually say, ‘You shall not eat of any tree in the garden’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the serpent was more cunning than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said to the woman, "Has God indeed said, ‘You shall not eat of every tree of the garden’?"
verses.textEnNlt: The serpent was the shrewdest of all the wild animals the Lord God had made. One day he asked the woman, "Did God really say you must not eat the fruit from any of the trees in the garden?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now the serpent was more cunning than any animal of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said to the woman, "Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat from any tree of the garden’?"
verses.textEn: Now the serpent was more crafty than any of the wild animals the Lord God had made. He said to the woman, "Did God really say, ‘You must not eat from any tree in the garden’?"

verses.textZh: 女人对蛇说："园中树上的果子，我们都可以吃；
verses.textZhCnvs: 女人对蛇说："园中树上的果子，我们都可以吃；
verses.textZhCuv: 女人对蛇说：「园中树上的果子，我们可以吃，
verses.textEnNiv: The woman said to the serpent, "We may eat fruit from the trees in the garden,
verses.textEnEsv: And the woman said to the serpent, "We may eat of the fruit of the trees in the garden,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the woman said to the serpent, "We may eat the fruit of the trees of the garden;
verses.textEnNlt: "Of course we may eat fruit from the trees in the garden," the woman replied.
verses.textEnNasb: The woman said to the serpent, "From the fruit of the trees of the garden we may eat;
verses.textEn: The woman said to the serpent, "We may eat fruit from the trees in the garden,

verses.textZh: 只有园中那棵树上的果子，神曾经说过：‘你们不可吃，也不可摸，免得你们死。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有园中那棵树上的果子，神曾经说过：‘你们不可吃，也不可摸，免得你们死。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有园当中那棵树上的果子，神曾说：『你们不可吃，也不可摸，免得你们死。』」
verses.textEnNiv: but God did say, ‘You must not eat fruit from the tree that is in the middle of the garden, and you must not touch it, or you will die.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: but God said, ‘You shall not eat of the fruit of the tree that is in the midst of the garden, neither shall you touch it, lest you die.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: but of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, God has said, ‘You shall not eat it, nor shall you touch it, lest you die.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: "It’s only the fruit from the tree in the middle of the garden that we are not allowed to eat. God said, ‘You must not eat it or even touch it; if you do, you will die.’"
verses.textEnNasb: but from the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden, God has said, ‘You shall not eat from it or touch it, or you will die.’ "
verses.textEn: but God did say, ‘You must not eat fruit from the tree that is in the middle of the garden, and you must not touch it, or you will die.’ "

verses.textZh: 蛇对女人说："你们决不会死；
verses.textZhCnvs: 蛇对女人说："你们决不会死；
verses.textZhCuv: 蛇对女人说：「你们不一定死；
verses.textEnNiv: "You will not certainly die," the serpent said to the woman.
verses.textEnEsv: But the serpent said to the woman, "You will not surely die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the serpent said to the woman, "You will not surely die.
verses.textEnNlt: "You won’t die!" the serpent replied to the woman.
verses.textEnNasb: The serpent said to the woman, "You certainly will not die!
verses.textEn: "You will not certainly die," the serpent said to the woman.

verses.textZh: 因为神知道你们吃那果子的时候，你们的眼睛就开了；你们会像神一样，能知道善恶。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神知道你们吃那果子的时候，你们的眼睛就开了；你们会像神一样，能知道善恶。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神知道，你们吃的日子眼睛就明亮了，你们便如神能知道善恶。」
verses.textEnNiv: "For God knows that when you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."
verses.textEnEsv: For God knows that when you eat of it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."
verses.textEnNkjv: For God knows that in the day you eat of it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."
verses.textEnNlt: "God knows that your eyes will be opened as soon as you eat it, and you will be like God, knowing both good and evil."
verses.textEnNasb: For God knows that on the day you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will become like God, knowing good and evil."
verses.textEn: "For God knows that when you eat from it your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil."

verses.textZh: 于是，女人见那棵树的果子好作食物，又悦人的眼目，而且讨人喜爱，能使人有智慧，就摘下果子来吃了；又给了和她在一起的丈夫，他也吃了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，女人见那棵树的果子好作食物，又悦人的眼目，而且讨人喜爱，能使人有智慧，就摘下果子来吃了；又给了和她在一起的丈夫，他也吃了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是女人见那棵树的果子好作食物，也悦人的眼目，且是可喜爱的，能使人有智慧，就摘下果子来吃了，又给她丈夫，她丈夫也吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the woman saw that the fruit of the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eye, and also desirable for gaining wisdom, she took some and ate it. She also gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate it.
verses.textEnEsv: So when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took of its fruit and ate, and she also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree desirable to make one wise, she took of its fruit and ate. She also gave to her husband with her, and he ate.
verses.textEnNlt: The woman was convinced. She saw that the tree was beautiful and its fruit looked delicious, and she wanted the wisdom it would give her. So she took some of the fruit and ate it. Then she gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate it, too.
verses.textEnNasb: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was desirable to make one wise, she took some of its fruit and ate; and she also gave some to her husband with her, and he ate.
verses.textEn: When the woman saw that the fruit of the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eye, and also desirable for gaining wisdom, she took some and ate it. She also gave some to her husband, who was with her, and he ate it.

verses.textZh: 二人的眼睛就开了，才知道自己是赤身露体的。于是把无花果树的叶子编缝起来，为自己做裙子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 二人的眼睛就开了，才知道自己是赤身露体的。于是把无花果树的叶子编缝起来，为自己做裙子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们二人的眼睛就明亮了，才知道自己是赤身露体，便拿无花果树的叶子为自己编做裙子。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they realized they were naked; so they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings for themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the eyes of both were opened, and they knew that they were naked. And they sewed fig leaves together and made themselves loincloths.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together and made themselves coverings.
verses.textEnNlt: At that moment their eyes were opened, and they suddenly felt shame at their nakedness. So they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together and made themselves waist coverings.
verses.textEn: Then the eyes of both of them were opened, and they realized they were naked; so they sewed fig leaves together and made coverings for themselves.

verses.textZh: 天起凉风的时候，那人和他的妻子听见耶和华神在园中行走的声音，就藏在园子的树林中，躲避耶和华神的面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 天起凉风的时候，那人和他的妻子听见耶和华神在园中行走的声音，就藏在园子的树林中，躲避耶和华神的面。
verses.textZhCuv: 天起了凉风，耶和华神在园中行走。那人和他妻子听见神的声音，就藏在园里的树木中，躲避耶和华神的面。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and they hid from the Lord God among the trees of the garden.
verses.textEnEsv: And they heard the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God among the trees of the garden.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they heard the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God among the trees of the garden.
verses.textEnNlt: When the cool evening breezes were blowing, the man and his wife heard the Lord God walking about in the garden. So they hid from the Lord God among the trees.
verses.textEnNasb: Now they heard the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the Lord God among the trees of the garden.
verses.textEn: Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God as he was walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and they hid from the Lord God among the trees of the garden.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神呼唤那人，对他说："你在哪里？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神呼唤那人，对他说："你在哪里？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神呼唤那人，对他说：「你在哪里？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord God called to the man, "Where are you?"
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord God called to the man and said to him, "Where are you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord God called to Adam and said to him, "Where are you?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord God called to the man, "Where are you?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord God called to the man, and said to him, "Where are you?"
verses.textEn: But the Lord God called to the man, "Where are you?"

verses.textZh: 他回答："我在园中听见你的声音，就害怕；因为我赤身露体，就藏了起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："我在园中听见你的声音，就害怕；因为我赤身露体，就藏了起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「我在园中听见你的声音，我就害怕；因为我赤身露体，我便藏了。」
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, "I heard you in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "I heard the sound of you in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked, and I hid myself."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "I heard Your voice in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; and I hid myself."
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "I heard you walking in the garden, so I hid. I was afraid because I was naked."
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "I heard the sound of You in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid myself."
verses.textEn: He answered, "I heard you in the garden, and I was afraid because I was naked; so I hid."

verses.textZh: 耶和华神说："谁告诉你，你是赤身露体呢？难道你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神说："谁告诉你，你是赤身露体呢？难道你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「谁告诉你赤身露体呢？莫非你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: And he said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?"
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten of the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you that you should not eat?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Who told you that you were naked?" the Lord God asked. "Have you eaten from the tree whose fruit I commanded you not to eat?"
verses.textEnNasb: And He said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree from which I commanded you not to eat?"
verses.textEn: And he said, "Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?"

verses.textZh: 那人说："你所赐给我、和我在一起的那女人，她把树上的果子给我，我就吃了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人说："你所赐给我、和我在一起的那女人，她把树上的果子给我，我就吃了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人说：「你所赐给我、与我同居的女人，她把那树上的果子给我，我就吃了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man said, "The woman you put here with me—she gave me some fruit from the tree, and I ate it."
verses.textEnEsv: The man said, "The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit of the tree, and I ate."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the man said, "The woman whom You gave tobe with me, she gave me of the tree, and I ate."
verses.textEnNlt: The man replied, "It was the woman you gave me who gave me the fruit, and I ate it."
verses.textEnNasb: The man said, "The woman whom You gave to be with me, she gave me some of the fruit of the tree, and I ate."
verses.textEn: The man said, "The woman you put here with me—she gave me some fruit from the tree, and I ate it."

verses.textZh: 耶和华神对女人说："你作了甚么事呢？"女人说："那蛇欺哄我，我就吃了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神对女人说："你作了甚么事呢？"女人说："那蛇欺哄我，我就吃了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神对女人说：「你做的是什么事呢？」女人说：「那蛇引诱我，我就吃了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord God said to the woman, "What is this you have done?" The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord God said to the woman, "What is this that you have done?" The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord God said to the woman, "What is this you have done?" The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord God asked the woman, "What have you done?" "The serpent deceived me," she replied. "That’s why I ate it."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord God said to the woman, "What is this that you have done?" And the woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord God said to the woman, "What is this you have done?" The woman said, "The serpent deceived me, and I ate."

verses.textZh: 耶和华神对蛇说： "因为你作了这事， 就必在所有的牲畜 和田野的活物中受咒诅； 你要用肚子行走， 一生都吃泥土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神对蛇说： "因为你作了这事， 就必在所有的牲畜 和田野的活物中受咒诅； 你要用肚子行走， 一生都吃泥土。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神对蛇说： 你既做了这事，就必受咒诅， 比一切的牲畜野兽更甚； 你必用肚子行走， 终身吃土。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, "Cursed are you above all livestock and all wild animals! You will crawl on your belly and you will eat dust all the days of your life.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, cursed are you above all livestock and above all beasts of the field; on your belly you shall go, and dust you shall eat all the days of your life.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord God said to the serpent: "Because you have done this, You are cursed more than all cattle, And more than every beast of the field; On your belly you shall go, And you shall eat dust All the days of your life.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, you are cursed more than all animals, domestic and wild. You will crawl on your belly, groveling in the dust as long as you live.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, Cursed are you more than all the livestock, And more than any animal of the field; On your belly you shall go, And dust you shall eat All the days of your life;
verses.textEn: So the Lord God said to the serpent, "Because you have done this, "Cursed are you above all livestock and all wild animals! You will crawl on your belly and you will eat dust all the days of your life.

verses.textZh: 我要使你和女人彼此为仇， 你的后裔和女人的后裔， 也彼此为仇， 他要伤你的头， 你要伤他的脚跟。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你和女人彼此为仇， 你的后裔和女人的后裔， 也彼此为仇， 他要伤你的头， 你要伤他的脚跟。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又要叫你和女人彼此为仇； 你的后裔和女人的后裔也彼此为仇。 女人的后裔要伤你的头； 你要伤他的脚跟。
verses.textEnNiv: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel."
verses.textEnEsv: I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring; he shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will put enmity Between you and the woman, And between your seed and her Seed; He shall bruise your head, And you shall bruise His heel."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will cause hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will strike your head, and you will strike his heel."
verses.textEnNasb: And I will make enemies Of you and the woman, And of your offspring and her Descendant; He shall bruise you on the head, And you shall bruise Him on the heel."
verses.textEn: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will crush your head, and you will strike his heel."

verses.textZh: 耶和华神对女人说： "我要大大增加你怀胎的痛苦， 你必在痛苦中生产儿女； 你要恋慕你的丈夫， 他却要管辖你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神对女人说： "我要大大增加你怀胎的痛苦， 你必在痛苦中生产儿女； 你要恋慕你的丈夫， 他却要管辖你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对女人说： 我必多多加增你怀胎的苦楚； 你生产儿女必多受苦楚。 你必恋慕你丈夫； 你丈夫必管辖你。
verses.textEnNiv: To the woman he said, "I will make your pains in childbearing very severe; with painful labor you will give birth to children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you."
verses.textEnEsv: To the woman he said, "I will surely multiply your pain in childbearing; in pain you shall bring forth children. Your desire shall be for your husband, and he shall rule over you."
verses.textEnNkjv: To the woman He said: "I will greatly multiply your sorrow and your conception; In pain you shall bring forth children; Your desire shallbe for your husband, And he shall rule over you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to the woman, "I will sharpen the pain of your pregnancy, and in pain you will give birth. And you will desire to control your husband, but he will rule over you. "
verses.textEnNasb: To the woman He said, "I will greatly multiply Your pain in childbirth, In pain you shall deliver children; Yet your desire will be for your husband, And he shall rule over you."
verses.textEn: To the woman he said, "I will make your pains in childbearing very severe; with painful labor you will give birth to children. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you."

verses.textZh: 耶和华神又对亚当说："因为你听从了你妻子的话，吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子； 地就必因你的缘故受咒诅； 你必终生劳苦，才能从地里得吃的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神又对亚当说："因为你听从了你妻子的话，吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子； 地就必因你的缘故受咒诅； 你必终生劳苦，才能从地里得吃的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又对亚当说： 你既听从妻子的话， 吃了我所吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子， 地必为你的缘故受咒诅； 你必终身劳苦才能从地里得吃的。
verses.textEnNiv: To Adam he said, "Because you listened to your wife and ate fruit from the tree about which I commanded you, ‘You must not eat from it,’ "Cursed is the ground because of you; through painful toil you will eat food from it all the days of your life.
verses.textEnEsv: And to Adam he said, "Because you have listened to the voice of your wife and have eaten of the tree of which I commanded you, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ cursed is the ground because of you; in pain you shall eat of it all the days of your life;
verses.textEnNkjv: Then to Adam He said, "Because you have heeded the voice of your wife, and have eaten from the tree of which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it’: "Cursed is the ground for your sake; In toil you shall eat of it All the days of your life.
verses.textEnNlt: And to the man he said, "Since you listened to your wife and ate from the tree whose fruit I commanded you not to eat, the ground is cursed because of you. All your life you will struggle to scratch a living from it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then to Adam He said, "Because you have listened to the voice of your wife, and have eaten from the tree about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat from it’; Cursed is the ground because of you; With hard labor you shall eat from it All the days of your life.
verses.textEn: To Adam he said, "Because you listened to your wife and ate fruit from the tree about which I commanded you, ‘You must not eat from it,’ "Cursed is the ground because of you; through painful toil you will eat food from it all the days of your life.

verses.textZh: 地要给你长出荆棘和蒺藜来； 你也要吃田间的蔬菜；
verses.textZhCnvs: 地要给你长出荆棘和蒺藜来； 你也要吃田间的蔬菜；
verses.textZhCuv: 地必给你长出荆棘和蒺藜来； 你也要吃田间的菜蔬。
verses.textEnNiv: It will produce thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.
verses.textEnEsv: thorns and thistles it shall bring forth for you; and you shall eat the plants of the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: Both thorns and thistles it shall bring forth for you, And you shall eat the herb of the field.
verses.textEnNlt: It will grow thorns and thistles for you, though you will eat of its grains.
verses.textEnNasb: "Both thorns and thistles it shall grow for you; Yet you shall eat the plants of the field;
verses.textEn: It will produce thorns and thistles for you, and you will eat the plants of the field.

verses.textZh: 你必汗流满面， 才有饭吃， 直到你归回地土， 因为你是从地土取出来的； 你既然是尘土，就要归回尘土。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必汗流满面， 才有饭吃， 直到你归回地土， 因为你是从地土取出来的； 你既然是尘土，就要归回尘土。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必汗流满面才得糊口， 直到你归了土， 因为你是从土而出的。 你本是尘土，仍要归于尘土。
verses.textEnNiv: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your food until you return to the ground, since from it you were taken; for dust you are and to dust you will return."
verses.textEnEsv: By the sweat of your face you shall eat bread, till you return to the ground, for out of it you were taken; for you are dust, and to dust you shall return."
verses.textEnNkjv: In the sweat of your face you shall eat bread Till you return to the ground, For out of it you were taken; For dust you are, And to dust you shall return."
verses.textEnNlt: By the sweat of your brow will you have food to eat until you return to the ground from which you were made. For you were made from dust, and to dust you will return."
verses.textEnNasb: By the sweat of your face You shall eat bread, Until you return to the ground, Because from it you were taken; For you are dust, And to dust you shall return."
verses.textEn: By the sweat of your brow you will eat your food until you return to the ground, since from it you were taken; for dust you are and to dust you will return."

verses.textZh: 亚当给他的妻子起名叫夏娃，因为她是众生之母。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚当给他的妻子起名叫夏娃，因为她是众生之母。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚当给他妻子起名叫夏娃，因为她是众生之母。
verses.textEnNiv: Adam named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.
verses.textEnEsv: The man called his wife’s name Eve, because she was the mother of all living.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Adam called his wife’s name Eve, because she was the mother of all living.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man—Adam—named his wife Eve, because she would be the mother of all who live.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the man named his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all the living.
verses.textEn: Adam named his wife Eve, because she would become the mother of all the living.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神为亚当和他的妻子做了皮衣，给他们穿上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神为亚当和他的妻子做了皮衣，给他们穿上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神为亚当和他妻子用皮子做衣服给他们穿。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and clothed them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord God made for Adam and for his wife garments of skins and clothed them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also for Adam and his wife the Lord God made tunics of skin, and clothed them.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord God made clothing from animal skins for Adam and his wife.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife, and clothed them.
verses.textEn: The Lord God made garments of skin for Adam and his wife and clothed them.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神说："那人和我们中间的一个相似，能知善恶；现在恐怕他伸出手来，摘取生命树上的果子吃，就永远活着。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神说："那人和我们中间的一个相似，能知善恶；现在恐怕他伸出手来，摘取生命树上的果子吃，就永远活着。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神说：「那人已经与我们相似，能知道善恶；现在恐怕他伸手又摘生命树的果子吃，就永远活着。」
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord God said, "The man has now become like one of us, knowing good and evil. He must not be allowed to reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life and eat, and live forever."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord God said, "Behold, the man has become like one of us in knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand and take also of the tree of life and eat, and live forever—"
