verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord God said, "Behold, the man has become like one of Us, to know good and evil. And now, lest he put out his hand and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever"—
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord God said, "Look, the human beings have become like us, knowing both good and evil. What if they reach out, take fruit from the tree of life, and eat it? Then they will live forever!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord God said, "Behold, the man has become like one of Us, knowing good and evil; and now, he might reach out with his hand, and take fruit also from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever"—
verses.textEn: And the Lord God said, "The man has now become like one of us, knowing good and evil. He must not be allowed to reach out his hand and take also from the tree of life and eat, and live forever."

verses.textZh: 耶和华神就把他赶出伊甸园，去耕种他自己也是从那里出来的地土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神就把他赶出伊甸园，去耕种他自己也是从那里出来的地土。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神便打发他出伊甸园去，耕种他所自出之土。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.
verses.textEnEsv: therefore the Lord God sent him out from the garden of Eden to work the ground from which he was taken.
verses.textEnNkjv: therefore the Lord God sent him out of the garden of Eden to till the ground from which he was taken.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord God banished them from the Garden of Eden, and he sent Adam out to cultivate the ground from which he had been made.
verses.textEnNasb: therefore the Lord God sent him out of the Garden of Eden, to cultivate the ground from which he was taken.
verses.textEn: So the Lord God banished him from the Garden of Eden to work the ground from which he had been taken.

verses.textZh: 于是把亚当驱逐出去，又派基路伯在伊甸园的东边，拿着旋转发火焰的剑，把守到生命树去的路。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是把亚当驱逐出去，又派基路伯在伊甸园的东边，拿着旋转发火焰的剑，把守到生命树去的路。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是把他赶出去了；又在伊甸园的东边安设基路伯和四面转动发火焰的剑，要把守生命树的道路。
verses.textEnNiv: After he drove the man out, he placed on the east side of the Garden of Eden cherubim and a flaming sword flashing back and forth to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.textEnEsv: He drove out the man, and at the east of the garden of Eden he placed the cherubim and a flaming sword that turned every way to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He drove out the man; and He placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.textEnNlt: After sending them out, the Lord God stationed mighty cherubim to the east of the Garden of Eden. And he placed a flaming sword that flashed back and forth to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.textEnNasb: So He drove the man out; and at the east of the Garden of Eden He stationed the cherubim and the flaming sword which turned every direction to guard the way to the tree of life.
verses.textEn: After he drove the man out, he placed on the east side of the Garden of Eden cherubim and a flaming sword flashing back and forth to guard the way to the tree of life.

verses.textZh: 亚当和他的妻子夏娃同房，夏娃就怀孕，生了该隐，就说："借着耶和华的帮助，我得了一个男儿。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚当和他的妻子夏娃同房，夏娃就怀孕，生了该隐，就说："借着耶和华的帮助，我得了一个男儿。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一日，那人和他妻子夏娃同房，夏娃就怀孕，生了该隐 ，便说：「耶和华使我得了一个男子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Adam made love to his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. She said, "With the help of the Lord I have brought forth a man."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, saying, "I have gotten a man with the help of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, and said, "I have acquired a man from the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Now Adam had sexual relations with his wife, Eve, and she became pregnant. When she gave birth to Cain, she said, "With the Lord ’s help, I have produced a man!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now the man had relations with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain, and she said, "I have obtained a male child with the help of the Lord."
verses.textEn: Adam made love to his wife Eve, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Cain. She said, "With the help of the Lord I have brought forth a man."

verses.textZh: 她又生了该隐的弟弟亚伯。亚伯是牧羊的，该隐是种地的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她又生了该隐的弟弟亚伯。亚伯是牧羊的，该隐是种地的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又生了该隐的兄弟亚伯。亚伯是牧羊的；该隐是种地的。
verses.textEnNiv: Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the soil.
verses.textEnEsv: And again, she bore his brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, and Cain a worker of the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she bore again, this time his brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: Later she gave birth to his brother and named him Abel. When they grew up, Abel became a shepherd, while Cain cultivated the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: And again, she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel was a keeper of flocks, but Cain was a cultivator of the ground.
verses.textEn: Later she gave birth to his brother Abel. Now Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the soil.

verses.textZh: 有一天，该隐把地里的出产拿来，当作礼物献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，该隐把地里的出产拿来，当作礼物献给耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一日，该隐拿地里的出产为供物献给耶和华；
verses.textEnNiv: In the course of time Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: In the course of time Cain brought to the Lord an offering of the fruit of the ground,
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the process of time it came to pass that Cain brought an offering of the fruit of the ground to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When it was time for the harvest, Cain presented some of his crops as a gift to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about in the course of time that Cain brought an offering to the Lord from the fruit of the ground.
verses.textEn: In the course of time Cain brought some of the fruits of the soil as an offering to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚伯也把自己羊群中一些头生的，和羊的脂油拿来献上。耶和华看中了亚伯和他的礼物；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯也把自己羊群中一些头生的，和羊的脂油拿来献上。耶和华看中了亚伯和他的礼物；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯也将他羊群中头生的和羊的脂油献上。耶和华看中了亚伯和他的供物，
verses.textEnNiv: And Abel also brought an offering—fat portions from some of the firstborn of his flock. The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering,
verses.textEnEsv: and Abel also brought of the firstborn of his flock and of their fat portions. And the Lord had regard for Abel and his offering,
verses.textEnNkjv: Abel also brought of the firstborn of his flock and of their fat. And the Lord respected Abel and his offering,
verses.textEnNlt: Abel also brought a gift—the best portions of the firstborn lambs from his flock. The Lord accepted Abel and his gift,
verses.textEnNasb: Abel, on his part also brought an offering, from the firstborn of his flock and from their fat portions. And the Lord had regard for Abel and his offering;
verses.textEn: And Abel also brought an offering—fat portions from some of the firstborn of his flock. The Lord looked with favor on Abel and his offering,

verses.textZh: 只是没有看中该隐和他的礼物。该隐就非常忿怒，垂头丧气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是没有看中该隐和他的礼物。该隐就非常忿怒，垂头丧气。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是看不中该隐和他的供物。该隐就大大地发怒，变了脸色。
verses.textEnNiv: but on Cain and his offering he did not look with favor. So Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.
verses.textEnEsv: but for Cain and his offering he had no regard. So Cain was very angry, and his face fell.
verses.textEnNkjv: but He did not respect Cain and his offering. And Cain was very angry, and his countenance fell.
verses.textEnNlt: but he did not accept Cain and his gift. This made Cain very angry, and he looked dejected.
verses.textEnNasb: but for Cain and his offering He had no regard. So Cain became very angry and his face was gloomy.
verses.textEn: but on Cain and his offering he did not look with favor. So Cain was very angry, and his face was downcast.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对该隐说："你为甚么忿怒呢？你为甚么垂头丧气呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对该隐说："你为甚么忿怒呢？你为甚么垂头丧气呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对该隐说：「你为什么发怒呢？你为什么变了脸色呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Why are you angry? Why is your face downcast?
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Cain, "Why are you angry, and why has your face fallen?
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said to Cain, "Why are you angry? And why has your countenance fallen?
verses.textEnNlt: "Why are you so angry?" the Lord asked Cain. "Why do you look so dejected?
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Why are you angry? And why is your face gloomy?
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Why are you angry? Why is your face downcast?

verses.textZh: 你若行得好，岂不可以抬起头来吗？你若行得不好，罪就伏在门口了；它要缠住你，你却要制伏它。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若行得好，岂不可以抬起头来吗？你若行得不好，罪就伏在门口了；它要缠住你，你却要制伏它。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你若行得好，岂不蒙悦纳？你若行得不好，罪就伏在门前。它必恋慕你，你却要制伏它。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you do not do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires to have you, but you must rule over it."
verses.textEnEsv: If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin is crouching at the door. Its desire is for you, and you must rule over it."
verses.textEnNkjv: If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin lies at the door. And its desire is for you, but you should rule over it."
verses.textEnNlt: You will be accepted if you do what is right. But if you refuse to do what is right, then watch out! Sin is crouching at the door, eager to control you. But you must subdue it and be its master."
verses.textEnNasb: If you do well, will your face not be cheerful? And if you do not do well, sin is lurking at the door; and its desire is for you, but you must master it."
verses.textEn: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you do not do what is right, sin is crouching at your door; it desires to have you, but you must rule over it."

verses.textZh: 该隐对他的弟弟亚伯说："我们到田间去吧。" ，该隐就起来袭击他的弟弟亚伯，把他杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 该隐对他的弟弟亚伯说："我们到田间去吧。" ，该隐就起来袭击他的弟弟亚伯，把他杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 该隐与他兄弟亚伯说话；二人正在田间。该隐起来打他兄弟亚伯，把他杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Cain said to his brother Abel, "Let’s go out to the field." While they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Cain spoke to Abel his brother. And when they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Cain talked with Abel his brother; and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother and killed him.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Cain suggested to his brother, "Let’s go out into the fields." And while they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother, Abel, and killed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Cain talked to his brother Abel; and it happened that when they were in the field Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.
verses.textEn: Now Cain said to his brother Abel, "Let’s go out to the field." While they were in the field, Cain attacked his brother Abel and killed him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华问该隐："你的弟弟亚伯在哪里？"他回答："我不知道；难道我是看守我弟弟的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华问该隐："你的弟弟亚伯在哪里？"他回答："我不知道；难道我是看守我弟弟的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对该隐说：「你兄弟亚伯在哪里？」他说：「我不知道！我岂是看守我兄弟的吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" "I don’t know," he replied. "Am I my brother’s keeper?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Where is Abel your brother?" He said, "I do not know; am I my brother’s keeper?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Where is Abel your brother?" He said, "I do not know. Am I my brother’s keeper?"
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward the Lord asked Cain, "Where is your brother? Where is Abel?" "I don’t know," Cain responded. "Am I my brother’s guardian?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Where is Abel your brother?" And he said, "I do not know. Am I my brother’s keeper?"
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" "I don’t know," he replied. "Am I my brother’s keeper?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："你作了甚么事呢？你弟弟的血有声音从地里向我呼叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："你作了甚么事呢？你弟弟的血有声音从地里向我呼叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「你做了什么事呢？你兄弟的血有声音从地里向我哀告。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said, "What have you done? Listen! Your brother’s blood cries out to me from the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood is crying to me from the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries out to Me from the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord said, "What have you done? Listen! Your brother’s blood cries out to me from the ground!
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood is crying out to Me from the ground.
verses.textEn: The Lord said, "What have you done? Listen! Your brother’s blood cries out to me from the ground.

verses.textZh: 地开了口，从你手里接受了你弟弟的血，现在你要从这地受咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地开了口，从你手里接受了你弟弟的血，现在你要从这地受咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 地开了口，从你手里接受你兄弟的血。现在你必从这地受咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: Now you are under a curse and driven from the ground, which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
verses.textEnEsv: And now you are cursed from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: So now you are cursed from the earth, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Now you are cursed and banished from the ground, which has swallowed your brother’s blood.
verses.textEnNasb: Now you are cursed from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
verses.textEn: Now you are under a curse and driven from the ground, which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

verses.textZh: 你种地，地也不再给你效力；你必在地上流离失所。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你种地，地也不再给你效力；你必在地上流离失所。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你种地，地不再给你效力；你必流离飘荡在地上。」
verses.textEnNiv: When you work the ground, it will no longer yield its crops for you. You will be a restless wanderer on the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: When you work the ground, it shall no longer yield to you its strength. You shall be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: When you till the ground, it shall no longer yield its strength to you. A fugitive and a vagabond you shall be on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: No longer will the ground yield good crops for you, no matter how hard you work! From now on you will be a homeless wanderer on the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: When you cultivate the ground, it will no longer yield its strength to you; you will be a wanderer and a drifter on the earth."
verses.textEn: When you work the ground, it will no longer yield its crops for you. You will be a restless wanderer on the earth."

verses.textZh: 该隐对耶和华说："我的刑罚太重，过于我所能担当。
verses.textZhCnvs: 该隐对耶和华说："我的刑罚太重，过于我所能担当。
verses.textZhCuv: 该隐对耶和华说：「我的刑罚太重，过于我所能当的。
verses.textEnNiv: Cain said to the Lord , "My punishment is more than I can bear.
verses.textEnEsv: Cain said to the Lord , "My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Cain said to the Lord, "My punishment is greater than I can bear!
verses.textEnNlt: Cain replied to the Lord , "My punishment is too great for me to bear!
verses.textEnNasb: Cain said to the Lord, "My punishment is too great to endure!
verses.textEn: Cain said to the Lord , "My punishment is more than I can bear.

verses.textZh: 看哪，今日你赶逐我离开这地，以致我要躲避你的面；我必在地上流离失所，遇见我的，都要杀我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，今日你赶逐我离开这地，以致我要躲避你的面；我必在地上流离失所，遇见我的，都要杀我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你如今赶逐我离开这地，以致不见你面；我必流离飘荡在地上，凡遇见我的必杀我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Today you are driving me from the land, and I will be hidden from your presence; I will be a restless wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you have driven me today away from the ground, and from your face I shall be hidden. I shall be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely You have driven me out this day from the face of the ground; I shall be hidden from Your face; I shall be a fugitive and a vagabond on the earth, and it will happen that anyone who finds me will kill me."
verses.textEnNlt: You have banished me from the land and from your presence; you have made me a homeless wanderer. Anyone who finds me will kill me!"
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, You have driven me this day from the face of the ground; and I will be hidden from Your face, and I will be a wanderer and a drifter on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me."
verses.textEn: Today you are driving me from the land, and I will be hidden from your presence; I will be a restless wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me."

verses.textZh: 耶和华对该隐说："绝不会这样，杀该隐的，必遭报七倍。"耶和华就给该隐立了一个记号，免得遇见他的人击杀他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对该隐说："绝不会这样，杀该隐的，必遭报七倍。"耶和华就给该隐立了一个记号，免得遇见他的人击杀他。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对他说：「凡杀该隐的，必遭报七倍。」耶和华就给该隐立一个记号，免得人遇见他就杀他。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord said to him, "Not so ; anyone who kills Cain will suffer vengeance seven times over." Then the Lord put a mark on Cain so that no one who found him would kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to him, "Not so! If anyone kills Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold." And the Lord put a mark on Cain, lest any who found him should attack him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to him, "Therefore, whoever kills Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold." And the Lord set a mark on Cain, lest anyone finding him should kill him.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied, "No, for I will give a sevenfold punishment to anyone who kills you." Then the Lord put a mark on Cain to warn anyone who might try to kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord said to him, "Therefore whoever kills Cain, vengeance will be taken on him seven times as much." And the Lord placed a mark on Cain, so that no one finding him would kill him.
verses.textEn: But the Lord said to him, "Not so ; anyone who kills Cain will suffer vengeance seven times over." Then the Lord put a mark on Cain so that no one who found him would kill him.

verses.textZh: 于是该隐从耶和华面前出去，住在伊甸东边的挪得地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是该隐从耶和华面前出去，住在伊甸东边的挪得地。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是该隐离开耶和华的面，去住在伊甸东边挪得之地。
verses.textEnNiv: So Cain went out from the Lord ’s presence and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Cain went away from the presence of the Lord and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Cain went out from the presence of the Lord and dwelt in the land of Nod on the east of Eden.
verses.textEnNlt: So Cain left the Lord ’s presence and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Cain left the presence of the Lord, and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
verses.textEn: So Cain went out from the Lord ’s presence and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

verses.textZh: 该隐和妻子同房，她就怀孕，生了以诺。该隐建造了一座城，就按着他儿子的名，给那城叫作以诺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 该隐和妻子同房，她就怀孕，生了以诺。该隐建造了一座城，就按着他儿子的名，给那城叫作以诺。
verses.textZhCuv: 该隐与妻子同房，他妻子就怀孕，生了以诺。该隐建造了一座城，就按着他儿子的名将那城叫做以诺。
verses.textEnNiv: Cain made love to his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain was then building a city, and he named it after his son Enoch.
verses.textEnEsv: Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Enoch. When he built a city, he called the name of the city after the name of his son, Enoch.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Ē´noch. And he built a city, and called the name of the city after the name of his son—Ē´noch.
verses.textEnNlt: Cain had sexual relations with his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Then Cain founded a city, which he named Enoch, after his son.
verses.textEnNasb: Cain had relations with his wife and she conceived, and gave birth to Enoch; and Cain built a city, and named the city Enoch, after the name of his son.
verses.textEn: Cain made love to his wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to Enoch. Cain was then building a city, and he named it after his son Enoch.

verses.textZh: 以诺生以拿，以拿生米户雅利，米户雅利生玛土撒利，玛土撒利生拉麦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以诺生以拿，以拿生米户雅利，米户雅利生玛土撒利，玛土撒利生拉麦。
verses.textZhCuv: 以诺生以拿；以拿生米户雅利；米户雅利生玛土撒利；玛土撒利生拉麦。
verses.textEnNiv: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech.
verses.textEnEsv: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad fathered Mehujael, and Mehujael fathered Methushael, and Methushael fathered Lamech.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Ē´noch was born Irad; and Irad begot Mehujael, and Mehujael begot Methushael, and Methushael begot Lamech.
verses.textEnNlt: Enoch had a son named Irad. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.
verses.textEnNasb: Now to Enoch was born Irad, and Irad fathered Mehujael, and Mehujael fathered Methushael, and Methushael fathered Lamech.
verses.textEn: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad was the father of Mehujael, and Mehujael was the father of Methushael, and Methushael was the father of Lamech.

verses.textZh: 拉麦娶了两个妻子，一个名叫亚大，另一个名叫洗拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉麦娶了两个妻子，一个名叫亚大，另一个名叫洗拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉麦娶了两个妻：一个名叫亚大，一个名叫洗拉。
verses.textEnNiv: Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.
verses.textEnEsv: And Lamech took two wives. The name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Lamech took for himself two wives: the name of one was Adah, and the name of the second was Zillah.
verses.textEnNlt: Lamech married two women. The first was named Adah, and the second was Zillah.
verses.textEnNasb: Lamech took two wives for himself: the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other, Zillah.
verses.textEn: Lamech married two women, one named Adah and the other Zillah.

verses.textZh: 亚大生雅八，雅八就是居住帐棚、牧养牲畜的人的鼻祖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚大生雅八，雅八就是居住帐棚、牧养牲畜的人的鼻祖。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚大生雅八；雅八就是住帐棚、牧养牲畜之人的祖师。
verses.textEnNiv: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and raise livestock.
verses.textEnEsv: Adah bore Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Adah bore Jabal. He was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.
verses.textEnNlt: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the first of those who raise livestock and live in tents.
verses.textEnNasb: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and have livestock.
verses.textEn: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and raise livestock.

verses.textZh: 雅八的兄弟名叫犹八；犹八是所有弹琴吹箫的人的鼻祖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅八的兄弟名叫犹八；犹八是所有弹琴吹箫的人的鼻祖。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅八的兄弟名叫犹八；他是一切弹琴吹箫之人的祖师。
verses.textEnNiv: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play stringed instruments and pipes.
verses.textEnEsv: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all those who play the lyre and pipe.
verses.textEnNkjv: His brother’s name was Jubal. He was the father of all those who play the harp and flute.
verses.textEnNlt: His brother’s name was Jubal, the first of all who play the harp and flute.
verses.textEnNasb: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all those who play the lyre and flute.
verses.textEn: His brother’s name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play stringed instruments and pipes.

verses.textZh: 洗拉也生了土八．该隐，就是打造各种铜铁器具的匠人；土八．该隐的妹妹是拿玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洗拉也生了土八．该隐，就是打造各种铜铁器具的匠人；土八．该隐的妹妹是拿玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 洗拉又生了土八‧该隐；他是打造各样铜铁利器的 。土八‧该隐的妹子是拿玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Zillah also had a son, Tubal-Cain, who forged all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.
verses.textEnEsv: Zillah also bore Tubal-cain; he was the forger of all instruments of bronze and iron. The sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for Zillah, she also bore Tubal-Cain, an instructor of every craftsman in bronze and iron. And the sister of Tubal-Cain was Naamah.
verses.textEnNlt: Lamech’s other wife, Zillah, gave birth to a son named Tubal-cain. He became an expert in forging tools of bronze and iron. Tubal-cain had a sister named Naamah.
verses.textEnNasb: As for Zillah, she also gave birth to Tubal-cain, the forger of all implements of bronze and iron; and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
verses.textEn: Zillah also had a son, Tubal-Cain, who forged all kinds of tools out of bronze and iron. Tubal-Cain’s sister was Naamah.

verses.textZh: 拉麦对他的两个妻子说： "亚大和洗拉，要听我的声音； 拉麦的妻子，聆听我的话： 壮年人伤我，我必杀他； 青年人损我，我必害他；
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉麦对他的两个妻子说： "亚大和洗拉，要听我的声音； 拉麦的妻子，聆听我的话： 壮年人伤我，我必杀他； 青年人损我，我必害他；
verses.textZhCuv: 拉麦对他两个妻子说： 亚大、洗拉，听我的声音； 拉麦的妻子，细听我的话语： 壮年人伤我，我把他杀了； 少年人损我，我把他害了 。
verses.textEnNiv: Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, listen to me; wives of Lamech, hear my words. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for injuring me.
verses.textEnEsv: Lamech said to his wives: "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; you wives of Lamech, listen to what I say: I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for striking me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Lamech said to his wives: "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; Wives of Lamech, listen to my speech! For I have killed a man for wounding me, Even a young man for hurting me.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; listen to me, you wives of Lamech. I have killed a man who attacked me, a young man who wounded me.
verses.textEnNasb: Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, Listen to my voice, You wives of Lamech, Pay attention to my words, For I have killed a man for wounding me; And a boy for striking me!
verses.textEn: Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, listen to me; wives of Lamech, hear my words. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for injuring me.

verses.textZh: 人若杀该隐，要遭报七倍； 人若杀拉麦，必遭报七十七倍！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 人若杀该隐，要遭报七倍； 人若杀拉麦，必遭报七十七倍！"
verses.textZhCuv: 若杀该隐，遭报七倍， 杀拉麦，必遭报七十七倍。
verses.textEnNiv: If Cain is avenged seven times, then Lamech seventy-seven times."
verses.textEnEsv: If Cain’s revenge is sevenfold, then Lamech’s is seventy-sevenfold."
verses.textEnNkjv: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, Then Lamech seventy-sevenfold."
verses.textEnNlt: If someone who kills Cain is punished seven times, then the one who kills me will be punished seventy-seven times!"
verses.textEnNasb: "If Cain is avenged seven times, Then Lamech seventy-seven times!"
verses.textEn: If Cain is avenged seven times, then Lamech seventy-seven times."

verses.textZh: 亚当又和妻子同房，她就生了一个儿子，给他起名叫塞特，因为她说："神给我立了另一个后裔代替亚伯，因为该隐杀了他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚当又和妻子同房，她就生了一个儿子，给他起名叫塞特，因为她说："神给我立了另一个后裔代替亚伯，因为该隐杀了他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚当又与妻子同房，她就生了一个儿子，起名叫塞特，意思说：「神另给我立了一个儿子代替亚伯，因为该隐杀了他。」
verses.textEnNiv: Adam made love to his wife again, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, "God has granted me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him."
verses.textEnEsv: And Adam knew his wife again, and she bore a son and called his name Seth, for she said, "God has appointed for me another offspring instead of Abel, for Cain killed him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Adam knew his wife again, and she bore a son and named him Seth, "For God has appointed another seed for me instead of Abel, whom Cain killed."
verses.textEnNlt: Adam had sexual relations with his wife again, and she gave birth to another son. She named him Seth, for she said, "God has granted me another son in place of Abel, whom Cain killed."
verses.textEnNasb: Adam had relations with his wife again; and she gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, for, she said, "God has appointed me another child in place of Abel, because Cain killed him."
verses.textEn: Adam made love to his wife again, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, "God has granted me another child in place of Abel, since Cain killed him."

verses.textZh: 塞特也生了一个儿子，就给他起名叫以挪士。那时人才开始呼求耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 塞特也生了一个儿子，就给他起名叫以挪士。那时人才开始呼求耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 塞特也生了一个儿子，起名叫以挪士。那时候，人才求告耶和华的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: To Seth also a son was born, and he called his name Enosh. At that time people began to call upon the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for Seth, to him also a son was born; and he named him Ē´nosh. Then men began to call on the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: When Seth grew up, he had a son and named him Enosh. At that time people first began to worship the Lord by name.
verses.textEnNasb: To Seth also a son was born; and he named him Enosh. Then people began to call upon the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Seth also had a son, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以下是亚当后代的记录。神创造人的时候，是按着自己的样式造的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是亚当后代的记录。神创造人的时候，是按着自己的样式造的；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚当的后代记在下面。（当神造人的日子，是照着自己的样式造的，
verses.textEnNiv: This is the written account of Adam’s family line. When God created mankind, he made them in the likeness of God.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the book of the generations of Adam. When God created man, he made him in the likeness of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the book of the genealogy of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in the likeness of God.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the written account of the descendants of Adam. When God created human beings, he made them to be like himself.
verses.textEnNasb: This is the book of the generations of Adam. On the day when God created man, He made him in the likeness of God.
verses.textEn: This is the written account of Adam’s family line. When God created mankind, he made them in the likeness of God.

verses.textZh: 他创造了一男一女。在创造他们的时候，神赐福给他们，称他们为人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他创造了一男一女。在创造他们的时候，神赐福给他们，称他们为人。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且造男造女。在他们被造的日子，神赐福给他们，称他们为「人」。）
verses.textEnNiv: He created them male and female and blessed them. And he named them "Mankind" when they were created.
verses.textEnEsv: Male and female he created them, and he blessed them and named them Man when they were created.
verses.textEnNkjv: He created them male and female, and blessed them and called them Mankind in the day they were created.
verses.textEnNlt: He created them male and female, and he blessed them and called them "human."
verses.textEnNasb: He created them male and female, and He blessed them and named them "mankind" on the day when they were created.
verses.textEn: He created them male and female and blessed them. And he named them "Mankind" when they were created.

verses.textZh: 亚当一百三十岁的时候，生了一个儿子，样式和形象都和自己相似，就给他起名叫塞特。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚当一百三十岁的时候，生了一个儿子，样式和形象都和自己相似，就给他起名叫塞特。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚当活到一百三十岁，生了一个儿子，形象样式和自己相似，就给他起名叫塞特。
verses.textEnNiv: When Adam had lived 130 years, he had a son in his own likeness, in his own image; and he named him Seth.
verses.textEnEsv: When Adam had lived 130 years, he fathered a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Adam lived one hundred and thirty years, and begot ason in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.
verses.textEnNlt: When Adam was 130 years old, he became the father of a son who was just like him—in his very image. He named his son Seth.
verses.textEnNasb: When Adam had lived 130 years, he fathered a son in his own likeness, according to his image, and named him Seth.
verses.textEn: When Adam had lived 130 years, he had a son in his own likeness, in his own image; and he named him Seth.

verses.textZh: 亚当生塞特以后，还活了八百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚当生塞特以后，还活了八百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚当生塞特之后，又在世八百年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: After Seth was born, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: The days of Adam after he fathered Seth were 800 years; and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Seth, the days of Adam were eight hundred years; and he had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Seth, Adam lived another 800 years, and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the days of Adam after he fathered Seth were eight hundred years, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: After Seth was born, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 亚当共活了九百三十岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚当共活了九百三十岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚当共活了九百三十岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the days that Adam lived were 930 years, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years; and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Adam lived 930 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days that Adam lived were 930 years, and he died.
verses.textEn: Altogether, Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 塞特一百零五岁的时候，生了以挪士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 塞特一百零五岁的时候，生了以挪士。
verses.textZhCuv: 塞特活到一百零五岁，生了以挪士。
verses.textEnNiv: When Seth had lived 105 years, he became the father of Enosh.
verses.textEnEsv: When Seth had lived 105 years, he fathered Enosh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Seth lived one hundred and five years, and begot Enosh.
verses.textEnNlt: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Seth lived 105 years, and fathered Enosh.
verses.textEn: When Seth had lived 105 years, he became the father of Enosh.

verses.textZh: 塞特生以挪士以后，还活了八百零七年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 塞特生以挪士以后，还活了八百零七年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 塞特生以挪士之后，又活了八百零七年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: After he became the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Seth lived after he fathered Enosh 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Enosh, Seth lived eight hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Enosh, Seth lived another 807 years, and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Seth lived 807 years after he fathered Enosh, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: After he became the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 塞特共活了九百一十二岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 塞特共活了九百一十二岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 塞特共活了九百一十二岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the days of Seth were 912 years, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years; and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Seth lived 912 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days of Seth were 912 years, and he died.
verses.textEn: Altogether, Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 以挪士九十岁的时候，生了该南。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以挪士九十岁的时候，生了该南。
verses.textZhCuv: 以挪士活到九十岁，生了该南。
verses.textEnNiv: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he became the father of Kenan.
verses.textEnEsv: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he fathered Kenan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Enosh lived ninety years, and begot Cainan.
verses.textEnNlt: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Enosh lived ninety years, and fathered Kenan.
verses.textEn: When Enosh had lived 90 years, he became the father of Kenan.

verses.textZhCnvs: 以挪士生该南以后，还活了八百一十五年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 以挪士生该南之后，又活了八百一十五年，并且生儿养女。

verses.textEnEsv: Enosh lived after he fathered Kenan 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Cainan, Enosh lived eight hundred and fifteen years, and had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Kenan, Enosh lived another 815 years, and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Enosh lived 815 years after he fathered Kenan, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: After he became the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 以挪士共活了九百零五岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以挪士共活了九百零五岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以挪士共活了九百零五岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the days of Enosh were 905 years, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years; and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Enosh lived 905 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days of Enosh were 905 years, and he died.
verses.textEn: Altogether, Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 该南七十岁的时候，生了玛勒列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 该南七十岁的时候，生了玛勒列。
verses.textZhCuv: 该南活到七十岁，生了玛勒列。
verses.textEnNiv: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he became the father of Mahalalel.
verses.textEnEsv: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he fathered Mahalalel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cainan lived seventy years, and begot Mahalalel.
verses.textEnNlt: When Kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Kenan lived seventy years, and fathered Mahalalel.
verses.textEn: When Kenan had lived 70 years, he became the father of Mahalalel.

verses.textZh: 该南生玛勒列以后，还活了八百四十年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 该南生玛勒列以后，还活了八百四十年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 该南生玛勒列之后，又活了八百四十年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: After he became the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Kenan lived after he fathered Mahalalel 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Mahalalel, Cainan lived eight hundred and forty years, and had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Mahalalel, Kenan lived another 840 years, and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Kenan lived 840 years after he fathered Mahalalel, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: After he became the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 该南共活了九百一十岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 该南共活了九百一十岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 该南共活了九百一十岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the days of Kenan were 910 years, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Kenan lived 910 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days of Kenan were 910 years, and he died.
verses.textEn: Altogether, Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 玛勒列六十五岁的时候，生了雅列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛勒列六十五岁的时候，生了雅列。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛勒列活到六十五岁，生了雅列。
verses.textEnNiv: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he became the father of Jared.
verses.textEnEsv: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he fathered Jared.
verses.textEnNkjv: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and begot Jared.
verses.textEnNlt: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and fathered Jared.
verses.textEn: When Mahalalel had lived 65 years, he became the father of Jared.

verses.textZh: 玛勒列生雅列以后，还活了八百三十年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛勒列生雅列以后，还活了八百三十年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛勒列生雅列之后，又活了八百三十年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: After he became the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Mahalalel lived after he fathered Jared 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Jared, Mahalalel lived eight hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Jared, Mahalalel lived another 830 years, and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Mahalalel lived 830 years after he fathered Jared, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: After he became the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 玛勒列共活了八百九十五岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛勒列共活了八百九十五岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛勒列共活了八百九十五岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the days of Mahalalel were 895 years, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred and ninety-five years; and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Mahalalel lived 895 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days of Mahalalel were 895 years, and he died.
verses.textEn: Altogether, Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 雅列一百六十二岁的时候，生了以诺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅列一百六十二岁的时候，生了以诺。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅列活到一百六十二岁，生了以诺。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jared had lived 162 years, he became the father of Enoch.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jared had lived 162 years, he fathered Enoch.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jared lived one hundred and sixty-two years, and begot Enoch.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jared lived 162 years, and fathered Enoch.
verses.textEn: When Jared had lived 162 years, he became the father of Enoch.

verses.textZh: 雅列生以诺以后，还活了八百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅列生以诺以后，还活了八百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅列生以诺之后，又活了八百年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: After he became the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Jared lived after he fathered Enoch 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Enoch, Jared lived eight hundred years, and had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Enoch, Jared lived another 800 years, and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jared lived eight hundred years after he fathered Enoch, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: After he became the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 雅列共活了九百六十二岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅列共活了九百六十二岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅列共活了九百六十二岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the days of Jared were 962 years, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years; and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Jared lived 962 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days of Jared were 962 years, and he died.
verses.textEn: Altogether, Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 以诺六十五岁的时候，生了玛土撒拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以诺六十五岁的时候，生了玛土撒拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 以诺活到六十五岁，生了玛土撒拉。
verses.textEnNiv: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he became the father of Methuselah.
verses.textEnEsv: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he fathered Methuselah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Enoch lived sixty-five years, and begot Methuselah.
verses.textEnNlt: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Enoch lived sixty-five years, and fathered Methuselah.
verses.textEn: When Enoch had lived 65 years, he became the father of Methuselah.

verses.textZh: 以诺生玛土撒拉以后，和神同行三百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以诺生玛土撒拉以后，和神同行三百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 以诺生玛土撒拉之后，与神同行三百年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: After he became the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked faithfully with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Enoch walked with God after he fathered Methuselah 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Methuselah, Enoch walked with God three hundred years, and had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Methuselah, Enoch lived in close fellowship with God for another 300 years, and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Enoch walked with God three hundred years after he fathered Methuselah, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: After he became the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked faithfully with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 以诺共活了三百六十五岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以诺共活了三百六十五岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 以诺共活了三百六十五岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, Enoch lived a total of 365 years.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the days of Enoch were 365 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.
verses.textEnNlt: Enoch lived 365 years,
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days of Enoch were 365 years.
verses.textEn: Altogether, Enoch lived a total of 365 years.

verses.textZh: 以诺和神同行，所以神把他取去，他就不在了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以诺和神同行，所以神把他取去，他就不在了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以诺与神同行，神将他取去，他就不在世了。
verses.textEnNiv: Enoch walked faithfully with God; then he was no more, because God took him away.
verses.textEnEsv: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Enoch walked with God; and he was not, for God took him.
verses.textEnNlt: walking in close fellowship with God. Then one day he disappeared, because God took him.
verses.textEnNasb: Enoch walked with God; and he was not, for God took him.
verses.textEn: Enoch walked faithfully with God; then he was no more, because God took him away.

verses.textZh: 玛土撒拉一百八十七岁的时候，生了拉麦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛土撒拉一百八十七岁的时候，生了拉麦。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛土撒拉活到一百八十七岁，生了拉麦。
verses.textEnNiv: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he became the father of Lamech.
verses.textEnEsv: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he fathered Lamech.
verses.textEnNkjv: Methuselah lived one hundred and eighty-seven years, and begot Lamech.
verses.textEnNlt: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Methuselah lived 187 years, and fathered Lamech.
verses.textEn: When Methuselah had lived 187 years, he became the father of Lamech.

verses.textZh: 玛土撒拉生拉麦以后，还活了七百八十二年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛土撒拉生拉麦以后，还活了七百八十二年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛土撒拉生拉麦之后，又活了七百八十二年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: After he became the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Methuselah lived after he fathered Lamech 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Lamech, Methuselah lived seven hundred and eighty-two years, and had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Lamech, Methuselah lived another 782 years, and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Methuselah lived 782 years after he fathered Lamech, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: After he became the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 玛土撒拉共活了九百六十九岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛土撒拉共活了九百六十九岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛土撒拉共活了九百六十九岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the days of Methuselah were 969 years, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred and sixty-nine years; and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Methuselah lived 969 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days of Methuselah were 969 years, and he died.
verses.textEn: Altogether, Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 拉麦一百八十二岁的时候，生了一个儿子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉麦一百八十二岁的时候，生了一个儿子，
verses.textZhCuv: 拉麦活到一百八十二岁，生了一个儿子，
verses.textEnNiv: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he had a son.
verses.textEnEsv: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he fathered a son
verses.textEnNkjv: Lamech lived one hundred and eighty-two years, and had a son.
verses.textEnNlt: When Lamech was 182 years old, he became the father of a son.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Lamech lived 182 years, and fathered a son.
verses.textEn: When Lamech had lived 182 years, he had a son.

verses.textZh: 就给他起名叫挪亚，说："这儿子必使我们从地上的操作和手中的劳苦得着安慰，因为耶和华曾经咒诅这地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就给他起名叫挪亚，说："这儿子必使我们从地上的操作和手中的劳苦得着安慰，因为耶和华曾经咒诅这地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 给他起名叫挪亚，说：「这个儿子必为我们的操作和手中的劳苦安慰我们；这操作劳苦是因为耶和华咒诅地。」
verses.textEnNiv: He named him Noah and said, "He will comfort us in the labor and painful toil of our hands caused by the ground the Lord has cursed."
verses.textEnEsv: and called his name Noah, saying, "Out of the ground that the Lord has cursed, this one shall bring us relief from our work and from the painful toil of our hands."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he called his name Noah, saying, "This one will comfort us concerning our work and the toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord has cursed."
verses.textEnNlt: Lamech named his son Noah, for he said, "May he bring us relief from our work and the painful labor of farming this ground that the Lord has cursed."
verses.textEnNasb: And he named him Noah, saying, "This one will give us comfort from our work and from the hard labor of our hands caused by the ground which the Lord has cursed."
verses.textEn: He named him Noah and said, "He will comfort us in the labor and painful toil of our hands caused by the ground the Lord has cursed."

verses.textZh: 拉麦生挪亚以后，还活了五百九十五年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉麦生挪亚以后，还活了五百九十五年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉麦生挪亚之后，又活了五百九十五年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: After Noah was born, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: Lamech lived after he fathered Noah 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Noah, Lamech lived five hundred and ninety-five years, and had sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Noah, Lamech lived another 595 years, and he had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Lamech lived 595 years after he fathered Noah, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: After Noah was born, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 拉麦共活了七百七十七岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉麦共活了七百七十七岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉麦共活了七百七十七岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Altogether, Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus all the days of Lamech were 777 years, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy-seven years; and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: Lamech lived 777 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days of Lamech were 777 years, and he died.
verses.textEn: Altogether, Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 挪亚五百岁的时候，就生了闪、含和雅弗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚五百岁的时候，就生了闪、含和雅弗。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚五百岁生了闪、含、雅弗。
verses.textEnNiv: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.
verses.textEnEsv: After Noah was 500 years old, Noah fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEnNlt: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after Noah was five hundred years old, Noah fathered Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEn: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham and Japheth.

verses.textZh: 人在地上开始增多，又生养女儿的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 人在地上开始增多，又生养女儿的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 当人在世上多起来、又生女儿的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: When human beings began to increase in number on the earth and daughters were born to them,
verses.textEnEsv: When man began to multiply on the face of the land and daughters were born to them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born to them,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the people began to multiply on the earth, and daughters were born to them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when mankind began to multiply on the face of the land, and daughters were born to them,
verses.textEn: When human beings began to increase in number on the earth and daughters were born to them,

verses.textZh: 神的众子看见人的女子美丽，就随意挑选，娶作妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的众子看见人的女子美丽，就随意挑选，娶作妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的儿子们看见人的女子美貌，就随意挑选，娶来为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: the sons of God saw that the daughters of humans were beautiful, and they married any of them they chose.
verses.textEnEsv: the sons of God saw that the daughters of man were attractive. And they took as their wives any they chose.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the sons of God saw the daughters of men, that they were beautiful; and they took wives for themselves of all whom they chose.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of God saw the beautiful women and took any they wanted as their wives.
verses.textEnNasb: that the sons of God saw that the daughters of mankind were beautiful; and they took wives for themselves, whomever they chose.
verses.textEn: the sons of God saw that the daughters of humans were beautiful, and they married any of them they chose.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："人既然是属肉体的，我的灵就不永远住在他里面，但他的日子还有一百二十年。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："人既然是属肉体的，我的灵就不永远住在他里面，但他的日子还有一百二十年。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「人既属乎血气，我的灵就不永远住在他里面；然而他的日子还可到一百二十年。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said, "My Spirit will not contend with humans forever, for they are mortal ; their days will be a hundred and twenty years."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said, "My Spirit shall not abide in man forever, for he is flesh: his days shall be 120 years."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "My Spirit shall not strive with man forever, for he is indeed flesh; yet his days shall be one hundred and twenty years."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said, "My Spirit will not put up with humans for such a long time, for they are only mortal flesh. In the future, their normal lifespan will be no more than 120 years."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said, "My Spirit will not remain with man forever, because he is also flesh; nevertheless his days shall be 120 years."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said, "My Spirit will not contend with humans forever, for they are mortal ; their days will be a hundred and twenty years."

verses.textZh: 在那些日子和以后的日子，有巨人在地上；神的儿子和人的女子结合，就生了上古英武有名的人物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那些日子和以后的日子，有巨人在地上；神的儿子和人的女子结合，就生了上古英武有名的人物。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时候有伟人在地上，后来神的儿子们和人的女子们交合生子；那就是上古英武有名的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and also afterward—when the sons of God went to the daughters of humans and had children by them. They were the heroes of old, men of renown.
verses.textEnEsv: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of man and they bore children to them. These were the mighty men who were of old, the men of renown.
verses.textEnNkjv: There were giants on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of men and they bore children to them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.
verses.textEnNlt: In those days, and for some time after, giant Nephilites lived on the earth, for whenever the sons of God had intercourse with women, they gave birth to children who became the heroes and famous warriors of ancient times.
verses.textEnNasb: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also afterward, when the sons of God came in to the daughters of mankind, and they bore children to them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.
verses.textEn: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days—and also afterward—when the sons of God went to the daughters of humans and had children by them. They were the heroes of old, men of renown.

verses.textZh: 耶和华看见人在地上的罪恶很大，终日心里思念的，尽都是邪恶的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华看见人在地上的罪恶很大，终日心里思念的，尽都是邪恶的。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华见人在地上罪恶很大，终日所思想的尽都是恶，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord saw how great the wickedness of the human race had become on the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil all the time.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every intention of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every intent of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord observed the extent of human wickedness on the earth, and he saw that everything they thought or imagined was consistently and totally evil.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord saw that the wickedness of mankind was great on the earth, and that every intent of the thoughts of their hearts was only evil continually.
verses.textEn: The Lord saw how great the wickedness of the human race had become on the earth, and that every inclination of the thoughts of the human heart was only evil all the time.

verses.textZh: 于是，耶和华后悔造人在地上，心中忧伤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，耶和华后悔造人在地上，心中忧伤。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华就后悔造人在地上，心中忧伤。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord regretted that he had made human beings on the earth, and his heart was deeply troubled.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord regretted that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him to his heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord was sorry that He had made man on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord was sorry he had ever made them and put them on the earth. It broke his heart.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord was sorry that He had made mankind on the earth, and He was grieved in His heart.
verses.textEn: The Lord regretted that he had made human beings on the earth, and his heart was deeply troubled.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我要把我创造的人，从地上消灭；无论是人或牲畜，是爬行的动物或是天空的飞鸟，我都要消灭，因为我后悔造了他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我要把我创造的人，从地上消灭；无论是人或牲畜，是爬行的动物或是天空的飞鸟，我都要消灭，因为我后悔造了他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我要将所造的人和走兽，并昆虫，以及空中的飞鸟，都从地上除灭，因为我造他们后悔了。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord said, "I will wipe from the face of the earth the human race I have created—and with them the animals, the birds and the creatures that move along the ground—for I regret that I have made them."
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord said, "I will blot out man whom I have created from the face of the land, man and animals and creeping things and birds of the heavens, for I am sorry that I have made them."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord said, "I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth, both man and beast, creeping thing and birds of the air, for I am sorry that I have made them."
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord said, "I will wipe this human race I have created from the face of the earth. Yes, and I will destroy every living thing—all the people, the large animals, the small animals that scurry along the ground, and even the birds of the sky. I am sorry I ever made them."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said, "I will wipe out mankind whom I have created from the face of the land; mankind, and animals as well, and crawling things, and the birds of the sky. For I am sorry that I have made them."
verses.textEn: So the Lord said, "I will wipe from the face of the earth the human race I have created—and with them the animals, the birds and the creatures that move along the ground—for I regret that I have made them."

verses.textZh: 只有挪亚在耶和华眼前蒙恩。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有挪亚在耶和华眼前蒙恩。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有挪亚在耶和华眼前蒙恩。
verses.textEnNiv: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But Noah found favor with the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord.
verses.textEn: But Noah found favor in the eyes of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 以下是挪亚的后代。挪亚是个义人，是当时一个完全人。挪亚和神同行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是挪亚的后代。挪亚是个义人，是当时一个完全人。挪亚和神同行。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚的后代记在下面。挪亚是个义人，在当时的世代是个完全人。挪亚与神同行。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of Noah and his family. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time, and he walked faithfully with God.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation. Noah walked with God.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the genealogy of Noah. Noah was a just man, perfect in his generations. Noah walked with God.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of Noah and his family. Noah was a righteous man, the only blameless person living on earth at the time, and he walked in close fellowship with God.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the records of the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless in his generation. Noah walked with God.
verses.textEn: This is the account of Noah and his family. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time, and he walked faithfully with God.

verses.textZh: 挪亚生了三个儿子，就是闪、含、雅弗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚生了三个儿子，就是闪、含、雅弗。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚生了三个儿子，就是闪、含、雅弗。
verses.textEnNiv: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth.
verses.textEnEsv: And Noah had three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Noah begot three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEnNlt: Noah was the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEnNasb: And Noah fathered three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.textEn: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham and Japheth.

verses.textZh: 当时，世界在神面前败坏了，地上满了强暴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，世界在神面前败坏了，地上满了强暴。
verses.textZhCuv: 世界在神面前败坏，地上满了强暴。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight and was full of violence.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.textEnNkjv: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.textEnNlt: Now God saw that the earth had become corrupt and was filled with violence.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the earth was corrupt in the sight of God, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.textEn: Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight and was full of violence.

verses.textZh: 神观看大地，看见世界已经败坏了；全人类在地上所行的都是败坏的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神观看大地，看见世界已经败坏了；全人类在地上所行的都是败坏的。
verses.textZhCuv: 神观看世界，见是败坏了；凡有血气的人在地上都败坏了行为。
verses.textEnNiv: God saw how corrupt the earth had become, for all the people on earth had corrupted their ways.
verses.textEnEsv: And God saw the earth, and behold, it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So God looked upon the earth, and indeed it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: God observed all this corruption in the world, for everyone on earth was corrupt.
verses.textEnNasb: And God looked on the earth, and behold, it was corrupt; for humanity had corrupted its way upon the earth.
verses.textEn: God saw how corrupt the earth had become, for all the people on earth had corrupted their ways.

verses.textZh: 神对挪亚说："在我面前全人类的尽头已经来到，因为地上由于他们的缘故满了强暴。看哪，我要把他们和世界一起毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对挪亚说："在我面前全人类的尽头已经来到，因为地上由于他们的缘故满了强暴。看哪，我要把他们和世界一起毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 神就对挪亚说：「凡有血气的人，他的尽头已经来到我面前；因为地上满了他们的强暴，我要把他们和地一并毁灭。
verses.textEnNiv: So God said to Noah, "I am going to put an end to all people, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. I am surely going to destroy both them and the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said to Noah, "I have determined to make an end of all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God said to Noah, "The end of all flesh has come before Me, for the earth is filled with violence through them; and behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: So God said to Noah, "I have decided to destroy all living creatures, for they have filled the earth with violence. Yes, I will wipe them all out along with the earth!
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said to Noah, "The end of humanity has come before Me; for the earth is filled with violence because of people; and behold, I am about to destroy them with the earth.
verses.textEn: So God said to Noah, "I am going to put an end to all people, for the earth is filled with violence because of them. I am surely going to destroy both them and the earth.

verses.textZh: 你要用歌斐木做一艘方舟。方舟里面要做一些舱房；方舟的内外都要涂上沥青。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要用歌斐木做一艘方舟。方舟里面要做一些舱房；方舟的内外都要涂上沥青。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要用歌斐木造一只方舟，分一间一间地造，里外抹上松香。
verses.textEnNiv: So make yourself an ark of cypress wood; make rooms in it and coat it with pitch inside and out.
verses.textEnEsv: Make yourself an ark of gopher wood. Make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and out with pitch.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make yourself an ark of gopherwood; make rooms in the ark, and cover it inside and outside with pitch.
verses.textEnNlt: "Build a large boat from cypress wood and waterproof it with tar, inside and out. Then construct decks and stalls throughout its interior.
verses.textEnNasb: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood; you shall make the ark with compartments, and cover it inside and out with pitch.
verses.textEn: So make yourself an ark of cypress wood; make rooms in it and coat it with pitch inside and out.

verses.textZh: 你要这样做方舟：方舟要长一百三十三公尺，宽二十二公尺，高十三公尺。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要这样做方舟：方舟要长一百三十三公尺，宽二十二公尺，高十三公尺。
verses.textZhCuv: 方舟的造法乃是这样：要长三百肘，宽五十肘，高三十肘。
verses.textEnNiv: This is how you are to build it: The ark is to be three hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high.
verses.textEnEsv: This is how you are to make it: the length of the ark 300 cubits, its breadth 50 cubits, and its height 30 cubits.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is how you shall make it: The length of the ark shallbe three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
verses.textEnNlt: Make the boat 450 feet long, 75 feet wide, and 45 feet high.
verses.textEnNasb: This is how you shall make it: the length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.
verses.textEn: This is how you are to build it: The ark is to be three hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high.

verses.textZh: 方舟上面四周要做透光口，高四十四公寸；方舟的门要开在旁边；方舟要分为上中下三层建造。
verses.textZhCnvs: 方舟上面四周要做透光口，高四十四公寸；方舟的门要开在旁边；方舟要分为上中下三层建造。
verses.textZhCuv: 方舟上边要留透光处，高一肘。方舟的门要开在旁边。方舟要分上、中、下三层。
verses.textEnNiv: Make a roof for it, leaving below the roof an opening one cubit high all around. Put a door in the side of the ark and make lower, middle and upper decks.
verses.textEnEsv: Make a roof for the ark, and finish it to a cubit above, and set the door of the ark in its side. Make it with lower, second, and third decks.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall make a window for the ark, and you shall finish it to a cubit from above; and set the door of the ark in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third decks.
verses.textEnNlt: Leave an 18-inch opening below the roof all the way around the boat. Put the door on the side, and build three decks inside the boat—lower, middle, and upper.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall make a window for the ark, and finish it to a cubit from the top; and put the door of the ark on the side; you shall make it with lower, second, and third decks.
verses.textEn: Make a roof for it, leaving below the roof an opening one cubit high all around. Put a door in the side of the ark and make lower, middle and upper decks.

verses.textZh: 看哪，我要使洪水临到地上，消灭天下的生物，就是有生气的活物；在地上的都必定要死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，我要使洪水临到地上，消灭天下的生物，就是有生气的活物；在地上的都必定要死。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，我要使洪水氾滥在地上，毁灭天下；凡地上有血肉、有气息的活物，无一不死。
verses.textEnNiv: I am going to bring floodwaters on the earth to destroy all life under the heavens, every creature that has the breath of life in it. Everything on earth will perish.
verses.textEnEsv: For behold, I will bring a flood of waters upon the earth to destroy all flesh in which is the breath of life under heaven. Everything that is on the earth shall die.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, I Myself am bringing floodwaters on the earth, to destroy from under heaven all flesh in which is the breath of life; everything that is on the earth shall die.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look! I am about to cover the earth with a flood that will destroy every living thing that breathes. Everything on earth will die.
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, I Myself am bringing the flood of water upon the earth, to destroy all flesh in which there is the breath of life, from under heaven; everything that is on the earth shall perish.
verses.textEn: I am going to bring floodwaters on the earth to destroy all life under the heavens, every creature that has the breath of life in it. Everything on earth will perish.

verses.textZh: 我要和你立约。你可以进入方舟；你和你的儿子、妻子和儿媳，都可以和你一同进入方舟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要和你立约。你可以进入方舟；你和你的儿子、妻子和儿媳，都可以和你一同进入方舟。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却要与你立约；你同你的妻，与儿子儿妇，都要进入方舟。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will establish my covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.
verses.textEnEsv: But I will establish my covenant with you, and you shall come into the ark, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall go into the ark—you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will confirm my covenant with you. So enter the boat—you and your wife and your sons and their wives.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will establish My covenant with you; and you shall enter the ark—you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.
verses.textEn: But I will establish my covenant with you, and you will enter the ark—you and your sons and your wife and your sons’ wives with you.

verses.textZh: 所有的活物，你要把每样一对，就是一公一母，带进方舟，好和你一同保全生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有的活物，你要把每样一对，就是一公一母，带进方舟，好和你一同保全生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有血肉的活物，每样两个，一公一母，你要带进方舟，好在你那里保全生命。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to bring into the ark two of all living creatures, male and female, to keep them alive with you.
verses.textEnEsv: And of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ark to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.
verses.textEnNkjv: And of every living thing of all flesh you shall bring two of every sort into the ark, to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.
verses.textEnNlt: Bring a pair of every kind of animal—a male and a female—into the boat with you to keep them alive during the flood.
verses.textEnNasb: And of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every kind into the ark, to keep them alive with you; they shall be male and female.
verses.textEn: You are to bring into the ark two of all living creatures, male and female, to keep them alive with you.

verses.textZh: 飞鸟各从其类，牲畜各从其类，地上所有爬行的动物，各从其类，每样一对，都要到你那里来，好保全生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 飞鸟各从其类，牲畜各从其类，地上所有爬行的动物，各从其类，每样一对，都要到你那里来，好保全生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 飞鸟各从其类，牲畜各从其类，地上的昆虫各从其类，每样两个，要到你那里，好保全生命。
verses.textEnNiv: Two of every kind of bird, of every kind of animal and of every kind of creature that moves along the ground will come to you to be kept alive.
verses.textEnEsv: Of the birds according to their kinds, and of the animals according to their kinds, of every creeping thing of the ground, according to its kind, two of every sort shall come in to you to keep them alive.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the birds after their kind, of animals after their kind, and of every creeping thing of the earth after its kind, two of every kind will come to you to keep them alive.
verses.textEnNlt: Pairs of every kind of bird, and every kind of animal, and every kind of small animal that scurries along the ground, will come to you to be kept alive.
verses.textEnNasb: Of the birds according to their kind, and of the animals according to their kind, of every crawling thing of the ground according to its kind, two of every kind will come to you to keep them alive.
verses.textEn: Two of every kind of bird, of every kind of animal and of every kind of creature that moves along the ground will come to you to be kept alive.

verses.textZh: 你要拿各种可吃的食物，积存起来，好作你和牠们的食物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要拿各种可吃的食物，积存起来，好作你和牠们的食物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你要拿各样食物积蓄起来，好作你和它们的食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: You are to take every kind of food that is to be eaten and store it away as food for you and for them."
verses.textEnEsv: Also take with you every sort of food that is eaten, and store it up. It shall serve as food for you and for them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And you shall take for yourself of all food that is eaten, and you shall gather it to yourself; and it shall be food for you and for them."
verses.textEnNlt: And be sure to take on board enough food for your family and for all the animals."
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, take for yourself some of every food that is edible, and gather it to yourself; and it shall be food for you and them."
verses.textEn: You are to take every kind of food that is to be eaten and store it away as food for you and for them."

verses.textZh: 挪亚就这样作了；神吩咐他的，他都照样作了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚就这样作了；神吩咐他的，他都照样作了。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚就这样行。凡神所吩咐的，他都照样行了。
verses.textEnNiv: Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: Noah did this; he did all that God commanded him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Noah did; according to all that God commanded him, so he did.
verses.textEnNlt: So Noah did everything exactly as God had commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Noah did these things; according to everything that God had commanded him, so he did.
verses.textEn: Noah did everything just as God commanded him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对挪亚说："你和你全家都要进入方舟，因为在这世代中，我见只有你在我面前是个义人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对挪亚说："你和你全家都要进入方舟，因为在这世代中，我见只有你在我面前是个义人。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对挪亚说：「你和你的全家都要进入方舟；因为在这世代中，我见你在我面前是义人。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord then said to Noah, "Go into the ark, you and your whole family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Noah, "Go into the ark, you and all your household, for I have seen that you are righteous before me in this generation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Noah, "Come into the ark, you and all your household, because I have seen that you are righteous before Me in this generation.
verses.textEnNlt: When everything was ready, the Lord said to Noah, "Go into the boat with all your family, for among all the people of the earth, I can see that you alone are righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Noah, "Enter the ark, you and all your household, for you alone I have seen to be righteous before Me in this generation.
verses.textEn: The Lord then said to Noah, "Go into the ark, you and your whole family, because I have found you righteous in this generation.

verses.textZh: 洁净的牲畜，你要各带七公七母；不洁净的牲畜，你要各带一公一母；
verses.textZhCnvs: 洁净的牲畜，你要各带七公七母；不洁净的牲畜，你要各带一公一母；
verses.textZhCuv: 凡洁净的畜类，你要带七公七母；不洁净的畜类，你要带一公一母；
verses.textEnNiv: Take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate, and one pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate,
verses.textEnEsv: Take with you seven pairs of all clean animals, the male and his mate, and a pair of the animals that are not clean, the male and his mate,
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall take with you seven each of every clean animal, a male and his female; two each of animals that are unclean, a male and his female;
verses.textEnNlt: Take with you seven pairs—male and female—of each animal I have approved for eating and for sacrifice, and take one pair of each of the others.
verses.textEnNasb: You shall take with you seven pairs of every clean animal, a male and his female; and two of the animals that are not clean, a male and his female;
verses.textEn: Take with you seven pairs of every kind of clean animal, a male and its mate, and one pair of every kind of unclean animal, a male and its mate,

verses.textZh: 空中的飞鸟，也要各带七公七母，以便传种，活在全地上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 空中的飞鸟，也要各带七公七母，以便传种，活在全地上；
verses.textZhCuv: 空中的飞鸟也要带七公七母，可以留种，活在全地上；
verses.textEnNiv: and also seven pairs of every kind of bird, male and female, to keep their various kinds alive throughout the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: and seven pairs of the birds of the heavens also, male and female, to keep their offspring alive on the face of all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: also seven each of birds of the air, male and female, to keep the species alive on the face of all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Also take seven pairs of every kind of bird. There must be a male and a female in each pair to ensure that all life will survive on the earth after the flood.
verses.textEnNasb: also of the birds of the sky, seven pairs, male and female, to keep their offspring alive on the face of all the earth.
verses.textEn: and also seven pairs of every kind of bird, male and female, to keep their various kinds alive throughout the earth.

verses.textZh: 因为再过七天，我就要一连四十昼夜降雨在地上，我把所造的一切生物都从地上除灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为再过七天，我就要一连四十昼夜降雨在地上，我把所造的一切生物都从地上除灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为再过七天，我要降雨在地上四十昼夜，把我所造的各种活物都从地上除灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: Seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living creature I have made."
verses.textEnEsv: For in seven days I will send rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and every living thing that I have made I will blot out from the face of the ground."
verses.textEnNkjv: For after seven more days I will cause it to rain on the earth forty days and forty nights, and I will destroy from the face of the earth all living things that I have made."
verses.textEnNlt: Seven days from now I will make the rains pour down on the earth. And it will rain for forty days and forty nights, until I have wiped from the earth all the living things I have created."
verses.textEnNasb: For after seven more days, I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights; and I will wipe out from the face of the land every living thing that I have made."
verses.textEn: Seven days from now I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, and I will wipe from the face of the earth every living creature I have made."

verses.textZh: 挪亚就照着耶和华吩咐他的一切作了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚就照着耶和华吩咐他的一切作了。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚就遵着耶和华所吩咐的行了。
verses.textEnNiv: And Noah did all that the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Noah did all that the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Noah did according to all that the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Noah did everything as the Lord commanded him.
verses.textEnNasb: So Noah acted in accordance with everything that the Lord had commanded him.
verses.textEn: And Noah did all that the Lord commanded him.

verses.textZh: 洪水临到地上的时候，挪亚刚好是六百岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洪水临到地上的时候，挪亚刚好是六百岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 当洪水氾滥在地上的时候，挪亚整六百岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came upon the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters were on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Noah was 600 years old when the flood covered the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of water came upon the earth.
verses.textEn: Noah was six hundred years old when the floodwaters came on the earth.

verses.textZh: 挪亚带着他的儿子、妻子和儿媳一同进了方舟，躲避洪水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚带着他的儿子、妻子和儿媳一同进了方舟，躲避洪水。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚就同他的妻和儿子儿妇都进入方舟，躲避洪水。
verses.textEnNiv: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
verses.textEnEsv: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives with him went into the ark to escape the waters of the flood.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Noah, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, went into the ark because of the waters of the flood.
verses.textEnNlt: He went on board the boat to escape the flood—he and his wife and his sons and their wives.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Noah and his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him entered the ark because of the waters of the flood.
verses.textEn: And Noah and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives entered the ark to escape the waters of the flood.

verses.textZh: 洁净的牲畜和不洁净的牲畜，飞鸟和各种在地上爬行的动物，
verses.textZhCnvs: 洁净的牲畜和不洁净的牲畜，飞鸟和各种在地上爬行的动物，
verses.textZhCuv: 洁净的畜类和不洁净的畜类，飞鸟并地上一切的昆虫，
verses.textEnNiv: Pairs of clean and unclean animals, of birds and of all creatures that move along the ground,
verses.textEnEsv: Of clean animals, and of animals that are not clean, and of birds, and of everything that creeps on the ground,
verses.textEnNkjv: Of clean animals, of animals that are unclean, of birds, and of everything that creeps on the earth,
