verses.textEnNlt: With them were all the various kinds of animals—those approved for eating and for sacrifice and those that were not—along with all the birds and the small animals that scurry along the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Of clean animals and animals that are not clean and birds and everything that crawls on the ground,
verses.textEn: Pairs of clean and unclean animals, of birds and of all creatures that move along the ground,

verses.textZh: 都是一公一母、一对一对来到挪亚那里，进入方舟，是照着神吩咐挪亚的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 都是一公一母、一对一对来到挪亚那里，进入方舟，是照着神吩咐挪亚的。
verses.textZhCuv: 都是一对一对地，有公有母，到挪亚那里进入方舟，正如神所吩咐挪亚的。
verses.textEnNiv: male and female, came to Noah and entered the ark, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.textEnEsv: two and two, male and female, went into the ark with Noah, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.textEnNkjv: two by two they went into the ark to Noah, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.textEnNlt: They entered the boat in pairs, male and female, just as God had commanded Noah.
verses.textEnNasb: they all went into the ark to Noah by twos, male and female, as God had commanded Noah.
verses.textEn: male and female, came to Noah and entered the ark, as God had commanded Noah.

verses.textZh: 那七天一过，洪水就临到地上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那七天一过，洪水就临到地上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了那七天，洪水氾滥在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: And after the seven days the floodwaters came on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And after seven days the waters of the flood came upon the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass after seven days that the waters of the flood were on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: After seven days, the waters of the flood came and covered the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after the seven days, that the waters of the flood came upon the earth.
verses.textEn: And after the seven days the floodwaters came on the earth.

verses.textZh: 挪亚六百岁那一年，二月十七日那一天，所有大渊的泉源都裂开了，天上的窗户都敞开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚六百岁那一年，二月十七日那一天，所有大渊的泉源都裂开了，天上的窗户都敞开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 当挪亚六百岁，二月十七日那一天，大渊的泉源都裂开了，天上的窗户也敞开了，
verses.textEnNiv: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month—on that day all the springs of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.
verses.textEnEsv: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst forth, and the windows of the heavens were opened.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.
verses.textEnNlt: When Noah was 600 years old, on the seventeenth day of the second month, all the underground waters erupted from the earth, and the rain fell in mighty torrents from the sky.
verses.textEnNasb: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the floodgates of the sky were opened.
verses.textEn: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, on the seventeenth day of the second month—on that day all the springs of the great deep burst forth, and the floodgates of the heavens were opened.

verses.textZh: 大雨倾盆下在地上，一连四十昼夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大雨倾盆下在地上，一连四十昼夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 四十昼夜降大雨在地上。
verses.textEnNiv: And rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEnEsv: And rain fell upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rain was on the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEnNlt: The rain continued to fall for forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEnNasb: The rain fell upon the earth for forty days and forty nights.
verses.textEn: And rain fell on the earth forty days and forty nights.

verses.textZh: 就在那一天，挪亚带着他的儿子闪、含、雅弗，以及他的妻子和三个儿媳，一同进了方舟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那一天，挪亚带着他的儿子闪、含、雅弗，以及他的妻子和三个儿媳，一同进了方舟。
verses.textZhCuv: 正当那日，挪亚和他三个儿子闪、含、雅弗，并挪亚的妻子和三个儿妇，都进入方舟。
verses.textEnNiv: On that very day Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, together with his wife and the wives of his three sons, entered the ark.
verses.textEnEsv: On the very same day Noah and his sons, Shem and Ham and Japheth, and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them entered the ark,
verses.textEnNkjv: On the very same day Noah and Noah’s sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered the ark—
verses.textEnNlt: That very day Noah had gone into the boat with his wife and his sons—Shem, Ham, and Japheth—and their wives.
verses.textEnNasb: On this very same day Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered the ark,
verses.textEn: On that very day Noah and his sons, Shem, Ham and Japheth, together with his wife and the wives of his three sons, entered the ark.

verses.textZh: 他们一家，所有走兽各从其类，所有牲畜各从其类，所有在地上爬行的动物各从其类，所有有羽有翼的飞禽各从其类，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们一家，所有走兽各从其类，所有牲畜各从其类，所有在地上爬行的动物各从其类，所有有羽有翼的飞禽各从其类，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们和百兽，各从其类，一切牲畜，各从其类，爬在地上的昆虫，各从其类，一切禽鸟，各从其类，都进入方舟。
verses.textEnNiv: They had with them every wild animal according to its kind, all livestock according to their kinds, every creature that moves along the ground according to its kind and every bird according to its kind, everything with wings.
verses.textEnEsv: they and every beast, according to its kind, and all the livestock according to their kinds, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, according to its kind, and every bird, according to its kind, every winged creature.
verses.textEnNkjv: they and every beast after its kind, all cattle after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.
verses.textEnNlt: With them in the boat were pairs of every kind of animal—domestic and wild, large and small—along with birds of every kind.
verses.textEnNasb: they and every animal according to its kind, and all the livestock according to their kind, and every crawling thing that crawls on the earth according to its kind, and every bird according to its kind, all sorts of birds.
verses.textEn: They had with them every wild animal according to its kind, all livestock according to their kinds, every creature that moves along the ground according to its kind and every bird according to its kind, everything with wings.

verses.textZh: 有生命、有气息的，都是一对一对来到挪亚那里，进入方舟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有生命、有气息的，都是一对一对来到挪亚那里，进入方舟。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有血肉、有气息的活物，都一对一对地到挪亚那里，进入方舟。
verses.textEnNiv: Pairs of all creatures that have the breath of life in them came to Noah and entered the ark.
verses.textEnEsv: They went into the ark with Noah, two and two of all flesh in which there was the breath of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they went into the ark to Noah, two by two, of all flesh in which is the breath of life.
verses.textEnNlt: Two by two they came into the boat, representing every living thing that breathes.
verses.textEnNasb: So they went into the ark to Noah, by twos of all flesh in which there was the breath of life.
verses.textEn: Pairs of all creatures that have the breath of life in them came to Noah and entered the ark.

verses.textZh: 那些进去的，都是有生命的，一公一母进去，是照着神吩咐挪亚的。耶和华跟着就把方舟关起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些进去的，都是有生命的，一公一母进去，是照着神吩咐挪亚的。耶和华跟着就把方舟关起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡有血肉进入方舟的，都是有公有母，正如神所吩咐挪亚的。耶和华就把他关在方舟里头。
verses.textEnNiv: The animals going in were male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the Lord shut him in.
verses.textEnEsv: And those that entered, male and female of all flesh, went in as God had commanded him. And the Lord shut him in.
verses.textEnNkjv: So those that entered, male and female of all flesh, went in as God had commanded him; and the Lord shut him in.
verses.textEnNlt: A male and female of each kind entered, just as God had commanded Noah. Then the Lord closed the door behind them.
verses.textEnNasb: Those that entered, male and female of all flesh, entered as God had commanded him; and the Lord closed the door behind him.
verses.textEn: The animals going in were male and female of every living thing, as God had commanded Noah. Then the Lord shut him in.

verses.textZh: 洪水就临到地上四十天；水不断上涨，把方舟升起，于是方舟就从地上浮起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洪水就临到地上四十天；水不断上涨，把方舟升起，于是方舟就从地上浮起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 洪水氾滥在地上四十天，水往上长，把方舟从地上漂起。
verses.textEnNiv: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and as the waters increased they lifted the ark high above the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: The flood continued forty days on the earth. The waters increased and bore up the ark, and it rose high above the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the flood was on the earth forty days. The waters increased and lifted up the ark, and it rose high above the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: For forty days the floodwaters grew deeper, covering the ground and lifting the boat high above the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the flood came upon the earth for forty days, and the water increased and lifted up the ark, so that it rose above the earth.
verses.textEn: For forty days the flood kept coming on the earth, and as the waters increased they lifted the ark high above the earth.

verses.textZh: 水势甚大，在地上大大上涨，方舟就在水面上漂来漂去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水势甚大，在地上大大上涨，方舟就在水面上漂来漂去。
verses.textZhCuv: 水势浩大，在地上大大地往上长，方舟在水面上漂来漂去。
verses.textEnNiv: The waters rose and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.
verses.textEnEsv: The waters prevailed and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the face of the waters.
verses.textEnNkjv: The waters prevailed and greatly increased on the earth, and the ark moved about on the surface of the waters.
verses.textEnNlt: As the waters rose higher and higher above the ground, the boat floated safely on the surface.
verses.textEnNasb: The water prevailed and increased greatly upon the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.
verses.textEn: The waters rose and increased greatly on the earth, and the ark floated on the surface of the water.

verses.textZh: 水势在地面上越来越大，天下所有的高山都被淹没了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水势在地面上越来越大，天下所有的高山都被淹没了。
verses.textZhCuv: 水势在地上极其浩大，天下的高山都淹没了。
verses.textEnNiv: They rose greatly on the earth, and all the high mountains under the entire heavens were covered.
verses.textEnEsv: And the waters prevailed so mightily on the earth that all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the waters prevailed exceedingly on the earth, and all the high hills under the whole heaven were covered.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, the water covered even the highest mountains on the earth,
verses.textEnNasb: And the water prevailed more and more upon the earth, so that all the high mountains everywhere under the heavens were covered.
verses.textEn: They rose greatly on the earth, and all the high mountains under the entire heavens were covered.

verses.textZh: 水势浩大，比众山高出七公尺，山岭都被淹没了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水势浩大，比众山高出七公尺，山岭都被淹没了。
verses.textZhCuv: 水势比山高过十五肘，山岭都淹没了。
verses.textEnNiv: The waters rose and covered the mountains to a depth of more than fifteen cubits.
verses.textEnEsv: The waters prevailed above the mountains, covering them fifteen cubits deep.
verses.textEnNkjv: The waters prevailed fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.
verses.textEnNlt: rising more than twenty-two feet above the highest peaks.
verses.textEnNasb: The water prevailed fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.
verses.textEn: The waters rose and covered the mountains to a depth of more than fifteen cubits.

verses.textZh: 凡有生命仍在地上行动的，无论是飞鸟或是牲畜，走兽或是在地上滋生的各样小生物，以及所有的人都死了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡有生命仍在地上行动的，无论是飞鸟或是牲畜，走兽或是在地上滋生的各样小生物，以及所有的人都死了；
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在地上有血肉的动物，就是飞鸟、牲畜、走兽，和爬在地上的昆虫，以及所有的人，都死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Every living thing that moved on land perished—birds, livestock, wild animals, all the creatures that swarm over the earth, and all mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: And all flesh died that moved on the earth, birds, livestock, beasts, all swarming creatures that swarm on the earth, and all mankind.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all flesh died that moved on the earth: birds and cattle and beasts and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.
verses.textEnNlt: All the living things on earth died—birds, domestic animals, wild animals, small animals that scurry along the ground, and all the people.
verses.textEnNasb: So all creatures that moved on the earth perished: birds, livestock, animals, and every swarming thing that swarms upon the earth, and all mankind;
verses.textEn: Every living thing that moved on land perished—birds, livestock, wild animals, all the creatures that swarm over the earth, and all mankind.

verses.textZh: 仍在陆地上，鼻孔里有气息的生灵都死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 仍在陆地上，鼻孔里有气息的生灵都死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在旱地上、鼻孔有气息的生灵都死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Everything on dry land that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.
verses.textEnEsv: Everything on the dry land in whose nostrils was the breath of life died.
verses.textEnNkjv: All in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, all that was on the dry land, died.
verses.textEnNlt: Everything that breathed and lived on dry land died.
verses.textEnNasb: of all that was on the dry land, all in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.
verses.textEn: Everything on dry land that had the breath of life in its nostrils died.

verses.textZh: 耶和华把地上的所有生物，从人类到牲畜，爬行的动物，以及空中的飞鸟都除灭了；于是，这一切都从地上消灭了。只留下挪亚和那些与挪亚一同在方舟里的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华把地上的所有生物，从人类到牲畜，爬行的动物，以及空中的飞鸟都除灭了；于是，这一切都从地上消灭了。只留下挪亚和那些与挪亚一同在方舟里的。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡地上各类的活物，连人带牲畜、昆虫，以及空中的飞鸟，都从地上除灭了，只留下挪亚和那些与他同在方舟里的。
verses.textEnNiv: Every living thing on the face of the earth was wiped out; people and animals and the creatures that move along the ground and the birds were wiped from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those with him in the ark.
verses.textEnEsv: He blotted out every living thing that was on the face of the ground, man and animals and creeping things and birds of the heavens. They were blotted out from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ark.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He destroyed all living things which were on the face of the ground: both man and cattle, creeping thing and bird of the air. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah and those who were with him in the ark remained alive.
verses.textEnNlt: God wiped out every living thing on the earth—people, livestock, small animals that scurry along the ground, and the birds of the sky. All were destroyed. The only people who survived were Noah and those with him in the boat.
verses.textEnNasb: So He wiped out every living thing that was upon the face of the land, from mankind to animals, to crawling things, and the birds of the sky, and they were wiped out from the earth; and only Noah was left, together with those that were with him in the ark.
verses.textEn: Every living thing on the face of the earth was wiped out; people and animals and the creatures that move along the ground and the birds were wiped from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those with him in the ark.

verses.textZh: 水势浩大，在地上共一百五十天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水势浩大，在地上共一百五十天。
verses.textZhCuv: 水势浩大，在地上共一百五十天。
verses.textEnNiv: The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.
verses.textEnEsv: And the waters prevailed on the earth 150 days.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the waters prevailed on the earth one hundred and fifty days.
verses.textEnNlt: And the floodwaters covered the earth for 150 days.
verses.textEnNasb: The water prevailed upon the earth for 150 days.
verses.textEn: The waters flooded the earth for a hundred and fifty days.

verses.textZh: 神顾念挪亚和所有与他一同在方舟里的走兽和牲畜；神使风吹过大地，水就渐渐退了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神顾念挪亚和所有与他一同在方舟里的走兽和牲畜；神使风吹过大地，水就渐渐退了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神记念挪亚和挪亚方舟里的一切走兽牲畜。神叫风吹地，水势渐落。
verses.textEnNiv: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and the livestock that were with him in the ark, and he sent a wind over the earth, and the waters receded.
verses.textEnEsv: But God remembered Noah and all the beasts and all the livestock that were with him in the ark. And God made a wind blow over the earth, and the waters subsided.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the animals that were with him in the ark. And God made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters subsided.
verses.textEnNlt: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and livestock with him in the boat. He sent a wind to blow across the earth, and the floodwaters began to recede.
verses.textEnNasb: But God remembered Noah and all the animals and all the livestock that were with him in the ark; and God caused a wind to pass over the earth, and the water subsided.
verses.textEn: But God remembered Noah and all the wild animals and the livestock that were with him in the ark, and he sent a wind over the earth, and the waters receded.

verses.textZh: 深渊的泉源和天上的窗户，都关闭起来；天降的大雨也止住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 深渊的泉源和天上的窗户，都关闭起来；天降的大雨也止住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 渊源和天上的窗户都闭塞了，天上的大雨也止住了。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens had been closed, and the rain had stopped falling from the sky.
verses.textEnEsv: The fountains of the deep and the windows of the heavens were closed, the rain from the heavens was restrained,
verses.textEnNkjv: The fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were also stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained.
verses.textEnNlt: The underground waters stopped flowing, and the torrential rains from the sky were stopped.
verses.textEnNasb: Also the fountains of the deep and the floodgates of the sky were closed, and the rain from the sky was restrained;
verses.textEn: Now the springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens had been closed, and the rain had stopped falling from the sky.

verses.textZh: 水从地上不断退去，过了一百五十天，水就消退了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水从地上不断退去，过了一百五十天，水就消退了。
verses.textZhCuv: 水从地上渐退。过了一百五十天，水就渐消。
verses.textEnNiv: The water receded steadily from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the water had gone down,
verses.textEnEsv: and the waters receded from the earth continually. At the end of 150 days the waters had abated,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the waters receded continually from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters decreased.
verses.textEnNlt: So the floodwaters gradually receded from the earth. After 150 days,
verses.textEnNasb: and the water receded steadily from the earth, and at the end of 150 days the water decreased.
verses.textEn: The water receded steadily from the earth. At the end of the hundred and fifty days the water had gone down,

verses.textZh: 七月十七日，方舟停在亚拉腊山上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 七月十七日，方舟停在亚拉腊山上。
verses.textZhCuv: 七月十七日，方舟停在亚拉腊山上。
verses.textEnNiv: and on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
verses.textEnEsv: and in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the ark rested in the seventh month, the seventeenth day of the month, on the mountains of Ararat.
verses.textEnNlt: exactly five months from the time the flood began, the boat came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
verses.textEnNasb: Then in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.textEn: and on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

verses.textZh: 水继续消退，直到十月；到了十月初一，山顶都露出来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水继续消退，直到十月；到了十月初一，山顶都露出来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 水又渐消，到十月初一日，山顶都现出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: The waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.
verses.textEnEsv: And the waters continued to abate until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.
verses.textEnNlt: Two and a half months later, as the waters continued to go down, other mountain peaks became visible.
verses.textEnNasb: And the water decreased steadily until the tenth month; in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains became visible.
verses.textEn: The waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.

verses.textZh: 过了四十天，挪亚开了他所做的方舟的窗户，
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了四十天，挪亚开了他所做的方舟的窗户，
verses.textZhCuv: 过了四十天，挪亚开了方舟的窗户，
verses.textEnNiv: After forty days Noah opened a window he had made in the ark
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of forty days Noah opened the window of the ark that he had made
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came to pass, at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made.
verses.textEnNlt: After another forty days, Noah opened the window he had made in the boat
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made;
verses.textEn: After forty days Noah opened a window he had made in the ark

verses.textZh: 放了一只乌鸦出去。地上的水还没有干，那乌鸦就一直飞来飞去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 放了一只乌鸦出去。地上的水还没有干，那乌鸦就一直飞来飞去。
verses.textZhCuv: 放出一只乌鸦去；那乌鸦飞来飞去，直到地上的水都干了。
verses.textEnNiv: and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: and sent forth a raven. It went to and fro until the waters were dried up from the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he sent out a raven, which kept going to and fro until the waters had dried up from the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: and released a raven. The bird flew back and forth until the floodwaters on the earth had dried up.
verses.textEnNasb: and he sent out a raven, and it flew here and there until the water was dried up from the earth.
verses.textEn: and sent out a raven, and it kept flying back and forth until the water had dried up from the earth.

verses.textZh: 他又放了一只鸽子出去，要看看水从地上退了没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又放了一只鸽子出去，要看看水从地上退了没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又放出一只鸽子去，要看看水从地上退了没有。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he sent out a dove to see if the water had receded from the surface of the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he sent forth a dove from him, to see if the waters had subsided from the face of the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: He also sent out from himself a dove, to see if the waters had receded from the face of the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: He also released a dove to see if the water had receded and it could find dry ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he sent out a dove, to see if the water was low on the surface of the land;
verses.textEn: Then he sent out a dove to see if the water had receded from the surface of the ground.

verses.textZh: 因为遍地都是水，那鸽子找不着歇脚的地方，就回到挪亚的方舟那里；于是，挪亚伸出手去，把鸽子接进方舟里来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为遍地都是水，那鸽子找不着歇脚的地方，就回到挪亚的方舟那里；于是，挪亚伸出手去，把鸽子接进方舟里来。
verses.textZhCuv: 但遍地上都是水，鸽子找不着落脚之地，就回到方舟挪亚那里，挪亚伸手把鸽子接进方舟来。
verses.textEnNiv: But the dove could find nowhere to perch because there was water over all the surface of the earth; so it returned to Noah in the ark. He reached out his hand and took the dove and brought it back to himself in the ark.
verses.textEnEsv: But the dove found no place to set her foot, and she returned to him to the ark, for the waters were still on the face of the whole earth. So he put out his hand and took her and brought her into the ark with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the dove found no resting place for the sole of her foot, and she returned into the ark to him, for the waters were on the face of the whole earth. So he put out his hand and took her, and drew her into the ark to himself.
verses.textEnNlt: But the dove could find no place to land because the water still covered the ground. So it returned to the boat, and Noah held out his hand and drew the dove back inside.
verses.textEnNasb: but the dove found no resting place for the sole of its foot, so it returned to him in the ark, for the water was on the surface of all the earth. Then he put out his hand and took it, and brought it into the ark to himself.
verses.textEn: But the dove could find nowhere to perch because there was water over all the surface of the earth; so it returned to Noah in the ark. He reached out his hand and took the dove and brought it back to himself in the ark.

verses.textZh: 他再等了七天，又把鸽子从方舟里放出去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他再等了七天，又把鸽子从方舟里放出去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又等了七天，再把鸽子从方舟放出去。
verses.textEnNiv: He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.
verses.textEnEsv: He waited another seven days, and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he waited yet another seven days, and again he sent the dove out from the ark.
verses.textEnNlt: After waiting another seven days, Noah released the dove again.
verses.textEnNasb: So he waited another seven days longer; and again he sent out the dove from the ark.
verses.textEn: He waited seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark.

verses.textZh: 到了黄昏的时候，鸽子回到挪亚那里，嘴里叼着一块新摘下来的橄榄树叶，挪亚就知道地上的水已经退了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了黄昏的时候，鸽子回到挪亚那里，嘴里叼着一块新摘下来的橄榄树叶，挪亚就知道地上的水已经退了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晚上，鸽子回到他那里，嘴里叼着一个新拧下来的橄榄叶子，挪亚就知道地上的水退了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And the dove came back to him in the evening, and behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters had subsided from the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the dove came to him in the evening, and behold, a freshly plucked olive leaf was in her mouth; and Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: This time the dove returned to him in the evening with a fresh olive leaf in its beak. Then Noah knew that the floodwaters were almost gone.
verses.textEnNasb: And the dove came to him in the evening, and behold, in its beak was a fresh olive leaf. So Noah knew that the water was low on the earth.
verses.textEn: When the dove returned to him in the evening, there in its beak was a freshly plucked olive leaf! Then Noah knew that the water had receded from the earth.

verses.textZh: 挪亚再等了七天，又把鸽子放出去，鸽子就再没有回到他那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚再等了七天，又把鸽子放出去，鸽子就再没有回到他那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又等了七天，放出鸽子去，鸽子就不再回来了。
verses.textEnNiv: He waited seven more days and sent the dove out again, but this time it did not return to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he waited another seven days and sent forth the dove, and she did not return to him anymore.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he waited yet another seven days and sent out the dove, which did not return again to him anymore.
verses.textEnNlt: He waited another seven days and then released the dove again. This time it did not come back.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he waited another seven days longer, and sent out the dove; but it did not return to him again.
verses.textEn: He waited seven more days and sent the dove out again, but this time it did not return to him.

verses.textZh: 到挪亚六百零一岁的时候，就在正月初一，地上的水都干了；挪亚移开方舟的盖看看，见地面已经干了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到挪亚六百零一岁的时候，就在正月初一，地上的水都干了；挪亚移开方舟的盖看看，见地面已经干了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到挪亚六百零一岁，正月初一日，地上的水都干了。挪亚撤去方舟的盖观看，便见地面上干了。
verses.textEnNiv: By the first day of the first month of Noah’s six hundred and first year, the water had dried up from the earth. Noah then removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.
verses.textEnEsv: In the six hundred and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried from off the earth. And Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked, and behold, the face of the ground was dry.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, that the waters were dried up from the earth; and Noah removed the covering of the ark and looked, and indeed the surface of the ground was dry.
verses.textEnNlt: Noah was now 601 years old. On the first day of the new year, ten and a half months after the flood began, the floodwaters had almost dried up from the earth. Noah lifted back the covering of the boat and saw that the surface of the ground was drying.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about in the six hundred and first year, in the first month, on the first of the month, that the water was dried up from the earth. Then Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked, and behold, the surface of the ground had dried up.
verses.textEn: By the first day of the first month of Noah’s six hundred and first year, the water had dried up from the earth. Noah then removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

verses.textZh: 到了二月二十七日，大地就都干了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了二月二十七日，大地就都干了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了二月二十七日，地就都干了。
verses.textEnNiv: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was completely dry.
verses.textEnEsv: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth had dried out.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dried.
verses.textEnNlt: Two more months went by, and at last the earth was dry!
verses.textEnNasb: And in the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
verses.textEn: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was completely dry.

verses.textZh: 神告诉挪亚说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 神告诉挪亚说：
verses.textZhCuv: 神对挪亚说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said to Noah,
verses.textEnEsv: Then God said to Noah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said to Noah,
verses.textEnNasb: Then God spoke to Noah, saying,
verses.textEn: Then God said to Noah,

verses.textZh: "你要从方舟出来，你和你的妻子、儿子，以及儿媳都要和你一同出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: "你要从方舟出来，你和你的妻子、儿子，以及儿媳都要和你一同出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「你和你的妻子、儿子、儿妇都可以出方舟。
verses.textEnNiv: "Come out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and their wives.
verses.textEnEsv: "Go out from the ark, you and your wife, and your sons and your sons’ wives with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Go out of the ark, you and your wife, and your sons and your sons’ wives with you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Leave the boat, all of you—you and your wife, and your sons and their wives.
verses.textEnNasb: "Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons’ wives with you.
verses.textEn: "Come out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and their wives.

verses.textZh: 所有和你在一起有生命的活物：飞鸟、牲畜和一切在地上爬行的动物，你都要带出来，使牠们可以在地上滋生、繁殖，也可以在地上增多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有和你在一起有生命的活物：飞鸟、牲畜和一切在地上爬行的动物，你都要带出来，使牠们可以在地上滋生、繁殖，也可以在地上增多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在你那里凡有血肉的活物，就是飞鸟、牲畜，和一切爬在地上的昆虫，都要带出来，叫它在地上多多滋生，大大兴旺。」
verses.textEnNiv: Bring out every kind of living creature that is with you—the birds, the animals, and all the creatures that move along the ground—so they can multiply on the earth and be fruitful and increase in number on it."
verses.textEnEsv: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh—birds and animals and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth—that they may swarm on the earth, and be fruitful and multiply on the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Bring out with you every living thing of all flesh that is with you: birds and cattle and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, so that they may abound on the earth, and be fruitful and multiply on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Release all the animals—the birds, the livestock, and the small animals that scurry along the ground—so they can be fruitful and multiply throughout the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: Bring out with you every living thing of all flesh that is with you, birds and animals and every crawling thing that crawls on the earth, that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful and multiply on the earth."
verses.textEn: Bring out every kind of living creature that is with you—the birds, the animals, and all the creatures that move along the ground—so they can multiply on the earth and be fruitful and increase in number on it."

verses.textZh: 于是，挪亚出来了，他的儿子、妻子和儿媳都与他一同出来了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，挪亚出来了，他的儿子、妻子和儿媳都与他一同出来了；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是挪亚和他的妻子、儿子、儿妇都出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Noah came out, together with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.
verses.textEnEsv: So Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Noah went out, and his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives with him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Noah, his wife, and his sons and their wives left the boat.
verses.textEnNasb: So Noah went out, and his sons and his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.
verses.textEn: So Noah came out, together with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.

verses.textZh: 各样走兽、牲畜、飞禽和各样在地上爬行的动物，各从自己的族类，都出了方舟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各样走兽、牲畜、飞禽和各样在地上爬行的动物，各从自己的族类，都出了方舟。
verses.textZhCuv: 一切走兽、昆虫、飞鸟，和地上所有的动物，各从其类，也都出了方舟。
verses.textEnNiv: All the animals and all the creatures that move along the ground and all the birds—everything that moves on land—came out of the ark, one kind after another.
verses.textEnEsv: Every beast, every creeping thing, and every bird, everything that moves on the earth, went out by families from the ark.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every animal, every creeping thing, every bird, and whatever creeps on the earth, according to their families, went out of the ark.
verses.textEnNlt: And all of the large and small animals and birds came out of the boat, pair by pair.
verses.textEnNasb: Every animal, every crawling thing, and every bird, everything that moves on the earth, went out by their families from the ark.
verses.textEn: All the animals and all the creatures that move along the ground and all the birds—everything that moves on land—came out of the ark, one kind after another.

verses.textZh: 挪亚给耶和华筑了一座祭坛，拿各样洁净的牲畜和飞禽，献在祭坛上作为燔祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚给耶和华筑了一座祭坛，拿各样洁净的牲畜和飞禽，献在祭坛上作为燔祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚为耶和华筑了一座坛，拿各类洁净的牲畜、飞鸟献在坛上为燔祭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord and, taking some of all the clean animals and clean birds, he sacrificed burnt offerings on it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord and took some of every clean animal and some of every clean bird and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord, and took of every clean animal and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord , and there he sacrificed as burnt offerings the animals and birds that had been approved for that purpose.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord, and took some of every kind of clean animal and some of every clean bird and offered burnt offerings on the altar.
verses.textEn: Then Noah built an altar to the Lord and, taking some of all the clean animals and clean birds, he sacrificed burnt offerings on it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华闻了那馨香的气味，就心里说："我必不再因人的缘故咒诅这地 ；我也必不再照着我作过的，击杀各样的活物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华闻了那馨香的气味，就心里说："我必不再因人的缘故咒诅这地 ；我也必不再照着我作过的，击杀各样的活物。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华闻那馨香之气，就心里说：「我不再因人的缘故咒诅地（人从小时心里怀着恶念），也不再按着我才行的灭各种的活物了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord smelled the pleasing aroma and said in his heart: "Never again will I curse the ground because of humans, even though every inclination of the human heart is evil from childhood. And never again will I destroy all living creatures, as I have done.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the Lord smelled the pleasing aroma, the Lord said in his heart, "I will never again curse the ground because of man, for the intention of man’s heart is evil from his youth. Neither will I ever again strike down every living creature as I have done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord smelled a soothing aroma. Then the Lord said in His heart, "I will never again curse the ground for man’s sake, although the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; nor will I again destroy every living thing as I have done.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord was pleased with the aroma of the sacrifice and said to himself, "I will never again curse the ground because of the human race, even though everything they think or imagine is bent toward evil from childhood. I will never again destroy all living things.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord smelled the soothing aroma, and the Lord said to Himself, "I will never again curse the ground on account of man, for the intent of man’s heart is evil from his youth; and I will never again destroy every living thing, as I have done.
verses.textEn: The Lord smelled the pleasing aroma and said in his heart: "Never again will I curse the ground because of humans, even though every inclination of the human heart is evil from childhood. And never again will I destroy all living creatures, as I have done.

verses.textZh: 大地尚存之日， 播种、收割， 寒暑、 冬夏、 白昼和黑夜 必然循环不息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大地尚存之日， 播种、收割， 寒暑、 冬夏、 白昼和黑夜 必然循环不息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 地还存留的时候，稼穑、寒暑、冬夏、昼夜就永不停息了。」
verses.textEnNiv: "As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease."
verses.textEnEsv: While the earth remains, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night, shall not cease."
verses.textEnNkjv: "While the earth remains, Seedtime and harvest, Cold and heat, Winter and summer, And day and night Shall not cease."
verses.textEnNlt: As long as the earth remains, there will be planting and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night."
verses.textEnNasb: "While the earth remains, Seedtime and harvest, Cold and heat, Summer and winter, And day and night Shall not cease."
verses.textEn: "As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night will never cease."

verses.textZh: 神赐福给挪亚和他的儿子，对他们说："你们要繁衍增多，充满大地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神赐福给挪亚和他的儿子，对他们说："你们要繁衍增多，充满大地。
verses.textZhCuv: 神赐福给挪亚和他的儿子，对他们说：「你们要生养众多，遍满了地。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, saying to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them: "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God blessed Noah and his sons and told them, "Be fruitful and multiply. Fill the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.
verses.textEn: Then God blessed Noah and his sons, saying to them, "Be fruitful and increase in number and fill the earth.

verses.textZh: 地上各样的走兽，空中各样的飞鸟，甚至地上各样爬行的动物，和海里各样的鱼类，都要对你们惊恐惧怕；这一切都已经交在你们手里了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上各样的走兽，空中各样的飞鸟，甚至地上各样爬行的动物，和海里各样的鱼类，都要对你们惊恐惧怕；这一切都已经交在你们手里了。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟都必惊恐，惧怕你们，连地上一切的昆虫并海里一切的鱼都交付你们的手。
verses.textEnNiv: The fear and dread of you will fall on all the beasts of the earth, and on all the birds in the sky, on every creature that moves along the ground, and on all the fish in the sea; they are given into your hands.
verses.textEnEsv: The fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth and upon every bird of the heavens, upon everything that creeps on the ground and all the fish of the sea. Into your hand they are delivered.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be on every beast of the earth, on every bird of the air, on all that move on the earth, and on all the fish of the sea. They are given into your hand.
verses.textEnNlt: All the animals of the earth, all the birds of the sky, all the small animals that scurry along the ground, and all the fish in the sea will look on you with fear and terror. I have placed them in your power.
verses.textEnNasb: The fear of you and the terror of you will be on every animal of the earth and on every bird of the sky; on everything that crawls on the ground, and on all the fish of the sea. They are handed over to you.
verses.textEn: The fear and dread of you will fall on all the beasts of the earth, and on all the birds in the sky, on every creature that moves along the ground, and on all the fish in the sea; they are given into your hands.

verses.textZh: 所有活着的动物都可以作你们的食物，我把这一切都赐给你们，好象我把青菜赐给了你们一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有活着的动物都可以作你们的食物，我把这一切都赐给你们，好象我把青菜赐给了你们一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡活着的动物都可以作你们的食物。这一切我都赐给你们，如同菜蔬一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Everything that lives and moves about will be food for you. Just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you everything.
verses.textEnEsv: Every moving thing that lives shall be food for you. And as I gave you the green plants, I give you everything.
verses.textEnNkjv: Every moving thing that lives shall be food for you. I have given you all things, even as the green herbs.
verses.textEnNlt: I have given them to you for food, just as I have given you grain and vegetables.
verses.textEnNasb: Every moving thing that is alive shall be food for you; I have given everything to you, as I gave the green plant.
verses.textEn: Everything that lives and moves about will be food for you. Just as I gave you the green plants, I now give you everything.

verses.textZh: 唯独带着生命的肉，就是带着血的肉，你们却不可吃。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独带着生命的肉，就是带着血的肉，你们却不可吃。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟独肉带着血，那就是它的生命，你们不可吃。
verses.textEnNiv: "But you must not eat meat that has its lifeblood still in it.
verses.textEnEsv: But you shall not eat flesh with its life, that is, its blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you shall not eat flesh with its life, thatis, its blood.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must never eat any meat that still has the lifeblood in it.
verses.textEnNasb: But you shall not eat flesh with its life, that is, its blood.
verses.textEn: "But you must not eat meat that has its lifeblood still in it.

verses.textZh: 流你们的血、害你们生命的，我必向他们追偿；无论是走兽或人类，甚至各人自己的兄弟，我必要他偿命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流你们的血、害你们生命的，我必向他们追偿；无论是走兽或人类，甚至各人自己的兄弟，我必要他偿命。
verses.textZhCuv: 流你们血、害你们命的，无论是兽是人，我必讨他的罪，就是向各人的弟兄也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: And for your lifeblood I will surely demand an accounting. I will demand an accounting from every animal. And from each human being, too, I will demand an accounting for the life of another human being.
verses.textEnEsv: And for your lifeblood I will require a reckoning: from every beast I will require it and from man. From his fellow man I will require a reckoning for the life of man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Surely for your lifeblood I will demand areckoning; from the hand of every beast I will require it, and from the hand of man. From the hand of every man’s brother I will require the life of man.
verses.textEnNlt: "And I will require the blood of anyone who takes another person’s life. If a wild animal kills a person, it must die. And anyone who murders a fellow human must die.
verses.textEnNasb: I certainly will require your lifeblood; from every animal I will require it. And from every person, from every man as his brother I will require the life of a person.
verses.textEn: And for your lifeblood I will surely demand an accounting. I will demand an accounting from every animal. And from each human being, too, I will demand an accounting for the life of another human being.

verses.textZh: 流人血的， 人也必流他的血； 因为神造人， 是按着他自己的形象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流人血的， 人也必流他的血； 因为神造人， 是按着他自己的形象。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡流人血的，他的血也必被人所流，因为神造人是照自己的形象造的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed; for in the image of God has God made mankind.
verses.textEnEsv: "Whoever sheds the blood of man, by man shall his blood be shed, for God made man in his own image.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whoever sheds man’s blood, By man his blood shall be shed; For in the image of God He made man.
verses.textEnNlt: If anyone takes a human life, that person’s life will also be taken by human hands. For God made human beings in his own image.
verses.textEnNasb: "Whoever sheds human blood, By man his blood shall be shed, For in the image of God He made mankind.
verses.textEn: "Whoever sheds human blood, by humans shall their blood be shed; for in the image of God has God made mankind.

verses.textZh: 你们要繁衍增多； 要在地上滋生、增多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要繁衍增多； 要在地上滋生、增多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要生养众多，在地上昌盛繁茂。」
verses.textEnNiv: As for you, be fruitful and increase in number; multiply on the earth and increase upon it."
verses.textEnEsv: And you, be fruitful and multiply, increase greatly on the earth and multiply in it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for you, be fruitful and multiply; Bring forth abundantly in the earth And multiply in it."
verses.textEnNlt: Now be fruitful and multiply, and repopulate the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, be fruitful and multiply; Populate the earth abundantly and multiply in it."
verses.textEn: As for you, be fruitful and increase in number; multiply on the earth and increase upon it."

verses.textZh: 神告诉挪亚和与他在一起的儿子说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 神告诉挪亚和与他在一起的儿子说：
verses.textZhCuv: 神晓谕挪亚和他的儿子说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him:
verses.textEnEsv: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: Then God told Noah and his sons,
verses.textEnNasb: Then God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,
verses.textEn: Then God said to Noah and to his sons with him:

verses.textZh: "看哪，我现在与你们和你们的后裔立约，
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪，我现在与你们和你们的后裔立约，
verses.textZhCuv: 「我与你们和你们的后裔立约，
verses.textEnNiv: "I now establish my covenant with you and with your descendants after you
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, I establish my covenant with you and your offspring after you,
verses.textEnNkjv: "And as for Me, behold, I establish My covenant with you and with your descendants after you,
verses.textEnNlt: "I hereby confirm my covenant with you and your descendants,
verses.textEnNasb: "Now behold, I Myself am establishing My covenant with you, and with your descendants after you;
verses.textEn: "I now establish my covenant with you and with your descendants after you

verses.textZh: 并且与所有跟你们在一起有生命的活物立约，包括飞鸟、牲畜和所有地上的走兽，就是与从方舟里出来的立约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并且与所有跟你们在一起有生命的活物立约，包括飞鸟、牲畜和所有地上的走兽，就是与从方舟里出来的立约。
verses.textZhCuv: 并与你们这里的一切活物－就是飞鸟、牲畜、走兽，凡从方舟里出来的活物－立约。
verses.textEnNiv: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock and all the wild animals, all those that came out of the ark with you—every living creature on earth.
verses.textEnEsv: and with every living creature that is with you, the birds, the livestock, and every beast of the earth with you, as many as came out of the ark; it is for every beast of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the cattle, and every beast of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ark, every beast of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: and with all the animals that were on the boat with you—the birds, the livestock, and all the wild animals—every living creature on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you; of all that comes out of the ark, every animal of the earth.
verses.textEn: and with every living creature that was with you—the birds, the livestock and all the wild animals, all those that came out of the ark with you—every living creature on earth.

verses.textZh: 我要与你们立约：凡有生命的必不再被洪水除灭，再没有洪水来毁灭大地了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要与你们立约：凡有生命的必不再被洪水除灭，再没有洪水来毁灭大地了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我与你们立约，凡有血肉的，不再被洪水灭绝，也不再有洪水毁坏地了。」
verses.textEnNiv: I establish my covenant with you: Never again will all life be destroyed by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: I establish my covenant with you, that never again shall all flesh be cut off by the waters of the flood, and never again shall there be a flood to destroy the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I establish My covenant with you: Never again shall all flesh be cut off by the waters of the flood; never again shall there be a flood to destroy the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, I am confirming my covenant with you. Never again will floodwaters kill all living creatures; never again will a flood destroy the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: I establish My covenant with you; and all flesh shall never again be eliminated by the waters of a flood, nor shall there again be a flood to destroy the earth."
verses.textEn: I establish my covenant with you: Never again will all life be destroyed by the waters of a flood; never again will there be a flood to destroy the earth."

verses.textZh: 神说："这就是我与你们，与一切跟你们同在有生命的活物所立之约的记号，直到万代；
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："这就是我与你们，与一切跟你们同在有生命的活物所立之约的记号，直到万代；
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「我与你们并你们这里的各样活物所立的永约是有记号的。
verses.textEnNiv: And God said, "This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:
verses.textEnEsv: And God said, "This is the sign of the covenant that I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for all future generations:
verses.textEnNkjv: And God said: "This is the sign of the covenant which I make between Me and you, and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "I am giving you a sign of my covenant with you and with all living creatures, for all generations to come.
verses.textEnNasb: God said, "This is the sign of the covenant which I am making between Me and you and every living creature that is with you, for all future generations;
verses.textEn: And God said, "This is the sign of the covenant I am making between me and you and every living creature with you, a covenant for all generations to come:

verses.textZh: 我把彩虹放在云彩中，作我与大地立约的记号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我把彩虹放在云彩中，作我与大地立约的记号。
verses.textZhCuv: 我把虹放在云彩中，这就可作我与地立约的记号了。
verses.textEnNiv: I have set my rainbow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: I have set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: I set My rainbow in the cloud, and it shall be for the sign of the covenant between Me and the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: I have placed my rainbow in the clouds. It is the sign of my covenant with you and with all the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: I have set My rainbow in the cloud, and it shall serve as a sign of a covenant between Me and the earth.
verses.textEn: I have set my rainbow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and the earth.

verses.textZh: 我使云彩遮盖大地时，彩虹出现云彩中，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我使云彩遮盖大地时，彩虹出现云彩中，
verses.textZhCuv: 我使云彩盖地的时候，必有虹现在云彩中，
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,
verses.textEnEsv: When I bring clouds over the earth and the bow is seen in the clouds,
verses.textEnNkjv: It shall be, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow shall be seen in the cloud;
verses.textEnNlt: When I send clouds over the earth, the rainbow will appear in the clouds,
verses.textEnNasb: It shall come about, when I make a cloud appear over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,
verses.textEn: Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds,

verses.textZh: 我就记念我与你们和一切有生命的活物所立的约： 水不再成为洪水， 来毁灭凡有生命的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就记念我与你们和一切有生命的活物所立的约： 水不再成为洪水， 来毁灭凡有生命的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我便记念我与你们和各样有血肉的活物所立的约，水就再不氾滥、毁坏一切有血肉的物了。
verses.textEnNiv: I will remember my covenant between me and you and all living creatures of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.
verses.textEnEsv: I will remember my covenant that is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh. And the waters shall never again become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: and I will remember My covenant which is between Me and you and every living creature of all flesh; the waters shall never again become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: and I will remember my covenant with you and with all living creatures. Never again will the floodwaters destroy all life.
verses.textEnNasb: and I will remember My covenant, which is between Me and you and every living creature of all flesh; and never again shall the water become a flood to destroy all flesh.
verses.textEn: I will remember my covenant between me and you and all living creatures of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life.

verses.textZh: 彩虹在云彩中出现， 我看见了就记念 我与地上一切有生命的活物，所立的永约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 彩虹在云彩中出现， 我看见了就记念 我与地上一切有生命的活物，所立的永约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 虹必现在云彩中，我看见，就要记念我与地上各样有血肉的活物所立的永约。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and all living creatures of every kind on the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: When the bow is in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: The rainbow shall be in the cloud, and I will look on it to remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: When I see the rainbow in the clouds, I will remember the eternal covenant between God and every living creature on earth."
verses.textEnNasb: When the rainbow is in the cloud, then I will look at it, to remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth."
verses.textEn: Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and all living creatures of every kind on the earth."

verses.textZh: 神对挪亚说："这就是我与地上凡有生命的立约的记号。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对挪亚说："这就是我与地上凡有生命的立约的记号。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神对挪亚说：「这就是我与地上一切有血肉之物立约的记号了。」
verses.textEnNiv: So God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant I have established between me and all life on the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is on the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said to Noah, "Yes, this rainbow is the sign of the covenant I am confirming with all the creatures on earth."
verses.textEnNasb: And God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant which I have established between Me and all flesh that is on the earth."
verses.textEn: So God said to Noah, "This is the sign of the covenant I have established between me and all life on the earth."

verses.textZh: 挪亚的儿子，从方舟里出来的，就是闪、含、雅弗；含是迦南的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚的儿子，从方舟里出来的，就是闪、含、雅弗；含是迦南的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 出方舟挪亚的儿子就是闪、含、雅弗。含是迦南的父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham and Japheth. (Ham was the father of Canaan.)
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Noah who went forth from the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. (Ham was the father of Canaan.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And Ham was the father of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Noah who came out of the boat with their father were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. (Ham is the father of Canaan.)
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and Ham was the father of Canaan.
verses.textEn: The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem, Ham and Japheth. (Ham was the father of Canaan.)

verses.textZh: 这三个人是挪亚的儿子，全地的人都是从这些人播散开来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这三个人是挪亚的儿子，全地的人都是从这些人播散开来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是挪亚的三个儿子，他们的后裔分散在全地。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the three sons of Noah, and from them came the people who were scattered over the whole earth.
verses.textEnEsv: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the people of the whole earth were dispersed.
verses.textEnNkjv: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
verses.textEnNlt: From these three sons of Noah came all the people who now populate the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.
verses.textEn: These were the three sons of Noah, and from them came the people who were scattered over the whole earth.

verses.textZh: 挪亚作起农夫来，栽种葡萄园。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚作起农夫来，栽种葡萄园。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚作起农夫来，栽了一个葡萄园。
verses.textEnNiv: Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.
verses.textEnEsv: Noah began to be a man of the soil, and he planted a vineyard.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Noah began tobe a farmer, and he planted a vineyard.
verses.textEnNlt: After the flood, Noah began to cultivate the ground, and he planted a vineyard.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Noah began farming and planted a vineyard.
verses.textEn: Noah, a man of the soil, proceeded to plant a vineyard.

verses.textZh: 他喝酒，喝醉了，就在帐棚里光着身子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他喝酒，喝醉了，就在帐棚里光着身子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他喝了园中的酒便醉了，在帐棚里赤着身子。
verses.textEnNiv: When he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and lay uncovered inside his tent.
verses.textEnEsv: He drank of the wine and became drunk and lay uncovered in his tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he drank of the wine and was drunk, and became uncovered in his tent.
verses.textEnNlt: One day he drank some wine he had made, and he became drunk and lay naked inside his tent.
verses.textEnNasb: He drank some of the wine and became drunk, and uncovered himself inside his tent.
verses.textEn: When he drank some of its wine, he became drunk and lay uncovered inside his tent.

verses.textZh: 迦南的父亲含看见了自己父亲的下体，就去告诉在外面的两个兄弟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦南的父亲含看见了自己父亲的下体，就去告诉在外面的两个兄弟。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦南的父亲含看见他父亲赤身，就到外边告诉他两个弟兄。
verses.textEnNiv: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father naked and told his two brothers outside.
verses.textEnEsv: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father and told his two brothers outside.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
verses.textEnNlt: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw that his father was naked and went outside and told his brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.
verses.textEn: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father naked and told his two brothers outside.

verses.textZh: 于是，闪和雅弗二人拿了件外衣，搭在自己的肩膀上，倒退着进去，盖上他们父亲的下体；因为他们背着脸，所以没有看见他们父亲的下体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，闪和雅弗二人拿了件外衣，搭在自己的肩膀上，倒退着进去，盖上他们父亲的下体；因为他们背着脸，所以没有看见他们父亲的下体。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是闪和雅弗拿件衣服搭在肩上，倒退着进去，给他父亲盖上；他们背着脸就看不见父亲的赤身。
verses.textEnNiv: But Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it across their shoulders; then they walked in backward and covered their father’s naked body. Their faces were turned the other way so that they would not see their father naked.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Shem and Japheth took a garment, laid it on both their shoulders, and walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were turned backward, and they did not see their father’s nakedness.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Shem and Japheth took a garment, laid it on both their shoulders, and went backward and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were turned away, and they did not see their father’s nakedness.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Shem and Japheth took a robe, held it over their shoulders, and backed into the tent to cover their father. As they did this, they looked the other way so they would not see him naked.
verses.textEnNasb: But Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it on both their shoulders and walked backward and covered the nakedness of their father; and their faces were turned away, so that they did not see their father’s nakedness.
verses.textEn: But Shem and Japheth took a garment and laid it across their shoulders; then they walked in backward and covered their father’s naked body. Their faces were turned the other way so that they would not see their father naked.

verses.textZh: 挪亚酒醒以后，知道小儿子对他所作的事，
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚酒醒以后，知道小儿子对他所作的事，
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚醒了酒，知道小儿子向他所做的事，
verses.textEnNiv: When Noah awoke from his wine and found out what his youngest son had done to him,
verses.textEnEsv: When Noah awoke from his wine and knew what his youngest son had done to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his younger son had done to him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Noah woke up from his stupor, he learned what Ham, his youngest son, had done.
verses.textEnNasb: When Noah awoke from his wine, he knew what his youngest son had done to him.
verses.textEn: When Noah awoke from his wine and found out what his youngest son had done to him,

verses.textZh: 就说： "迦南应当受咒诅， 他必给自己的兄弟， 作奴仆的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就说： "迦南应当受咒诅， 他必给自己的兄弟， 作奴仆的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就说： 迦南当受咒诅， 必给他弟兄作奴仆的奴仆；
verses.textEnNiv: he said, "Cursed be Canaan! The lowest of slaves will he be to his brothers."
verses.textEnEsv: he said, "Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be to his brothers."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said: "Cursed be Canaan; A servant of servants He shall be to his brethren."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he cursed Canaan, the son of Ham: "May Canaan be cursed! May he be the lowest of servants to his relatives."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "Cursed be Canaan; A servant of servants He shall be to his brothers."
verses.textEn: he said, "Cursed be Canaan! The lowest of slaves will he be to his brothers."

verses.textZh: 又说： "耶和华，闪的神， 是应当称颂的；愿迦南作他的奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说： "耶和华，闪的神， 是应当称颂的；愿迦南作他的奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说： 耶和华－闪的神是应当称颂的！ 愿迦南作闪的奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: He also said, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Shem! May Canaan be the slave of Shem.
verses.textEnEsv: He also said, "Blessed be the Lord , the God of Shem; and let Canaan be his servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said: "Blessed be the Lord, The God of Shem, And may Canaan be his servant.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Noah said, "May the Lord , the God of Shem, be blessed, and may Canaan be his servant!
verses.textEnNasb: He also said, "Blessed be the Lord, The God of Shem; And may Canaan be his servant.
verses.textEn: He also said, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of Shem! May Canaan be the slave of Shem.

verses.textZh: 愿神使雅弗扩展， 使雅弗住在闪的帐棚里； 愿迦南作他的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿神使雅弗扩展， 使雅弗住在闪的帐棚里； 愿迦南作他的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿神使雅弗扩张， 使他住在闪的帐棚里； 又愿迦南作他的奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: May God extend Japheth’s territory; may Japheth live in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be the slave of Japheth."
verses.textEnEsv: May God enlarge Japheth, and let him dwell in the tents of Shem, and let Canaan be his servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: May God enlarge Japheth, And may he dwell in the tents of Shem; And may Canaan be his servant."
verses.textEnNlt: May God expand the territory of Japheth! May Japheth share the prosperity of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant."
verses.textEnNasb: "May God enlarge Japheth, And may he live in the tents of Shem; And may Canaan be his servant."
verses.textEn: May God extend Japheth’s territory; may Japheth live in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be the slave of Japheth."

verses.textZh: 洪水以后，挪亚又活了三百 五十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 洪水以后，挪亚又活了三百 五十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 洪水以后，挪亚又活了三百五十年。
verses.textEnNiv: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.
verses.textEnEsv: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Noah lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
verses.textEnNlt: Noah lived another 350 years after the great flood.
verses.textEnNasb: Noah lived 350 years after the flood.
verses.textEn: After the flood Noah lived 350 years.

verses.textZh: 挪亚共活了九百五十岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 挪亚共活了九百五十岁，就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚共活了九百五十岁就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnEsv: All the days of Noah were 950 years, and he died.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years; and he died.
verses.textEnNlt: He lived 950 years, and then he died.
verses.textEnNasb: So all the days of Noah were 950 years, and he died.
verses.textEn: Noah lived a total of 950 years, and then he died.

verses.textZh: 以下是挪亚的儿子闪、含、雅弗的后代。洪水以后，他们都生了儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是挪亚的儿子闪、含、雅弗的后代。洪水以后，他们都生了儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 挪亚的儿子闪、含、雅弗的后代记在下面。洪水以后，他们都生了儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of Shem, Ham and Japheth, Noah’s sons, who themselves had sons after the flood.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this is the genealogy of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth. And sons were born to them after the flood.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of the families of Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the three sons of Noah. Many children were born to them after the great flood.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the records of the generations of the sons of Noah: Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and sons were born to them after the flood.
verses.textEn: This is the account of Shem, Ham and Japheth, Noah’s sons, who themselves had sons after the flood.

verses.textZh: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.textEn: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek and Tiras.

verses.textZh: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、利法、陀迦玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、利法、陀迦玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、利法、陀迦玛。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath and Togarmah.

verses.textZh: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施，基提人和多单人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施，基提人和多单人。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施、基提、多单。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.textEn: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites and the Rodanites.

verses.textZh: 这些人的后裔分散居住在沿海的土地和岛屿上。各人随着自己的方言、宗族，住在自己的国土中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人的后裔分散居住在沿海的土地和岛屿上。各人随着自己的方言、宗族，住在自己的国土中。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些人的后裔将各国的地土、海岛分开居住，各随各的方言、宗族立国。
verses.textEnNiv: (From these the maritime peoples spread out into their territories by their clans within their nations, each with its own language.)
verses.textEnEsv: From these the coastland peoples spread in their lands, each with his own language, by their clans, in their nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: From these the coastland peoples of the Gentiles were separated into their lands, everyone according to his language, according to their families, into their nations.
verses.textEnNlt: Their descendants became the seafaring peoples that spread out to various lands, each identified by its own language, clan, and national identity.
verses.textEnNasb: From these the people of the coastlands of the nations were separated into their lands, every one according to his language, according to their families, into their nations.
verses.textEn: (From these the maritime peoples spread out into their territories by their clans within their nations, each with its own language.)

verses.textZh: 含的儿子是古实、埃及、弗和迦南。
verses.textZhCnvs: 含的儿子是古实、埃及、弗和迦南。
verses.textZhCuv: 含的儿子是古实、麦西、弗、迦南。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put, and Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.textEn: The sons of Ham: Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan.

verses.textZh: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛和撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴和底但。
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛和撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴和底但。
verses.textZhCuv: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛、撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴、底但。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabtechah; and the sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The descendants of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.textEn: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah and Sabteka. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.textZh: 古实又生宁录；宁录是世上第一位英雄。
verses.textZhCnvs: 古实又生宁录；宁录是世上第一位英雄。
verses.textZhCuv: 古实又生宁录，他为世上英雄之首。
verses.textEnNiv: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Cush fathered Nimrod; he was the first on earth to be a mighty man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cush begot Nimrod; he began to be a mighty one on the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Cush was also the ancestor of Nimrod, who was the first heroic warrior on earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Cush fathered Nimrod; he became a mighty one on the earth.
verses.textEn: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who became a mighty warrior on the earth.

verses.textZh: 他在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎人；因此有句俗语说："就像宁录一样，在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎人；因此有句俗语说："就像宁录一样，在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户，所以俗语说：「像宁录在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户。」
verses.textEnNiv: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord ; that is why it is said, "Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord . Therefore it is said, "Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord; therefore it is said, "Like Nimrod the mighty hunter before the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: Since he was the greatest hunter in the world, his name became proverbial. People would say, "This man is like Nimrod, the greatest hunter in the world."
verses.textEnNasb: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord; therefore it is said, "Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before the Lord."
verses.textEn: He was a mighty hunter before the Lord ; that is why it is said, "Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 他开始建国是在示拿地的巴别、以力、亚甲和甲尼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他开始建国是在示拿地的巴别、以力、亚甲和甲尼。
verses.textZhCuv: 他国的起头是巴别、以力、亚甲、甲尼，都在示拿地。
verses.textEnNiv: The first centers of his kingdom were Babylon, Uruk, Akkad and Kalneh, in Shinar.
verses.textEnEsv: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.textEnNlt: He built his kingdom in the land of Babylonia, with the cities of Babylon, Erech, Akkad, and Calneh.
verses.textEnNasb: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
verses.textEn: The first centers of his kingdom were Babylon, Uruk, Akkad and Kalneh, in Shinar.

verses.textZh: 他从那地出来，到亚述去，建造了尼尼微、利河伯城、迦拉，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从那地出来，到亚述去，建造了尼尼微、利河伯城、迦拉，
verses.textZhCuv: 他从那地出来往亚述去，建造尼尼微、利河伯、迦拉，
verses.textEnNiv: From that land he went to Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah
verses.textEnEsv: From that land he went into Assyria and built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah, and
verses.textEnNkjv: From that land he went to Assyria and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
verses.textEnNlt: From there he expanded his territory to Assyria, building the cities of Nineveh, Rehoboth-ir, Calah,
verses.textEnNasb: From that land he went to Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah,
verses.textEn: From that land he went to Assyria, where he built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah

verses.textZh: 和尼尼微与迦拉之间的利鲜，就是那大城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和尼尼微与迦拉之间的利鲜，就是那大城。
verses.textZhCuv: 和尼尼微、迦拉中间的利鲜，这就是那大城。
verses.textEnNiv: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and Calah—which is the great city.
verses.textEnEsv: Resen between Nineveh and Calah; that is the great city.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (that is the principal city).
verses.textEnNlt: and Resen (the great city located between Nineveh and Calah).
verses.textEnNasb: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah; that is the great city.
verses.textEn: and Resen, which is between Nineveh and Calah—which is the great city.

verses.textZh: 埃及生路低人，亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及生路低人，亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
verses.textZhCuv: 麦西生路低人、亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
verses.textEnNiv: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,
verses.textEnEsv: Egypt fathered Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
verses.textEnNkjv: Mizraim begot Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
verses.textEnNlt: Mizraim was the ancestor of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,
verses.textEnNasb: Mizraim fathered Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
verses.textEn: Egypt was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,

verses.textZh: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人和迦斐托人；从迦斐托出来的有非利士人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人和迦斐托人；从迦斐托出来的有非利士人。
verses.textZhCuv: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人、迦斐托人；从迦斐托出来的有非利士人。
verses.textEnNiv: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.
verses.textEnEsv: Pathrusim, Casluhim (from whom the Philistines came), and Caphtorim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Pathrusim, and Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines and Caphtorim).
verses.textEnNlt: Pathrusites, Casluhites, and the Caphtorites, from whom the Philistines came.
verses.textEnNasb: Pathrusim, Casluhim (from whom came the Philistines), and Caphtorim.
verses.textEn: Pathrusites, Kasluhites (from whom the Philistines came) and Caphtorites.

verses.textZh: 迦南生了长子西顿，又生赫，
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦南生了长子西顿，又生赫，
verses.textZhCuv: 迦南生长子西顿，又生赫
verses.textEnNiv: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,
verses.textEnEsv: Canaan fathered Sidon his firstborn and Heth,
verses.textEnNkjv: Canaan begot Sidon his firstborn, and Heth;
verses.textEnNlt: Canaan’s oldest son was Sidon, the ancestor of the Sidonians. Canaan was also the ancestor of the Hittites,
verses.textEnNasb: Canaan fathered Sidon, his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.textEn: Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn, and of the Hittites,

verses.textZh: 以及耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以及耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、
verses.textZhCuv: 和耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、
verses.textEnNiv: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
verses.textEnEsv: and the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
verses.textEnNkjv: the Jebusite, the Amorite, and the Girgashite;
verses.textEnNlt: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,
verses.textEnNasb: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,
verses.textEn: Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,

verses.textZh: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、
verses.textZhCnvs: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、
verses.textZhCuv: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、
verses.textEnNiv: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,
verses.textEnEsv: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
verses.textEnNkjv: the Hivite, the Arkite, and the Sinite;
verses.textEnNlt: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,
verses.textEnNasb: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,
verses.textEn: Hivites, Arkites, Sinites,

verses.textZh: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人、哈马人，后来迦南人的宗族分散了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人、哈马人，后来迦南人的宗族分散了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人、哈马人，后来迦南的诸族分散了。
verses.textEnNiv: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans scattered
verses.textEnEsv: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the clans of the Canaanites dispersed.
verses.textEnNkjv: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were dispersed.
verses.textEnNlt: Arvadites, Zemarites, and Hamathites. The Canaanite clans eventually spread out,
verses.textEnNasb: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite; and afterward the families of the Canaanite were spread abroad.
verses.textEn: Arvadites, Zemarites and Hamathites. Later the Canaanite clans scattered

verses.textZh: 迦南人的境界是从西顿伸向基拉耳，直到迦萨；又伸向所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁，直到拉沙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦南人的境界是从西顿伸向基拉耳，直到迦萨；又伸向所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁，直到拉沙。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦南的境界是从西顿向基拉耳的路上，直到迦萨，又向所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁的路上，直到拉沙。
verses.textEnNiv: and the borders of Canaan reached from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboyim, as far as Lasha.
verses.textEnEsv: And the territory of the Canaanites extended from Sidon in the direction of Gerar as far as Gaza, and in the direction of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon as you go toward Gerar, as far as Gaza; then as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
verses.textEnNlt: and the territory of Canaan extended from Sidon in the north to Gerar and Gaza in the south, and east as far as Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, near Lasha.
verses.textEnNasb: The territory of the Canaanite extended from Sidon going toward Gerar, as far as Gaza; and going toward Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, as far as Lasha.
verses.textEn: and the borders of Canaan reached from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza, and then toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboyim, as far as Lasha.

verses.textZh: 这些人都是含的子孙，随着自己的宗族、方言，住在自己的国土中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人都是含的子孙，随着自己的宗族、方言，住在自己的国土中。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是含的后裔，各随他们的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦国。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the sons of Ham by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Ham, by their clans, their languages, their lands, and their nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Ham, according to their families, according to their languages, in their lands and in their nations.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the descendants of Ham, identified by clan, language, territory, and national identity.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Ham, according to their families, according to their languages, by their lands, and by their nations.
verses.textEn: These are the sons of Ham by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.

verses.textZh: 雅弗的哥哥闪，就是希伯所有子孙的祖宗，他也生了孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅弗的哥哥闪，就是希伯所有子孙的祖宗，他也生了孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅弗的哥哥闪，是希伯子孙之祖，他也生了儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Sons were also born to Shem, whose older brother was Japheth; Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.
verses.textEnEsv: To Shem also, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, children were born.
verses.textEnNkjv: And children were born also to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the brother of Japheth the elder.
verses.textEnNlt: Sons were also born to Shem, the older brother of Japheth. Shem was the ancestor of all the descendants of Eber.
verses.textEnNasb: Also to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, and the older brother of Japheth, children were born.
verses.textEn: Sons were also born to Shem, whose older brother was Japheth; Shem was the ancestor of all the sons of Eber.

verses.textZh: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德和亚兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德和亚兰。
