verses.textZhCuv: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德、亚兰。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
verses.textEn: The sons of Shem: Elam, Ashur, Arphaxad, Lud and Aram.

verses.textZh: 亚兰的儿子是乌斯、户勒、基帖、玛施。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚兰的儿子是乌斯、户勒、基帖、玛施。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚兰的儿子是乌斯、户勒、基帖、玛施。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Aram were Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
verses.textEn: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether and Meshek.

verses.textZh: 亚法撒生沙拉，沙拉生希伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚法撒生沙拉，沙拉生希伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
verses.textEnNiv: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.
verses.textEnEsv: Arpachshad fathered Shelah; and Shelah fathered Eber.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arphaxad begot Salah, and Salah begot Eber.
verses.textEnNlt: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
verses.textEnNasb: Arpachshad fathered Shelah; and Shelah fathered Eber.
verses.textEn: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah the father of Eber.

verses.textZh: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒，因为他在世的时候，世人就分散了；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒，因为他在世的时候，世人就分散了；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒 ，因为那时人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。
verses.textEnNiv: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.
verses.textEnEsv: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided, and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.textEnNkjv: To Eber were born two sons: the name of one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.textEnNlt: Eber had two sons. The first was named Peleg (which means "division"), for during his lifetime the people of the world were divided into different language groups. His brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.textEnNasb: Two sons were born to Eber; the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.textEn: Two sons were born to Eber: One was named Peleg, because in his time the earth was divided; his brother was named Joktan.

verses.textZh: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、
verses.textZhCnvs: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、
verses.textZhCuv: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、
verses.textEnNiv: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEnEsv: Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Joktan begot Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEnNlt: Joktan was the ancestor of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEnNasb: Joktan fathered Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.textEn: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

verses.textZh: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、
verses.textZhCuv: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、
verses.textEnNiv: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.textEnEsv: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.textEnNkjv: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.textEnNlt: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.textEnNasb: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.textEn: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

verses.textZh: 俄巴路、亚比玛利、示巴、
verses.textZhCnvs: 俄巴路、亚比玛利、示巴、
verses.textZhCuv: 俄巴路、亚比玛利、示巴、
verses.textEnNiv: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEnEsv: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEnNkjv: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEnNlt: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEnNasb: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.textEn: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

verses.textZh: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴，这些人都是约坍的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴，这些人都是约坍的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴，这都是约坍的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.
verses.textEnEsv: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.textEnNlt: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were descendants of Joktan.
verses.textEnNasb: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab; all of these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.textEn: Ophir, Havilah and Jobab. All these were sons of Joktan.

verses.textZh: 他们居住的地方，是从米沙伸向西发，直到东边的山地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们居住的地方，是从米沙伸向西发，直到东边的山地。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们所住的地方是从米沙直到西发东边的山。
verses.textEnNiv: The region where they lived stretched from Mesha toward Sephar, in the eastern hill country.
verses.textEnEsv: The territory in which they lived extended from Mesha in the direction of Sephar to the hill country of the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: And their dwelling place was from Mesha as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
verses.textEnNlt: The territory they occupied extended from Mesha all the way to Sephar in the eastern mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: Now their settlement extended from Mesha going toward Sephar, the hill country of the east.
verses.textEn: The region where they lived stretched from Mesha toward Sephar, in the eastern hill country.

verses.textZh: 这都是闪的子孙，随着自己的宗族、方言，住在自己的国土中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这都是闪的子孙，随着自己的宗族、方言，住在自己的国土中。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是闪的子孙，各随他们的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦国。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the sons of Shem by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Shem, by their clans, their languages, their lands, and their nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Shem, according to their families, according to their languages, in their lands, according to their nations.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the descendants of Shem, identified by clan, language, territory, and national identity.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Shem, according to their families, according to their languages, by their lands, and according to their nations.
verses.textEn: These are the sons of Shem by their clans and languages, in their territories and nations.

verses.textZh: 这些宗族都是挪亚的子孙，按着他们的族系住在列国中。洪水以后，地上的列国都是从这些宗族分出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些宗族都是挪亚的子孙，按着他们的族系住在列国中。洪水以后，地上的列国都是从这些宗族分出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这些都是挪亚三个儿子的宗族，各随他们的支派立国。洪水以后，他们在地上分为邦国。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their lines of descent, within their nations. From these the nations spread out over the earth after the flood.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the clans of the sons of Noah, according to their genealogies, in their nations, and from these the nations spread abroad on the earth after the flood.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the families of the sons of Noah, according to their generations, in their nations; and from these the nations were divided on the earth after the flood.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the clans that descended from Noah’s sons, arranged by nation according to their lines of descent. All the nations of the earth descended from these clans after the great flood.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the families of the sons of Noah, according to their descendants, by their nations; and out of these the nations were separated on the earth after the flood.
verses.textEn: These are the clans of Noah’s sons, according to their lines of descent, within their nations. From these the nations spread out over the earth after the flood.

verses.textZh: 那时，全世界只有一种语言，大家说同样的话语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，全世界只有一种语言，大家说同样的话语。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，天下人的口音、言语都是一样。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the whole world had one language and a common speech.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the whole earth had one language and the same words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the whole earth had one language and one speech.
verses.textEnNlt: At one time all the people of the world spoke the same language and used the same words.
verses.textEnNasb: Now all the earth used the same language and the same words.
verses.textEn: Now the whole world had one language and a common speech.

verses.textZh: 他们向东迁移的时候，在示拿地发现一块平原，就住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们向东迁移的时候，在示拿地发现一块平原，就住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们往东边迁移的时候，在示拿地遇见一片平原，就住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: As people moved eastward, they found a plain in Shinar and settled there.
verses.textEnEsv: And as people migrated from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they dwelt there.
verses.textEnNlt: As the people migrated to the east, they found a plain in the land of Babylonia and settled there.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, as they journeyed east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
verses.textEn: As people moved eastward, they found a plain in Shinar and settled there.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此说："来，我们做砖，把砖烧透吧！"他们就把砖当作石头，又把石漆当作灰泥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此说："来，我们做砖，把砖烧透吧！"他们就把砖当作石头，又把石漆当作灰泥。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们彼此商量说：「来吧！我们要做砖，把砖烧透了。」他们就拿砖当石头，又拿石漆当灰泥。
verses.textEnNiv: They said to each other, "Come, let’s make bricks and bake them thoroughly." They used brick instead of stone, and tar for mortar.
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to one another, "Come, let us make bricks, and burn them thoroughly." And they had brick for stone, and bitumen for mortar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to one another, "Come, let us make bricks and bake them thoroughly." They had brick for stone, and they had asphalt for mortar.
verses.textEnNlt: They began saying to each other, "Let’s make bricks and harden them with fire." (In this region bricks were used instead of stone, and tar was used for mortar.)
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to one another, "Come, let’s make bricks and fire them thoroughly." And they used brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
verses.textEn: They said to each other, "Come, let’s make bricks and bake them thoroughly." They used brick instead of stone, and tar for mortar.

verses.textZh: 他们又说："来，我们建一座城，造一座塔，塔顶要通天。我们要为自己立名，免得分散在全地上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又说："来，我们建一座城，造一座塔，塔顶要通天。我们要为自己立名，免得分散在全地上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「来吧！我们要建造一座城和一座塔，塔顶通天，为要传扬我们的名，免得我们分散在全地上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens, so that we may make a name for ourselves; otherwise we will be scattered over the face of the whole earth."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city and a tower with its top in the heavens, and let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be dispersed over the face of the whole earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top is in the heavens; let us make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad over the face of the whole earth."
verses.textEnNlt: Then they said, "Come, let’s build a great city for ourselves with a tower that reaches into the sky. This will make us famous and keep us from being scattered all over the world."
verses.textEnNasb: And they said, "Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top will reach into heaven, and let’s make a name for ourselves; otherwise we will be scattered abroad over the face of all the earth."
verses.textEn: Then they said, "Come, let us build ourselves a city, with a tower that reaches to the heavens, so that we may make a name for ourselves; otherwise we will be scattered over the face of the whole earth."

verses.textZh: 耶和华下来，要看看世人建造的城和塔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华下来，要看看世人建造的城和塔。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华降临，要看看世人所建造的城和塔。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord came down to see the city and the tower the people were building.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of man had built.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord came down to see the city and the tower which the sons of men had built.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord came down to look at the city and the tower the people were building.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord came down to see the city and the tower which the men had built.
verses.textEn: But the Lord came down to see the city and the tower the people were building.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："看哪，他们同是一个民族，有一样的语言，他们一开始就作这事，以后他们所要作的一切，就没有可以拦阻他们的了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："看哪，他们同是一个民族，有一样的语言，他们一开始就作这事，以后他们所要作的一切，就没有可以拦阻他们的了。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said, "If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language, and this is only the beginning of what they will do. And nothing that they propose to do will now be impossible for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "Indeed the people are one and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do; now nothing that they propose to do will be withheld from them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Look!" he said. "The people are united, and they all speak the same language. After this, nothing they set out to do will be impossible for them!
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said, "Behold, they are one people, and they all have the same language. And this is what they have started to do, and now nothing which they plan to do will be impossible for them.
verses.textEn: The Lord said, "If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.

verses.textZh: 来，我们下去，在那里混乱他们的语言，使他们听不懂对方的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 来，我们下去，在那里混乱他们的语言，使他们听不懂对方的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们下去，在那里变乱他们的口音，使他们的言语彼此不通。」
verses.textEnNiv: Come, let us go down and confuse their language so they will not understand each other."
verses.textEnEsv: Come, let us go down and there confuse their language, so that they may not understand one another’s speech."
verses.textEnNkjv: Come, let Us go down and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech."
verses.textEnNlt: Come, let’s go down and confuse the people with different languages. Then they won’t be able to understand each other."
verses.textEnNasb: Come, let Us go down and there confuse their language, so that they will not understand one another’s speech."
verses.textEn: Come, let us go down and confuse their language so they will not understand each other."

verses.textZh: 于是，耶和华把他们从那里分散到全地上，他们就停止建造那城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，耶和华把他们从那里分散到全地上，他们就停止建造那城。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是耶和华使他们从那里分散在全地上；他们就停工，不造那城了。
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord scattered them from there over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.
verses.textEnEsv: So the Lord dispersed them from there over the face of all the earth, and they left off building the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord scattered them abroad from there over the face of all the earth, and they ceased building the city.
verses.textEnNlt: In that way, the Lord scattered them all over the world, and they stopped building the city.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord scattered them abroad from there over the face of all the earth; and they stopped building the city.
verses.textEn: So the Lord scattered them from there over all the earth, and they stopped building the city.

verses.textZh: 因此，那城的名就叫巴别，因为耶和华在那里混乱了全地所有的人的语言，又从那里把他们分散在全地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，那城的名就叫巴别，因为耶和华在那里混乱了全地所有的人的语言，又从那里把他们分散在全地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为耶和华在那里变乱天下人的言语，使众人分散在全地上，所以那城名叫巴别 。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why it was called Babel —because there the Lord confused the language of the whole world. From there the Lord scattered them over the face of the whole earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the Lord confused the language of all the earth. And from there the Lord dispersed them over the face of all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore its name is called Babel, because there the Lord confused the language of all the earth; and from there the Lord scattered them abroad over the face of all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why the city was called Babel, because that is where the Lord confused the people with different languages. In this way he scattered them all over the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore it was named Babel, because there the Lord confused the language of all the earth; and from there the Lord scattered them abroad over the face of all the earth.
verses.textEn: That is why it was called Babel —because there the Lord confused the language of the whole world. From there the Lord scattered them over the face of the whole earth.

verses.textZh: 以下是闪的后代。洪水以后两年，闪一百岁的时候，生了亚法撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是闪的后代。洪水以后两年，闪一百岁的时候，生了亚法撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 闪的后代记在下面。洪水以后二年，闪一百岁生了亚法撒。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of Shem’s family line. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of Shem. When Shem was 100 years old, he fathered Arpachshad two years after the flood.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the genealogy of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old, and begot Arphaxad two years after the flood.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of Shem’s family. Two years after the great flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the records of the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old when he fathered Arpachshad, two years after the flood;
verses.textEn: This is the account of Shem’s family line. Two years after the flood, when Shem was 100 years old, he became the father of Arphaxad.

verses.textZh: 闪生亚法撒以后，又活了五百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 闪生亚法撒以后，又活了五百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 闪生亚法撒之后又活了五百年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: And after he became the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And Shem lived after he fathered Arpachshad 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Arphaxad, Shem lived five hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Arphaxad, Shem lived another 500 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and Shem lived five hundred years after he fathered Arpachshad, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: And after he became the father of Arphaxad, Shem lived 500 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 亚法撒活到三十五岁，就生了沙拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚法撒活到三十五岁，就生了沙拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚法撒活到三十五岁，生了沙拉。
verses.textEnNiv: When Arphaxad had lived 35 years, he became the father of Shelah.
verses.textEnEsv: When Arpachshad had lived 35 years, he fathered Shelah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arphaxad lived thirty-five years, and begot Salah.
verses.textEnNlt: When Arphaxad was 35 years old, he became the father of Shelah.
verses.textEnNasb: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years, and fathered Shelah;
verses.textEn: When Arphaxad had lived 35 years, he became the father of Shelah.

verses.textZh: 亚法撒生沙拉以后，又活了四百零三年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚法撒生沙拉以后，又活了四百零三年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚法撒生沙拉之后又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: And after he became the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And Arpachshad lived after he fathered Shelah 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Salah, Arphaxad lived four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Shelah, Arphaxad lived another 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and Arpachshad lived 403 years after he fathered Shelah, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: And after he became the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 沙拉活到三十岁，就生了希伯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙拉活到三十岁，就生了希伯。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙拉活到三十岁，生了希伯。
verses.textEnNiv: When Shelah had lived 30 years, he became the father of Eber.
verses.textEnEsv: When Shelah had lived 30 years, he fathered Eber.
verses.textEnNkjv: Salah lived thirty years, and begot Eber.
verses.textEnNlt: When Shelah was 30 years old, he became the father of Eber.
verses.textEnNasb: Shelah lived thirty years, and fathered Eber;
verses.textEn: When Shelah had lived 30 years, he became the father of Eber.

verses.textZh: 沙拉生希伯以后，又活了四百零三年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙拉生希伯以后，又活了四百零三年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙拉生希伯之后又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: And after he became the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And Shelah lived after he fathered Eber 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Eber, Salah lived four hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Eber, Shelah lived another 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and Shelah lived 403 years after he fathered Eber, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: And after he became the father of Eber, Shelah lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 希伯活到三十四岁，就生了法勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯活到三十四岁，就生了法勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯活到三十四岁，生了法勒。
verses.textEnNiv: When Eber had lived 34 years, he became the father of Peleg.
verses.textEnEsv: When Eber had lived 34 years, he fathered Peleg.
verses.textEnNkjv: Eber lived thirty-four years, and begot Peleg.
verses.textEnNlt: When Eber was 34 years old, he became the father of Peleg.
verses.textEnNasb: Eber lived thirty-four years, and fathered Peleg;
verses.textEn: When Eber had lived 34 years, he became the father of Peleg.

verses.textZh: 希伯生法勒以后，又活了四百三十年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 希伯生法勒以后，又活了四百三十年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 希伯生法勒之后又活了四百三十年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: And after he became the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And Eber lived after he fathered Peleg 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Peleg, Eber lived four hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Peleg, Eber lived another 430 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and Eber lived 430 years after he fathered Peleg, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: And after he became the father of Peleg, Eber lived 430 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 法勒活到三十岁，就生了拉吴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法勒活到三十岁，就生了拉吴。
verses.textZhCuv: 法勒活到三十岁，生了拉吴。
verses.textEnNiv: When Peleg had lived 30 years, he became the father of Reu.
verses.textEnEsv: When Peleg had lived 30 years, he fathered Reu.
verses.textEnNkjv: Peleg lived thirty years, and begot Reu.
verses.textEnNlt: When Peleg was 30 years old, he became the father of Reu.
verses.textEnNasb: Peleg lived thirty years, and fathered Reu;
verses.textEn: When Peleg had lived 30 years, he became the father of Reu.

verses.textZh: 法勒生拉吴以后，又活了二百零九年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法勒生拉吴以后，又活了二百零九年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 法勒生拉吴之后又活了二百零九年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: And after he became the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And Peleg lived after he fathered Reu 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Reu, Peleg lived two hundred and nine years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Reu, Peleg lived another 209 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and Peleg lived 209 years after he fathered Reu, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: And after he became the father of Reu, Peleg lived 209 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 拉吴活到三十二岁，就生了西鹿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉吴活到三十二岁，就生了西鹿。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉吴活到三十二岁，生了西鹿。
verses.textEnNiv: When Reu had lived 32 years, he became the father of Serug.
verses.textEnEsv: When Reu had lived 32 years, he fathered Serug.
verses.textEnNkjv: Reu lived thirty-two years, and begot Serug.
verses.textEnNlt: When Reu was 32 years old, he became the father of Serug.
verses.textEnNasb: Reu lived thirty-two years, and fathered Serug;
verses.textEn: When Reu had lived 32 years, he became the father of Serug.

verses.textZh: 拉吴生西鹿以后，又活了二百零七年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉吴生西鹿以后，又活了二百零七年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉吴生西鹿之后又活了二百零七年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: And after he became the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And Reu lived after he fathered Serug 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Serug, Reu lived two hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Serug, Reu lived another 207 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and Reu lived 207 years after he fathered Serug, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: And after he became the father of Serug, Reu lived 207 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 西鹿活到三十岁，就生了拿鹤。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西鹿活到三十岁，就生了拿鹤。
verses.textZhCuv: 西鹿活到三十岁，生了拿鹤。
verses.textEnNiv: When Serug had lived 30 years, he became the father of Nahor.
verses.textEnEsv: When Serug had lived 30 years, he fathered Nahor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Serug lived thirty years, and begot Nahor.
verses.textEnNlt: When Serug was 30 years old, he became the father of Nahor.
verses.textEnNasb: Serug lived thirty years, and fathered Nahor;
verses.textEn: When Serug had lived 30 years, he became the father of Nahor.

verses.textZh: 西鹿生拿鹤以后，又活了二百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西鹿生拿鹤以后，又活了二百年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 西鹿生拿鹤之后又活了二百年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: And after he became the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And Serug lived after he fathered Nahor 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Nahor, Serug lived two hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Nahor, Serug lived another 200 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and Serug lived two hundred years after he fathered Nahor, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: And after he became the father of Nahor, Serug lived 200 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 拿鹤活到二十九岁，就生了他拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿鹤活到二十九岁，就生了他拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿鹤活到二十九岁，生了他拉。
verses.textEnNiv: When Nahor had lived 29 years, he became the father of Terah.
verses.textEnEsv: When Nahor had lived 29 years, he fathered Terah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and begot Terah.
verses.textEnNlt: When Nahor was 29 years old, he became the father of Terah.
verses.textEnNasb: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and fathered Terah;
verses.textEn: When Nahor had lived 29 years, he became the father of Terah.

verses.textZh: 拿鹤生他拉以后，又活了一百一十九年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿鹤生他拉以后，又活了一百一十九年，并且生了其他的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿鹤生他拉之后又活了一百一十九年，并且生儿养女。
verses.textEnNiv: And after he became the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnEsv: And Nahor lived after he fathered Terah 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: After he begot Terah, Nahor lived one hundred and nineteen years, and begot sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: After the birth of Terah, Nahor lived another 119 years and had other sons and daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: and Nahor lived 119 years after he fathered Terah, and he fathered other sons and daughters.
verses.textEn: And after he became the father of Terah, Nahor lived 119 years and had other sons and daughters.

verses.textZh: 他拉活到七十岁，就生了亚伯兰、拿鹤和哈兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拉活到七十岁，就生了亚伯兰、拿鹤和哈兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 他拉活到七十岁，生了亚伯兰、拿鹤、哈兰。
verses.textEnNiv: After Terah had lived 70 years, he became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran.
verses.textEnEsv: When Terah had lived 70 years, he fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Terah lived seventy years, and begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.textEnNlt: After Terah was 70 years old, he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.textEnNasb: Terah lived seventy years, and fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.textEn: After Terah had lived 70 years, he became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran.

verses.textZh: 以下是他拉的后代：他拉生亚伯兰、拿鹤和哈兰；哈兰生罗得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是他拉的后代：他拉生亚伯兰、拿鹤和哈兰；哈兰生罗得。
verses.textZhCuv: 他拉的后代记在下面。他拉生亚伯兰、拿鹤、哈兰；哈兰生罗得。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of Terah’s family line. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.
verses.textEnEsv: Now these are the generations of Terah. Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran fathered Lot.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the genealogy of Terah: Terah begot Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran begot Lot.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of Terah’s family. Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran was the father of Lot.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the records of the generations of Terah. Terah fathered Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran fathered Lot.
verses.textEn: This is the account of Terah’s family line. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. And Haran became the father of Lot.

verses.textZh: 哈兰在他父亲他拉之前，死在他出生之地，就是迦勒底的吾珥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈兰在他父亲他拉之前，死在他出生之地，就是迦勒底的吾珥。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈兰死在他的本地迦勒底的吾珥，在他父亲他拉之先。
verses.textEnNiv: While his father Terah was still alive, Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, in the land of his birth.
verses.textEnEsv: Haran died in the presence of his father Terah in the land of his kindred, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Haran died before his father Terah in his native land, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNlt: But Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, the land of his birth, while his father, Terah, was still living.
verses.textEnNasb: Haran died during the lifetime of his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEn: While his father Terah was still alive, Haran died in Ur of the Chaldeans, in the land of his birth.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰和拿鹤都娶了妻子；亚伯兰的妻子名叫撒莱；拿鹤的妻子名叫密迦，是哈兰的女儿；哈兰是密迦和亦迦的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰和拿鹤都娶了妻子；亚伯兰的妻子名叫撒莱；拿鹤的妻子名叫密迦，是哈兰的女儿；哈兰是密迦和亦迦的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰、拿鹤各娶了妻：亚伯兰的妻子名叫撒莱；拿鹤的妻子名叫密迦，是哈兰的女儿；哈兰是密迦和亦迦的父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milkah; she was the daughter of Haran, the father of both Milkah and Iskah.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abram and Nahor took wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran the father of Milcah and Iscah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abram and Nahor took wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran the father of Milcah and the father of Iscah.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah. (Milcah and her sister Iscah were daughters of Nahor’s brother Haran.)
verses.textEnNasb: Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah and Iscah.
verses.textEn: Abram and Nahor both married. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milkah; she was the daughter of Haran, the father of both Milkah and Iskah.

verses.textZh: 撒莱不能生育，没有孩子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒莱不能生育，没有孩子。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒莱不生育，没有孩子。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Sarai was childless because she was not able to conceive.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.textEnNlt: But Sarai was unable to become pregnant and had no children.
verses.textEnNasb: Sarai was unable to conceive; she did not have a child.
verses.textEn: Now Sarai was childless because she was not able to conceive.

verses.textZh: 他拉带着他的儿子亚伯兰和他的孙子，就是哈兰的儿子罗得，以及他的媳妇亚伯兰的妻子撒莱，一同出了迦勒底的吾珥，要到迦南地去；他们到了哈兰，就住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拉带着他的儿子亚伯兰和他的孙子，就是哈兰的儿子罗得，以及他的媳妇亚伯兰的妻子撒莱，一同出了迦勒底的吾珥，要到迦南地去；他们到了哈兰，就住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他拉带着他儿子亚伯兰和他孙子哈兰的儿子罗得，并他儿妇亚伯兰的妻子撒莱，出了迦勒底的吾珥，要往迦南地去；他们走到哈兰，就住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, the wife of his son Abram, and together they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to Canaan. But when they came to Harran, they settled there.
verses.textEnEsv: Terah took Abram his son and Lot the son of Haran, his grandson, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife, and they went forth together from Ur of the Chaldeans to go into the land of Canaan, but when they came to Haran, they settled there.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Terah took his son Abram and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, his son Abram’s wife, and they went out with them from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran and dwelt there.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Terah took his son Abram, his daughter-in-law Sarai (his son Abram’s wife), and his grandson Lot (his son Haran’s child) and moved away from Ur of the Chaldeans. He was headed for the land of Canaan, but they stopped at Haran and settled there.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Terah took his son Abram, and Lot the son of Haran, his grandson, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, his son Abram’s wife, and they departed together from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to the land of Canaan; and they went as far as Haran and settled there.
verses.textEn: Terah took his son Abram, his grandson Lot son of Haran, and his daughter-in-law Sarai, the wife of his son Abram, and together they set out from Ur of the Chaldeans to go to Canaan. But when they came to Harran, they settled there.

verses.textZh: 他拉死在哈兰；他的寿数共二百零五岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拉死在哈兰；他的寿数共二百零五岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 他拉共活了二百零五岁，就死在哈兰。
verses.textEnNiv: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Harran.
verses.textEnEsv: The days of Terah were 205 years, and Terah died in Haran.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the days of Terah were two hundred and five years, and Terah died in Haran.
verses.textEnNlt: Terah lived for 205 years and died while still in Haran.
verses.textEnNasb: The days of Terah were 205 years; and Terah died in Haran.
verses.textEn: Terah lived 205 years, and he died in Harran.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对亚伯兰说： "你要离开本地、本族、父家， 到我指示你的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对亚伯兰说： "你要离开本地、本族、父家， 到我指示你的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对亚伯兰说：「你要离开本地、本族、父家，往我所要指示你的地去。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord had said to Abram, "Go from your country, your people and your father’s household to the land I will show you.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Lord said to Abram, "Go from your country and your kindred and your father’s house to the land that I will show you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord had said to Abram: "Get out of your country, From your family And from your father’s house, To a land that I will show you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord had said to Abram, "Leave your native country, your relatives, and your father’s family, and go to the land that I will show you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord said to Abram, "Go from your country, And from your relatives And from your father’s house, To the land which I will show you;
verses.textEn: The Lord had said to Abram, "Go from your country, your people and your father’s household to the land I will show you.

verses.textZh: 我必使你成为大国， 赐福给你， 使你的名为大， 你也必使别人得福，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你成为大国， 赐福给你， 使你的名为大， 你也必使别人得福，
verses.textZhCuv: 我必叫你成为大国。我必赐福给你，叫你的名为大；你也要叫别人得福。
verses.textEnNiv: "I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make of you a great nation, and I will bless you and make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make you a great nation; I will bless you And make your name great; And you shall be a blessing.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make you into a great nation. I will bless you and make you famous, and you will be a blessing to others.
verses.textEnNasb: And I will make you into a great nation, And I will bless you, And make your name great; And you shall be a blessing;
verses.textEn: "I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.

verses.textZh: 给你祝福的，我必赐福给他； 咒诅你的，我必咒诅他； 地上的万族，都必因你得福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 给你祝福的，我必赐福给他； 咒诅你的，我必咒诅他； 地上的万族，都必因你得福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 为你祝福的，我必赐福与他；那咒诅你的，我必咒诅他。地上的万族都要因你得福。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you."
verses.textEnEsv: I will bless those who bless you, and him who dishonors you I will curse, and in you all the families of the earth shall be blessed."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will bless those who bless you, And I will curse him who curses you; And in you all the families of the earth shall be blessed."
verses.textEnNlt: I will bless those who bless you and curse those who treat you with contempt. All the families on earth will be blessed through you."
verses.textEnNasb: And I will bless those who bless you, And the one who curses you I will curse. And in you all the families of the earth will be blessed."
verses.textEn: I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you."

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰就照着耶和华吩咐他的去了；罗得也和他同去。亚伯兰离开哈兰的时候，已经七十五岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰就照着耶和华吩咐他的去了；罗得也和他同去。亚伯兰离开哈兰的时候，已经七十五岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰就照着耶和华的吩咐去了；罗得也和他同去。亚伯兰出哈兰的时候年七十五岁。
verses.textEnNiv: So Abram went, as the Lord had told him; and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he set out from Harran.
verses.textEnEsv: So Abram went, as the Lord had told him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abram departed as the Lord had spoken to him, and Lot went with him. And Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abram departed as the Lord had instructed, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abram went away as the Lord had spoken to him; and Lot went with him. Now Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
verses.textEn: So Abram went, as the Lord had told him; and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he set out from Harran.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰带着他的妻子撒莱和侄儿罗得以及他们在哈兰所积蓄的一切财物，和所获得的人口，一同出来，要到迦南地去。后来他们到了迦南地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰带着他的妻子撒莱和侄儿罗得以及他们在哈兰所积蓄的一切财物，和所获得的人口，一同出来，要到迦南地去。后来他们到了迦南地。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰将他妻子撒莱和侄儿罗得，连他们在哈兰所积蓄的财物、所得的人口，都带往迦南地去。他们就到了迦南地。
verses.textEnNiv: He took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, all the possessions they had accumulated and the people they had acquired in Harran, and they set out for the land of Canaan, and they arrived there.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abram took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother’s son, and all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people that they had acquired in Haran, and they set out to go to the land of Canaan. When they came to the land of Canaan,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abram took Sarai his wife and Lot his brother’s son, and all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they departed to go to the land of Canaan. So they came to the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: He took his wife, Sarai, his nephew Lot, and all his wealth—his livestock and all the people he had taken into his household at Haran—and headed for the land of Canaan. When they arrived in Canaan,
verses.textEnNasb: Abram took his wife Sarai and his nephew Lot, and all their possessions which they had accumulated, and the people which they had acquired in Haran, and they set out for the land of Canaan; so they came to the land of Canaan.
verses.textEn: He took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, all the possessions they had accumulated and the people they had acquired in Harran, and they set out for the land of Canaan, and they arrived there.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰穿过那地，到了示剑的地方，摩利的橡树那里。当时，迦南人住在那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰穿过那地，到了示剑的地方，摩利的橡树那里。当时，迦南人住在那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰经过那地，到了示剑地方、摩利橡树那里。那时迦南人住在那地。
verses.textEnNiv: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the great tree of Moreh at Shechem. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Abram passed through the land to the place at Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, as far as the terebinth tree of Moreh. And the Canaanites were then in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Abram traveled through the land as far as Shechem. There he set up camp beside the oak of Moreh. At that time, the area was inhabited by Canaanites.
verses.textEnNasb: Abram passed through the land as far as the site of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. Now the Canaanites were in the land at that time.
verses.textEn: Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the great tree of Moreh at Shechem. At that time the Canaanites were in the land.

verses.textZh: 耶和华向亚伯兰显现，说："我要把这地赐给你的后裔。"亚伯兰就在那里为向他显现的耶和华筑了一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华向亚伯兰显现，说："我要把这地赐给你的后裔。"亚伯兰就在那里为向他显现的耶和华筑了一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向亚伯兰显现，说：「我要把这地赐给你的后裔。」亚伯兰就在那里为向他显现的耶和华筑了一座坛。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord appeared to Abram and said, "To your offspring I will give this land." So he built an altar there to the Lord , who had appeared to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord appeared to Abram and said, "To your offspring I will give this land." So he built there an altar to the Lord , who had appeared to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord appeared to Abram and said, "To your descendants I will give this land." And there he built an altar to the Lord, who had appeared to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord appeared to Abram and said, "I will give this land to your descendants. " And Abram built an altar there and dedicated it to the Lord , who had appeared to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord appeared to Abram and said, "To your descendants I will give this land." So he built an altar there to the Lord who had appeared to him.
verses.textEn: The Lord appeared to Abram and said, "To your offspring I will give this land." So he built an altar there to the Lord , who had appeared to him.

verses.textZh: 后来他从那里迁到伯特利东边的山地，搭起帐棚。西边是伯特利，东边是艾城；他在那里也为耶和华筑了一座祭坛，呼求耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来他从那里迁到伯特利东边的山地，搭起帐棚。西边是伯特利，东边是艾城；他在那里也为耶和华筑了一座祭坛，呼求耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 从那里他又迁到伯特利东边的山，支搭帐棚；西边是伯特利，东边是艾。他在那里又为耶和华筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名。
verses.textEnNiv: From there he went on toward the hills east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the Lord and called on the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: From there he moved to the hill country on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. And there he built an altar to the Lord and called upon the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And he moved from there to the mountain east of Bethel, and he pitched his tent with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; there he built an altar to the Lord and called on the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: After that, Abram traveled south and set up camp in the hill country, with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east. There he built another altar and dedicated it to the Lord , and he worshiped the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then he proceeded from there to the mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east; and there he built an altar to the Lord and called upon the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: From there he went on toward the hills east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel on the west and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the Lord and called on the name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰又起程，渐渐移到南地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰又起程，渐渐移到南地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来亚伯兰又渐渐迁往南地去。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abram set out and continued toward the Negev.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abram journeyed on, still going toward the Negeb.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abram journeyed, going on still toward the South.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abram continued traveling south by stages toward the Negev.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abram journeyed on, continuing toward the Negev.
verses.textEn: Then Abram set out and continued toward the Negev.

verses.textZh: 当时，那地发生饥荒，亚伯兰就下到埃及去，要在那里寄居；因为那地的饥荒十分严重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，那地发生饥荒，亚伯兰就下到埃及去，要在那里寄居；因为那地的饥荒十分严重。
verses.textZhCuv: 那地遭遇饥荒。因饥荒甚大，亚伯兰就下埃及去，要在那里暂居。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was a famine in the land. So Abram went down to Egypt to sojourn there, for the famine was severe in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to dwell there, for the famine was severe in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time a severe famine struck the land of Canaan, forcing Abram to go down to Egypt, where he lived as a foreigner.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a famine in the land; so Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a time, because the famine was severe in the land.
verses.textEn: Now there was a famine in the land, and Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.

verses.textZh: 快要到达埃及的时候，亚伯兰对他的妻子撒莱说："看哪，我知道你是个美貌的女人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 快要到达埃及的时候，亚伯兰对他的妻子撒莱说："看哪，我知道你是个美貌的女人。
verses.textZhCuv: 将近埃及，就对他妻子撒莱说：「我知道你是容貌俊美的妇人。
verses.textEnNiv: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, "I know what a beautiful woman you are.
verses.textEnEsv: When he was about to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, "I know that you are a woman beautiful in appearance,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when he was close to entering Egypt, that he said to Sarai his wife, "Indeed I know that you are a woman of beautiful countenance.
verses.textEnNlt: As he was approaching the border of Egypt, Abram said to his wife, Sarai, "Look, you are a very beautiful woman.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about, when he was approaching Egypt, that he said to his wife Sarai, "See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman;
verses.textEn: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, "I know what a beautiful woman you are.

verses.textZh: 埃及人看见你的时候，必会说：‘这是他的妻子’，他们就会杀我，却叫你活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及人看见你的时候，必会说：‘这是他的妻子’，他们就会杀我，却叫你活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及人看见你必说：『这是他的妻子』，他们就要杀我，却叫你存活。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.
verses.textEnEsv: and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me, but they will let you live.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore it will happen, when the Egyptians see you, that they will say, ‘This is his wife’; and they will kill me, but they will let you live.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife. Let’s kill him; then we can have her!’
verses.textEnNasb: and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife’; and they will kill me, but they will let you live.
verses.textEn: When the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.

verses.textZh: 请你说你是我的妹妹，使我因你的缘故可以平安无事，我的性命也可以因你的缘故得以保全。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你说你是我的妹妹，使我因你的缘故可以平安无事，我的性命也可以因你的缘故得以保全。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求你说，你是我的妹子，使我因你得平安，我的命也因你存活。」
verses.textEnNiv: Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake and my life will be spared because of you."
verses.textEnEsv: Say you are my sister, that it may go well with me because of you, and that my life may be spared for your sake."
verses.textEnNkjv: Please say you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that I may live because of you."
verses.textEnNlt: So please tell them you are my sister. Then they will spare my life and treat me well because of their interest in you."
verses.textEnNasb: Please say that you are my sister so that it may go well for me because of you, and that I may live on account of you."
verses.textEn: Say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake and my life will be spared because of you."

verses.textZh: 果然，亚伯兰进入埃及的时候，埃及人就注视那女人，因为她十分美丽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 果然，亚伯兰进入埃及的时候，埃及人就注视那女人，因为她十分美丽。
verses.textZhCuv: 及至亚伯兰到了埃及，埃及人看见那妇人极其美貌。
verses.textEnNiv: When Abram came to Egypt, the Egyptians saw that Sarai was a very beautiful woman.
verses.textEnEsv: When Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when Abram came into Egypt, that the Egyptians saw the woman, that she was very beautiful.
verses.textEnNlt: And sure enough, when Abram arrived in Egypt, everyone noticed Sarai’s beauty.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when Abram entered Egypt, that the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
verses.textEn: When Abram came to Egypt, the Egyptians saw that Sarai was a very beautiful woman.

verses.textZh: 法老的一些大臣看见了撒莱，就在法老面前称赞她；于是那女人被带进法老的宫里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老的一些大臣看见了撒莱，就在法老面前称赞她；于是那女人被带进法老的宫里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老的臣宰看见了她，就在法老面前夸奖她。那妇人就被带进法老的宫去。
verses.textEnNiv: And when Pharaoh’s officials saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the princes of Pharaoh saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh. And the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: The princes of Pharaoh also saw her and commended her to Pharaoh. And the woman was taken to Pharaoh’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: When the palace officials saw her, they sang her praises to Pharaoh, their king, and Sarai was taken into his palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Pharaoh’s officials saw her and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.textEn: And when Pharaoh’s officials saw her, they praised her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into his palace.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰因这女人的缘故就被优待，得了许多牛羊、公驴、母驴、仆婢和骆驼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰因这女人的缘故就被优待，得了许多牛羊、公驴、母驴、仆婢和骆驼。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老因这妇人就厚待亚伯兰，亚伯兰得了许多牛、羊、骆驼、公驴、母驴、仆婢。
verses.textEnNiv: He treated Abram well for her sake, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, male and female servants, and camels.
verses.textEnEsv: And for her sake he dealt well with Abram; and he had sheep, oxen, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
verses.textEnNkjv: He treated Abram well for her sake. He had sheep, oxen, male donkeys, male and female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh gave Abram many gifts because of her—sheep, goats, cattle, male and female donkeys, male and female servants, and camels.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore he treated Abram well for her sake; and he gave him sheep, oxen, male donkeys, male servants and female servants, female donkeys, and camels.
verses.textEn: He treated Abram well for her sake, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, male and female servants, and camels.

verses.textZh: 耶和华因为亚伯兰的妻子撒莱的缘故，就用严重的灾病打击法老和他的全家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华因为亚伯兰的妻子撒莱的缘故，就用严重的灾病打击法老和他的全家。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华因亚伯兰妻子撒莱的缘故，降大灾与法老和他的全家。
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord inflicted serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household because of Abram’s wife Sarai.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord sent terrible plagues upon Pharaoh and his household because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord struck Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.
verses.textEn: But the Lord inflicted serious diseases on Pharaoh and his household because of Abram’s wife Sarai.

verses.textZh: 于是，法老把亚伯兰召了来，对他说："你向我作的是甚么？你为甚么不告诉我她是你的妻子呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，法老把亚伯兰召了来，对他说："你向我作的是甚么？你为甚么不告诉我她是你的妻子呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 法老就召了亚伯兰来，说：「你这向我做的是什么事呢？为什么没有告诉我她是你的妻子？
verses.textEnNiv: So Pharaoh summoned Abram. "What have you done to me?" he said. "Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
verses.textEnEsv: So Pharaoh called Abram and said, "What is this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh called Abram and said, "What is this you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?
verses.textEnNlt: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and accused him sharply. "What have you done to me?" he demanded. "Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh called Abram and said, "What is this that you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?
verses.textEn: So Pharaoh summoned Abram. "What have you done to me?" he said. "Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?

verses.textZh: 你为甚么说她是你的妹妹，以致我娶了她作妻子呢？现在，你的妻子在这里，带她走吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么说她是你的妹妹，以致我娶了她作妻子呢？现在，你的妻子在这里，带她走吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 为什么说她是你的妹子，以致我把她取来要作我的妻子？现在你的妻子在这里，可以带她走吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!"
verses.textEnEsv: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her for my wife? Now then, here is your wife; take her, and go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’? I might have taken her as my wife. Now therefore, here is your wife; take her and go your way."
verses.textEnNlt: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ and allow me to take her as my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and get out of here!"
verses.textEnNasb: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her for myself as a wife? Now then, here is your wife, take her and go!"
verses.textEn: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!"

verses.textZh: 法老为了亚伯兰的事吩咐臣仆，他们就把亚伯兰和他的妻子，以及他所有的一切都送走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老为了亚伯兰的事吩咐臣仆，他们就把亚伯兰和他的妻子，以及他所有的一切都送走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是法老吩咐人将亚伯兰和他妻子，并他所有的都送走了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh gave orders about Abram to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and everything he had.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh gave men orders concerning him, and they sent him away with his wife and all that he had.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him; and they sent him away, with his wife and all that he had.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh ordered some of his men to escort them, and he sent Abram out of the country, along with his wife and all his possessions.
verses.textEnNasb: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him; and they escorted him away, with his wife and all that belonged to him.
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh gave orders about Abram to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and everything he had.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰带着妻子和所有的一切，以及罗得，一同从埃及上到南地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰带着妻子和所有的一切，以及罗得，一同从埃及上到南地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰带着他的妻子与罗得，并一切所有的，都从埃及上南地去。
verses.textEnNiv: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, with his wife and everything he had, and Lot went with him.
verses.textEnEsv: So Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all that he had, and Lot with him, into the Negeb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abram went up from Egypt, he and his wife and all that he had, and Lot with him, to the South.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abram left Egypt and traveled north into the Negev, along with his wife and Lot and all that they owned.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, he and his wife and all that belonged to him, and Lot with him.
verses.textEn: So Abram went up from Egypt to the Negev, with his wife and everything he had, and Lot went with him.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰有很多牲畜和金银。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰有很多牲畜和金银。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰的金、银、牲畜极多。
verses.textEnNiv: Abram had become very wealthy in livestock and in silver and gold.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
verses.textEnNlt: (Abram was very rich in livestock, silver, and gold.)
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abram was very rich in livestock, silver, and gold.
verses.textEn: Abram had become very wealthy in livestock and in silver and gold.

verses.textZh: 他从南地一站一站往前走，到伯特利去；到伯特利和艾城中间，就是他起先支搭帐棚的地方，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他从南地一站一站往前走，到伯特利去；到伯特利和艾城中间，就是他起先支搭帐棚的地方，
verses.textZhCuv: 他从南地渐渐往伯特利去，到了伯特利和艾的中间，就是从前支搭帐棚的地方，
verses.textEnNiv: From the Negev he went from place to place until he came to Bethel, to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had been earlier
verses.textEnEsv: And he journeyed on from the Negeb as far as Bethel to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he went on his journey from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
verses.textEnNlt: From the Negev, they continued traveling by stages toward Bethel, and they pitched their tents between Bethel and Ai, where they had camped before.
verses.textEnNasb: And he went on his journeys from the Negev as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,
verses.textEn: From the Negev he went from place to place until he came to Bethel, to the place between Bethel and Ai where his tent had been earlier

verses.textZh: 也是他筑头一座祭坛的地方，亚伯兰就在那里求告耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也是他筑头一座祭坛的地方，亚伯兰就在那里求告耶和华的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 也是他起先筑坛的地方；他又在那里求告耶和华的名。
verses.textEnNiv: and where he had first built an altar. There Abram called on the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: to the place where he had made an altar at the first. And there Abram called upon the name of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: to the place of the altar which he had made there at first. And there Abram called on the name of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: This was the same place where Abram had built the altar, and there he worshiped the Lord again.
verses.textEnNasb: to the place of the altar which he had made there previously; and there Abram called on the name of the Lord.
verses.textEn: and where he had first built an altar. There Abram called on the name of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 和亚伯兰同行的罗得，也有羊群、牛群和帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 和亚伯兰同行的罗得，也有羊群、牛群和帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 与亚伯兰同行的罗得也有牛群、羊群、帐棚。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Lot, who was moving about with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.
verses.textEnEsv: And Lot, who went with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents,
verses.textEnNkjv: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks and herds and tents.
verses.textEnNlt: Lot, who was traveling with Abram, had also become very wealthy with flocks of sheep and goats, herds of cattle, and many tents.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Lot, who went with Abram, also had flocks, herds, and tents.
verses.textEn: Now Lot, who was moving about with Abram, also had flocks and herds and tents.

verses.textZh: 那地容不下他们住在一起；因为他们的财物很多，所以他们再也不能住在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地容不下他们住在一起；因为他们的财物很多，所以他们再也不能住在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 那地容不下他们；因为他们的财物甚多，使他们不能同居。
verses.textEnNiv: But the land could not support them while they stayed together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to stay together.
verses.textEnEsv: so that the land could not support both of them dwelling together; for their possessions were so great that they could not dwell together,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the land was not able to support them, that they might dwell together, for their possessions were so great that they could not dwell together.
verses.textEnNlt: But the land could not support both Abram and Lot with all their flocks and herds living so close together.
verses.textEnNasb: And the land could not support both of them while living together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to remain together.
verses.textEn: But the land could not support them while they stayed together, for their possessions were so great that they were not able to stay together.

verses.textZh: 牧养亚伯兰牲畜的和牧养罗得牲畜的，起了纷争；当时迦南人和比利洗人还住在那地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牧养亚伯兰牲畜的和牧养罗得牲畜的，起了纷争；当时迦南人和比利洗人还住在那地。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，迦南人与比利洗人在那地居住。亚伯兰的牧人和罗得的牧人相争。
verses.textEnNiv: And quarreling arose between Abram’s herders and Lot’s. The Canaanites and Perizzites were also living in the land at that time.
verses.textEnEsv: and there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. At that time the Canaanites and the Perizzites were dwelling in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites then dwelt in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: So disputes broke out between the herdsmen of Abram and Lot. (At that time Canaanites and Perizzites were also living in the land.)
verses.textEnNasb: And there was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. Now the Canaanites and the Perizzites were living in the land at that time.
verses.textEn: And quarreling arose between Abram’s herders and Lot’s. The Canaanites and Perizzites were also living in the land at that time.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰就对罗得说："你我之间，切不可纷争；你的牧人和我的牧人之间，也不可纷争，因为我们是至亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰就对罗得说："你我之间，切不可纷争；你的牧人和我的牧人之间，也不可纷争，因为我们是至亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰就对罗得说：「你我不可相争，你的牧人和我的牧人也不可相争，因为我们是骨肉 。
verses.textEnNiv: So Abram said to Lot, "Let’s not have any quarreling between you and me, or between your herders and mine, for we are close relatives.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abram said to Lot, "Let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen, for we are kinsmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abram said to Lot, "Please let there be no strife between you and me, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen; for we are brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally Abram said to Lot, "Let’s not allow this conflict to come between us or our herdsmen. After all, we are close relatives!
verses.textEnNasb: So Abram said to Lot, "Please let there be no strife between you and me, nor between my herdsmen and your herdsmen, for we are relatives!
verses.textEn: So Abram said to Lot, "Let’s not have any quarreling between you and me, or between your herders and mine, for we are close relatives.

verses.textZh: 全地不都是在你面前吗？请你离开我吧！你若向左，我就向右；你若向右，我就向左。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 全地不都是在你面前吗？请你离开我吧！你若向左，我就向右；你若向右，我就向左。"
verses.textZhCuv: 遍地不都在你眼前吗？请你离开我：你向左，我就向右；你向右，我就向左。」
verses.textEnNiv: Is not the whole land before you? Let’s part company. If you go to the left, I’ll go to the right; if you go to the right, I’ll go to the left."
verses.textEnEsv: Is not the whole land before you? Separate yourself from me. If you take the left hand, then I will go to the right, or if you take the right hand, then I will go to the left."
verses.textEnNkjv: Is not the whole land before you? Please separate from me. If youtake the left, then I will go to the right; or, if yougo to the right, then I will go to the left."
verses.textEnNlt: The whole countryside is open to you. Take your choice of any section of the land you want, and we will separate. If you want the land to the left, then I’ll take the land on the right. If you prefer the land on the right, then I’ll go to the left."
verses.textEnNasb: Is the entire land not before you? Please separate from me; if you choose the left, then I will go to the right; or if you choose the right, then I will go to the left."
verses.textEn: Is not the whole land before you? Let’s part company. If you go to the left, I’ll go to the right; if you go to the right, I’ll go to the left."

verses.textZh: 罗得举目，看见约旦河整个平原，直到琐珥，都有水灌溉；在耶和华毁灭所多玛和蛾摩拉之前，这地好象耶和华的园子，也像埃及地一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗得举目，看见约旦河整个平原，直到琐珥，都有水灌溉；在耶和华毁灭所多玛和蛾摩拉之前，这地好象耶和华的园子，也像埃及地一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗得举目看见约旦河的全平原，直到琐珥，都是滋润的，那地在耶和华未灭所多玛、蛾摩拉以先如同耶和华的园子，也像埃及地。
verses.textEnNiv: Lot looked around and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan toward Zoar was well watered, like the garden of the Lord , like the land of Egypt. (This was before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
verses.textEnEsv: And Lot lifted up his eyes and saw that the Jordan Valley was well watered everywhere like the garden of the Lord , like the land of Egypt, in the direction of Zoar. (This was before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
verses.textEnNkjv: And Lot lifted his eyes and saw all the plain of Jordan, that it was well watered everywhere (before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah) like the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt as you go toward Zoar.
verses.textEnNlt: Lot took a long look at the fertile plains of the Jordan Valley in the direction of Zoar. The whole area was well watered everywhere, like the garden of the Lord or the beautiful land of Egypt. (This was before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)
verses.textEnNasb: Lot raised his eyes and saw all the vicinity of the Jordan, that it was well watered everywhere—this was before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah—like the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt going toward Zoar.
verses.textEn: Lot looked around and saw that the whole plain of the Jordan toward Zoar was well watered, like the garden of the Lord , like the land of Egypt. (This was before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.)

verses.textZh: 罗得选择了约旦河整个平原，于是向东移动，他们就彼此分开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗得选择了约旦河整个平原，于是向东移动，他们就彼此分开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是罗得选择约旦河的全平原，往东迁移；他们就彼此分离了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan and set out toward the east. The two men parted company:
verses.textEnEsv: So Lot chose for himself all the Jordan Valley, and Lot journeyed east. Thus they separated from each other.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Lot chose for himself all the plain of Jordan, and Lot journeyed east. And they separated from each other.
verses.textEnNlt: Lot chose for himself the whole Jordan Valley to the east of them. He went there with his flocks and servants and parted company with his uncle Abram.
verses.textEnNasb: So Lot chose for himself all the vicinity of the Jordan, and Lot journeyed eastward. So they separated from each other.
verses.textEn: So Lot chose for himself the whole plain of the Jordan and set out toward the east. The two men parted company:

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰住在迦南地；罗得住在平原的城市中，渐渐挪移帐棚，直到所多玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰住在迦南地；罗得住在平原的城市中，渐渐挪移帐棚，直到所多玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰住在迦南地，罗得住在平原的城邑，渐渐挪移帐棚，直到所多玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain and pitched his tents near Sodom.
verses.textEnEsv: Abram settled in the land of Canaan, while Lot settled among the cities of the valley and moved his tent as far as Sodom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, and Lot dwelt in the cities of the plain and pitched his tent even as far as Sodom.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abram settled in the land of Canaan, and Lot moved his tents to a place near Sodom and settled among the cities of the plain.
verses.textEnNasb: Abram settled in the land of Canaan, while Lot settled in the cities of the vicinity of the Jordan, and moved his tents as far as Sodom.
verses.textEn: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, while Lot lived among the cities of the plain and pitched his tents near Sodom.

verses.textZh: 在耶和华看来，所多玛人是罪大恶极的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在耶和华看来，所多玛人是罪大恶极的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所多玛人在耶和华面前罪大恶极。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the people of Sodom were wicked and were sinning greatly against the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: Now the men of Sodom were wicked, great sinners against the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinful against the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of this area were extremely wicked and constantly sinned against the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked sinners against the Lord.
verses.textEn: Now the people of Sodom were wicked and were sinning greatly against the Lord .

verses.textZh: 罗得离开亚伯兰以后，耶和华对亚伯兰说："你要举目，从你所在的地方向东南西北观看。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗得离开亚伯兰以后，耶和华对亚伯兰说："你要举目，从你所在的地方向东南西北观看。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗得离别亚伯兰以后，耶和华对亚伯兰说：「从你所在的地方，你举目向东西南北观看；
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to Abram after Lot had parted from him, "Look around from where you are, to the north and south, to the east and west.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him, "Lift up your eyes and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him: "Lift your eyes now and look from the place where you are— northward, southward, eastward, and westward;
verses.textEnNlt: After Lot had gone, the Lord said to Abram, "Look as far as you can see in every direction—north and south, east and west.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said to Abram, after Lot had separated from him, "Now raise your eyes and look from the place where you are, northward and southward, and eastward and westward;
verses.textEn: The Lord said to Abram after Lot had parted from him, "Look around from where you are, to the north and south, to the east and west.

verses.textZh: 你看见的地方，我都要赐给你和你的后裔，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你看见的地方，我都要赐给你和你的后裔，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡你所看见的一切地，我都要赐给你和你的后裔，直到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: All the land that you see I will give to you and your offspring forever.
verses.textEnEsv: for all the land that you see I will give to you and to your offspring forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: for all the land which you see I give to you and your descendants forever.
verses.textEnNlt: I am giving all this land, as far as you can see, to you and your descendants as a permanent possession.
verses.textEnNasb: for all the land which you see I will give to you and to your descendants forever.
verses.textEn: All the land that you see I will give to you and your offspring forever.

verses.textZh: 我要使你的后裔好象地上灰尘那么多；若能数算地上的灰尘，才能数算你的后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你的后裔好象地上灰尘那么多；若能数算地上的灰尘，才能数算你的后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也要使你的后裔如同地上的尘沙那样多，人若能数算地上的尘沙才能数算你的后裔。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust, then your offspring could be counted.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if one can count the dust of the earth, your offspring also can be counted.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will make your descendants as the dust of the earth; so that if a man could number the dust of the earth, then your descendants also could be numbered.
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give you so many descendants that, like the dust of the earth, they cannot be counted!
verses.textEnNasb: I will make your descendants as plentiful as the dust of the earth, so that if anyone can count the dust of the earth, then your descendants could also be counted.
verses.textEn: I will make your offspring like the dust of the earth, so that if anyone could count the dust, then your offspring could be counted.

verses.textZh: 你起来，纵横走遍这地，因为我必把这地赐给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你起来，纵横走遍这地，因为我必把这地赐给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你起来，纵横走遍这地，因为我必把这地赐给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you."
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, walk through the length and the breadth of the land, for I will give it to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, walk in the land through its length and its width, for I give it to you."
verses.textEnNlt: Go and walk through the land in every direction, for I am giving it to you."
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, walk about in the land through its length and width; for I will give it to you."
verses.textEn: Go, walk through the length and breadth of the land, for I am giving it to you."

verses.textZh: 于是，亚伯兰渐渐挪移帐棚，来到希伯仑幔利的橡树附近，在那里居住，也在那里为耶和华筑了一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，亚伯兰渐渐挪移帐棚，来到希伯仑幔利的橡树附近，在那里居住，也在那里为耶和华筑了一座祭坛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰就搬了帐棚，来到希伯仑、幔利的橡树那里居住，在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛。
verses.textEnNiv: So Abram went to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he pitched his tents. There he built an altar to the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So Abram moved his tent and came and settled by the oaks of Mamre, which are at Hebron, and there he built an altar to the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abram moved his tent, and went and dwelt by the terebinth trees of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abram moved his camp to Hebron and settled near the oak grove belonging to Mamre. There he built another altar to the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abram moved his tent and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron; and there he built an altar to the Lord.
verses.textEn: So Abram went to live near the great trees of Mamre at Hebron, where he pitched his tents. There he built an altar to the Lord .

verses.textZh: 当暗拉非作示拿王，亚略作以拉撒王，基大老玛作以拦王，提达作戈印王的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 当暗拉非作示拿王，亚略作以拉撒王，基大老玛作以拦王，提达作戈印王的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 当暗拉非作示拿王，亚略作以拉撒王，基大老玛作以拦王，提达作戈印王的时候，
verses.textEnNiv: At the time when Amraphel was king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Kedorlaomer king of Elam and Tidal king of Goyim,
verses.textEnEsv: In the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of nations,
verses.textEnNlt: About this time war broke out in the region. King Amraphel of Babylonia, King Arioch of Ellasar, King Kedorlaomer of Elam, and King Tidal of Goiim
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim,
verses.textEn: At the time when Amraphel was king of Shinar, Arioch king of Ellasar, Kedorlaomer king of Elam and Tidal king of Goyim,

verses.textZh: 他们兴兵攻打所多玛王比拉、蛾摩拉王比沙、押玛王示纳、洗扁王善以别和比拉王。比拉就是琐珥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们兴兵攻打所多玛王比拉、蛾摩拉王比沙、押玛王示纳、洗扁王善以别和比拉王。比拉就是琐珥。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们都攻打所多玛王比拉、蛾摩拉王比沙、押玛王示纳、洗扁王善以别，和比拉王；比拉就是琐珥。
verses.textEnNiv: these kings went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboyim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
verses.textEnEsv: these kings made war with Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
verses.textEnNkjv: that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
verses.textEnNlt: fought against King Bera of Sodom, King Birsha of Gomorrah, King Shinab of Admah, King Shemeber of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).
verses.textEnNasb: that they made war with Bera king of Sodom, and with Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, and Shemeber king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).
verses.textEn: these kings went to war against Bera king of Sodom, Birsha king of Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboyim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar).

verses.textZh: 这五王在西订谷会合。西订谷就是盐海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这五王在西订谷会合。西订谷就是盐海。
verses.textZhCuv: 这五王都在西订谷会合；西订谷就是盐海。
verses.textEnNiv: All these latter kings joined forces in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Dead Sea Valley).
verses.textEnEsv: And all these joined forces in the Valley of Siddim ( that is, the Salt Sea).
verses.textEnNkjv: All these joined together in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea).
verses.textEnNlt: This second group of kings joined forces in Siddim Valley (that is, the valley of the Dead Sea ).
verses.textEnNasb: All these kings came as allies to the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Salt Sea).
verses.textEn: All these latter kings joined forces in the Valley of Siddim (that is, the Dead Sea Valley).

verses.textZh: 他们服事了基大老玛已经有十二年，到第十三年就背叛了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们服事了基大老玛已经有十二年，到第十三年就背叛了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们已经事奉基大老玛十二年，到十三年就背叛了。
verses.textEnNiv: For twelve years they had been subject to Kedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.textEnEsv: Twelve years they had served Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.textEnNkjv: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.textEnNlt: For twelve years they had been subject to King Kedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled against him.
verses.textEnNasb: For twelve years they had served Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.
verses.textEn: For twelve years they had been subject to Kedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

verses.textZh: 第十四年基大老玛和同盟的王都来了，在亚特律．加宁击败了利乏音人，在哈麦击败了苏西人，在沙微．基列亭击败了以米人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 第十四年基大老玛和同盟的王都来了，在亚特律．加宁击败了利乏音人，在哈麦击败了苏西人，在沙微．基列亭击败了以米人，
verses.textZhCuv: 十四年，基大老玛和同盟的王都来在亚特律‧加宁，杀败了利乏音人，在哈麦杀败了苏西人，在沙微‧基列亭杀败了以米人，
verses.textEnNiv: In the fourteenth year, Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh Kiriathaim
verses.textEnEsv: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and defeated the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
verses.textEnNkjv: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings that were with him came and attacked the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,
verses.textEnNlt: One year later Kedorlaomer and his allies arrived and defeated the Rephaites at Ashteroth-karnaim, the Zuzites at Ham, the Emites at Shaveh-kiriathaim,
verses.textEnNasb: And in the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and defeated the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
verses.textEn: In the fourteenth year, Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him went out and defeated the Rephaites in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzites in Ham, the Emites in Shaveh Kiriathaim

verses.textZh: 在何利人的西珥山击败了何利人，一直追击到靠近旷野的伊勒．巴兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在何利人的西珥山击败了何利人，一直追击到靠近旷野的伊勒．巴兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 在何利人的西珥山杀败了何利人，一直杀到靠近旷野的伊勒‧巴兰。
verses.textEnNiv: and the Horites in the hill country of Seir, as far as El Paran near the desert.
verses.textEnEsv: and the Horites in their hill country of Seir as far as El-paran on the border of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the Horites in their mountain of Seir, as far as El Paran, which is by the wilderness.
verses.textEnNlt: and the Horites at Mount Seir, as far as El-paran at the edge of the wilderness.
verses.textEnNasb: and the Horites on their Mount Seir, as far as El-paran, which is by the wilderness.
verses.textEn: and the Horites in the hill country of Seir, as far as El Paran near the desert.

verses.textZh: 然后转到安．密巴，就是加低斯，攻占了亚玛力人全部的领土，也击败了住在哈洗逊．他玛的亚摩利人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后转到安．密巴，就是加低斯，攻占了亚玛力人全部的领土，也击败了住在哈洗逊．他玛的亚摩利人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回到安‧密巴，就是加低斯，杀败了亚玛力全地的人，以及住在哈洗逊‧他玛的亚摩利人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they turned back and went to En Mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who were living in Hazezon Tamar.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they turned back and came to En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh) and defeated all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites who were dwelling in Hazazon-tamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they turned back and came to En Mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and attacked all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites who dwelt in Hazezon Tamar.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they turned back and came to En-mishpat (now called Kadesh) and conquered all the territory of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites living in Hazazon-tamar.
