verses.textEnNasb: Then they turned back and came to En-mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and conquered all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, who lived in Hazazon-tamar.
verses.textEn: Then they turned back and went to En Mishpat (that is, Kadesh), and they conquered the whole territory of the Amalekites, as well as the Amorites who were living in Hazezon Tamar.

verses.textZh: 于是所多玛王、蛾摩拉王、押玛王、洗扁王和比拉王 都出来，在西订谷列阵，与他们交战；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是所多玛王、蛾摩拉王、押玛王、洗扁王和比拉王 都出来，在西订谷列阵，与他们交战；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是所多玛王、蛾摩拉王、押玛王、洗扁王，和比拉王（比拉就是琐珥）都出来，在西订谷摆阵，与他们交战，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboyim and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and drew up their battle lines in the Valley of Siddim
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) went out, and they joined battle in the Valley of Siddim
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) went out and joined together in battle in the Valley of Siddim
verses.textEnNlt: Then the rebel kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboiim, and Bela (also called Zoar) prepared for battle in the valley of the Dead Sea.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of Sodom and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) came out; and they lined up for battle against them in the Valley of Siddim,
verses.textEn: Then the king of Sodom, the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboyim and the king of Bela (that is, Zoar) marched out and drew up their battle lines in the Valley of Siddim

verses.textZh: 就是与以拦王基大老玛、戈印王提达、示拿王暗拉非、以拉撒王亚略交战，就是四王与五王交战。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是与以拦王基大老玛、戈印王提达、示拿王暗拉非、以拉撒王亚略交战，就是四王与五王交战。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是与以拦王基大老玛、戈印王提达、示拿王暗拉非、以拉撒王亚略交战；乃是四王与五王交战。
verses.textEnNiv: against Kedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goyim, Amraphel king of Shinar and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.
verses.textEnEsv: with Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar, four kings against five.
verses.textEnNkjv: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of nations, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.
verses.textEnNlt: They fought against King Kedorlaomer of Elam, King Tidal of Goiim, King Amraphel of Babylonia, and King Arioch of Ellasar—four kings against five.
verses.textEnNasb: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.
verses.textEn: against Kedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goyim, Amraphel king of Shinar and Arioch king of Ellasar—four kings against five.

verses.textZh: 西订谷有许多漆坑。所多玛王和蛾摩拉王逃跑的时候，都掉在坑里，其余的人都向着山上逃跑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西订谷有许多漆坑。所多玛王和蛾摩拉王逃跑的时候，都掉在坑里，其余的人都向着山上逃跑。
verses.textZhCuv: 西订谷有许多石漆坑。所多玛王和蛾摩拉王逃跑，有掉在坑里的，其余的人都往山上逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and when the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some of the men fell into them and the rest fled to the hills.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of bitumen pits, and as the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some fell into them, and the rest fled to the hill country.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Valley of Siddim wasfullof asphalt pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled; some fell there, and the remainder fled to the mountains.
verses.textEnNlt: As it happened, the valley of the Dead Sea was filled with tar pits. And as the army of the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some fell into the tar pits, while the rest escaped into the mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell into them. But those who survived fled to the hill country.
verses.textEn: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits, and when the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, some of the men fell into them and the rest fled to the hills.

verses.textZh: 四王就把所多玛和蛾摩拉所有的财物，以及一切粮食都拿走，
verses.textZhCnvs: 四王就把所多玛和蛾摩拉所有的财物，以及一切粮食都拿走，
verses.textZhCuv: 四王就把所多玛和蛾摩拉所有的财物，并一切的粮食都掳掠去了；
verses.textEnNiv: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food; then they went away.
verses.textEnEsv: So the enemy took all the possessions of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their provisions, and went their way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their provisions, and went their way.
verses.textEnNlt: The victorious invaders then plundered Sodom and Gomorrah and headed for home, taking with them all the spoils of war and the food supplies.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they took all the possessions of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food supply, and departed.
verses.textEn: The four kings seized all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah and all their food; then they went away.

verses.textZh: 连亚伯兰的侄儿罗得和罗得的财物也带走了。当时，罗得住在所多玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 连亚伯兰的侄儿罗得和罗得的财物也带走了。当时，罗得住在所多玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 又把亚伯兰的侄儿罗得和罗得的财物掳掠去了。当时罗得正住在所多玛。
verses.textEnNiv: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since he was living in Sodom.
verses.textEnEsv: They also took Lot, the son of Abram’s brother, who was dwelling in Sodom, and his possessions, and went their way.
verses.textEnNkjv: They also took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son who dwelt in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.
verses.textEnNlt: They also captured Lot—Abram’s nephew who lived in Sodom—and carried off everything he owned.
verses.textEnNasb: They also took Lot, Abram’s nephew, and his possessions and departed, for he was living in Sodom.
verses.textEn: They also carried off Abram’s nephew Lot and his possessions, since he was living in Sodom.

verses.textZh: 有一个逃出来的人，跑来告诉希伯来人亚伯兰。那时，亚伯兰住在亚摩利人幔利的橡树那里。幔利和以实各，以及亚乃，都是兄弟；他们都是亚伯兰的盟友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个逃出来的人，跑来告诉希伯来人亚伯兰。那时，亚伯兰住在亚摩利人幔利的橡树那里。幔利和以实各，以及亚乃，都是兄弟；他们都是亚伯兰的盟友。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个逃出来的人告诉希伯来人亚伯兰；亚伯兰正住在亚摩利人幔利的橡树那里。幔利和以实各并亚乃都是弟兄，曾与亚伯兰联盟。
verses.textEnNiv: A man who had escaped came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the great trees of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshkol and Aner, all of whom were allied with Abram.
verses.textEnEsv: Then one who had escaped came and told Abram the Hebrew, who was living by the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and of Aner. These were allies of Abram.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then one who had escaped came and told Abram the Hebrew, for he dwelt by the terebinth trees of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner; and they were allies with Abram.
verses.textEnNlt: But one of Lot’s men escaped and reported everything to Abram the Hebrew, who was living near the oak grove belonging to Mamre the Amorite. Mamre and his relatives, Eshcol and Aner, were Abram’s allies.
verses.textEnNasb: Then a survivor came and told Abram the Hebrew. Now he was residing by the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner, and they were allies with Abram.
verses.textEn: A man who had escaped came and reported this to Abram the Hebrew. Now Abram was living near the great trees of Mamre the Amorite, a brother of Eshkol and Aner, all of whom were allied with Abram.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰一听见侄儿被人掳去，就抽调他家里生养的精练壮丁三百一十八人，一直追到但。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰一听见侄儿被人掳去，就抽调他家里生养的精练壮丁三百一十八人，一直追到但。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰听见他侄儿 被掳去，就率领他家里生养的精练壮丁三百一十八人，直追到但，
verses.textEnNiv: When Abram heard that his relative had been taken captive, he called out the 318 trained men born in his household and went in pursuit as far as Dan.
verses.textEnEsv: When Abram heard that his kinsman had been taken captive, he led forth his trained men, born in his house, 318 of them, and went in pursuit as far as Dan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive, he armed his three hundred and eighteen trained servants who were born in his own house, and went in pursuit as far as Dan.
verses.textEnNlt: When Abram heard that his nephew Lot had been captured, he mobilized the 318 trained men who had been born into his household. Then he pursued Kedorlaomer’s army until he caught up with them at Dan.
verses.textEnNasb: When Abram heard that his relative had been taken captive, he led out his trained men, born in his house, numbering 318, and went in pursuit as far as Dan.
verses.textEn: When Abram heard that his relative had been taken captive, he called out the 318 trained men born in his household and went in pursuit as far as Dan.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰和他的仆人趁夜分队攻击他们，结果击败了他们，又追赶他们直到大马士革北面的何把，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰和他的仆人趁夜分队攻击他们，结果击败了他们，又追赶他们直到大马士革北面的何把，
verses.textZhCuv: 便在夜间，自己同仆人分队杀败敌人，又追到大马士革左边的何把，
verses.textEnNiv: During the night Abram divided his men to attack them and he routed them, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.
verses.textEnEsv: And he divided his forces against them by night, he and his servants, and defeated them and pursued them to Hobah, north of Damascus.
verses.textEnNkjv: He divided his forces against them by night, and he and his servants attacked them and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is north of Damascus.
verses.textEnNlt: There he divided his men and attacked during the night. Kedorlaomer’s army fled, but Abram chased them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he divided his forces against them by night, he and his servants, and defeated them, and pursued them as far as Hobah, which is north of Damascus.
verses.textEn: During the night Abram divided his men to attack them and he routed them, pursuing them as far as Hobah, north of Damascus.

verses.textZh: 将一切财物都夺回来，也把他的侄儿罗得和罗得的财物，以及妇女和族人，都夺了回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 将一切财物都夺回来，也把他的侄儿罗得和罗得的财物，以及妇女和族人，都夺了回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 将被掳掠的一切财物夺回来，连他侄儿罗得和他的财物，以及妇女、人民也都夺回来。
verses.textEnNiv: He recovered all the goods and brought back his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the other people.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he brought back all the possessions, and also brought back his kinsman Lot with his possessions, and the women and the people.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he brought back all the goods, and also brought back his brother Lot and his goods, as well as the women and the people.
verses.textEnNlt: Abram recovered all the goods that had been taken, and he brought back his nephew Lot with his possessions and all the women and other captives.
verses.textEnNasb: He brought back all the possessions, and also brought back his relative Lot with his possessions, and also the women, and the other people.
verses.textEn: He recovered all the goods and brought back his relative Lot and his possessions, together with the women and the other people.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰击败了基大老玛和与他联盟的王回来的时候，所多玛王出来，在沙微谷迎接他。沙微谷就是帝王谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰击败了基大老玛和与他联盟的王回来的时候，所多玛王出来，在沙微谷迎接他。沙微谷就是帝王谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰杀败基大老玛和与他同盟的王回来的时候，所多玛王出来，在沙微谷迎接他；沙微谷就是王谷。
verses.textEnNiv: After Abram returned from defeating Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom came out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
verses.textEnEsv: After his return from the defeat of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him at the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him at the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley), after his return from the defeat of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him.
verses.textEnNlt: After Abram returned from his victory over Kedorlaomer and all his allies, the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
verses.textEnNasb: Then after his return from the defeat of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, the king of Sodom went out to meet him at the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).
verses.textEn: After Abram returned from defeating Kedorlaomer and the kings allied with him, the king of Sodom came out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

verses.textZh: 撒冷王麦基洗德也带着饼和酒出来；他是至高神的祭司。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒冷王麦基洗德也带着饼和酒出来；他是至高神的祭司。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有撒冷王麦基洗德带着饼和酒出来迎接；他是至高神的祭司。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High,
verses.textEnEsv: And Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. (He was priest of God Most High.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine; he was the priest of God Most High.
verses.textEnNlt: And Melchizedek, the king of Salem and a priest of God Most High, brought Abram some bread and wine.
verses.textEnNasb: And Melchizedek the king of Salem brought out bread and wine; now he was a priest of God Most High.
verses.textEn: Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High,

verses.textZh: 他给亚伯兰祝福，说： "愿创造天地的主、至高的神， 赐福给亚伯兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他给亚伯兰祝福，说： "愿创造天地的主、至高的神， 赐福给亚伯兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 他为亚伯兰祝福，说：「愿天地的主、至高的神赐福与亚伯兰！
verses.textEnNiv: and he blessed Abram, saying, "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And he blessed him and said, "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth;
verses.textEnNkjv: And he blessed him and said: "Blessed be Abram of God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth;
verses.textEnNlt: Melchizedek blessed Abram with this blessing: "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.
verses.textEnNasb: And he blessed him and said, "Blessed be Abram of God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth;
verses.textEn: and he blessed Abram, saying, "Blessed be Abram by God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth.

verses.textZh: 把敌人交在你手里的至高的神，是应当称颂的！" 亚伯兰就把所得的一切，拿出十分之一来，给了麦基洗德。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把敌人交在你手里的至高的神，是应当称颂的！" 亚伯兰就把所得的一切，拿出十分之一来，给了麦基洗德。
verses.textZhCuv: 至高的神把敌人交在你手里，是应当称颂的！」亚伯兰就把所得的拿出十分之一来，给麦基洗德。
verses.textEnNiv: And praise be to God Most High, who delivered your enemies into your hand." Then Abram gave him a tenth of everything.
verses.textEnEsv: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand!" And Abram gave him a tenth of everything.
verses.textEnNkjv: And blessed be God Most High, Who has delivered your enemies into your hand." And he gave him a tithe of all.
verses.textEnNlt: And blessed be God Most High, who has defeated your enemies for you." Then Abram gave Melchizedek a tenth of all the goods he had recovered.
verses.textEnNasb: And blessed be God Most High, Who has handed over your enemies to you." And he gave him a tenth of everything.
verses.textEn: And praise be to God Most High, who delivered your enemies into your hand." Then Abram gave him a tenth of everything.

verses.textZh: 所多玛王对亚伯兰说："请你把人交给我，至于财物，你拿去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 所多玛王对亚伯兰说："请你把人交给我，至于财物，你拿去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所多玛王对亚伯兰说：「你把人口给我，财物你自己拿去吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: The king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the people and keep the goods for yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the persons, but take the goods for yourself."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the persons, and take the goods for yourself."
verses.textEnNlt: The king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give back my people who were captured. But you may keep for yourself all the goods you have recovered."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give the people to me and take the possessions for yourself."
verses.textEn: The king of Sodom said to Abram, "Give me the people and keep the goods for yourself."

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰对所多玛王说："我已经向创造天地的主、至高的神耶和华举手起誓；
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰对所多玛王说："我已经向创造天地的主、至高的神耶和华举手起誓；
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰对所多玛王说：「我已经向天地的主－至高的神耶和华起誓：
verses.textEnNiv: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "With raised hand I have sworn an oath to the Lord , God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
verses.textEnEsv: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I have lifted my hand to the Lord , God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I have raised my hand to the Lord, God Most High, the Possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.textEnNlt: Abram replied to the king of Sodom, "I solemnly swear to the Lord , God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,
verses.textEnNasb: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "I have sworn to the Lord God Most High, Possessor of heaven and earth,
verses.textEn: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, "With raised hand I have sworn an oath to the Lord , God Most High, Creator of heaven and earth,

verses.textZh: 凡是你的东西，就是一根线，一条鞋带，我也不拿，免得你说：‘我使亚伯兰发了财。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡是你的东西，就是一根线，一条鞋带，我也不拿，免得你说：‘我使亚伯兰发了财。’
verses.textZhCuv: 凡是你的东西，就是一根线、一根鞋带，我都不拿，免得你说：『我使亚伯兰富足！』
verses.textEnNiv: that I will accept nothing belonging to you, not even a thread or the strap of a sandal, so that you will never be able to say, ‘I made Abram rich.’
verses.textEnEsv: that I would not take a thread or a sandal strap or anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
verses.textEnNkjv: that I willtake nothing, from a thread to a sandal strap, and that I will not take anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich’—
verses.textEnNlt: that I will not take so much as a single thread or sandal thong from what belongs to you. Otherwise you might say, ‘I am the one who made Abram rich.’
verses.textEnNasb: that I will not take a thread or a sandal strap or anything that is yours, so that you do not say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’
verses.textEn: that I will accept nothing belonging to you, not even a thread or the strap of a sandal, so that you will never be able to say, ‘I made Abram rich.’

verses.textZh: 我甚么都不要，除了仆人吃掉的以外，但与我同行的亚乃、以实各、幔利所应得的分，让他们拿去吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我甚么都不要，除了仆人吃掉的以外，但与我同行的亚乃、以实各、幔利所应得的分，让他们拿去吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 只有仆人所吃的，并与我同行的亚乃、以实各、幔利所应得的分，可以任凭他们拿去。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share that belongs to the men who went with me—to Aner, Eshkol and Mamre. Let them have their share."
verses.textEnEsv: I will take nothing but what the young men have eaten, and the share of the men who went with me. Let Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre take their share."
verses.textEnNkjv: except only what the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their portion."
verses.textEnNlt: I will accept only what my young warriors have already eaten, and I request that you give a fair share of the goods to my allies—Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre."
verses.textEnNasb: I will take nothing except what the young men have eaten, and the share of the men who went with me, Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre; let them take their share."
verses.textEn: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share that belongs to the men who went with me—to Aner, Eshkol and Mamre. Let them have their share."

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，耶和华的话在异象中临到亚伯兰说： "亚伯兰，你不要惧怕， 我是你的盾牌； 你的赏赐是很大的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，耶和华的话在异象中临到亚伯兰说： "亚伯兰，你不要惧怕， 我是你的盾牌； 你的赏赐是很大的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，耶和华在异象中有话对亚伯兰说：「亚伯兰，你不要惧怕！我是你的盾牌，必大大地赏赐你。」
verses.textEnNiv: After this, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision: "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward. "
verses.textEnEsv: After these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision: "Fear not, Abram, I am your shield; your reward shall be very great."
verses.textEnNkjv: After these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward."
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later, the Lord spoke to Abram in a vision and said to him, "Do not be afraid, Abram, for I will protect you, and your reward will be great."
verses.textEnNasb: After these things the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, "Do not fear, Abram, I am a shield to you; Your reward shall be very great."
verses.textEn: After this, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision: "Do not be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your very great reward. "

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰说："主耶和华啊，我一向都没有孩子，你还能赐给我甚么呢？这样，承受我家业的，就是大马士革人以利以谢了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰说："主耶和华啊，我一向都没有孩子，你还能赐给我甚么呢？这样，承受我家业的，就是大马士革人以利以谢了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰说：「主耶和华啊，我既无子，你还赐我什么呢？并且要承受我家业的是大马士革人以利以谢。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Abram said, "Sovereign Lord , what can you give me since I remain childless and the one who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?"
verses.textEnEsv: But Abram said, "O Lord God , what will you give me, for I continue childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Abram said, "Lord God, what will You give me, seeing I go childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Abram replied, "O Sovereign Lord , what good are all your blessings when I don’t even have a son? Since you’ve given me no children, Eliezer of Damascus, a servant in my household, will inherit all my wealth.
verses.textEnNasb: But Abram said, "Lord God, what will You give me, since I am childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?"
verses.textEn: But Abram said, "Sovereign Lord , what can you give me since I remain childless and the one who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?"

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰又说："你既然没有给我后裔，那生在我家中的人，就是我的继承人了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰又说："你既然没有给我后裔，那生在我家中的人，就是我的继承人了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰又说：「你没有给我儿子；那生在我家中的人就是我的后嗣。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Abram said, "You have given me no children; so a servant in my household will be my heir."
verses.textEnEsv: And Abram said, "Behold, you have given me no offspring, and a member of my household will be my heir."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abram said, "Look, You have given me no offspring; indeed one born in my house is my heir!"
verses.textEnNlt: You have given me no descendants of my own, so one of my servants will be my heir."
verses.textEnNasb: Abram also said, " Since You have given me no son, one who has been born in my house is my heir."
verses.textEn: And Abram said, "You have given me no children; so a servant in my household will be my heir."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话又临到亚伯兰说："这人必不会作你的继承人；你亲生的才会是你的继承人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话又临到亚伯兰说："这人必不会作你的继承人；你亲生的才会是你的继承人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又有话对他说：「这人必不成为你的后嗣；你本身所生的才成为你的后嗣。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to him: "This man will not be your heir, but a son who is your own flesh and blood will be your heir."
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, the word of the Lord came to him: "This man shall not be your heir; your very own son shall be your heir."
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, the word of the Lordcame to him, saying, "This one shall not be your heir, but one who will come from your own body shall be your heir."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to him, "No, your servant will not be your heir, for you will have a son of your own who will be your heir."
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, the word of the Lord came to him, saying, "This man will not be your heir; but one who will come from your own body shall be your heir."
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to him: "This man will not be your heir, but a son who is your own flesh and blood will be your heir."

verses.textZh: 于是领他到外面去，说："你向天观看，数点众星，看你能不能把它们数得清楚。"又对他说："你的后裔将要这样众多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是领他到外面去，说："你向天观看，数点众星，看你能不能把它们数得清楚。"又对他说："你的后裔将要这样众多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是领他走到外边，说：「你向天观看，数算众星，能数得过来吗？」又对他说：「你的后裔将要如此。」
verses.textEnNiv: He took him outside and said, "Look up at the sky and count the stars—if indeed you can count them." Then he said to him, "So shall your offspring be."
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought him outside and said, "Look toward heaven, and number the stars, if you are able to number them." Then he said to him, "So shall your offspring be."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He brought him outside and said, "Look now toward heaven, and count the stars if you are able to number them." And He said to him, "So shall your descendants be."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord took Abram outside and said to him, "Look up into the sky and count the stars if you can. That’s how many descendants you will have!"
verses.textEnNasb: And He took him outside and said, "Now look toward the heavens and count the stars, if you are able to count them." And He said to him, "So shall your descendants be."
verses.textEn: He took him outside and said, "Look up at the sky and count the stars—if indeed you can count them." Then he said to him, "So shall your offspring be."

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰信耶和华，耶和华就以此算为他的义了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰信耶和华，耶和华就以此算为他的义了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰信耶和华，耶和华就以此为他的义。
verses.textEnNiv: Abram believed the Lord , and he credited it to him as righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: And he believed the Lord , and he counted it to him as righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he believed in the Lord, and He accounted it to him for righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: And Abram believed the Lord , and the Lord counted him as righteous because of his faith.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he believed in the Lord; and He credited it to him as righteousness.
verses.textEn: Abram believed the Lord , and he credited it to him as righteousness.

verses.textZh: 耶和华又对亚伯兰说："我是耶和华，曾经把你从迦勒底的吾珥领出来，为要把这地赐给你作产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华又对亚伯兰说："我是耶和华，曾经把你从迦勒底的吾珥领出来，为要把这地赐给你作产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华又对他说：「我是耶和华，曾领你出了迦勒底的吾珥，为要将这地赐你为业。」
verses.textEnNiv: He also said to him, "I am the Lord , who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to take possession of it."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "I am the Lord who brought you out from Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to possess."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to him, "I am the Lord, who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans, to give you this land to inherit it."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord told him, "I am the Lord who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land as your possession."
verses.textEnNasb: And He said to him, "I am the Lord who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans, to give you this land to possess it."
verses.textEn: He also said to him, "I am the Lord , who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldeans to give you this land to take possession of it."

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰说："主耶和华啊，我凭甚么能知道我必得这地为业呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰说："主耶和华啊，我凭甚么能知道我必得这地为业呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰说：「主耶和华啊，我怎能知道必得这地为业呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But Abram said, "Sovereign Lord , how can I know that I will gain possession of it?"
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "O Lord God , how am I to know that I shall possess it?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Lord God, how shall I know that I will inherit it?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Abram replied, "O Sovereign Lord , how can I be sure that I will actually possess it?"
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "Lord God, how may I know that I will possess it?"
verses.textEn: But Abram said, "Sovereign Lord , how can I know that I will gain possession of it?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对他说："你给我拿一头三岁的母牛犊，一只三岁的母山羊，一只三岁的公绵羊，一只斑鸠和一只雏鸽。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对他说："你给我拿一头三岁的母牛犊，一只三岁的母山羊，一只三岁的公绵羊，一只斑鸠和一只雏鸽。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「你为我取一只三年的母牛，一只三年的母山羊，一只三年的公绵羊，一只斑鸠，一只雏鸽。」
verses.textEnNiv: So the Lord said to him, "Bring me a heifer, a goat and a ram, each three years old, along with a dove and a young pigeon."
verses.textEnEsv: He said to him, "Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said to him, "Bring Me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord told him, "Bring me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."
verses.textEnNasb: So He said to him, " Bring Me a three-year-old heifer, a three-year-old female goat, a three-year-old ram, a turtledove, and a young pigeon."
verses.textEn: So the Lord said to him, "Bring me a heifer, a goat and a ram, each three years old, along with a dove and a young pigeon."

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰就把这一切拿了来，每样都从当中劈开，一半一半相对摆列；只是鸟却没有劈开。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰就把这一切拿了来，每样都从当中劈开，一半一半相对摆列；只是鸟却没有劈开。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰就取了这些来，每样劈开，分成两半，一半对着一半地摆列，只有鸟没有劈开。
verses.textEnNiv: Abram brought all these to him, cut them in two and arranged the halves opposite each other; the birds, however, he did not cut in half.
verses.textEnEsv: And he brought him all these, cut them in half, and laid each half over against the other. But he did not cut the birds in half.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he brought all these to Him and cut them in two, down the middle, and placed each piece opposite the other; but he did not cut the birds in two.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abram presented all these to him and killed them. Then he cut each animal down the middle and laid the halves side by side; he did not, however, cut the birds in half.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he brought all these to Him and cut them in two, and laid each half opposite the other; but he did not cut the birds.
verses.textEn: Abram brought all these to him, cut them in two and arranged the halves opposite each other; the birds, however, he did not cut in half.

verses.textZh: 有鸷鸟下来，落在这些尸骸上，亚伯兰就把牠们吓走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有鸷鸟下来，落在这些尸骸上，亚伯兰就把牠们吓走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有鸷鸟下来，落在那死畜的肉上，亚伯兰就把它吓飞了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then birds of prey came down on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.
verses.textEnEsv: And when birds of prey came down on the carcasses, Abram drove them away.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the vultures came down on the carcasses, Abram drove them away.
verses.textEnNlt: Some vultures swooped down to eat the carcasses, but Abram chased them away.
verses.textEnNasb: And birds of prey came down upon the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
verses.textEn: Then birds of prey came down on the carcasses, but Abram drove them away.

verses.textZh: 日落的时候，亚伯兰沉沉地睡着了，忽然有可怕的大黑暗落在他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日落的时候，亚伯兰沉沉地睡着了，忽然有可怕的大黑暗落在他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 日头正落的时候，亚伯兰沉沉地睡了；忽然有惊人的大黑暗落在他身上。
verses.textEnNiv: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a thick and dreadful darkness came over him.
verses.textEnEsv: As the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. And behold, dreadful and great darkness fell upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and behold, horror and great darkness fell upon him.
verses.textEnNlt: As the sun was going down, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a terrifying darkness came down over him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell upon Abram; and behold, terror and great darkness fell upon him.
verses.textEn: As the sun was setting, Abram fell into a deep sleep, and a thick and dreadful darkness came over him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华对亚伯兰说："你要确实地知道，你的后裔必在外地寄居，也必服事那地的人，那地的人苦待他们四百年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对亚伯兰说："你要确实地知道，你的后裔必在外地寄居，也必服事那地的人，那地的人苦待他们四百年。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对亚伯兰说：「你要的确知道，你的后裔必寄居别人的地，又服事那地的人；那地的人要苦待他们四百年。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to him, "Know for certain that for four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own and that they will be enslaved and mistreated there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Abram, "Know for certain that your offspring will be sojourners in a land that is not theirs and will be servants there, and they will be afflicted for four hundred years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said to Abram: "Know certainly that your descendants will be strangers in a land thatis not theirs, and will serve them, and they will afflict them four hundred years.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Abram, "You can be sure that your descendants will be strangers in a foreign land, where they will be oppressed as slaves for 400 years.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said to Abram, "Know for certain that your descendants will be strangers in a land that is not theirs, where they will be enslaved and oppressed for four hundred years.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to him, "Know for certain that for four hundred years your descendants will be strangers in a country not their own and that they will be enslaved and mistreated there.

verses.textZh: 他们所要服事的那国，我要亲自惩罚。后来他们必带着很多财物，从那里出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们所要服事的那国，我要亲自惩罚。后来他们必带着很多财物，从那里出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且他们所要服事的那国，我要惩罚，后来他们必带着许多财物从那里出来。
verses.textEnNiv: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will come out with great possessions.
verses.textEnEsv: But I will bring judgment on the nation that they serve, and afterward they shall come out with great possessions.
verses.textEnNkjv: And also the nation whom they serve I will judge; afterward they shall come out with great possessions.
verses.textEnNlt: But I will punish the nation that enslaves them, and in the end they will come away with great wealth.
verses.textEnNasb: But I will also judge the nation whom they will serve, and afterward they will come out with many possessions.
verses.textEn: But I will punish the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will come out with great possessions.

verses.textZh: 你必得享长寿，被人埋葬，平平安安地回到你列祖那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必得享长寿，被人埋葬，平平安安地回到你列祖那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你要享大寿数，平平安安地归到你列祖那里，被人埋葬。
verses.textEnNiv: You, however, will go to your ancestors in peace and be buried at a good old age.
verses.textEnEsv: As for you, you shall go to your fathers in peace; you shall be buried in a good old age.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now as for you, you shall go to your fathers in peace; you shall be buried at a good old age.
verses.textEnNlt: (As for you, you will die in peace and be buried at a ripe old age.)
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, you shall go to your fathers in peace; you will be buried at a good old age.
verses.textEn: You, however, will go to your ancestors in peace and be buried at a good old age.

verses.textZh: 到了第四代，他们必回到这里，因为亚摩利人的罪孽还没有满盈。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第四代，他们必回到这里，因为亚摩利人的罪孽还没有满盈。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了第四代，他们必回到此地，因为亚摩利人的罪孽还没有满盈。」
verses.textEnNiv: In the fourth generation your descendants will come back here, for the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure."
verses.textEnEsv: And they shall come back here in the fourth generation, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete."
verses.textEnNkjv: But in the fourth generation they shall return here, for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet complete."
verses.textEnNlt: After four generations your descendants will return here to this land, for the sins of the Amorites do not yet warrant their destruction."
verses.textEnNasb: Then in the fourth generation they will return here, for the wrongdoing of the Amorite is not yet complete."
verses.textEn: In the fourth generation your descendants will come back here, for the sin of the Amorites has not yet reached its full measure."

verses.textZh: 日落天黑的时候，忽然有冒烟的炉和烧着的火把，从那些肉块中经过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 日落天黑的时候，忽然有冒烟的炉和烧着的火把，从那些肉块中经过。
verses.textZhCuv: 日落天黑，不料有冒烟的炉并烧着的火把从那些肉块中经过。
verses.textEnNiv: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, a smoking firepot with a blazing torch appeared and passed between the pieces.
verses.textEnEsv: When the sun had gone down and it was dark, behold, a smoking fire pot and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when the sun went down and it was dark, that behold, there appeared a smoking oven and a burning torch that passed between those pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: After the sun went down and darkness fell, Abram saw a smoking firepot and a flaming torch pass between the halves of the carcasses.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when the sun had set, that it was very dark, and behold, a smoking oven and a flaming torch appeared which passed between these pieces.
verses.textEn: When the sun had set and darkness had fallen, a smoking firepot with a blazing torch appeared and passed between the pieces.

verses.textZh: 就在那时候，耶和华与亚伯兰立约说： "我已经把这地赐给你的后裔了， 就是从埃及河直到幼发拉底河之地；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那时候，耶和华与亚伯兰立约说： "我已经把这地赐给你的后裔了， 就是从埃及河直到幼发拉底河之地；
verses.textZhCuv: 当那日，耶和华与亚伯兰立约，说：「我已赐给你的后裔，从埃及河直到幼发拉底大河之地，
verses.textEnNiv: On that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram and said, "To your descendants I give this land, from the Wadi of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates—
verses.textEnEsv: On that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, "To your offspring I give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates,
verses.textEnNkjv: On the same day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying: "To your descendants I have given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the River Euphrates—
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord made a covenant with Abram that day and said, "I have given this land to your descendants, all the way from the border of Egypt to the great Euphrates River—
verses.textEnNasb: On that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram, saying, "To your descendants I have given this land, From the river of Egypt as far as the great river, the river Euphrates:
verses.textEn: On that day the Lord made a covenant with Abram and said, "To your descendants I give this land, from the Wadi of Egypt to the great river, the Euphrates—

verses.textZh: 就是基尼人、基尼洗人、甲摩尼人、
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是基尼人、基尼洗人、甲摩尼人、
verses.textZhCuv: 就是基尼人、基尼洗人、甲摩尼人、
verses.textEnNiv: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,
verses.textEnEsv: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,
verses.textEnNkjv: the Kenites, the Kenezzites, the Kadmonites,
verses.textEnNlt: the land now occupied by the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,
verses.textEnNasb: the land of the Kenite, the Kenizzite, the Kadmonite,
verses.textEn: the land of the Kenites, Kenizzites, Kadmonites,

verses.textZh: 赫人、比利洗人、利乏音人、
verses.textZhCnvs: 赫人、比利洗人、利乏音人、
verses.textZhCuv: 赫人、比利洗人、利乏音人、
verses.textEnNiv: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,
verses.textEnEsv: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
verses.textEnNkjv: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,
verses.textEnNlt: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,
verses.textEnNasb: the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Rephaim,
verses.textEn: Hittites, Perizzites, Rephaites,

verses.textZh: 亚摩利人、迦南人、革迦撒人、耶布斯人之地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚摩利人、迦南人、革迦撒人、耶布斯人之地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚摩利人、迦南人、革迦撒人、耶布斯人之地。」
verses.textEnNiv: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites and Jebusites."
verses.textEnEsv: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites and the Jebusites."
verses.textEnNkjv: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites."
verses.textEnNlt: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites, and Jebusites."
verses.textEnNasb: the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Girgashite, and the Jebusite."
verses.textEn: Amorites, Canaanites, Girgashites and Jebusites."

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰的妻子撒莱，没有为他生孩子。撒莱却有一个婢女，是埃及人，名叫夏甲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰的妻子撒莱，没有为他生孩子。撒莱却有一个婢女，是埃及人，名叫夏甲。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰的妻子撒莱不给他生儿女。撒莱有一个使女，名叫夏甲，是埃及人。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children. But she had an Egyptian slave named Hagar;
verses.textEnEsv: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children. She had a female Egyptian servant whose name was Hagar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children. And she had an Egyptian maidservant whose name was Hagar.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had not been able to bear children for him. But she had an Egyptian servant named Hagar.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had not borne him a child, but she had an Egyptian slave woman whose name was Hagar.
verses.textEn: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, had borne him no children. But she had an Egyptian slave named Hagar;

verses.textZh: 撒莱对亚伯兰说："请看，耶和华使我不能生育，求你去亲近我的婢女，或者我可以从她得孩子。"亚伯兰就听从了撒莱的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒莱对亚伯兰说："请看，耶和华使我不能生育，求你去亲近我的婢女，或者我可以从她得孩子。"亚伯兰就听从了撒莱的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒莱对亚伯兰说：「耶和华使我不能生育。求你和我的使女同房，或者我可以因她得孩子 。」亚伯兰听从了撒莱的话。
verses.textEnNiv: so she said to Abram, "The Lord has kept me from having children. Go, sleep with my slave; perhaps I can build a family through her." Abram agreed to what Sarai said.
verses.textEnEsv: And Sarai said to Abram, "Behold now, the Lord has prevented me from bearing children. Go in to my servant; it may be that I shall obtain children by her." And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Sarai said to Abram, "See now, the Lord has restrained me from bearing children. Please, go in to my maid; perhaps I shall obtain children by her." And Abram heeded the voice of Sarai.
verses.textEnNlt: So Sarai said to Abram, "The Lord has prevented me from having children. Go and sleep with my servant. Perhaps I can have children through her." And Abram agreed with Sarai’s proposal.
verses.textEnNasb: So Sarai said to Abram, "See now, the Lord has prevented me from bearing children. Please have relations with my slave woman; perhaps I will obtain children through her." And Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.
verses.textEn: so she said to Abram, "The Lord has kept me from having children. Go, sleep with my slave; perhaps I can build a family through her." Abram agreed to what Sarai said.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰在迦南地住满了十年，他的妻子撒莱，把自己的婢女埃及人夏甲，给了她的丈夫亚伯兰为妾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰在迦南地住满了十年，他的妻子撒莱，把自己的婢女埃及人夏甲，给了她的丈夫亚伯兰为妾。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚伯兰的妻子撒莱将使女埃及人夏甲给了丈夫为妾；那时亚伯兰在迦南已经住了十年。
verses.textEnNiv: So after Abram had been living in Canaan ten years, Sarai his wife took her Egyptian slave Hagar and gave her to her husband to be his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: So, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, and gave her to Abram her husband as a wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to her husband Abram to be his wife, after Abram had dwelt ten years in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: So Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian servant and gave her to Abram as a wife. (This happened ten years after Abram had settled in the land of Canaan.)
verses.textEnNasb: And so after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, Abram’s wife Sarai took Hagar the Egyptian, her slave woman, and gave her to her husband Abram as his wife.
verses.textEn: So after Abram had been living in Canaan ten years, Sarai his wife took her Egyptian slave Hagar and gave her to her husband to be his wife.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰与夏甲亲近，夏甲就怀了孕。夏甲见自己有了孕，就轻看她的主母。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰与夏甲亲近，夏甲就怀了孕。夏甲见自己有了孕，就轻看她的主母。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰与夏甲同房，夏甲就怀了孕；她见自己有孕，就小看她的主母。
verses.textEnNiv: He slept with Hagar, and she conceived. When she knew she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.
verses.textEnEsv: And he went in to Hagar, and she conceived. And when she saw that she had conceived, she looked with contempt on her mistress.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he went in to Hagar, and she conceived. And when she saw that she had conceived, her mistress became despised in her eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abram had sexual relations with Hagar, and she became pregnant. But when Hagar knew she was pregnant, she began to treat her mistress, Sarai, with contempt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he had relations with Hagar, and she conceived; and when Hagar became aware that she had conceived, her mistress was insignificant in her sight.
verses.textEn: He slept with Hagar, and she conceived. When she knew she was pregnant, she began to despise her mistress.

verses.textZh: 撒莱对亚伯兰说："我因你受屈；我把我的婢女送到你的怀中，她见自己有了孕，就轻看我。愿耶和华在你我之间主持公道。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒莱对亚伯兰说："我因你受屈；我把我的婢女送到你的怀中，她见自己有了孕，就轻看我。愿耶和华在你我之间主持公道。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒莱对亚伯兰说：「我因你受屈。我将我的使女放在你怀中，她见自己有了孕，就小看我。愿耶和华在你我中间判断。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Sarai said to Abram, "You are responsible for the wrong I am suffering. I put my slave in your arms, and now that she knows she is pregnant, she despises me. May the Lord judge between you and me."
verses.textEnEsv: And Sarai said to Abram, "May the wrong done to me be on you! I gave my servant to your embrace, and when she saw that she had conceived, she looked on me with contempt. May the Lord judge between you and me!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Sarai said to Abram, "My wrong be upon you! I gave my maid into your embrace; and when she saw that she had conceived, I became despised in her eyes. The Lord judge between you and me."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Sarai said to Abram, "This is all your fault! I put my servant into your arms, but now that she’s pregnant she treats me with contempt. The Lord will show who’s wrong—you or me!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Sarai said to Abram, "May the wrong done to me be upon you! I put my slave woman into your arms, but when she saw that she had conceived, I was insignificant in her sight. May the Lord judge between you and me."
verses.textEn: Then Sarai said to Abram, "You are responsible for the wrong I am suffering. I put my slave in your arms, and now that she knows she is pregnant, she despises me. May the Lord judge between you and me."

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰对撒莱说："你的婢女在你手中，你看怎样好，就怎样待她吧。"于是撒莱虐待夏甲，她就从撒莱面前逃走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰对撒莱说："你的婢女在你手中，你看怎样好，就怎样待她吧。"于是撒莱虐待夏甲，她就从撒莱面前逃走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰对撒莱说：「使女在你手下，你可以随意待她。」撒莱苦待她，她就从撒莱面前逃走了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Your slave is in your hands," Abram said. "Do with her whatever you think best." Then Sarai mistreated Hagar; so she fled from her.
verses.textEnEsv: But Abram said to Sarai, "Behold, your servant is in your power; do to her as you please." Then Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abram said to Sarai, "Indeed your maid is in your hand; do to her as you please." And when Sarai dealt harshly with her, she fled from her presence.
verses.textEnNlt: Abram replied, "Look, she is your servant, so deal with her as you see fit." Then Sarai treated Hagar so harshly that she finally ran away.
verses.textEnNasb: But Abram said to Sarai, "Look, your slave woman is in your power; do to her what is good in your sight." So Sarai treated her harshly, and she fled from her presence.
verses.textEn: "Your slave is in your hands," Abram said. "Do with her whatever you think best." Then Sarai mistreated Hagar; so she fled from her.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者在旷野的水泉旁边，就是在到书珥路上的水旁边，遇到了她，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者在旷野的水泉旁边，就是在到书珥路上的水旁边，遇到了她，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者在旷野书珥路上的水泉旁遇见她，
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord found Hagar near a spring in the desert; it was the spring that is beside the road to Shur.
verses.textEnEsv: The angel of the Lord found her by a spring of water in the wilderness, the spring on the way to Shur.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Angel of the Lord found her by a spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the way to Shur.
verses.textEnNlt: The angel of the Lord found Hagar beside a spring of water in the wilderness, along the road to Shur.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the angel of the Lord found her by a spring of water in the wilderness, by the spring on the way to Shur.
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord found Hagar near a spring in the desert; it was the spring that is beside the road to Shur.

verses.textZh: 就问她："撒莱的婢女夏甲啊，你从哪里来？要到哪里去？"夏甲回答："我从我的主母撒莱面前逃出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就问她："撒莱的婢女夏甲啊，你从哪里来？要到哪里去？"夏甲回答："我从我的主母撒莱面前逃出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 对她说：「撒莱的使女夏甲，你从哪里来？要往哪里去？」夏甲说：「我从我的主母撒莱面前逃出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: And he said, "Hagar, slave of Sarai, where have you come from, and where are you going?" "I’m running away from my mistress Sarai," she answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Hagar, servant of Sarai, where have you come from and where are you going?" She said, "I am fleeing from my mistress Sarai."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Hagar, Sarai’s maid, where have you come from, and where are you going?" She said, "I am fleeing from the presence of my mistress Sarai."
verses.textEnNlt: The angel said to her, "Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where have you come from, and where are you going?" "I’m running away from my mistress, Sarai," she replied.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "Hagar, Sarai’s slave woman, from where have you come, and where are you going?" And she said, "I am fleeing from the presence of my mistress Sarai."
verses.textEn: And he said, "Hagar, slave of Sarai, where have you come from, and where are you going?" "I’m running away from my mistress Sarai," she answered.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者对她说："回到你主母那里去，服在她的手下！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者对她说："回到你主母那里去，服在她的手下！"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者对她说：「你回到你主母那里，服在她手下」；
verses.textEnNiv: Then the angel of the Lord told her, "Go back to your mistress and submit to her."
verses.textEnEsv: The angel of the Lord said to her, "Return to your mistress and submit to her."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Angel of the Lord said to her, "Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hand."
verses.textEnNlt: The angel of the Lord said to her, "Return to your mistress, and submit to her authority."
verses.textEnNasb: So the angel of the Lord said to her, "Return to your mistress, and submit to her authority."
verses.textEn: Then the angel of the Lord told her, "Go back to your mistress and submit to her."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者又对她说："我必使你的后裔人丁兴旺，多到不可胜数。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者又对她说："我必使你的后裔人丁兴旺，多到不可胜数。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「我必使你的后裔极其繁多，甚至不可胜数」；
verses.textEnNiv: The angel added, "I will increase your descendants so much that they will be too numerous to count."
verses.textEnEsv: The angel of the Lord also said to her, "I will surely multiply your offspring so that they cannot be numbered for multitude."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Angel of the Lord said to her, "I will multiply your descendants exceedingly, so that they shall not be counted for multitude."
verses.textEnNlt: Then he added, "I will give you more descendants than you can count."
verses.textEnNasb: The angel of the Lord also said to her, "I will greatly multiply your descendants so that they will be too many to count."
verses.textEn: The angel added, "I will increase your descendants so much that they will be too numerous to count."

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者再对她说： "看哪，你已经怀了孕， 你要生一个儿子； 你要给他起名叫以实玛利， 因为耶和华听见了你的苦情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者再对她说： "看哪，你已经怀了孕， 你要生一个儿子； 你要给他起名叫以实玛利， 因为耶和华听见了你的苦情。
verses.textZhCuv: 并说：「你如今怀孕要生一个儿子，可以给他起名叫以实玛利 ，因为耶和华听见了你的苦情。
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of the Lord also said to her: "You are now pregnant and you will give birth to a son. You shall name him Ishmael, for the Lord has heard of your misery.
verses.textEnEsv: And the angel of the Lord said to her, "Behold, you are pregnant and shall bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because the Lord has listened to your affliction.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Angel of the Lord said to her: "Behold, you are with child, And you shall bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, Because the Lord has heard your affliction.
verses.textEnNlt: And the angel also said, "You are now pregnant and will give birth to a son. You are to name him Ishmael (which means ‘God hears’), for the Lord has heard your cry of distress.
verses.textEnNasb: The angel of the Lord said to her further, "Behold, you are pregnant, And you will give birth to a son; And you shall name him Ishmael, Because the Lord has heard your affliction.
verses.textEn: The angel of the Lord also said to her: "You are now pregnant and you will give birth to a son. You shall name him Ishmael, for the Lord has heard of your misery.

verses.textZh: 他将来为人， 必像野驴。 他的手要攻打人， 人的手也要攻打他。 他必住在众兄弟的东面。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他将来为人， 必像野驴。 他的手要攻打人， 人的手也要攻打他。 他必住在众兄弟的东面。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他为人必像野驴。他的手要攻打人，人的手也要攻打他；他必住在众弟兄的东边。」
verses.textEnNiv: He will be a wild donkey of a man; his hand will be against everyone and everyone’s hand against him, and he will live in hostility toward all his brothers."
verses.textEnEsv: He shall be a wild donkey of a man, his hand against everyone and everyone’s hand against him, and he shall dwell over against all his kinsmen."
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall be a wild man; His hand shallbe against every man, And every man’s hand against him. And he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren."
verses.textEnNlt: This son of yours will be a wild man, as untamed as a wild donkey! He will raise his fist against everyone, and everyone will be against him. Yes, he will live in open hostility against all his relatives."
verses.textEnNasb: "But he will be a wild donkey of a man; His hand will be against everyone, And everyone’s hand will be against him; And he will live in defiance of all his brothers."
verses.textEn: He will be a wild donkey of a man; his hand will be against everyone and everyone’s hand against him, and he will live in hostility toward all his brothers."

verses.textZh: 于是，夏甲给那对她说话的耶和华，起名叫"你是看顾人的神"，因为她说："在这里我不是也看见了那位看顾人的吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，夏甲给那对她说话的耶和华，起名叫"你是看顾人的神"，因为她说："在这里我不是也看见了那位看顾人的吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 夏甲就称那对她说话的耶和华为「看顾人的神」。因而说：「在这里我也看见那看顾我的吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: She gave this name to the Lord who spoke to her: "You are the God who sees me," for she said, "I have now seen the One who sees me."
verses.textEnEsv: So she called the name of the Lord who spoke to her, "You are a God of seeing," for she said, "Truly here I have seen him who looks after me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she called the name of the Lord who spoke to her, You-Are-the-God-Who-Sees; for she said, "Have I also here seen Him who sees me?"
verses.textEnNlt: Thereafter, Hagar used another name to refer to the Lord , who had spoken to her. She said, "You are the God who sees me." She also said, "Have I truly seen the One who sees me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then she called the name of the Lord who spoke to her, " You are a God who sees me"; for she said, "Have I even seen Him here and lived after He saw me?"
verses.textEn: She gave this name to the Lord who spoke to her: "You are the God who sees me," for she said, "I have now seen the One who sees me."

verses.textZh: 因此，这井名叫庇耳．拉海．莱，是在加低斯和巴列之间。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，这井名叫庇耳．拉海．莱，是在加低斯和巴列之间。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以这井名叫庇耳‧拉海‧莱。这井正在加低斯和巴列中间。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why the well was called Beer Lahai Roi ; it is still there, between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; it lies between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi; observe, itis between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.textEnNlt: So that well was named Beer-lahai-roi (which means "well of the Living One who sees me"). It can still be found between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore the well was called Beer-lahai-roi; behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.
verses.textEn: That is why the well was called Beer Lahai Roi ; it is still there, between Kadesh and Bered.

verses.textZh: 夏甲给亚伯兰生了一个儿子，亚伯兰就给夏甲所生的儿子，起名叫以实玛利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 夏甲给亚伯兰生了一个儿子，亚伯兰就给夏甲所生的儿子，起名叫以实玛利。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来夏甲给亚伯兰生了一个儿子；亚伯兰给他起名叫以实玛利。
verses.textEnNiv: So Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Hagar bore Abram a son; and Abram named his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.
verses.textEnNlt: So Hagar gave Abram a son, and Abram named him Ishmael.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hagar bore a son to Abram; and Abram named his son, to whom Hagar gave birth, Ishmael.
verses.textEn: So Hagar bore Abram a son, and Abram gave the name Ishmael to the son she had borne.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰八十六岁的时候，夏甲给他生了以实玛利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰八十六岁的时候，夏甲给他生了以实玛利。
verses.textZhCuv: 夏甲给亚伯兰生以实玛利的时候，亚伯兰年八十六岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore him Ishmael.
verses.textEnEsv: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
verses.textEnNlt: Abram was eighty-six years old when Ishmael was born.
verses.textEnNasb: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to him.
verses.textEn: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore him Ishmael.

verses.textZh: 亚伯兰九十九岁的时候，耶和华向他显现，对他说： "我是全能的神， 你要在我面前行事为人； 你要作完全人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯兰九十九岁的时候，耶和华向他显现，对他说： "我是全能的神， 你要在我面前行事为人； 你要作完全人。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰年九十九岁的时候，耶和华向他显现，对他说：「我是全能的神。你当在我面前作完全人，
verses.textEnNiv: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to him and said, "I am God Almighty ; walk before me faithfully and be blameless.
verses.textEnEsv: When Abram was ninety-nine years old the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, "I am God Almighty; walk before me, and be blameless,
verses.textEnNkjv: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, "I am Almighty God; walk before Me and be blameless.
verses.textEnNlt: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to him and said, "I am El-Shaddai—‘God Almighty.’ Serve me faithfully and live a blameless life.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to Abram and said to him, "I am God Almighty; Walk before Me, and be blameless.
verses.textEn: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord appeared to him and said, "I am God Almighty ; walk before me faithfully and be blameless.

verses.textZh: 我要与你立约，要使你的后裔人丁兴旺。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要与你立约，要使你的后裔人丁兴旺。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我就与你立约，使你的后裔极其繁多。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I will make my covenant between me and you and will greatly increase your numbers."
verses.textEnEsv: that I may make my covenant between me and you, and may multiply you greatly."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will make My covenant between Me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly."
verses.textEnNlt: I will make a covenant with you, by which I will guarantee to give you countless descendants."
verses.textEnNasb: "I will make My covenant between Me and you, And I will multiply you exceedingly."
verses.textEn: Then I will make my covenant between me and you and will greatly increase your numbers."

verses.textZh: 于是亚伯兰俯伏在地，神又告诉他，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚伯兰俯伏在地，神又告诉他，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯兰俯伏在地；神又对他说：
verses.textEnNiv: Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abram fell on his face. And God said to him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abram fell on his face, and God talked with him, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: At this, Abram fell face down on the ground. Then God said to him,
verses.textEnNasb: Abram fell on his face, and God talked with him, saying,
verses.textEn: Abram fell facedown, and God said to him,

verses.textZh: "看哪，这就是我和你所立的约： 你要作多国的父。
verses.textZhCnvs: "看哪，这就是我和你所立的约： 你要作多国的父。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我与你立约：你要作多国的父。
verses.textEnNiv: "As for me, this is my covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.
verses.textEnEsv: "Behold, my covenant is with you, and you shall be the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As for Me, behold, My covenant is with you, and you shall be a father of many nations.
verses.textEnNlt: "This is my covenant with you: I will make you the father of a multitude of nations!
verses.textEnNasb: "As for Me, behold, My covenant is with you, And you will be the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.textEn: "As for me, this is my covenant with you: You will be the father of many nations.

verses.textZh: 你的名不要再叫亚伯兰， 要叫亚伯拉罕，因为我已经立了你作万国的父。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的名不要再叫亚伯兰， 要叫亚伯拉罕，因为我已经立了你作万国的父。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此以后，你的名不再叫亚伯兰，要叫亚伯拉罕，因为我已立你作多国的父。
verses.textEnNiv: No longer will you be called Abram ; your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.
verses.textEnEsv: No longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham, for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.textEnNkjv: No longer shall your name be called Abram, but your name shall be Abraham; for I have made you a father of many nations.
verses.textEnNlt: What’s more, I am changing your name. It will no longer be Abram. Instead, you will be called Abraham, for you will be the father of many nations.
verses.textEnNasb: "No longer shall you be named Abram, But your name shall be Abraham; For I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.
verses.textEn: No longer will you be called Abram ; your name will be Abraham, for I have made you a father of many nations.

verses.textZh: 我要使你极其昌盛，国度因你而立，君王必从你而出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要使你极其昌盛，国度因你而立，君王必从你而出。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必使你的后裔极其繁多；国度从你而立，君王从你而出。
verses.textEnNiv: I will make you very fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.
verses.textEnEsv: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make you into nations, and kings shall come from you.
verses.textEnNkjv: I will make you exceedingly fruitful; and I will make nations of you, and kings shall come from you.
verses.textEnNlt: I will make you extremely fruitful. Your descendants will become many nations, and kings will be among them!
verses.textEnNasb: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.
verses.textEn: I will make you very fruitful; I will make nations of you, and kings will come from you.

verses.textZh: 我要与你，和你世世代代的后裔，坚立我的约，成为永远的约，使我作你和你的后裔的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要与你，和你世世代代的后裔，坚立我的约，成为永远的约，使我作你和你的后裔的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要与你并你世世代代的后裔坚立我的约，作永远的约，是要作你和你后裔的神。
verses.textEnNiv: I will establish my covenant as an everlasting covenant between me and you and your descendants after you for the generations to come, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
verses.textEnEsv: And I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your offspring after you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you in their generations, for an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and your descendants after you.
verses.textEnNlt: "I will confirm my covenant with you and your descendants after you, from generation to generation. This is the everlasting covenant: I will always be your God and the God of your descendants after you.
verses.textEnNasb: I will establish My covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you throughout their generations as an everlasting covenant, to be God to you and to your descendants after you.
verses.textEn: I will establish my covenant as an everlasting covenant between me and you and your descendants after you for the generations to come, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.

verses.textZh: 我要把你现在寄居的地，就是迦南全地，赐给你和你的后裔，作永远的产业，我也要作他们的神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要把你现在寄居的地，就是迦南全地，赐给你和你的后裔，作永远的产业，我也要作他们的神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要将你现在寄居的地，就是迦南全地，赐给你和你的后裔永远为业，我也必作他们的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: The whole land of Canaan, where you now reside as a foreigner, I will give as an everlasting possession to you and your descendants after you; and I will be their God."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will give to you and to your offspring after you the land of your sojournings, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession, and I will be their God."
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I give to you and your descendants after you the land in which you are a stranger, all the land of Canaan, as an everlasting possession; and I will be their God."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give the entire land of Canaan, where you now live as a foreigner, to you and your descendants. It will be their possession forever, and I will be their God."
verses.textEnNasb: And I will give to you and to your descendants after you the land where you live as a stranger, all the land of Canaan, as an everlasting possession; and I will be their God."
verses.textEn: The whole land of Canaan, where you now reside as a foreigner, I will give as an everlasting possession to you and your descendants after you; and I will be their God."

verses.textZh: 神又对亚伯拉罕说："你和你世世代代的后裔都要谨守我的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神又对亚伯拉罕说："你和你世世代代的后裔都要谨守我的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 神又对亚伯拉罕说：「你和你的后裔必世世代代遵守我的约。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said to Abraham, "As for you, you must keep my covenant, you and your descendants after you for the generations to come.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said to Abraham, "As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God said to Abraham: "As for you, you shall keep My covenant, you and your descendants after you throughout their generations.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said to Abraham, "Your responsibility is to obey the terms of the covenant. You and all your descendants have this continual responsibility.
verses.textEnNasb: God said further to Abraham, "Now as for you, you shall keep My covenant, you and your descendants after you throughout their generations.
verses.textEn: Then God said to Abraham, "As for you, you must keep my covenant, you and your descendants after you for the generations to come.

verses.textZh: 我与你和你的后裔所立的这约，是你们应当谨守的，就是你们所有的男子，都要受割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我与你和你的后裔所立的这约，是你们应当谨守的，就是你们所有的男子，都要受割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所有的男子都要受割礼；这就是我与你并你的后裔所立的约，是你们所当遵守的。
verses.textEnNiv: This is my covenant with you and your descendants after you, the covenant you are to keep: Every male among you shall be circumcised.
verses.textEnEsv: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you: Every male among you shall be circumcised.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is My covenant which you shall keep, between Me and you and your descendants after you: Every male child among you shall be circumcised;
verses.textEnNlt: This is the covenant that you and your descendants must keep: Each male among you must be circumcised.
verses.textEnNasb: This is My covenant, which you shall keep, between Me and you and your descendants after you: every male among you shall be circumcised.
verses.textEn: This is my covenant with you and your descendants after you, the covenant you are to keep: Every male among you shall be circumcised.

verses.textZh: 你们都要割去身上的包皮，这就是我与你们立约的记号了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们都要割去身上的包皮，这就是我与你们立约的记号了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们都要受割礼 ；这是我与你们立约的证据。
verses.textEnNiv: You are to undergo circumcision, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and you.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskins, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between me and you.
verses.textEnNkjv: and you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskins, and it shall be a sign of the covenant between Me and you.
verses.textEnNlt: You must cut off the flesh of your foreskin as a sign of the covenant between me and you.
verses.textEnNasb: And you shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin, and it shall be the sign of the covenant between Me and you.
verses.textEn: You are to undergo circumcision, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and you.

verses.textZh: 你们中间世世代代所有的男子，无论是在家里生的，或是用银子从不是属你后裔的外族人买来的，生下来第八日都要受割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们中间世世代代所有的男子，无论是在家里生的，或是用银子从不是属你后裔的外族人买来的，生下来第八日都要受割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们世世代代的男子，无论是家里生的，是在你后裔之外用银子从外人买的，生下来第八日，都要受割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: For the generations to come every male among you who is eight days old must be circumcised, including those born in your household or bought with money from a foreigner—those who are not your offspring.
verses.textEnEsv: He who is eight days old among you shall be circumcised. Every male throughout your generations, whether born in your house or bought with your money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring,
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is eight days old among you shall be circumcised, every male child in your generations, he who is born in your house or bought with money from any foreigner who is not your descendant.
verses.textEnNlt: From generation to generation, every male child must be circumcised on the eighth day after his birth. This applies not only to members of your family but also to the servants born in your household and the foreign-born servants whom you have purchased.
verses.textEnNasb: And every male among you who is eight days old shall be circumcised throughout your generations, including a slave who is born in the house or who is bought with money from any foreigner, who is not of your descendants.
verses.textEn: For the generations to come every male among you who is eight days old must be circumcised, including those born in your household or bought with money from a foreigner—those who are not your offspring.

verses.textZh: 在你家里生的，和你用银子买来的，都一定要受割礼。这样，我的约就刻在你们身上，作永远的约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你家里生的，和你用银子买来的，都一定要受割礼。这样，我的约就刻在你们身上，作永远的约。
verses.textZhCuv: 你家里生的和你用银子买的，都必须受割礼。这样，我的约就立在你们肉体上作永远的约。
verses.textEnNiv: Whether born in your household or bought with your money, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh is to be an everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: both he who is born in your house and he who is bought with your money, shall surely be circumcised. So shall my covenant be in your flesh an everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who is born in your house and he who is bought with your money must be circumcised, and My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: All must be circumcised. Your bodies will bear the mark of my everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: A slave who is born in your house or who is bought with your money shall certainly be circumcised; so My covenant shall be in your flesh as an everlasting covenant.
verses.textEn: Whether born in your household or bought with your money, they must be circumcised. My covenant in your flesh is to be an everlasting covenant.

verses.textZh: 但不受割礼的男子，就是没有割去身上的包皮的，那人必从民中剪除，因为他违背了我的约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但不受割礼的男子，就是没有割去身上的包皮的，那人必从民中剪除，因为他违背了我的约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但不受割礼的男子必从民中剪除，因他背了我的约。」
verses.textEnNiv: Any uncircumcised male, who has not been circumcised in the flesh, will be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant."
verses.textEnEsv: Any uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin shall be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the uncircumcised male child, who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that person shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant."
verses.textEnNlt: Any male who fails to be circumcised will be cut off from the covenant family for breaking the covenant."
verses.textEnNasb: But as for an uncircumcised male, one who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that person shall be cut off from his people; he has broken My covenant."
verses.textEn: Any uncircumcised male, who has not been circumcised in the flesh, will be cut off from his people; he has broken my covenant."

verses.textZh: 神又对亚伯拉罕说："至于你的妻子撒莱，不要再叫她的名撒莱，要叫撒拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神又对亚伯拉罕说："至于你的妻子撒莱，不要再叫她的名撒莱，要叫撒拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 神又对亚伯拉罕说：「你的妻子撒莱不可再叫撒莱，她的名要叫撒拉。
verses.textEnNiv: God also said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you are no longer to call her Sarai; her name will be Sarah.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shall be her name.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but Sarah shallbe her name.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said to Abraham, "Regarding Sarai, your wife—her name will no longer be Sarai. From now on her name will be Sarah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said to Abraham, "As for your wife Sarai, you shall not call her by the name Sarai, but Sarah shall be her name.
verses.textEn: God also said to Abraham, "As for Sarai your wife, you are no longer to call her Sarai; her name will be Sarah.

verses.textZh: 我必赐福给她，也必使她为你生一个儿子；我要赐福给她，她也要作多国的母，万族的君王必从她而出。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必赐福给她，也必使她为你生一个儿子；我要赐福给她，她也要作多国的母，万族的君王必从她而出。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我必赐福给她，也要使你从她得一个儿子。我要赐福给她，她也要作多国之母；必有百姓的君王从她而出。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her so that she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will come from her."
verses.textEnEsv: I will bless her, and moreover, I will give you a son by her. I will bless her, and she shall become nations; kings of peoples shall come from her."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will bless her and also give you a son by her; then I will bless her, and she shall be amother of nations; kings of peoples shall be from her."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will bless her and give you a son from her! Yes, I will bless her richly, and she will become the mother of many nations. Kings of nations will be among her descendants."
verses.textEnNasb: I will bless her, and indeed I will give you a son by her. Then I will bless her, and she shall be a mother of nations; kings of peoples will come from her."
verses.textEn: I will bless her and will surely give you a son by her. I will bless her so that she will be the mother of nations; kings of peoples will come from her."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕就俯伏在地，笑了起来，心里说："一百岁的人，还能生孩子吗？撒拉已经九十岁了，还能生育吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕就俯伏在地，笑了起来，心里说："一百岁的人，还能生孩子吗？撒拉已经九十岁了，还能生育吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕就俯伏在地喜笑，心里说：「一百岁的人还能得孩子吗？撒拉已经九十岁了，还能生养吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham fell facedown; he laughed and said to himself, "Will a son be born to a man a hundred years old? Will Sarah bear a child at the age of ninety?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed and said to himself, "Shall a child be born to a man who is a hundred years old? Shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear a child?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, "Shall achild be born to a man who is one hundred years old? And shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear achild?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham bowed down to the ground, but he laughed to himself in disbelief. "How could I become a father at the age of 100?" he thought. "And how can Sarah have a baby when she is ninety years old?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, "Will a child be born to a man a hundred years old? And will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth to a child?"
verses.textEn: Abraham fell facedown; he laughed and said to himself, "Will a son be born to a man a hundred years old? Will Sarah bear a child at the age of ninety?"

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕对神说："愿以实玛利能在你面前活着！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕对神说："愿以实玛利能在你面前活着！"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕对神说：「但愿以实玛利活在你面前。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Abraham said to God, "If only Ishmael might live under your blessing!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham said to God, "Oh that Ishmael might live before you!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham said to God, "Oh, that Ishmael might live before You!"
verses.textEnNlt: So Abraham said to God, "May Ishmael live under your special blessing!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Abraham said to God, "Oh that Ishmael might live before You!"
verses.textEn: And Abraham said to God, "If only Ishmael might live under your blessing!"

verses.textZh: 神说："你的妻子撒拉，真的要为你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫以撒，我要与他坚立我的约，作他后裔的永约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："你的妻子撒拉，真的要为你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫以撒，我要与他坚立我的约，作他后裔的永约。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「不然，你妻子撒拉要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫以撒。我要与他坚定所立的约，作他后裔永远的约。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said, "Yes, but your wife Sarah will bear you a son, and you will call him Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
verses.textEnEsv: God said, "No, but Sarah your wife shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said: "No, Sarah your wife shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac; I will establish My covenant with him for an everlasting covenant, and with his descendants after him.
verses.textEnNlt: But God replied, "No—Sarah, your wife, will give birth to a son for you. You will name him Isaac, and I will confirm my covenant with him and his descendants as an everlasting covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: But God said, "No, but your wife Sarah will bear you a son, and you shall name him Isaac; and I will establish My covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.
verses.textEn: Then God said, "Yes, but your wife Sarah will bear you a son, and you will call him Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him as an everlasting covenant for his descendants after him.

verses.textZh: 至于以实玛利，我也应允你。看哪，我已经赐福给他；我必使他昌盛，子孙极其众多；他必生十二个族长；我也必使他成为大国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于以实玛利，我也应允你。看哪，我已经赐福给他；我必使他昌盛，子孙极其众多；他必生十二个族长；我也必使他成为大国。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于以实玛利，我也应允你：我必赐福给他，使他昌盛，极其繁多。他必生十二个族长；我也要使他成为大国。
verses.textEnNiv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you: I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and will greatly increase his numbers. He will be the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.
verses.textEnEsv: As for Ishmael, I have heard you; behold, I have blessed him and will make him fruitful and multiply him greatly. He shall father twelve princes, and I will make him into a great nation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He shall beget twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.textEnNlt: As for Ishmael, I will bless him also, just as you have asked. I will make him extremely fruitful and multiply his descendants. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.
verses.textEnNasb: As for Ishmael, I have heard you; behold, I will bless him, and make him fruitful and multiply him exceedingly. He shall father twelve princes, and I will make him into a great nation.
verses.textEn: And as for Ishmael, I have heard you: I will surely bless him; I will make him fruitful and will greatly increase his numbers. He will be the father of twelve rulers, and I will make him into a great nation.

verses.textZh: 但我的约是要和以撒坚立的。这以撒，就是明年这时候，撒拉要为你生的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我的约是要和以撒坚立的。这以撒，就是明年这时候，撒拉要为你生的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到明年这时节，撒拉必给你生以撒，我要与他坚定所立的约。」
verses.textEnNiv: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you by this time next year."
verses.textEnEsv: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this time next year."
verses.textEnNkjv: But My covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah shall bear to you at this set time next year."
verses.textEnNlt: But my covenant will be confirmed with Isaac, who will be born to you and Sarah about this time next year."
verses.textEnNasb: But I will establish My covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this season next year."
verses.textEn: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you by this time next year."

verses.textZh: 神和亚伯拉罕说完了话，就离开他上升去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神和亚伯拉罕说完了话，就离开他上升去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神和亚伯拉罕说完了话，就离开他上升去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When he had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.
verses.textEnEsv: When he had finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He finished talking with him, and God went up from Abraham.
verses.textEnNlt: When God had finished speaking, he left Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: When He finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.
verses.textEn: When he had finished speaking with Abraham, God went up from him.

verses.textZh: 就在那一天，亚伯拉罕照着神吩咐他的，给他儿子以实玛利，和他家里所有的男子，无论是在家里生的，或是用银子买来的，都割去了他们身上的包皮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那一天，亚伯拉罕照着神吩咐他的，给他儿子以实玛利，和他家里所有的男子，无论是在家里生的，或是用银子买来的，都割去了他们身上的包皮。
verses.textZhCuv: 正当那日，亚伯拉罕遵着神的命，给他的儿子以实玛利和家里的一切男子，无论是在家里生的，是用银子买的，都行了割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or bought with his money, every male in his household, and circumcised them, as God told him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abraham took Ishmael his son and all those born in his house or bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and he circumcised the flesh of their foreskins that very day, as God had said to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house and all who were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskins that very same day, as God had said to him.
