verses.textEnNlt: On that very day Abraham took his son, Ishmael, and every male in his household, including those born there and those he had bought. Then he circumcised them, cutting off their foreskins, just as God had told him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abraham took his son Ishmael, and all the slaves who were born in his house and all who were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s household, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin on this very same day, as God had said to him.
verses.textEn: On that very day Abraham took his son Ishmael and all those born in his household or bought with his money, every male in his household, and circumcised them, as God told him.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕九十九岁的时候，割去了他身上的包皮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕九十九岁的时候，割去了他身上的包皮。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕受割礼的时候年九十九岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.textEn: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised,

verses.textZh: 他的儿子以实玛利十三岁的时候，割去了他身上的包皮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的儿子以实玛利十三岁的时候，割去了他身上的包皮。
verses.textZhCuv: 他儿子以实玛利受割礼的时候年十三岁。
verses.textEnNiv: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;
verses.textEnEsv: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.textEnNlt: and Ishmael, his son, was thirteen.
verses.textEnNasb: And his son Ishmael was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.textEn: and his son Ishmael was thirteen;

verses.textZh: 就在那一天，亚伯拉罕和他的儿子以实玛利，都受了割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就在那一天，亚伯拉罕和他的儿子以实玛利，都受了割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 正当那日，亚伯拉罕和他儿子以实玛利一同受了割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham and his son Ishmael were both circumcised on that very day.
verses.textEnEsv: That very day Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised.
verses.textEnNkjv: That very same day Abraham was circumcised, and his son Ishmael;
verses.textEnNlt: Both Abraham and his son, Ishmael, were circumcised on that same day,
verses.textEnNasb: On this very same day Abraham was circumcised, as well as his son Ishmael.
verses.textEn: Abraham and his son Ishmael were both circumcised on that very day.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕家里所有的男人，无论是在家里生的，或是用银子从外族人买来的，都与他一同受了割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕家里所有的男人，无论是在家里生的，或是用银子从外族人买来的，都与他一同受了割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 家里所有的人，无论是在家里生的，是用银子从外人买的，也都一同受了割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: And every male in Abraham’s household, including those born in his household or bought from a foreigner, was circumcised with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And all the men of his house, those born in the house and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: and all the men of his house, born in the house or bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
verses.textEnNlt: along with all the other men and boys of the household, whether they were born there or bought as servants. All were circumcised with him.
verses.textEnNasb: And all the men of his household, those who were born in the house or bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
verses.textEn: And every male in Abraham’s household, including those born in his household or bought from a foreigner, was circumcised with him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华在幔利橡树那里，向亚伯拉罕显现。那时，是一天中最热的时候，亚伯拉罕正坐在帐棚门口；
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华在幔利橡树那里，向亚伯拉罕显现。那时，是一天中最热的时候，亚伯拉罕正坐在帐棚门口；
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华在幔利橡树那里向亚伯拉罕显现出来。那时正热，亚伯拉罕坐在帐棚门口，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord appeared to Abraham near the great trees of Mamre while he was sitting at the entrance to his tent in the heat of the day.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat at the door of his tent in the heat of the day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord appeared to him by the terebinth trees of Mamre, as he was sitting in the tent door in the heat of the day.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord appeared again to Abraham near the oak grove belonging to Mamre. One day Abraham was sitting at the entrance to his tent during the hottest part of the day.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord appeared to Abraham by the oaks of Mamre, while he was sitting at the tent door in the heat of the day.
verses.textEn: The Lord appeared to Abraham near the great trees of Mamre while he was sitting at the entrance to his tent in the heat of the day.

verses.textZh: 他举目观看，忽然看见三个人在他对面站着；亚伯拉罕看见了，就从帐棚门口跑去迎接他们，俯伏在地，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他举目观看，忽然看见三个人在他对面站着；亚伯拉罕看见了，就从帐棚门口跑去迎接他们，俯伏在地，
verses.textZhCuv: 举目观看，见有三个人在对面站着。他一见，就从帐棚门口跑去迎接他们，俯伏在地，
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he hurried from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, three men were standing in front of him. When he saw them, he ran from the tent door to meet them and bowed himself to the earth
verses.textEnNkjv: So he lifted his eyes and looked, and behold, three men were standing by him; and when he saw them, he ran from the tent door to meet them, and bowed himself to the ground,
verses.textEnNlt: He looked up and noticed three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he ran to meet them and welcomed them, bowing low to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: When he raised his eyes and looked, behold, three men were standing opposite him; and when he saw them, he ran from the tent door to meet them and bowed down to the ground,
verses.textEn: Abraham looked up and saw three men standing nearby. When he saw them, he hurried from the entrance of his tent to meet them and bowed low to the ground.

verses.textZh: 说："我主啊，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你不要离开你的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："我主啊，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你不要离开你的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我主，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你不要离开仆人往前去。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "If I have found favor in your eyes, my lord, do not pass your servant by.
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "O Lord, if I have found favor in your sight, do not pass by your servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said, "My Lord, if I have now found favor in Your sight, do not pass on by Your servant.
verses.textEnNlt: "My lord," he said, "if it pleases you, stop here for a while.
verses.textEnNasb: and said, " My Lord, if now I have found favor in Your sight, please do not pass Your servant by.
verses.textEn: He said, "If I have found favor in your eyes, my lord, do not pass your servant by.

verses.textZh: 让我叫人拿点水来，你们可以洗洗脚，然后在树下歇一歇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 让我叫人拿点水来，你们可以洗洗脚，然后在树下歇一歇。
verses.textZhCuv: 容我拿点水来，你们洗洗脚，在树下歇息歇息。
verses.textEnNiv: Let a little water be brought, and then you may all wash your feet and rest under this tree.
verses.textEnEsv: Let a little water be brought, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree,
verses.textEnNkjv: Please let a little water be brought, and wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.
verses.textEnNlt: Rest in the shade of this tree while water is brought to wash your feet.
verses.textEnNasb: Please let a little water be brought and wash your feet, and make yourselves comfortable under the tree;
verses.textEn: Let a little water be brought, and then you may all wash your feet and rest under this tree.

verses.textZh: 让我拿点饼来给你们吃，使你们可以恢复精力，然后再走，因为你们既然到了仆人这里来，就应该这样。"他们说："就照着你所说的去作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 让我拿点饼来给你们吃，使你们可以恢复精力，然后再走，因为你们既然到了仆人这里来，就应该这样。"他们说："就照着你所说的去作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我再拿一点饼来，你们可以加添心力，然后往前去。你们既到仆人这里来，理当如此。」他们说：「就照你说的行吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: Let me get you something to eat, so you can be refreshed and then go on your way—now that you have come to your servant." "Very well," they answered, "do as you say."
verses.textEnEsv: while I bring a morsel of bread, that you may refresh yourselves, and after that you may pass on— since you have come to your servant." So they said, "Do as you have said."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will bring a morsel of bread, that you may refresh your hearts. After that you may pass by, inasmuch as you have come to your servant." They said, "Do as you have said."
verses.textEnNlt: And since you’ve honored your servant with this visit, let me prepare some food to refresh you before you continue on your journey." "All right," they said. "Do as you have said."
verses.textEnNasb: and I will bring a piece of bread, so that you may refresh yourselves; after that you may go on, since you have visited your servant." And they said, "So do as you have said."
verses.textEn: Let me get you something to eat, so you can be refreshed and then go on your way—now that you have come to your servant." "Very well," they answered, "do as you say."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕赶快进帐棚，到撒拉那里，说："你快拿三斗细面调和，作些饼。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕赶快进帐棚，到撒拉那里，说："你快拿三斗细面调和，作些饼。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕急忙进帐棚见撒拉，说：「你速速拿三细亚细面调和做饼。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah. "Quick," he said, "get three seahs of the finest flour and knead it and bake some bread."
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham went quickly into the tent to Sarah and said, "Quick! Three seahs of fine flour! Knead it, and make cakes."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah and said, "Quickly, make ready three measures of fine meal; knead it and make cakes."
verses.textEnNlt: So Abraham ran back to the tent and said to Sarah, "Hurry! Get three large measures of your best flour, knead it into dough, and bake some bread."
verses.textEnNasb: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, " Quickly, prepare three measures of fine flour, knead it, and make bread cakes."
verses.textEn: So Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah. "Quick," he said, "get three seahs of the finest flour and knead it and bake some bread."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕又跑到牛群里，牵了一头又嫩又好的牛犊，交给仆人；仆人就赶快去预备。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕又跑到牛群里，牵了一头又嫩又好的牛犊，交给仆人；仆人就赶快去预备。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕又跑到牛群里，牵了一只又嫩又好的牛犊来，交给仆人，仆人急忙预备好了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he ran to the herd and selected a choice, tender calf and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham ran to the herd and took a calf, tender and good, and gave it to a young man, who prepared it quickly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham ran to the herd, took a tender and good calf, gave it to a young man, and he hastened to prepare it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham ran out to the herd and chose a tender calf and gave it to his servant, who quickly prepared it.
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham also ran to the herd, and took a tender and choice calf and gave it to the servant, and he hurried to prepare it.
verses.textEn: Then he ran to the herd and selected a choice, tender calf and gave it to a servant, who hurried to prepare it.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕又拿了乳酪、奶和预备好的牛犊肉来，摆在他们面前。他们吃的时候，亚伯拉罕在树下侍候他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕又拿了乳酪、奶和预备好的牛犊肉来，摆在他们面前。他们吃的时候，亚伯拉罕在树下侍候他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕又取了奶油和奶，并预备好的牛犊来，摆在他们面前，自己在树下站在旁边，他们就吃了。
verses.textEnNiv: He then brought some curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and set these before them. While they ate, he stood near them under a tree.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he took curds and milk and the calf that he had prepared, and set it before them. And he stood by them under the tree while they ate.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he took butter and milk and the calf which he had prepared, and set it before them; and he stood by them under the tree as they ate.
verses.textEnNlt: When the food was ready, Abraham took some yogurt and milk and the roasted meat, and he served it to the men. As they ate, Abraham waited on them in the shade of the trees.
verses.textEnNasb: He took curds and milk and the calf which he had prepared, and set it before them; and he was standing by them under the tree as they ate.
verses.textEn: He then brought some curds and milk and the calf that had been prepared, and set these before them. While they ate, he stood near them under a tree.

verses.textZh: 他们问亚伯拉罕："你的妻子撒拉在哪里？"他回答："在帐棚里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们问亚伯拉罕："你的妻子撒拉在哪里？"他回答："在帐棚里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们问亚伯拉罕说：「你妻子撒拉在哪里？」他说：「在帐棚里。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Where is your wife Sarah?" they asked him. "There, in the tent," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "Where is Sarah your wife?" And he said, "She is in the tent."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to him, "Where is Sarah your wife?" So he said, "Here, in the tent."
verses.textEnNlt: "Where is Sarah, your wife?" the visitors asked. "She’s inside the tent," Abraham replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to him, "Where is your wife Sarah?" And he said, "There, in the tent."
verses.textEn: "Where is your wife Sarah?" they asked him. "There, in the tent," he said.

verses.textZh: 其中一位说："到明年这个时候，我必回到你这里来。那时，你的妻子撒拉必生一个儿子。"撒拉在那人后面的帐棚门口，也听见了这话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中一位说："到明年这个时候，我必回到你这里来。那时，你的妻子撒拉必生一个儿子。"撒拉在那人后面的帐棚门口，也听见了这话。
verses.textZhCuv: 三人中有一位说：「到明年这时候，我必要回到你这里；你的妻子撒拉必生一个儿子。」撒拉在那人后边的帐棚门口也听见了这话。
verses.textEnNiv: Then one of them said, "I will surely return to you about this time next year, and Sarah your wife will have a son." Now Sarah was listening at the entrance to the tent, which was behind him.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said, "I will surely return to you about this time next year, and Sarah your wife shall have a son." And Sarah was listening at the tent door behind him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "I will certainly return to you according to the time of life, and behold, Sarah your wife shall have a son." (Sarah was listening in the tent door which was behind him.)
verses.textEnNlt: Then one of them said, "I will return to you about this time next year, and your wife, Sarah, will have a son!" Sarah was listening to this conversation from the tent.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "I will certainly return to you at this time next year; and behold, your wife Sarah will have a son." And Sarah was listening at the tent door, which was behind him.
verses.textEn: Then one of them said, "I will surely return to you about this time next year, and Sarah your wife will have a son." Now Sarah was listening at the entrance to the tent, which was behind him.

verses.textZh: 当时，亚伯拉罕和撒拉都老了，上了年纪，撒拉的月经也停止了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，亚伯拉罕和撒拉都老了，上了年纪，撒拉的月经也停止了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕和撒拉年纪老迈，撒拉的月经已断绝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham and Sarah were already very old, and Sarah was past the age of childbearing.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in years. The way of women had ceased to be with Sarah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age; and Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham and Sarah were both very old by this time, and Sarah was long past the age of having children.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, advanced in age; Sarah was past childbearing.
verses.textEn: Abraham and Sarah were already very old, and Sarah was past the age of childbearing.

verses.textZh: 撒拉心里暗笑，说："现在我已经衰老了，我的丈夫也老了，我还有房事的乐趣吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒拉心里暗笑，说："现在我已经衰老了，我的丈夫也老了，我还有房事的乐趣吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒拉心里暗笑，说：「我既已衰败，我主也老迈，岂能有这喜事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So Sarah laughed to herself as she thought, "After I am worn out and my lord is old, will I now have this pleasure?"
verses.textEnEsv: So Sarah laughed to herself, saying, "After I am worn out, and my lord is old, shall I have pleasure?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself, saying, "After I have grown old, shall I have pleasure, my lord being old also?"
verses.textEnNlt: So she laughed silently to herself and said, "How could a worn-out woman like me enjoy such pleasure, especially when my master—my husband—is also so old?"
verses.textEnNasb: So Sarah laughed to herself, saying, "After I have become old, am I to have pleasure, my lord being old also?"
verses.textEn: So Sarah laughed to herself as she thought, "After I am worn out and my lord is old, will I now have this pleasure?"

verses.textZh: 耶和华对亚伯拉罕说："撒拉为甚么暗笑说：‘我已经老了，真的还能生育吗？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华对亚伯拉罕说："撒拉为甚么暗笑说：‘我已经老了，真的还能生育吗？’
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对亚伯拉罕说：「撒拉为什么暗笑，说：『我既已年老，果真能生养吗？』
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Will I really have a child, now that I am old?’
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Shall I indeed bear a child, now that I am old?’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Shall I surely bear achild, since I am old?’
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh? Why did she say, ‘Can an old woman like me have a baby?’
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Shall I actually give birth to a child, when I am so old?’
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Abraham, "Why did Sarah laugh and say, ‘Will I really have a child, now that I am old?’

verses.textZh: 耶和华岂有难成的事吗？到明年这个时候，我要回到你这里来，那时，撒拉必生一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华岂有难成的事吗？到明年这个时候，我要回到你这里来，那时，撒拉必生一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华岂有难成的事吗？到了日期，明年这时候，我必回到你这里，撒拉必生一个儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Is anything too hard for the Lord ? I will return to you at the appointed time next year, and Sarah will have a son."
verses.textEnEsv: Is anything too hard for the Lord ? At the appointed time I will return to you, about this time next year, and Sarah shall have a son."
verses.textEnNkjv: Is anything too hard for the Lord? At the appointed time I will return to you, according to the time of life, and Sarah shall have a son."
verses.textEnNlt: Is anything too hard for the Lord ? I will return about this time next year, and Sarah will have a son."
verses.textEnNasb: Is anything too difficult for the Lord? At the appointed time I will return to you, at this time next year, and Sarah will have a son."
verses.textEn: Is anything too hard for the Lord ? I will return to you at the appointed time next year, and Sarah will have a son."

verses.textZh: 撒拉害怕起来，就否认，说："我没有笑。"但那位说："不，你实在笑了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒拉害怕起来，就否认，说："我没有笑。"但那位说："不，你实在笑了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒拉就害怕，不承认，说：「我没有笑。」那位说：「不然，你实在笑了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Sarah was afraid, so she lied and said, "I did not laugh." But he said, "Yes, you did laugh."
verses.textEnEsv: But Sarah denied it, saying, "I did not laugh," for she was afraid. He said, "No, but you did laugh."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Sarah denied it, saying, "I did not laugh," for she was afraid. And He said, "No, but you did laugh!"
verses.textEnNlt: Sarah was afraid, so she denied it, saying, "I didn’t laugh." But the Lord said, "No, you did laugh."
verses.textEnNasb: Sarah denied it, however, saying, "I did not laugh"; for she was afraid. And He said, "No, but you did laugh."
verses.textEn: Sarah was afraid, so she lied and said, "I did not laugh." But he said, "Yes, you did laugh."

verses.textZh: 三人就从那里起身，向着所多玛观望。亚伯拉罕与他们同行，要送他们一程。
verses.textZhCnvs: 三人就从那里起身，向着所多玛观望。亚伯拉罕与他们同行，要送他们一程。
verses.textZhCuv: 三人就从那里起行，向所多玛观看，亚伯拉罕也与他们同行，要送他们一程。
verses.textEnNiv: When the men got up to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them on their way.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the men set out from there, and they looked down toward Sodom. And Abraham went with them to set them on their way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men rose from there and looked toward Sodom, and Abraham went with them to send them on the way.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the men got up from their meal and looked out toward Sodom. As they left, Abraham went with them to send them on their way.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men rose up from there, and looked down toward Sodom; and Abraham was walking with them to send them off.
verses.textEn: When the men got up to leave, they looked down toward Sodom, and Abraham walked along with them to see them on their way.

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："我要作的事，岂可瞒着亚伯拉罕呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："我要作的事，岂可瞒着亚伯拉罕呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「我所要做的事岂可瞒着亚伯拉罕呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am doing,
verses.textEnNlt: "Should I hide my plan from Abraham?" the Lord asked.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said, "Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕必要成为强大兴盛的国，地上的万国，都必因他得福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕必要成为强大兴盛的国，地上的万国，都必因他得福。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕必要成为强大的国；地上的万国都必因他得福。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and all nations on earth will be blessed through him.
verses.textEnEsv: seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.textEnNkjv: since Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him?
verses.textEnNlt: "For Abraham will certainly become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed through him.
verses.textEnNasb: since Abraham will certainly become a great and mighty nation, and in him all the nations of the earth will be blessed?
verses.textEn: Abraham will surely become a great and powerful nation, and all nations on earth will be blessed through him.

verses.textZh: 我拣选了他 ，是要他吩咐子孙，和他的家属，遵守我耶和华的道，秉公行义，好叫我耶和华应许亚伯拉罕的话都可实现。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我拣选了他 ，是要他吩咐子孙，和他的家属，遵守我耶和华的道，秉公行义，好叫我耶和华应许亚伯拉罕的话都可实现。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我眷顾他，为要叫他吩咐他的众子和他的眷属遵守我的道，秉公行义，使我所应许亚伯拉罕的话都成就了。」
verses.textEnNiv: For I have chosen him, so that he will direct his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord by doing what is right and just, so that the Lord will bring about for Abraham what he has promised him."
verses.textEnEsv: For I have chosen him, that he may command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord by doing righteousness and justice, so that the Lord may bring to Abraham what he has promised him."
verses.textEnNkjv: For I have known him, in order that he may command his children and his household after him, that they keep the way of the Lord, to do righteousness and justice, that the Lord may bring to Abraham what He has spoken to him."
verses.textEnNlt: I have singled him out so that he will direct his sons and their families to keep the way of the Lord by doing what is right and just. Then I will do for Abraham all that I have promised."
verses.textEnNasb: For I have chosen him, so that he may command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord by doing righteousness and justice, so that the Lord may bring upon Abraham what He has spoken about him."
verses.textEn: For I have chosen him, so that he will direct his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord by doing what is right and just, so that the Lord will bring about for Abraham what he has promised him."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："控告所多玛和蛾摩拉的声音甚大，他们的罪恶极重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："控告所多玛和蛾摩拉的声音甚大，他们的罪恶极重。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「所多玛和蛾摩拉的罪恶甚重，声闻于我。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said, "The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is so great and their sin so grievous
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said, "Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great and their sin is very grave,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said, "Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grave,
verses.textEnNlt: So the Lord told Abraham, "I have heard a great outcry from Sodom and Gomorrah, because their sin is so flagrant.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said, "The outcry of Sodom and Gomorrah is indeed great, and their sin is exceedingly grave.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said, "The outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is so great and their sin so grievous

verses.textZh: 我现在要下去，看看他们所行的，是不是全像那声闻于我的控告；如果不是，我也会知道的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在要下去，看看他们所行的，是不是全像那声闻于我的控告；如果不是，我也会知道的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我现在要下去，察看他们所行的，果然尽像那达到我耳中的声音一样吗？若是不然，我也必知道。」
verses.textEnNiv: that I will go down and see if what they have done is as bad as the outcry that has reached me. If not, I will know."
verses.textEnEsv: I will go down to see whether they have done altogether according to the outcry that has come to me. And if not, I will know."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will go down now and see whether they have done altogether according to the outcry against it that has come to Me; and if not, I will know."
verses.textEnNlt: I am going down to see if their actions are as wicked as I have heard. If not, I want to know."
verses.textEnNasb: I will go down now and see whether they have done entirely as the outcry, which has come to Me indicates; and if not, I will know."
verses.textEn: that I will go down and see if what they have done is as bad as the outcry that has reached me. If not, I will know."

verses.textZh: 其中二人从那里动身，向所多玛走去，亚伯拉罕却仍然站在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中二人从那里动身，向所多玛走去，亚伯拉罕却仍然站在耶和华面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人转身离开那里，向所多玛去；但亚伯拉罕仍旧站在耶和华面前。
verses.textEnNiv: The men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: So the men turned from there and went toward Sodom, but Abraham still stood before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men turned away from there and went toward Sodom, but Abraham still stood before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The other men turned and headed toward Sodom, but the Lord remained with Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men turned away from there and went toward Sodom, while Abraham was still standing before the Lord.
verses.textEn: The men turned away and went toward Sodom, but Abraham remained standing before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕上前说："你真的要把义人和恶人一同除灭吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕上前说："你真的要把义人和恶人一同除灭吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕近前来，说：「无论善恶，你都要剿灭吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abraham approached him and said: "Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abraham drew near and said, "Will you indeed sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham came near and said, "Would You also destroy the righteous with the wicked?
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham approached him and said, "Will you sweep away both the righteous and the wicked?
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham approached and said, "Will You indeed sweep away the righteous with the wicked?
verses.textEn: Then Abraham approached him and said: "Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked?

verses.textZh: 假如城中有五十个义人，你还真的要除灭那地方，不为城里的五十个义人而赦免那地方吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 假如城中有五十个义人，你还真的要除灭那地方，不为城里的五十个义人而赦免那地方吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 假若那城里有五十个义人，你还剿灭那地方吗？不为城里这五十个义人饶恕其中的人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: What if there are fifty righteous people in the city? Will you really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous people in it?
verses.textEnEsv: Suppose there are fifty righteous within the city. Will you then sweep away the place and not spare it for the fifty righteous who are in it?
verses.textEnNkjv: Suppose there were fifty righteous within the city; would You also destroy the place and not spare it for the fifty righteous that were in it?

verses.textEn: What if there are fifty righteous people in the city? Will you really sweep it away and not spare the place for the sake of the fifty righteous people in it?

verses.textEnNiv: Far be it from you to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, treating the righteous and the wicked alike. Far be it from you! Will not the Judge of all the earth do right?"
verses.textEnEsv: Far be it from you to do such a thing, to put the righteous to death with the wicked, so that the righteous fare as the wicked! Far be that from you! Shall not the Judge of all the earth do what is just?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Far be it from You to do such a thing as this, to slay the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be as the wicked; far be it from You! Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right?"
verses.textEnNlt: Surely you wouldn’t do such a thing, destroying the righteous along with the wicked. Why, you would be treating the righteous and the wicked exactly the same! Surely you wouldn’t do that! Should not the Judge of all the earth do what is right?"
verses.textEnNasb: Far be it from You to do such a thing, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous and the wicked are treated alike. Far be it from You! Shall not the Judge of all the earth deal justly?"
verses.textEn: Far be it from you to do such a thing—to kill the righteous with the wicked, treating the righteous and the wicked alike. Far be it from you! Will not the Judge of all the earth do right?"

verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I have two daughters who have not known any man. Let me bring them out to you, and do to them as you please. Only do nothing to these men, for they have come under the shelter of my roof."
verses.textEnNkjv: See now, I have two daughters who have not known a man; please, let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them as you wish; only do nothing to these men, since this is the reason they have come under the shadow of my roof."
verses.textEnNlt: Look, I have two virgin daughters. Let me bring them out to you, and you can do with them as you wish. But please, leave these men alone, for they are my guests and are under my protection."
verses.textEnNasb: Now look, I have two daughters who have not had relations with any man; please let me bring them out to you, and do to them whatever you like; only do not do anything to these men, because they have come under the shelter of my roof."
verses.textEn: Look, I have two daughters who have never slept with a man. Let me bring them out to you, and you can do what you like with them. But don’t do anything to these men, for they have come under the protection of my roof."

verses.textZh: 众人却说："滚开！"又说："一个来这里寄居的人，竟作起审判官来；现在我们要害你，比害他们还要厉害。"众人就向罗得极力拥挤，他们冲前要打破房门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人却说："滚开！"又说："一个来这里寄居的人，竟作起审判官来；现在我们要害你，比害他们还要厉害。"众人就向罗得极力拥挤，他们冲前要打破房门。
verses.textZhCuv: 众人说：「退去吧！」又说：「这个人来寄居，还想要作官哪！现在我们要害你比害他们更甚。」众人就向前拥挤罗得，要攻破房门。
verses.textEnNiv: "Get out of our way," they replied. "This fellow came here as a foreigner, and now he wants to play the judge! We’ll treat you worse than them." They kept bringing pressure on Lot and moved forward to break down the door.
verses.textEnEsv: But they said, "Stand back!" And they said, "This fellow came to sojourn, and he has become the judge! Now we will deal worse with you than with them." Then they pressed hard against the man Lot, and drew near to break the door down.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "Stand back!" Then they said, "This one came in to stay here, and he keeps acting as a judge; now we will deal worse with you than with them." So they pressed hard against the man Lot, and came near to break down the door.
verses.textEnNlt: "Stand back!" they shouted. "This fellow came to town as an outsider, and now he’s acting like our judge! We’ll treat you far worse than those other men!" And they lunged toward Lot to break down the door.
verses.textEnNasb: But they said, "Get out of the way!" They also said, "This one came in as a foreigner, and already he is acting like a judge; now we will treat you worse than them!" So they pressed hard against Lot and moved forward to break the door.
verses.textEn: "Get out of our way," they replied. "This fellow came here as a foreigner, and now he wants to play the judge! We’ll treat you worse than them." They kept bringing pressure on Lot and moved forward to break down the door.

verses.textZh: 那两个人却伸出手来，把罗得拉进屋里去，并把门关上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那两个人却伸出手来，把罗得拉进屋里去，并把门关上。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是那二人伸出手来，将罗得拉进屋去，把门关上，
verses.textEnNiv: But the men inside reached out and pulled Lot back into the house and shut the door.
verses.textEnEsv: But the men reached out their hands and brought Lot into the house with them and shut the door.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the men reached out their hands and pulled Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.
verses.textEnNlt: But the two angels reached out, pulled Lot into the house, and bolted the door.
verses.textEnNasb: But the men reached out their hands and brought Lot into the house with them, and shut the door.
verses.textEn: But the men inside reached out and pulled Lot back into the house and shut the door.

verses.textZh: 然后击打那些门外的人，使他们无论老少，都眼目昏眩，以致找不到门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后击打那些门外的人，使他们无论老少，都眼目昏眩，以致找不到门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且使门外的人，无论老少，眼都昏迷；他们摸来摸去，总寻不着房门。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they struck the men who were at the door of the house, young and old, with blindness so that they could not find the door.
verses.textEnEsv: And they struck with blindness the men who were at the entrance of the house, both small and great, so that they wore themselves out groping for the door.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they struck the men who were at the doorway of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they became weary trying to find the door.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they blinded all the men, young and old, who were at the door of the house, so they gave up trying to get inside.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they struck the men who were at the doorway of the house with blindness, from the small to the great, so that they became weary of trying to find the doorway.
verses.textEn: Then they struck the men who were at the door of the house, young and old, with blindness so that they could not find the door.

verses.textZh: 那二人对罗得说："你这里还有甚么人没有？无论是女婿、儿女，或是城中所有属你的人，都要把他们从这地方带走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那二人对罗得说："你这里还有甚么人没有？无论是女婿、儿女，或是城中所有属你的人，都要把他们从这地方带走。
verses.textZhCuv: 二人对罗得说：「你这里还有什么人吗？无论是女婿是儿女，和这城中一切属你的人，你都要将他们从这地方带出去。
verses.textEnNiv: The two men said to Lot, "Do you have anyone else here—sons-in-law, sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the men said to Lot, "Have you anyone else here? Sons-in-law, sons, daughters, or anyone you have in the city, bring them out of the place.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men said to Lot, "Have you anyone else here? Son-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city— take them out of this place!
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the angels questioned Lot. "Do you have any other relatives here in the city?" they asked. "Get them out of this place—your sons-in-law, sons, daughters, or anyone else.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the two men said to Lot, "Whom else do you have here? A son-in-law and your sons and daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place;
verses.textEn: The two men said to Lot, "Do you have anyone else here—sons-in-law, sons or daughters, or anyone else in the city who belongs to you? Get them out of here,

verses.textZh: 我们快要毁灭这地方了，因为控告他们的声音在耶和华面前实在很大，所以耶和华派我们来毁灭这地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们快要毁灭这地方了，因为控告他们的声音在耶和华面前实在很大，所以耶和华派我们来毁灭这地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要毁灭这地方；因为城内罪恶的声音在耶和华面前甚大，耶和华差我们来，要毁灭这地方。」
verses.textEnNiv: because we are going to destroy this place. The outcry to the Lord against its people is so great that he has sent us to destroy it."
verses.textEnEsv: For we are about to destroy this place, because the outcry against its people has become great before the Lord , and the Lord has sent us to destroy it."
verses.textEnNkjv: For we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown great before the face of the Lord, and the Lord has sent us to destroy it."
verses.textEnNlt: For we are about to destroy this city completely. The outcry against this place is so great it has reached the Lord , and he has sent us to destroy it."
verses.textEnNasb: for we are about to destroy this place, because their outcry has become so great before the Lord that the Lord has sent us to destroy it."
verses.textEn: because we are going to destroy this place. The outcry to the Lord against its people is so great that he has sent us to destroy it."

verses.textZh: 于是罗得出去，告诉娶了他女儿的女婿说："你们起来离开这地方；因为耶和华就要毁灭这城。"但是他的女婿以为他在开玩笑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是罗得出去，告诉娶了他女儿的女婿说："你们起来离开这地方；因为耶和华就要毁灭这城。"但是他的女婿以为他在开玩笑。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗得就出去，告诉娶了 他女儿的女婿们说：「你们起来离开这地方，因为耶和华要毁灭这城。」他女婿们却以为他说的是戏言。
verses.textEnNiv: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters. He said, "Hurry and get out of this place, because the Lord is about to destroy the city!" But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.
verses.textEnEsv: So Lot went out and said to his sons-in-law, who were to marry his daughters, "Up! Get out of this place, for the Lord is about to destroy the city." But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be jesting.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who had married his daughters, and said, "Get up, get out of this place; for the Lord will destroy this city!" But to his sons-in-law he seemed to be joking.
verses.textEnNlt: So Lot rushed out to tell his daughters’ fiancés, "Quick, get out of the city! The Lord is about to destroy it." But the young men thought he was only joking.
verses.textEnNasb: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were to marry his daughters, and said, "Up, get out of this place, for the Lord is destroying the city." But he appeared to his sons-in-law to be joking.
verses.textEn: So Lot went out and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters. He said, "Hurry and get out of this place, because the Lord is about to destroy the city!" But his sons-in-law thought he was joking.

verses.textZh: 天快亮的时候，两位天使催促罗得说："起来，带你的妻子，和你这里的两个女儿出去，免得你因这城的罪孽被除灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天快亮的时候，两位天使催促罗得说："起来，带你的妻子，和你这里的两个女儿出去，免得你因这城的罪孽被除灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天明了，天使催逼罗得说：「起来！带着你的妻子和你在这里的两个女儿出去，免得你因这城里的罪恶同被剿灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: With the coming of dawn, the angels urged Lot, saying, "Hurry! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away when the city is punished."
verses.textEnEsv: As morning dawned, the angels urged Lot, saying, "Up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be swept away in the punishment of the city."
verses.textEnNkjv: When the morning dawned, the angels urged Lot to hurry, saying, "Arise, take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the punishment of the city."
verses.textEnNlt: At dawn the next morning the angels became insistent. "Hurry," they said to Lot. "Take your wife and your two daughters who are here. Get out right now, or you will be swept away in the destruction of the city!"
verses.textEnNasb: When morning dawned, the angels urged Lot, saying, "Up, take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away in the punishment of the city."
verses.textEn: With the coming of dawn, the angels urged Lot, saying, "Hurry! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, or you will be swept away when the city is punished."

verses.textZh: 罗得还在犹豫不决的时候，二人因为耶和华宽容罗得，就拉着罗得的手，和他妻子的手，以及他两个女儿的手，把他们带出来，安置在城外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗得还在犹豫不决的时候，二人因为耶和华宽容罗得，就拉着罗得的手，和他妻子的手，以及他两个女儿的手，把他们带出来，安置在城外。
verses.textZhCuv: 但罗得迟延不走。二人因为耶和华怜恤罗得，就拉着他的手和他妻子的手，并他两个女儿的手，把他们领出来，安置在城外；
verses.textEnNiv: When he hesitated, the men grasped his hand and the hands of his wife and of his two daughters and led them safely out of the city, for the Lord was merciful to them.
verses.textEnEsv: But he lingered. So the men seized him and his wife and his two daughters by the hand, the Lord being merciful to him, and they brought him out and set him outside the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And while he lingered, the men took hold of his hand, his wife’s hand, and the hands of his two daughters, the Lord being merciful to him, and they brought him out and set him outside the city.
verses.textEnNlt: When Lot still hesitated, the angels seized his hand and the hands of his wife and two daughters and rushed them to safety outside the city, for the Lord was merciful.
verses.textEnNasb: But he hesitated. So the men grasped his hand and the hand of his wife and the hands of his two daughters, because the compassion of the Lordwas upon him; and they brought him out and put him outside the city.
verses.textEn: When he hesitated, the men grasped his hand and the hands of his wife and of his two daughters and led them safely out of the city, for the Lord was merciful to them.

verses.textZh: 二人把他们带出来以后，其中一位说："逃命吧，不要回头看，也不可留在这片平原上，要逃到山上去，免得你被除灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 二人把他们带出来以后，其中一位说："逃命吧，不要回头看，也不可留在这片平原上，要逃到山上去，免得你被除灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 领他们出来以后，就说：「逃命吧！不可回头看，也不可在平原站住。要往山上逃跑，免得你被剿灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as they had brought them out, one of them said, "Flee for your lives! Don’t look back, and don’t stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains or you will be swept away!"
verses.textEnEsv: And as they brought them out, one said, "Escape for your life. Do not look back or stop anywhere in the valley. Escape to the hills, lest you be swept away."
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came to pass, when they had brought them outside, that he said, "Escape for your life! Do not look behind you nor stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be destroyed."
verses.textEnNlt: When they were safely out of the city, one of the angels ordered, "Run for your lives! And don’t look back or stop anywhere in the valley! Escape to the mountains, or you will be swept away!"
verses.textEnNasb: When they had brought them outside, one said, "Escape for your life! Do not look behind you, and do not stay anywhere in the surrounding area; escape to the mountains, or you will be swept away."
verses.textEn: As soon as they had brought them out, one of them said, "Flee for your lives! Don’t look back, and don’t stop anywhere in the plain! Flee to the mountains or you will be swept away!"

verses.textZh: 罗得对他们说："我主啊！请不要这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗得对他们说："我主啊！请不要这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗得对他们说：「我主啊，不要如此！
verses.textEnNiv: But Lot said to them, "No, my lords, please!
verses.textEnEsv: And Lot said to them, "Oh, no, my lords.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Lot said to them, "Please, no, my lords!
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh no, my lord!" Lot begged.
verses.textEnNasb: But Lot said to them, "Oh no, my lords!
verses.textEn: But Lot said to them, "No, my lords, please!

verses.textZh: 看哪，你仆人既然在你眼前蒙恩，你又向我大施慈爱，救活我的性命；可是我还逃不到山上，恐怕这灾祸就追上了我，我就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，你仆人既然在你眼前蒙恩，你又向我大施慈爱，救活我的性命；可是我还逃不到山上，恐怕这灾祸就追上了我，我就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你仆人已经在你眼前蒙恩；你又向我显出莫大的慈爱，救我的性命。我不能逃到山上去，恐怕这灾祸临到我，我便死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Your servant has found favor in your eyes, and you have shown great kindness to me in sparing my life. But I can’t flee to the mountains; this disaster will overtake me, and I’ll die.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have shown me great kindness in saving my life. But I cannot escape to the hills, lest the disaster overtake me and I die.
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have increased your mercy which you have shown me by saving my life; but I cannot escape to the mountains, lest some evil overtake me and I die.
verses.textEnNlt: "You have been so gracious to me and saved my life, and you have shown such great kindness. But I cannot go to the mountains. Disaster would catch up to me there, and I would soon die.
verses.textEnNasb: Now behold, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your compassion, which you have shown me by saving my life; but I cannot escape to the mountains, for the disaster will overtake me and I will die;
verses.textEn: Your servant has found favor in your eyes, and you have shown great kindness to me in sparing my life. But I can’t flee to the mountains; this disaster will overtake me, and I’ll die.

verses.textZh: 看哪，这座城很近，可以逃到那里，那只是一座小城，请让我逃到那里去。那不是一座小城吗？这样我就可以活命了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，这座城很近，可以逃到那里，那只是一座小城，请让我逃到那里去。那不是一座小城吗？这样我就可以活命了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，这座城又小又近，容易逃到，这不是一个小的吗？求你容我逃到那里，我的性命就得存活。」
verses.textEnNiv: Look, here is a town near enough to run to, and it is small. Let me flee to it—it is very small, isn’t it? Then my life will be spared."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, this city is near enough to flee to, and it is a little one. Let me escape there—is it not a little one?—and my life will be saved!"
verses.textEnNkjv: See now, this city is near enough to flee to, and it is a little one; please let me escape there (is it not a little one?) and my soul shall live."
verses.textEnNlt: See, there is a small village nearby. Please let me go there instead; don’t you see how small it is? Then my life will be saved."
verses.textEnNasb: now behold, this town is near enough to flee to, and it is small. Please, let me escape there (is it not small?) so that my life may be saved."
verses.textEn: Look, here is a town near enough to run to, and it is small. Let me flee to it—it is very small, isn’t it? Then my life will be spared."

verses.textZh: 有一位天使对他说："这事我也答应你，你所说的这城，我必不倾覆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一位天使对他说："这事我也答应你，你所说的这城，我必不倾覆。
verses.textZhCuv: 天使对他说：「这事我也应允你；我不倾覆你所说的这城。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to him, "Very well, I will grant this request too; I will not overthrow the town you speak of.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to him, "Behold, I grant you this favor also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to him, "See, I have favored you concerning this thing also, in that I will not overthrow this city for which you have spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," the angel said, "I will grant your request. I will not destroy the little village.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to him, "Behold, I grant you this request also, not to overthrow the town of which you have spoken.
verses.textEn: He said to him, "Very well, I will grant this request too; I will not overthrow the town you speak of.

verses.textZh: 你赶快逃到那里去，因为你还没有到达那里，我就不能作甚么。"因此那城名叫琐珥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你赶快逃到那里去，因为你还没有到达那里，我就不能作甚么。"因此那城名叫琐珥。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要速速地逃到那城；因为你还没有到那里，我不能做什么。」因此那城名叫琐珥 。
verses.textEnNiv: But flee there quickly, because I cannot do anything until you reach it." (That is why the town was called Zoar. )
verses.textEnEsv: Escape there quickly, for I can do nothing till you arrive there." Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hurry, escape there. For I cannot do anything until you arrive there." Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.
verses.textEnNlt: But hurry! Escape to it, for I can do nothing until you arrive there." (This explains why that village was known as Zoar, which means "little place.")
verses.textEnNasb: Hurry, escape there, for I cannot do anything until you arrive there." Therefore the town was named Zoar.
verses.textEn: But flee there quickly, because I cannot do anything until you reach it." (That is why the town was called Zoar. )

verses.textZh: 罗得到达琐珥的时候，太阳已经从地面升上来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗得到达琐珥的时候，太阳已经从地面升上来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗得到了琐珥，日头已经出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: By the time Lot reached Zoar, the sun had risen over the land.
verses.textEnEsv: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sun had risen upon the earth when Lot entered Zoar.
verses.textEnNlt: Lot reached the village just as the sun was rising over the horizon.
verses.textEnNasb: The sun had risen over the earth when Lot came to Zoar.
verses.textEn: By the time Lot reached Zoar, the sun had risen over the land.

verses.textZh: 当时，耶和华就使硫磺与火，从天上耶和华那里降与所多玛和蛾摩拉；
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时，耶和华就使硫磺与火，从天上耶和华那里降与所多玛和蛾摩拉；
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，耶和华将硫磺与火从天上耶和华那里降与所多玛和蛾摩拉，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord rained down burning sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the Lord out of the heavens.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord rained on Sodom and Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the Lord out of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah, from the Lord out of the heavens.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord rained down fire and burning sulfur from the sky on Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord rained brimstone and fire on Sodom and Gomorrah from the Lord out of heaven,
verses.textEn: Then the Lord rained down burning sulfur on Sodom and Gomorrah—from the Lord out of the heavens.

verses.textZh: 把那些城和全平原，以及城中所有的居民，连地上生长的，都毁灭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把那些城和全平原，以及城中所有的居民，连地上生长的，都毁灭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 把那些城和全平原，并城里所有的居民，连地上生长的，都毁灭了。
verses.textEnNiv: Thus he overthrew those cities and the entire plain, destroying all those living in the cities—and also the vegetation in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: And he overthrew those cities, and all the valley, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and what grew on the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and what grew on the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: He utterly destroyed them, along with the other cities and villages of the plain, wiping out all the people and every bit of vegetation.
verses.textEnNasb: and He overthrew those cities, and all the surrounding area, and all the inhabitants of the cities, and what grew on the ground.
verses.textEn: Thus he overthrew those cities and the entire plain, destroying all those living in the cities—and also the vegetation in the land.

verses.textZh: 罗得的妻子在他后面向后一望，就变成了盐柱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗得的妻子在他后面向后一望，就变成了盐柱。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗得的妻子在后边回头一看，就变成了一根盐柱。
verses.textEnNiv: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.textEnEsv: But Lot’s wife, behind him, looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.textEnNkjv: But his wife looked back behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.textEnNlt: But Lot’s wife looked back as she was following behind him, and she turned into a pillar of salt.
verses.textEnNasb: But Lot’s wife, from behind him, looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.
verses.textEn: But Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，到他从前站在耶和华面前的地方，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，到他从前站在耶和华面前的地方，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，到了他从前站在耶和华面前的地方，
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham went early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham went early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham got up early that morning and hurried out to the place where he had stood in the Lord ’s presence.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abraham got up early in the morning and went to the place where he had stood before the Lord;
verses.textEn: Early the next morning Abraham got up and returned to the place where he had stood before the Lord .

verses.textZh: 向所多玛和蛾摩拉，以及平原全地观望。不料，看见那地有烟上升，好象烧窑的烟一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 向所多玛和蛾摩拉，以及平原全地观望。不料，看见那地有烟上升，好象烧窑的烟一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 向所多玛和蛾摩拉与平原的全地观看，不料，那地方烟气上腾，如同烧窑一般。
verses.textEnNiv: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah, toward all the land of the plain, and he saw dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.
verses.textEnEsv: And he looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and toward all the land of the valley, and he looked and, behold, the smoke of the land went up like the smoke of a furnace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain; and he saw, and behold, the smoke of the land which went up like the smoke of a furnace.
verses.textEnNlt: He looked out across the plain toward Sodom and Gomorrah and watched as columns of smoke rose from the cities like smoke from a furnace.
verses.textEnNasb: and he looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the surrounding area; and behold, he saw the smoke of the land ascended like the smoke of a furnace.
verses.textEn: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah, toward all the land of the plain, and he saw dense smoke rising from the land, like smoke from a furnace.

verses.textZh: 神毁灭那平原上的众城，倾覆罗得所住过的众城的时候，神记念亚伯拉罕，把罗得从倾覆中救出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神毁灭那平原上的众城，倾覆罗得所住过的众城的时候，神记念亚伯拉罕，把罗得从倾覆中救出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 当神毁灭平原诸城的时候，他记念亚伯拉罕，正在倾覆罗得所住之城的时候，就打发罗得从倾覆之中出来。
verses.textEnNiv: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, he remembered Abraham, and he brought Lot out of the catastrophe that overthrew the cities where Lot had lived.
verses.textEnEsv: So it was that, when God destroyed the cities of the valley, God remembered Abraham and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow when he overthrew the cities in which Lot had lived.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot had dwelt.
verses.textEnNlt: But God had listened to Abraham’s request and kept Lot safe, removing him from the disaster that engulfed the cities on the plain.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about, when God destroyed the cities of the surrounding area, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the midst of the destruction, when He overthrew the cities in which Lot had lived.
verses.textEn: So when God destroyed the cities of the plain, he remembered Abraham, and he brought Lot out of the catastrophe that overthrew the cities where Lot had lived.

verses.textZh: 罗得因为怕住在琐珥，就与他的两个女儿，一同离开琐珥上了山，住在那里；他和两个女儿住在一个洞里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗得因为怕住在琐珥，就与他的两个女儿，一同离开琐珥上了山，住在那里；他和两个女儿住在一个洞里。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗得因为怕住在琐珥，就同他两个女儿从琐珥上去，住在山里；他和两个女儿住在一个洞里。
verses.textEnNiv: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains, for he was afraid to stay in Zoar. He and his two daughters lived in a cave.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Lot went up out of Zoar and lived in the hills with his two daughters, for he was afraid to live in Zoar. So he lived in a cave with his two daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Lot went up out of Zoar and dwelt in the mountains, and his two daughters were with him; for he was afraid to dwell in Zoar. And he and his two daughters dwelt in a cave.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward Lot left Zoar because he was afraid of the people there, and he went to live in a cave in the mountains with his two daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Lot went up from Zoar with his two daughters and stayed in the mountains, because he was afraid to stay in Zoar; and he stayed in a cave, he and his two daughters.
verses.textEn: Lot and his two daughters left Zoar and settled in the mountains, for he was afraid to stay in Zoar. He and his two daughters lived in a cave.

verses.textZh: 大女儿对小女儿说："我们的爸爸已经老了，这地又没有男人可以按着世上的常规进来与我们亲近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大女儿对小女儿说："我们的爸爸已经老了，这地又没有男人可以按着世上的常规进来与我们亲近。
verses.textZhCuv: 大女儿对小女儿说：「我们的父亲老了，地上又无人按着世上的常规进到我们这里。
verses.textEnNiv: One day the older daughter said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is no man around here to give us children—as is the custom all over the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: And the firstborn said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is not a man on earth to come in to us after the manner of all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the firstborn said to the younger, "Our father is old, and thereis no man on the earth to come in to us as is the custom of all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: One day the older daughter said to her sister, "There are no men left anywhere in this entire area, so we can’t get married like everyone else. And our father will soon be too old to have children.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the firstborn said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is not a man on earth to have relations with us according to the custom of all the earth.
verses.textEn: One day the older daughter said to the younger, "Our father is old, and there is no man around here to give us children—as is the custom all over the earth.

verses.textZh: 来吧，我们可以叫父亲喝酒，然后与他同睡，这样我们可以借着父亲保全后裔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 来吧，我们可以叫父亲喝酒，然后与他同睡，这样我们可以借着父亲保全后裔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 来！我们可以叫父亲喝酒，与他同寝。这样，我们好从他存留后裔。」
verses.textEnNiv: Let’s get our father to drink wine and then sleep with him and preserve our family line through our father."
verses.textEnEsv: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve offspring from our father."
verses.textEnNkjv: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve the lineage of our father."
verses.textEnNlt: Come, let’s get him drunk with wine, and then we will have sex with him. That way we will preserve our family line through our father."
verses.textEnNasb: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and let’s sleep with him so that we may keep our family alive through our father."
verses.textEn: Let’s get our father to drink wine and then sleep with him and preserve our family line through our father."

verses.textZh: 当夜，她们叫父亲喝酒，大女儿就进去与父亲同睡，她甚么时候躺下，甚么时候起来，她父亲都不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当夜，她们叫父亲喝酒，大女儿就进去与父亲同睡，她甚么时候躺下，甚么时候起来，她父亲都不知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，那夜她们叫父亲喝酒，大女儿就进去和她父亲同寝；她几时躺下，几时起来，父亲都不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: That night they got their father to drink wine, and the older daughter went in and slept with him. He was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.
verses.textEnEsv: So they made their father drink wine that night. And the firstborn went in and lay with her father. He did not know when she lay down or when she arose.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they made their father drink wine that night. And the firstborn went in and lay with her father, and he did not know when she lay down or when she arose.
verses.textEnNlt: So that night they got him drunk with wine, and the older daughter went in and had intercourse with her father. He was unaware of her lying down or getting up again.
verses.textEnNasb: So they made their father drink wine that night, and the firstborn went in and slept with her father; and he did not know when she lay down or got up.
verses.textEn: That night they got their father to drink wine, and the older daughter went in and slept with him. He was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.

verses.textZh: 第二天，大女儿对小女儿说："昨夜我与父亲同睡了，今夜我们再叫父亲喝酒，你可以进去与他同睡，这样我们可以借着父亲保全后裔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，大女儿对小女儿说："昨夜我与父亲同睡了，今夜我们再叫父亲喝酒，你可以进去与他同睡，这样我们可以借着父亲保全后裔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 第二天，大女儿对小女儿说：「我昨夜与父亲同寝。今夜我们再叫他喝酒，你可以进去与他同寝。这样，我们好从父亲存留后裔。」
verses.textEnNiv: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, "Last night I slept with my father. Let’s get him to drink wine again tonight, and you go in and sleep with him so we can preserve our family line through our father."
verses.textEnEsv: The next day, the firstborn said to the younger, "Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine tonight also. Then you go in and lie with him, that we may preserve offspring from our father."
verses.textEnNkjv: It happened on the next day that the firstborn said to the younger, "Indeed I lay with my father last night; let us make him drink wine tonight also, and you go in and lie with him, that we may preserve the lineage of our father."
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning the older daughter said to her younger sister, "I had sex with our father last night. Let’s get him drunk with wine again tonight, and you go in and have sex with him. That way we will preserve our family line through our father."
verses.textEnNasb: On the following day, the firstborn said to the younger, "Look, I slept last night with my father; let’s make him drink wine tonight too, then you go in and sleep with him, so that we may keep our family alive through our father."
verses.textEn: The next day the older daughter said to the younger, "Last night I slept with my father. Let’s get him to drink wine again tonight, and you go in and sleep with him so we can preserve our family line through our father."

verses.textZh: 当夜，她们又叫父亲喝酒，小女儿就起来，与父亲同睡；她甚么时候躺下，甚么时候起来，她父亲都不知道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当夜，她们又叫父亲喝酒，小女儿就起来，与父亲同睡；她甚么时候躺下，甚么时候起来，她父亲都不知道。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，那夜她们又叫父亲喝酒，小女儿起来与她父亲同寝；她几时躺下，几时起来，父亲都不知道。
verses.textEnNiv: So they got their father to drink wine that night also, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him. Again he was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.
verses.textEnEsv: So they made their father drink wine that night also. And the younger arose and lay with him, and he did not know when she lay down or when she arose.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they made their father drink wine that night also. And the younger arose and lay with him, and he did not know when she lay down or when she arose.
verses.textEnNlt: So that night they got him drunk with wine again, and the younger daughter went in and had intercourse with him. As before, he was unaware of her lying down or getting up again.
verses.textEnNasb: So they had their father drink wine that night too, and the younger got up and slept with him; and he did not know when she lay down or got up.
verses.textEn: So they got their father to drink wine that night also, and the younger daughter went in and slept with him. Again he was not aware of it when she lay down or when she got up.

verses.textZh: 这样，罗得的两个女儿，都从她们的父亲怀了孕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，罗得的两个女儿，都从她们的父亲怀了孕。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，罗得的两个女儿都从她父亲怀了孕。
verses.textEnNiv: So both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus both the daughters of Lot became pregnant by their father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus both the daughters of Lot were with child by their father.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their own father.
verses.textEnNasb: And so both of the daughters of Lot conceived by their father.
verses.textEn: So both of Lot’s daughters became pregnant by their father.

verses.textZh: 大女儿生了一个儿子，给他起名叫摩押，就是现在摩押人的始祖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大女儿生了一个儿子，给他起名叫摩押，就是现在摩押人的始祖。
verses.textZhCuv: 大女儿生了儿子，给他起名叫摩押，就是现今摩押人的始祖。
verses.textEnNiv: The older daughter had a son, and she named him Moab ; he is the father of the Moabites of today.
verses.textEnEsv: The firstborn bore a son and called his name Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: The firstborn bore a son and called his name Moab; he is the father of the Moabites to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: When the older daughter gave birth to a son, she named him Moab. He became the ancestor of the nation now known as the Moabites.
verses.textEnNasb: The firstborn gave birth to a son, and named him Moab; he is the father of the Moabites to this day.
verses.textEn: The older daughter had a son, and she named him Moab ; he is the father of the Moabites of today.

verses.textZh: 小女儿也生了一个儿子，给他起名叫便．亚米，就是现在亚扪人的始祖。
verses.textZhCnvs: 小女儿也生了一个儿子，给他起名叫便．亚米，就是现在亚扪人的始祖。
verses.textZhCuv: 小女儿也生了儿子，给他起名叫便‧亚米，就是现今亚扪人的始祖。
verses.textEnNiv: The younger daughter also had a son, and she named him Ben-Ammi ; he is the father of the Ammonites of today.
verses.textEnEsv: The younger also bore a son and called his name Ben-ammi. He is the father of the Ammonites to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the younger, she also bore a son and called his name Ben-Ammi; he is the father of the people of Ammon to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: When the younger daughter gave birth to a son, she named him Ben-ammi. He became the ancestor of the nation now known as the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the younger, she also gave birth to a son, and named him Ben-ammi; he is the father of the sons of Ammon to this day.
verses.textEn: The younger daughter also had a son, and she named him Ben-Ammi ; he is the father of the Ammonites of today.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕从那里迁到南地，就住在加低斯和书珥中间。亚伯拉罕寄居在基拉耳的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕从那里迁到南地，就住在加低斯和书珥中间。亚伯拉罕寄居在基拉耳的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕从那里向南地迁去，寄居在加低斯和书珥中间的基拉耳。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Abraham moved on from there into the region of the Negev and lived between Kadesh and Shur. For a while he stayed in Gerar,
verses.textEnEsv: From there Abraham journeyed toward the territory of the Negeb and lived between Kadesh and Shur; and he sojourned in Gerar.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham journeyed from there to the South, and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur, and stayed in Gerar.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham moved south to the Negev and lived for a while between Kadesh and Shur, and then he moved on to Gerar. While living there as a foreigner,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abraham journeyed from there toward the land of the Negev, and settled between Kadesh and Shur; then he lived for a time in Gerar.
verses.textEn: Now Abraham moved on from there into the region of the Negev and lived between Kadesh and Shur. For a while he stayed in Gerar,

verses.textZh: 曾经提到他的妻子撒拉说："她是我的妹妹。"于是基拉耳王亚比米勒派人来把撒拉取了去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 曾经提到他的妻子撒拉说："她是我的妹妹。"于是基拉耳王亚比米勒派人来把撒拉取了去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕称他的妻撒拉为妹子，基拉耳王亚比米勒差人把撒拉取了去。
verses.textEnNiv: and there Abraham said of his wife Sarah, "She is my sister." Then Abimelek king of Gerar sent for Sarah and took her.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, "She is my sister." And Abimelech king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Abraham said of Sarah his wife, "She is my sister." And Abimelech king of Gerar sent and took Sarah.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham introduced his wife, Sarah, by saying, "She is my sister." So King Abimelech of Gerar sent for Sarah and had her brought to him at his palace.
verses.textEnNasb: And Abraham said of his wife Sarah, "She is my sister." So Abimelech king of Gerar sent men and took Sarah.
verses.textEn: and there Abraham said of his wife Sarah, "She is my sister." Then Abimelek king of Gerar sent for Sarah and took her.

verses.textZh: 当夜，神在梦中来到亚比米勒那里，对他说："你该死，因为你接来的那女人，是个有夫之妇。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当夜，神在梦中来到亚比米勒那里，对他说："你该死，因为你接来的那女人，是个有夫之妇。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但夜间，神来，在梦中对亚比米勒说：「你是个死人哪！因为你取了那女人来；她原是别人的妻子。」
verses.textEnNiv: But God came to Abimelek in a dream one night and said to him, "You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken; she is a married woman."
verses.textEnEsv: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night and said to him, "Behold, you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken, for she is a man’s wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, "Indeed you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken, for she is a man’s wife."
verses.textEnNlt: But that night God came to Abimelech in a dream and told him, "You are a dead man, for that woman you have taken is already married!"
verses.textEnNasb: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, "Behold, you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken, for she is married."
verses.textEn: But God came to Abimelek in a dream one night and said to him, "You are as good as dead because of the woman you have taken; she is a married woman."

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒还没有亲近撒拉，所以他说："我主啊，连正义的人你也要杀害吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒还没有亲近撒拉，所以他说："我主啊，连正义的人你也要杀害吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒却还没有亲近撒拉；他说：「主啊，连有义的国，你也要毁灭吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Now Abimelek had not gone near her, so he said, "Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation?
verses.textEnEsv: Now Abimelech had not approached her. So he said, "Lord, will you kill an innocent people?
verses.textEnNkjv: But Abimelech had not come near her; and he said, "Lord, will You slay a righteous nation also?
verses.textEnNlt: But Abimelech had not slept with her yet, so he said, "Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation?
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abimelech had not come near her; and he said, "Lord, will You kill a nation, even though blameless?
verses.textEn: Now Abimelek had not gone near her, so he said, "Lord, will you destroy an innocent nation?

verses.textZh: 那人岂不是自己对我说：‘她是我的妹妹’吗？就是那女人自己也说：‘他是我的哥哥’。我作这事，是手洁心清的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人岂不是自己对我说：‘她是我的妹妹’吗？就是那女人自己也说：‘他是我的哥哥’。我作这事，是手洁心清的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人岂不是自己对我说『她是我的妹子』吗？就是女人也自己说：『他是我的哥哥。』我做这事是心正手洁的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Did he not say to me, ‘She is my sister,’ and didn’t she also say, ‘He is my brother’? I have done this with a clear conscience and clean hands."
verses.textEnEsv: Did he not himself say to me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands I have done this."
verses.textEnNkjv: Did he not say to me, ‘She is my sister’? And she, even she herself said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and innocence of my hands I have done this."
verses.textEnNlt: Didn’t Abraham tell me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself said, ‘Yes, he is my brother.’ I acted in complete innocence! My hands are clean."
verses.textEnNasb: Did he himself not say to me, ‘She is my sister’? And she herself said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands I have done this."
verses.textEn: Did he not say to me, ‘She is my sister,’ and didn’t she also say, ‘He is my brother’? I have done this with a clear conscience and clean hands."

verses.textZh: 神在梦中对他说："我也知道你作这事，是问心无愧的，所以我也阻止你，免得你得罪我。因此我不容许你接触她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在梦中对他说："我也知道你作这事，是问心无愧的，所以我也阻止你，免得你得罪我。因此我不容许你接触她。
verses.textZhCuv: 神在梦中对他说：「我知道你做这事是心中正直；我也拦阻了你，免得你得罪我，所以我不容你沾着她。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said to him in the dream, "Yes, I know you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against me. That is why I did not let you touch her.
verses.textEnEsv: Then God said to him in the dream, "Yes, I know that you have done this in the integrity of your heart, and it was I who kept you from sinning against me. Therefore I did not let you touch her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God said to him in a dream, "Yes, I know that you did this in the integrity of your heart. For I also withheld you from sinning against Me; therefore I did not let you touch her.
verses.textEnNlt: In the dream God responded, "Yes, I know you are innocent. That’s why I kept you from sinning against me, and why I did not let you touch her.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said to him in the dream, "Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also kept you from sinning against Me; therefore I did not let you touch her.
verses.textEn: Then God said to him in the dream, "Yes, I know you did this with a clear conscience, and so I have kept you from sinning against me. That is why I did not let you touch her.

verses.textZh: 现在你要把那人的妻子还给他，因为他是先知，他要为你祷告，你才可以存活。你若不还给他，你当知道，你和所有属你的，都死定了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要把那人的妻子还给他，因为他是先知，他要为你祷告，你才可以存活。你若不还给他，你当知道，你和所有属你的，都死定了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你把这人的妻子归还他；因为他是先知，他要为你祷告，使你存活。你若不归还他，你当知道，你和你所有的人都必要死。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not return her, you may be sure that you and all who belong to you will die."
verses.textEnEsv: Now then, return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet, so that he will pray for you, and you shall live. But if you do not return her, know that you shall surely die, you and all who are yours."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife; for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you shall live. But if you do not restore her, know that you shall surely die, you and all who are yours."
verses.textEnNlt: Now return the woman to her husband, and he will pray for you, for he is a prophet. Then you will live. But if you don’t return her to him, you can be sure that you and all your people will die."
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not return her, know that you will certainly die, you and all who are yours."
verses.textEn: Now return the man’s wife, for he is a prophet, and he will pray for you and you will live. But if you do not return her, you may be sure that you and all who belong to you will die."

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒清早起来，召了他的众臣仆来，把这一切都说给他们听，以致他们都很惧怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒清早起来，召了他的众臣仆来，把这一切都说给他们听，以致他们都很惧怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒清早起来，召了众臣仆来，将这些事都说给他们听，他们都甚惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning Abimelek summoned all his officials, and when he told them all that had happened, they were very much afraid.
verses.textEnEsv: So Abimelech rose early in the morning and called all his servants and told them all these things. And the men were very much afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abimelech rose early in the morning, called all his servants, and told all these things in their hearing; and the men were very much afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: Abimelech got up early the next morning and quickly called all his servants together. When he told them what had happened, his men were terrified.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abimelech got up early in the morning and called all his servants, and told all these things in their presence; and the people were greatly frightened.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning Abimelek summoned all his officials, and when he told them all that had happened, they were very much afraid.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒把亚伯拉罕召了来，对他说："你为甚么向我们这样行呢？我在甚么事上得罪了你，以致你给我和我的国带来这个大罪呢？你对我作了不应该作的事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒把亚伯拉罕召了来，对他说："你为甚么向我们这样行呢？我在甚么事上得罪了你，以致你给我和我的国带来这个大罪呢？你对我作了不应该作的事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒召了亚伯拉罕来，对他说：「你怎么向我这样行呢？我在什么事上得罪了你，你竟使我和我国里的人陷在大罪里？你向我行不当行的事了！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abimelek called Abraham in and said, "What have you done to us? How have I wronged you that you have brought such great guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should never be done."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, "What have you done to us? And how have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and my kingdom a great sin? You have done to me things that ought not to be done."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, "What have you done to us? How have I offended you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abimelech called for Abraham. "What have you done to us?" he demanded. "What crime have I committed that deserves treatment like this, making me and my kingdom guilty of this great sin? No one should ever do what you have done!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abimelech called Abraham and said to him, "What have you done to us? And how have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done to me things that ought not to be done."
verses.textEn: Then Abimelek called Abraham in and said, "What have you done to us? How have I wronged you that you have brought such great guilt upon me and my kingdom? You have done things to me that should never be done."

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒又对亚伯拉罕说："你为了甚么缘故要这样作呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒又对亚伯拉罕说："你为了甚么缘故要这样作呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒又对亚伯拉罕说：「你见了什么才做这事呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: And Abimelek asked Abraham, "What was your reason for doing this?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Abimelech said to Abraham, "What did you see, that you did this thing?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech said to Abraham, "What did you have in view, that you have done this thing?"
verses.textEnNlt: Whatever possessed you to do such a thing?"
verses.textEnNasb: And Abimelech said to Abraham, "What have you encountered, that you have done this thing?"
verses.textEn: And Abimelek asked Abraham, "What was your reason for doing this?"

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕回答："因为我以为这地方必定没有敬畏神的人，他们会因我妻子的缘故杀我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕回答："因为我以为这地方必定没有敬畏神的人，他们会因我妻子的缘故杀我。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕说：「我以为这地方的人总不惧怕神，必为我妻子的缘故杀我。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham replied, "I said to myself, ‘There is surely no fear of God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.’
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham said, "I did it because I thought, ‘There is no fear of God at all in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham said, "Because I thought, surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will kill me on account of my wife.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham replied, "I thought, ‘This is a godless place. They will want my wife and will kill me to get her.’
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham said, "Because I thought, surely there is no fear of God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.
verses.textEn: Abraham replied, "I said to myself, ‘There is surely no fear of God in this place, and they will kill me because of my wife.’

verses.textZh: 何况她也实在是我的妹妹；她原是我同父异母的妹妹，后来作了我的妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 何况她也实在是我的妹妹；她原是我同父异母的妹妹，后来作了我的妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 况且她也实在是我的妹子；她与我是同父异母，后来作了我的妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father though not of my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.textEnEsv: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father though not the daughter of my mother, and she became my wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: But indeed sheis truly my sister. She is the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.
verses.textEnNlt: And she really is my sister, for we both have the same father, but different mothers. And I married her.
verses.textEnNasb: Besides, she actually is my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife;
verses.textEn: Besides, she really is my sister, the daughter of my father though not of my mother; and she became my wife.

verses.textZh: 神叫我离开我父家，在外飘流的时候，我对她说：‘我们无论到甚么地方去，你都要对人说："他是我的哥哥。"这就是你待我的恩情了。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神叫我离开我父家，在外飘流的时候，我对她说：‘我们无论到甚么地方去，你都要对人说："他是我的哥哥。"这就是你待我的恩情了。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 当神叫我离开父家、飘流在外的时候，我对她说：『我们无论走到什么地方，你可以对人说：他是我的哥哥；这就是你待我的恩典了。』」
verses.textEnNiv: And when God had me wander from my father’s household, I said to her, ‘This is how you can show your love to me: Everywhere we go, say of me, "He is my brother." ’ "
verses.textEnEsv: And when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is the kindness you must do me: at every place to which we come, say of me, "He is my brother."’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said to her, ‘This is your kindness that you should do for me: in every place, wherever we go, say of me, "He is my brother." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: When God called me to leave my father’s home and to travel from place to place, I told her, ‘Do me a favor. Wherever we go, tell the people that I am your brother.’"
verses.textEnNasb: and it came about, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said to her, ‘This is the kindness which you will show to me: everywhere we go, say of me, "He is my brother." ’ "
verses.textEn: And when God had me wander from my father’s household, I said to her, ‘This is how you can show your love to me: Everywhere we go, say of me, "He is my brother." ’ "

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒取了些牛羊、仆婢，送给亚伯拉罕，又把亚伯拉罕的妻子撒拉还给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒取了些牛羊、仆婢，送给亚伯拉罕，又把亚伯拉罕的妻子撒拉还给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒把牛、羊、仆婢赐给亚伯拉罕，又把他的妻子撒拉归还他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abimelek brought sheep and cattle and male and female slaves and gave them to Abraham, and he returned Sarah his wife to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and returned Sarah his wife to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech took sheep, oxen, and male and female servants, and gave them to Abraham; and he restored Sarah his wife to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abimelech took some of his sheep and goats, cattle, and male and female servants, and he presented them to Abraham. He also returned his wife, Sarah, to him.
verses.textEnNasb: Abimelech then took sheep and oxen and male and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and returned his wife Sarah to him.
verses.textEn: Then Abimelek brought sheep and cattle and male and female slaves and gave them to Abraham, and he returned Sarah his wife to him.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒说："看哪，我的国土都在你面前，你喜欢哪里，就住在哪里吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒说："看哪，我的国土都在你面前，你喜欢哪里，就住在哪里吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒又说：「看哪，我的地都在你面前，你可以随意居住」；
verses.textEnNiv: And Abimelek said, "My land is before you; live wherever you like."
verses.textEnEsv: And Abimelech said, "Behold, my land is before you; dwell where it pleases you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abimelech said, "See, my land is before you; dwell where it pleases you."
