verses.textEnNlt: Then Abimelech said, "Look over my land and choose any place where you would like to live."
verses.textEnNasb: Abimelech said, "Behold, my land is before you; settle wherever you please."
verses.textEn: And Abimelek said, "My land is before you; live wherever you like."

verses.textZh: 他又对撒拉说："看哪，我给了你哥哥一千银子，作你在全家人面前的遮羞钱 。这样，你在众人面前就算清白了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对撒拉说："看哪，我给了你哥哥一千银子，作你在全家人面前的遮羞钱 。这样，你在众人面前就算清白了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又对撒拉说：「我给你哥哥一千银子，作为你在合家人面前遮羞的 ，你就在众人面前没有不是了。」
verses.textEnNiv: To Sarah he said, "I am giving your brother a thousand shekels of silver. This is to cover the offense against you before all who are with you; you are completely vindicated."
verses.textEnEsv: To Sarah he said, "Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. It is a sign of your innocence in the eyes of all who are with you, and before everyone you are vindicated."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then to Sarah he said, "Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver; indeed this vindicates you before all who are with you and before everybody." Thus she was rebuked.
verses.textEnNlt: And he said to Sarah, "Look, I am giving your ‘brother’ 1,000 pieces of silver in the presence of all these witnesses. This is to compensate you for any wrong I may have done to you. This will settle any claim against me, and your reputation is cleared."
verses.textEnNasb: To Sarah he said, "Look, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. It is your vindication before all who are with you, and before everyone you are cleared."
verses.textEn: To Sarah he said, "I am giving your brother a thousand shekels of silver. This is to cover the offense against you before all who are with you; you are completely vindicated."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕祷告神，神就医好了亚比米勒和他的妻子，以及他的众婢女，使她们能生育。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕祷告神，神就医好了亚比米勒和他的妻子，以及他的众婢女，使她们能生育。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕祷告神，神就医好了亚比米勒和他的妻子，并他的众女仆，她们便能生育。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek, his wife and his female slaves so they could have children again,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, and also healed his wife and female slaves so that they bore children.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abraham prayed to God; and God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants. Then they bore children;
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, so they could have children.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelech and his wife and his female slaves, so that they gave birth to children.
verses.textEn: Then Abraham prayed to God, and God healed Abimelek, his wife and his female slaves so they could have children again,

verses.textZh: 因为耶和华为了亚伯拉罕妻子撒拉的缘故，曾经使亚比米勒家中所有的妇女，都不能生育。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为耶和华为了亚伯拉罕妻子撒拉的缘故，曾经使亚比米勒家中所有的妇女，都不能生育。
verses.textZhCuv: 因耶和华为亚伯拉罕的妻子撒拉的缘故，已经使亚比米勒家中的妇人不能生育。
verses.textEnNiv: for the Lord had kept all the women in Abimelek’s household from conceiving because of Abraham’s wife Sarah.
verses.textEnEsv: For the Lord had closed all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: for the Lord had closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord had caused all the women to be infertile because of what happened with Abraham’s wife, Sarah.
verses.textEnNasb: For the Lord had completely closed all the wombs of the household of Abimelech because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.
verses.textEn: for the Lord had kept all the women in Abimelek’s household from conceiving because of Abraham’s wife Sarah.

verses.textZh: 耶和华照着以前所说的，眷顾撒拉；耶和华按着他的应许，给撒拉作成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华照着以前所说的，眷顾撒拉；耶和华按着他的应许，给撒拉作成。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华按着先前的话眷顾撒拉，便照他所说的给撒拉成就。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Lord was gracious to Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did for Sarah what he had promised.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord visited Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did to Sarah as he had promised.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord visited Sarah as He had said, and the Lord did for Sarah as He had spoken.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord kept his word and did for Sarah exactly what he had promised.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord took note of Sarah as He had said, and the Lord did for Sarah as He had promised.
verses.textEn: Now the Lord was gracious to Sarah as he had said, and the Lord did for Sarah what he had promised.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕年老的时候，撒拉怀了孕，到了神应许的日期，就给亚伯拉罕生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕年老的时候，撒拉怀了孕，到了神应许的日期，就给亚伯拉罕生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 当亚伯拉罕年老的时候，撒拉怀了孕；到神所说的日期，就给亚伯拉罕生了一个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Sarah became pregnant and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age at the time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Sarah conceived and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.textEnNlt: She became pregnant, and she gave birth to a son for Abraham in his old age. This happened at just the time God had said it would.
verses.textEnNasb: So Sarah conceived and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the appointed time of which God had spoken to him.
verses.textEn: Sarah became pregnant and bore a son to Abraham in his old age, at the very time God had promised him.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕给撒拉为他所生的儿子，起名叫以撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕给撒拉为他所生的儿子，起名叫以撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕给撒拉所生的儿子起名叫以撒。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore him.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham called the name of his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore him, Isaac.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham called the name of his son who was born to him—whom Sarah bore to him— Isaac.
verses.textEnNlt: And Abraham named their son Isaac.
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham named his son who was born to him, the son whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.
verses.textEn: Abraham gave the name Isaac to the son Sarah bore him.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕的儿子以撒生下来第八天，亚伯拉罕就照着神吩咐他的，给以撒行了割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕的儿子以撒生下来第八天，亚伯拉罕就照着神吩咐他的，给以撒行了割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒生下来第八日，亚伯拉罕照着神所吩咐的，给以撒行了割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God commanded him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.textEnNlt: Eight days after Isaac was born, Abraham circumcised him as God had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abraham circumcised his son Isaac when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.
verses.textEn: When his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, as God commanded him.

verses.textZh: 他儿子以撒出生的时候，亚伯拉罕正一百岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他儿子以撒出生的时候，亚伯拉罕正一百岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 他儿子以撒生的时候，亚伯拉罕年一百岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Abraham was one hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham was 100 years old when Isaac was born.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.
verses.textEn: Abraham was a hundred years old when his son Isaac was born to him.

verses.textZh: 撒拉说："神使我欢笑，凡听见的，也必为我欢笑。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒拉说："神使我欢笑，凡听见的，也必为我欢笑。"
verses.textZhCuv: 撒拉说：「神使我喜笑，凡听见的必与我一同喜笑」；
verses.textEnNiv: Sarah said, "God has brought me laughter, and everyone who hears about this will laugh with me."
verses.textEnEsv: And Sarah said, "God has made laughter for me; everyone who hears will laugh over me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Sarah said, "God has made me laugh, and all who hear will laugh with me."
verses.textEnNlt: And Sarah declared, "God has brought me laughter. All who hear about this will laugh with me.
verses.textEnNasb: Sarah said, "God has made laughter for me; everyone who hears will laugh with me."
verses.textEn: Sarah said, "God has brought me laughter, and everyone who hears about this will laugh with me."

verses.textZh: 又说："谁能告诉亚伯拉罕，撒拉要乳养儿女呢？在他年老的时候，我竟给他生了一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说："谁能告诉亚伯拉罕，撒拉要乳养儿女呢？在他年老的时候，我竟给他生了一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「谁能预先对亚伯拉罕说『撒拉要乳养婴孩』呢？因为在他年老的时候，我给他生了一个儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: And she added, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age."
verses.textEnEsv: And she said, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age."
verses.textEnNkjv: She also said, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age."
verses.textEnNlt: Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse a baby? Yet I have given Abraham a son in his old age!"
verses.textEnNasb: And she said, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have given birth to a son in his old age."
verses.textEn: And she added, "Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? Yet I have borne him a son in his old age."

verses.textZh: 孩子渐渐长大，就断了奶。以撒断奶的那天，亚伯拉罕摆设盛大的筵席。
verses.textZhCnvs: 孩子渐渐长大，就断了奶。以撒断奶的那天，亚伯拉罕摆设盛大的筵席。
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子渐长，就断了奶。以撒断奶的日子，亚伯拉罕设摆丰盛的筵席。
verses.textEnNiv: The child grew and was weaned, and on the day Isaac was weaned Abraham held a great feast.
verses.textEnEsv: And the child grew and was weaned. And Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the child grew and was weaned. And Abraham made a great feast on the same day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.textEnNlt: When Isaac grew up and was about to be weaned, Abraham prepared a huge feast to celebrate the occasion.
verses.textEnNasb: And the child grew and was weaned, and Abraham held a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.textEn: The child grew and was weaned, and on the day Isaac was weaned Abraham held a great feast.

verses.textZh: 撒拉看见那埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子在嬉戏，
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒拉看见那埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子在嬉戏，
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，撒拉看见埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子戏笑，
verses.textEnNiv: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking,
verses.textEnEsv: But Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, laughing.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, scoffing.
verses.textEnNlt: But Sarah saw Ishmael—the son of Abraham and her Egyptian servant Hagar—making fun of her son, Isaac.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking Isaac.
verses.textEn: But Sarah saw that the son whom Hagar the Egyptian had borne to Abraham was mocking,

verses.textZh: 就对亚伯拉罕说："把这婢女和她的儿子赶出去，因为这婢女的儿子不能和我的儿子以撒一同承受产业。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就对亚伯拉罕说："把这婢女和她的儿子赶出去，因为这婢女的儿子不能和我的儿子以撒一同承受产业。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就对亚伯拉罕说：「你把这使女和她儿子赶出去！因为这使女的儿子不可与我的儿子以撒一同承受产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: and she said to Abraham, "Get rid of that slave woman and her son, for that woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac."
verses.textEnEsv: So she said to Abraham, "Cast out this slave woman with her son, for the son of this slave woman shall not be heir with my son Isaac."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore she said to Abraham, "Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, namely with Isaac."
verses.textEnNlt: So she turned to Abraham and demanded, "Get rid of that slave woman and her son. He is not going to share the inheritance with my son, Isaac. I won’t have it!"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore she said to Abraham, "Drive out this slave woman and her son, for the son of this slave woman shall not be an heir with my son Isaac!"
verses.textEn: and she said to Abraham, "Get rid of that slave woman and her son, for that woman’s son will never share in the inheritance with my son Isaac."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕因他的儿子而非常烦恼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕因他的儿子而非常烦恼。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕因他儿子的缘故很忧愁。
verses.textEnNiv: The matter distressed Abraham greatly because it concerned his son.
verses.textEnEsv: And the thing was very displeasing to Abraham on account of his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the matter was very displeasing in Abraham’s sight because of his son.
verses.textEnNlt: This upset Abraham very much because Ishmael was his son.
verses.textEnNasb: The matter distressed Abraham greatly because of his son Ishmael.
verses.textEn: The matter distressed Abraham greatly because it concerned his son.

verses.textZh: 神对亚伯拉罕说："不要因这童子和你的婢女而烦恼。撒拉对你说的话，你都要听从；因为以撒生的，才可以称为你的后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对亚伯拉罕说："不要因这童子和你的婢女而烦恼。撒拉对你说的话，你都要听从；因为以撒生的，才可以称为你的后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 神对亚伯拉罕说：「你不必为这童子和你的使女忧愁。凡撒拉对你说的话，你都该听从；因为从以撒生的，才要称为你的后裔。
verses.textEnNiv: But God said to him, "Do not be so distressed about the boy and your slave woman. Listen to whatever Sarah tells you, because it is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.
verses.textEnEsv: But God said to Abraham, "Be not displeased because of the boy and because of your slave woman. Whatever Sarah says to you, do as she tells you, for through Isaac shall your offspring be named.
verses.textEnNkjv: But God said to Abraham, "Do not let it be displeasing in your sight because of the lad or because of your bondwoman. Whatever Sarah has said to you, listen to her voice; for in Isaac your seed shall be called.
verses.textEnNlt: But God told Abraham, "Do not be upset over the boy and your servant. Do whatever Sarah tells you, for Isaac is the son through whom your descendants will be counted.
verses.textEnNasb: But God said to Abraham, " Do not be distressed because of the boy and your slave woman; whatever Sarah tells you, listen to her, for through Isaac your descendants shall be named.
verses.textEn: But God said to him, "Do not be so distressed about the boy and your slave woman. Listen to whatever Sarah tells you, because it is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned.

verses.textZh: 至于这婢女的儿子，我也要使他成为一国，因为他是你的后裔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于这婢女的儿子，我也要使他成为一国，因为他是你的后裔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于使女的儿子，我也必使他的后裔成立一国，因为他是你所生的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will make the son of the slave into a nation also, because he is your offspring."
verses.textEnEsv: And I will make a nation of the son of the slave woman also, because he is your offspring."
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I will also make a nation of the son of the bondwoman, because he is your seed."
verses.textEnNlt: But I will also make a nation of the descendants of Hagar’s son because he is your son, too."
verses.textEnNasb: And of the son of the slave woman I will make a nation also, because he is your descendant."
verses.textEn: I will make the son of the slave into a nation also, because he is your offspring."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，拿饼和一皮袋水，给了夏甲，放在她的肩膀上，又把孩子交给她，就打发她离开。夏甲走了，在别是巴的旷野飘荡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，拿饼和一皮袋水，给了夏甲，放在她的肩膀上，又把孩子交给她，就打发她离开。夏甲走了，在别是巴的旷野飘荡。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，拿饼和一皮袋水，给了夏甲，搭在她的肩上，又把孩子交给她，打发她走。夏甲就走了，在别是巴的旷野走迷了路。
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning Abraham took some food and a skin of water and gave them to Hagar. He set them on her shoulders and then sent her off with the boy. She went on her way and wandered in the Desert of Beersheba.
verses.textEnEsv: So Abraham rose early in the morning and took bread and a skin of water and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder, along with the child, and sent her away. And she departed and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abraham rose early in the morning, and took bread and a skin of water; and putting it on her shoulder, he gave it and the boy to Hagar, and sent her away. Then she departed and wandered in the Wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abraham got up early the next morning, prepared food and a container of water, and strapped them on Hagar’s shoulders. Then he sent her away with their son, and she wandered aimlessly in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abraham got up early in the morning and took bread and a skin of water, and gave them to Hagar, putting them on her shoulder, and gave her the boy, and sent her away. And she departed and wandered about in the wilderness of Beersheba.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning Abraham took some food and a skin of water and gave them to Hagar. He set them on her shoulders and then sent her off with the boy. She went on her way and wandered in the Desert of Beersheba.

verses.textZh: 皮袋里的水用尽了，夏甲就把孩子撇在一棵小树底下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 皮袋里的水用尽了，夏甲就把孩子撇在一棵小树底下。
verses.textZhCuv: 皮袋的水用尽了，夏甲就把孩子撇在小树底下，
verses.textEnNiv: When the water in the skin was gone, she put the boy under one of the bushes.
verses.textEnEsv: When the water in the skin was gone, she put the child under one of the bushes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the water in the skin was used up, and she placed the boy under one of the shrubs.
verses.textEnNlt: When the water was gone, she put the boy in the shade of a bush.
verses.textEnNasb: When the water in the skin was used up, she left the boy under one of the bushes.
verses.textEn: When the water in the skin was gone, she put the boy under one of the bushes.

verses.textZh: 然后自己走开，在离开约有一箭之远的地方，相对而坐，说："我不忍眼看孩子死去。"就相对坐着，放声大哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后自己走开，在离开约有一箭之远的地方，相对而坐，说："我不忍眼看孩子死去。"就相对坐着，放声大哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 自己走开约有一箭之远，相对而坐，说：「我不忍见孩子死」，就相对而坐，放声大哭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then she went off and sat down about a bowshot away, for she thought, "I cannot watch the boy die." And as she sat there, she began to sob.
verses.textEnEsv: Then she went and sat down opposite him a good way off, about the distance of a bowshot, for she said, "Let me not look on the death of the child." And as she sat opposite him, she lifted up her voice and wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she went and sat down across from him at a distance of about a bowshot; for she said to herself, "Let me not see the death of the boy." So she sat opposite him, and lifted her voice and wept.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she went and sat down by herself about a hundred yards away. "I don’t want to watch the boy die," she said, as she burst into tears.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she went and sat down opposite him, about a bowshot away, for she said, "May I not see the boy die!" And she sat opposite him, and raised her voice and wept.
verses.textEn: Then she went off and sat down about a bowshot away, for she thought, "I cannot watch the boy die." And as she sat there, she began to sob.

verses.textZh: 神听见了童子的声音，他的使者就从天上呼叫夏甲，对她说："夏甲啊，你为甚么这样呢？不要害怕，因为孩子在那里所发的声音神已经听见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神听见了童子的声音，他的使者就从天上呼叫夏甲，对她说："夏甲啊，你为甚么这样呢？不要害怕，因为孩子在那里所发的声音神已经听见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神听见童子的声音；神的使者从天上呼叫夏甲说：「夏甲，你为何这样呢？不要害怕，神已经听见童子的声音了。
verses.textEnNiv: God heard the boy crying, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, "What is the matter, Hagar? Do not be afraid; God has heard the boy crying as he lies there.
verses.textEnEsv: And God heard the voice of the boy, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, "What troubles you, Hagar? Fear not, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God heard the voice of the lad. Then the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said to her, "What ails you, Hagar? Fear not, for God has heard the voice of the lad where he is.
verses.textEnNlt: But God heard the boy crying, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven, "Hagar, what’s wrong? Do not be afraid! God has heard the boy crying as he lies there.
verses.textEnNasb: God heard the boy crying; and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, " What is the matter with you, Hagar? Do not fear, for God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.
verses.textEn: God heard the boy crying, and the angel of God called to Hagar from heaven and said to her, "What is the matter, Hagar? Do not be afraid; God has heard the boy crying as he lies there.

verses.textZh: 起来，扶起孩子，尽力保护他；因为我要使他成为大国。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 起来，扶起孩子，尽力保护他；因为我要使他成为大国。"
verses.textZhCuv: 起来！把童子抱在怀中 ，我必使他的后裔成为大国。」
verses.textEnNiv: Lift the boy up and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation."
verses.textEnEsv: Up! Lift up the boy, and hold him fast with your hand, for I will make him into a great nation."
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, lift up the lad and hold him with your hand, for I will make him a great nation."
verses.textEnNlt: Go to him and comfort him, for I will make a great nation from his descendants."
verses.textEnNasb: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him by the hand, for I will make a great nation of him."
verses.textEn: Lift the boy up and take him by the hand, for I will make him into a great nation."

verses.textZh: 神开了夏甲的眼睛，她就看见一口水井。她去把皮袋盛满了水，就给孩子喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神开了夏甲的眼睛，她就看见一口水井。她去把皮袋盛满了水，就给孩子喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 神使夏甲的眼睛明亮，她就看见一口水井，便去将皮袋盛满了水，给童子喝。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
verses.textEnEsv: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. And she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. And she went and filled the skin with water, and gave the lad a drink.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God opened Hagar’s eyes, and she saw a well full of water. She quickly filled her water container and gave the boy a drink.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water; and she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.
verses.textEn: Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink.

verses.textZh: 神与孩子同在，他渐渐长大，住在旷野，成了个弓箭手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神与孩子同在，他渐渐长大，住在旷野，成了个弓箭手。
verses.textZhCuv: 神保佑童子，他就渐长，住在旷野，成了弓箭手。
verses.textEnNiv: God was with the boy as he grew up. He lived in the desert and became an archer.
verses.textEnEsv: And God was with the boy, and he grew up. He lived in the wilderness and became an expert with the bow.
verses.textEnNkjv: So God was with the lad; and he grew and dwelt in the wilderness, and became an archer.
verses.textEnNlt: And God was with the boy as he grew up in the wilderness. He became a skillful archer,
verses.textEnNasb: And God was with the boy, and he grew; and he lived in the wilderness and became an archer.
verses.textEn: God was with the boy as he grew up. He lived in the desert and became an archer.

verses.textZh: 他住在巴兰的旷野，他的母亲从埃及地给他娶了一个妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他住在巴兰的旷野，他的母亲从埃及地给他娶了一个妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他住在巴兰的旷野；他母亲从埃及地给他娶了一个妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: While he was living in the Desert of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: He lived in the wilderness of Paran, and his mother took a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: He dwelt in the Wilderness of Paran; and his mother took a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: and he settled in the wilderness of Paran. His mother arranged for him to marry a woman from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: He lived in the wilderness of Paran, and his mother took a wife for him from the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: While he was living in the Desert of Paran, his mother got a wife for him from Egypt.

verses.textZh: 那时，亚比米勒和他的军长非各对亚伯拉罕说："在你所作的一切事上，神都与你同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，亚比米勒和他的军长非各对亚伯拉罕说："在你所作的一切事上，神都与你同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那时候，亚比米勒同他军长非各对亚伯拉罕说：「凡你所行的事都有神的保佑。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces said to Abraham, "God is with you in everything you do.
verses.textEnEsv: At that time Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army said to Abraham, "God is with you in all that you do.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass at that time that Abimelech and Phichol, the commander of his army, spoke to Abraham, saying, "God is with you in all that you do.
verses.textEnNlt: About this time, Abimelech came with Phicol, his army commander, to visit Abraham. "God is obviously with you, helping you in everything you do," Abimelech said.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about at that time that Abimelech and Phicol, the commander of his army, spoke to Abraham, saying, "God is with you in all that you do;
verses.textEn: At that time Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces said to Abraham, "God is with you in everything you do.

verses.textZh: 现在你要在这里指着神对我起誓，你不会以诡诈待我和我的子子孙孙。我怎样恩待了你，你也要怎样恩待我和你寄居的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你要在这里指着神对我起誓，你不会以诡诈待我和我的子子孙孙。我怎样恩待了你，你也要怎样恩待我和你寄居的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我愿你如今在这里指着神对我起誓，不要欺负我与我的儿子，并我的子孙。我怎样厚待了你，你也要照样厚待我与你所寄居这地的民。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or my descendants. Show to me and the country where you now reside as a foreigner the same kindness I have shown to you."
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me or with my descendants or with my posterity, but as I have dealt kindly with you, so you will deal with me and with the land where you have sojourned."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, swear to me by God that you will not deal falsely with me, with my offspring, or with my posterity; but that according to the kindness that I have done to you, you will do to me and to the land in which you have dwelt."
verses.textEnNlt: "Swear to me in God’s name that you will never deceive me, my children, or any of my descendants. I have been loyal to you, so now swear that you will be loyal to me and to this country where you are living as a foreigner."
verses.textEnNasb: so now, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me or with my offspring or with my descendants, but according to the kindness that I have shown to you, you shall show to me and to the land in which you have resided."
verses.textEn: Now swear to me here before God that you will not deal falsely with me or my children or my descendants. Show to me and the country where you now reside as a foreigner the same kindness I have shown to you."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕回答："我愿意起誓。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕回答："我愿意起誓。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕说：「我情愿起誓。」
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham said, "I swear it."
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham said, "I will swear."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham said, "I will swear."
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham replied, "Yes, I swear to it!"
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham said, "I swear it."
verses.textEn: Abraham said, "I swear it."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕因亚比米勒的仆人强占了一口水井，就指责亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕因亚比米勒的仆人强占了一口水井，就指责亚比米勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前，亚比米勒的仆人霸占了一口水井，亚伯拉罕为这事指责亚比米勒。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abraham complained to Abimelek about a well of water that Abimelek’s servants had seized.
verses.textEnEsv: When Abraham reproved Abimelech about a well of water that Abimelech’s servants had seized,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abraham rebuked Abimelech because of a well of water which Abimelech’s servants had seized.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well that Abimelech’s servants had taken by force from Abraham’s servants.
verses.textEnNasb: But Abraham complained to Abimelech because of the well of water which the servants of Abimelech had seized.
verses.textEn: Then Abraham complained to Abimelek about a well of water that Abimelek’s servants had seized.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒说："谁作了这事，我不知道，你也没有告诉我；我现在才听见。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒说："谁作了这事，我不知道，你也没有告诉我；我现在才听见。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒说：「谁做这事，我不知道，你也没有告诉我，今日我才听见了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Abimelek said, "I don’t know who has done this. You did not tell me, and I heard about it only today."
verses.textEnEsv: Abimelech said, "I do not know who has done this thing; you did not tell me, and I have not heard of it until today."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abimelech said, "I do not know who has done this thing; you did not tell me, nor had I heard ofit until today."
verses.textEnNlt: "This is the first I’ve heard of it," Abimelech answered. "I have no idea who is responsible. You have never complained about this before."
verses.textEnNasb: And Abimelech said, "I do not know who has done this thing; you did not tell me, nor did I hear of it until today."
verses.textEn: But Abimelek said, "I don’t know who has done this. You did not tell me, and I heard about it only today."

verses.textZh: 于是亚伯拉罕牵了牛羊来，送给亚比米勒，二人就彼此立约。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是亚伯拉罕牵了牛羊来，送给亚比米勒，二人就彼此立约。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕把羊和牛给了亚比米勒，二人就彼此立约。
verses.textEnNiv: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelek, and the two men made a treaty.
verses.textEnEsv: So Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two men made a covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two of them made a covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham then gave some of his sheep, goats, and cattle to Abimelech, and they made a treaty.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two of them made a covenant.
verses.textEn: So Abraham brought sheep and cattle and gave them to Abimelek, and the two men made a treaty.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕把羊群中的七只母羊羔，放在另外一处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕把羊群中的七只母羊羔，放在另外一处。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕把七只母羊羔另放在一处。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs from the flock,
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock apart.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: But Abraham also took seven additional female lambs and set them off by themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: But Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.
verses.textEn: Abraham set apart seven ewe lambs from the flock,

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒问亚伯拉罕："你把这七只母羊羔放在另外一处，是甚么意思呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒问亚伯拉罕："你把这七只母羊羔放在另外一处，是甚么意思呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒问亚伯拉罕说：「你把这七只母羊羔另放在一处，是什么意思呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: and Abimelek asked Abraham, "What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs you have set apart by themselves?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Abimelech said to Abraham, "What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs that you have set apart?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech asked Abraham, "What isthemeaningof these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves?"
verses.textEnNlt: Abimelech asked, "Why have you set these seven apart from the others?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abimelech said to Abraham, "What do these seven ewe lambs mean, which you have set by themselves?"
verses.textEn: and Abimelek asked Abraham, "What is the meaning of these seven ewe lambs you have set apart by themselves?"

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕回答："意思就是：你从我手里接受这七只母羊羔，好作我挖了这口井的证据。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕回答："意思就是：你从我手里接受这七只母羊羔，好作我挖了这口井的证据。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「你要从我手里受这七只母羊羔，作我挖这口井的证据。」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "Accept these seven lambs from my hand as a witness that I dug this well."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "These seven ewe lambs you will take from my hand, that this may be a witness for me that I dug this well."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "You will take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that they may be my witness that I have dug this well."
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham replied, "Please accept these seven lambs to show your agreement that I dug this well."
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand so that it may be a witness for me, that I dug this well."
verses.textEn: He replied, "Accept these seven lambs from my hand as a witness that I dug this well."

verses.textZh: 因此那地方名叫别是巴，因为他们二人在那里起了誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此那地方名叫别是巴，因为他们二人在那里起了誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以他给那地方起名叫别是巴 ，因为他们二人在那里起了誓。
verses.textEnNiv: So that place was called Beersheba, because the two men swore an oath there.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore that place was called Beersheba, because there both of them swore an oath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because the two of them swore an oath there.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he named the place Beersheba (which means "well of the oath"), because that was where they had sworn the oath.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because there the two of them took an oath.
verses.textEn: So that place was called Beersheba, because the two men swore an oath there.

verses.textZh: 他们在别是巴立约以后，亚比米勒和他的军长非各，就起程回非利士地去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在别是巴立约以后，亚比米勒和他的军长非各，就起程回非利士地去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在别是巴立了约，亚比米勒就同他军长非各起身回非利士地去了。
verses.textEnNiv: After the treaty had been made at Beersheba, Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces returned to the land of the Philistines.
verses.textEnEsv: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Then Abimelech and Phicol the commander of his army rose up and returned to the land of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba. So Abimelech rose with Phichol, the commander of his army, and they returned to the land of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNlt: After making their covenant at Beersheba, Abimelech left with Phicol, the commander of his army, and they returned home to the land of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNasb: So they made a covenant at Beersheba; and Abimelech and Phicol, the commander of his army, got up and returned to the land of the Philistines.
verses.textEn: After the treaty had been made at Beersheba, Abimelek and Phicol the commander of his forces returned to the land of the Philistines.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕在别是巴栽了一棵垂丝柳树，就在那里求告耶和华永活的神的名。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕在别是巴栽了一棵垂丝柳树，就在那里求告耶和华永活的神的名。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕在别是巴栽上一棵垂丝柳树，又在那里求告耶和华－永生神的名。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the Lord , the Eternal God.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and called there on the name of the Lord , the Everlasting God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there called on the name of the Lord, the Everlasting God.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham planted a tamarisk tree at Beersheba, and there he worshiped the Lord , the Eternal God.
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree at Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the Lord, the Everlasting God.
verses.textEn: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the Lord , the Eternal God.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕在非利士人的地方寄居了许多日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕在非利士人的地方寄居了许多日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕在非利士人的地寄居了多日。
verses.textEnNiv: And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines for a long time.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham sojourned many days in the land of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines many days.
verses.textEnNlt: And Abraham lived as a foreigner in Philistine country for a long time.
verses.textEnNasb: And Abraham resided in the land of the Philistines for many days.
verses.textEn: And Abraham stayed in the land of the Philistines for a long time.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，神试验亚伯拉罕，对他说："亚伯拉罕啊！"他回答："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，神试验亚伯拉罕，对他说："亚伯拉罕啊！"他回答："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这些事以后，神要试验亚伯拉罕，就呼叫他说：「亚伯拉罕！」他说：「我在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later God tested Abraham. He said to him, "Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: After these things God tested Abraham and said to him, "Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass after these things that God tested Abraham, and said to him, "Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later, God tested Abraham’s faith. "Abraham!" God called. "Yes," he replied. "Here I am."
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after these things, that God tested Abraham, and said to him, "Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEn: Some time later God tested Abraham. He said to him, "Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.

verses.textZh: 神说："带着你的儿子，就是你所爱的独生子以撒，到摩利亚地去，在我所要指示你的一座山上，把他献为燔祭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："带着你的儿子，就是你所爱的独生子以撒，到摩利亚地去，在我所要指示你的一座山上，把他献为燔祭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「你带着你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，你所爱的以撒，往摩利亚地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他献为燔祭。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said, "Take your son, your only son, whom you love—Isaac—and go to the region of Moriah. Sacrifice him there as a burnt offering on a mountain I will show you."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Take your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I shall tell you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then He said, "Take now your son, your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I shall tell you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Take your son, your only son—yes, Isaac, whom you love so much—and go to the land of Moriah. Go and sacrifice him as a burnt offering on one of the mountains, which I will show you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said, "Take now your son, your only son, whom you love, Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I will tell you."
verses.textEn: Then God said, "Take your son, your only son, whom you love—Isaac—and go to the region of Moriah. Sacrifice him there as a burnt offering on a mountain I will show you."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，预备好了驴，带着两个童仆和自己的儿子以撒，也劈好了献燔祭用的柴，就起程到神指示他的地方去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，预备好了驴，带着两个童仆和自己的儿子以撒，也劈好了献燔祭用的柴，就起程到神指示他的地方去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，备上驴，带着两个仆人和他儿子以撒，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往神所指示他的地方去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning Abraham got up and loaded his donkey. He took with him two of his servants and his son Isaac. When he had cut enough wood for the burnt offering, he set out for the place God had told him about.
verses.textEnEsv: So Abraham rose early in the morning, saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and his son Isaac. And he cut the wood for the burnt offering and arose and went to the place of which God had told him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son; and he split the wood for the burnt offering, and arose and went to the place of which God had told him.
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning Abraham got up early. He saddled his donkey and took two of his servants with him, along with his son, Isaac. Then he chopped wood for a fire for a burnt offering and set out for the place God had told him about.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abraham got up early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him and his son Isaac; and he split wood for the burnt offering, and set out and went to the place of which God had told him.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning Abraham got up and loaded his donkey. He took with him two of his servants and his son Isaac. When he had cut enough wood for the burnt offering, he set out for the place God had told him about.

verses.textZh: 第三日，亚伯拉罕举目观望，远远地看见了那地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第三日，亚伯拉罕举目观望，远远地看见了那地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了第三日，亚伯拉罕举目远远地看见那地方。
verses.textEnNiv: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.
verses.textEnEsv: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw the place from afar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then on the third day Abraham lifted his eyes and saw the place afar off.
verses.textEnNlt: On the third day of their journey, Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.
verses.textEnNasb: On the third day Abraham raised his eyes and saw the place from a distance.
verses.textEn: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕对他的童仆说："你们和驴留在这里，我与孩子要到那边去敬拜，然后回到你们这里来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕对他的童仆说："你们和驴留在这里，我与孩子要到那边去敬拜，然后回到你们这里来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕对他的仆人说：「你们和驴在此等候，我与童子往那里去拜一拜，就回到你们这里来。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to his servants, "Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abraham said to his young men, "Stay here with the donkey; I and the boy will go over there and worship and come again to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham said to his young men, "Stay here with the donkey; the lad and I will go yonder and worship, and we will come back to you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Stay here with the donkey," Abraham told the servants. "The boy and I will travel a little farther. We will worship there, and then we will come right back."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abraham said to his young men, "Stay here with the donkey, and I and the boy will go over there; and we will worship and return to you."
verses.textEn: He said to his servants, "Stay here with the donkey while I and the boy go over there. We will worship and then we will come back to you."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕把献燔祭的柴，放在他儿子以撒的身上，自己手里拿着火与刀。他们二人一起向前走的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕把献燔祭的柴，放在他儿子以撒的身上，自己手里拿着火与刀。他们二人一起向前走的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕把燔祭的柴放在他儿子以撒身上，自己手里拿着火与刀；于是二人同行。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them went on together,
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. And he took in his hand the fire and the knife. So they went both of them together.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife, and the two of them went together.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abraham placed the wood for the burnt offering on Isaac’s shoulders, while he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them walked on together,
verses.textEnNasb: And Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and laid it on his son Isaac, and he took in his hand the fire and the knife. So the two of them walked on together.
verses.textEn: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac, and he himself carried the fire and the knife. As the two of them went on together,

verses.textZh: 以撒问他父亲亚伯拉罕说："爸爸！"亚伯拉罕回答："我儿！有甚么事？"以撒说："你看，火与柴都有了，可是献燔祭用的羊羔在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒问他父亲亚伯拉罕说："爸爸！"亚伯拉罕回答："我儿！有甚么事？"以撒说："你看，火与柴都有了，可是献燔祭用的羊羔在哪里呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒对他父亲亚伯拉罕说：「父亲哪！」亚伯拉罕说：「我儿，我在这里。」以撒说：「请看，火与柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在哪里呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac spoke up and said to his father Abraham, "Father?" "Yes, my son?" Abraham replied. "The fire and wood are here," Isaac said, "but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaac said to his father Abraham, "My father!" And he said, "Here I am, my son." He said, "Behold, the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But Isaac spoke to Abraham his father and said, "My father!" And he said, "Here I am, my son." Then he said, "Look, the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?"
verses.textEnNlt: Isaac turned to Abraham and said, "Father?" "Yes, my son?" Abraham replied. "We have the fire and the wood," the boy said, "but where is the sheep for the burnt offering?"
verses.textEnNasb: Isaac spoke to his father Abraham and said, "My father!" And he said, "Here I am, my son." And he said, "Look, the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?"
verses.textEn: Isaac spoke up and said to his father Abraham, "Father?" "Yes, my son?" Abraham replied. "The fire and wood are here," Isaac said, "but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?"

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕回答："我儿，神自己必亲自预备献燔祭用的羊羔。"于是二人继续一起前行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕回答："我儿，神自己必亲自预备献燔祭用的羊羔。"于是二人继续一起前行。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕说：「我儿，神必自己预备作燔祭的羊羔。」于是二人同行。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham answered, "God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son." And the two of them went on together.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham said, "God will provide for himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son." So they went both of them together.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham said, "My son, God will provide for Himself the lamb for a burnt offering." So the two of them went together.
verses.textEnNlt: "God will provide a sheep for the burnt offering, my son," Abraham answered. And they both walked on together.
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham said, "God will provide for Himself the lamb for the burnt offering, my son." So the two of them walked on together.
verses.textEn: Abraham answered, "God himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son." And the two of them went on together.

verses.textZh: 他们到了神指示他的地方，亚伯拉罕就在那里筑了一座祭坛，摆好了柴，捆绑了自己的儿子以撒，就把他放在祭坛的柴上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了神指示他的地方，亚伯拉罕就在那里筑了一座祭坛，摆好了柴，捆绑了自己的儿子以撒，就把他放在祭坛的柴上。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了神所指示的地方，亚伯拉罕在那里筑坛，把柴摆好，捆绑他的儿子以撒，放在坛的柴上。
verses.textEnNiv: When they reached the place God had told him about, Abraham built an altar there and arranged the wood on it. He bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.
verses.textEnEsv: When they came to the place of which God had told him, Abraham built the altar there and laid the wood in order and bound Isaac his son and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came to the place of which God had told him. And Abraham built an altar there and placed the wood in order; and he bound Isaac his son and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived at the place where God had told him to go, Abraham built an altar and arranged the wood on it. Then he tied his son, Isaac, and laid him on the altar on top of the wood.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they came to the place of which God had told him; and Abraham built the altar there and arranged the wood, and bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.
verses.textEn: When they reached the place God had told him about, Abraham built an altar there and arranged the wood on it. He bound his son Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕伸手拿刀，要宰杀自己的儿子的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕伸手拿刀，要宰杀自己的儿子的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕就伸手拿刀，要杀他的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he reached out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham stretched out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.
verses.textEnNlt: And Abraham picked up the knife to kill his son as a sacrifice.
verses.textEnNasb: And Abraham reached out with his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son.
verses.textEn: Then he reached out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的使者从天上呼叫亚伯拉罕，说："亚伯拉罕，亚伯拉罕！"亚伯拉罕回答："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的使者从天上呼叫亚伯拉罕，说："亚伯拉罕，亚伯拉罕！"亚伯拉罕回答："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的使者从天上呼叫他说：「亚伯拉罕！亚伯拉罕！」他说：「我在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: But the angel of the Lord called out to him from heaven, "Abraham! Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: But the angel of the Lord called to him from heaven and said, "Abraham, Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Angel of the Lord called to him from heaven and said, "Abraham, Abraham!" So he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNlt: At that moment the angel of the Lord called to him from heaven, "Abraham! Abraham!" "Yes," Abraham replied. "Here I am!"
verses.textEnNasb: But the angel of the Lord called to him from heaven and said, "Abraham, Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEn: But the angel of the Lord called out to him from heaven, "Abraham! Abraham!" "Here I am," he replied.

verses.textZh: 天使说："不可在这孩子身上下手，一点也不可害他；现在我知道你是敬畏神的了，因为你没有留下你的儿子、你的独生子不给我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 天使说："不可在这孩子身上下手，一点也不可害他；现在我知道你是敬畏神的了，因为你没有留下你的儿子、你的独生子不给我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 天使说：「你不可在这童子身上下手。一点不可害他！现在我知道你是敬畏神的了；因为你没有将你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，留下不给我。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not lay a hand on the boy," he said. "Do not do anything to him. Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from me your son, your only son."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Do not lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him, for now I know that you fear God, seeing you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Do not lay your hand on the lad, or do anything to him; for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from Me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t lay a hand on the boy!" the angel said. "Do not hurt him in any way, for now I know that you truly fear God. You have not withheld from me even your son, your only son."
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "Do not reach out your hand against the boy, and do not do anything to him; for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from Me."
verses.textEn: "Do not lay a hand on the boy," he said. "Do not do anything to him. Now I know that you fear God, because you have not withheld from me your son, your only son."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕举目观望，看见在后面有一只公绵羊，两角扣在稠密的小树丛中；亚伯拉罕就去取了那只公绵羊，把牠献为燔祭，代替自己的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕举目观望，看见在后面有一只公绵羊，两角扣在稠密的小树丛中；亚伯拉罕就去取了那只公绵羊，把牠献为燔祭，代替自己的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕举目观看，不料，有一只公羊，两角扣在稠密的小树中，亚伯拉罕就取了那只公羊来，献为燔祭，代替他的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham looked up and there in a thicket he saw a ram caught by its horns. He went over and took the ram and sacrificed it as a burnt offering instead of his son.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, behind him was a ram, caught in a thicket by his horns. And Abraham went and took the ram and offered it up as a burnt offering instead of his son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abraham lifted his eyes and looked, and there behind himwas a ram caught in a thicket by its horns. So Abraham went and took the ram, and offered it up for a burnt offering instead of his son.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught by its horns in a thicket. So he took the ram and sacrificed it as a burnt offering in place of his son.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abraham raised his eyes and looked, and behold, behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by its horns; and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it up as a burnt offering in the place of his son.
verses.textEn: Abraham looked up and there in a thicket he saw a ram caught by its horns. He went over and took the ram and sacrificed it as a burnt offering instead of his son.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕给那地方起名叫"耶和华以勒"。直到今日，人还说："在耶和华的山上必有预备。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕给那地方起名叫"耶和华以勒"。直到今日，人还说："在耶和华的山上必有预备。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕给那地方起名叫「耶和华以勒」 ，直到今日人还说：「在耶和华的山上必有预备。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Abraham called that place The Lord Will Provide. And to this day it is said, "On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided."
verses.textEnEsv: So Abraham called the name of that place, "The Lord will provide"; as it is said to this day, "On the mount of the Lord it shall be provided."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham called the name of the place, The-Lord-Will-Provide; as it is said to this day, "In the Mount of the Lord it shall be provided."
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham named the place Yahweh-Yireh (which means "the Lord will provide"). To this day, people still use that name as a proverb: "On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided."
verses.textEnNasb: And Abraham named that place The Lord Will Provide, as it is said to this day, "On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided."
verses.textEn: So Abraham called that place The Lord Will Provide. And to this day it is said, "On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided."

verses.textZh: 我必定赐福给你，必使你的后裔繁多，像天上的星，海边的沙；你的后裔必占领仇敌的城门。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必定赐福给你，必使你的后裔繁多，像天上的星，海边的沙；你的后裔必占领仇敌的城门。
verses.textZhCuv: 论福，我必赐大福给你；论子孙，我必叫你的子孙多起来，如同天上的星，海边的沙。你子孙必得着仇敌的城门，
verses.textEnNiv: I will surely bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will take possession of the cities of their enemies,
verses.textEnEsv: I will surely bless you, and I will surely multiply your offspring as the stars of heaven and as the sand that is on the seashore. And your offspring shall possess the gate of his enemies,
verses.textEnNkjv: blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply your descendants as the stars of the heaven and as the sand which is on the seashore; and your descendants shall possess the gate of their enemies.
verses.textEnNlt: I will certainly bless you. I will multiply your descendants beyond number, like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will conquer the cities of their enemies.
verses.textEnNasb: indeed I will greatly bless you, and I will greatly multiply your seed as the stars of the heavens and as the sand, which is on the seashore; and your seed shall possess the gate of their enemies.
verses.textEn: I will surely bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will take possession of the cities of their enemies,

verses.textEnNiv: and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed me."
verses.textEnEsv: and in your offspring shall all the nations of the earth be blessed, because you have obeyed my voice."
verses.textEnNkjv: In your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice."
verses.textEnNlt: And through your descendants all the nations of the earth will be blessed—all because you have obeyed me."
verses.textEnNasb: And in your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice."
verses.textEn: and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed me."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕回到他的童仆那里；他们就起程，一起到别是巴去了；亚伯拉罕就住在别是巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕回到他的童仆那里；他们就起程，一起到别是巴去了；亚伯拉罕就住在别是巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚伯拉罕回到他仆人那里，他们一同起身往别是巴去，亚伯拉罕就住在别是巴。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abraham returned to his servants, and they set off together for Beersheba. And Abraham stayed in Beersheba.
verses.textEnEsv: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they arose and went together to Beersheba. And Abraham lived at Beersheba.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they returned to the servants and traveled back to Beersheba, where Abraham continued to live.
verses.textEnNasb: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they got up and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham lived in Beersheba.
verses.textEn: Then Abraham returned to his servants, and they set off together for Beersheba. And Abraham stayed in Beersheba.

verses.textEnNiv: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milkah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.

verses.textEnNkjv: And Bethuel begot Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

verses.textEn: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milkah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.

verses.textZh: 拿鹤的妾名叫流玛。她也生了提八、迦含、他辖和玛迦。

verses.textEnNiv: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also had sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash and Maakah.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, his concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.textEnNkjv: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Thahash, and Maachah.
verses.textEnNlt: Nahor had four other children from his concubine Reumah. Their names were Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.textEnNasb: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also gave birth to Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
verses.textEn: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also had sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash and Maakah.

verses.textZh: 撒拉享寿一百二十七岁，这是撒拉一生的岁数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒拉享寿一百二十七岁，这是撒拉一生的岁数。

verses.textEnNiv: Sarah lived to be a hundred and twenty-seven years old.
verses.textEnEsv: Sarah lived 127 years; these were the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sarah lived one hundred and twenty-seven years; thesewere the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.textEnNlt: When Sarah was 127 years old,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Sarah lived 127 years; these were the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.textEn: Sarah lived to be a hundred and twenty-seven years old.

verses.textZh: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列．亚巴，就是希伯仑；亚伯拉罕进去为撒拉哀恸哭号。
verses.textZhCnvs: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列．亚巴，就是希伯仑；亚伯拉罕进去为撒拉哀恸哭号。

verses.textEnNiv: She died at Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went to mourn for Sarah and to weep over her.
verses.textEnEsv: And Sarah died at Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went in to mourn for Sarah and to weep for her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Sarah died in Kirjath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah and to weep for her.
verses.textEnNlt: she died at Kiriath-arba (now called Hebron) in the land of Canaan. There Abraham mourned and wept for her.
verses.textEnNasb: Sarah died in Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan; and Abraham came in to mourn for Sarah and to weep for her.
verses.textEn: She died at Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan, and Abraham went to mourn for Sarah and to weep over her.

verses.textEnNiv: Then Abraham rose from beside his dead wife and spoke to the Hittites. He said,
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham rose up from before his dead and said to the Hittites,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abraham stood up from before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then, leaving her body, he said to the Hittite elders,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abraham arose from mourning before his dead, and spoke to the sons of Heth, saying,
verses.textEn: Then Abraham rose from beside his dead wife and spoke to the Hittites. He said,

verses.textZh: "我是在你们中间寄居的外族人，求你们在你们中间给我一块坟地作产业，使我可以埋葬我死了的人，使她不露在我面前。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我是在你们中间寄居的外族人，求你们在你们中间给我一块坟地作产业，使我可以埋葬我死了的人，使她不露在我面前。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「我在你们中间是外人，是寄居的。求你们在这里给我一块地，我好埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前。」
verses.textEnNiv: "I am a foreigner and stranger among you. Sell me some property for a burial site here so I can bury my dead."
verses.textEnEsv: "I am a sojourner and foreigner among you; give me property among you for a burying place, that I may bury my dead out of my sight."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I am a foreigner and a visitor among you. Give me property for a burial place among you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight."
verses.textEnNlt: "Here I am, a stranger and a foreigner among you. Please sell me a piece of land so I can give my wife a proper burial."
verses.textEnNasb: "I am a stranger and a foreign resident among you; give me a burial site among you so that I may bury my dead out of my sight."
verses.textEn: "I am a foreigner and stranger among you. Sell me some property for a burial site here so I can bury my dead."

verses.textZh: 赫人回答亚伯拉罕，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 赫人回答亚伯拉罕，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 赫人回答亚伯拉罕说：
verses.textEnNiv: The Hittites replied to Abraham,
verses.textEnEsv: The Hittites answered Abraham,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.textEnNlt: The Hittites replied to Abraham,
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.textEn: The Hittites replied to Abraham,

verses.textZh: "我主请听，你在我们中间是一位尊贵的王子，你可以在我们最好的坟地里埋葬你死了的人，我们必没有人阻止你在他的坟地埋葬你死了的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我主请听，你在我们中间是一位尊贵的王子，你可以在我们最好的坟地里埋葬你死了的人，我们必没有人阻止你在他的坟地埋葬你死了的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「我主请听。你在我们中间是一位尊大的王子，只管在我们最好的坟地里埋葬你的死人；我们没有一人不容你在他的坟地里埋葬你的死人。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Sir, listen to us. You are a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the choicest of our tombs. None of us will refuse you his tomb for burying your dead."
verses.textEnEsv: "Hear us, my lord; you are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the choicest of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb to hinder you from burying your dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hear us, my lord: You are a mighty prince among us; bury your dead in the choicest of our burial places. None of us will withhold from you his burial place, that you may bury your dead."
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen, my lord, you are an honored prince among us. Choose the finest of our tombs and bury her there. No one here will refuse to help you in this way."
verses.textEnNasb: "Hear us, my lord: you are a mighty prince among us; bury your dead in the choicest of our graves; none of us will refuse you his grave for burying your dead."
verses.textEn: "Sir, listen to us. You are a mighty prince among us. Bury your dead in the choicest of our tombs. None of us will refuse you his tomb for burying your dead."

verses.textZh: 于是，亚伯拉罕起来，向当地的赫人下拜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，亚伯拉罕起来，向当地的赫人下拜，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕就起来，向那地的赫人下拜，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham rose and bowed to the Hittites, the people of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abraham stood up and bowed himself to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham bowed low before the Hittites
verses.textEnNasb: So Abraham stood up and bowed to the people of the land, the sons of Heth.
verses.textEn: Then Abraham rose and bowed down before the people of the land, the Hittites.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："你们若有意使我埋葬我死了的人，使她不露在我的眼前，就请听我的话，为我请求琐辖的儿子以弗仑，
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："你们若有意使我埋葬我死了的人，使她不露在我的眼前，就请听我的话，为我请求琐辖的儿子以弗仑，
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「你们若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前，就请听我的话，为我求琐辖的儿子以弗仑；
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "If you are willing to let me bury my dead, then listen to me and intercede with Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "If you are willing that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me and entreat for me Ephron the son of Zohar,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he spoke with them, saying, "If it is your wish that I bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and meet with Ephron the son of Zohar for me,
verses.textEnNlt: and said, "Since you are willing to help me in this way, be so kind as to ask Ephron son of Zohar
verses.textEnNasb: And he spoke with them, saying, "If you are willing to let me bury my dead out of my sight, listen to me, and plead with Ephron the son of Zohar for me,
verses.textEn: He said to them, "If you are willing to let me bury my dead, then listen to me and intercede with Ephron son of Zohar on my behalf

verses.textZh: 叫他把他所拥有的，田头上那麦比拉洞卖给我。他可以按着十足的价银卖给我，使我在你们中间有产业作坟地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 叫他把他所拥有的，田头上那麦比拉洞卖给我。他可以按着十足的价银卖给我，使我在你们中间有产业作坟地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 把田头上那麦比拉洞给我；他可以按着足价卖给我，作我在你们中间的坟地。」
verses.textEnNiv: so he will sell me the cave of Machpelah, which belongs to him and is at the end of his field. Ask him to sell it to me for the full price as a burial site among you."
verses.textEnEsv: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which he owns; it is at the end of his field. For the full price let him give it to me in your presence as property for a burying place."
verses.textEnNkjv: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah which he has, which is at the end of his field. Let him give it to me at the full price, as property for a burial place among you."
verses.textEnNlt: to let me buy his cave at Machpelah, down at the end of his field. I will pay the full price in the presence of witnesses, so I will have a permanent burial place for my family."
verses.textEnNasb: that he may give me the cave of Machpelah which he owns, which is at the end of his field; for the full price let him give it to me in your presence for a burial site."
verses.textEn: so he will sell me the cave of Machpelah, which belongs to him and is at the end of his field. Ask him to sell it to me for the full price as a burial site among you."

verses.textZh: 那时，以弗仑正坐在赫人中间。于是，赫人以弗仑就回答亚伯拉罕，所有来到城门口的赫人都听见他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以弗仑正坐在赫人中间。于是，赫人以弗仑就回答亚伯拉罕，所有来到城门口的赫人都听见他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 当时以弗仑正坐在赫人中间。于是，赫人以弗仑在城门出入的赫人面前对亚伯拉罕说：
verses.textEnNiv: Ephron the Hittite was sitting among his people and he replied to Abraham in the hearing of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Ephron was sitting among the Hittites, and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the Hittites, of all who went in at the gate of his city,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Ephron dwelt among the sons of Heth; and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the presence of the sons of Heth, all who entered at the gate of his city, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Ephron was sitting there among the others, and he answered Abraham as the others listened, speaking publicly before all the Hittite elders of the town.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Ephron was sitting among the sons of Heth; and Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham so that the sons of Heth heard, that is, all who entered the gate of his city, saying,
verses.textEn: Ephron the Hittite was sitting among his people and he replied to Abraham in the hearing of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of his city.

verses.textZh: "我主，不要这样，请听我说，这块田我送给你，连其中的洞我也送给你。我在我的族人眼前送给你，让你可以埋葬你死了的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我主，不要这样，请听我说，这块田我送给你，连其中的洞我也送给你。我在我的族人眼前送给你，让你可以埋葬你死了的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「不然，我主请听。我送给你这块田，连田间的洞也送给你，在我同族的人面前都给你，可以埋葬你的死人。」
verses.textEnNiv: "No, my lord," he said. "Listen to me; I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead."
verses.textEnEsv: "No, my lord, hear me: I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the sight of the sons of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: "No, my lord, hear me: I give you the field and the cave that is in it; I give it to you in the presence of the sons of my people. I give it to you. Bury your dead!"
verses.textEnNlt: "No, my lord," he said to Abraham, "please listen to me. I will give you the field and the cave. Here in the presence of my people, I give it to you. Go and bury your dead."
verses.textEnNasb: "No, my lord, listen to me; I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the sons of my people I give it to you; bury your dead."
verses.textEn: "No, my lord," he said. "Listen to me; I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. I give it to you in the presence of my people. Bury your dead."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕就在当地的人面前下拜，
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕就在当地的人面前下拜，
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，
verses.textEnNiv: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land
verses.textEnEsv: Then Abraham bowed down before the people of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land;
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham again bowed low before the citizens of the land,
verses.textEnNasb: And Abraham bowed before the people of the land.
verses.textEn: Again Abraham bowed down before the people of the land

verses.textZh: 然后在当地的人面前对以弗仑说："请听我说，如果你愿意，我必定把地的价银给你，请你收下吧，让我可以在那里埋葬我死了的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后在当地的人面前对以弗仑说："请听我说，如果你愿意，我必定把地的价银给你，请你收下吧，让我可以在那里埋葬我死了的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 在他们面前对以弗仑说：「你若应允，请听我的话。我要把田价给你，求你收下，我就在那里埋葬我的死人。」
verses.textEnNiv: and he said to Ephron in their hearing, "Listen to me, if you will. I will pay the price of the field. Accept it from me so I can bury my dead there."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to Ephron in the hearing of the people of the land, "But if you will, hear me: I give the price of the field. Accept it from me, that I may bury my dead there."
verses.textEnNkjv: and he spoke to Ephron in the hearing of the people of the land, saying, "If you willgiveit, please hear me. I will give you money for the field; take it from me and I will bury my dead there."
verses.textEnNlt: and he replied to Ephron as everyone listened. "No, listen to me. I will buy it from you. Let me pay the full price for the field so I can bury my dead there."
verses.textEnNasb: But he spoke to Ephron so that the people of the land heard, saying, "If you will only please listen to me; I will give the price of the field, accept it from me so that I may bury my dead there."
verses.textEn: and he said to Ephron in their hearing, "Listen to me, if you will. I will pay the price of the field. Accept it from me so I can bury my dead there."

verses.textZh: 以弗仑回答亚伯拉罕，对他说：

verses.textEnEsv: Ephron answered Abraham,

verses.textEnNlt: Ephron answered Abraham,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,
verses.textEn: Ephron answered Abraham,

verses.textZh: "我主，请听我说，一块值四百块 银子的田地，在你我之间，算得甚么呢？你埋葬你死了的人吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "我主，请听我说，一块值四百块 银子的田地，在你我之间，算得甚么呢？你埋葬你死了的人吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「我主请听。值四百舍客勒银子的一块田，在你我中间还算什么呢？只管埋葬你的死人吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: "Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead."
verses.textEnEsv: "My lord, listen to me: a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver, what is that between you and me? Bury your dead."
verses.textEnNkjv: "My lord, listen to me; the land isworth four hundred shekels of silver. What is that between you and me? So bury your dead."
verses.textEnNlt: "My lord, please listen to me. The land is worth 400 pieces of silver, but what is that between friends? Go ahead and bury your dead."
verses.textEnNasb: "My lord, listen to me: a plot of land worth four hundred shekels of silver—what is that between me and you? So bury your dead."
verses.textEn: "Listen to me, my lord; the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver, but what is that between you and me? Bury your dead."

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕同意以弗仑说的价银，就照着他在赫人面前所说的，拿商人通用的银子，称了四百块 银子给以弗仑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕同意以弗仑说的价银，就照着他在赫人面前所说的，拿商人通用的银子，称了四百块 银子给以弗仑。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕听从了以弗仑，照着他在赫人面前所说的话，把买卖通用的银子平了四百舍客勒给以弗仑。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the weight current among the merchants.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham listened to Ephron, and Abraham weighed out for Ephron the silver that he had named in the hearing of the Hittites, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the weights current among the merchants.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham listened to Ephron; and Abraham weighed out the silver for Ephron which he had named in the hearing of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, currency of the merchants.
verses.textEnNlt: So Abraham agreed to Ephron’s price and paid the amount he had suggested—400 pieces of silver, weighed according to the market standard. The Hittite elders witnessed the transaction.
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham listened to Ephron; and Abraham weighed out for Ephron the silver which he had named in the presence of the sons of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, currency acceptable to a merchant.
verses.textEn: Abraham agreed to Ephron’s terms and weighed out for him the price he had named in the hearing of the Hittites: four hundred shekels of silver, according to the weight current among the merchants.

verses.textZh: 于是，以弗仑在麦比拉，在幔利前面的那块地，包括那块田和其中的洞，田中和四周所有的树木，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以弗仑在麦比拉，在幔利前面的那块地，包括那块田和其中的洞，田中和四周所有的树木，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，麦比拉、幔利前、以弗仑的那块田和其中的洞，并田间四围的树木，

verses.textEnNkjv: So the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field and the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, which were within all the surrounding borders, were deeded
verses.textEnNlt: So Abraham bought the plot of land belonging to Ephron at Machpelah, near Mamre. This included the field itself, the cave that was in it, and all the surrounding trees.
verses.textEnNasb: So Ephron’s field, which was in Machpelah, which faced Mamre, the field and the cave which was in it, and all the trees which were in the field, that were within all the confines of its border, were deeded over
verses.textEn: So Ephron’s field in Machpelah near Mamre—both the field and the cave in it, and all the trees within the borders of the field—was deeded

verses.textZh: 都在赫人眼前，就是在所有来到城门口的赫人眼前，归给亚伯拉罕作产业。

verses.textZhCuv: 都定准归与亚伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前并城门出入的人面前买妥的。
verses.textEnNiv: to Abraham as his property in the presence of all the Hittites who had come to the gate of the city.

verses.textZh: 这事以后，亚伯拉罕把自己的妻子撒拉埋在迦南地，幔利前面麦比拉田间的洞里。幔利就是希伯仑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事以后，亚伯拉罕把自己的妻子撒拉埋在迦南地，幔利前面麦比拉田间的洞里。幔利就是希伯仑。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后，亚伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麦比拉田间的洞里。（幔利就是希伯仑）。
verses.textEnNiv: Afterward Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah near Mamre (which is at Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah east of Mamre (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah, before Mamre (that is, Hebron) in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abraham buried his wife, Sarah, there in Canaan, in the cave of Machpelah, near Mamre (also called Hebron).
verses.textEnNasb: After this, Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave of the field of Machpelah facing Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEn: Afterward Abraham buried his wife Sarah in the cave in the field of Machpelah near Mamre (which is at Hebron) in the land of Canaan.

verses.textZh: 这样，那块田和田中的洞，就从赫人归给了亚伯拉罕为产业作坟地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，那块田和田中的洞，就从赫人归给了亚伯拉罕为产业作坟地。
verses.textZhCuv: 从此，那块田和田间的洞就藉着赫人定准归与亚伯拉罕作坟地。
verses.textEnNiv: So the field and the cave in it were deeded to Abraham by the Hittites as a burial site.
verses.textEnEsv: The field and the cave that is in it were made over to Abraham as property for a burying place by the Hittites.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the field and the cave that is in it were deeded to Abraham by the sons of Heth as property for a burial place.
verses.textEnNlt: So the field and the cave were transferred from the Hittites to Abraham for use as a permanent burial place.
verses.textEnNasb: So the field and the cave that was in it were deeded over to Abraham for a burial site by the sons of Heth.
verses.textEn: So the field and the cave in it were deeded to Abraham by the Hittites as a burial site.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕老迈了，年事已高，耶和华在一切事上都赐福给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕老迈了，年事已高，耶和华在一切事上都赐福给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕年纪老迈，向来在一切事上耶和华都赐福给他。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham was now very old, and the Lord had blessed him in every way.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Abraham was old, well advanced in years. And the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Abraham was old, well advanced in age; and the Lord had blessed Abraham in all things.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham was now a very old man, and the Lord had blessed him in every way.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abraham was old, advanced in age; and the Lord had blessed Abraham in every way.
verses.textEn: Abraham was now very old, and the Lord had blessed him in every way.

verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕对管理他全业最老的仆人说：「请你把手放在我大腿底下。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to the senior servant in his household, the one in charge of all that he had, "Put your hand under my thigh.
verses.textEnEsv: And Abraham said to his servant, the oldest of his household, who had charge of all that he had, "Put your hand under my thigh,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abraham said to the oldest servant of his house, who ruled over all that he had, "Please, put your hand under my thigh,
verses.textEnNlt: One day Abraham said to his oldest servant, the man in charge of his household, "Take an oath by putting your hand under my thigh.
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham said to his servant, the oldest of his household who was in charge of all that he owned, "Please place your hand under my thigh,
verses.textEn: He said to the senior servant in his household, the one in charge of all that he had, "Put your hand under my thigh.

verses.textZh: 我要你指着耶和华天地的神起誓，不可从我现在居住的迦南人中，为我的儿子娶他们的女子为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要你指着耶和华天地的神起誓，不可从我现在居住的迦南人中，为我的儿子娶他们的女子为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要叫你指着耶和华－天地的主起誓，不要为我儿子娶这迦南地中的女子为妻。

verses.textEnEsv: that I may make you swear by the Lord , the God of heaven and God of the earth, that you will not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell,
