verses.textEn: but will go to my country and my own relatives and get a wife for my son Isaac."

verses.textZh: 仆人问亚伯拉罕："如果那女子不愿跟我到这地方来，我必须把你的儿子带回你原出之地去吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 仆人问亚伯拉罕："如果那女子不愿跟我到这地方来，我必须把你的儿子带回你原出之地去吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人对他说：「倘若女子不肯跟我到这地方来，我必须将你的儿子带回你原出之地吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: The servant asked him, "What if the woman is unwilling to come back with me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the country you came from?"
verses.textEnEsv: The servant said to him, "Perhaps the woman may not be willing to follow me to this land. Must I then take your son back to the land from which you came?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And the servant said to him, "Perhaps the woman will not be willing to follow me to this land. Must I take your son back to the land from which you came?"
verses.textEnNlt: The servant asked, "But what if I can’t find a young woman who is willing to travel so far from home? Should I then take Isaac there to live among your relatives in the land you came from?"
verses.textEnNasb: The servant said to him, "Suppose the woman is not willing to follow me to this land; should I take your son back to the land from where you came?"
verses.textEn: The servant asked him, "What if the woman is unwilling to come back with me to this land? Shall I then take your son back to the country you came from?"

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕对他说："你要谨慎，切不可带我的儿子回到那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕对他说："你要谨慎，切不可带我的儿子回到那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕对他说：「你要谨慎，不要带我的儿子回那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Make sure that you do not take my son back there," Abraham said.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham said to him, "See to it that you do not take my son back there.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Abraham said to him, "Beware that you do not take my son back there.
verses.textEnNlt: "No!" Abraham responded. "Be careful never to take my son there.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abraham said to him, "Beware that you do not take my son back there!
verses.textEn: "Make sure that you do not take my son back there," Abraham said.

verses.textZh: 耶和华天上的神，就是领我离开我的父家和我亲族之地，曾经对我说话，又向我起誓的那位说：‘我必把这地赐给你的后裔。’他必在你前面差派他的使者，你就可以从那里为我的儿子娶妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华天上的神，就是领我离开我的父家和我亲族之地，曾经对我说话，又向我起誓的那位说：‘我必把这地赐给你的后裔。’他必在你前面差派他的使者，你就可以从那里为我的儿子娶妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华－天上的主曾带领我离开父家和本族的地，对我说话，向我起誓说：『我要将这地赐给你的后裔。』他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以从那里为我儿子娶一个妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: "The Lord , the God of heaven, who brought me out of my father’s household and my native land and who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—he will send his angel before you so that you can get a wife for my son from there.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord , the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house and from the land of my kindred, and who spoke to me and swore to me, ‘To your offspring I will give this land,’ he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house and from the land of my family, and who spoke to me and swore to me, saying, ‘To your descendants I give this land,’ He will send His angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord , the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house and my native land, solemnly promised to give this land to my descendants. He will send his angel ahead of you, and he will see to it that you find a wife there for my son.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord, the God of heaven, who took me from my father’s house and from the land of my birth, and who spoke to me and who swore to me, saying, ‘To your descendants I will give this land’—He will send His angel ahead of you, and you will take a wife for my son from there.
verses.textEn: "The Lord , the God of heaven, who brought me out of my father’s household and my native land and who spoke to me and promised me on oath, saying, ‘To your offspring I will give this land’—he will send his angel before you so that you can get a wife for my son from there.

verses.textZh: 如果那女子不愿跟你来，我叫你所起的这誓就与你无关了。只是不可带我的儿子回到那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那女子不愿跟你来，我叫你所起的这誓就与你无关了。只是不可带我的儿子回到那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若女子不肯跟你来，我使你起的誓就与你无干了，只是不可带我的儿子回那里去。」
verses.textEnNiv: If the woman is unwilling to come back with you, then you will be released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there."
verses.textEnEsv: But if the woman is not willing to follow you, then you will be free from this oath of mine; only you must not take my son back there."
verses.textEnNkjv: And if the woman is not willing to follow you, then you will be released from this oath; only do not take my son back there."
verses.textEnNlt: If she is unwilling to come back with you, then you are free from this oath of mine. But under no circumstances are you to take my son there."
verses.textEnNasb: But if the woman is not willing to follow you, then you will be free of this oath of mine; only do not take my son back there."
verses.textEn: If the woman is unwilling to come back with you, then you will be released from this oath of mine. Only do not take my son back there."

verses.textZh: 于是，仆人把手放在他主人亚伯拉罕的大腿下，为这事向亚伯拉罕起誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，仆人把手放在他主人亚伯拉罕的大腿下，为这事向亚伯拉罕起誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人就把手放在他主人亚伯拉罕的大腿底下，为这事向他起誓。
verses.textEnNiv: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.
verses.textEnEsv: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master and swore to him concerning this matter.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.
verses.textEnNlt: So the servant took an oath by putting his hand under the thigh of his master, Abraham. He swore to follow Abraham’s instructions.
verses.textEnNasb: So the servant placed his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham, and swore to him concerning this matter.
verses.textEn: So the servant put his hand under the thigh of his master Abraham and swore an oath to him concerning this matter.

verses.textZh: 那仆人从他主人的骆驼里取了十匹骆驼，带着主人各样的美物，起程往两河之间的亚兰去，到了拿鹤的城。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那仆人从他主人的骆驼里取了十匹骆驼，带着主人各样的美物，起程往两河之间的亚兰去，到了拿鹤的城。
verses.textZhCuv: 那仆人从他主人的骆驼里取了十匹骆驼，并带些他主人各样的财物，起身往美索不达米亚去，到了拿鹤的城。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the servant left, taking with him ten of his master’s camels loaded with all kinds of good things from his master. He set out for Aram Naharaim and made his way to the town of Nahor.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the servant took ten of his master’s camels and departed, taking all sorts of choice gifts from his master; and he arose and went to Mesopotamia to the city of Nahor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the servant took ten of his master’s camels and departed, for all his master’s goods werein his hand. And he arose and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he loaded ten of Abraham’s camels with all kinds of expensive gifts from his master, and he traveled to distant Aram-naharaim. There he went to the town where Abraham’s brother Nahor had settled.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the servant took ten camels from the camels of his master, and went out with a variety of good things of his master’s in his hand; so he set out and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.
verses.textEn: Then the servant left, taking with him ten of his master’s camels loaded with all kinds of good things from his master. He set out for Aram Naharaim and made his way to the town of Nahor.

verses.textZh: 黄昏时分，女人出来打水的时候，那仆人就叫骆驼跪在城外的水井旁边，
verses.textZhCnvs: 黄昏时分，女人出来打水的时候，那仆人就叫骆驼跪在城外的水井旁边，
verses.textZhCuv: 天将晚，众女子出来打水的时候，他便叫骆驼跪在城外的水井那里。
verses.textEnNiv: He had the camels kneel down near the well outside the town; it was toward evening, the time the women go out to draw water.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time when women go out to draw water.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he made his camels kneel down outside the city by a well of water at evening time, the time when women go out to draw water.
verses.textEnNlt: He made the camels kneel beside a well just outside the town. It was evening, and the women were coming out to draw water.
verses.textEnNasb: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water when it was evening, the time when women go out to draw water.
verses.textEn: He had the camels kneel down near the well outside the town; it was toward evening, the time the women go out to draw water.

verses.textZh: 然后祷告说："耶和华我主人亚伯拉罕的神啊，求你今日使我遇见好机会，施慈爱给我的主人亚伯拉罕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后祷告说："耶和华我主人亚伯拉罕的神啊，求你今日使我遇见好机会，施慈爱给我的主人亚伯拉罕。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「耶和华－我主人亚伯拉罕的神啊，求你施恩给我主人亚伯拉罕，使我今日遇见好机会。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he prayed, " Lord , God of my master Abraham, make me successful today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "O Lord , God of my master Abraham, please grant me success today and show steadfast love to my master Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "O Lord God of my master Abraham, please give me success this day, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord , God of my master, Abraham," he prayed. "Please give me success today, and show unfailing love to my master, Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Lord, God of my master Abraham, please grant me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.
verses.textEn: Then he prayed, " Lord , God of my master Abraham, make me successful today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

verses.textZh: 我现在站在水泉旁边，城内居民的女儿正出来打水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在站在水泉旁边，城内居民的女儿正出来打水。
verses.textZhCuv: 我现今站在井旁，城内居民的女子们正出来打水。
verses.textEnNiv: See, I am standing beside this spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water, and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, here I stand by the well of water, and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
verses.textEnNlt: See, I am standing here beside this spring, and the young women of the town are coming out to draw water.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am standing by the spring, and the daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water;
verses.textEn: See, I am standing beside this spring, and the daughters of the townspeople are coming out to draw water.

verses.textZh: 我对哪一个少女说：‘请你放下水瓶来，让我喝点水。’如果她回答：‘请喝，我也给你的骆驼喝。’愿那少女就作你选定给你仆人以撒的妻子。这样，我就知道你施慈爱给我的主人了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我对哪一个少女说：‘请你放下水瓶来，让我喝点水。’如果她回答：‘请喝，我也给你的骆驼喝。’愿那少女就作你选定给你仆人以撒的妻子。这样，我就知道你施慈爱给我的主人了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我向那一个女子说：『请你拿下水瓶来，给我水喝』，她若说：『请喝！我也给你的骆驼喝。』愿那女子就作你所预定给你仆人以撒的妻。这样，我便知道你施恩给我主人了。」
verses.textEnNiv: May it be that when I say to a young woman, ‘Please let down your jar that I may have a drink,’ and she says, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels too’—let her be the one you have chosen for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master."
verses.textEnEsv: Let the young woman to whom I shall say, ‘Please let down your jar that I may drink,’ and who shall say, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels’—let her be the one whom you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I shall know that you have shown steadfast love to my master."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now let it be that the young woman to whom I say, ‘Please let down your pitcher that I may drink,’ and she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink’—let her betheone You have appointed for Your servant Isaac. And by this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master."
verses.textEnNlt: This is my request. I will ask one of them, ‘Please give me a drink from your jug.’ If she says, ‘Yes, have a drink, and I will water your camels, too!’—let her be the one you have selected as Isaac’s wife. This is how I will know that you have shown unfailing love to my master."
verses.textEnNasb: now may it be that the young woman to whom I say, ‘Please let down your jar so that I may drink,’ and who answers, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels also’—may she be the one whom You have appointed for Your servant Isaac; and by this I will know that You have shown kindness to my master."
verses.textEn: May it be that when I say to a young woman, ‘Please let down your jar that I may have a drink,’ and she says, ‘Drink, and I’ll water your camels too’—let her be the one you have chosen for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master."

verses.textZh: 话还没有说完，不料，利百加肩头上扛着水瓶出来了。利百加是彼土利所生的。彼土利是亚伯拉罕兄弟拿鹤的妻子密迦的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 话还没有说完，不料，利百加肩头上扛着水瓶出来了。利百加是彼土利所生的。彼土利是亚伯拉罕兄弟拿鹤的妻子密迦的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 话还没有说完，不料，利百加肩头上扛着水瓶出来。利百加是彼土利所生的；彼土利是亚伯拉罕兄弟拿鹤妻子密迦的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Before he had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milkah, who was the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor.
verses.textEnEsv: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, came out with her water jar on her shoulder.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah, who was born to Bethuel, son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, came out with her pitcher on her shoulder.
verses.textEnNlt: Before he had finished praying, he saw a young woman named Rebekah coming out with her water jug on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel, who was the son of Abraham’s brother Nahor and his wife, Milcah.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, before he had finished speaking, that behold, Rebekah, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor, came out with her jar on her shoulder.
verses.textEn: Before he had finished praying, Rebekah came out with her jar on her shoulder. She was the daughter of Bethuel son of Milkah, who was the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor.

verses.textZh: 那少女容貌非常美丽，还是个处女，没有男人亲近过她。她下到水泉那里，打满了水瓶，又上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那少女容貌非常美丽，还是个处女，没有男人亲近过她。她下到水泉那里，打满了水瓶，又上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 那女子容貌极其俊美，还是处女，也未曾有人亲近她。她下到井旁，打满了瓶，又上来。
verses.textEnNiv: The woman was very beautiful, a virgin; no man had ever slept with her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar and came up again.
verses.textEnEsv: The young woman was very attractive in appearance, a maiden whom no man had known. She went down to the spring and filled her jar and came up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the young woman was very beautiful to behold, a virgin; no man had known her. And she went down to the well, filled her pitcher, and came up.
verses.textEnNlt: Rebekah was very beautiful and old enough to be married, but she was still a virgin. She went down to the spring, filled her jug, and came up again.
verses.textEnNasb: The young woman was very beautiful, a virgin; no man had had relations with her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar, and came up.
verses.textEn: The woman was very beautiful, a virgin; no man had ever slept with her. She went down to the spring, filled her jar and came up again.

verses.textZh: 仆人就跑去迎着她，说："请你把瓶里的水给我喝一点。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 仆人就跑去迎着她，说："请你把瓶里的水给我喝一点。"
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人跑上前去迎着她，说：「求你将瓶里的水给我一点喝。」
verses.textEnNiv: The servant hurried to meet her and said, "Please give me a little water from your jar."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the servant ran to meet her and said, "Please give me a little water to drink from your jar."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the servant ran to meet her and said, "Please let me drink a little water from your pitcher."
verses.textEnNlt: Running over to her, the servant said, "Please give me a little drink of water from your jug."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the servant ran to meet her, and said, "Please let me drink a little water from your jar."
verses.textEn: The servant hurried to meet her and said, "Please give me a little water from your jar."

verses.textZh: 那少女回答："我主请喝。"就急忙把水瓶拿下来，托在手上给他喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那少女回答："我主请喝。"就急忙把水瓶拿下来，托在手上给他喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 女子说：「我主请喝！」就急忙拿下瓶来，托在手上给他喝。
verses.textEnNiv: "Drink, my lord," she said, and quickly lowered the jar to her hands and gave him a drink.
verses.textEnEsv: She said, "Drink, my lord." And she quickly let down her jar upon her hand and gave him a drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said, "Drink, my lord." Then she quickly let her pitcher down to her hand, and gave him a drink.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, my lord," she answered, "have a drink." And she quickly lowered her jug from her shoulder and gave him a drink.
verses.textEnNasb: And she said, "Drink, my lord"; then she quickly lowered her jar to her hand, and gave him a drink.
verses.textEn: "Drink, my lord," she said, and quickly lowered the jar to her hands and gave him a drink.

verses.textZh: 他喝足了，少女就说："我也要为你的骆驼打水，直到牠们都喝足了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他喝足了，少女就说："我也要为你的骆驼打水，直到牠们都喝足了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 女子给他喝了，就说：「我再为你的骆驼打水，叫骆驼也喝足。」
verses.textEnNiv: After she had given him a drink, she said, "I’ll draw water for your camels too, until they have had enough to drink."
verses.textEnEsv: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, "I will draw water for your camels also, until they have finished drinking."
verses.textEnNkjv: And when she had finished giving him a drink, she said, "I will draw water for your camels also, until they have finished drinking."
verses.textEnNlt: When she had given him a drink, she said, "I’ll draw water for your camels, too, until they have had enough to drink."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when she had finished giving him a drink, she said, "I will also draw water for your camels until they have finished drinking."
verses.textEn: After she had given him a drink, she said, "I’ll draw water for your camels too, until they have had enough to drink."

verses.textZh: 于是急忙把水瓶里的水倒在槽里，又跑到井旁去打水，给他所有的骆驼打上水来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是急忙把水瓶里的水倒在槽里，又跑到井旁去打水，给他所有的骆驼打上水来。
verses.textZhCuv: 她就急忙把瓶里的水倒在槽里，又跑到井旁打水，就为所有的骆驼打上水来。
verses.textEnNiv: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough, ran back to the well to draw more water, and drew enough for all his camels.
verses.textEnEsv: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough and ran again to the well to draw water, and she drew for all his camels.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she quickly emptied her pitcher into the trough, ran back to the well to draw water, and drew for all his camels.
verses.textEnNlt: So she quickly emptied her jug into the watering trough and ran back to the well to draw water for all his camels.
verses.textEnNasb: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough, and ran back to the well to draw, and she drew for all his camels.
verses.textEn: So she quickly emptied her jar into the trough, ran back to the well to draw more water, and drew enough for all his camels.

verses.textZh: 那人一句话也不说，只注视着她，要知道耶和华使他的道路亨通不亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人一句话也不说，只注视着她，要知道耶和华使他的道路亨通不亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人定睛看她，一句话也不说，要晓得耶和华赐他通达的道路没有。
verses.textEnNiv: Without saying a word, the man watched her closely to learn whether or not the Lord had made his journey successful.
verses.textEnEsv: The man gazed at her in silence to learn whether the Lord had prospered his journey or not.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the man, wondering at her, remained silent so as to know whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.
verses.textEnNlt: The servant watched her in silence, wondering whether or not the Lord had given him success in his mission.
verses.textEnNasb: Meanwhile, the man was taking a close look at her in silence, to find out whether the Lord had made his journey successful or not.
verses.textEn: Without saying a word, the man watched her closely to learn whether or not the Lord had made his journey successful.

verses.textZh: 骆驼喝足了，那人就拿出一个重近六克的金鼻环，戴在她的鼻子上，又拿出两个重一百一十四克的金手镯，套在她的手上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 骆驼喝足了，那人就拿出一个重近六克的金鼻环，戴在她的鼻子上，又拿出两个重一百一十四克的金手镯，套在她的手上，
verses.textZhCuv: 骆驼喝足了，那人就拿一个金环，重半舍客勒，两个金镯，重十舍客勒，给了那女子，
verses.textEnNiv: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took out a gold nose ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets weighing ten shekels.
verses.textEnEsv: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took a gold ring weighing a half shekel, and two bracelets for her arms weighing ten gold shekels,
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when the camels had finished drinking, that the man took a golden nose ring weighing half a shekel, and two bracelets for her wrists weighing ten shekels of gold,
verses.textEnNlt: Then at last, when the camels had finished drinking, he took out a gold ring for her nose and two large gold bracelets for her wrists.
verses.textEnNasb: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took a gold ring weighing a half-shekel, and two bracelets for her wrists weighing ten shekels in gold,
verses.textEn: When the camels had finished drinking, the man took out a gold nose ring weighing a beka and two gold bracelets weighing ten shekels.

verses.textZh: 然后问她："请你告诉我，你是谁的女儿？你父亲的家里有地方给我们住宿没有？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后问她："请你告诉我，你是谁的女儿？你父亲的家里有地方给我们住宿没有？"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「请告诉我，你是谁的女儿？你父亲家里有我们住宿的地方没有？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he asked, "Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?"
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "Please tell me whose daughter you are. Is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?"
verses.textEnNkjv: and said, "Whose daughter are you? Tell me, please, is there room in your father’s house for us to lodge?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Whose daughter are you?" he asked. "And please tell me, would your father have any room to put us up for the night?"
verses.textEnNasb: and he said, "Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room for us to stay overnight at your father’s house?"
verses.textEn: Then he asked, "Whose daughter are you? Please tell me, is there room in your father’s house for us to spend the night?"

verses.textZh: 她回答："我是密迦给拿鹤所生的儿子彼土利的女儿。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她回答："我是密迦给拿鹤所生的儿子彼土利的女儿。"
verses.textZhCuv: 女子说：「我是密迦与拿鹤之子彼土利的女儿」；
verses.textEnNiv: She answered him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milkah bore to Nahor."
verses.textEnEsv: She said to him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor."
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said to him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, Milcah’s son, whom she bore to Nahor."
verses.textEnNlt: "I am the daughter of Bethuel," she replied. "My grandparents are Nahor and Milcah.
verses.textEnNasb: She said to him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, Milcah’s son, whom she bore to Nahor."
verses.textEn: She answered him, "I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son that Milkah bore to Nahor."

verses.textZh: 她又说："我们有很多粮草和饲料，也有住宿的地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她又说："我们有很多粮草和饲料，也有住宿的地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「我们家里足有粮草，也有住宿的地方。」
verses.textEnNiv: And she added, "We have plenty of straw and fodder, as well as room for you to spend the night."
verses.textEnEsv: She added, "We have plenty of both straw and fodder, and room to spend the night."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover she said to him, "We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, we have plenty of straw and feed for the camels, and we have room for guests."
verses.textEnNasb: Again she said to him, "We have plenty of both straw and feed, and room to stay overnight."
verses.textEn: And she added, "We have plenty of straw and fodder, as well as room for you to spend the night."

verses.textZh: 那人就跪下敬拜耶和华，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人就跪下敬拜耶和华，
verses.textZhCuv: 那人就低头向耶和华下拜，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the Lord ,
verses.textEnEsv: The man bowed his head and worshiped the Lord
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the man bowed down his head and worshiped the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: The man bowed low and worshiped the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Then the man bowed low and worshiped the Lord.
verses.textEn: Then the man bowed down and worshiped the Lord ,

verses.textZh: 说："耶和华我主人亚伯拉罕的神是应当称颂的，因为他不断以慈爱和信实待我的主人；耶和华也一路引导我，到了我主人的兄弟家里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 说："耶和华我主人亚伯拉罕的神是应当称颂的，因为他不断以慈爱和信实待我的主人；耶和华也一路引导我，到了我主人的兄弟家里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「耶和华－我主人亚伯拉罕的神是应当称颂的，因他不断地以慈爱诚实待我主人。至于我，耶和华在路上引领我，直走到我主人的兄弟家里。」
verses.textEnNiv: saying, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who has not abandoned his kindness and faithfulness to my master. As for me, the Lord has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives."
verses.textEnEsv: and said, "Blessed be the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his steadfast love and his faithfulness toward my master. As for me, the Lord has led me in the way to the house of my master’s kinsmen."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken His mercy and His truth toward my master. As for me, being on the way, the Lord led me to the house of my master’s brethren."
verses.textEnNlt: "Praise the Lord , the God of my master, Abraham," he said. "The Lord has shown unfailing love and faithfulness to my master, for he has led me straight to my master’s relatives."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Blessed be the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who has not abandoned His kindness and His trustworthiness toward my master; as for me, the Lord has guided me in the way to the house of my master’s brothers."
verses.textEn: saying, "Praise be to the Lord , the God of my master Abraham, who has not abandoned his kindness and faithfulness to my master. As for me, the Lord has led me on the journey to the house of my master’s relatives."

verses.textZh: 那少女就跑回去，把这些事都告诉了她母亲家里的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那少女就跑回去，把这些事都告诉了她母亲家里的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 女子跑回去，照着这些话告诉她母亲和她家里的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The young woman ran and told her mother’s household about these things.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the young woman ran and told her mother’s household about these things.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the young woman ran and told her mother’s household these things.
verses.textEnNlt: The young woman ran home to tell her family everything that had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the young woman ran and told her mother’s household about these things.
verses.textEn: The young woman ran and told her mother’s household about these things.

verses.textZh: 利百加有一个哥哥，名叫拉班。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利百加有一个哥哥，名叫拉班。
verses.textZhCuv: 便对他说：「你这蒙耶和华赐福的，请进来，为什么站在外边？我已经收拾了房屋，也为骆驼预备了地方。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring.
verses.textEnEsv: Rebekah had a brother whose name was Laban. Laban ran out toward the man, to the spring.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Rebekah had a brother whose name was Laban, and Laban ran out to the man by the well.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, who ran out to meet the man at the spring.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Rebekah had a brother whose name was Laban; and Laban ran outside to the man at the spring.
verses.textEn: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he hurried out to the man at the spring.

verses.textZh: 他看见了妹妹的鼻环和手上的手镯，又听见了妹妹利百加说："那人对我这样这样说"，就跑去见外面水泉旁边的那人。他来到那人跟前的时候，见他仍然站在骆驼旁边的水泉那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他看见了妹妹的鼻环和手上的手镯，又听见了妹妹利百加说："那人对我这样这样说"，就跑去见外面水泉旁边的那人。他来到那人跟前的时候，见他仍然站在骆驼旁边的水泉那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人就进了拉班的家。拉班卸了骆驼，用草料喂上，拿水给那人和跟随的人洗脚；
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as he had seen the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s arms, and had heard Rebekah tell what the man said to her, he went out to the man and found him standing by the camels near the spring.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as he saw the ring and the bracelets on his sister’s arms, and heard the words of Rebekah his sister, "Thus the man spoke to me," he went to the man. And behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came to pass, when he saw the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s wrists, and when he heard the words of his sister Rebekah, saying, "Thus the man spoke to me," that he went to the man. And there he stood by the camels at the well.
verses.textEnNlt: He had seen the nose-ring and the bracelets on his sister’s wrists, and had heard Rebekah tell what the man had said. So he rushed out to the spring, where the man was still standing beside his camels.
verses.textEnNasb: When he saw the ring and the bracelets on his sister’s wrists, and when he heard the words of his sister Rebekah, saying, " This is what the man said to me," he went to the man; and behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.
verses.textEn: As soon as he had seen the nose ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s arms, and had heard Rebekah tell what the man said to her, he went out to the man and found him standing by the camels near the spring.

verses.textZh: 拉班说："你这蒙耶和华赐福的，请进来吧，为甚么站在外面呢？我已经收拾好了房间，也为骆驼预备了地方。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班说："你这蒙耶和华赐福的，请进来吧，为甚么站在外面呢？我已经收拾好了房间，也为骆驼预备了地方。"
verses.textZhCuv: 把饭摆在他面前，叫他吃，他却说：「我不吃，等我说明白我的事情再吃。」拉班说：「请说。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Come, you who are blessed by the Lord ," he said. "Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Come in, O blessed of the Lord . Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house and a place for the camels."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Come in, O blessed of the Lord! Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and a place for the camels."
verses.textEnNlt: Laban said to him, "Come and stay with us, you who are blessed by the Lord ! Why are you standing here outside the town when I have a room all ready for you and a place prepared for the camels?"
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Come in, blessed of the Lord! Why do you stand outside, since I have prepared the house, and a place for the camels?"
verses.textEn: "Come, you who are blessed by the Lord ," he said. "Why are you standing out here? I have prepared the house and a place for the camels."

verses.textZh: 那人就进了拉班的家。拉班卸了骆驼，拿粮草和饲料给骆驼吃，又拿水给那人和与他同来的人洗脚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人就进了拉班的家。拉班卸了骆驼，拿粮草和饲料给骆驼吃，又拿水给那人和与他同来的人洗脚。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「我是亚伯拉罕的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: So the man went to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and fodder were brought for the camels, and water for him and his men to wash their feet.
verses.textEnEsv: So the man came to the house and unharnessed the camels, and gave straw and fodder to the camels, and there was water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the man came to the house. And he unloaded the camels, and provided straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
verses.textEnNlt: So the man went home with Laban, and Laban unloaded the camels, gave him straw for their bedding, fed them, and provided water for the man and the camel drivers to wash their feet.
verses.textEnNasb: So the man entered the house. Then Laban unloaded the camels, and he gave straw and feed to the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.
verses.textEn: So the man went to the house, and the camels were unloaded. Straw and fodder were brought for the camels, and water for him and his men to wash their feet.

verses.textZh: 然后在他面前摆上食物，但那人说："除非等我说完了我的事，我不会吃。"拉班说："请说。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后在他面前摆上食物，但那人说："除非等我说完了我的事，我不会吃。"拉班说："请说。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华大大地赐福给我主人，使他昌大，又赐给他羊群、牛群、金银、仆婢、骆驼，和驴。
verses.textEnNiv: Then food was set before him, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told you what I have to say." "Then tell us," Laban said.
verses.textEnEsv: Then food was set before him to eat. But he said, "I will not eat until I have said what I have to say." He said, "Speak on."
verses.textEnNkjv: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told about my errand." And he said, "Speak on."
verses.textEnNlt: Then food was served. But Abraham’s servant said, "I don’t want to eat until I have told you why I have come." "All right," Laban said, "tell us."
verses.textEnNasb: But when food was set before him to eat, he said, "I will not eat until I have stated my business." And he said, "Speak on."
verses.textEn: Then food was set before him, but he said, "I will not eat until I have told you what I have to say." "Then tell us," Laban said.

verses.textZh: 那人说："我是亚伯拉罕的仆人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人说："我是亚伯拉罕的仆人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的时候给我主人生了一个儿子；我主人也将一切所有的都给了这个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: So he said, "I am Abraham’s servant.
verses.textEnEsv: So he said, "I am Abraham’s servant.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "I am Abraham’s servant.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am Abraham’s servant," he explained.
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "I am Abraham’s servant.
verses.textEn: So he said, "I am Abraham’s servant.

verses.textZh: 耶和华厚厚地赐福我主人，他就昌大起来；耶和华又赐给他羊群、牛群、金银、仆婢、骆驼和驴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华厚厚地赐福我主人，他就昌大起来；耶和华又赐给他羊群、牛群、金银、仆婢、骆驼和驴。
verses.textZhCuv: 我主人叫我起誓说：『你不要为我儿子娶迦南地的女子为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord has blessed my master abundantly, and he has become wealthy. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord has greatly blessed my master, and he has become great. He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, camels and donkeys.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord has blessed my master greatly, and he has become great; and He has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.textEnNlt: "And the Lord has greatly blessed my master; he has become a wealthy man. The Lord has given him flocks of sheep and goats, herds of cattle, a fortune in silver and gold, and many male and female servants and camels and donkeys.
verses.textEnNasb: The Lord has greatly blessed my master, so that he has become rich; and He has given him flocks and herds, and silver and gold, and servants and slave women, and camels and donkeys.
verses.textEn: The Lord has blessed my master abundantly, and he has become wealthy. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, male and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

verses.textZh: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的时候，给我主人生了一个儿子。我主人也把他一切所有的都给了这个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的时候，给我主人生了一个儿子。我主人也把他一切所有的都给了这个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你要往我父家、我本族那里去，为我的儿子娶一个妻子。』
verses.textEnNiv: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and he has given him everything he owns.
verses.textEnEsv: And Sarah my master’s wife bore a son to my master when she was old, and to him he has given all that he has.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Sarah my master’s wife bore a son to my master when she was old; and to him he has given all that he has.
verses.textEnNlt: "When Sarah, my master’s wife, was very old, she gave birth to my master’s son, and my master has given him everything he owns.
verses.textEnNasb: Now my master’s wife Sarah bore a son to my master in her old age, and he has given him all that he has.
verses.textEn: My master’s wife Sarah has borne him a son in her old age, and he has given him everything he owns.

verses.textZh: 我主人要我起誓，说：‘你不可从我现在居住的迦南地中，为我的儿子娶迦南的女子为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我主人要我起誓，说：‘你不可从我现在居住的迦南地中，为我的儿子娶迦南的女子为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对我主人说：『恐怕女子不肯跟我来。』
verses.textEnNiv: And my master made me swear an oath, and said, ‘You must not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,
verses.textEnEsv: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now my master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I dwell;
verses.textEnNlt: And my master made me take an oath. He said, ‘Do not allow my son to marry one of these local Canaanite women.
verses.textEnNasb: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live;
verses.textEn: And my master made me swear an oath, and said, ‘You must not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

verses.textZh: 你要到我的父家，和我的族人那里去，为我的儿子娶一个妻子。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要到我的父家，和我的族人那里去，为我的儿子娶一个妻子。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他就说：『我所事奉的耶和华必要差遣他的使者与你同去，叫你的道路通达，你就得以在我父家、我本族那里，给我的儿子娶一个妻子。
verses.textEnNiv: but go to my father’s family and to my own clan, and get a wife for my son.’
verses.textEnEsv: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my clan and take a wife for my son.’
verses.textEnNkjv: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my family, and take a wife for my son.’
verses.textEnNlt: Go instead to my father’s house, to my relatives, and find a wife there for my son.’
verses.textEnNasb: but you shall go to my father’s house and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’
verses.textEn: but go to my father’s family and to my own clan, and get a wife for my son.’

verses.textZh: 我问我主人：‘如果那女子不愿跟我回来呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我问我主人：‘如果那女子不愿跟我回来呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 只要你到了我本族那里，我使你起的誓就与你无干。他们若不把女子交给你，我使你起的誓也与你无干。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’
verses.textEnEsv: I said to my master, ‘Perhaps the woman will not follow me.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And I said to my master, ‘Perhaps the woman will not follow me.’
verses.textEnNlt: "But I said to my master, ‘What if I can’t find a young woman who is willing to go back with me?’
verses.textEnNasb: Then I said to my master, ‘Suppose the woman does not follow me.’
verses.textEn: "Then I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’

verses.textZh: 他回答：‘我行事为人都在他面前的耶和华，必差派他的使者与你同去，使你的道路亨通，你就可以从我的族人和我的父家，给我的儿子娶一个妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答：‘我行事为人都在他面前的耶和华，必差派他的使者与你同去，使你的道路亨通，你就可以从我的族人和我的父家，给我的儿子娶一个妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我今日到了井旁，便说：『耶和华－我主人亚伯拉罕的神啊，愿你叫我所行的道路通达。
verses.textEnNiv: "He replied, ‘The Lord , before whom I have walked faithfully, will send his angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you can get a wife for my son from my own clan and from my father’s family.
verses.textEnEsv: But he said to me, ‘The Lord , before whom I have walked, will send his angel with you and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my clan and from my father’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said to me, ‘The Lord, before whom I walk, will send His angel with you and prosper your way; and you shall take a wife for my son from my family and from my father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: He responded, ‘The Lord , in whose presence I have lived, will send his angel with you and will make your mission successful. Yes, you must find a wife for my son from among my relatives, from my father’s family.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to me, ‘The Lord, before whom I have walked, will send His angel with you to make your journey successful, and you will take a wife for my son from my relatives and from my father’s house;
verses.textEn: "He replied, ‘The Lord , before whom I have walked faithfully, will send his angel with you and make your journey a success, so that you can get a wife for my son from my own clan and from my father’s family.
