verses.textEnNlt: "Well," they said, "we’ll call Rebekah and ask her what she thinks."
verses.textEnNasb: And they said, "We will call the young woman and ask her."
verses.textEn: Then they said, "Let’s call the young woman and ask her about it."

verses.textZh: 他们把利百加叫了来，问她："你愿意与这人同去吗？"她回答："我愿意去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把利百加叫了来，问她："你愿意与这人同去吗？"她回答："我愿意去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就给利百加祝福说： 我们的妹子啊，愿你作千万人的母！ 愿你的后裔得着仇敌的城门！
verses.textEnNiv: So they called Rebekah and asked her, "Will you go with this man?" "I will go," she said.
verses.textEnEsv: And they called Rebekah and said to her, "Will you go with this man?" She said, "I will go."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they called Rebekah and said to her, "Will you go with this man?" And she said, "I will go."
verses.textEnNlt: So they called Rebekah. "Are you willing to go with this man?" they asked her. And she replied, "Yes, I will go."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they called Rebekah and said to her, "Will you go with this man?" And she said, "I will go."
verses.textEn: So they called Rebekah and asked her, "Will you go with this man?" "I will go," she said.

verses.textZh: 于是，他们把自己的妹妹利百加，她的乳母和亚伯拉罕的仆人，以及同来的人，都打发走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，他们把自己的妹妹利百加，她的乳母和亚伯拉罕的仆人，以及同来的人，都打发走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 利百加和她的使女们起来，骑上骆驼，跟着那仆人，仆人就带着利百加走了。
verses.textEnNiv: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men.
verses.textEnEsv: So they sent away Rebekah their sister and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant and his men.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they sent away Rebekah their sister and her nurse, and Abraham’s servant and his men.
verses.textEnNlt: So they said good-bye to Rebekah and sent her away with Abraham’s servant and his men. The woman who had been Rebekah’s childhood nurse went along with her.
verses.textEnNasb: So they sent away their sister Rebekah and her nurse with Abraham’s servant and his men.
verses.textEn: So they sent their sister Rebekah on her way, along with her nurse and Abraham’s servant and his men.

verses.textZh: 他们给利百加祝福，对她说： "我们的妹妹啊， 愿你作千万人之母； 愿你的后裔， 占领仇敌的城门。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们给利百加祝福，对她说： "我们的妹妹啊， 愿你作千万人之母； 愿你的后裔， 占领仇敌的城门。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，以撒住在南地，刚从庇耳‧拉海‧莱回来。
verses.textEnNiv: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, "Our sister, may you increase to thousands upon thousands; may your offspring possess the cities of their enemies."
verses.textEnEsv: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, "Our sister, may you become thousands of ten thousands, and may your offspring possess the gate of those who hate him!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her: "Our sister, may you become Themotherof thousands of ten thousands; And may your descendants possess The gates of those who hate them."
verses.textEnNlt: They gave her this blessing as she parted: "Our sister, may you become the mother of many millions! May your descendants be strong and conquer the cities of their enemies."
verses.textEnNasb: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, "May you, our sister, Become thousands of ten thousands, And may your descendants possess The gate of those who hate them."
verses.textEn: And they blessed Rebekah and said to her, "Our sister, may you increase to thousands upon thousands; may your offspring possess the cities of their enemies."

verses.textZh: 利百加和她的众使女就起来，骑上骆驼，跟着那人走；那仆人就带着利百加走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利百加和她的众使女就起来，骑上骆驼，跟着那人走；那仆人就带着利百加走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 天将晚，以撒出来在田间默想，举目一看，见来了些骆驼。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Rebekah and her attendants got ready and mounted the camels and went back with the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Rebekah and her young women arose and rode on the camels and followed the man. Thus the servant took Rebekah and went his way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Rebekah and her maids arose, and they rode on the camels and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and departed.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Rebekah and her servant girls mounted the camels and followed the man. So Abraham’s servant took Rebekah and went on his way.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rebekah got up with her female attendants, and they mounted the camels and followed the man. So the servant took Rebekah and departed.
verses.textEn: Then Rebekah and her attendants got ready and mounted the camels and went back with the man. So the servant took Rebekah and left.

verses.textZh: 那时，以撒刚从庇耳．拉海．莱回来，他原本是住在南地的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，以撒刚从庇耳．拉海．莱回来，他原本是住在南地的。
verses.textZhCuv: 利百加举目看见以撒，就急忙下了骆驼，
verses.textEnNiv: Now Isaac had come from Beer Lahai Roi, for he was living in the Negev.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Isaac had returned from Beer-lahai-roi and was dwelling in the Negeb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he dwelt in the South.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Isaac, whose home was in the Negev, had returned from Beer-lahai-roi.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Isaac had come back from a journey to Beer-lahai-roi; for he was living in the Negev.
verses.textEn: Now Isaac had come from Beer Lahai Roi, for he was living in the Negev.

verses.textZh: 黄昏的时候，以撒出来田间默想。他举目观看，忽然看见来了些骆驼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 黄昏的时候，以撒出来田间默想。他举目观看，忽然看见来了些骆驼。
verses.textZhCuv: 问那仆人说：「这田间走来迎接我们的是谁？」仆人说：「是我的主人。」利百加就拿帕子蒙上脸。
verses.textEnNiv: He went out to the field one evening to meditate, and as he looked up, he saw camels approaching.
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field toward evening. And he lifted up his eyes and saw, and behold, there were camels coming.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field in the evening; and he lifted his eyes and looked, and there, the camels were coming.
verses.textEnNlt: One evening as he was walking and meditating in the fields, he looked up and saw the camels coming.
verses.textEnNasb: Isaac went out to meditate in the field toward evening; and he raised his eyes and looked, and behold, camels were coming.
verses.textEn: He went out to the field one evening to meditate, and as he looked up, he saw camels approaching.

verses.textZh: 利百加举目观看，看见了以撒，就下了骆驼，
verses.textZhCnvs: 利百加举目观看，看见了以撒，就下了骆驼，
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人就将所办的一切事都告诉以撒。
verses.textEnNiv: Rebekah also looked up and saw Isaac. She got down from her camel
verses.textEnEsv: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she dismounted from the camel
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Rebekah lifted her eyes, and when she saw Isaac she dismounted from her camel;
verses.textEnNlt: When Rebekah looked up and saw Isaac, she quickly dismounted from her camel.
verses.textEnNasb: Rebekah raised her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she dismounted from the camel.
verses.textEn: Rebekah also looked up and saw Isaac. She got down from her camel

verses.textZh: 问那仆人："在田间走来迎接我们的这人是谁？"仆人回答："他是我的主人。"利百加就拿面纱蒙在面上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问那仆人："在田间走来迎接我们的这人是谁？"仆人回答："他是我的主人。"利百加就拿面纱蒙在面上。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒便领利百加进了他母亲撒拉的帐棚，娶了她为妻，并且爱她。以撒自从他母亲不在了，这才得了安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: and asked the servant, "Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?" "He is my master," the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to the servant, "Who is that man, walking in the field to meet us?" The servant said, "It is my master." So she took her veil and covered herself.
verses.textEnNkjv: for she had said to the servant, "Who is this man walking in the field to meet us?" The servant said, "It is my master." So she took a veil and covered herself.
verses.textEnNlt: "Who is that man walking through the fields to meet us?" she asked the servant. And he replied, "It is my master." So Rebekah covered her face with her veil.
verses.textEnNasb: She said to the servant, "Who is that man walking in the field to meet us?" And the servant said, "He is my master." Then she took her veil and covered herself.
verses.textEn: and asked the servant, "Who is that man in the field coming to meet us?" "He is my master," the servant answered. So she took her veil and covered herself.

verses.textZh: 仆人把所作的一切事，都告诉以撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 仆人把所作的一切事，都告诉以撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 仆人把所作的一切事，都告诉以撒。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the servant told Isaac all he had done.
verses.textEnEsv: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the servant told Isaac everything he had done.
verses.textEnNasb: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.
verses.textEn: Then the servant told Isaac all he had done.

verses.textZh: 以撒领利百加进了他母亲撒拉的帐棚，并且娶了她。利百加就作了以撒的妻子。以撒爱利百加。以撒自从他母亲去世后，这才得了安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒领利百加进了他母亲撒拉的帐棚，并且娶了她。利百加就作了以撒的妻子。以撒爱利百加。以撒自从他母亲去世后，这才得了安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒领利百加进了他母亲撒拉的帐棚，并且娶了她。利百加就作了以撒的妻子。以撒爱利百加。以撒自从他母亲去世后，这才得了安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah, and he married Rebekah. So she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaac brought her into the tent of Sarah his mother and took Rebekah, and she became his wife, and he loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent; and he took Rebekah and she became his wife, and he loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
verses.textEnNlt: And Isaac brought Rebekah into his mother Sarah’s tent, and she became his wife. He loved her deeply, and she was a special comfort to him after the death of his mother.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and he took Rebekah, and she became his wife, and he loved her; so Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.
verses.textEn: Isaac brought her into the tent of his mother Sarah, and he married Rebekah. So she became his wife, and he loved her; and Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕又娶了一个妻子，名叫基土拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕又娶了一个妻子，名叫基土拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕又娶了一妻，名叫基土拉。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham had taken another wife, whose name was Keturah.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham took another wife, whose name was Keturah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Abraham again took a wife, and her name was Keturah.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham married another wife, whose name was Keturah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abraham took another wife, whose name was Keturah.
verses.textEn: Abraham had taken another wife, whose name was Keturah.

verses.textZh: 基土拉给他生了心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴和书亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基土拉给他生了心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴和书亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 基土拉给他生了心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴，和书亚。
verses.textEnNiv: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.
verses.textEnEsv: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.textEnNlt: She gave birth to Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.textEnNasb: She bore to him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
verses.textEn: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuah.

verses.textZh: 约珊生了示巴和底但，而底但的子孙是亚书利人、利都示人和利乌米人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约珊生了示巴和底但，而底但的子孙是亚书利人、利都示人和利乌米人。
verses.textZhCuv: 约珊生了示巴和底但。底但的子孙是亚书利族、利都是族，和利乌米族。
verses.textEnNiv: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan; the descendants of Dedan were the Ashurites, the Letushites and the Leummites.
verses.textEnEsv: Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Jokshan begot Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.textEnNlt: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan. Dedan’s descendants were the Asshurites, Letushites, and Leummites.
verses.textEnNasb: Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
verses.textEn: Jokshan was the father of Sheba and Dedan; the descendants of Dedan were the Ashurites, the Letushites and the Leummites.

verses.textZh: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大和以勒大。这些人都是基土拉的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大和以勒大。这些人都是基土拉的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大，和以勒大。这都是基土拉的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abidah, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
verses.textEnNlt: Midian’s sons were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. These were all descendants of Abraham through Keturah.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were the sons of Keturah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abida and Eldaah. All these were descendants of Keturah.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕把自己一切所有的都给了以撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕把自己一切所有的都给了以撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕将一切所有的都给了以撒。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham gave all he had to Isaac.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham gave everything he owned to his son Isaac.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac;
verses.textEn: Abraham left everything he owned to Isaac.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕把礼物分给他庶出的众子，在自己还活着的时候，就打发他们离开他的儿子以撒，向东面行，往东方的地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕把礼物分给他庶出的众子，在自己还活着的时候，就打发他们离开他的儿子以撒，向东面行，往东方的地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕把财物分给他庶出的众子，趁着自己还在世的时候打发他们离开他的儿子以撒，往东方去。
verses.textEnNiv: But while he was still living, he gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.
verses.textEnEsv: But to the sons of his concubines Abraham gave gifts, and while he was still living he sent them away from his son Isaac, eastward to the east country.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Abraham gave gifts to the sons of the concubines which Abraham had; and while he was still living he sent them eastward, away from Isaac his son, to the country of the east.
verses.textEnNlt: But before he died, he gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them off to a land in the east, away from Isaac.
verses.textEnNasb: but to the sons of his concubines, Abraham gave gifts while he was still living, and sent them away from his son Isaac eastward, to the land of the east.
verses.textEn: But while he was still living, he gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away from his son Isaac to the land of the east.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Abraham lived a hundred and seventy-five years.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life, 175 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the sum of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred and seventy-five years.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham lived for 175 years,
verses.textEnNasb: These are all the years of Abraham’s life that he lived, 175 years.
verses.textEn: Abraham lived a hundred and seventy-five years.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕寿高年老，享尽天年，气绝而死，归到他的先人那里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕寿高年老，享尽天年，气绝而死，归到他的先人那里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕寿高年迈，气绝而死，归到他列祖 那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abraham breathed his last and died at a good old age, an old man and full of years; and he was gathered to his people.
verses.textEnEsv: Abraham breathed his last and died in a good old age, an old man and full of years, and was gathered to his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abraham breathed his last and died in a good old age, an old man and full ofyears, and was gathered to his people.
verses.textEnNlt: and he died at a ripe old age, having lived a long and satisfying life. He breathed his last and joined his ancestors in death.
verses.textEnNasb: Abraham breathed his last and died at a good old age, an old man and satisfied with life; and he was gathered to his people.
verses.textEn: Then Abraham breathed his last and died at a good old age, an old man and full of years; and he was gathered to his people.

verses.textZh: 他的儿子以撒和以实玛利把他埋葬在麦比拉洞里。这洞是在幔利前面，赫人琐辖的儿子以弗仑的田间，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的儿子以撒和以实玛利把他埋葬在麦比拉洞里。这洞是在幔利前面，赫人琐辖的儿子以弗仑的田间，
verses.textZhCuv: 他两个儿子以撒、以实玛利把他埋葬在麦比拉洞里。这洞在幔利前、赫人琐辖的儿子以弗仑的田中，
verses.textEnNiv: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite,
verses.textEnEsv: Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, east of Mamre,
verses.textEnNkjv: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite,
verses.textEnNlt: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.
verses.textEnNasb: Then his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, facing Mamre,
verses.textEn: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite,

verses.textZh: 就是亚伯拉罕从赫人那里买来的那块田。亚伯拉罕和他的妻子撒拉都埋葬在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是亚伯拉罕从赫人那里买来的那块田。亚伯拉罕和他的妻子撒拉都埋葬在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是亚伯拉罕向赫人买的那块田。亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried with his wife Sarah.
verses.textEnEsv: the field that Abraham purchased from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried, with Sarah his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: the field which Abraham purchased from the sons of Heth. There Abraham was buried, and Sarah his wife.
verses.textEnNlt: This was the field Abraham had purchased from the Hittites and where he had buried his wife Sarah.
verses.textEnNasb: the field which Abraham purchased from the sons of Heth; there Abraham was buried with his wife Sarah.
verses.textEn: the field Abraham had bought from the Hittites. There Abraham was buried with his wife Sarah.

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕死后，神赐福给他的儿子以撒；那时，以撒住在庇耳．拉海．莱附近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕死后，神赐福给他的儿子以撒；那时，以撒住在庇耳．拉海．莱附近。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕死了以后，神赐福给他的儿子以撒。以撒靠近庇耳‧拉海‧莱居住。
verses.textEnNiv: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who then lived near Beer Lahai Roi.
verses.textEnEsv: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac his son. And Isaac settled at Beer-lahai-roi.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac. And Isaac dwelt at Beer Lahai Roi.
verses.textEnNlt: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who settled near Beer-lahai-roi in the Negev.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about after the death of Abraham, that God blessed his son Isaac; and Isaac lived by Beer-lahai-roi.
verses.textEn: After Abraham’s death, God blessed his son Isaac, who then lived near Beer Lahai Roi.

verses.textZh: 以下是撒拉的婢女埃及人夏甲，给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子以实玛利的后代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是撒拉的婢女埃及人夏甲，给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子以实玛利的后代。
verses.textZhCuv: 撒拉的使女埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子是以实玛利。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Sarah’s slave, Hagar the Egyptian, bore to Abraham.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this is the genealogy of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s maidservant, bore to Abraham.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of the family of Ishmael, the son of Abraham through Hagar, Sarah’s Egyptian servant.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the records of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s slave woman, bore to Abraham;
verses.textEn: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Ishmael, whom Sarah’s slave, Hagar the Egyptian, bore to Abraham.

verses.textZh: 以实玛利的众子，按着他们的家谱，名字如下：以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，其次是基达、押德别、米比衫、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以实玛利的众子，按着他们的家谱，名字如下：以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，其次是基达、押德别、米比衫、
verses.textZhCuv: 以实玛利儿子们的名字，按着他们的家谱记在下面。以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，又有基达、亚德别、米比衫、
verses.textEnNiv: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, listed in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEnEsv: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, named in the order of their birth: Nebaioth, the firstborn of Ishmael; and Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEnNkjv: And these were the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebajoth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEnNlt: Here is a list, by their names and clans, of Ishmael’s descendants: The oldest was Nebaioth, followed by Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEnNasb: and these are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, in the order of their birth: Nebaioth, the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.textEn: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, listed in the order of their birth: Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

verses.textZh: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、
verses.textZhCnvs: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、
verses.textZhCuv: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、
verses.textEnNiv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
verses.textEnEsv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
verses.textEnNkjv: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
verses.textEnNlt: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
verses.textEnNasb: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
verses.textEn: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

verses.textZh: 哈达、提玛、伊突、拿非施和基底玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈达、提玛、伊突、拿非施和基底玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈大、提玛、伊突、拿非施、基底玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah.
verses.textEnEsv: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Hadar, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
verses.textEnNlt: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
verses.textEnNasb: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
verses.textEn: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish and Kedemah.

verses.textZh: 这些都是以实玛利的儿子。他们的村庄和营地都按着他们的名字命名；他们作了十二族的族长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些都是以实玛利的儿子。他们的村庄和营地都按着他们的名字命名；他们作了十二族的族长。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是以实玛利众子的名字，照着他们的村庄、营寨，作了十二族的族长。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these are the names of the twelve tribal rulers according to their settlements and camps.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Ishmael and these are their names, by their villages and by their encampments, twelve princes according to their tribes.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Ishmael and these were their names, by their towns and their settlements, twelve princes according to their nations.
verses.textEnNlt: These twelve sons of Ishmael became the founders of twelve tribes named after them, listed according to the places they settled and camped.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Ishmael and these are their names, by their villages, and by their camps; twelve princes according to their tribes.
verses.textEn: These were the sons of Ishmael, and these are the names of the twelve tribal rulers according to their settlements and camps.

verses.textZh: 以实玛利一生的岁数，是一百三十七岁；他气绝而死，归到他的先人那里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以实玛利一生的岁数，是一百三十七岁；他气绝而死，归到他的先人那里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以实玛利享寿一百三十七岁，气绝而死，归到他列祖 那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Ishmael lived a hundred and thirty-seven years. He breathed his last and died, and he was gathered to his people.
verses.textEnEsv: (These are the years of the life of Ishmael: 137 years. He breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.)
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred and thirty-seven years; and he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
verses.textEnNlt: Ishmael lived for 137 years. Then he breathed his last and joined his ancestors in death.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the years of the life of Ishmael, 137 years; and he breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people.
verses.textEn: Ishmael lived a hundred and thirty-seven years. He breathed his last and died, and he was gathered to his people.

verses.textZh: 他的子孙住在哈腓拉直到埃及东面的书珥，通往亚述的道上。以实玛利却住在自己众兄弟的东面。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的子孙住在哈腓拉直到埃及东面的书珥，通往亚述的道上。以实玛利却住在自己众兄弟的东面。
verses.textZhCuv: 他子孙的住处在他众弟兄东边，从哈腓拉直到埃及前的书珥，正在亚述的道上。
verses.textEnNiv: His descendants settled in the area from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt, as you go toward Ashur. And they lived in hostility toward all the tribes related to them.
verses.textEnEsv: They settled from Havilah to Shur, which is opposite Egypt in the direction of Assyria. He settled over against all his kinsmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: (They dwelt from Havilah as far as Shur, which is east of Egypt as you go toward Assyria.) He died in the presence of all his brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: Ishmael’s descendants occupied the region from Havilah to Shur, which is east of Egypt in the direction of Asshur. There they lived in open hostility toward all their relatives.
verses.textEnNasb: They settled from Havilah to Shur which is east of Egypt going toward Assyria; he settled in defiance of all his relatives.
verses.textEn: His descendants settled in the area from Havilah to Shur, near the eastern border of Egypt, as you go toward Ashur. And they lived in hostility toward all the tribes related to them.

verses.textZh: 以下是亚伯拉罕的儿子以撒的后代。亚伯拉罕生以撒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是亚伯拉罕的儿子以撒的后代。亚伯拉罕生以撒。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕的儿子以撒的后代记在下面。亚伯拉罕生以撒。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham fathered Isaac,
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the genealogy of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham begot Isaac.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of the family of Isaac, the son of Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the records of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son: Abraham fathered Isaac;
verses.textEn: This is the account of the family line of Abraham’s son Isaac. Abraham became the father of Isaac,

verses.textZh: 以撒娶利百加为妻的时候，正四十岁。利百加是巴旦．亚兰地、亚兰人彼土利的女儿，是亚兰人拉班的妹妹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒娶利百加为妻的时候，正四十岁。利百加是巴旦．亚兰地、亚兰人彼土利的女儿，是亚兰人拉班的妹妹。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒娶利百加为妻的时候正四十岁。利百加是巴旦‧亚兰地的亚兰人彼土利的女儿，是亚兰人拉班的妹子。
verses.textEnNiv: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan Aram and sister of Laban the Aramean.
verses.textEnEsv: and Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Aramean, to be his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah as wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian.
verses.textEnNlt: When Isaac was forty years old, he married Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan-aram and the sister of Laban the Aramean.
verses.textEnNasb: and Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramean of Paddan-aram, the sister of Laban the Aramean, to be his wife.
verses.textEn: and Isaac was forty years old when he married Rebekah daughter of Bethuel the Aramean from Paddan Aram and sister of Laban the Aramean.

verses.textZh: 以撒因为自己的妻子不生育，就为她恳求耶和华。耶和华应允了他，他的妻子利百加就怀了孕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒因为自己的妻子不生育，就为她恳求耶和华。耶和华应允了他，他的妻子利百加就怀了孕。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒因他妻子不生育，就为她祈求耶和华；耶和华应允他的祈求，他的妻子利百加就怀了孕。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac prayed to the Lord on behalf of his wife, because she was childless. The Lord answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaac prayed to the Lord for his wife, because she was barren. And the Lord granted his prayer, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Isaac pleaded with the Lord for his wife, because she was barren; and the Lord granted his plea, and Rebekah his wife conceived.
verses.textEnNlt: Isaac pleaded with the Lord on behalf of his wife, because she was unable to have children. The Lord answered Isaac’s prayer, and Rebekah became pregnant with twins.
verses.textEnNasb: Isaac prayed to the Lord on behalf of his wife, because she was unable to have children; and the Lord answered him, and his wife Rebekah conceived.
verses.textEn: Isaac prayed to the Lord on behalf of his wife, because she was childless. The Lord answered his prayer, and his wife Rebekah became pregnant.

verses.textZh: 双胎在她腹中彼此碰撞，她就说："若是这样，我为甚么活着呢？"她就去求问耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 双胎在她腹中彼此碰撞，她就说："若是这样，我为甚么活着呢？"她就去求问耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 孩子们在她腹中彼此相争，她就说：「若是这样，我为什么活着呢 ？」她就去求问耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: The babies jostled each other within her, and she said, "Why is this happening to me?" So she went to inquire of the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: The children struggled together within her, and she said, "If it is thus, why is this happening to me?" So she went to inquire of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But the children struggled together within her; and she said, "If allis well, why amIlike this?" So she went to inquire of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But the two children struggled with each other in her womb. So she went to ask the Lord about it. "Why is this happening to me?" she asked.
verses.textEnNasb: But the children struggled together within her; and she said, "If it is so, why am I in this condition?" So she went to inquire of the Lord.
verses.textEn: The babies jostled each other within her, and she said, "Why is this happening to me?" So she went to inquire of the Lord .

verses.textZh: 耶和华回答她： "两国在你肚里， 两族从你腹中要分出来； 将来这族必强过那族， 大的要服事小的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华回答她： "两国在你肚里， 两族从你腹中要分出来； 将来这族必强过那族， 大的要服事小的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对她说： 两国在你腹内； 两族要从你身上出来。 这族必强于那族； 将来大的要服事小的。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord said to her, "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said to her, "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you shall be divided; the one shall be stronger than the other, the older shall serve the younger."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord said to her: "Two nations are in your womb, Two peoples shall be separated from your body; One people shall be stronger than the other, And the older shall serve the younger."
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord told her, "The sons in your womb will become two nations. From the very beginning, the two nations will be rivals. One nation will be stronger than the other; and your older son will serve your younger son."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord said to her, "Two nations are in your womb; And two peoples will be separated from your body; And one people will be stronger than the other; And the older will serve the younger."
verses.textEn: The Lord said to her, "Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples from within you will be separated; one people will be stronger than the other, and the older will serve the younger."

verses.textZh: 到了生产的时候，她肚腹中果然是一对双生子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了生产的时候，她肚腹中果然是一对双生子。
verses.textZhCuv: 生产的日子到了，腹中果然是双子。
verses.textEnNiv: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.
verses.textEnEsv: When her days to give birth were completed, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.textEnNkjv: So when her days were fulfilled forher to give birth, indeed therewere twins in her womb.
verses.textEnNlt: And when the time came to give birth, Rebekah discovered that she did indeed have twins!
verses.textEnNasb: When her days leading to the delivery were at an end, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.textEn: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

verses.textZh: 先出来的，全身赤红有毛，像毛衣一样，他们就给他起名叫以扫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 先出来的，全身赤红有毛，像毛衣一样，他们就给他起名叫以扫。
verses.textZhCuv: 先产的身体发红，浑身有毛，如同皮衣，他们就给他起名叫以扫 。
verses.textEnNiv: The first to come out was red, and his whole body was like a hairy garment; so they named him Esau.
verses.textEnEsv: The first came out red, all his body like a hairy cloak, so they called his name Esau.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the first came out red. Hewas like a hairy garment all over; so they called his name Esau.
verses.textEnNlt: The first one was very red at birth and covered with thick hair like a fur coat. So they named him Esau.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the first came out red, all over like a hairy garment; and they named him Esau.
verses.textEn: The first to come out was red, and his whole body was like a hairy garment; so they named him Esau.

verses.textZh: 随后，他的弟弟也出来了，他的手抓住以扫的脚跟，因此就给他起名叫雅各。利百加生下两个儿子的时候，以撒年正六十岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 随后，他的弟弟也出来了，他的手抓住以扫的脚跟，因此就给他起名叫雅各。利百加生下两个儿子的时候，以撒年正六十岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后又生了以扫的兄弟，手抓住以扫的脚跟，因此给他起名叫雅各 。利百加生下两个儿子的时候，以撒年正六十岁。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, his brother came out, with his hand grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah gave birth to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward his brother came out with his hand holding Esau’s heel, so his name was called Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward his brother came out, and his hand took hold of Esau’s heel; so his name was called Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the other twin was born with his hand grasping Esau’s heel. So they named him Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when the twins were born.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward his brother came out with his hand holding on to Esau’s heel, so he was named Jacob; and Isaac was sixty years old when she gave birth to them.
verses.textEn: After this, his brother came out, with his hand grasping Esau’s heel; so he was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when Rebekah gave birth to them.

verses.textZh: 两个孩子渐渐长大；以扫善于打猎，喜欢生活在田野；雅各为人安静，常常住在帐棚里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 两个孩子渐渐长大；以扫善于打猎，喜欢生活在田野；雅各为人安静，常常住在帐棚里。
verses.textZhCuv: 两个孩子渐渐长大，以扫善于打猎，常在田野；雅各为人安静，常住在帐棚里。
verses.textEnNiv: The boys grew up, and Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the open country, while Jacob was content to stay at home among the tents.
verses.textEnEsv: When the boys grew up, Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field, while Jacob was a quiet man, dwelling in tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the boys grew. And Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field; but Jacob was a mild man, dwelling in tents.
verses.textEnNlt: As the boys grew up, Esau became a skillful hunter. He was an outdoorsman, but Jacob had a quiet temperament, preferring to stay at home.
verses.textEnNasb: When the boys grew up, Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the field; but Jacob was a civilized man, living in tents.
verses.textEn: The boys grew up, and Esau became a skillful hunter, a man of the open country, while Jacob was content to stay at home among the tents.

verses.textZh: 以撒爱以扫，因为他常吃以扫的野味；利百加却爱雅各。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒爱以扫，因为他常吃以扫的野味；利百加却爱雅各。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒爱以扫，因为常吃他的野味；利百加却爱雅各。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac, who had a taste for wild game, loved Esau, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: Isaac loved Esau because he ate of his game, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Isaac loved Esau because he ate ofhis game, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: Isaac loved Esau because he enjoyed eating the wild game Esau brought home, but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Isaac loved Esau because he had a taste for game; but Rebekah loved Jacob.
verses.textEn: Isaac, who had a taste for wild game, loved Esau, but Rebekah loved Jacob.

verses.textZh: 有一次，雅各正在煮豆汤的时候，以扫从田野回来，疲乏得很。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，雅各正在煮豆汤的时候，以扫从田野回来，疲乏得很。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一天，雅各熬汤，以扫从田野回来累昏了。
verses.textEnNiv: Once when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the open country, famished.
verses.textEnEsv: Once when Jacob was cooking stew, Esau came in from the field, and he was exhausted.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jacob cooked a stew; and Esau came in from the field, and he was weary.
verses.textEnNlt: One day when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau arrived home from the wilderness exhausted and hungry.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jacob had cooked a stew one day, Esau came in from the field and he was exhausted;
verses.textEn: Once when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came in from the open country, famished.

verses.textZh: 以扫对雅各说："求你把这红豆汤给我喝吧，因为我疲乏得很。"因此，以扫的名字又叫以东。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫对雅各说："求你把这红豆汤给我喝吧，因为我疲乏得很。"因此，以扫的名字又叫以东。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫对雅各说：「我累昏了，求你把这红汤给我喝。」因此以扫又叫以东 。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to Jacob, "Quick, let me have some of that red stew! I’m famished!" (That is why he was also called Edom. )
verses.textEnEsv: And Esau said to Jacob, "Let me eat some of that red stew, for I am exhausted!" (Therefore his name was called Edom. )
verses.textEnNkjv: And Esau said to Jacob, "Please feed me with that same red stew, for I am weary." Therefore his name was called Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: Esau said to Jacob, "I’m starved! Give me some of that red stew!" (This is how Esau got his other name, Edom, which means "red.")
verses.textEnNasb: and Esau said to Jacob, "Please let me have a mouthful of that red stuff there, for I am exhausted." Therefore he was called Edom by name.
verses.textEn: He said to Jacob, "Quick, let me have some of that red stew! I’m famished!" (That is why he was also called Edom. )

verses.textZh: 雅各说："你要先把你的长子名分卖给我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各说："你要先把你的长子名分卖给我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各说：「你今日把长子的名分卖给我吧。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob replied, "First sell me your birthright."
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob said, "Sell me your birthright now."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jacob said, "Sell me your birthright as of this day."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," Jacob replied, "but trade me your rights as the firstborn son."
verses.textEnNasb: But Jacob said, " First sell me your birthright."
verses.textEn: Jacob replied, "First sell me your birthright."

verses.textZh: 以扫说："我快要死了，这长子名分对我有甚么益处呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫说："我快要死了，这长子名分对我有甚么益处呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫说：「我将要死，这长子的名分于我有什么益处呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "Look, I am about to die," Esau said. "What good is the birthright to me?"
verses.textEnEsv: Esau said, "I am about to die; of what use is a birthright to me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Esau said, "Look, I am about to die; so what is this birthright to me?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Look, I’m dying of starvation!" said Esau. "What good is my birthright to me now?"
verses.textEnNasb: Esau said, "Look, I am about to die; so of what use then is the birthright to me?"
verses.textEn: "Look, I am about to die," Esau said. "What good is the birthright to me?"

verses.textZh: 雅各说："你先向我起誓吧。"以扫就向他起了誓，把自己的长子名分卖给雅各。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各说："你先向我起誓吧。"以扫就向他起了誓，把自己的长子名分卖给雅各。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各说：「你今日对我起誓吧。」以扫就对他起了誓，把长子的名分卖给雅各。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jacob said, "Swear to me first." So he swore an oath to him, selling his birthright to Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob said, "Swear to me now." So he swore to him and sold his birthright to Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob said, "Swear to me as of this day." So he swore to him, and sold his birthright to Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jacob said, "First you must swear that your birthright is mine." So Esau swore an oath, thereby selling all his rights as the firstborn to his brother, Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jacob said, " First swear to me"; so he swore an oath to him, and sold his birthright to Jacob.
verses.textEn: But Jacob said, "Swear to me first." So he swore an oath to him, selling his birthright to Jacob.

verses.textZh: 于是，雅各把饼和红豆汤给了以扫；以扫吃了，喝了，就起来走了。以扫就这样轻看了他的长子名分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，雅各把饼和红豆汤给了以扫；以扫吃了，喝了，就起来走了。以扫就这样轻看了他的长子名分。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是雅各将饼和红豆汤给了以扫，以扫吃了喝了，便起来走了。这就是以扫轻看了他长子的名分。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob gave Esau some bread and some lentil stew. He ate and drank, and then got up and left. So Esau despised his birthright.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew, and he ate and drank and rose and went his way. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob gave Esau bread and stew of lentils; then he ate and drank, arose, and went his way. Thus Esau despised his birthright.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob gave Esau some bread and lentil stew. Esau ate the meal, then got up and left. He showed contempt for his rights as the firstborn.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew; and he ate and drank, and got up and went on his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
verses.textEn: Then Jacob gave Esau some bread and some lentil stew. He ate and drank, and then got up and left. So Esau despised his birthright.

verses.textZh: 从前在亚伯拉罕的时候，曾经有过一次饥荒，现在那地又有饥荒，以撒就到基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亚比米勒那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前在亚伯拉罕的时候，曾经有过一次饥荒，现在那地又有饥荒，以撒就到基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亚比米勒那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 在亚伯拉罕的日子，那地有一次饥荒；这时又有饥荒，以撒就往基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亚比米勒那里。
verses.textEnNiv: Now there was a famine in the land—besides the previous famine in Abraham’s time—and Isaac went to Abimelek king of the Philistines in Gerar.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was a famine in the land, besides the former famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Gerar to Abimelech king of the Philistines.
verses.textEnNkjv: There was a famine in the land, besides the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, in Gerar.
verses.textEnNlt: A severe famine now struck the land, as had happened before in Abraham’s time. So Isaac moved to Gerar, where Abimelech, king of the Philistines, lived.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was a famine in the land, besides the previous famine that had occurred in the days of Abraham. So Isaac went to Gerar, to Abimelech king of the Philistines.
verses.textEn: Now there was a famine in the land—besides the previous famine in Abraham’s time—and Isaac went to Abimelek king of the Philistines in Gerar.

verses.textZh: 耶和华向以撒显现，说："你不要下到埃及去，要住在我所指示你的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华向以撒显现，说："你不要下到埃及去，要住在我所指示你的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华向以撒显现，说：「你不要下埃及去，要住在我所指示你的地。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord appeared to Isaac and said, "Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land where I tell you to live.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord appeared to him and said, "Do not go down to Egypt; dwell in the land of which I shall tell you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord appeared to him and said: "Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land of which I shall tell you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord appeared to Isaac and said, "Do not go down to Egypt, but do as I tell you.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord appeared to him and said, "Do not go down to Egypt; stay in the land of which I shall tell you.
verses.textEn: The Lord appeared to Isaac and said, "Do not go down to Egypt; live in the land where I tell you to live.

verses.textZh: 你要寄居在这地，我必与你同在，必赐福给你，因为我要把这全地都赐给你和你的后裔，履行我向你父亲亚伯拉罕所起的誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要寄居在这地，我必与你同在，必赐福给你，因为我要把这全地都赐给你和你的后裔，履行我向你父亲亚伯拉罕所起的誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 你寄居在这地，我必与你同在，赐福给你，因为我要将这些地都赐给你和你的后裔。我必坚定我向你父亚伯拉罕所起的誓。
verses.textEnNiv: Stay in this land for a while, and I will be with you and will bless you. For to you and your descendants I will give all these lands and will confirm the oath I swore to your father Abraham.
verses.textEnEsv: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with you and will bless you, for to you and to your offspring I will give all these lands, and I will establish the oath that I swore to Abraham your father.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dwell in this land, and I will be with you and bless you; for to you and your descendants I give all these lands, and I will perform the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.
verses.textEnNlt: Live here as a foreigner in this land, and I will be with you and bless you. I hereby confirm that I will give all these lands to you and your descendants, just as I solemnly promised Abraham, your father.
verses.textEnNasb: Live for a time in this land and I will be with you and bless you, for to you and to your descendants I will give all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to your father Abraham.
verses.textEn: Stay in this land for a while, and I will be with you and will bless you. For to you and your descendants I will give all these lands and will confirm the oath I swore to your father Abraham.

verses.textZh: 我必使你的后裔增多，好象天上的星那样多；我必把这全地都赐给你的后裔；地上的万国都必因你的后裔得福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我必使你的后裔增多，好象天上的星那样多；我必把这全地都赐给你的后裔；地上的万国都必因你的后裔得福。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要加增你的后裔，像天上的星那样多，又要将这些地都赐给你的后裔。并且地上万国必因你的后裔得福－
verses.textEnNiv: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed,
verses.textEnEsv: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of heaven and will give to your offspring all these lands. And in your offspring all the nations of the earth shall be blessed,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I will make your descendants multiply as the stars of heaven; I will give to your descendants all these lands; and in your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed;
verses.textEnNlt: I will cause your descendants to become as numerous as the stars of the sky, and I will give them all these lands. And through your descendants all the nations of the earth will be blessed.
verses.textEnNasb: I will multiply your descendants as the stars of heaven, and will give your descendants all these lands; and by your descendants all the nations of the earth shall be blessed,
verses.textEn: I will make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and will give them all these lands, and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed,

verses.textZh: 这是因为亚伯拉罕听从了我的话，遵守了我的吩咐、我的命令、我的条例和我的律法。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是因为亚伯拉罕听从了我的话，遵守了我的吩咐、我的命令、我的条例和我的律法。"
verses.textZhCuv: 都因亚伯拉罕听从我的话，遵守我的吩咐和我的命令、律例、法度。」
verses.textEnNiv: because Abraham obeyed me and did everything I required of him, keeping my commands, my decrees and my instructions."
verses.textEnEsv: because Abraham obeyed my voice and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws."
verses.textEnNkjv: because Abraham obeyed My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes, and My laws."
verses.textEnNlt: I will do this because Abraham listened to me and obeyed all my requirements, commands, decrees, and instructions."
verses.textEnNasb: because Abraham obeyed Me and fulfilled his duty to Me, and kept My commandments, My statutes, and My laws."
verses.textEn: because Abraham obeyed me and did everything I required of him, keeping my commands, my decrees and my instructions."

verses.textZh: 于是，以撒就住在基拉耳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以撒就住在基拉耳。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒就住在基拉耳。
verses.textEnNiv: So Isaac stayed in Gerar.
verses.textEnEsv: So Isaac settled in Gerar.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Isaac dwelt in Gerar.
verses.textEnNlt: So Isaac stayed in Gerar.
verses.textEnNasb: So Isaac lived in Gerar.
verses.textEn: So Isaac stayed in Gerar.

verses.textZh: 那地方的人问起他的妻子，他就回答："她是我的妹妹。"因为他不敢说："她是我的妻子。"他心里想："恐怕这地方的人，因利百加的缘故把我杀了，因为她容貌美丽。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地方的人问起他的妻子，他就回答："她是我的妹妹。"因为他不敢说："她是我的妻子。"他心里想："恐怕这地方的人，因利百加的缘故把我杀了，因为她容貌美丽。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那地方的人问到他的妻子，他便说：「那是我的妹子。」原来他怕说：「是我的妻子」；他心里想：「恐怕这地方的人为利百加的缘故杀我」，因为她容貌俊美。
verses.textEnNiv: When the men of that place asked him about his wife, he said, "She is my sister," because he was afraid to say, "She is my wife." He thought, "The men of this place might kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is beautiful."
verses.textEnEsv: When the men of the place asked him about his wife, he said, "She is my sister," for he feared to say, "My wife," thinking, "lest the men of the place should kill me because of Rebekah," because she was attractive in appearance.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men of the place asked about his wife. And he said, "She is my sister"; for he was afraid to say, "Sheis my wife," becausehethought, "lest the men of the place kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to behold."
verses.textEnNlt: When the men who lived there asked Isaac about his wife, Rebekah, he said, "She is my sister." He was afraid to say, "She is my wife." He thought, "They will kill me to get her, because she is so beautiful."
verses.textEnNasb: When the men of the place asked about his wife, he said, "She is my sister," for he was afraid to say, "my wife," thinking, " the men of the place might kill me on account of Rebekah, since she is beautiful."
verses.textEn: When the men of that place asked him about his wife, he said, "She is my sister," because he was afraid to say, "She is my wife." He thought, "The men of this place might kill me on account of Rebekah, because she is beautiful."

verses.textZh: 以撒在那里住了很久。有一天，非利士人的王亚比米勒从窗户里向外观望，看见以撒正在爱抚他的妻子利百加。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒在那里住了很久。有一天，非利士人的王亚比米勒从窗户里向外观望，看见以撒正在爱抚他的妻子利百加。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在那里住了许久。有一天，非利士人的王亚比米勒从窗户里往外观看，见以撒和他的妻子利百加戏玩。
verses.textEnNiv: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelek king of the Philistines looked down from a window and saw Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.
verses.textEnEsv: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out of a window and saw Isaac laughing with Rebekah his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked through a window, and saw, and there was Isaac, showing endearment to Rebekah his wife.
verses.textEnNlt: But some time later, Abimelech, king of the Philistines, looked out his window and saw Isaac caressing Rebekah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked down through a window, and saw them, and behold, Isaac was caressing his wife Rebekah.
verses.textEn: When Isaac had been there a long time, Abimelek king of the Philistines looked down from a window and saw Isaac caressing his wife Rebekah.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒于是把以撒召了来，对他说："你看，她实在是你的妻子，你怎么说是你的妹妹呢？"以撒回答他："因为我心里想：‘恐怕我因她的缘故丧命。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒于是把以撒召了来，对他说："你看，她实在是你的妻子，你怎么说是你的妹妹呢？"以撒回答他："因为我心里想：‘恐怕我因她的缘故丧命。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒召了以撒来，对他说：「她实在是你的妻子，你怎么说她是你的妹子？」以撒说：「我心里想，恐怕我因她而死。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Abimelek summoned Isaac and said, "She is really your wife! Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?" Isaac answered him, "Because I thought I might lose my life on account of her."
verses.textEnEsv: So Abimelech called Isaac and said, "Behold, she is your wife. How then could you say, ‘She is my sister’?" Isaac said to him, "Because I thought, ‘Lest I die because of her.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech called Isaac and said, "Quite obviously she is your wife; so how could you say, ‘She is my sister’?" Isaac said to him, "Because I said, ‘Lest I die on account of her.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Immediately, Abimelech called for Isaac and exclaimed, "She is obviously your wife! Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?" "Because I was afraid someone would kill me to get her from me," Isaac replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abimelech called Isaac and said, "Behold, she certainly is your wife! So how is it that you said, ‘She is my sister’?" And Isaac said to him, "Because I thought, ‘otherwise I might be killed on account of her.’ "
verses.textEn: So Abimelek summoned Isaac and said, "She is really your wife! Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?" Isaac answered him, "Because I thought I might lose my life on account of her."

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒说："你向我们作的是甚么事呢？人民中间险些有人与你的妻子同睡，那你就把我们陷在罪恶里了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒说："你向我们作的是甚么事呢？人民中间险些有人与你的妻子同睡，那你就把我们陷在罪恶里了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒说：「你向我们做的是什么事呢？民中险些有人和你的妻同寝，把我们陷在罪里。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abimelek said, "What is this you have done to us? One of the men might well have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us."
verses.textEnEsv: Abimelech said, "What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abimelech said, "What is this you have done to us? One of the people might soon have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us."
verses.textEnNlt: "How could you do this to us?" Abimelech exclaimed. "One of my people might easily have taken your wife and slept with her, and you would have made us guilty of great sin."
verses.textEnNasb: And Abimelech said, "What is this that you have done to us? One of the people might easily have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us."
verses.textEn: Then Abimelek said, "What is this you have done to us? One of the men might well have slept with your wife, and you would have brought guilt upon us."

verses.textZh: 于是，亚比米勒吩咐全国人民，说："凡是触犯这人或是他的妻子的，必被处死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，亚比米勒吩咐全国人民，说："凡是触犯这人或是他的妻子的，必被处死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是亚比米勒晓谕众民说：「凡沾着这个人，或是他妻子的，定要把他治死。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Abimelek gave orders to all the people: "Anyone who harms this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."
verses.textEnEsv: So Abimelech warned all the people, saying, "Whoever touches this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Abimelech charged all his people, saying, "He who touches this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Abimelech issued a public proclamation: "Anyone who touches this man or his wife will be put to death!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, "He who touches this man or his wife will certainly be put to death."
verses.textEn: So Abimelek gave orders to all the people: "Anyone who harms this man or his wife shall surely be put to death."

verses.textZh: 以撒在那里耕种，那一年丰收百倍，耶和华实在赐福给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒在那里耕种，那一年丰收百倍，耶和华实在赐福给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒在那地耕种，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和华赐福给他，
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the Lord blessed him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaac sowed in that land and reaped in the same year a hundredfold. The Lord blessed him,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year a hundredfold; and the Lord blessed him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Isaac planted his crops that year, he harvested a hundred times more grain than he planted, for the Lord blessed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Isaac sowed in that land and reaped in the same year a hundred times as much. And the Lord blessed him,
verses.textEn: Isaac planted crops in that land and the same year reaped a hundredfold, because the Lord blessed him.

verses.textZh: 他就日渐昌大，越来越富有，成了个大富翁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就日渐昌大，越来越富有，成了个大富翁。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就昌大，日增月盛，成了大富户。
verses.textEnNiv: The man became rich, and his wealth continued to grow until he became very wealthy.
verses.textEnEsv: and the man became rich, and gained more and more until he became very wealthy.
verses.textEnNkjv: The man began to prosper, and continued prospering until he became very prosperous;
verses.textEnNlt: He became a very rich man, and his wealth continued to grow.
verses.textEnNasb: and the man became rich, and continued to grow richer until he became very wealthy;
verses.textEn: The man became rich, and his wealth continued to grow until he became very wealthy.

verses.textZh: 他拥有羊群、牛群和很多仆人，非利士人就嫉妒他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他拥有羊群、牛群和很多仆人，非利士人就嫉妒他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他有羊群牛群，又有许多仆人，非利士人就嫉妒他。
verses.textEnNiv: He had so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.
verses.textEnEsv: He had possessions of flocks and herds and many servants, so that the Philistines envied him.
verses.textEnNkjv: for he had possessions of flocks and possessions of herds and a great number of servants. So the Philistines envied him.
verses.textEnNlt: He acquired so many flocks of sheep and goats, herds of cattle, and servants that the Philistines became jealous of him.
verses.textEnNasb: for he had possessions of flocks and herds, and a great household, so that the Philistines envied him.
verses.textEn: He had so many flocks and herds and servants that the Philistines envied him.

verses.textZh: 他父亲亚伯拉罕在世的时候，所有由他父亲仆人挖的井，非利士人都塞住了，填满了土。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他父亲亚伯拉罕在世的时候，所有由他父亲仆人挖的井，非利士人都塞住了，填满了土。
verses.textZhCuv: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世的日子，他父亲的仆人所挖的井，非利士人全都塞住，填满了土。
verses.textEnNiv: So all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the time of his father Abraham, the Philistines stopped up, filling them with earth.
verses.textEnEsv: (Now the Philistines had stopped and filled with earth all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father.)
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Philistines had stopped up all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, and they had filled them with earth.
verses.textEnNlt: So the Philistines filled up all of Isaac’s wells with dirt. These were the wells that had been dug by the servants of his father, Abraham.
verses.textEnNasb: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of his father Abraham, the Philistines stopped up by filling them with dirt.
verses.textEn: So all the wells that his father’s servants had dug in the time of his father Abraham, the Philistines stopped up, filling them with earth.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒对以撒说："你离开我们去吧，因为你比我们强大得多了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒对以撒说："你离开我们去吧，因为你比我们强大得多了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒对以撒说：「你离开我们去吧。因为你比我们强盛得多。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Abimelek said to Isaac, "Move away from us; you have become too powerful for us."
verses.textEnEsv: And Abimelech said to Isaac, "Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Abimelech said to Isaac, "Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, Abimelech ordered Isaac to leave the country. "Go somewhere else," he said, "for you have become too powerful for us."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abimelech said to Isaac, "Go away from us, for you are too powerful for us."
verses.textEn: Then Abimelek said to Isaac, "Move away from us; you have become too powerful for us."

verses.textZh: 以撒于是离开那里，在基拉耳谷支搭帐棚，住在那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒于是离开那里，在基拉耳谷支搭帐棚，住在那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒就离开那里，在基拉耳谷支搭帐棚，住在那里。
verses.textEnNiv: So Isaac moved away from there and encamped in the Valley of Gerar, where he settled.
verses.textEnEsv: So Isaac departed from there and encamped in the Valley of Gerar and settled there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaac departed from there and pitched his tent in the Valley of Gerar, and dwelt there.
verses.textEnNlt: So Isaac moved away to the Gerar Valley, where he set up their tents and settled down.
verses.textEnNasb: So Isaac departed from there and camped in the Valley of Gerar, and settled there.
verses.textEn: So Isaac moved away from there and encamped in the Valley of Gerar, where he settled.

verses.textZh: 他父亲亚伯拉罕在世的时候，仆人所挖的水井，在亚伯拉罕死后都被非利士人塞住了。以撒重新挖掘这些井，仍然照着他父亲所起的名字叫它们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他父亲亚伯拉罕在世的时候，仆人所挖的水井，在亚伯拉罕死后都被非利士人塞住了。以撒重新挖掘这些井，仍然照着他父亲所起的名字叫它们。
verses.textZhCuv: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世之日所挖的水井因非利士人在亚伯拉罕死后塞住了，以撒就重新挖出来，仍照他父亲所叫的叫那些井的名字。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the time of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died, and he gave them the same names his father had given them.
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaac dug again the wells of water that had been dug in the days of Abraham his father, which the Philistines had stopped after the death of Abraham. And he gave them the names that his father had given them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Isaac dug again the wells of water which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them up after the death of Abraham. He called them by the names which his father had called them.
verses.textEnNlt: He reopened the wells his father had dug, which the Philistines had filled in after Abraham’s death. Isaac also restored the names Abraham had given them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaac dug again the wells of water which had been dug in the days of his father Abraham, for the Philistines had stopped them up after the death of Abraham; and he gave them the same names which his father had given them.
verses.textEn: Isaac reopened the wells that had been dug in the time of his father Abraham, which the Philistines had stopped up after Abraham died, and he gave them the same names his father had given them.

verses.textZh: 以撒的仆人在山谷里挖井，在那里挖得一口活水井。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒的仆人在山谷里挖井，在那里挖得一口活水井。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒的仆人在谷中挖井，便得了一口活水井。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and discovered a well of fresh water there.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and found there a well of spring water,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found a well of running water there.
verses.textEnNlt: Isaac’s servants also dug in the Gerar Valley and discovered a well of fresh water.
verses.textEnNasb: But when Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and found there a well of flowing water,
verses.textEn: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley and discovered a well of fresh water there.

verses.textZh: 基拉耳的牧人与以撒的牧人争闹起来，说："这水是我们的。"以撒就给那井起名叫埃色，因为他们与他相争。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基拉耳的牧人与以撒的牧人争闹起来，说："这水是我们的。"以撒就给那井起名叫埃色，因为他们与他相争。
verses.textZhCuv: 基拉耳的牧人与以撒的牧人争竞，说：「这水是我们的。」以撒就给那井起名叫埃色 ，因为他们和他相争。
verses.textEnNiv: But the herders of Gerar quarreled with those of Isaac and said, "The water is ours!" So he named the well Esek, because they disputed with him.
verses.textEnEsv: the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, "The water is ours." So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, "The water is ours." So he called the name of the well Esek, because they quarreled with him.
verses.textEnNlt: But then the shepherds from Gerar came and claimed the spring. "This is our water," they said, and they argued over it with Isaac’s herdsmen. So Isaac named the well Esek (which means "argument").
verses.textEnNasb: the herdsmen of Gerar quarreled with the herdsmen of Isaac, saying, "The water is ours!" So he named the well Esek, because they argued with him.
verses.textEn: But the herders of Gerar quarreled with those of Isaac and said, "The water is ours!" So he named the well Esek, because they disputed with him.

verses.textZh: 以撒的仆人又挖了另一口井，他们又为这井争闹起来，因此以撒给这井起名叫西提拿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒的仆人又挖了另一口井，他们又为这井争闹起来，因此以撒给这井起名叫西提拿。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒的仆人又挖了一口井，他们又为这井争竞，因此以撒给这井起名叫西提拿 。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they dug another well, but they quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they dug another well, and they quarreled over that also, so he called its name Sitnah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they dug another well, and they quarreled over that one also. So he called its name Sitnah.
verses.textEnNlt: Isaac’s men then dug another well, but again there was a dispute over it. So Isaac named it Sitnah (which means "hostility").
verses.textEnNasb: Then they dug another well, and they quarreled over it too, so he named it Sitnah.
verses.textEn: Then they dug another well, but they quarreled over that one also; so he named it Sitnah.

verses.textZh: 以撒离开那里，又挖了另一口井；他们不再为这井争闹了，他就给那井起名利河伯，因为他说："现在耶和华给我们宽阔的地方，我们必在这里繁盛起来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒离开那里，又挖了另一口井；他们不再为这井争闹了，他就给那井起名利河伯，因为他说："现在耶和华给我们宽阔的地方，我们必在这里繁盛起来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒离开那里，又挖了一口井，他们不为这井争竞了，他就给那井起名叫利河伯 。他说：「耶和华现在给我们宽阔之地，我们必在这地昌盛。」
verses.textEnNiv: He moved on from there and dug another well, and no one quarreled over it. He named it Rehoboth, saying, "Now the Lord has given us room and we will flourish in the land."
verses.textEnEsv: And he moved from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it. So he called its name Rehoboth, saying, "For now the Lord has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he moved from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it. So he called its name Rehoboth, because he said, "For now the Lord has made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land."
verses.textEnNlt: Abandoning that one, Isaac moved on and dug another well. This time there was no dispute over it, so Isaac named the place Rehoboth (which means "open space"), for he said, "At last the Lord has created enough space for us to prosper in this land."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he moved away from there and dug another well, and they did not quarrel over it; so he named it Rehoboth, for he said, " At last the Lord has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land."
verses.textEn: He moved on from there and dug another well, and no one quarreled over it. He named it Rehoboth, saying, "Now the Lord has given us room and we will flourish in the land."

verses.textZh: 以撒从那里上到别是巴去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒从那里上到别是巴去。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒从那里上别是巴去。
verses.textEnNiv: From there he went up to Beersheba.
verses.textEnEsv: From there he went up to Beersheba.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he went up from there to Beersheba.
verses.textEnNlt: From there Isaac moved to Beersheba,
verses.textEnNasb: And he went up from there to Beersheba.
verses.textEn: From there he went up to Beersheba.

verses.textZh: 那天晚上，耶和华向他显现，说： "我是你父亲亚伯拉罕的神； 你不要怕，因为我与你同在； 我必为了我仆人亚伯拉罕的缘故， 赐福给你，使你的后裔增多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天晚上，耶和华向他显现，说： "我是你父亲亚伯拉罕的神； 你不要怕，因为我与你同在； 我必为了我仆人亚伯拉罕的缘故， 赐福给你，使你的后裔增多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜耶和华向他显现，说：「我是你父亲亚伯拉罕的神，不要惧怕！因为我与你同在，要赐福给你，并要为我仆人亚伯拉罕的缘故，使你的后裔繁多。」
verses.textEnNiv: That night the Lord appeared to him and said, "I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bless you and will increase the number of your descendants for the sake of my servant Abraham."
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord appeared to him the same night and said, "I am the God of Abraham your father. Fear not, for I am with you and will bless you and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord appeared to him the same night and said, "I am the God of your father Abraham; do not fear, for I am with you. I will bless you and multiply your descendants for My servant Abraham’s sake."
verses.textEnNlt: where the Lord appeared to him on the night of his arrival. "I am the God of your father, Abraham," he said. "Do not be afraid, for I am with you and will bless you. I will multiply your descendants, and they will become a great nation. I will do this because of my promise to Abraham, my servant."
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord appeared to him the same night and said, "I am the God of your father Abraham; Do not fear, for I am with you. I will bless you and multiply your descendants, For the sake of My servant Abraham."
verses.textEn: That night the Lord appeared to him and said, "I am the God of your father Abraham. Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bless you and will increase the number of your descendants for the sake of my servant Abraham."

verses.textZh: 以撒就在那里筑了一座祭坛，呼求耶和华的名；又在那里支搭帐棚；以撒的仆人也在那里挖了一口井。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒就在那里筑了一座祭坛，呼求耶和华的名；又在那里支搭帐棚；以撒的仆人也在那里挖了一口井。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒就在那里筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名，并且支搭帐棚；他的仆人便在那里挖了一口井。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the Lord . There he pitched his tent, and there his servants dug a well.
verses.textEnEsv: So he built an altar there and called upon the name of the Lord and pitched his tent there. And there Isaac’s servants dug a well.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he built an altar there and called on the name of the Lord, and he pitched his tent there; and there Isaac’s servants dug a well.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaac built an altar there and worshiped the Lord . He set up his camp at that place, and his servants dug another well.
verses.textEnNasb: So he built an altar there and called upon the name of the Lord, and pitched his tent there; and there Isaac’s servants dug a well.
verses.textEn: Isaac built an altar there and called on the name of the Lord . There he pitched his tent, and there his servants dug a well.

verses.textZh: 亚比米勒和他的朋友亚户撒，以及他的军长非各，从基拉耳来到以撒那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚比米勒和他的朋友亚户撒，以及他的军长非各，从基拉耳来到以撒那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚比米勒，同他的朋友亚户撒和他的军长非各，从基拉耳来见以撒。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, Abimelek had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his personal adviser and Phicol the commander of his forces.
verses.textEnEsv: When Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his adviser and Phicol the commander of his army,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Abimelech came to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath, one of his friends, and Phichol the commander of his army.
verses.textEnNlt: One day King Abimelech came from Gerar with his adviser, Ahuzzath, and also Phicol, his army commander.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Abimelech came to him from Gerar with his adviser Ahuzzath, and Phicol the commander of his army.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, Abimelek had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his personal adviser and Phicol the commander of his forces.

verses.textZh: 以撒问他们："你们既然恨我，把我从你们中间赶出来，为甚么又到我这里来呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒问他们："你们既然恨我，把我从你们中间赶出来，为甚么又到我这里来呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒对他们说：「你们既然恨我，打发我走了，为什么到我这里来呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac asked them, "Why have you come to me, since you were hostile to me and sent me away?"
verses.textEnEsv: Isaac said to them, "Why have you come to me, seeing that you hate me and have sent me away from you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Isaac said to them, "Why have you come to me, since you hate me and have sent me away from you?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why have you come here?" Isaac asked. "You obviously hate me, since you kicked me off your land."
verses.textEnNasb: Isaac said to them, "Why have you come to me, since you hate me and have sent me away from you?"
verses.textEn: Isaac asked them, "Why have you come to me, since you were hostile to me and sent me away?"

verses.textZh: 他们回答："我们实在看见耶和华与你同在，因此我们想：‘不如我们双方起誓。’让我们与你立约吧；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："我们实在看见耶和华与你同在，因此我们想：‘不如我们双方起誓。’让我们与你立约吧；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「我们明明地看见耶和华与你同在，便说，不如我们两下彼此起誓，彼此立约，
verses.textEnNiv: They answered, "We saw clearly that the Lord was with you; so we said, ‘There ought to be a sworn agreement between us’—between us and you. Let us make a treaty with you
verses.textEnEsv: They said, "We see plainly that the Lord has been with you. So we said, let there be a sworn pact between us, between you and us, and let us make a covenant with you,
verses.textEnNkjv: But they said, "We have certainly seen that the Lord is with you. So we said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, between you and us; and let us make a covenant with you,
verses.textEnNlt: They replied, "We can plainly see that the Lord is with you. So we want to enter into a sworn treaty with you. Let’s make a covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: They said, "We have seen plainly that the Lord has been with you; so we said, ‘An oath must now be taken by us,’ that is, by you and us. So let us make a covenant with you,
verses.textEn: They answered, "We saw clearly that the Lord was with you; so we said, ‘There ought to be a sworn agreement between us’—between us and you. Let us make a treaty with you

verses.textZh: 你不要伤害我们，正如我们从来没有触犯你，只有善待你，让你平平安安地离开。现在你是蒙耶和华赐福的了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你不要伤害我们，正如我们从来没有触犯你，只有善待你，让你平平安安地离开。现在你是蒙耶和华赐福的了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 使你不害我们，正如我们未曾害你，一味地厚待你，并且打发你平平安安地走。你是蒙耶和华赐福的了。」
verses.textEnNiv: that you will do us no harm, just as we did not harm you but always treated you well and sent you away peacefully. And now you are blessed by the Lord ."
verses.textEnEsv: that you will do us no harm, just as we have not touched you and have done to you nothing but good and have sent you away in peace. You are now the blessed of the Lord ."
verses.textEnNkjv: that you will do us no harm, since we have not touched you, and since we have done nothing to you but good and have sent you away in peace. You are now the blessed of the Lord.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Swear that you will not harm us, just as we have never troubled you. We have always treated you well, and we sent you away from us in peace. And now look how the Lord has blessed you!"
verses.textEnNasb: that you will do us no harm, just as we have not touched you and have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace. You are now the blessed of the Lord."
verses.textEn: that you will do us no harm, just as we did not harm you but always treated you well and sent you away peacefully. And now you are blessed by the Lord ."

verses.textZh: 以撒就为他们摆设筵席，他们就一起吃喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒就为他们摆设筵席，他们就一起吃喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒就为他们设摆筵席，他们便吃了喝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac then made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.
verses.textEnEsv: So he made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
verses.textEnNlt: So Isaac prepared a covenant feast to celebrate the treaty, and they ate and drank together.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he made them a feast, and they ate and drank.
verses.textEn: Isaac then made a feast for them, and they ate and drank.

verses.textZh: 第二天，他们清早起来，彼此起誓；以撒就送他们走，他们平平安安地离开他走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第二天，他们清早起来，彼此起誓；以撒就送他们走，他们平平安安地离开他走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们清早起来彼此起誓。以撒打发他们走，他们就平平安安地离开他走了。
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning the men swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they went away peacefully.
verses.textEnEsv: In the morning they rose early and exchanged oaths. And Isaac sent them on their way, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they arose early in the morning and swore an oath with one another; and Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.
verses.textEnNlt: Early the next morning, they each took a solemn oath not to interfere with each other. Then Isaac sent them home again, and they left him in peace.
verses.textEnNasb: In the morning they got up early and exchanged oaths; then Isaac sent them away, and they left him in peace.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning the men swore an oath to each other. Then Isaac sent them on their way, and they went away peacefully.

verses.textZh: 那一天，以撒的仆人来把他们挖井的事告诉他，说："我们找到水了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，以撒的仆人来把他们挖井的事告诉他，说："我们找到水了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那一天，以撒的仆人来，将挖井的事告诉他说：「我们得了水了。」
verses.textEnNiv: That day Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. They said, "We’ve found water!"
verses.textEnEsv: That same day Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well that they had dug and said to him, "We have found water."
verses.textEnNkjv: It came to pass the same day that Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well which they had dug, and said to him, "We have found water."
verses.textEnNlt: That very day Isaac’s servants came and told him about a new well they had dug. "We’ve found water!" they exclaimed.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about on the same day, that Isaac’s servants came in and told him about the well which they had dug, and said to him, "We have found water."
verses.textEn: That day Isaac’s servants came and told him about the well they had dug. They said, "We’ve found water!"

verses.textZh: 以撒就给那井起名叫示巴，因此那城名叫别是巴，直到今日。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒就给那井起名叫示巴，因此那城名叫别是巴，直到今日。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就给那井起名叫示巴；因此那城叫做别是巴，直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: He called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the town has been Beersheba.
verses.textEnEsv: He called it Shibah; therefore the name of the city is Beersheba to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he called it Shebah. Therefore the name of the city is Beersheba to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: So Isaac named the well Shibah (which means "oath"). And to this day the town that grew up there is called Beersheba (which means "well of the oath").
verses.textEnNasb: So he called it Shibah; therefore the name of the city is Beersheba to this day.
verses.textEn: He called it Shibah, and to this day the name of the town has been Beersheba.

verses.textZh: 以扫四十岁的时候，娶了赫人比利的女儿犹滴，和赫人以伦的女儿巴实抹为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫四十岁的时候，娶了赫人比利的女儿犹滴，和赫人以伦的女儿巴实抹为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫四十岁的时候娶了赫人比利的女儿犹滴，与赫人以伦的女儿巴实抹为妻。

verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when Isaac was old and his eyes were too dim to see, that he called his older son Esau and said to him, "My son." And he said to him, "Here I am."
verses.textEn: When Isaac was old and his eyes were so weak that he could no longer see, he called for Esau his older son and said to him, "My son." "Here I am," he answered.

verses.textEnNiv: Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing."
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me; now sit up and eat of my game, that your soul may bless me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn; I have done just as you told me; please arise, sit and eat of my game, that your soul may bless me."
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob replied, "It’s Esau, your firstborn son. I’ve done as you told me. Here is the wild game. Now sit up and eat it so you can give me your blessing."
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn; I have done as you told me. Come now, sit and eat of my game, so that you may bless me."
verses.textEn: Jacob said to his father, "I am Esau your firstborn. I have done as you told me. Please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing."

verses.textZh: 以撒问他的儿子："我儿啊，你怎么这样快就猎到了呢？"雅各回答："因为耶和华你的神叫我碰着好机会。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒问他的儿子："我儿啊，你怎么这样快就猎到了呢？"雅各回答："因为耶和华你的神叫我碰着好机会。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒对他儿子说：「我儿，你如何找得这么快呢？」他说：「因为耶和华－你的神使我遇见好机会得着的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac asked his son, "How did you find it so quickly, my son?" "The Lord your God gave me success," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: But Isaac said to his son, "How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?" He answered, "Because the Lord your God granted me success."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Isaac said to his son, "How isit that you have found it so quickly, my son?" And he said, "Because the Lord your God brought it to me."
verses.textEnNlt: Isaac asked, "How did you find it so quickly, my son?" "The Lord your God put it in my path!" Jacob replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Isaac said to his son, "How is it that you have it so quickly, my son?" And he said, "Because the Lord your God made it come to me."
verses.textEn: Isaac asked his son, "How did you find it so quickly, my son?" "The Lord your God gave me success," he replied.

verses.textZh: 以撒对雅各说："我儿啊，你上前来，让我摸摸你，看看你是不是我的儿子以扫。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒对雅各说："我儿啊，你上前来，让我摸摸你，看看你是不是我的儿子以扫。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒对雅各说：「我儿，你近前来，我摸摸你，知道你真是我的儿子以扫不是。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Come near so I can touch you, my son, to know whether you really are my son Esau or not."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, to know whether you are really my son Esau or not."
verses.textEnNkjv: Isaac said to Jacob, "Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Come closer so I can touch you and make sure that you really are Esau."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Please come close, so that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not."
verses.textEn: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Come near so I can touch you, my son, to know whether you really are my son Esau or not."

verses.textZh: 雅各就走近他父亲以撒身边，以撒摸着他，说："声音是雅各的声音，手却是以扫的手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各就走近他父亲以撒身边，以撒摸着他，说："声音是雅各的声音，手却是以扫的手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就挨近他父亲以撒。以撒摸着他，说：「声音是雅各的声音，手却是以扫的手。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob went close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, "The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau."
verses.textEnEsv: So Jacob went near to Isaac his father, who felt him and said, "The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob went near to Isaac his father, and he felt him and said, "The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau."
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob went closer to his father, and Isaac touched him. "The voice is Jacob’s, but the hands are Esau’s," Isaac said.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob came close to his father Isaac, and he touched him and said, "The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau."
verses.textEn: Jacob went close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, "The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau."

verses.textZh: 以撒认不出他来，因为他的手上有毛，好象他哥哥以扫的手一样，于是给他祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒认不出他来，因为他的手上有毛，好象他哥哥以扫的手一样，于是给他祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒就辨不出他来；因为他手上有毛，像他哥哥以扫的手一样，就给他祝福；
