verses.textEnNiv: He did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he proceeded to bless him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau’s hands; so he blessed him.
verses.textEnNlt: But he did not recognize Jacob, because Jacob’s hands felt hairy just like Esau’s. So Isaac prepared to bless Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: And he did not recognize him, because his hands were hairy like his brother Esau’s hands; so he blessed him.
verses.textEn: He did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he proceeded to bless him.

verses.textZh: 以撒问："你真是我的儿子以扫吗？"他回答："我是。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒问："你真是我的儿子以扫吗？"他回答："我是。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「你真是我儿子以扫吗？」他说：「我是。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Are you really my son Esau?" he asked. "I am," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Are you really my son Esau?" He answered, "I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Are you really my son Esau?" He said, "I am."
verses.textEnNlt: "But are you really my son Esau?" he asked. "Yes, I am," Jacob replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Are you really my son Esau?" And he said, "I am."
verses.textEn: "Are you really my son Esau?" he asked. "I am," he replied.

verses.textZh: 以撒说："把食物递给我，好让我吃我儿子的猎物，我就给你祝福。"雅各把食物递给他，他就吃了；又拿酒给他，他也喝了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒说："把食物递给我，好让我吃我儿子的猎物，我就给你祝福。"雅各把食物递给他，他就吃了；又拿酒给他，他也喝了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒说：「你递给我，我好吃我儿子的野味，给你祝福。」雅各就递给他，他便吃了，又拿酒给他，他也喝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he said, "My son, bring me some of your game to eat, so that I may give you my blessing." Jacob brought it to him and he ate; and he brought some wine and he drank.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "Bring it near to me, that I may eat of my son’s game and bless you." So he brought it near to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.
verses.textEnNkjv: He said, "Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s game, so that my soul may bless you." So he brought it near to him, and he ate; and he brought him wine, and he drank.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaac said, "Now, my son, bring me the wild game. Let me eat it, and then I will give you my blessing." So Jacob took the food to his father, and Isaac ate it. He also drank the wine that Jacob served him.
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "Bring it to me, and I will eat of my son’s game, that I may bless you." And he brought it to him, and he ate; he also brought him wine and he drank.
verses.textEn: Then he said, "My son, bring me some of your game to eat, so that I may give you my blessing." Jacob brought it to him and he ate; and he brought some wine and he drank.

verses.textZh: 他父亲以撒对他说："我儿啊，你上前来，和我亲吻。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他父亲以撒对他说："我儿啊，你上前来，和我亲吻。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他父亲以撒对他说：「我儿，你上前来与我亲嘴。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come here, my son, and kiss me."
verses.textEnEsv: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come near and kiss me, my son."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come near now and kiss me, my son."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Isaac said to Jacob, "Please come a little closer and kiss me, my son."
verses.textEnNasb: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Please come close and kiss me, my son."
verses.textEn: Then his father Isaac said to him, "Come here, my son, and kiss me."

verses.textZh: 他就上前和父亲亲吻；他父亲一闻到他衣服的香气，就给他祝福，说： "看哪，我儿子的香气， 好象蒙耶和华赐福的田地所发出的香气一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就上前和父亲亲吻；他父亲一闻到他衣服的香气，就给他祝福，说： "看哪，我儿子的香气， 好象蒙耶和华赐福的田地所发出的香气一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就上前与父亲亲嘴。他父亲一闻他衣服上的香气，就给他祝福，说： 我儿的香气 如同耶和华赐福之田地的香气一样。
verses.textEnNiv: So he went to him and kissed him. When Isaac caught the smell of his clothes, he blessed him and said, "Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the Lord has blessed.
verses.textEnEsv: So he came near and kissed him. And Isaac smelled the smell of his garments and blessed him and said, "See, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field that the Lord has blessed!
verses.textEnNkjv: And he came near and kissed him; and he smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him and said: "Surely, the smell of my son Is like the smell of a field Which the Lord has blessed.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob went over and kissed him. And when Isaac caught the smell of his clothes, he was finally convinced, and he blessed his son. He said, "Ah! The smell of my son is like the smell of the outdoors, which the Lord has blessed!
verses.textEnNasb: So he came close and kissed him; and when he smelled the smell of his garments, he blessed him and said, "See, the smell of my son Is like the smell of a field which the Lord has blessed;
verses.textEn: So he went to him and kissed him. When Isaac caught the smell of his clothes, he blessed him and said, "Ah, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field that the Lord has blessed.

verses.textZh: 愿神赐给你 天上的甘露， 地上的沃土， 以及大量五谷和美酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿神赐给你 天上的甘露， 地上的沃土， 以及大量五谷和美酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿神赐你天上的甘露， 地上的肥土， 并许多五谷新酒。
verses.textEnNiv: May God give you heaven’s dew and earth’s richness— an abundance of grain and new wine.
verses.textEnEsv: May God give you of the dew of heaven and of the fatness of the earth and plenty of grain and wine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore may God give you Of the dew of heaven, Of the fatness of the earth, And plenty of grain and wine.
verses.textEnNlt: "From the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth, may God always give you abundant harvests of grain and bountiful new wine.
verses.textEnNasb: Now may God give you of the dew of heaven, And of the fatness of the earth, And an abundance of grain and new wine;
verses.textEn: May God give you heaven’s dew and earth’s richness— an abundance of grain and new wine.

verses.textZh: 愿万民服事你， 愿万族向你下拜， 愿你作你兄弟的主人， 愿你母亲的子孙向你下拜。 咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅； 给你祝福的，愿他蒙福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿万民服事你， 愿万族向你下拜， 愿你作你兄弟的主人， 愿你母亲的子孙向你下拜。 咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅； 给你祝福的，愿他蒙福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿多民事奉你， 多国跪拜你。 愿你作你弟兄的主； 你母亲的儿子向你跪拜。 凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅； 为你祝福的，愿他蒙福。
verses.textEnNiv: May nations serve you and peoples bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you be blessed."
verses.textEnEsv: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and may your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you, and blessed be everyone who blesses you!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Let peoples serve you, And nations bow down to you. Be master over your brethren, And let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you, And blessed be those who bless you!"
verses.textEnNlt: May many nations become your servants, and may they bow down to you. May you be the master over your brothers, and may your mother’s sons bow down to you. All who curse you will be cursed, and all who bless you will be blessed."
verses.textEnNasb: May peoples serve you, And nations bow down to you; Be master of your brothers, And may your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be those who curse you, And blessed be those who bless you."
verses.textEn: May nations serve you and peoples bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers, and may the sons of your mother bow down to you. May those who curse you be cursed and those who bless you be blessed."

verses.textZh: 以撒给雅各祝福完了，雅各刚刚从他父亲以撒那里出来的时候，他哥哥以扫就打猎回来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒给雅各祝福完了，雅各刚刚从他父亲以撒那里出来的时候，他哥哥以扫就打猎回来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒为雅各祝福已毕，雅各从他父亲那里才出来，他哥哥以扫正打猎回来，
verses.textEnNiv: After Isaac finished blessing him, and Jacob had scarcely left his father’s presence, his brother Esau came in from hunting.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, when Jacob had scarcely gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it happened, as soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had scarcely gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, that Esau his brother came in from his hunting.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and almost before Jacob had left his father, Esau returned from his hunt.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, as soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had hardly gone out from the presence of his father Isaac, that his brother Esau came in from his hunting.
verses.textEn: After Isaac finished blessing him, and Jacob had scarcely left his father’s presence, his brother Esau came in from hunting.

verses.textZh: 他也预备了美味的食物，拿来给他父亲，对他说："请我父起来，吃你儿子的猎物，好给我祝福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也预备了美味的食物，拿来给他父亲，对他说："请我父起来，吃你儿子的猎物，好给我祝福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 也做了美味，拿来给他父亲，说：「请父亲起来，吃你儿子的野味，好给我祝福。」
verses.textEnNiv: He too prepared some tasty food and brought it to his father. Then he said to him, "My father, please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing."
verses.textEnEsv: He also prepared delicious food and brought it to his father. And he said to his father, "Let my father arise and eat of his son’s game, that you may bless me."
verses.textEnNkjv: He also had made savory food, and brought it to his father, and said to his father, "Let my father arise and eat of his son’s game, that your soul may bless me."
verses.textEnNlt: Esau prepared a delicious meal and brought it to his father. Then he said, "Sit up, my father, and eat my wild game so you can give me your blessing."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he also made a delicious meal, and brought it to his father; and he said to his father, "Let my father arise and eat of his son’s game, that you may bless me."
verses.textEn: He too prepared some tasty food and brought it to his father. Then he said to him, "My father, please sit up and eat some of my game, so that you may give me your blessing."

verses.textZh: 他父亲以撒问他："你是谁？"他回答："我就是你的长子以扫。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他父亲以撒问他："你是谁？"他回答："我就是你的长子以扫。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他父亲以撒对他说：「你是谁？」他说：「我是你的长子以扫。」
verses.textEnNiv: His father Isaac asked him, "Who are you?" "I am your son," he answered, "your firstborn, Esau."
verses.textEnEsv: His father Isaac said to him, "Who are you?" He answered, "I am your son, your firstborn, Esau."
verses.textEnNkjv: And his father Isaac said to him, "Who are you?" So he said, "I am your son, your firstborn, Esau."
verses.textEnNlt: But Isaac asked him, "Who are you?" Esau replied, "It’s your son, your firstborn son, Esau."
verses.textEnNasb: His father Isaac said to him, "Who are you?" And he said, "I am your son, your firstborn, Esau."
verses.textEn: His father Isaac asked him, "Who are you?" "I am your son," he answered, "your firstborn, Esau."

verses.textZh: 以撒就大大地战兢起来，说："那么，刚才去打猎又拿猎物给我的是谁呢？在你未来以先，我已经吃了，又给他祝福了；他将来必定蒙福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒就大大地战兢起来，说："那么，刚才去打猎又拿猎物给我的是谁呢？在你未来以先，我已经吃了，又给他祝福了；他将来必定蒙福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒就大大地战兢，说：「你未来之先，是谁得了野味拿来给我呢？我已经吃了，为他祝福；他将来也必蒙福。」
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac trembled violently and said, "Who was it, then, that hunted game and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came and I blessed him—and indeed he will be blessed!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaac trembled very violently and said, "Who was it then that hunted game and brought it to me, and I ate it all before you came, and I have blessed him? Yes, and he shall be blessed."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaac trembled exceedingly, and said, "Who? Where is the one who hunted game and brought it to me? I ate all ofit before you came, and I have blessed him— and indeed he shall be blessed."
verses.textEnNlt: Isaac began to tremble uncontrollably and said, "Then who just served me wild game? I have already eaten it, and I blessed him just before you came. And yes, that blessing must stand!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaac trembled violently, and said, "Who then was he who hunted game and brought it to me, so that I ate from all of it before you came, and blessed him? Yes, and he shall be blessed."
verses.textEn: Isaac trembled violently and said, "Who was it, then, that hunted game and brought it to me? I ate it just before you came and I blessed him—and indeed he will be blessed!"

verses.textZh: 以扫听了他父亲的话，就非常痛心，放声大哭，对他父亲说："我父啊，求你也给我祝福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫听了他父亲的话，就非常痛心，放声大哭，对他父亲说："我父啊，求你也给我祝福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫听了他父亲的话，就放声痛哭，说：「我父啊，求你也为我祝福！」
verses.textEnNiv: When Esau heard his father’s words, he burst out with a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, "Bless me—me too, my father!"
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Esau heard the words of his father, he cried out with an exceedingly great and bitter cry and said to his father, "Bless me, even me also, O my father!"
verses.textEnNkjv: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, "Bless me—me also, O my father!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Esau heard his father’s words, he let out a loud and bitter cry. "Oh my father, what about me? Bless me, too!" he begged.
verses.textEnNasb: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried out with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, "Bless me, me as well, my father!"
verses.textEn: When Esau heard his father’s words, he burst out with a loud and bitter cry and said to his father, "Bless me—me too, my father!"

verses.textZh: 以撒说："你弟弟已经前来，用诡计把你的祝福夺去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒说："你弟弟已经前来，用诡计把你的祝福夺去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒说：「你兄弟已经用诡计来将你的福分夺去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But he said, "Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing."
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "Your brother came deceitfully, and he has taken away your blessing."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said, "Your brother came with deceit and has taken away your blessing."
verses.textEnNlt: But Isaac said, "Your brother was here, and he tricked me. He has taken away your blessing."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Your brother came deceitfully and has taken away your blessing."
verses.textEn: But he said, "Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing."

verses.textZh: 以扫说："他名叫雅各不是很对吗？因为他欺骗了我两次。从前他夺去我的长子名分，现在他又夺去我的祝福。"以扫又说："你再没有祝福留给我吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫说："他名叫雅各不是很对吗？因为他欺骗了我两次。从前他夺去我的长子名分，现在他又夺去我的祝福。"以扫又说："你再没有祝福留给我吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫说：「他名雅各，岂不是正对吗？因为他欺骗了我两次：他从前夺了我长子的名分，你看，他现在又夺了我的福分。」以扫又说：「你没有留下为我可祝的福吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: Esau said, "Isn’t he rightly named Jacob ? This is the second time he has taken advantage of me: He took my birthright, and now he’s taken my blessing!" Then he asked, "Haven’t you reserved any blessing for me?"
verses.textEnEsv: Esau said, "Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has cheated me these two times. He took away my birthright, and behold, now he has taken away my blessing." Then he said, "Have you not reserved a blessing for me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Esau said, "Is he not rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright, and now look, he has taken away my blessing!" And he said, "Have you not reserved a blessing for me?"
verses.textEnNlt: Esau exclaimed, "No wonder his name is Jacob, for now he has cheated me twice. First he took my rights as the firstborn, and now he has stolen my blessing. Oh, haven’t you saved even one blessing for me?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Esau said, " Is he not rightly named Jacob, for he has betrayed me these two times? He took away my birthright, and behold, now he has taken away my blessing." And he said, "Have you not reserved a blessing for me?"
verses.textEn: Esau said, "Isn’t he rightly named Jacob ? This is the second time he has taken advantage of me: He took my birthright, and now he’s taken my blessing!" Then he asked, "Haven’t you reserved any blessing for me?"

verses.textZh: 以撒回答以扫，说："我已经立他作你的主人，又把他所有的兄弟给了他作仆人，并且把五谷和美酒供给他了。我儿啊，我还可以为你作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒回答以扫，说："我已经立他作你的主人，又把他所有的兄弟给了他作仆人，并且把五谷和美酒供给他了。我儿啊，我还可以为你作甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒回答以扫说：「我已立他为你的主，使他的弟兄都给他作仆人，并赐他五谷新酒可以养生。我儿，现在我还能为你做什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac answered Esau, "I have made him lord over you and have made all his relatives his servants, and I have sustained him with grain and new wine. So what can I possibly do for you, my son?"
verses.textEnEsv: Isaac answered and said to Esau, "Behold, I have made him lord over you, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants, and with grain and wine I have sustained him. What then can I do for you, my son?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaac answered and said to Esau, "Indeed I have made him your master, and all his brethren I have given to him as servants; with grain and wine I have sustained him. What shall I do now for you, my son?"
verses.textEnNlt: Isaac said to Esau, "I have made Jacob your master and have declared that all his brothers will be his servants. I have guaranteed him an abundance of grain and wine—what is left for me to give you, my son?"
verses.textEnNasb: But Isaac replied to Esau, "Behold, I have made him your master, and I have given to him all his relatives as servants; and with grain and new wine I have sustained him. What then can I do for you, my son?"
verses.textEn: Isaac answered Esau, "I have made him lord over you and have made all his relatives his servants, and I have sustained him with grain and new wine. So what can I possibly do for you, my son?"

verses.textZh: 以扫问他的父亲："我父啊，你只有一个祝福吗？我父啊，求你也给我祝福。"以扫就放声大哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫问他的父亲："我父啊，你只有一个祝福吗？我父啊，求你也给我祝福。"以扫就放声大哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫对他父亲说：「父啊，你只有一样可祝的福吗？我父啊，求你也为我祝福！」以扫就放声而哭。
verses.textEnNiv: Esau said to his father, "Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, my father!" Then Esau wept aloud.
verses.textEnEsv: Esau said to his father, "Have you but one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, O my father." And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Esau said to his father, "Have you only one blessing, my father? Bless me—me also, O my father!" And Esau lifted up his voice and wept.
verses.textEnNlt: Esau pleaded, "But do you have only one blessing? Oh my father, bless me, too!" Then Esau broke down and wept.
verses.textEnNasb: Esau said to his father, "Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me, me as well, my father." So Esau raised his voice and wept.
verses.textEn: Esau said to his father, "Do you have only one blessing, my father? Bless me too, my father!" Then Esau wept aloud.

verses.textZh: 他父亲以撒回答他，说： "你住的地方必远离地上的沃土， 远离天上的甘露。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他父亲以撒回答他，说： "你住的地方必远离地上的沃土， 远离天上的甘露。
verses.textZhCuv: 他父亲以撒说： 地上的肥土必为你所住； 天上的甘露必为你所得。
verses.textEnNiv: His father Isaac answered him, "Your dwelling will be away from the earth’s richness, away from the dew of heaven above.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaac his father answered and said to him: "Behold, away from the fatness of the earth shall your dwelling be, and away from the dew of heaven on high.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaac his father answered and said to him: "Behold, your dwelling shall be of the fatness of the earth, And of the dew of heaven from above.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, his father, Isaac, said to him, "You will live away from the richness of the earth, and away from the dew of the heaven above.
verses.textEnNasb: Then his father Isaac answered and said to him, "Behold, away from the fertility of the earth shall be your dwelling, And away from the dew of heaven from above.
verses.textEn: His father Isaac answered him, "Your dwelling will be away from the earth’s richness, away from the dew of heaven above.

verses.textZh: 你必依靠刀剑生活， 你必服事你的弟弟； 到你自由的时候， 你必从你的颈项上挣脱他的轭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必依靠刀剑生活， 你必服事你的弟弟； 到你自由的时候， 你必从你的颈项上挣脱他的轭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你必倚靠刀剑度日， 又必事奉你的兄弟； 到你强盛的时候， 必从你颈项上挣开他的轭。
verses.textEnNiv: You will live by the sword and you will serve your brother. But when you grow restless, you will throw his yoke from off your neck."
verses.textEnEsv: By your sword you shall live, and you shall serve your brother; but when you grow restless you shall break his yoke from your neck."
verses.textEnNkjv: By your sword you shall live, And you shall serve your brother; And it shall come to pass, when you become restless, That you shall break his yoke from your neck."
verses.textEnNlt: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. But when you decide to break free, you will shake his yoke from your neck."
verses.textEnNasb: "And by your sword you shall live, And you shall serve your brother; But it shall come about when you become restless, That you will break his yoke from your neck."
verses.textEn: You will live by the sword and you will serve your brother. But when you grow restless, you will throw his yoke from off your neck."

verses.textZh: 以扫因为他父亲给雅各所祝的福，就怀恨雅各；以扫心里想："为我父亲守丧的时候近了，到时我必杀我的弟弟雅各。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫因为他父亲给雅各所祝的福，就怀恨雅各；以扫心里想："为我父亲守丧的时候近了，到时我必杀我的弟弟雅各。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫因他父亲给雅各祝的福，就怨恨雅各，心里说：「为我父亲居丧的日子近了，到那时候，我要杀我的兄弟雅各。」
verses.textEnNiv: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. He said to himself, "The days of mourning for my father are near; then I will kill my brother Jacob."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father had blessed him, and Esau said to himself, "The days of mourning for my father are approaching; then I will kill my brother Jacob."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him, and Esau said in his heart, "The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then I will kill my brother Jacob."
verses.textEnNlt: From that time on, Esau hated Jacob because their father had given Jacob the blessing. And Esau began to scheme: "I will soon be mourning my father’s death. Then I will kill my brother, Jacob."
verses.textEnNasb: So Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing with which his father had blessed him; and Esau said to himself, "The days of mourning for my father are near; then I will kill my brother Jacob."
verses.textEn: Esau held a grudge against Jacob because of the blessing his father had given him. He said to himself, "The days of mourning for my father are near; then I will kill my brother Jacob."

verses.textZh: 有人把利百加大儿子以扫所说的话告诉了利百加，她就派人把她小儿子雅各叫了来，对他说："你哥哥以扫想要杀你，报仇雪恨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人把利百加大儿子以扫所说的话告诉了利百加，她就派人把她小儿子雅各叫了来，对他说："你哥哥以扫想要杀你，报仇雪恨。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人把利百加大儿子以扫的话告诉利百加，她就打发人去，叫了她小儿子雅各来，对他说：「你哥哥以扫想要杀你，报仇雪恨。
verses.textEnNiv: When Rebekah was told what her older son Esau had said, she sent for her younger son Jacob and said to him, "Your brother Esau is planning to avenge himself by killing you.
verses.textEnEsv: But the words of Esau her older son were told to Rebekah. So she sent and called Jacob her younger son and said to him, "Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the words of Esau her older son were told to Rebekah. So she sent and called Jacob her younger son, and said to him, "Surely your brother Esau comforts himself concerning you byintending to kill you.
verses.textEnNlt: But Rebekah heard about Esau’s plans. So she sent for Jacob and told him, "Listen, Esau is consoling himself by plotting to kill you.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the words of her elder son Esau were reported to Rebekah, she sent word and called her younger son Jacob, and said to him, "Behold your brother Esau is consoling himself concerning you by planning to kill you.
verses.textEn: When Rebekah was told what her older son Esau had said, she sent for her younger son Jacob and said to him, "Your brother Esau is planning to avenge himself by killing you.

verses.textZh: 我儿啊，现在你要听我的话；起来，逃到哈兰我哥哥拉班那里去吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我儿啊，现在你要听我的话；起来，逃到哈兰我哥哥拉班那里去吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在，我儿，你要听我的话：起来，逃往哈兰、我哥哥拉班那里去，
verses.textEnNiv: Now then, my son, do what I say: Flee at once to my brother Laban in Harran.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban my brother in Haran
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice: arise, flee to my brother Laban in Haran.
verses.textEnNlt: So listen carefully, my son. Get ready and flee to my brother, Laban, in Haran.
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, my son, obey my voice, and arise, flee to Haran, to my brother Laban!
verses.textEn: Now then, my son, do what I say: Flee at once to my brother Laban in Harran.

verses.textZh: 与他住些时日，等到你哥哥的怒气消了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 与他住些时日，等到你哥哥的怒气消了。
verses.textZhCuv: 同他住些日子，直等你哥哥的怒气消了。
verses.textEnNiv: Stay with him for a while until your brother’s fury subsides.
verses.textEnEsv: and stay with him a while, until your brother’s fury turns away—
verses.textEnNkjv: And stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away,
verses.textEnNlt: Stay there with him until your brother cools off.
verses.textEnNasb: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury subsides,
verses.textEn: Stay with him for a while until your brother’s fury subsides.

verses.textZh: 你哥哥对你消了怒气，忘记了你对他所作的事，我就派人去把你从那里接回来。我何必在一日之内丧失你们两个呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你哥哥对你消了怒气，忘记了你对他所作的事，我就派人去把你从那里接回来。我何必在一日之内丧失你们两个呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你哥哥向你消了怒气，忘了你向他所做的事，我便打发人去把你从那里带回来。为什么一日丧你们二人呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When your brother is no longer angry with you and forgets what you did to him, I’ll send word for you to come back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?"
verses.textEnEsv: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send and bring you from there. Why should I be bereft of you both in one day?"
verses.textEnNkjv: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him; then I will send and bring you from there. Why should I be bereaved also of you both in one day?"
verses.textEnNlt: When he calms down and forgets what you have done to him, I will send for you to come back. Why should I lose both of you in one day?"
verses.textEnNasb: until your brother’s anger against you subsides and he forgets what you did to him. Then I will send word and get you from there. Why should I lose you both in one day?"
verses.textEn: When your brother is no longer angry with you and forgets what you did to him, I’ll send word for you to come back from there. Why should I lose both of you in one day?"

verses.textZh: 利百加对以撒说："我因为这些赫人女子，连性命都厌恶了。如果雅各也从这地的女子中，娶了像这样的赫人女子为妻，那我活着还有甚么意思呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 利百加对以撒说："我因为这些赫人女子，连性命都厌恶了。如果雅各也从这地的女子中，娶了像这样的赫人女子为妻，那我活着还有甚么意思呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 利百加对以撒说：「我因这赫人的女子连性命都厌烦了；倘若雅各也娶赫人的女子为妻，像这些一样，我活着还有什么益处呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, "I’m disgusted with living because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a wife from among the women of this land, from Hittite women like these, my life will not be worth living."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, "I loathe my life because of the Hittite women. If Jacob marries one of the Hittite women like these, one of the women of the land, what good will my life be to me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Rebekah said to Isaac, "I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth; if Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, like these whoare the daughters of the land, what good will my life be to me?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, "I’m sick and tired of these local Hittite women! I would rather die than see Jacob marry one of them."
verses.textEnNasb: And Rebekah said to Isaac, "I am tired of living because of the daughters of Heth; if Jacob takes a wife from the daughters of Heth like these from the daughters of the land, what good will my life be to me?"
verses.textEn: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, "I’m disgusted with living because of these Hittite women. If Jacob takes a wife from among the women of this land, from Hittite women like these, my life will not be worth living."

verses.textZh: 以撒把雅各叫了来，给他祝福，并且吩咐他，说："你不可娶迦南的女子为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒把雅各叫了来，给他祝福，并且吩咐他，说："你不可娶迦南的女子为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒叫了雅各来，给他祝福，并嘱咐他说：「你不要娶迦南的女子为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. Then he commanded him: "Do not marry a Canaanite woman.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaac called Jacob and blessed him and directed him, "You must not take a wife from the Canaanite women.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Isaac called Jacob and blessed him, and charged him, and said to him: "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: So Isaac called for Jacob, blessed him, and said, "You must not marry any of these Canaanite women.
verses.textEnNasb: So Isaac called Jacob and blessed him and commanded him, saying to him, "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan.
verses.textEn: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. Then he commanded him: "Do not marry a Canaanite woman.

verses.textZh: 起来，到巴旦．亚兰你外祖父彼土利的家里去，在那里娶你舅父拉班的一个女儿为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 起来，到巴旦．亚兰你外祖父彼土利的家里去，在那里娶你舅父拉班的一个女儿为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 你起身往巴旦‧亚兰去，到你外祖彼土利家里，在你母舅拉班的女儿中娶一女为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: Go at once to Paddan Aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel. Take a wife for yourself there, from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
verses.textEnEsv: Arise, go to Paddan-aram to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father, and take as your wife from there one of the daughters of Laban your mother’s brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: Arise, go to Padan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father; and take yourself a wife from there of the daughters of Laban your mother’s brother.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, go at once to Paddan-aram, to the house of your grandfather Bethuel, and marry one of your uncle Laban’s daughters.
verses.textEnNasb: Arise, go to Paddan-aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father; and from there take to yourself a wife from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
verses.textEn: Go at once to Paddan Aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel. Take a wife for yourself there, from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

verses.textZh: 愿全能的神赐福给你，使你繁衍增多，成为大族。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿全能的神赐福给你，使你繁衍增多，成为大族。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿全能的神赐福给你，使你生养众多，成为多族，
verses.textEnNiv: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and increase your numbers until you become a community of peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, that you may become a company of peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: "May God Almighty bless you, And make you fruitful and multiply you, That you may be an assembly of peoples;
verses.textEnNlt: May God Almighty bless you and give you many children. And may your descendants multiply and become many nations!
verses.textEnNasb: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, so that you may become a multitude of peoples.
verses.textEn: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and increase your numbers until you become a community of peoples.

verses.textZh: 愿神把应许给亚伯拉罕的福，赐给你和你的后裔，使你可以得着你寄居的地为业，就是神赐给亚伯拉罕的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿神把应许给亚伯拉罕的福，赐给你和你的后裔，使你可以得着你寄居的地为业，就是神赐给亚伯拉罕的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 将应许亚伯拉罕的福赐给你和你的后裔，使你承受你所寄居的地为业，就是神赐给亚伯拉罕的地。」
verses.textEnNiv: May he give you and your descendants the blessing given to Abraham, so that you may take possession of the land where you now reside as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham."
verses.textEnEsv: May he give the blessing of Abraham to you and to your offspring with you, that you may take possession of the land of your sojournings that God gave to Abraham!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And give you the blessing of Abraham, To you and your descendants with you, That you may inherit the land In which you are a stranger, Which God gave to Abraham."
verses.textEnNlt: May God pass on to you and your descendants the blessings he promised to Abraham. May you own this land where you are now living as a foreigner, for God gave this land to Abraham."
verses.textEnNasb: May He also give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your descendants with you, so that you may possess the land where you live as a stranger, which God gave to Abraham."
verses.textEn: May he give you and your descendants the blessing given to Abraham, so that you may take possession of the land where you now reside as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham."

verses.textZh: 于是，以撒打发雅各去了，雅各就往巴旦．亚兰去，到了亚兰人彼土利的儿子拉班那里。拉班就是雅各和以扫的母亲利百加的哥哥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以撒打发雅各去了，雅各就往巴旦．亚兰去，到了亚兰人彼土利的儿子拉班那里。拉班就是雅各和以扫的母亲利百加的哥哥。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒打发雅各走了，他就往巴旦‧亚兰去，到亚兰人彼土利的儿子拉班那里。拉班是雅各、以扫的母舅。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Isaac sent Jacob on his way, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Isaac sent Jacob away. And he went to Paddan-aram, to Laban, the son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Padan Aram, to Laban the son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.textEnNlt: So Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Paddan-aram to stay with his uncle Laban, his mother’s brother, the son of Bethuel the Aramean.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaac sent Jacob away, and he went to Paddan-aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.textEn: Then Isaac sent Jacob on his way, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.

verses.textZh: 以扫见以撒给雅各祝福，又打发他到巴旦．亚兰去，在那里娶妻；又见以撒给雅各祝福的时候，吩咐他说："你不可娶迦南的女子为妻"；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫见以撒给雅各祝福，又打发他到巴旦．亚兰去，在那里娶妻；又见以撒给雅各祝福的时候，吩咐他说："你不可娶迦南的女子为妻"；
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫见以撒已经给雅各祝福，而且打发他往巴旦‧亚兰去，在那里娶妻，并见祝福的时候嘱咐他说：「不要娶迦南的女子为妻」，
verses.textEnNiv: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and had sent him to Paddan Aram to take a wife from there, and that when he blessed him he commanded him, "Do not marry a Canaanite woman,"
verses.textEnEsv: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan-aram to take a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he directed him, "You must not take a wife from the Canaanite women,"
verses.textEnNkjv: Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Padan Aram to take himself a wife from there, andthat as he blessed him he gave him a charge, saying, "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan,"
verses.textEnNlt: Esau knew that his father, Isaac, had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to find a wife, and that he had warned Jacob, "You must not marry a Canaanite woman."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan-aram to take to himself a wife from there, and that when he blessed him he commanded him, saying, "You shall not take a wife from the daughters of Canaan,"
verses.textEn: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and had sent him to Paddan Aram to take a wife from there, and that when he blessed him he commanded him, "Do not marry a Canaanite woman,"

verses.textZh: 又见雅各听从了他父母的话，到巴旦．亚兰去了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 又见雅各听从了他父母的话，到巴旦．亚兰去了；
verses.textZhCuv: 又见雅各听从父母的话往巴旦‧亚兰去了，
verses.textEnNiv: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.
verses.textEnEsv: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and his mother and gone to Paddan-aram.
verses.textEnNkjv: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and his mother and had gone to Padan Aram.
verses.textEnNlt: He also knew that Jacob had obeyed his parents and gone to Paddan-aram.
verses.textEnNasb: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and his mother and had gone to Paddan-aram.
verses.textEn: and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and had gone to Paddan Aram.

verses.textZh: 以扫就看出，他父亲以撒不喜欢迦南的女子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫就看出，他父亲以撒不喜欢迦南的女子。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫就晓得他父亲以撒看不中迦南的女子，
verses.textEnNiv: Esau then realized how displeasing the Canaanite women were to his father Isaac;
verses.textEnEsv: So when Esau saw that the Canaanite women did not please Isaac his father,
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan did not please his father Isaac.
verses.textEnNlt: It was now very clear to Esau that his father did not like the local Canaanite women.
verses.textEnNasb: So Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan displeased his father Isaac;
verses.textEn: Esau then realized how displeasing the Canaanite women were to his father Isaac;

verses.textZh: 于是，以扫到以实玛利那里去，在他两个妻子以外，娶了玛哈拉为妻。玛哈拉就是亚伯拉罕的儿子以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹妹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以扫到以实玛利那里去，在他两个妻子以外，娶了玛哈拉为妻。玛哈拉就是亚伯拉罕的儿子以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹妹。
verses.textZhCuv: 便往以实玛利那里去，在他二妻之外又娶了玛哈拉为妻。她是亚伯拉罕儿子以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹子。
verses.textEnNiv: so he went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Ishmael son of Abraham, in addition to the wives he already had.
verses.textEnEsv: Esau went to Ishmael and took as his wife, besides the wives he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebajoth, to be his wife in addition to the wives he had.
verses.textEnNlt: So Esau visited his uncle Ishmael’s family and married one of Ishmael’s daughters, in addition to the wives he already had. His new wife’s name was Mahalath. She was the sister of Nebaioth and the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son.
verses.textEnNasb: and Esau went to Ishmael, and married, besides the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth.
verses.textEn: so he went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Ishmael son of Abraham, in addition to the wives he already had.

verses.textZh: 雅各离开别是巴，到哈兰去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各离开别是巴，到哈兰去。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各出了别是巴，向哈兰走去；
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Harran.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob left Beersheba and went toward Haran.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jacob went out from Beersheba and went toward Haran.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Jacob left Beersheba and traveled toward Haran.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob departed from Beersheba and went toward Haran.
verses.textEn: Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Harran.

verses.textZh: 来到一个地方，就在那里过夜，因为太阳已经落了。他拾起那地方的一块石头，把它放在头底下作枕头，就在那里躺下睡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 来到一个地方，就在那里过夜，因为太阳已经落了。他拾起那地方的一块石头，把它放在头底下作枕头，就在那里躺下睡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了一个地方，因为太阳落了，就在那里住宿，便拾起那地方的一块石头枕在头下，在那里躺卧睡了，
verses.textEnNiv: When he reached a certain place, he stopped for the night because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones there, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.
verses.textEnEsv: And he came to a certain place and stayed there that night, because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones of the place, he put it under his head and lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he came to a certain place and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. And he took one of the stones of that place and put it at his head, and he lay down in that place to sleep.
verses.textEnNlt: At sundown he arrived at a good place to set up camp and stopped there for the night. Jacob found a stone to rest his head against and lay down to sleep.
verses.textEnNasb: And he happened upon a particular place and spent the night there, because the sun had set; and he took one of the stones of the place and made it a support for his head, and lay down in that place.
verses.textEn: When he reached a certain place, he stopped for the night because the sun had set. Taking one of the stones there, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.

verses.textZh: 他作了一个梦，梦见一个梯子立在地上，梯顶直通到天，神的众使者在梯子上下往来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他作了一个梦，梦见一个梯子立在地上，梯顶直通到天，神的众使者在梯子上下往来。
verses.textZhCuv: 梦见一个梯子立在地上，梯子的头顶着天，有神的使者在梯子上，上去下来。
verses.textEnNiv: He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he dreamed, and behold, there was a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven. And behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he dreamed, and behold, a ladder was set up on the earth, and its top reached to heaven; and there the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
verses.textEnNlt: As he slept, he dreamed of a stairway that reached from the earth up to heaven. And he saw the angels of God going up and down the stairway.
verses.textEnNasb: And he had a dream, and behold, a ladder was set up on the earth with its top reaching to heaven; and behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.
verses.textEn: He had a dream in which he saw a stairway resting on the earth, with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

verses.textZh: 耶和华站在梯子上，说："我是耶和华你祖父亚伯拉罕的神，也是以撒的神，我要把你现在躺着的这块地赐给你和你的后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华站在梯子上，说："我是耶和华你祖父亚伯拉罕的神，也是以撒的神，我要把你现在躺着的这块地赐给你和你的后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华站在梯子以上 ，说：「我是耶和华－你祖亚伯拉罕的神，也是以撒的神；我要将你现在所躺卧之地赐给你和你的后裔。
verses.textEnNiv: There above it stood the Lord , and he said: "I am the Lord , the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, the Lord stood above it and said, "I am the Lord , the God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac. The land on which you lie I will give to you and to your offspring.
verses.textEnNkjv: And behold, the Lord stood above it and said: "I am the Lord God of Abraham your father and the God of Isaac; the land on which you lie I will give to you and your descendants.
verses.textEnNlt: At the top of the stairway stood the Lord , and he said, "I am the Lord , the God of your grandfather Abraham, and the God of your father, Isaac. The ground you are lying on belongs to you. I am giving it to you and your descendants.
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, the Lord was standing above it and said, "I am the Lord, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac; the land on which you lie I will give to you and to your descendants.
verses.textEn: There above it stood the Lord , and he said: "I am the Lord , the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you are lying.

verses.textZh: 你的后裔必像地面的灰尘那么多；你必向东、南、西、北扩展；地上的万族必因你和你的后裔得福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的后裔必像地面的灰尘那么多；你必向东、南、西、北扩展；地上的万族必因你和你的后裔得福。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的后裔必像地上的尘沙那样多，必向东西南北开展；地上万族必因你和你的后裔得福。
verses.textEnNiv: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.
verses.textEnEsv: Your offspring shall be like the dust of the earth, and you shall spread abroad to the west and to the east and to the north and to the south, and in you and your offspring shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also your descendants shall be as the dust of the earth; you shall spread abroad to the west and the east, to the north and the south; and in you and in your seed all the families of the earth shall be blessed.
verses.textEnNlt: Your descendants will be as numerous as the dust of the earth! They will spread out in all directions—to the west and the east, to the north and the south. And all the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your descendants.
verses.textEnNasb: Your descendants will also be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and to the east, and to the north and to the south; and in you and in your descendants shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.textEn: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south. All peoples on earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.

verses.textZh: 我与你同在，你无论到哪里去，我必看顾你；我必领你回到这地方来，因为我必不离弃你，直到我实现了我对你所应许的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我与你同在，你无论到哪里去，我必看顾你；我必领你回到这地方来，因为我必不离弃你，直到我实现了我对你所应许的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我也与你同在。你无论往哪里去，我必保佑你，领你归回这地，总不离弃你，直到我成全了向你所应许的。」
verses.textEnNiv: I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land; for I will not leave you until I have done what I have spoken to you."
verses.textEnNlt: What’s more, I am with you, and I will protect you wherever you go. One day I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have finished giving you everything I have promised you."
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and will bring you back to this land; for I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you."
verses.textEn: I am with you and will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you."

verses.textZh: 雅各一觉醒来，说："耶和华确实在这地方，我竟不知道！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各一觉醒来，说："耶和华确实在这地方，我竟不知道！"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各睡醒了，说：「耶和华真在这里，我竟不知道！」
verses.textEnNiv: When Jacob awoke from his sleep, he thought, "Surely the Lord is in this place, and I was not aware of it."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, "Surely the Lord is in this place, and I did not know it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, "Surely the Lord is in this place, and I did not know it."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, "Surely the Lord is in this place, and I wasn’t even aware of it!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob awoke from his sleep and said, "The Lord is certainly in this place, and I did not know it!"
verses.textEn: When Jacob awoke from his sleep, he thought, "Surely the Lord is in this place, and I was not aware of it."

verses.textZh: 他就惧怕起来，说："这地方多么可畏啊，这不是别的地方，而是神的殿，是天的门。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就惧怕起来，说："这地方多么可畏啊，这不是别的地方，而是神的殿，是天的门。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就惧怕，说：「这地方何等可畏！这不是别的，乃是神的殿，也是天的门。」
verses.textEnNiv: He was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven."
verses.textEnEsv: And he was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven!"
verses.textEnNlt: But he was also afraid and said, "What an awesome place this is! It is none other than the house of God, the very gateway to heaven!"
verses.textEnNasb: And he was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God, and this is the gate of heaven!"
verses.textEn: He was afraid and said, "How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven."

verses.textZh: 雅各清早起来，把他曾经放在头底下作枕头的那块石头，立作石柱，在柱上浇了油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各清早起来，把他曾经放在头底下作枕头的那块石头，立作石柱，在柱上浇了油。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各清早起来，把所枕的石头立作柱子，浇油在上面。
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning Jacob took the stone he had placed under his head and set it up as a pillar and poured oil on top of it.
verses.textEnEsv: So early in the morning Jacob took the stone that he had put under his head and set it up for a pillar and poured oil on the top of it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob rose early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put at his head, set it up as a pillar, and poured oil on top of it.
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning Jacob got up very early. He took the stone he had rested his head against, and he set it upright as a memorial pillar. Then he poured olive oil over it.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob got up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had placed as a support for his head, and set it up as a memorial stone, and poured oil on its top.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning Jacob took the stone he had placed under his head and set it up as a pillar and poured oil on top of it.

verses.textZh: 他就给那地方起名叫伯特利，但那城起初名叫路斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就给那地方起名叫伯特利，但那城起初名叫路斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就给那地方起名叫伯特利 ；但那地方起先名叫路斯。
verses.textEnNiv: He called that place Bethel, though the city used to be called Luz.
verses.textEnEsv: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he called the name of that place Bethel; but the name of that city had been Luz previously.
verses.textEnNlt: He named that place Bethel (which means "house of God"), although it was previously called Luz.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he named that place Bethel; but previously the name of the city had been Luz.
verses.textEn: He called that place Bethel, though the city used to be called Luz.

verses.textZh: 于是雅各许了一个愿说："如果神与我同在，在我所走的路上看顾我，赐我食物吃，给我衣服穿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是雅各许了一个愿说："如果神与我同在，在我所走的路上看顾我，赐我食物吃，给我衣服穿，
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各许愿说：「神若与我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又给我食物吃，衣服穿，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me and will watch over me on this journey I am taking and will give me food to eat and clothes to wear
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat and clothing to wear,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me, and keep me in this way that I am going, and give me bread to eat and clothing to put on,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob made this vow: "If God will indeed be with me and protect me on this journey, and if he will provide me with food and clothing,
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob also made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me and will keep me on this journey that I take, and give me food to eat and garments to wear,
verses.textEn: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, "If God will be with me and will watch over me on this journey I am taking and will give me food to eat and clothes to wear

verses.textZh: 使我可以平平安安地回到我的父家，我就必定以耶和华为我的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 使我可以平平安安地回到我的父家，我就必定以耶和华为我的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 使我平平安安地回到我父亲的家，我就必以耶和华为我的神。
verses.textEnNiv: so that I return safely to my father’s household, then the Lord will be my God
verses.textEnEsv: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, then the Lord shall be my God,
verses.textEnNkjv: so that I come back to my father’s house in peace, then the Lord shall be my God.
verses.textEnNlt: and if I return safely to my father’s home, then the Lord will certainly be my God.
verses.textEnNasb: and I return to my father’s house in safety, then the Lord will be my God.
verses.textEn: so that I return safely to my father’s household, then the Lord will be my God

verses.textZh: 我立作石柱的那块石头，必作神的殿；你赐给我的一切，我必把十分之一献给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我立作石柱的那块石头，必作神的殿；你赐给我的一切，我必把十分之一献给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我所立为柱子的石头也必作神的殿；凡你所赐给我的，我必将十分之一献给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: and this stone that I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that you give me I will give you a tenth."
verses.textEnEsv: and this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, shall be God’s house. And of all that you give me I will give a full tenth to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And this stone which I have set as a pillar shall be God’s house, and of all that You give me I will surely give a tenth to You."
verses.textEnNlt: And this memorial pillar I have set up will become a place for worshiping God, and I will present to God a tenth of everything he gives me."
verses.textEnNasb: And this stone, which I have set up as a memorial stone, will be God’s house, and of everything that You give me I will assuredly give a tenth to You."
verses.textEn: and this stone that I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that you give me I will give you a tenth."

verses.textZh: 雅各继续前行，到了东方人的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各继续前行，到了东方人的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各起行，到了东方人之地，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob continued on his journey and came to the land of the eastern peoples.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob went on his journey and came to the land of the people of the east.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob went on his journey and came to the land of the people of the East.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob hurried on, finally arriving in the land of the east.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob set out on his journey, and went to the land of the people of the east.
verses.textEn: Then Jacob continued on his journey and came to the land of the eastern peoples.

verses.textZh: 他看见田间有一口井；有三群羊躺卧在井旁，因为人都是用那井里的水给羊群喝；井口上有一块大石头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他看见田间有一口井；有三群羊躺卧在井旁，因为人都是用那井里的水给羊群喝；井口上有一块大石头。
verses.textZhCuv: 看见田间有一口井，有三群羊卧在井旁；因为人饮羊群都是用那井里的水。井口上的石头是大的。
verses.textEnNiv: There he saw a well in the open country, with three flocks of sheep lying near it because the flocks were watered from that well. The stone over the mouth of the well was large.
verses.textEnEsv: As he looked, he saw a well in the field, and behold, three flocks of sheep lying beside it, for out of that well the flocks were watered. The stone on the well’s mouth was large,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he looked, and saw a well in the field; and behold, there were three flocks of sheep lying by it; for out of that well they watered the flocks. A large stone was on the well’s mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: He saw a well in the distance. Three flocks of sheep and goats lay in an open field beside it, waiting to be watered. But a heavy stone covered the mouth of the well.
verses.textEnNasb: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and behold, three flocks of sheep were lying there beside it, because they watered the flocks from that well. Now the stone on the mouth of the well was large.
verses.textEn: There he saw a well in the open country, with three flocks of sheep lying near it because the flocks were watered from that well. The stone over the mouth of the well was large.

verses.textZh: 当所有羊群都到齐了，牧人就把井口的石头辊开，取水给羊群喝，然后把石头放回井口原处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当所有羊群都到齐了，牧人就把井口的石头辊开，取水给羊群喝，然后把石头放回井口原处。
verses.textZhCuv: 常有羊群在那里聚集，牧人把石头转离井口饮羊，随后又把石头放在井口的原处。
verses.textEnNiv: When all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone away from the well’s mouth and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.
verses.textEnEsv: and when all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone from the mouth of the well and water the sheep, and put the stone back in its place over the mouth of the well.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now all the flocks would be gathered there; and they would roll the stone from the well’s mouth, water the sheep, and put the stone back in its place on the well’s mouth.
verses.textEnNlt: It was the custom there to wait for all the flocks to arrive before removing the stone and watering the animals. Afterward the stone would be placed back over the mouth of the well.
verses.textEnNasb: When all the flocks were gathered there, they would roll the stone from the mouth of the well and water the sheep. Then they would put the stone back in its place on the mouth of the well.
verses.textEn: When all the flocks were gathered there, the shepherds would roll the stone away from the well’s mouth and water the sheep. Then they would return the stone to its place over the mouth of the well.

verses.textZh: 雅各问这些牧人："弟兄们，你们是哪里来的？"他们回答："我们是从哈兰来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各问这些牧人："弟兄们，你们是哪里来的？"他们回答："我们是从哈兰来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各对牧人说：「弟兄们，你们是哪里来的？」他们说：「我们是哈兰来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob asked the shepherds, "My brothers, where are you from?" "We’re from Harran," they replied.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob said to them, "My brothers, where do you come from?" They said, "We are from Haran."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob said to them, "My brethren, where are you from?" And they said, "We are from Haran."
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob went over to the shepherds and asked, "Where are you from, my friends?" "We are from Haran," they answered.
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob said to them, "My brothers, where are you from?" And they said, "We are from Haran."
verses.textEn: Jacob asked the shepherds, "My brothers, where are you from?" "We’re from Harran," they replied.

verses.textZh: 他问他们："你们认识拿鹤的孙子拉班吗？"他们回答："我们认识。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他问他们："你们认识拿鹤的孙子拉班吗？"他们回答："我们认识。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他问他们说：「拿鹤的孙子拉班，你们认识吗？」他们说：「我们认识。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "Do you know Laban, Nahor’s grandson?" "Yes, we know him," they answered.
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Do you know Laban the son of Nahor?" They said, "We know him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to them, "Do you know Laban the son of Nahor?" And they said, "We know him."
verses.textEnNlt: "Do you know a man there named Laban, the grandson of Nahor?" he asked. "Yes, we do," they replied.
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to them, "Do you know Laban the son of Nahor?" And they said, "We know him."
verses.textEn: He said to them, "Do you know Laban, Nahor’s grandson?" "Yes, we know him," they answered.

verses.textZh: 雅各又问他们："他平安吗？"他们回答："平安。你看，他的女儿拉结领着羊群来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各又问他们："他平安吗？"他们回答："平安。你看，他的女儿拉结领着羊群来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各说：「他平安吗？」他们说：「平安。看哪，他女儿拉结领着羊来了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob asked them, "Is he well?" "Yes, he is," they said, "and here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep."
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Is it well with him?" They said, "It is well; and see, Rachel his daughter is coming with the sheep!"
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to them, "Is he well?" And they said, "Heis well. And look, his daughter Rachel is coming with the sheep."
verses.textEnNlt: "Is he doing well?" Jacob asked. "Yes, he’s well," they answered. "Look, here comes his daughter Rachel with the flock now."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them, "Is it well with him?" And they said, "It is well, and here is his daughter Rachel coming with the sheep."
verses.textEn: Then Jacob asked them, "Is he well?" "Yes, he is," they said, "and here comes his daughter Rachel with the sheep."

verses.textZh: 雅各说："现在太阳还高，不是牲畜聚集的时候；你们取水给羊群喝，再去牧放吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各说："现在太阳还高，不是牲畜聚集的时候；你们取水给羊群喝，再去牧放吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各说：「日头还高，不是羊群聚集的时候，你们不如饮羊，再去放一放。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Look," he said, "the sun is still high; it is not time for the flocks to be gathered. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture."
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Behold, it is still high day; it is not time for the livestock to be gathered together. Water the sheep and go, pasture them."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Look, itis still high day; itis not time for the cattle to be gathered together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them."
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob said, "Look, it’s still broad daylight—too early to round up the animals. Why don’t you water the sheep and goats so they can get back out to pasture?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Look, it is still high day; it is not time for the livestock to be gathered. Water the sheep, and go, pasture them."
verses.textEn: "Look," he said, "the sun is still high; it is not time for the flocks to be gathered. Water the sheep and take them back to pasture."

verses.textZh: 他们回答："我们不能这样作，必须等到所有的羊群都到齐了，有人把井口的石头辊开，我们才可以取水给羊群喝。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："我们不能这样作，必须等到所有的羊群都到齐了，有人把井口的石头辊开，我们才可以取水给羊群喝。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「我们不能，必等羊群聚齐，人把石头转离井口才可饮羊。」
verses.textEnNiv: "We can’t," they replied, "until all the flocks are gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep."
verses.textEnEsv: But they said, "We cannot until all the flocks are gathered together and the stone is rolled from the mouth of the well; then we water the sheep."
verses.textEnNkjv: But they said, "We cannot until all the flocks are gathered together, and they have rolled the stone from the well’s mouth; then we water the sheep."
verses.textEnNlt: "We can’t water the animals until all the flocks have arrived," they replied. "Then the shepherds move the stone from the mouth of the well, and we water all the sheep and goats."
verses.textEnNasb: But they said, "We cannot, until all the flocks are gathered, and they roll the stone from the mouth of the well; then we water the sheep."
verses.textEn: "We can’t," they replied, "until all the flocks are gathered and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the well. Then we will water the sheep."

verses.textZh: 雅各还跟他们说话的时候，拉结领着她父亲的羊群来了。拉结原来是个牧羊女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各还跟他们说话的时候，拉结领着她父亲的羊群来了。拉结原来是个牧羊女。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各正和他们说话的时候，拉结领着她父亲的羊来了，因为那些羊是她牧放的。
verses.textEnNiv: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherd.
verses.textEnEsv: While he was still speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now while he was still speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob was still talking with them when Rachel arrived with her father’s flock, for she was a shepherd.
verses.textEnNasb: While he was still speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
verses.textEn: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherd.

verses.textZh: 雅各看见了舅父拉班的女儿拉结，和舅父拉班的羊群，就上前来，把井口的石头辊开，取水给舅父拉班的羊群喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各看见了舅父拉班的女儿拉结，和舅父拉班的羊群，就上前来，把井口的石头辊开，取水给舅父拉班的羊群喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各看见母舅拉班的女儿拉结和母舅拉班的羊群，就上前把石头转离井口，饮他母舅拉班的羊群。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jacob saw Rachel daughter of his uncle Laban, and Laban’s sheep, he went over and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle’s sheep.
verses.textEnEsv: Now as soon as Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, Jacob came near and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother, that Jacob went near and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.
verses.textEnNlt: And because Rachel was his cousin—the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother—and because the sheep and goats belonged to his uncle Laban, Jacob went over to the well and moved the stone from its mouth and watered his uncle’s flock.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of his mother’s brother Laban, and the sheep of his mother’s brother Laban, Jacob went up and rolled the stone from the mouth of the well, and watered the flock of his mother’s brother Laban.
verses.textEn: When Jacob saw Rachel daughter of his uncle Laban, and Laban’s sheep, he went over and rolled the stone away from the mouth of the well and watered his uncle’s sheep.

verses.textZh: 雅各和拉结亲吻，就放声大哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各和拉结亲吻，就放声大哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各与拉结亲嘴，就放声而哭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and began to weep aloud.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and wept aloud.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice and wept.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob kissed Rachel, and he wept aloud.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob kissed Rachel, and raised his voice and wept.
verses.textEn: Then Jacob kissed Rachel and began to weep aloud.

verses.textZh: 雅各告诉拉结，自己是她父亲的外甥，是利百加的儿子。拉结就跑去告诉她的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各告诉拉结，自己是她父亲的外甥，是利百加的儿子。拉结就跑去告诉她的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各告诉拉结，自己是她父亲的外甥，是利百加的儿子，拉结就跑去告诉她父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: He had told Rachel that he was a relative of her father and a son of Rebekah. So she ran and told her father.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s kinsman, and that he was Rebekah’s son, and she ran and told her father.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative and that he was Rebekah’s son. So she ran and told her father.
verses.textEnNlt: He explained to Rachel that he was her cousin on her father’s side—the son of her aunt Rebekah. So Rachel quickly ran and told her father, Laban.
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob told Rachel that he was a relative of her father and that he was Rebekah’s son, and she ran and told her father.
verses.textEn: He had told Rachel that he was a relative of her father and a son of Rebekah. So she ran and told her father.

verses.textZh: 拉班听见了关于外甥雅各的消息，就跑去迎接他，拥抱他，和他亲吻，带他到自己的家里。雅各就把一切经过都告诉拉班。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班听见了关于外甥雅各的消息，就跑去迎接他，拥抱他，和他亲吻，带他到自己的家里。雅各就把一切经过都告诉拉班。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班听见外甥雅各的信息，就跑去迎接，抱着他，与他亲嘴，领他到自己的家。雅各将一切的情由告诉拉班。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as Laban heard the news about Jacob, his sister’s son, he hurried to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, and there Jacob told him all these things.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Laban heard the news about Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet him and embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it came to pass, when Laban heard the report about Jacob his sister’s son, that he ran to meet him, and embraced him and kissed him, and brought him to his house. So he told Laban all these things.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as Laban heard that his nephew Jacob had arrived, he ran out to meet him. He embraced and kissed him and brought him home. When Jacob had told him his story,
verses.textEnNasb: So when Laban heard the news about Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet him, and embraced him and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Then he told Laban all these things.
verses.textEn: As soon as Laban heard the news about Jacob, his sister’s son, he hurried to meet him. He embraced him and kissed him and brought him to his home, and there Jacob told him all these things.

verses.textZh: 拉班对雅各说："你实在是我的骨肉。"雅各就与拉班同住了一个月。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班对雅各说："你实在是我的骨肉。"雅各就与拉班同住了一个月。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班对他说：「你实在是我的骨肉。」雅各就和他同住了一个月。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Laban said to him, "You are my own flesh and blood." After Jacob had stayed with him for a whole month,
verses.textEnEsv: and Laban said to him, "Surely you are my bone and my flesh!" And he stayed with him a month.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban said to him, "Surely you are my bone and my flesh." And he stayed with him for a month.
verses.textEnNlt: Laban exclaimed, "You really are my own flesh and blood!" After Jacob had stayed with Laban for about a month,
verses.textEnNasb: And Laban said to him, "You certainly are my bone and my flesh." And he stayed with him a month.
verses.textEn: Then Laban said to him, "You are my own flesh and blood." After Jacob had stayed with him for a whole month,

verses.textZh: 拉班对雅各说："你因为是我的外甥，就要白白地服事我吗？告诉我，你要甚么报酬？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班对雅各说："你因为是我的外甥，就要白白地服事我吗？告诉我，你要甚么报酬？"
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班对雅各说：「你虽是我的骨肉 ，岂可白白地服事我？请告诉我，你要什么为工价？」
verses.textEnNiv: Laban said to him, "Just because you are a relative of mine, should you work for me for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my kinsman, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what shall your wages be?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what should your wages be?"
verses.textEnNlt: Laban said to him, "You shouldn’t work for me without pay just because we are relatives. Tell me how much your wages should be."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Laban said to Jacob, "Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what shall your wages be?"
verses.textEn: Laban said to him, "Just because you are a relative of mine, should you work for me for nothing? Tell me what your wages should be."

verses.textZh: 拉班有两个女儿；大的名叫利亚，小的名叫拉结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班有两个女儿；大的名叫利亚，小的名叫拉结。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班有两个女儿，大的名叫利亚，小的名叫拉结。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Laban had two daughters. The name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Laban had two daughters: the name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.textEnNlt: Now Laban had two daughters. The older daughter was named Leah, and the younger one was Rachel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
verses.textEn: Now Laban had two daughters; the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

verses.textZh: 利亚的眼睛虽然可爱，拉结却生得身材美丽，样貌娟秀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚的眼睛虽然可爱，拉结却生得身材美丽，样貌娟秀。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚的眼睛没有神气，拉结却生得美貌俊秀。
verses.textEnNiv: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel had a lovely figure and was beautiful.
verses.textEnEsv: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and appearance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Leah’s eyes were delicate, but Rachel was beautiful of form and appearance.
verses.textEnNlt: There was no sparkle in Leah’s eyes, but Rachel had a beautiful figure and a lovely face.
verses.textEnNasb: And Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in figure and appearance.
verses.textEn: Leah had weak eyes, but Rachel had a lovely figure and was beautiful.

verses.textZh: 雅各爱拉结，所以对拉班说："我愿为你的小女儿拉结服事你七年。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各爱拉结，所以对拉班说："我愿为你的小女儿拉结服事你七年。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各爱拉结，就说：「我愿为你小女儿拉结服事你七年。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob was in love with Rachel and said, "I’ll work for you seven years in return for your younger daughter Rachel."
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob loved Rachel. And he said, "I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jacob loved Rachel; so he said, "I will serve you seven years for Rachel your younger daughter."
verses.textEnNlt: Since Jacob was in love with Rachel, he told her father, "I’ll work for you for seven years if you’ll give me Rachel, your younger daughter, as my wife."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jacob loved Rachel, so he said, "I will serve you seven years for your younger daughter Rachel."
verses.textEn: Jacob was in love with Rachel and said, "I’ll work for you seven years in return for your younger daughter Rachel."

verses.textZh: 拉班说："我把她给你，比给别人更好，你就与我同住吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班说："我把她给你，比给别人更好，你就与我同住吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班说：「我把她给你，胜似给别人，你与我同住吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Laban said, "It’s better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me."
verses.textEnEsv: Laban said, "It is better that I give her to you than that I should give her to any other man; stay with me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban said, "Itis better that I give her to you than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Agreed!" Laban replied. "I’d rather give her to you than to anyone else. Stay and work with me."
verses.textEnNasb: Laban said, "It is better that I give her to you than to give her to another man; stay with me."
verses.textEn: Laban said, "It’s better that I give her to you than to some other man. Stay here with me."

verses.textZh: 于是，雅各为拉结服事了拉班七年；他就看这七年好象几天一样，因为他爱拉结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，雅各为拉结服事了拉班七年；他就看这七年好象几天一样，因为他爱拉结。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就为拉结服事了七年；他因为深爱拉结，就看这七年如同几天。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jacob served seven years to get Rachel, but they seemed like only a few days to him because of his love for her.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed to him but a few days because of the love he had for her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed only a few days to him because of the love he had for her.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob worked seven years to pay for Rachel. But his love for her was so strong that it seemed to him but a few days.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel, and they seemed to him like only a few days because of his love for her.
verses.textEn: So Jacob served seven years to get Rachel, but they seemed like only a few days to him because of his love for her.

verses.textZh: 雅各对拉班说："期限到了，请把我的妻子给我，好让我与她亲近。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各对拉班说："期限到了，请把我的妻子给我，好让我与她亲近。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各对拉班说：「日期已经满了，求你把我的妻子给我，我好与她同房。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife. My time is completed, and I want to make love to her."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife that I may go in to her, for my time is completed."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, the time came for him to marry her. "I have fulfilled my agreement," Jacob said to Laban. "Now give me my wife so I can sleep with her."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife, for my time is completed, that I may have relations with her."
verses.textEn: Then Jacob said to Laban, "Give me my wife. My time is completed, and I want to make love to her."

verses.textZh: 拉班就摆设筵席，邀请了那地方所有的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班就摆设筵席，邀请了那地方所有的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班就摆设筵席，请齐了那地方的众人。
verses.textEnNiv: So Laban brought together all the people of the place and gave a feast.
verses.textEnEsv: So Laban gathered together all the people of the place and made a feast.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place and made a feast.
verses.textEnNlt: So Laban invited everyone in the neighborhood and prepared a wedding feast.
verses.textEnNasb: So Laban gathered all the people of the place and held a feast.
verses.textEn: So Laban brought together all the people of the place and gave a feast.

verses.textZh: 到了晚上，拉班把自己的女儿利亚带来给雅各，雅各就与她亲近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了晚上，拉班把自己的女儿利亚带来给雅各，雅各就与她亲近。
verses.textZhCuv: 到晚上，拉班将女儿利亚送来给雅各，雅各就与她同房。
verses.textEnNiv: But when evening came, he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob, and Jacob made love to her.
verses.textEnEsv: But in the evening he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob, and he went in to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the evening, that he took Leah his daughter and brought her to Jacob; and he went in to her.
verses.textEnNlt: But that night, when it was dark, Laban took Leah to Jacob, and he slept with her.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the evening he took his daughter Leah and brought her to him; and Jacob had relations with her.
verses.textEn: But when evening came, he took his daughter Leah and brought her to Jacob, and Jacob made love to her.

verses.textZh: 拉班又把自己的婢女悉帕给了女儿利亚作婢女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班又把自己的婢女悉帕给了女儿利亚作婢女。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班又将婢女悉帕给女儿利亚作使女。
verses.textEnNiv: And Laban gave his servant Zilpah to his daughter as her attendant.
verses.textEnEsv: (Laban gave his female servant Zilpah to his daughter Leah to be her servant.)
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban gave his maid Zilpah to his daughter Leah as a maid.
verses.textEnNlt: (Laban had given Leah a servant, Zilpah, to be her maid.)
verses.textEnNasb: Laban also gave his female slave Zilpah to his daughter Leah as a slave.
verses.textEn: And Laban gave his servant Zilpah to his daughter as her attendant.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，雅各才看出原来是利亚，就对拉班说："你向我作的是甚么事呢？我服事你，不是为了拉结的缘故吗？你为甚么欺骗我呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早晨，雅各才看出原来是利亚，就对拉班说："你向我作的是甚么事呢？我服事你，不是为了拉结的缘故吗？你为甚么欺骗我呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 到了早晨，雅各一看是利亚，就对拉班说：「你向我做的是什么事呢？我服事你，不是为拉结吗？你为什么欺哄我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When morning came, there was Leah! So Jacob said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? I served you for Rachel, didn’t I? Why have you deceived me?"
verses.textEnEsv: And in the morning, behold, it was Leah! And Jacob said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? Did I not serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came to pass in the morning, that behold, it was Leah. And he said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? Was it not for Rachel that I served you? Why then have you deceived me?"
verses.textEnNlt: But when Jacob woke up in the morning—it was Leah! "What have you done to me?" Jacob raged at Laban. "I worked seven years for Rachel! Why have you tricked me?"
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about in the morning that, behold, it was Leah! And he said to Laban, "What is this that you have done to me? Was it not for Rachel that I served with you? Why then have you deceived me?"
verses.textEn: When morning came, there was Leah! So Jacob said to Laban, "What is this you have done to me? I served you for Rachel, didn’t I? Why have you deceived me?"

verses.textZh: 拉班回答："大女儿还没有出嫁，就先把小女儿嫁出去，我们这地方是没有这规矩的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班回答："大女儿还没有出嫁，就先把小女儿嫁出去，我们这地方是没有这规矩的。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班说：「大女儿还没有给人，先把小女儿给人，在我们这地方没有这规矩。
verses.textEnNiv: Laban replied, "It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older one.
verses.textEnEsv: Laban said, "It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban said, "It must not be done so in our country, to give the younger before the firstborn.
verses.textEnNlt: "It’s not our custom here to marry off a younger daughter ahead of the firstborn," Laban replied.
verses.textEnNasb: But Laban said, "It is not the practice in our place to marry off the younger before the firstborn.
verses.textEn: Laban replied, "It is not our custom here to give the younger daughter in marriage before the older one.

verses.textZh: 你与大女儿七天的庆典过了以后，我们也把小女儿给你，只是你要再服事我七年。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你与大女儿七天的庆典过了以后，我们也把小女儿给你，只是你要再服事我七年。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你为这个满了七日，我就把那个也给你，你再为她服事我七年。」
verses.textEnNiv: Finish this daughter’s bridal week; then we will give you the younger one also, in return for another seven years of work."
verses.textEnEsv: Complete the week of this one, and we will give you the other also in return for serving me another seven years."
verses.textEnNkjv: Fulfill her week, and we will give you this one also for the service which you will serve with me still another seven years."
verses.textEnNlt: "But wait until the bridal week is over; then we’ll give you Rachel, too—provided you promise to work another seven years for me."
verses.textEnNasb: Complete the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you shall serve with me, for another seven years."
verses.textEn: Finish this daughter’s bridal week; then we will give you the younger one also, in return for another seven years of work."

verses.textZh: 于是雅各这样作了。他与利亚七天的庆典过了以后，拉班就把自己的女儿拉结给雅各为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是雅各这样作了。他与利亚七天的庆典过了以后，拉班就把自己的女儿拉结给雅各为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就如此行。满了利亚的七日，拉班便将女儿拉结给雅各为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: And Jacob did so. He finished the week with Leah, and then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel to be his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob did so, and completed her week. Then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel to be his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob did so and fulfilled her week. So he gave him his daughter Rachel as wife also.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob agreed to work seven more years. A week after Jacob had married Leah, Laban gave him Rachel, too.
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob did so and completed her week, and he gave him his daughter Rachel as his wife.
verses.textEn: And Jacob did so. He finished the week with Leah, and then Laban gave him his daughter Rachel to be his wife.

verses.textZh: 拉班又把自己的婢女辟拉给了女儿拉结作婢女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班又把自己的婢女辟拉给了女儿拉结作婢女。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班又将婢女辟拉给女儿拉结作使女。
verses.textEnNiv: Laban gave his servant Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her attendant.
verses.textEnEsv: (Laban gave his female servant Bilhah to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.)
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban gave his maid Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as a maid.
verses.textEnNlt: (Laban gave Rachel a servant, Bilhah, to be her maid.)
verses.textEnNasb: Laban also gave his female slave Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her slave.
verses.textEn: Laban gave his servant Bilhah to his daughter Rachel as her attendant.

verses.textZh: 雅各也与拉结亲近，并且爱拉结胜过爱利亚；于是他再服事了拉班七年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各也与拉结亲近，并且爱拉结胜过爱利亚；于是他再服事了拉班七年。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各也与拉结同房，并且爱拉结胜似爱利亚，于是又服事了拉班七年。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob made love to Rachel also, and his love for Rachel was greater than his love for Leah. And he worked for Laban another seven years.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jacob went in to Rachel also, and he loved Rachel more than Leah, and served Laban for another seven years.
