verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob also went in to Rachel, and he also loved Rachel more than Leah. And he served with Laban still another seven years.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob slept with Rachel, too, and he loved her much more than Leah. He then stayed and worked for Laban the additional seven years.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob had relations with Rachel also, and indeed he loved Rachel more than Leah, and he served with Laban for another seven years.
verses.textEn: Jacob made love to Rachel also, and his love for Rachel was greater than his love for Leah. And he worked for Laban another seven years.

verses.textZh: 耶和华见利亚失宠，就使她生育，拉结却不生育。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华见利亚失宠，就使她生育，拉结却不生育。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华见利亚失宠 ，就使她生育，拉结却不生育。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Lord saw that Leah was not loved, he enabled her to conceive, but Rachel remained childless.
verses.textEnEsv: When the Lord saw that Leah was hated, he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.
verses.textEnNkjv: When the Lord saw that Leah was unloved, He opened her womb; but Rachel was barren.
verses.textEnNlt: When the Lord saw that Leah was unloved, he enabled her to have children, but Rachel could not conceive.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the Lord saw that Leah was unloved, and He opened her womb, but Rachel was unable to have children.
verses.textEn: When the Lord saw that Leah was not loved, he enabled her to conceive, but Rachel remained childless.

verses.textZh: 利亚怀孕，生了一个儿子，就给他起名叫流本，因为她说："耶和华看见了我的苦情，现在我的丈夫必爱我了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚怀孕，生了一个儿子，就给他起名叫流本，因为她说："耶和华看见了我的苦情，现在我的丈夫必爱我了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚怀孕生子，就给他起名叫吕便 ，因而说：「耶和华看见我的苦情，如今我的丈夫必爱我。」
verses.textEnNiv: Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben, for she said, "It is because the Lord has seen my misery. Surely my husband will love me now."
verses.textEnEsv: And Leah conceived and bore a son, and she called his name Reuben, for she said, "Because the Lord has looked upon my affliction; for now my husband will love me."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Leah conceived and bore a son, and she called his name Reuben; for she said, "The Lord has surely looked on my affliction. Now therefore, my husband will love me."
verses.textEnNlt: So Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben, for she said, "The Lord has noticed my misery, and now my husband will love me."
verses.textEnNasb: Leah conceived and gave birth to a son, and named him Reuben, for she said, "Because the Lord has seen my affliction; surely now my husband will love me."
verses.textEn: Leah became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Reuben, for she said, "It is because the Lord has seen my misery. Surely my husband will love me now."

verses.textZh: 她又怀孕，生了一个儿子，就说："耶和华因为听见我失宠，所以又赐给我这个儿子。"于是给他起名叫西缅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她又怀孕，生了一个儿子，就说："耶和华因为听见我失宠，所以又赐给我这个儿子。"于是给他起名叫西缅。
verses.textZhCuv: 她又怀孕生子，就说：「耶和华因为听见我失宠，所以又赐给我这个儿子」，于是给他起名叫西缅 。
verses.textEnNiv: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Because the Lord heard that I am not loved, he gave me this one too." So she named him Simeon.
verses.textEnEsv: She conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Because the Lord has heard that I am hated, he has given me this son also." And she called his name Simeon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Because the Lord has heard that I am unloved, He has therefore given me this son also." And she called his name Simeon.
verses.textEnNlt: She soon became pregnant again and gave birth to another son. She named him Simeon, for she said, "The Lord heard that I was unloved and has given me another son."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she conceived again and gave birth to a son, and said, "Because the Lord has heard that I am unloved, He has therefore given me this son also." So she named him Simeon.
verses.textEn: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Because the Lord heard that I am not loved, he gave me this one too." So she named him Simeon.

verses.textZh: 她又怀孕，生了一个儿子，就说："这一次，我的丈夫要依恋我了，因为我已经给他生了三个儿子。"因此给孩子起名叫利未。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她又怀孕，生了一个儿子，就说："这一次，我的丈夫要依恋我了，因为我已经给他生了三个儿子。"因此给孩子起名叫利未。
verses.textZhCuv: 她又怀孕生子，起名叫利未 ，说：「我给丈夫生了三个儿子，他必与我联合。」
verses.textEnNiv: Again she conceived, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." So he was named Levi.
verses.textEnEsv: Again she conceived and bore a son, and said, "Now this time my husband will be attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." Therefore his name was called Levi.
verses.textEnNkjv: She conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Now this time my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." Therefore his name was called Levi.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she became pregnant a third time and gave birth to another son. He was named Levi, for she said, "Surely this time my husband will feel affection for me, since I have given him three sons!"
verses.textEnNasb: And she conceived again and gave birth to a son, and said, "Now this time my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." Therefore he was named Levi.
verses.textEn: Again she conceived, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "Now at last my husband will become attached to me, because I have borne him three sons." So he was named Levi.

verses.textZh: 她又怀孕，生了一个儿子，就说："这一次，我要赞美耶和华了。"因此给孩子起名叫犹大。这样，她才停止了生育。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她又怀孕，生了一个儿子，就说："这一次，我要赞美耶和华了。"因此给孩子起名叫犹大。这样，她才停止了生育。
verses.textZhCuv: 她又怀孕生子，说：「这回我要赞美耶和华」，因此给他起名叫犹大 。这才停了生育。
verses.textEnNiv: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "This time I will praise the Lord ." So she named him Judah. Then she stopped having children.
verses.textEnEsv: And she conceived again and bore a son, and said, "This time I will praise the Lord ." Therefore she called his name Judah. Then she ceased bearing.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she conceived again and bore a son, and said, "Now I will praise the Lord." Therefore she called his name Judah. Then she stopped bearing.
verses.textEnNlt: Once again Leah became pregnant and gave birth to another son. She named him Judah, for she said, "Now I will praise the Lord !" And then she stopped having children.
verses.textEnNasb: And she conceived again and gave birth to a son, and said, "This time I will praise the Lord." Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped having children.
verses.textEn: She conceived again, and when she gave birth to a son she said, "This time I will praise the Lord ." So she named him Judah. Then she stopped having children.

verses.textZh: 拉结见自己没有给雅各生孩子，就嫉妒她的姊姊，对雅各说："你要给我儿子，不然，我要死了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结见自己没有给雅各生孩子，就嫉妒她的姊姊，对雅各说："你要给我儿子，不然，我要死了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结见自己不给雅各生子，就嫉妒她姊姊，对雅各说：「你给我孩子，不然我就死了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing Jacob any children, she became jealous of her sister. So she said to Jacob, "Give me children, or I’ll die!"
verses.textEnEsv: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, she envied her sister. She said to Jacob, "Give me children, or I shall die!"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister, and said to Jacob, "Give me children, or else I die!"
verses.textEnNlt: When Rachel saw that she wasn’t having any children for Jacob, she became jealous of her sister. She pleaded with Jacob, "Give me children, or I’ll die!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now when Rachel saw that she had not borne Jacob any children, she became jealous of her sister; and she said to Jacob, "Give me children, or else I am going to die."
verses.textEn: When Rachel saw that she was not bearing Jacob any children, she became jealous of her sister. So she said to Jacob, "Give me children, or I’ll die!"

verses.textZh: 雅各就向拉结生气，说："使你不能生育的是神，我能代替他吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各就向拉结生气，说："使你不能生育的是神，我能代替他吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各向拉结生气，说：「叫你不生育的是神，我岂能代替他作主呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob became angry with her and said, "Am I in the place of God, who has kept you from having children?"
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob’s anger was kindled against Rachel, and he said, "Am I in the place of God, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob’s anger was aroused against Rachel, and he said, "Am I in the place of God, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob became furious with Rachel. "Am I God?" he asked. "He’s the one who has kept you from having children!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, "Am I in the place of God, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?"
verses.textEn: Jacob became angry with her and said, "Am I in the place of God, who has kept you from having children?"

verses.textZh: 拉结说："我的婢女辟拉在这里，你可以与她亲近，使她生子归我，我就可以从她得到孩子 。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结说："我的婢女辟拉在这里，你可以与她亲近，使她生子归我，我就可以从她得到孩子 。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结说：「有我的使女辟拉在这里，你可以与她同房，使她生子在我膝下，我便因她也得孩子 。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then she said, "Here is Bilhah, my servant. Sleep with her so that she can bear children for me and I too can build a family through her."
verses.textEnEsv: Then she said, "Here is my servant Bilhah; go in to her, so that she may give birth on my behalf, that even I may have children through her."
verses.textEnNkjv: So she said, "Here is my maid Bilhah; go in to her, and she will bear achild on my knees, that I also may have children by her."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Rachel told him, "Take my maid, Bilhah, and sleep with her. She will bear children for me, and through her I can have a family, too."
verses.textEnNasb: Then she said, "Here is my female slave Bilhah: have relations with her that she may give birth on my knees, so that by her I too may obtain a child."
verses.textEn: Then she said, "Here is Bilhah, my servant. Sleep with her so that she can bear children for me and I too can build a family through her."

verses.textZh: 于是，拉结把自己的婢女辟拉给了雅各为妾，雅各就与她亲近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，拉结把自己的婢女辟拉给了雅各为妾，雅各就与她亲近。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结就把她的使女辟拉给丈夫为妾；雅各便与她同房，

verses.textEnNkjv: Then she gave him Bilhah her maid as wife, and Jacob went in to her.
verses.textEnNlt: So Rachel gave her servant, Bilhah, to Jacob as a wife, and he slept with her.
verses.textEnNasb: So she gave him her slave Bilhah as a wife, and Jacob had relations with her.
verses.textEn: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife. Jacob slept with her,

verses.textZh: 辟拉怀孕，给雅各生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 辟拉怀孕，给雅各生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 辟拉就怀孕，给雅各生了一个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: and she became pregnant and bore him a son.
verses.textEnEsv: And Bilhah conceived and bore Jacob a son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Bilhah conceived and bore Jacob a son.
verses.textEnNlt: Bilhah became pregnant and presented him with a son.
verses.textEnNasb: Bilhah conceived and bore Jacob a son.
verses.textEn: and she became pregnant and bore him a son.

verses.textZh: 拉结说："神为我伸了冤，也垂听了我的声音，赐给我一个儿子。"所以给他起名叫但。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结说："神为我伸了冤，也垂听了我的声音，赐给我一个儿子。"所以给他起名叫但。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结说：「神伸了我的冤，也听了我的声音，赐我一个儿子」，因此给他起名叫但 。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Rachel said, "God has vindicated me; he has listened to my plea and given me a son." Because of this she named him Dan.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Rachel said, "God has judged me, and has also heard my voice and given me a son." Therefore she called his name Dan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Rachel said, "God has judged my case; and He has also heard my voice and given me a son." Therefore she called his name Dan.
verses.textEnNlt: Rachel named him Dan, for she said, "God has vindicated me! He has heard my request and given me a son."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Rachel said, "God has vindicated me, and has indeed heard my voice and has given me a son." Therefore she named him Dan.
verses.textEn: Then Rachel said, "God has vindicated me; he has listened to my plea and given me a son." Because of this she named him Dan.

verses.textZh: 拉结的使女辟拉又怀孕，给雅各生了第二个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结的使女辟拉又怀孕，给雅各生了第二个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结的使女辟拉又怀孕，给雅各生了第二个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
verses.textEnEsv: Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Rachel’s maid Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Bilhah became pregnant again and gave Jacob a second son.
verses.textEnNasb: And Rachel’s slave Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.
verses.textEn: Rachel’s servant Bilhah conceived again and bore Jacob a second son.

verses.textZh: 拉结说："我与姊姊大大地相争 ，我得胜了。"于是给孩子起名叫拿弗他利 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结说："我与姊姊大大地相争 ，我得胜了。"于是给孩子起名叫拿弗他利 。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结说：「我与我姊姊大大相争，并且得胜」，于是给他起名叫拿弗他利 。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Rachel said, "I have had a great struggle with my sister, and I have won." So she named him Naphtali.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Rachel said, "With mighty wrestlings I have wrestled with my sister and have prevailed." So she called his name Naphtali.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Rachel said, "With great wrestlings I have wrestled with my sister, and indeed I have prevailed." So she called his name Naphtali.
verses.textEnNlt: Rachel named him Naphtali, for she said, "I have struggled hard with my sister, and I’m winning!"
verses.textEnNasb: So Rachel said, "With mighty wrestling I have wrestled with my sister, and I have indeed prevailed." And she named him Naphtali.
verses.textEn: Then Rachel said, "I have had a great struggle with my sister, and I have won." So she named him Naphtali.

verses.textZh: 利亚见自己停止生育，就把她的婢女悉帕给了雅各为妾。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚见自己停止生育，就把她的婢女悉帕给了雅各为妾。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚见自己停了生育，就把使女悉帕给雅各为妾。
verses.textEnNiv: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she took her servant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
verses.textEnEsv: When Leah saw that she had ceased bearing children, she took her servant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Leah saw that she had stopped bearing, she took Zilpah her maid and gave her to Jacob as wife.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Leah realized that she wasn’t getting pregnant anymore, so she took her servant, Zilpah, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
verses.textEnNasb: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she took her slave Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.
verses.textEn: When Leah saw that she had stopped having children, she took her servant Zilpah and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

verses.textZh: 利亚的婢女悉帕给雅各生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚的婢女悉帕给雅各生了一个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚的使女悉帕给雅各生了一个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Leah’s maid Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon Zilpah presented him with a son.
verses.textEnNasb: And Leah’s slave Zilpah bore Jacob a son.
verses.textEn: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a son.

verses.textZh: 利亚说："我真幸运。"给他起名叫迦得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚说："我真幸运。"给他起名叫迦得。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚说：「万幸！」于是给他起名叫迦得 。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Leah said, "What good fortune!" So she named him Gad.
verses.textEnEsv: And Leah said, "Good fortune has come!" so she called his name Gad.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Leah said, "A troop comes!" So she called his name Gad.
verses.textEnNlt: Leah named him Gad, for she said, "How fortunate I am!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Leah said, " How fortunate!" So she named him Gad.
verses.textEn: Then Leah said, "What good fortune!" So she named him Gad.

verses.textZh: 利亚的婢女悉帕又给雅各生了第二个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚的婢女悉帕又给雅各生了第二个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚的使女悉帕又给雅各生了第二个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.
verses.textEnEsv: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Leah’s maid Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Zilpah gave Jacob a second son.
verses.textEnNasb: And Leah’s slave Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.
verses.textEn: Leah’s servant Zilpah bore Jacob a second son.

verses.textZh: 利亚说："我真有福气，众女子都要称我是有福的。"于是给孩子起名叫亚设。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚说："我真有福气，众女子都要称我是有福的。"于是给孩子起名叫亚设。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚说：「我有福啊，众女子都要称我是有福的」，于是给他起名叫亚设 。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Leah said, "How happy I am! The women will call me happy." So she named him Asher.
verses.textEnEsv: And Leah said, "Happy am I! For women have called me happy." So she called his name Asher.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Leah said, "I am happy, for the daughters will call me blessed." So she called his name Asher.
verses.textEnNlt: And Leah named him Asher, for she said, "What joy is mine! Now the other women will celebrate with me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Leah said, " Happy am I! For women will call me happy." So she named him Asher.
verses.textEn: Then Leah said, "How happy I am! The women will call me happy." So she named him Asher.

verses.textZh: 到了收割麦子的时候，流本出去，在田间找到了一些风茄，就拿来给他母亲利亚。拉结对利亚说："请你把你儿子的风茄分一些给我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了收割麦子的时候，流本出去，在田间找到了一些风茄，就拿来给他母亲利亚。拉结对利亚说："请你把你儿子的风茄分一些给我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 割麦子的时候，吕便往田里去，寻见风茄，拿来给他母亲利亚。拉结对利亚说：「请你把你儿子的风茄给我些。」
verses.textEnNiv: During wheat harvest, Reuben went out into the fields and found some mandrake plants, which he brought to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes."
verses.textEnEsv: In the days of wheat harvest Reuben went and found mandrakes in the field and brought them to his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes."
verses.textEnNlt: One day during the wheat harvest, Reuben found some mandrakes growing in a field and brought them to his mother, Leah. Rachel begged Leah, "Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes."
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the days of wheat harvest Reuben went and found mandrake fruits in the field, and brought them to his mother Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes."
verses.textEn: During wheat harvest, Reuben went out into the fields and found some mandrake plants, which he brought to his mother Leah. Rachel said to Leah, "Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes."

verses.textZh: 利亚回答拉结："你夺去了我的丈夫，还算小事吗？你还要夺去我儿子的风茄吗？"拉结说："好吧，今夜就让他与你同睡，来交换你儿子的风茄。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚回答拉结："你夺去了我的丈夫，还算小事吗？你还要夺去我儿子的风茄吗？"拉结说："好吧，今夜就让他与你同睡，来交换你儿子的风茄。"
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚说：「你夺了我的丈夫还算小事吗？你又要夺我儿子的风茄吗？」拉结说：「为你儿子的风茄，今夜他可以与你同寝。」
verses.textEnNiv: But she said to her, "Wasn’t it enough that you took away my husband? Will you take my son’s mandrakes too?" "Very well," Rachel said, "he can sleep with you tonight in return for your son’s mandrakes."
verses.textEnEsv: But she said to her, "Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes also?" Rachel said, "Then he may lie with you tonight in exchange for your son’s mandrakes."
verses.textEnNkjv: But she said to her, "Isit a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes also?" And Rachel said, "Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes."
verses.textEnNlt: But Leah angrily replied, "Wasn’t it enough that you stole my husband? Now will you steal my son’s mandrakes, too?" Rachel answered, "I will let Jacob sleep with you tonight if you give me some of the mandrakes."
verses.textEnNasb: But she said to her, "Is it a small matter for you to take my husband? And would you take my son’s mandrakes also?" So Rachel said, "Therefore he may sleep with you tonight in return for your son’s mandrakes."
verses.textEn: But she said to her, "Wasn’t it enough that you took away my husband? Will you take my son’s mandrakes too?" "Very well," Rachel said, "he can sleep with you tonight in return for your son’s mandrakes."

verses.textZh: 到了晚上，雅各从田间回来，利亚出去迎接他，说："你要与我亲近，因为我实在用我儿子的风茄把你雇下了。"那一夜，雅各就与利亚同睡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了晚上，雅各从田间回来，利亚出去迎接他，说："你要与我亲近，因为我实在用我儿子的风茄把你雇下了。"那一夜，雅各就与利亚同睡。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了晚上，雅各从田里回来，利亚出来迎接他，说：「你要与我同寝，因为我实在用我儿子的风茄把你雇下了。」那一夜，雅各就与她同寝。
verses.textEnNiv: So when Jacob came in from the fields that evening, Leah went out to meet him. "You must sleep with me," she said. "I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes." So he slept with her that night.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jacob came from the field in the evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, "You must come in to me, for I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes." So he lay with her that night.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jacob came out of the field in the evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, "You must come in to me, for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes." And he lay with her that night.
verses.textEnNlt: So that evening, as Jacob was coming home from the fields, Leah went out to meet him. "You must come and sleep with me tonight!" she said. "I have paid for you with some mandrakes that my son found." So that night he slept with Leah.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jacob came in from the field in the evening, Leah went out to meet him and said, "You must have relations with me, for I have indeed hired you with my son’s mandrakes." So he slept with her that night.
verses.textEn: So when Jacob came in from the fields that evening, Leah went out to meet him. "You must sleep with me," she said. "I have hired you with my son’s mandrakes." So he slept with her that night.

verses.textZh: 神垂听了利亚的祷告，利亚就怀孕，给雅各生了第五个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神垂听了利亚的祷告，利亚就怀孕，给雅各生了第五个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 神应允了利亚，她就怀孕，给雅各生了第五个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.
verses.textEnEsv: And God listened to Leah, and she conceived and bore Jacob a fifth son.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God listened to Leah, and she conceived and bore Jacob a fifth son.
verses.textEnNlt: And God answered Leah’s prayers. She became pregnant again and gave birth to a fifth son for Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: God listened to Leah, and she conceived and bore Jacob a fifth son.
verses.textEn: God listened to Leah, and she became pregnant and bore Jacob a fifth son.

verses.textZh: 利亚说："神给了我酬报，因为我把我的婢女给了我的丈夫。"于是给孩子起名叫以萨迦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚说："神给了我酬报，因为我把我的婢女给了我的丈夫。"于是给孩子起名叫以萨迦。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚说：「神给了我价值，因为我把使女给了我丈夫」，于是给他起名叫以萨迦 。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Leah said, "God has rewarded me for giving my servant to my husband." So she named him Issachar.
verses.textEnEsv: Leah said, "God has given me my wages because I gave my servant to my husband." So she called his name Issachar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Leah said, "God has given me my wages, because I have given my maid to my husband." So she called his name Issachar.
verses.textEnNlt: She named him Issachar, for she said, "God has rewarded me for giving my servant to my husband as a wife."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Leah said, "God has given me my reward, because I gave my slave to my husband." So she named him Issachar.
verses.textEn: Then Leah said, "God has rewarded me for giving my servant to my husband." So she named him Issachar.

verses.textZh: 利亚又怀孕，给雅各生了第六个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚又怀孕，给雅各生了第六个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚又怀孕，给雅各生了第六个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.
verses.textEnEsv: And Leah conceived again, and she bore Jacob a sixth son.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Leah became pregnant again and gave birth to a sixth son for Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: And Leah conceived again and bore a sixth son to Jacob.
verses.textEn: Leah conceived again and bore Jacob a sixth son.

verses.textZh: 利亚说："神把美好的礼物送了给我，这一次我的丈夫要抬举我了，因为我给他生了六个儿子。"于是给孩子起名叫西布伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚说："神把美好的礼物送了给我，这一次我的丈夫要抬举我了，因为我给他生了六个儿子。"于是给孩子起名叫西布伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚说：「神赐我厚赏；我丈夫必与我同住，因我给他生了六个儿子」，于是给他起名西布伦 。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Leah said, "God has presented me with a precious gift. This time my husband will treat me with honor, because I have borne him six sons." So she named him Zebulun.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Leah said, "God has endowed me with a good endowment; now my husband will honor me, because I have borne him six sons." So she called his name Zebulun.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Leah said, "God has endowed me with a good endowment; now my husband will dwell with me, because I have borne him six sons." So she called his name Zebulun.
verses.textEnNlt: She named him Zebulun, for she said, "God has given me a good reward. Now my husband will treat me with respect, for I have given him six sons."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Leah said, "God has endowed me with a good gift; finally my husband will acknowledge me as his wife, because I have borne him six sons." So she named him Zebulun.
verses.textEn: Then Leah said, "God has presented me with a precious gift. This time my husband will treat me with honor, because I have borne him six sons." So she named him Zebulun.

verses.textZh: 后来利亚又生了一个女儿，给她起名叫底拿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来利亚又生了一个女儿，给她起名叫底拿。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来又生了一个女儿，给她起名叫底拿。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward she bore a daughter and called her name Dinah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward she bore a daughter, and called her name Dinah.
verses.textEnNlt: Later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward she gave birth to a daughter, and named her Dinah.
verses.textEn: Some time later she gave birth to a daughter and named her Dinah.

verses.textZh: 神顾念拉结，垂听了她的祷告，使她能生育。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神顾念拉结，垂听了她的祷告，使她能生育。
verses.textZhCuv: 神顾念拉结，应允了她，使她能生育。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and enabled her to conceive.
verses.textEnEsv: Then God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her and opened her womb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her and opened her womb.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God remembered Rachel’s plight and answered her prayers by enabling her to have children.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her and opened her womb.
verses.textEn: Then God remembered Rachel; he listened to her and enabled her to conceive.

verses.textZh: 拉结就怀孕，生了一个儿子，说："神把我的耻辱除去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结就怀孕，生了一个儿子，说："神把我的耻辱除去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结怀孕生子，说：「神除去了我的羞耻」，
verses.textEnNiv: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son and said, "God has taken away my disgrace."
verses.textEnEsv: She conceived and bore a son and said, "God has taken away my reproach."
verses.textEnNkjv: And she conceived and bore a son, and said, "God has taken away my reproach."
verses.textEnNlt: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son. "God has removed my disgrace," she said.
verses.textEnNasb: So she conceived and gave birth to a son, and said, "God has taken away my disgrace."
verses.textEn: She became pregnant and gave birth to a son and said, "God has taken away my disgrace."

verses.textZh: 于是给孩子起名叫约瑟，说："愿耶和华再给我一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是给孩子起名叫约瑟，说："愿耶和华再给我一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就给他起名叫约瑟 ，意思说：「愿耶和华再增添我一个儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: She named him Joseph, and said, "May the Lord add to me another son."
verses.textEnEsv: And she called his name Joseph, saying, "May the Lord add to me another son!"
verses.textEnNkjv: So she called his name Joseph, and said, "The Lord shall add to me another son."
verses.textEnNlt: And she named him Joseph, for she said, "May the Lord add yet another son to my family."
verses.textEnNasb: And she named him Joseph, saying, "May the Lord give me another son."
verses.textEn: She named him Joseph, and said, "May the Lord add to me another son."

verses.textZh: 拉结生了约瑟以后，雅各对拉班说："请你让我走吧，我好回到自己的地方，自己的故乡去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结生了约瑟以后，雅各对拉班说："请你让我走吧，我好回到自己的地方，自己的故乡去。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结生约瑟之后，雅各对拉班说：「请打发我走，叫我回到我本乡本土去。
verses.textEnNiv: After Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, "Send me on my way so I can go back to my own homeland.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, "Send me away, that I may go to my own home and country.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, "Send me away, that I may go to my own place and to my country.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon after Rachel had given birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, "Please release me so I can go home to my own country.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, when Rachel had given birth to Joseph, that Jacob said to Laban, "Send me away, so that I may go to my own place and to my own country.
verses.textEn: After Rachel gave birth to Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, "Send me on my way so I can go back to my own homeland.

verses.textZh: 请你把我服事你所得的妻子和儿女都给我，让我回去；我怎样服事了你，你是知道的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你把我服事你所得的妻子和儿女都给我，让我回去；我怎样服事了你，你是知道的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 请你把我服事你所得的妻子和儿女给我，让我走；我怎样服事你，你都知道。」
verses.textEnNiv: Give me my wives and children, for whom I have served you, and I will be on my way. You know how much work I’ve done for you."
verses.textEnEsv: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, that I may go, for you know the service that I have given you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service which I have done for you."
verses.textEnNlt: Let me take my wives and children, for I have earned them by serving you, and let me be on my way. You certainly know how hard I have worked for you."
verses.textEnNasb: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you yourself know my service which I have rendered you."
verses.textEn: Give me my wives and children, for whom I have served you, and I will be on my way. You know how much work I’ve done for you."

verses.textZh: 拉班对他说："我若蒙你赏脸，请你不要走，因为我得了神旨，知道耶和华赐福给我，是因你的缘故。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班对他说："我若蒙你赏脸，请你不要走，因为我得了神旨，知道耶和华赐福给我，是因你的缘故。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班对他说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你仍与我同住，因为我已算定，耶和华赐福与我是为你的缘故」；
verses.textEnNiv: But Laban said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the Lord has blessed me because of you."
verses.textEnEsv: But Laban said to him, "If I have found favor in your sight, I have learned by divination that the Lord has blessed me because of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban said to him, "Please stay, if I have found favor in your eyes, for I have learned by experience that the Lord has blessed me for your sake."
verses.textEnNlt: "Please listen to me," Laban replied. "I have become wealthy, for the Lord has blessed me because of you.
verses.textEnNasb: But Laban said to him, "If it pleases you at all, stay with me; I have determined by divination that the Lord has blessed me on your account."
verses.textEn: But Laban said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, please stay. I have learned by divination that the Lord has blessed me because of you."

verses.textZh: 他又说："请你定你的工资吧，我必给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又说："请你定你的工资吧，我必给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「请你定你的工价，我就给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: He added, "Name your wages, and I will pay them."
verses.textEnEsv: Name your wages, and I will give it."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Name me your wages, and I will give it."
verses.textEnNlt: Tell me how much I owe you. Whatever it is, I’ll pay it."
verses.textEnNasb: He continued, "Name me your wages, and I will give them."
verses.textEn: He added, "Name your wages, and I will pay them."

verses.textZh: 雅各对拉班说："我怎样服事了你，你的牲畜在我手里情形怎样，你是知道的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各对拉班说："我怎样服事了你，你的牲畜在我手里情形怎样，你是知道的。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各对他说：「我怎样服事你，你的牲畜在我手里怎样，是你知道的。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob said to him, "You know how I have worked for you and how your livestock has fared under my care.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob said to him, "You yourself know how I have served you, and how your livestock has fared with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob said to him, "You know how I have served you and how your livestock has been with me.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob replied, "You know how hard I’ve worked for you, and how your flocks and herds have grown under my care.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jacob said to him, "You yourself know how I have served you and how your livestock have fared with me.
verses.textEn: Jacob said to him, "You know how I have worked for you and how your livestock has fared under my care.

verses.textZh: 我没来以前，你所有的很少，现在却大大地增加了；耶和华随着我的脚踪赐福给你。现在，我甚么时候才能兴家立业呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我没来以前，你所有的很少，现在却大大地增加了；耶和华随着我的脚踪赐福给你。现在，我甚么时候才能兴家立业呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我未来之先，你所有的很少，现今却发大众多，耶和华随我的脚步赐福与你。如今，我什么时候才为自己兴家立业呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: The little you had before I came has increased greatly, and the Lord has blessed you wherever I have been. But now, when may I do something for my own household?"
verses.textEnEsv: For you had little before I came, and it has increased abundantly, and the Lord has blessed you wherever I turned. But now when shall I provide for my own household also?"
verses.textEnNkjv: For what you had before I camewas little, and it has increased to a great amount; the Lord has blessed you since my coming. And now, when shall I also provide for my own house?"
verses.textEnNlt: You had little indeed before I came, but your wealth has increased enormously. The Lord has blessed you through everything I’ve done. But now, what about me? When can I start providing for my own family?"
verses.textEnNasb: For you had little before I came, and it has increased to a multitude, and the Lord has blessed you wherever I turned. But now, when shall I provide for my own household also?"
verses.textEn: The little you had before I came has increased greatly, and the Lord has blessed you wherever I have been. But now, when may I do something for my own household?"

verses.textZh: 拉班问："我该给你甚么？"雅各回答："你甚么也不必给我；只要你答应我这一件事，我就继续牧放看守你的羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班问："我该给你甚么？"雅各回答："你甚么也不必给我；只要你答应我这一件事，我就继续牧放看守你的羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班说：「我当给你什么呢？」雅各说：「什么你也不必给我，只有一件事，你若应承，我便仍旧牧放你的羊群。
verses.textEnNiv: "What shall I give you?" he asked. "Don’t give me anything," Jacob replied. "But if you will do this one thing for me, I will go on tending your flocks and watching over them:
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "What shall I give you?" Jacob said, "You shall not give me anything. If you will do this for me, I will again pasture your flock and keep it:
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "What shall I give you?" And Jacob said, "You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed and keep your flocks:
verses.textEnNlt: "What wages do you want?" Laban asked again. Jacob replied, "Don’t give me anything. Just do this one thing, and I’ll continue to tend and watch over your flocks.
verses.textEnNasb: So he said, "What shall I give you?" And Jacob said, "You shall not give me anything. If you will do this one thing for me, I will again pasture and keep your flock:
verses.textEn: "What shall I give you?" he asked. "Don’t give me anything," Jacob replied. "But if you will do this one thing for me, I will go on tending your flocks and watching over them:

verses.textZh: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，凡有斑点的羊、黑色的绵羊和有斑点的山羊，都挑出来，作为我的工资。
verses.textZhCnvs: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，凡有斑点的羊、黑色的绵羊和有斑点的山羊，都挑出来，作为我的工资。
verses.textZhCuv: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，把绵羊中凡有点的、有斑的，和黑色的，并山羊中凡有斑的、有点的，都挑出来；将来这一等的就算我的工价。
verses.textEnNiv: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb and every spotted or speckled goat. They will be my wages.
verses.textEnEsv: let me pass through all your flock today, removing from it every speckled and spotted sheep and every black lamb, and the spotted and speckled among the goats, and they shall be my wages.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let me pass through all your flock today, removing from there all the speckled and spotted sheep, and all the brown ones among the lambs, and the spotted and speckled among the goats; and these shall be my wages.
verses.textEnNlt: Let me inspect your flocks today and remove all the sheep and goats that are speckled or spotted, along with all the black sheep. Give these to me as my wages.
verses.textEnNasb: let me pass through your entire flock today, removing from there every speckled or spotted sheep and every black sheep among the lambs, and the spotted or speckled among the goats; and those shall be my wages.
verses.textEn: Let me go through all your flocks today and remove from them every speckled or spotted sheep, every dark-colored lamb and every spotted or speckled goat. They will be my wages.

verses.textZh: 日后你来查看我的工资的时候，我好对你证明我的公道。凡在我手里没有斑点的山羊，或不是黑色的绵羊，都算是我偷来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 日后你来查看我的工资的时候，我好对你证明我的公道。凡在我手里没有斑点的山羊，或不是黑色的绵羊，都算是我偷来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以后你来查看我的工价，凡在我手里的山羊不是有点有斑的，绵羊不是黑色的，那就算是我偷的；这样便可证出我的公义来。」
verses.textEnNiv: And my honesty will testify for me in the future, whenever you check on the wages you have paid me. Any goat in my possession that is not speckled or spotted, or any lamb that is not dark-colored, will be considered stolen."
verses.textEnEsv: So my honesty will answer for me later, when you come to look into my wages with you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats and black among the lambs, if found with me, shall be counted stolen."
verses.textEnNkjv: So my righteousness will answer for me in time to come, when the subject of my wages comes before you: every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and brown among the lambs, will be considered stolen, if itis with me."
verses.textEnNlt: In the future, when you check on the animals you have given me as my wages, you’ll see that I have been honest. If you find in my flock any goats without speckles or spots, or any sheep that are not black, you will know that I have stolen them from you."
verses.textEnNasb: So my honesty will answer for me later, when you come concerning my wages. Every one that is not speckled or spotted among the goats, or black among the lambs, if found with me, will be considered stolen."
verses.textEn: And my honesty will testify for me in the future, whenever you check on the wages you have paid me. Any goat in my possession that is not speckled or spotted, or any lamb that is not dark-colored, will be considered stolen."

verses.textZh: 拉班回答："好吧，就照你的话去作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班回答："好吧，就照你的话去作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班说：「好啊！我情愿照着你的话行。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Agreed," said Laban. "Let it be as you have said."
verses.textEnEsv: Laban said, "Good! Let it be as you have said."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban said, "Oh, that it were according to your word!"
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," Laban replied. "It will be as you say."
verses.textEnNasb: Laban said, " Good, let it be according to your word."
verses.textEn: "Agreed," said Laban. "Let it be as you have said."

verses.textZh: 当日，拉班把有条纹和有斑点的公山羊、有斑点和有白纹的母山羊，以及所有黑色的绵羊，都挑出来交在自己的众子手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当日，拉班把有条纹和有斑点的公山羊、有斑点和有白纹的母山羊，以及所有黑色的绵羊，都挑出来交在自己的众子手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日，拉班把有纹的、有斑的公山羊，有点的、有斑的、有杂白纹的母山羊，并黑色的绵羊，都挑出来，交在他儿子们的手下，
verses.textEnNiv: That same day he removed all the male goats that were streaked or spotted, and all the speckled or spotted female goats (all that had white on them) and all the dark-colored lambs, and he placed them in the care of his sons.
verses.textEnEsv: But that day Laban removed the male goats that were striped and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white on it, and every lamb that was black, and put them in the charge of his sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he removed that day the male goats that were speckled and spotted, all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had some white in it, and all the brown ones among the lambs, and gave them into the hand of his sons.
verses.textEnNlt: But that very day Laban went out and removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, all the female goats that were speckled and spotted or had white patches, and all the black sheep. He placed them in the care of his own sons,
verses.textEnNasb: So he removed on that day the striped or spotted male goats, and all the speckled or spotted female goats, every one with white on it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and put them in the care of his sons.
verses.textEn: That same day he removed all the male goats that were streaked or spotted, and all the speckled or spotted female goats (all that had white on them) and all the dark-colored lambs, and he placed them in the care of his sons.

verses.textZh: 又使自己和雅各之间相距有三天的路程。雅各就牧放拉班其余的羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又使自己和雅各之间相距有三天的路程。雅各就牧放拉班其余的羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 又使自己和雅各相离三天的路程。雅各就牧养拉班其余的羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob continued to tend the rest of Laban’s flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: And he set a distance of three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob pastured the rest of Laban’s flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he put three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
verses.textEnNlt: who took them a three-days’ journey from where Jacob was. Meanwhile, Jacob stayed and cared for the rest of Laban’s flock.
verses.textEnNasb: And he put a distance of three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.
verses.textEn: Then he put a three-day journey between himself and Jacob, while Jacob continued to tend the rest of Laban’s flocks.

verses.textZh: 雅各拿杨树、杏树和枫树的嫩枝子，把树皮剥成白色的条纹，使枝子露出白的部分来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各拿杨树、杏树和枫树的嫩枝子，把树皮剥成白色的条纹，使枝子露出白的部分来。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各拿杨树、杏树、枫树的嫩枝，将皮剥成白纹，使枝子露出白的来，
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob, however, took fresh-cut branches from poplar, almond and plane trees and made white stripes on them by peeling the bark and exposing the white inner wood of the branches.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob took fresh sticks of poplar and almond and plane trees, and peeled white streaks in them, exposing the white of the sticks.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jacob took for himself rods of green poplar and of the almond and chestnut trees, peeled white strips in them, and exposed the white which was in the rods.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob took some fresh branches from poplar, almond, and plane trees and peeled off strips of bark, making white streaks on them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob took fresh rods of poplar, almond, and plane trees, and peeled white stripes in them, exposing the white that was in the rods.
verses.textEn: Jacob, however, took fresh-cut branches from poplar, almond and plane trees and made white stripes on them by peeling the bark and exposing the white inner wood of the branches.

verses.textZh: 然后把剥了皮的枝子插在水沟和水槽里，枝子正对着来喝水的羊群。羊群来喝水的时候，就彼此交配。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后把剥了皮的枝子插在水沟和水槽里，枝子正对着来喝水的羊群。羊群来喝水的时候，就彼此交配。
verses.textZhCuv: 将剥了皮的枝子，对着羊群，插在饮羊的水沟里和水槽里，羊来喝的时候，牝牡配合。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he placed the peeled branches in all the watering troughs, so that they would be directly in front of the flocks when they came to drink. When the flocks were in heat and came to drink,
verses.textEnEsv: He set the sticks that he had peeled in front of the flocks in the troughs, that is, the watering places, where the flocks came to drink. And since they bred when they came to drink,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the rods which he had peeled, he set before the flocks in the gutters, in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink, so that they should conceive when they came to drink.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he placed these peeled branches in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink, for that was where they mated.
verses.textEnNasb: He set the rods which he had peeled in front of the flocks in the drinking troughs, that is, in the watering channels where the flocks came to drink; and they mated when they came to drink.
verses.textEn: Then he placed the peeled branches in all the watering troughs, so that they would be directly in front of the flocks when they came to drink. When the flocks were in heat and came to drink,

verses.textZh: 羊群对着枝子交配，就生下有条纹和有斑点的小羊来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 羊群对着枝子交配，就生下有条纹和有斑点的小羊来。
verses.textZhCuv: 羊对着枝子配合，就生下有纹的、有点的、有斑的来。
verses.textEnNiv: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.
verses.textEnEsv: the flocks bred in front of the sticks and so the flocks brought forth striped, speckled, and spotted.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks brought forth streaked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.textEnNlt: And when they mated in front of the white-streaked branches, they gave birth to young that were streaked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.textEnNasb: So the flocks mated by the rods, and the flocks delivered striped, speckled, and spotted offspring.
verses.textEn: they mated in front of the branches. And they bore young that were streaked or speckled or spotted.

verses.textZh: 雅各把羊羔分别出来，使拉班的羊，对着这些有条纹的和所有黑色的羊。他为自己另组羊群，不把牠们放在拉班的羊群中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各把羊羔分别出来，使拉班的羊，对着这些有条纹的和所有黑色的羊。他为自己另组羊群，不把牠们放在拉班的羊群中。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各把羊羔分出来，使拉班的羊与这有纹和黑色的羊相对，把自己的羊另放一处，不叫他和拉班的羊混杂。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob set apart the young of the flock by themselves, but made the rest face the streaked and dark-colored animals that belonged to Laban. Thus he made separate flocks for himself and did not put them with Laban’s animals.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob separated the lambs and set the faces of the flocks toward the striped and all the black in the flock of Laban. He put his own droves apart and did not put them with Laban’s flock.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob separated the lambs, and made the flocks face toward the streaked and all the brown in the flock of Laban; but he put his own flocks by themselves and did not put them with Laban’s flock.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob separated those lambs from Laban’s flock. And at mating time he turned the flock to face Laban’s animals that were streaked or black. This is how he built his own flock instead of increasing Laban’s.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob separated the lambs, and made the flocks face toward the striped and all the black in the flock of Laban; and he put his own herds apart, and did not put them with Laban’s flock.
verses.textEn: Jacob set apart the young of the flock by themselves, but made the rest face the streaked and dark-colored animals that belonged to Laban. Thus he made separate flocks for himself and did not put them with Laban’s animals.

verses.textZh: 到了肥壮的羊群要交配的时候，雅各就在羊群的面前把枝子插在水沟里，使牠们在枝子中间彼此交配。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了肥壮的羊群要交配的时候，雅各就在羊群的面前把枝子插在水沟里，使牠们在枝子中间彼此交配。
verses.textZhCuv: 到羊群肥壮配合的时候，雅各就把枝子插在水沟里，使羊对着枝子配合。
verses.textEnNiv: Whenever the stronger females were in heat, Jacob would place the branches in the troughs in front of the animals so they would mate near the branches,
verses.textEnEsv: Whenever the stronger of the flock were breeding, Jacob would lay the sticks in the troughs before the eyes of the flock, that they might breed among the sticks,
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, whenever the stronger livestock conceived, that Jacob placed the rods before the eyes of the livestock in the gutters, that they might conceive among the rods.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the stronger females were ready to mate, Jacob would place the peeled branches in the watering troughs in front of them. Then they would mate in front of the branches.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, whenever the stronger of the flock were mating, Jacob would place the rods in the sight of the flock in the drinking troughs, so that they would mate by the rods;
verses.textEn: Whenever the stronger females were in heat, Jacob would place the branches in the troughs in front of the animals so they would mate near the branches,

verses.textZh: 但当瘦弱的羊群交配的时候，雅各就不插枝子。这样，瘦弱的就归拉班，肥壮的就归雅各。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但当瘦弱的羊群交配的时候，雅各就不插枝子。这样，瘦弱的就归拉班，肥壮的就归雅各。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是到羊瘦弱配合的时候就不插枝子。这样，瘦弱的就归拉班，肥壮的就归雅各。
verses.textEnNiv: but if the animals were weak, he would not place them there. So the weak animals went to Laban and the strong ones to Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: but for the feebler of the flock he would not lay them there. So the feebler would be Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when the flocks were feeble, he did not put them in; so the feebler were Laban’s and the stronger Jacob’s.
verses.textEnNlt: But he didn’t do this with the weaker ones, so the weaker lambs belonged to Laban, and the stronger ones were Jacob’s.
verses.textEnNasb: but when the flock was sickly, he did not put them in; so the sickly were Laban’s, and the stronger were Jacob’s.
verses.textEn: but if the animals were weak, he would not place them there. So the weak animals went to Laban and the strong ones to Jacob.

verses.textZh: 于是，雅各变得非常富有，拥有很多羊群、仆婢、骆驼和驴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，雅各变得非常富有，拥有很多羊群、仆婢、骆驼和驴。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是雅各极其发大，得了许多的羊群、仆婢、骆驼，和驴。
verses.textEnNiv: In this way the man grew exceedingly prosperous and came to own large flocks, and female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the man increased greatly and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the man became exceedingly prosperous, and had large flocks, female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.textEnNlt: As a result, Jacob became very wealthy, with large flocks of sheep and goats, female and male servants, and many camels and donkeys.
verses.textEnNasb: So the man became exceedingly prosperous, and had large flocks, and female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.
verses.textEn: In this way the man grew exceedingly prosperous and came to own large flocks, and female and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

verses.textZh: 雅各听见拉班的众子谈论，说："雅各把我们父亲所有的都夺去了，他这一切财物，都是从我们父亲的财产那里得来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各听见拉班的众子谈论，说："雅各把我们父亲所有的都夺去了，他这一切财物，都是从我们父亲的财产那里得来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各听见拉班的儿子们有话说：「雅各把我们父亲所有的都夺了去，并藉着我们父亲的，得了这一切的荣耀 。」
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob heard that Laban’s sons were saying, "Jacob has taken everything our father owned and has gained all this wealth from what belonged to our father."
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jacob heard that the sons of Laban were saying, "Jacob has taken all that was our father’s, and from what was our father’s he has gained all this wealth."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jacob heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, "Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s, and from what was our father’s he has acquired all this wealth."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jacob soon learned that Laban’s sons were grumbling about him. "Jacob has robbed our father of everything!" they said. "He has gained all his wealth at our father’s expense."
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jacob heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, "Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s, and from what belonged to our father he has made all this wealth."
verses.textEn: Jacob heard that Laban’s sons were saying, "Jacob has taken everything our father owned and has gained all this wealth from what belonged to our father."

verses.textZh: 雅各也注意到拉班的脸色，对自己不像从前那样了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各也注意到拉班的脸色，对自己不像从前那样了。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各见拉班的气色向他不如从前了。
verses.textEnNiv: And Jacob noticed that Laban’s attitude toward him was not what it had been.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob saw that Laban did not regard him with favor as before.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob saw the countenance of Laban, and indeed it was not favorable toward him as before.
verses.textEnNlt: And Jacob began to notice a change in Laban’s attitude toward him.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jacob saw the attitude of Laban, and behold, it was not friendly toward him as it had been before.
verses.textEn: And Jacob noticed that Laban’s attitude toward him was not what it had been.

verses.textZh: 那时，耶和华对雅各说："你要回到你列祖之地，到你的亲族那里去，我必与你同在。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，耶和华对雅各说："你要回到你列祖之地，到你的亲族那里去，我必与你同在。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华对雅各说：「你要回你祖、你父之地，到你亲族那里去，我必与你同在。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Go back to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your fathers and to your kindred, and I will be with you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your fathers and to your family, and I will be with you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your father and grandfather and to your relatives there, and I will be with you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Return to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you."
verses.textEn: Then the Lord said to Jacob, "Go back to the land of your fathers and to your relatives, and I will be with you."

verses.textZh: 雅各就派人把拉结和利亚叫到田间的羊群那里去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各就派人把拉结和利亚叫到田间的羊群那里去，
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就打发人，叫拉结和利亚到田野羊群那里来，
verses.textEnNiv: So Jacob sent word to Rachel and Leah to come out to the fields where his flocks were.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah into the field where his flock was
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field, to his flock,
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob called Rachel and Leah out to the field where he was watching his flock.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob sent word and called Rachel and Leah to his flock in the field,
verses.textEn: So Jacob sent word to Rachel and Leah to come out to the fields where his flocks were.

verses.textZh: 对她们说："我注意到你们父亲的脸色，对我不像从前那样了；但是我父亲的神与我同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对她们说："我注意到你们父亲的脸色，对我不像从前那样了；但是我父亲的神与我同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 对她们说：「我看你们父亲的气色向我不如从前了；但我父亲的神向来与我同在。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "I see that your father’s attitude toward me is not what it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.
verses.textEnEsv: and said to them, "I see that your father does not regard me with favor as he did before. But the God of my father has been with me.
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to them, "I see your father’s countenance, that it is not favorable toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.
verses.textEnNlt: He said to them, "I have noticed that your father’s attitude toward me has changed. But the God of my father has been with me.
verses.textEnNasb: and said to them, "I see your father’s attitude, that it is not friendly toward me as it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.
verses.textEn: He said to them, "I see that your father’s attitude toward me is not what it was before, but the God of my father has been with me.

verses.textZh: 我尽了我的力量来服事你们的父亲，这是你们知道的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我尽了我的力量来服事你们的父亲，这是你们知道的；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也知道，我尽了我的力量服事你们的父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: You know that I’ve worked for your father with all my strength,
verses.textEnEsv: You know that I have served your father with all my strength,
verses.textEnNkjv: And you know that with all my might I have served your father.
verses.textEnNlt: You know how hard I have worked for your father,
verses.textEnNasb: You know that I have served your father with all my strength.
verses.textEn: You know that I’ve worked for your father with all my strength,

verses.textZh: 你们的父亲却欺骗了我，十次更改了我的工资；但神不容许他伤害我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的父亲却欺骗了我，十次更改了我的工资；但神不容许他伤害我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的父亲欺哄我，十次改了我的工价；然而神不容他害我。
verses.textEnNiv: yet your father has cheated me by changing my wages ten times. However, God has not allowed him to harm me.
verses.textEnEsv: yet your father has cheated me and changed my wages ten times. But God did not permit him to harm me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet your father has deceived me and changed my wages ten times, but God did not allow him to hurt me.
verses.textEnNlt: but he has cheated me, changing my wages ten times. But God has not allowed him to do me any harm.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet your father has cheated me and changed my wages ten times; however, God did not allow him to do me harm.
verses.textEn: yet your father has cheated me by changing my wages ten times. However, God has not allowed him to harm me.

verses.textZh: 如果他说：‘有斑点的算是你的工资’，羊群所生的全部都有斑点；如果他说：‘有条纹的算是你的工资’，羊群所生的全部有条纹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他说：‘有斑点的算是你的工资’，羊群所生的全部都有斑点；如果他说：‘有条纹的算是你的工资’，羊群所生的全部有条纹。
verses.textZhCuv: 他若说：『有点的归你作工价』，羊群所生的都有点；他若说：『有纹的归你作工价』，羊群所生的都有纹。
verses.textEnNiv: If he said, ‘The speckled ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks gave birth to speckled young; and if he said, ‘The streaked ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks bore streaked young.
verses.textEnEsv: If he said, ‘The spotted shall be your wages,’ then all the flock bore spotted; and if he said, ‘The striped shall be your wages,’ then all the flock bore striped.
verses.textEnNkjv: If he said thus: ‘The speckled shall be your wages,’ then all the flocks bore speckled. And if he said thus: ‘The streaked shall be your wages,’ then all the flocks bore streaked.
verses.textEnNlt: For if he said, ‘The speckled animals will be your wages,’ the whole flock began to produce speckled young. And when he changed his mind and said, ‘The striped animals will be your wages,’ then the whole flock produced striped young.
verses.textEnNasb: If he said this: ‘The speckled shall be your wages,’ then all the flock delivered speckled; and if he said this: ‘The striped shall be your wages,’ then all the flock delivered striped.
verses.textEn: If he said, ‘The speckled ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks gave birth to speckled young; and if he said, ‘The streaked ones will be your wages,’ then all the flocks bore streaked young.

verses.textZh: 这样，神把你们父亲的牲畜夺来，赐给我了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，神把你们父亲的牲畜夺来，赐给我了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，神把你们父亲的牲畜夺来赐给我了。
verses.textEnNiv: So God has taken away your father’s livestock and has given them to me.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus God has taken away the livestock of your father and given them to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: So God has taken away the livestock of your father and given them to me.
verses.textEnNlt: In this way, God has taken your father’s animals and given them to me.
verses.textEnNasb: So God has taken away your father’s livestock and given them to me.
verses.textEn: So God has taken away your father’s livestock and has given them to me.

verses.textZh: 有一次，羊群交配的时候，我在梦中举目观看，看见爬在母羊身上的公山羊，都是有条纹、有斑点和有花斑的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一次，羊群交配的时候，我在梦中举目观看，看见爬在母羊身上的公山羊，都是有条纹、有斑点和有花斑的。
verses.textZhCuv: 羊配合的时候，我梦中举目一看，见跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的、有点的、有花斑的。
verses.textEnNiv: "In breeding season I once had a dream in which I looked up and saw that the male goats mating with the flock were streaked, speckled or spotted.
verses.textEnEsv: In the breeding season of the flock I lifted up my eyes and saw in a dream that the goats that mated with the flock were striped, spotted, and mottled.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it happened, at the time when the flocks conceived, that I lifted my eyes and saw in a dream, and behold, the rams which leaped upon the flocks were streaked, speckled, and gray-spotted.
verses.textEnNlt: "One time during the mating season, I had a dream and saw that the male goats mating with the females were streaked, speckled, and spotted.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about at the time when the flock was breeding that I raised my eyes and saw in a dream—and behold—the male goats that were mating were striped, speckled, or mottled.
verses.textEn: "In breeding season I once had a dream in which I looked up and saw that the male goats mating with the flock were streaked, speckled or spotted.

verses.textZh: 神的使者在梦中对我说：‘雅各。’我说：‘我在这里。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的使者在梦中对我说：‘雅各。’我说：‘我在这里。’
verses.textZhCuv: 神的使者在那梦中呼叫我说：『雅各。』我说：『我在这里。』
verses.textEnNiv: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’ I answered, ‘Here I am.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then the angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am!’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Angel of God spoke to me in a dream, saying, ‘Jacob.’ And I said, ‘Here I am.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then in my dream, the angel of God said to me, ‘Jacob!’ And I replied, ‘Yes, here I am.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then the angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob’; and I said, ‘Here I am.’
verses.textEn: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob.’ I answered, ‘Here I am.’

verses.textZh: 他说：‘你举目观看，所有爬在母羊身上的公山羊，都是有条纹、有斑点和有花斑的，因为拉班向你所作的一切，我都看见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说：‘你举目观看，所有爬在母羊身上的公山羊，都是有条纹、有斑点和有花斑的，因为拉班向你所作的一切，我都看见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：『你举目观看，跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的、有点的、有花斑的；凡拉班向你所做的，我都看见了。
verses.textEnNiv: And he said, ‘Look up and see that all the male goats mating with the flock are streaked, speckled or spotted, for I have seen all that Laban has been doing to you.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, ‘Lift up your eyes and see, all the goats that mate with the flock are striped, spotted, and mottled, for I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, ‘Lift your eyes now and see, all the rams which leap on the flocks are streaked, speckled, and gray-spotted; for I have seen all that Laban is doing to you.
verses.textEnNlt: "The angel said, ‘Look up, and you will see that only the streaked, speckled, and spotted males are mating with the females of your flock. For I have seen how Laban has treated you.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, ‘Now raise your eyes and see that all the male goats that are mating are striped, speckled, or mottled; for I have seen everything that Laban has been doing to you.
verses.textEn: And he said, ‘Look up and see that all the male goats mating with the flock are streaked, speckled or spotted, for I have seen all that Laban has been doing to you.

verses.textZh: 我就是伯特利的神，你曾经在那里用油膏过石柱，又在那里向我许过愿。现在你要起程，离开这地，回到你的亲族那里去吧。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就是伯特利的神，你曾经在那里用油膏过石柱，又在那里向我许过愿。现在你要起程，离开这地，回到你的亲族那里去吧。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我是伯特利的神；你在那里用油浇过柱子，向我许过愿。现今你起来，离开这地，回你本地去吧！』」
verses.textEnNiv: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and where you made a vow to me. Now leave this land at once and go back to your native land.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and made a vow to me. Now arise, go out from this land and return to the land of your kindred.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed the pillar and where you made a vow to Me. Now arise, get out of this land, and return to the land of your family.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: I am the God who appeared to you at Bethel, the place where you anointed the pillar of stone and made your vow to me. Now get ready and leave this country and return to the land of your birth.’"
verses.textEnNasb: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a memorial stone, where you made a vow to Me; now arise, leave this land, and return to the land of your birth.’ "
verses.textEn: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar and where you made a vow to me. Now leave this land at once and go back to your native land.’ "

verses.textZh: 拉结和利亚回答雅各，说："在我们父亲的家里，我们还有可得的分和产业吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结和利亚回答雅各，说："在我们父亲的家里，我们还有可得的分和产业吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结和利亚回答雅各说：「在我们父亲的家里还有我们可得的分吗？还有我们的产业吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Then Rachel and Leah replied, "Do we still have any share in the inheritance of our father’s estate?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, "Is there any portion or inheritance left to us in our father’s house?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Rachel and Leah answered and said to him, "Is there still any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?
verses.textEnNlt: Rachel and Leah responded, "That’s fine with us! We won’t inherit any of our father’s wealth anyway.
verses.textEnNasb: Rachel and Leah said to him, "Do we still have any share or inheritance in our father’s house?
verses.textEn: Then Rachel and Leah replied, "Do we still have any share in the inheritance of our father’s estate?

verses.textZh: 他不是把我们看作外人吗？因为他把我们卖了，吞没了我们的身价。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他不是把我们看作外人吗？因为他把我们卖了，吞没了我们的身价。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不是被他当作外人吗？因为他卖了我们，吞了我们的价值。
verses.textEnNiv: Does he not regard us as foreigners? Not only has he sold us, but he has used up what was paid for us.
verses.textEnEsv: Are we not regarded by him as foreigners? For he has sold us, and he has indeed devoured our money.
verses.textEnNkjv: Are we not considered strangers by him? For he has sold us, and also completely consumed our money.
verses.textEnNlt: He has reduced our rights to those of foreign women. And after he sold us, he wasted the money you paid him for us.
verses.textEnNasb: Are we not regarded by him as foreigners? For he has sold us, and has also entirely consumed our purchase price.
verses.textEn: Does he not regard us as foreigners? Not only has he sold us, but he has used up what was paid for us.

verses.textZh: 神从我们父亲夺回来的一切财物，都是属于我们和我们的儿女的。现在神吩咐你的一切，你只管作吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神从我们父亲夺回来的一切财物，都是属于我们和我们的儿女的。现在神吩咐你的一切，你只管作吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神从我们父亲所夺出来的一切财物，那就是我们和我们孩子们的。现今凡神所吩咐你的，你只管去行吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Surely all the wealth that God took away from our father belongs to us and our children. So do whatever God has told you."
verses.textEnEsv: All the wealth that God has taken away from our father belongs to us and to our children. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do."
verses.textEnNkjv: For all these riches which God has taken from our father are really ours and our children’s; now then, whatever God has said to you, do it."
verses.textEnNlt: All the wealth God has given you from our father legally belongs to us and our children. So go ahead and do whatever God has told you."
verses.textEnNasb: Surely all the wealth which God has taken away from our father belongs to us and our children; now then, do whatever God has told you."
verses.textEn: Surely all the wealth that God took away from our father belongs to us and our children. So do whatever God has told you."

verses.textZh: 于是雅各起来，叫他的儿女和妻子们都骑上骆驼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是雅各起来，叫他的儿女和妻子们都骑上骆驼。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各起来，使他的儿子和妻子都骑上骆驼，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob put his children and his wives on camels,
verses.textEnEsv: So Jacob arose and set his sons and his wives on camels.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob rose and set his sons and his wives on camels.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob put his wives and children on camels,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob stood up and put his children and his wives on camels;
verses.textEn: Then Jacob put his children and his wives on camels,

verses.textZh: 又赶着他所有的牲畜，带着他所得的一切财物，就是他在巴旦．亚兰所得的一切牲畜，要到迦南地，他父亲以撒那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又赶着他所有的牲畜，带着他所得的一切财物，就是他在巴旦．亚兰所得的一切牲畜，要到迦南地，他父亲以撒那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 又带着他在巴旦‧亚兰所得的一切牲畜和财物，往迦南地、他父亲以撒那里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: and he drove all his livestock ahead of him, along with all the goods he had accumulated in Paddan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: He drove away all his livestock, all his property that he had gained, the livestock in his possession that he had acquired in Paddan-aram, to go to the land of Canaan to his father Isaac.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he carried away all his livestock and all his possessions which he had gained, his acquired livestock which he had gained in Padan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: and he drove all his livestock in front of him. He packed all the belongings he had acquired in Paddan-aram and set out for the land of Canaan, where his father, Isaac, lived.
verses.textEnNasb: and he drove away all his livestock and all his property which he had acquired, the livestock he possessed which he had acquired in Paddan-aram, to go to the land of Canaan to his father Isaac.
verses.textEn: and he drove all his livestock ahead of him, along with all the goods he had accumulated in Paddan Aram, to go to his father Isaac in the land of Canaan.

verses.textZh: 当时拉班剪羊毛去了，拉结就偷了他父亲的神像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时拉班剪羊毛去了，拉结就偷了他父亲的神像。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时拉班剪羊毛去了，拉结偷了他父亲家中的神像。
verses.textEnNiv: When Laban had gone to shear his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household gods.
verses.textEnEsv: Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel stole her father’s household gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel had stolen the household idols that were her father’s.
verses.textEnNlt: At the time they left, Laban was some distance away, shearing his sheep. Rachel stole her father’s household idols and took them with her.
verses.textEnNasb: Laban had gone to shear his flock, and Rachel stole the household idols that were her father’s.
verses.textEn: When Laban had gone to shear his sheep, Rachel stole her father’s household gods.

verses.textZh: 雅各瞒着亚兰人拉班 ，没有告诉拉班他将要逃走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各瞒着亚兰人拉班 ，没有告诉拉班他将要逃走。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各背着亚兰人拉班偷走了，并不告诉他，
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob tricked Laban the Aramean, by not telling him that he intended to flee.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob stole away, unknown to Laban the Syrian, in that he did not tell him that he intended to flee.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob outwitted Laban the Aramean, for they set out secretly and never told Laban they were leaving.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him that he was fleeing.
verses.textEn: Moreover, Jacob deceived Laban the Aramean by not telling him he was running away.

verses.textZh: 于是，雅各带着他所有的一切逃走了。他起程渡过了大河，面对着基列山走去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，雅各带着他所有的一切逃走了。他起程渡过了大河，面对着基列山走去。
verses.textZhCuv: 就带着所有的逃跑。他起身过大河，面向基列山行去。
verses.textEnNiv: So he fled with all he had, crossed the Euphrates River, and headed for the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: He fled with all that he had and arose and crossed the Euphrates, and set his face toward the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he fled with all that he had. He arose and crossed the river, and headed toward the mountains of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob took all his possessions with him and crossed the Euphrates River, heading for the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: So he fled with all that he had; and he got up and crossed the Euphrates River, and set out for the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEn: So he fled with all he had, crossed the Euphrates River, and headed for the hill country of Gilead.

verses.textZh: 到了第三天，有人告诉拉班说雅各逃走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第三天，有人告诉拉班说雅各逃走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到第三日，有人告诉拉班，雅各逃跑了。
verses.textEnNiv: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.
verses.textEnEsv: When it was told Laban on the third day that Jacob had fled,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.
verses.textEnNlt: Three days later, Laban was told that Jacob had fled.
verses.textEnNasb: When Laban was informed on the third day that Jacob had fled,
verses.textEn: On the third day Laban was told that Jacob had fled.

verses.textZh: 拉班就带着自己的众兄弟追赶他，追了七日的路程，才在基列山把他们追上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班就带着自己的众兄弟追赶他，追了七日的路程，才在基列山把他们追上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班带领他的众弟兄去追赶，追了七日，在基列山就追上了。
verses.textEnNiv: Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: he took his kinsmen with him and pursued him for seven days and followed close after him into the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he took his brethren with him and pursued him for seven days’ journey, and he overtook him in the mountains of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: So he gathered a group of his relatives and set out in hot pursuit. He caught up with Jacob seven days later in the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: he took his kinsmen with him and pursued him a distance of seven days’ journey, and he overtook him in the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEn: Taking his relatives with him, he pursued Jacob for seven days and caught up with him in the hill country of Gilead.

verses.textZh: 当天晚上，神在梦中来到亚兰人拉班那里，对他说："你要小心，不可与雅各说甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 当天晚上，神在梦中来到亚兰人拉班那里，对他说："你要小心，不可与雅各说甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 夜间，神到亚兰人拉班那里，在梦中对他说：「你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream at night and said to him, "Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad."
verses.textEnEsv: But God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream by night and said to him, "Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad."
verses.textEnNkjv: But God had come to Laban the Syrian in a dream by night, and said to him, "Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad."
verses.textEnNlt: But the previous night God had appeared to Laban the Aramean in a dream and told him, "I’m warning you—leave Jacob alone!"
verses.textEnNasb: However, God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream of the night and said to him, " Be careful that you do not speak to Jacob either good or bad."
verses.textEn: Then God came to Laban the Aramean in a dream at night and said to him, "Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad."

verses.textZh: 拉班追上了雅各。当时雅各已经在山上支搭了帐棚；拉班和他的众兄弟，也在基列山上支搭了帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班追上了雅各。当时雅各已经在山上支搭了帐棚；拉班和他的众兄弟，也在基列山上支搭了帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班追上雅各。雅各在山上支搭帐棚；拉班和他的众弟兄也在基列山上支搭帐棚。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there too.
verses.textEnEsv: And Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country, and Laban with his kinsmen pitched tents in the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Laban overtook Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountains, and Laban with his brethren pitched in the mountains of Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: Laban caught up with Jacob as he was camped in the hill country of Gilead, and he set up his camp not far from Jacob’s.
verses.textEnNasb: And Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country, and Laban with his kinsmen camped in the hill country of Gilead.
verses.textEn: Jacob had pitched his tent in the hill country of Gilead when Laban overtook him, and Laban and his relatives camped there too.

verses.textZh: 拉班对雅各说："你作的是甚么事呢？你瞒着我，把我的女儿们当作战俘一样带走了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班对雅各说："你作的是甚么事呢？你瞒着我，把我的女儿们当作战俘一样带走了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班对雅各说：「你做的是什么事呢？你背着我偷走了，又把我的女儿们带了去，如同用刀剑掳去的一般。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done? You’ve deceived me, and you’ve carried off my daughters like captives in war.
verses.textEnEsv: And Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done, that you have tricked me and driven away my daughters like captives of the sword?
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban said to Jacob: "What have you done, that you have stolen away unknown to me, and carried away my daughters like captives taken with the sword?
verses.textEnNlt: "What do you mean by deceiving me like this?" Laban demanded. "How dare you drag my daughters away like prisoners of war?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done by deceiving me and carrying away my daughters like captives of the sword?
verses.textEn: Then Laban said to Jacob, "What have you done? You’ve deceived me, and you’ve carried off my daughters like captives in war.

verses.textZh: 你为甚么暗中逃走，瞒着我不让我知道，使我可以欢欢喜喜地唱歌、击鼓、弹琴给你送行呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你为甚么暗中逃走，瞒着我不让我知道，使我可以欢欢喜喜地唱歌、击鼓、弹琴给你送行呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你为什么暗暗地逃跑，偷着走，并不告诉我，叫我可以欢乐、唱歌、击鼓、弹琴地送你回去？
verses.textEnNiv: Why did you run off secretly and deceive me? Why didn’t you tell me, so I could send you away with joy and singing to the music of timbrels and harps?
verses.textEnEsv: Why did you flee secretly and trick me, and did not tell me, so that I might have sent you away with mirth and songs, with tambourine and lyre?
verses.textEnNkjv: Why did you flee away secretly, and steal away from me, and not tell me; for I might have sent you away with joy and songs, with timbrel and harp?
verses.textEnNlt: Why did you slip away secretly? Why did you deceive me? And why didn’t you say you wanted to leave? I would have given you a farewell feast, with singing and music, accompanied by tambourines and harps.
verses.textEnNasb: Why did you flee secretly and deceive me, and did not tell me, so that I might have sent you away with joy and with songs, with tambourine and with lyre;
verses.textEn: Why did you run off secretly and deceive me? Why didn’t you tell me, so I could send you away with joy and singing to the music of timbrels and harps?

verses.textZh: 你又不让我与我的外孙和女儿亲吻。你所作的太糊涂了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你又不让我与我的外孙和女儿亲吻。你所作的太糊涂了！
verses.textZhCuv: 又不容我与外孙和女儿亲嘴？你所行的真是愚昧！
verses.textEnNiv: You didn’t even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. You have done a foolish thing.
verses.textEnEsv: And why did you not permit me to kiss my sons and my daughters farewell? Now you have done foolishly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And you did not allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters. Now you have done foolishly in so doing.
verses.textEnNlt: Why didn’t you let me kiss my daughters and grandchildren and tell them good-bye? You have acted very foolishly!
verses.textEnNasb: and did not allow me to kiss my grandchildren and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.
verses.textEn: You didn’t even let me kiss my grandchildren and my daughters goodbye. You have done a foolish thing.

verses.textZh: 我本来有能力可以伤害你，但昨天晚上，你们父亲的神对我说：‘你要小心，不可与雅各说甚么。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我本来有能力可以伤害你，但昨天晚上，你们父亲的神对我说：‘你要小心，不可与雅各说甚么。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我手中原有能力害你，只是你父亲的神昨夜对我说：『你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。』
verses.textEnNiv: I have the power to harm you; but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’
verses.textEnEsv: It is in my power to do you harm. But the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’
verses.textEnNkjv: It is in my power to do you harm, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you speak to Jacob neither good nor bad.’
verses.textEnNlt: I could destroy you, but the God of your father appeared to me last night and warned me, ‘Leave Jacob alone!’
verses.textEnNasb: It is in my power to do you harm, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘ Be careful not to speak either good or bad to Jacob.’
verses.textEn: I have the power to harm you; but last night the God of your father said to me, ‘Be careful not to say anything to Jacob, either good or bad.’

verses.textZh: 现在你既然渴想你的父家，一定要回去，为甚么又偷我的神像呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你既然渴想你的父家，一定要回去，为甚么又偷我的神像呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你虽然想你父家，不得不去，为什么又偷了我的神像呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now you have gone off because you longed to return to your father’s household. But why did you steal my gods?"
verses.textEnEsv: And now you have gone away because you longed greatly for your father’s house, but why did you steal my gods?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And now you have surely gone because you greatly long for your father’s house, but why did you steal my gods?"
verses.textEnNlt: I can understand your feeling that you must go, and your intense longing for your father’s home. But why have you stolen my gods?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now you have indeed gone away because you longed greatly for your father’s house; but why did you steal my gods?"
verses.textEn: Now you have gone off because you longed to return to your father’s household. But why did you steal my gods?"

verses.textZh: 雅各回答拉班，说："我逃走，是因为我害怕，我心里想：恐怕你会把你的女儿们从我的手中抢走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各回答拉班，说："我逃走，是因为我害怕，我心里想：恐怕你会把你的女儿们从我的手中抢走。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各回答拉班说：「恐怕你把你的女儿从我夺去，所以我逃跑。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob answered Laban, "I was afraid, because I thought you would take your daughters away from me by force.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob answered and said to Laban, "Because I was afraid, for I thought that you would take your daughters from me by force.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob answered and said to Laban, "Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Perhaps you would take your daughters from me by force.’
verses.textEnNlt: "I rushed away because I was afraid," Jacob answered. "I thought you would take your daughters from me by force.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob replied to Laban, "Because I was afraid, for I thought that you would take your daughters from me by force.
verses.textEn: Jacob answered Laban, "I was afraid, because I thought you would take your daughters away from me by force.

verses.textZh: 至于你的神像，你在谁身上搜出来，那人就不该活着；你当着我们众兄弟面前查一查，如果在我这里有甚么东西是你的，你只管拿去。"原来雅各不知拉结偷了神像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于你的神像，你在谁身上搜出来，那人就不该活着；你当着我们众兄弟面前查一查，如果在我这里有甚么东西是你的，你只管拿去。"原来雅各不知拉结偷了神像。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于你的神像，你在谁那里搜出来，就不容谁存活。当着我们的众弟兄，你认一认，在我这里有什么东西是你的，就拿去。」原来雅各不知道拉结偷了那些神像。
