verses.textEnNiv: But if you find anyone who has your gods, that person shall not live. In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself whether there is anything of yours here with me; and if so, take it." Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the gods.
verses.textEnEsv: Anyone with whom you find your gods shall not live. In the presence of our kinsmen point out what I have that is yours, and take it." Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.textEnNkjv: With whomever you find your gods, do not let him live. In the presence of our brethren, identify what I have of yours and take it with you." For Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.textEnNlt: But as for your gods, see if you can find them, and let the person who has taken them die! And if you find anything else that belongs to you, identify it before all these relatives of ours, and I will give it back!" But Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the household idols.
verses.textEnNasb: The one with whom you find your gods shall not live; in the presence of our relatives point out what is yours among my belongings and take it for yourself." Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen them.
verses.textEn: But if you find anyone who has your gods, that person shall not live. In the presence of our relatives, see for yourself whether there is anything of yours here with me; and if so, take it." Now Jacob did not know that Rachel had stolen the gods.

verses.textZh: 拉班进了雅各的帐棚、利亚的帐棚和两个婢女的帐棚，都没有搜出甚么，于是从利亚的帐棚出来，进了拉结的帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班进了雅各的帐棚、利亚的帐棚和两个婢女的帐棚，都没有搜出甚么，于是从利亚的帐棚出来，进了拉结的帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班进了雅各、利亚，并两个使女的帐棚，都没有搜出来，就从利亚的帐棚出来，进了拉结的帐棚。
verses.textEnNiv: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent and into Leah’s tent and into the tent of the two female servants, but he found nothing. After he came out of Leah’s tent, he entered Rachel’s tent.
verses.textEnEsv: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent and into Leah’s tent and into the tent of the two female servants, but he did not find them. And he went out of Leah’s tent and entered Rachel’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the two maids’ tents, but he did not find them. Then he went out of Leah’s tent and entered Rachel’s tent.
verses.textEnNlt: Laban went first into Jacob’s tent to search there, then into Leah’s, and then the tents of the two servant wives—but he found nothing. Finally, he went into Rachel’s tent.
verses.textEnNasb: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent, and into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two slave women, but he did not find them. Then he went out of Leah’s tent and entered Rachel’s tent.
verses.textEn: So Laban went into Jacob’s tent and into Leah’s tent and into the tent of the two female servants, but he found nothing. After he came out of Leah’s tent, he entered Rachel’s tent.

verses.textZh: 拉结已经把神像放在骆驼的鞍下，自己坐在上面。拉班搜遍了帐棚，但没有搜出甚么。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结已经把神像放在骆驼的鞍下，自己坐在上面。拉班搜遍了帐棚，但没有搜出甚么。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结已经把神像藏在骆驼的驮篓里，便坐在上头。拉班摸遍了那帐棚，并没有摸着。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Rachel had taken the household gods and put them inside her camel’s saddle and was sitting on them. Laban searched through everything in the tent but found nothing.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Rachel had taken the household gods and put them in the camel’s saddle and sat on them. Laban felt all about the tent, but did not find them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Rachel had taken the household idols, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. And Laban searched all about the tent but did not find them.
verses.textEnNlt: But Rachel had taken the household idols and hidden them in her camel saddle, and now she was sitting on them. When Laban had thoroughly searched her tent without finding them,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Rachel had taken the household idols and put them in the camel’s saddlebag, and she sat on them. So Laban searched through all the tent, but did not find them.
verses.textEn: Now Rachel had taken the household gods and put them inside her camel’s saddle and was sitting on them. Laban searched through everything in the tent but found nothing.

verses.textZh: 拉结对她父亲说："求我主不要生气，我不能在你面前起来，因为我正有女人的经期。"这样，拉班彻底搜查了，也搜不出那神像来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结对她父亲说："求我主不要生气，我不能在你面前起来，因为我正有女人的经期。"这样，拉班彻底搜查了，也搜不出那神像来。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结对她父亲说：「现在我身上不便，不能在你面前起来，求我主不要生气。」这样，拉班搜寻神像，竟没有搜出来。
verses.textEnNiv: Rachel said to her father, "Don’t be angry, my lord, that I cannot stand up in your presence; I’m having my period." So he searched but could not find the household gods.
verses.textEnEsv: And she said to her father, "Let not my lord be angry that I cannot rise before you, for the way of women is upon me." So he searched but did not find the household gods.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she said to her father, "Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise before you, for the manner of women is with me." And he searched but did not find the household idols.
verses.textEnNlt: she said to her father, "Please, sir, forgive me if I don’t get up for you. I’m having my monthly period." So Laban continued his search, but he could not find the household idols.
verses.textEnNasb: And she said to her father, "May my lord not be angry that I cannot stand in your presence, because the way of women is upon me." So he searched but did not find the household idols.
verses.textEn: Rachel said to her father, "Don’t be angry, my lord, that I cannot stand up in your presence; I’m having my period." So he searched but could not find the household gods.

verses.textZh: 雅各就生气，与拉班争吵起来。雅各责问拉班说："我到底有甚么过犯，有甚么罪恶，你竟这样急速地追赶我呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各就生气，与拉班争吵起来。雅各责问拉班说："我到底有甚么过犯，有甚么罪恶，你竟这样急速地追赶我呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就发怒斥责拉班说：「我有什么过犯，有什么罪恶，你竟这样火速地追我？
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob was angry and took Laban to task. "What is my crime?" he asked Laban. "How have I wronged you that you hunt me down?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob became angry and berated Laban. Jacob said to Laban, "What is my offense? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob was angry and rebuked Laban, and Jacob answered and said to Laban: "What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have so hotly pursued me?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob became very angry, and he challenged Laban. "What’s my crime?" he demanded. "What have I done wrong to make you chase after me as though I were a criminal?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob became angry and argued with Laban; and Jacob said to Laban, "What is my offense? What is my sin that you have hotly pursued me?
verses.textEn: Jacob was angry and took Laban to task. "What is my crime?" he asked Laban. "How have I wronged you that you hunt me down?

verses.textZh: 你已经搜遍了我所有的家具，你有找到你家的东西没有？可以把它放在这里，在你我的众兄弟面前，让他们可以在你我中间判断一下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你已经搜遍了我所有的家具，你有找到你家的东西没有？可以把它放在这里，在你我的众兄弟面前，让他们可以在你我中间判断一下。
verses.textZhCuv: 你摸遍了我一切的家具，你搜出什么来呢？可以放在你我弟兄面前，叫他们在你我中间辨别辨别。
verses.textEnNiv: Now that you have searched through all my goods, what have you found that belongs to your household? Put it here in front of your relatives and mine, and let them judge between the two of us.
verses.textEnEsv: For you have felt through all my goods; what have you found of all your household goods? Set it here before my kinsmen and your kinsmen, that they may decide between us two.
verses.textEnNkjv: Although you have searched all my things, what part of your household things have you found? Set it here before my brethren and your brethren, that they may judge between us both!
verses.textEnNlt: You have rummaged through everything I own. Now show me what you found that belongs to you! Set it out here in front of us, before our relatives, for all to see. Let them judge between us!
verses.textEnNasb: Though you have searched through all my property, what have you found of all your household property? Set it here in front of my relatives and your relatives, so that they may decide between the two of us.
verses.textEn: Now that you have searched through all my goods, what have you found that belongs to your household? Put it here in front of your relatives and mine, and let them judge between the two of us.

verses.textZh: 这二十年来，我与你在一起；你的母绵羊和母山羊没掉过胎，你羊群中的公羊，我没有吃过。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这二十年来，我与你在一起；你的母绵羊和母山羊没掉过胎，你羊群中的公羊，我没有吃过。
verses.textZhCuv: 我在你家这二十年，你的母绵羊、母山羊没有掉过胎。你群中的公羊，我没有吃过；
verses.textEnNiv: "I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten rams from your flocks.
verses.textEnEsv: These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not miscarried, and I have not eaten the rams of your flocks.
verses.textEnNkjv: These twenty years I havebeen with you; your ewes and your female goats have not miscarried their young, and I have not eaten the rams of your flock.
verses.textEnNlt: "For twenty years I have been with you, caring for your flocks. In all that time your sheep and goats never miscarried. In all those years I never used a single ram of yours for food.
verses.textEnNasb: For these twenty years I have been with you; your ewes and your female goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten the rams of your flocks.
verses.textEn: "I have been with you for twenty years now. Your sheep and goats have not miscarried, nor have I eaten rams from your flocks.

verses.textZh: 被野兽撕裂的，我没有给你带回来，都是由我自己赔偿；无论白天偷去的，或是黑夜偷的，你都要我负责。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被野兽撕裂的，我没有给你带回来，都是由我自己赔偿；无论白天偷去的，或是黑夜偷的，你都要我负责。
verses.textZhCuv: 被野兽撕裂的，我没有带来给你，是我自己赔上。无论是白日，是黑夜，被偷去的，你都向我索要。
verses.textEnNiv: I did not bring you animals torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for whatever was stolen by day or night.
verses.textEnEsv: What was torn by wild beasts I did not bring to you. I bore the loss of it myself. From my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: That which was torn bybeasts I did not bring to you; I bore the loss of it. You required it from my hand, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
verses.textEnNlt: If any were attacked and killed by wild animals, I never showed you the carcass and asked you to reduce the count of your flock. No, I took the loss myself! You made me pay for every stolen animal, whether it was taken in broad daylight or in the dark of night.
verses.textEnNasb: I did not even bring to you that which was torn by wild animals; I took the loss myself. You demanded it of my hand whether stolen by day or stolen by night.
verses.textEn: I did not bring you animals torn by wild beasts; I bore the loss myself. And you demanded payment from me for whatever was stolen by day or night.

verses.textZh: 我白天受尽炎热，黑夜受尽寒霜，不能入睡；我经常是这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我白天受尽炎热，黑夜受尽寒霜，不能入睡；我经常是这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我白日受尽干热，黑夜受尽寒霜，不得合眼睡着，我常是这样。
verses.textEnNiv: This was my situation: The heat consumed me in the daytime and the cold at night, and sleep fled from my eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: There I was: by day the heat consumed me, and the cold by night, and my sleep fled from my eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: There I was! In the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night, and my sleep departed from my eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: "I worked for you through the scorching heat of the day and through cold and sleepless nights.
verses.textEnNasb: This is how I was: by day the heat consumed me and the frost by night, and my sleep fled from my eyes.
verses.textEn: This was my situation: The heat consumed me in the daytime and the cold at night, and sleep fled from my eyes.

verses.textZh: 我这二十年在你的家里，为你的两个女儿服事了你十四年；为你的羊群服事了你六年；你又十次改了我的工资。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这二十年在你的家里，为你的两个女儿服事了你十四年；为你的羊群服事了你六年；你又十次改了我的工资。
verses.textZhCuv: 我这二十年在你家里，为你的两个女儿服事你十四年，为你的羊群服事你六年，你又十次改了我的工价。
verses.textEnNiv: It was like this for the twenty years I was in your household. I worked for you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks, and you changed my wages ten times.
verses.textEnEsv: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus I have been in your house twenty years; I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, for twenty years I slaved in your house! I worked for fourteen years earning your two daughters, and then six more years for your flock. And you changed my wages ten times!
verses.textEnNasb: For these twenty years I have been in your house; I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you changed my wages ten times.
verses.textEn: It was like this for the twenty years I was in your household. I worked for you fourteen years for your two daughters and six years for your flocks, and you changed my wages ten times.

verses.textZh: 如果不是我父亲的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒所敬畏的神，与我同在，你现在必定打发我空手回去。但神看见了我的苦情和我手中的辛劳，所以他昨天晚上责备了你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果不是我父亲的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神，以撒所敬畏的神，与我同在，你现在必定打发我空手回去。但神看见了我的苦情和我手中的辛劳，所以他昨天晚上责备了你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若不是我父亲以撒所敬畏的神，就是亚伯拉罕的神与我同在，你如今必定打发我空手而去。神看见我的苦情和我的劳碌，就在昨夜责备你。」
verses.textEnNiv: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, you would surely have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my hardship and the toil of my hands, and last night he rebuked you."
verses.textEnEsv: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been on my side, surely now you would have sent me away empty-handed. God saw my affliction and the labor of my hands and rebuked you last night."
verses.textEnNkjv: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty-handed. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night."
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, if the God of my father had not been on my side—the God of Abraham and the fearsome God of Isaac —you would have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen your abuse and my hard work. That is why he appeared to you last night and rebuked you!"
verses.textEnNasb: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the fear of Isaac, had not been for me, surely now you would have sent me away empty-handed. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, so He rendered judgment last night."
verses.textEn: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, you would surely have sent me away empty-handed. But God has seen my hardship and the toil of my hands, and last night he rebuked you."

verses.textZh: 拉班回答雅各，说："这些女儿是我的女儿；这些孩子是我的孩子；这些羊群也是我的羊群。其实你眼所见的一切都是我的。但我今日向我的女儿和她们所生的孩子，能作甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班回答雅各，说："这些女儿是我的女儿；这些孩子是我的孩子；这些羊群也是我的羊群。其实你眼所见的一切都是我的。但我今日向我的女儿和她们所生的孩子，能作甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班回答雅各说：「这女儿是我的女儿，这些孩子是我的孩子，这些羊群也是我的羊群；凡在你眼前的都是我的。我的女儿并她们所生的孩子，我今日能向他们做什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Laban answered Jacob, "The women are my daughters, the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks. All you see is mine. Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine, or about the children they have borne?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Laban answered and said to Jacob, "The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine. But what can I do this day for these my daughters or for their children whom they have borne?
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban answered and said to Jacob, "These daughters are my daughters, and these children are my children, and this flock is my flock; all that you see is mine. But what can I do this day to these my daughters or to their children whom they have borne?
verses.textEnNlt: Then Laban replied to Jacob, "These women are my daughters, these children are my grandchildren, and these flocks are my flocks—in fact, everything you see is mine. But what can I do now about my daughters and their children?
verses.textEnNasb: Then Laban replied to Jacob, "The daughters are my daughters, the children are my grandchildren, the flocks are my flocks, and everything that you see is mine. But what can I do this day to these daughters of mine or to their children to whom they have given birth?
verses.textEn: Laban answered Jacob, "The women are my daughters, the children are my children, and the flocks are my flocks. All you see is mine. Yet what can I do today about these daughters of mine, or about the children they have borne?

verses.textZh: 来吧，现在我和你可以立约，作为你我之间的证据。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 来吧，现在我和你可以立约，作为你我之间的证据。"
verses.textZhCuv: 来吧！你我二人可以立约，作你我中间的证据。」
verses.textEnNiv: Come now, let’s make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between us."
verses.textEnEsv: Come now, let us make a covenant, you and I. And let it be a witness between you and me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, come, let us make a covenant, you and I, and let it be a witness between you and me."
verses.textEnNlt: So come, let’s make a covenant, you and I, and it will be a witness to our commitment."
verses.textEnNasb: So now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I, and it shall be a witness between you and me."
verses.textEn: Come now, let’s make a covenant, you and I, and let it serve as a witness between us."

verses.textZh: 雅各就拿了一块石头，立作石柱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各就拿了一块石头，立作石柱。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就拿一块石头立作柱子，
verses.textEnNiv: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a monument.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob took a stone and set it up as a memorial stone.
verses.textEn: So Jacob took a stone and set it up as a pillar.

verses.textZh: 雅各又对自己的众兄弟说："你们把石头堆聚起来。"他们就把石头拿来，堆成了一堆。他们又在石堆旁边吃喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各又对自己的众兄弟说："你们把石头堆聚起来。"他们就把石头拿来，堆成了一堆。他们又在石堆旁边吃喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 又对众弟兄说：「你们堆聚石头。」他们就拿石头来堆成一堆，大家便在旁边吃喝。
verses.textEnNiv: He said to his relatives, "Gather some stones." So they took stones and piled them in a heap, and they ate there by the heap.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob said to his kinsmen, "Gather stones." And they took stones and made a heap, and they ate there by the heap.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob said to his brethren, "Gather stones." And they took stones and made a heap, and they ate there on the heap.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he told his family members, "Gather some stones." So they gathered stones and piled them in a heap. Then Jacob and Laban sat down beside the pile of stones to eat a covenant meal.
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob said to his relatives, "Gather stones." So they took stones and made a heap, and they ate there by the heap.
verses.textEn: He said to his relatives, "Gather some stones." So they took stones and piled them in a heap, and they ate there by the heap.

verses.textZh: 拉班称那石堆为伊迦尔．撒哈杜他，雅各却称那石堆为迦累得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班称那石堆为伊迦尔．撒哈杜他，雅各却称那石堆为迦累得。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班称那石堆为伊迦尔‧撒哈杜他，雅各却称那石堆为迦累得 。
verses.textEnNiv: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.textEnEsv: Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.textEnNlt: To commemorate the event, Laban called the place Jegar-sahadutha (which means "witness pile" in Aramaic), and Jacob called it Galeed (which means "witness pile" in Hebrew).
verses.textEnNasb: Now Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.
verses.textEn: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed.

verses.textZh: 拉班说："今天这堆石头是你我之间的证据。"因此它名叫迦累得，
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班说："今天这堆石头是你我之间的证据。"因此它名叫迦累得，
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班说：「今日这石堆作你我中间的证据。」因此这地方名叫迦累得，
verses.textEnNiv: Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me today." That is why it was called Galeed.
verses.textEnEsv: Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me today." Therefore he named it Galeed,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me this day." Therefore its name was called Galeed,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Laban declared, "This pile of stones will stand as a witness to remind us of the covenant we have made today." This explains why it was called Galeed—"Witness Pile."
verses.textEnNasb: Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me this day." Therefore it was named Galeed,
verses.textEn: Laban said, "This heap is a witness between you and me today." That is why it was called Galeed.

verses.textZh: 又名叫米斯巴，因为拉班说："我们彼此分离以后，愿耶和华在你我中间鉴察。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又名叫米斯巴，因为拉班说："我们彼此分离以后，愿耶和华在你我中间鉴察。
verses.textZhCuv: 又叫米斯巴，意思说：「我们彼此离别以后，愿耶和华在你我中间鉴察。
verses.textEnNiv: It was also called Mizpah, because he said, "May the Lord keep watch between you and me when we are away from each other.
verses.textEnEsv: and Mizpah, for he said, "The Lord watch between you and me, when we are out of one another’s sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: also Mizpah, because he said, "May the Lord watch between you and me when we are absent one from another.
verses.textEnNlt: But it was also called Mizpah (which means "watchtower"), for Laban said, "May the Lord keep watch between us to make sure that we keep this covenant when we are out of each other’s sight.
verses.textEnNasb: and Mizpah, for he said, "May the Lord keep watch between you and me when we are absent one from the other.
verses.textEn: It was also called Mizpah, because he said, "May the Lord keep watch between you and me when we are away from each other.

verses.textZh: 你若苦待我的女儿，或在我的女儿以外，另娶妻子，虽然没有人在我们中间作证，但你要注意，神就是你我之间的见证人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若苦待我的女儿，或在我的女儿以外，另娶妻子，虽然没有人在我们中间作证，但你要注意，神就是你我之间的见证人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你若苦待我的女儿，又在我的女儿以外另娶妻，虽没有人知道，却有神在你我中间作见证。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you mistreat my daughters or if you take any wives besides my daughters, even though no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me."
verses.textEnEsv: If you oppress my daughters, or if you take wives besides my daughters, although no one is with us, see, God is witness between you and me."
verses.textEnNkjv: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take other wives besides my daughters, although no man is with us—see, God is witness between you and me!"
verses.textEnNlt: If you mistreat my daughters or if you marry other wives, God will see it even if no one else does. He is a witness to this covenant between us.
verses.textEnNasb: If you mistreat my daughters, or if you take wives besides my daughters, although no one is with us, see, God is witness between you and me."
verses.textEn: If you mistreat my daughters or if you take any wives besides my daughters, even though no one is with us, remember that God is a witness between you and me."

verses.textZh: 拉班又对雅各说："你看这堆石头，看我在你我之间所竖立的石柱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班又对雅各说："你看这堆石头，看我在你我之间所竖立的石柱。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班又说：「你看我在你我中间所立的这石堆和柱子。
verses.textEnNiv: Laban also said to Jacob, "Here is this heap, and here is this pillar I have set up between you and me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Laban said to Jacob, "See this heap and the pillar, which I have set between you and me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Laban said to Jacob, "Here is this heap and here is this pillar, which I have placed between you and me.
verses.textEnNlt: "See this pile of stones," Laban continued, "and see this monument I have set between us.
verses.textEnNasb: Laban also said to Jacob, "Behold this heap and behold the memorial stone which I have set between you and me.
verses.textEn: Laban also said to Jacob, "Here is this heap, and here is this pillar I have set up between you and me.

verses.textZh: 这堆石头就是证据，这石柱也是证据：我决不越过这石堆到你那里去，你也决不可越过这石堆和石柱，到我这里来害我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这堆石头就是证据，这石柱也是证据：我决不越过这石堆到你那里去，你也决不可越过这石堆和石柱，到我这里来害我。
verses.textZhCuv: 这石堆作证据，这柱子也作证据。我必不过这石堆去害你；你也不可过这石堆和柱子来害我。
verses.textEnNiv: This heap is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this heap to your side to harm you and that you will not go past this heap and pillar to my side to harm me.
verses.textEnEsv: This heap is a witness, and the pillar is a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, to do harm.
verses.textEnNkjv: This heap is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not pass beyond this heap to you, and you will not pass beyond this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.
verses.textEnNlt: They stand between us as witnesses of our vows. I will never pass this pile of stones to harm you, and you must never pass these stones or this monument to harm me.
verses.textEnNasb: This heap is a witness, and the memorial stone is a witness, that I will not pass by this heap to you for harm, and you will not pass by this heap and this memorial stone to me, for harm.
verses.textEn: This heap is a witness, and this pillar is a witness, that I will not go past this heap to your side to harm you and that you will not go past this heap and pillar to my side to harm me.

verses.textZh: 但愿亚伯拉罕的神、拿鹤的神，就是他们父亲的神，在我们中间判断。"雅各就指着他父亲以撒所敬畏的神起誓。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿亚伯拉罕的神、拿鹤的神，就是他们父亲的神，在我们中间判断。"雅各就指着他父亲以撒所敬畏的神起誓。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿亚伯拉罕的神和拿鹤的神，就是他们父亲的神，在你我中间判断。」雅各就指着他父亲以撒所敬畏的神起誓，
verses.textEnNiv: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us." So Jacob took an oath in the name of the Fear of his father Isaac.
verses.textEnEsv: The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us." So Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac,
verses.textEnNkjv: The God of Abraham, the God of Nahor, and the God of their father judge between us." And Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.
verses.textEnNlt: I call on the God of our ancestors—the God of your grandfather Abraham and the God of my grandfather Nahor—to serve as a judge between us." So Jacob took an oath before the fearsome God of his father, Isaac, to respect the boundary line.
verses.textEnNasb: The God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us." So Jacob swore by the fear of his father Isaac.
verses.textEn: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us." So Jacob took an oath in the name of the Fear of his father Isaac.

verses.textZh: 雅各又在山上献祭，叫了自己的众兄弟来吃饭。他们吃了饭，就在山上过夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各又在山上献祭，叫了自己的众兄弟来吃饭。他们吃了饭，就在山上过夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 又在山上献祭，请众弟兄来吃饭。他们吃了饭，便在山上住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: He offered a sacrifice there in the hill country and invited his relatives to a meal. After they had eaten, they spent the night there.
verses.textEnEsv: and Jacob offered a sacrifice in the hill country and called his kinsmen to eat bread. They ate bread and spent the night in the hill country.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain, and called his brethren to eat bread. And they ate bread and stayed all night on the mountain.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice to God there on the mountain and invited everyone to a covenant feast. After they had eaten, they spent the night on the mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain, and called his relatives to the meal; and they ate the meal and spent the night on the mountain.
verses.textEn: He offered a sacrifice there in the hill country and invited his relatives to a meal. After they had eaten, they spent the night there.

verses.textZh: 拉班清早起来，与他的外孙和女儿亲吻，给他们祝福。然后拉班离开那里，回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉班清早起来，与他的外孙和女儿亲吻，给他们祝福。然后拉班离开那里，回自己的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉班清早起来，与他外孙和女儿亲嘴，给他们祝福，回往自己的地方去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Early the next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then he left and returned home.
verses.textEnEsv: Early in the morning Laban arose and kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then Laban departed and returned home.
verses.textEnNkjv: And early in the morning Laban arose, and kissed his sons and daughters and blessed them. Then Laban departed and returned to his place.
verses.textEnNlt: Laban got up early the next morning, and he kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then he left and returned home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then early in the morning Laban got up, and kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then Laban departed and returned to his place.
verses.textEn: Early the next morning Laban kissed his grandchildren and his daughters and blessed them. Then he left and returned home.

verses.textZh: 雅各继续他的路程，神的众使者遇见他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各继续他的路程，神的众使者遇见他。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各仍旧行路，神的使者遇见他。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.
verses.textEnNlt: As Jacob started on his way again, angels of God came to meet him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as Jacob went on his way, the angels of God met him.
verses.textEn: Jacob also went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

verses.textZh: 雅各看见他们，就说："这是神的军队。"于是给那地方起名叫玛哈念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各看见他们，就说："这是神的军队。"于是给那地方起名叫玛哈念。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各看见他们就说：「这是神的军兵」，于是给那地方起名叫玛哈念 。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jacob saw them, he said, "This is the camp of God!" So he named that place Mahanaim.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Jacob saw them he said, "This is God’s camp!" So he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jacob saw them, he said, "This is God’s camp." And he called the name of that place Mahanaim.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jacob saw them, he exclaimed, "This is God’s camp!" So he named the place Mahanaim.
verses.textEnNasb: And when he saw them, Jacob said, "This is God’s camp." So he named that place Mahanaim.
verses.textEn: When Jacob saw them, he said, "This is the camp of God!" So he named that place Mahanaim.

verses.textZh: 雅各先派使者到西珥地，就是以东的地区，他的哥哥以扫那里去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各先派使者到西珥地，就是以东的地区，他的哥哥以扫那里去，
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各打发人先往西珥地去，就是以东地，见他哥哥以扫，
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother in the land of Seir, the country of Edom,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob sent messengers ahead to his brother, Esau, who was living in the region of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob sent messengers ahead of himself to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.
verses.textEn: Jacob sent messengers ahead of him to his brother Esau in the land of Seir, the country of Edom.

verses.textZh: 吩咐他们说："你们要对我主以扫这样说：‘你的仆人雅各这样说：我在拉班那里寄居，一直到现在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吩咐他们说："你们要对我主以扫这样说：‘你的仆人雅各这样说：我在拉班那里寄居，一直到现在。
verses.textZhCuv: 吩咐他们说：「你们对我主以扫说：『你的仆人雅各这样说：我在拉班那里寄居，直到如今。
verses.textEnNiv: He instructed them: "This is what you are to say to my lord Esau: ‘Your servant Jacob says, I have been staying with Laban and have remained there till now.
verses.textEnEsv: instructing them, "Thus you shall say to my lord Esau: Thus says your servant Jacob, ‘I have sojourned with Laban and stayed until now.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he commanded them, saying, "Speak thus to my lord Esau, ‘Thus your servant Jacob says: "I have dwelt with Laban and stayed there until now.
verses.textEnNlt: He told them, "Give this message to my master Esau: ‘Humble greetings from your servant Jacob. Until now I have been living with Uncle Laban,
verses.textEnNasb: He commanded them, saying, "This is what you shall say to my lord Esau: ‘Your servant Jacob says the following: "I have resided with Laban, and stayed until now;
verses.textEn: He instructed them: "This is what you are to say to my lord Esau: ‘Your servant Jacob says, I have been staying with Laban and have remained there till now.

verses.textZh: 我拥有牛、驴、羊群、仆婢，现在派人来报告我主，希望得到你的欢心。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我拥有牛、驴、羊群、仆婢，现在派人来报告我主，希望得到你的欢心。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 我有牛、驴、羊群、仆婢，现在打发人来报告我主，为要在你眼前蒙恩。』」
verses.textEnNiv: I have cattle and donkeys, sheep and goats, male and female servants. Now I am sending this message to my lord, that I may find favor in your eyes.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, in order that I may find favor in your sight.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, and male and female servants; and I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight." ’ "
verses.textEnNlt: and now I own cattle, donkeys, flocks of sheep and goats, and many servants, both men and women. I have sent these messengers to inform my lord of my coming, hoping that you will be friendly to me.’"
verses.textEnNasb: and I have oxen, donkeys, flocks, and male and female servants; and I have sent messengers to tell my lord, so that I may find favor in your sight." ’ "
verses.textEn: I have cattle and donkeys, sheep and goats, male and female servants. Now I am sending this message to my lord, that I may find favor in your eyes.’ "

verses.textZh: 使者回到雅各那里说："我们到了你哥哥以扫那里，他带着四百人，正迎着你来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 使者回到雅各那里说："我们到了你哥哥以扫那里，他带着四百人，正迎着你来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所打发的人回到雅各那里，说：「我们到了你哥哥以扫那里，他带着四百人，正迎着你来。」
verses.textEnNiv: When the messengers returned to Jacob, they said, "We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."
verses.textEnEsv: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, "We came to your brother Esau, and he is coming to meet you, and there are four hundred men with him."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, "We came to your brother Esau, and he also is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."
verses.textEnNlt: After delivering the message, the messengers returned to Jacob and reported, "We met your brother, Esau, and he is already on his way to meet you—with an army of 400 men!"
verses.textEnNasb: And the messengers returned to Jacob, saying, "We came to your brother Esau, and furthermore he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."
verses.textEn: When the messengers returned to Jacob, they said, "We went to your brother Esau, and now he is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him."

verses.textZh: 雅各感到非常惧怕和焦虑，就把随行的人、羊群、牛群和骆驼，分成两队，
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各感到非常惧怕和焦虑，就把随行的人、羊群、牛群和骆驼，分成两队，
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就甚惧怕，而且愁烦，便把那与他同在的人口和羊群、牛群、骆驼分做两队，
verses.textEnNiv: In great fear and distress Jacob divided the people who were with him into two groups, and the flocks and herds and camels as well.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed. He divided the people who were with him, and the flocks and herds and camels, into two camps,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed; and he divided the people that were with him, and the flocks and herds and camels, into two companies.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob was terrified at the news. He divided his household, along with the flocks and herds and camels, into two groups.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed; and he divided the people who were with him, and the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies;
verses.textEn: In great fear and distress Jacob divided the people who were with him into two groups, and the flocks and herds and camels as well.

verses.textZh: 心里想："即使以扫来击杀这一队，余下的一队还可以逃脱。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 心里想："即使以扫来击杀这一队，余下的一队还可以逃脱。"
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「以扫若来击杀这一队，剩下的那一队还可以逃避。」
verses.textEnNiv: He thought, "If Esau comes and attacks one group, the group that is left may escape."
verses.textEnEsv: thinking, "If Esau comes to the one camp and attacks it, then the camp that is left will escape."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "If Esau comes to the one company and attacks it, then the other company which is left will escape."
verses.textEnNlt: He thought, "If Esau meets one group and attacks it, perhaps the other group can escape."
verses.textEnNasb: for he said, "If Esau comes to the one company and attacks it, then the company which is left will escape."
verses.textEn: He thought, "If Esau comes and attacks one group, the group that is left may escape."

verses.textZh: 雅各说："耶和华，我祖亚伯拉罕的神，我父以撒的神啊，你曾经对我说过：‘回到你自己的故乡，到你的亲族那里去，我必厚待你。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各说："耶和华，我祖亚伯拉罕的神，我父以撒的神啊，你曾经对我说过：‘回到你自己的故乡，到你的亲族那里去，我必厚待你。’
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各说：「耶和华－我祖亚伯拉罕的神，我父亲以撒的神啊，你曾对我说：『回你本地本族去，我要厚待你。』
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob prayed, "O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, Lord , you who said to me, ‘Go back to your country and your relatives, and I will make you prosper,’
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob said, "O God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, O Lord who said to me, ‘Return to your country and to your kindred, that I may do you good,’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob said, "O God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, the Lord who said to me, ‘Return to your country and to your family, and I will deal well with you’:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob prayed, "O God of my grandfather Abraham, and God of my father, Isaac—O Lord , you told me, ‘Return to your own land and to your relatives.’ And you promised me, ‘I will treat you kindly.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob said, "God of my father Abraham and God of my father Isaac, Lord, who said to me, ‘Return to your country and to your relatives, and I will make you prosper,’
verses.textEn: Then Jacob prayed, "O God of my father Abraham, God of my father Isaac, Lord , you who said to me, ‘Go back to your country and your relatives, and I will make you prosper,’

verses.textZh: 你向你仆人所施的一切慈爱和信实，我实在不配得。从前我只拿着我的手杖过这约旦河；现在我却拥有这两队人马了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你向你仆人所施的一切慈爱和信实，我实在不配得。从前我只拿着我的手杖过这约旦河；现在我却拥有这两队人马了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你向仆人所施的一切慈爱和诚实，我一点也不配得；我先前只拿着我的杖过这约旦河，如今我却成了两队了。
verses.textEnNiv: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness you have shown your servant. I had only my staff when I crossed this Jordan, but now I have become two camps.
verses.textEnEsv: I am not worthy of the least of all the deeds of steadfast love and all the faithfulness that you have shown to your servant, for with only my staff I crossed this Jordan, and now I have become two camps.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies and of all the truth which You have shown Your servant; for I crossed over this Jordan with my staff, and now I have become two companies.
verses.textEnNlt: I am not worthy of all the unfailing love and faithfulness you have shown to me, your servant. When I left home and crossed the Jordan River, I owned nothing except a walking stick. Now my household fills two large camps!
verses.textEnNasb: I am unworthy of all the favor and of all the faithfulness, which You have shown to Your servant; for with only my staff I crossed this Jordan, and now I have become two companies.
verses.textEn: I am unworthy of all the kindness and faithfulness you have shown your servant. I had only my staff when I crossed this Jordan, but now I have become two camps.

verses.textZh: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手，因为我怕他来击杀我，连母亲和孩子也击杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手，因为我怕他来击杀我，连母亲和孩子也击杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手；因为我怕他来杀我，连妻子带儿女一同杀了。
verses.textEnNiv: Save me, I pray, from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid he will come and attack me, and also the mothers with their children.
verses.textEnEsv: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau, for I fear him, that he may come and attack me, the mothers with the children.
verses.textEnNkjv: Deliver me, I pray, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and attack me and the mother with the children.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , please rescue me from the hand of my brother, Esau. I am afraid that he is coming to attack me, along with my wives and children.
verses.textEnNasb: Save me, please, from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, that he will come and attack me and the mothers with the children.
verses.textEn: Save me, I pray, from the hand of my brother Esau, for I am afraid he will come and attack me, and also the mothers with their children.

verses.textZh: 你曾经说过：‘我必厚待你，使你的后裔好象海边的沙一样，多到不可胜数。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你曾经说过：‘我必厚待你，使你的后裔好象海边的沙一样，多到不可胜数。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你曾说：『我必定厚待你，使你的后裔如同海边的沙，多得不可胜数。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But you have said, ‘I will surely make you prosper and will make your descendants like the sand of the sea, which cannot be counted.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But you said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: For You said, ‘I will surely treat you well, and make your descendants as the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But you promised me, ‘I will surely treat you kindly, and I will multiply your descendants until they become as numerous as the sands along the seashore—too many to count.’"
verses.textEnNasb: For You said, ‘I will assuredly make you prosper and make your descendants as the sand of the sea, which is too great to be counted.’ "
verses.textEn: But you have said, ‘I will surely make you prosper and will make your descendants like the sand of the sea, which cannot be counted.’ "

verses.textZh: 那天晚上，雅各在那里过夜。然后从他所拥有的牲畜中，取出一部分，作为给他哥哥以扫的礼物，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那天晚上，雅各在那里过夜。然后从他所拥有的牲畜中，取出一部分，作为给他哥哥以扫的礼物，
verses.textZhCuv: 当夜，雅各在那里住宿，就从他所有的物中拿礼物要送给他哥哥以扫：
verses.textEnNiv: He spent the night there, and from what he had with him he selected a gift for his brother Esau:
verses.textEnEsv: So he stayed there that night, and from what he had with him he took a present for his brother Esau,
verses.textEnNkjv: So he lodged there that same night, and took what came to his hand as a present for Esau his brother:
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob stayed where he was for the night. Then he selected these gifts from his possessions to present to his brother, Esau:
verses.textEnNasb: So he spent the night there. Then he selected from what he had with him a gift for his brother Esau:
verses.textEn: He spent the night there, and from what he had with him he selected a gift for his brother Esau:

verses.textZh: 就是母山羊二百只、公山羊二十只、母绵羊二百只、公绵羊二十只、
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是母山羊二百只、公山羊二十只、母绵羊二百只、公绵羊二十只、
verses.textZhCuv: 母山羊二百只，公山羊二十只，母绵羊二百只，公绵羊二十只，
verses.textEnNiv: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
verses.textEnEsv: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
verses.textEnNkjv: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
verses.textEnNlt: 200 female goats, 20 male goats, 200 ewes, 20 rams,
verses.textEnNasb: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
verses.textEn: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

verses.textZh: 哺乳的母骆驼三十匹，各带着驹子，母牛四十头、公牛十头、母驴二十头、公驴十头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哺乳的母骆驼三十匹，各带着驹子，母牛四十头、公牛十头、母驴二十头、公驴十头。
verses.textZhCuv: 奶崽子的骆驼三十只－各带着崽子，母牛四十只，公牛十只，母驴二十匹，驴驹十匹；
verses.textEnNiv: thirty female camels with their young, forty cows and ten bulls, and twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.
verses.textEnEsv: thirty milking camels and their calves, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.
verses.textEnNkjv: thirty milk camels with their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.
verses.textEnNlt: 30 female camels with their young, 40 cows, 10 bulls, 20 female donkeys, and 10 male donkeys.
verses.textEnNasb: thirty milking camels and their colts, forty cows and ten bulls, and twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.
verses.textEn: thirty female camels with their young, forty cows and ten bulls, and twenty female donkeys and ten male donkeys.

verses.textZh: 雅各把这些分成一队一队，交在仆人的手里，又对仆人说："你们先过去，每队之间要留一段距离。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各把这些分成一队一队，交在仆人的手里，又对仆人说："你们先过去，每队之间要留一段距离。"
verses.textZhCuv: 每样各分一群，交在仆人手下，就对仆人说：「你们要在我前头过去，使群群相离，有空闲的地方」；
verses.textEnNiv: He put them in the care of his servants, each herd by itself, and said to his servants, "Go ahead of me, and keep some space between the herds."
verses.textEnEsv: These he handed over to his servants, every drove by itself, and said to his servants, "Pass on ahead of me and put a space between drove and drove."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he delivered them to the hand of his servants, every drove by itself, and said to his servants, "Pass over before me, and put some distance between successive droves."
verses.textEnNlt: He divided these animals into herds and assigned each to different servants. Then he told his servants, "Go ahead of me with the animals, but keep some distance between the herds."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he placed them in the care of his servants, every flock by itself, and said to his servants, "Pass on ahead of me, and put a space between flocks."
verses.textEn: He put them in the care of his servants, each herd by itself, and said to his servants, "Go ahead of me, and keep some space between the herds."

verses.textZh: 他又吩咐走在最前的仆人说："我哥哥以扫遇见你的时候，如果问你：‘你的主人是谁？你要到哪里去？在你前面的这些牲畜是谁的？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又吩咐走在最前的仆人说："我哥哥以扫遇见你的时候，如果问你：‘你的主人是谁？你要到哪里去？在你前面的这些牲畜是谁的？’
verses.textZhCuv: 又吩咐尽先走的说：「我哥哥以扫遇见你的时候，问你说：『你是哪家的人？要往哪里去？你前头这些是谁的？』
verses.textEnNiv: He instructed the one in the lead: "When my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘Who do you belong to, and where are you going, and who owns all these animals in front of you?’
verses.textEnEsv: He instructed the first, "When Esau my brother meets you and asks you, ‘To whom do you belong? Where are you going? And whose are these ahead of you?’
verses.textEnNkjv: And he commanded the first one, saying, "When Esau my brother meets you and asks you, saying, ‘To whom do you belong, and where are you going? Whose are these in front of you?’
verses.textEnNlt: He gave these instructions to the men leading the first group: "When my brother, Esau, meets you, he will ask, ‘Whose servants are you? Where are you going? Who owns these animals?’
verses.textEnNasb: And he commanded the one in front, saying, "When my brother Esau meets you and asks you, saying, ‘To whom do you belong, and where are you going, and to whom do these animals in front of you belong?’
verses.textEn: He instructed the one in the lead: "When my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘Who do you belong to, and where are you going, and who owns all these animals in front of you?’

verses.textZh: 你就要回答：‘是你仆人雅各的，是送给我主以扫的礼物，他自己也在我们后面。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就要回答：‘是你仆人雅各的，是送给我主以扫的礼物，他自己也在我们后面。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你就说：『是你仆人雅各的，是送给我主以扫的礼物；他自己也在我们后边。』」
verses.textEnNiv: then you are to say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift sent to my lord Esau, and he is coming behind us.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: then you shall say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a present sent to my lord Esau. And moreover, he is behind us.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: then you shall say, ‘They are your servant Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord Esau; and behold, he also is behind us.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: You must reply, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob, but they are a gift for his master Esau. Look, he is coming right behind us.’"
verses.textEnNasb: then you shall say, ‘These belong to your servant Jacob; it is a gift sent to my lord Esau. And behold, he also is behind us.’ "
verses.textEn: then you are to say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. They are a gift sent to my lord Esau, and he is coming behind us.’ "

verses.textZh: 他又吩咐第二个、第三个和所有跟在队伍后面的人说："你们遇见以扫的时候，都要这样对他说。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又吩咐第二个、第三个和所有跟在队伍后面的人说："你们遇见以扫的时候，都要这样对他说。
verses.textZhCuv: 又吩咐第二、第三，和一切赶群畜的人说：「你们遇见以扫的时候也要这样对他说；
verses.textEnNiv: He also instructed the second, the third and all the others who followed the herds: "You are to say the same thing to Esau when you meet him.
verses.textEnEsv: He likewise instructed the second and the third and all who followed the droves, "You shall say the same thing to Esau when you find him,
verses.textEnNkjv: So he commanded the second, the third, and all who followed the droves, saying, "In this manner you shall speak to Esau when you find him;
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob gave the same instructions to the second and third herdsmen and to all who followed behind the herds: "You must say the same thing to Esau when you meet him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he commanded also the second and the third, and all those who followed the flocks, saying, "In this way you shall speak to Esau when you find him;
verses.textEn: He also instructed the second, the third and all the others who followed the herds: "You are to say the same thing to Esau when you meet him.

verses.textZh: 你们还要说：‘你的仆人雅各在我们后面。’"因为他心里想："我先送礼物去，藉此与他和解，然后再与他见面，或者他会原谅我 。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们还要说：‘你的仆人雅各在我们后面。’"因为他心里想："我先送礼物去，藉此与他和解，然后再与他见面，或者他会原谅我 。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且你们要说：『你仆人雅各在我们后边。』」因雅各心里说：「我藉着在我前头去的礼物解他的恨，然后再见他的面，或者他容纳我。」
verses.textEnNiv: And be sure to say, ‘Your servant Jacob is coming behind us.’ " For he thought, "I will pacify him with these gifts I am sending on ahead; later, when I see him, perhaps he will receive me."
verses.textEnEsv: and you shall say, ‘Moreover, your servant Jacob is behind us.’" For he thought, "I may appease him with the present that goes ahead of me, and afterward I shall see his face. Perhaps he will accept me."
verses.textEnNkjv: and also say, ‘Behold, your servant Jacob is behind us.’ " For he said, "I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face; perhaps he will accept me."
verses.textEnNlt: And be sure to say, ‘Look, your servant Jacob is right behind us.’" Jacob thought, "I will try to appease him by sending gifts ahead of me. When I see him in person, perhaps he will be friendly to me."
verses.textEnNasb: and you shall say, ‘Behold, your servant Jacob also is behind us.’ " For he said, "I will appease him with the gift that goes ahead of me. Then afterward I will see his face; perhaps he will accept me."
verses.textEn: And be sure to say, ‘Your servant Jacob is coming behind us.’ " For he thought, "I will pacify him with these gifts I am sending on ahead; later, when I see him, perhaps he will receive me."

verses.textZh: 于是礼物先过去了；那天晚上雅各在营中过夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是礼物先过去了；那天晚上雅各在营中过夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是礼物先过去了；那夜，雅各在队中住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jacob’s gifts went on ahead of him, but he himself spent the night in the camp.
verses.textEnEsv: So the present passed on ahead of him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the present went on over before him, but he himself lodged that night in the camp.
verses.textEnNlt: So the gifts were sent on ahead, while Jacob himself spent that night in the camp.
verses.textEnNasb: So the gift passed on ahead of him, while he himself spent that night in the camp.
verses.textEn: So Jacob’s gifts went on ahead of him, but he himself spent the night in the camp.

verses.textZh: 雅各那夜起来，带着他的两个妻子、两个婢女和十一个孩子，都过了雅博渡口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各那夜起来，带着他的两个妻子、两个婢女和十一个孩子，都过了雅博渡口。
verses.textZhCuv: 他夜间起来，带着两个妻子，两个使女，并十一个儿子，都过了雅博渡口，
verses.textEnNiv: That night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two female servants and his eleven sons and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.
verses.textEnEsv: The same night he arose and took his two wives, his two female servants, and his eleven children, and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he arose that night and took his two wives, his two female servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of Jabbok.
verses.textEnNlt: During the night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two servant wives, and his eleven sons and crossed the Jabbok River with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now he got up that same night and took his two wives, his two female slaves, and his eleven children, and crossed the shallow place of the Jabbok.
verses.textEn: That night Jacob got up and took his two wives, his two female servants and his eleven sons and crossed the ford of the Jabbok.

verses.textZh: 他带着他们，先打发他们过河，然后又打发他所有的都过去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他带着他们，先打发他们过河，然后又打发他所有的都过去。
verses.textZhCuv: 先打发他们过河，又打发所有的都过去，
verses.textEnNiv: After he had sent them across the stream, he sent over all his possessions.
verses.textEnEsv: He took them and sent them across the stream, and everything else that he had.
verses.textEnNkjv: He took them, sent them over the brook, and sent over what he had.
verses.textEnNlt: After taking them to the other side, he sent over all his possessions.
verses.textEnNasb: He took them and sent them across the stream. And he sent across whatever he had.
verses.textEn: After he had sent them across the stream, he sent over all his possessions.

verses.textZh: 只留下雅各一人，有一个人来与他摔角，直到天快亮的时候。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只留下雅各一人，有一个人来与他摔角，直到天快亮的时候。
verses.textZhCuv: 只剩下雅各一人。有一个人来和他摔跤，直到黎明。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob was left alone. And a man wrestled with him until the breaking of the day.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob was left alone; and a Man wrestled with him until the breaking of day.
verses.textEnNlt: This left Jacob all alone in the camp, and a man came and wrestled with him until the dawn began to break.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him until daybreak.
verses.textEn: So Jacob was left alone, and a man wrestled with him till daybreak.

verses.textZh: 那人见自己不能胜过他，就在他的大腿窝上打了一下。于是，雅各与那人摔角的时候，大腿窝脱了节。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人见自己不能胜过他，就在他的大腿窝上打了一下。于是，雅各与那人摔角的时候，大腿窝脱了节。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人见自己胜不过他，就将他的大腿窝摸了一把，雅各的大腿窝正在摔跤的时候就扭了。
verses.textEnNiv: When the man saw that he could not overpower him, he touched the socket of Jacob’s hip so that his hip was wrenched as he wrestled with the man.
verses.textEnEsv: When the man saw that he did not prevail against Jacob, he touched his hip socket, and Jacob’s hip was put out of joint as he wrestled with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when He saw that He did not prevail against him, He touched the socket of his hip; and the socket of Jacob’s hip was out of joint as He wrestled with him.
verses.textEnNlt: When the man saw that he would not win the match, he touched Jacob’s hip and wrenched it out of its socket.
verses.textEnNasb: When the man saw that he had not prevailed against him, he touched the socket of Jacob’s hip; and the socket of Jacob’s hip was dislocated while he wrestled with him.
verses.textEn: When the man saw that he could not overpower him, he touched the socket of Jacob’s hip so that his hip was wrenched as he wrestled with the man.

verses.textZh: 那人说："天快亮了，让我走吧。"雅各说："如果你不给我祝福，我就不让你走。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人说："天快亮了，让我走吧。"雅各说："如果你不给我祝福，我就不让你走。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人说：「天黎明了，容我去吧！」雅各说：「你不给我祝福，我就不容你去。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man said, "Let me go, for it is daybreak." But Jacob replied, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "Let me go, for the day has broken." But Jacob said, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Let Me go, for the day breaks." But he said, "I will not let You go unless You bless me!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then the man said, "Let me go, for the dawn is breaking!" But Jacob said, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Let me go, for the dawn is breaking." But he said, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."
verses.textEn: Then the man said, "Let me go, for it is daybreak." But Jacob replied, "I will not let you go unless you bless me."

verses.textZh: 那人问他："你叫甚么名字？"他回答："雅各。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人问他："你叫甚么名字？"他回答："雅各。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人说：「你名叫什么？」他说：「我名叫雅各。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man asked him, "What is your name?" "Jacob," he answered.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to him, "What is your name?" And he said, "Jacob."
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said to him, "What is your name?" He said, "Jacob."
verses.textEnNlt: "What is your name?" the man asked. He replied, "Jacob."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to him, "What is your name?" And he said, "Jacob."
verses.textEn: The man asked him, "What is your name?" "Jacob," he answered.

verses.textZh: 那人说："你的名字不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列，因为你与神与人较力，都得了胜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人说："你的名字不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列，因为你与神与人较力，都得了胜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那人说：「你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因为你与神与人较力，都得了胜。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the man said, "Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel, for you have striven with God and with men, and have prevailed."
verses.textEnNkjv: And He said, "Your name shall no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have struggled with God and with men, and have prevailed."
verses.textEnNlt: "Your name will no longer be Jacob," the man told him. "From now on you will be called Israel, because you have fought with God and with men and have won."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Your name shall no longer be Jacob, but Israel; for you have contended with God and with men, and have prevailed."
verses.textEn: Then the man said, "Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have struggled with God and with humans and have overcome."

verses.textZh: 雅各问他，说："请把你的名告诉我。"那人回答："为甚么问我的名呢？"他就在那里给雅各祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各问他，说："请把你的名告诉我。"那人回答："为甚么问我的名呢？"他就在那里给雅各祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各问他说：「请将你的名告诉我。」那人说：「何必问我的名？」于是在那里给雅各祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob said, "Please tell me your name." But he replied, "Why do you ask my name?" Then he blessed him there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob asked him, "Please tell me your name." But he said, "Why is it that you ask my name?" And there he blessed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob asked, saying, "Tell me Your name, I pray." And He said, "Why is it that you ask about My name?" And He blessed him there.
verses.textEnNlt: "Please tell me your name," Jacob said. "Why do you want to know my name?" the man replied. Then he blessed Jacob there.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jacob asked him and said, "Please tell me your name." But he said, "Why is it that you ask my name?" And he blessed him there.
verses.textEn: Jacob said, "Please tell me your name." But he replied, "Why do you ask my name?" Then he blessed him there.

verses.textZh: 于是，雅各给那地方起名叫毘努伊勒，意思说："我面对面看见了神，我的性命仍得保全。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，雅各给那地方起名叫毘努伊勒，意思说："我面对面看见了神，我的性命仍得保全。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各便给那地方起名叫毗努伊勒 ，意思说：「我面对面见了神，我的性命仍得保全。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Jacob called the place Peniel, saying, "It is because I saw God face to face, and yet my life was spared."
verses.textEnEsv: So Jacob called the name of the place Peniel, saying, "For I have seen God face to face, and yet my life has been delivered."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob called the name of the place Peniel: "For I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved."
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob named the place Peniel (which means "face of God"), for he said, "I have seen God face to face, yet my life has been spared."
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob named the place Peniel, for he said, "I have seen God face to face, yet my life has been spared."
verses.textEn: So Jacob called the place Peniel, saying, "It is because I saw God face to face, and yet my life was spared."

verses.textZh: 雅各经过毘努伊勒的时候，太阳刚刚出来，照在他身上。他因为大腿的伤，跛脚行走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各经过毘努伊勒的时候，太阳刚刚出来，照在他身上。他因为大腿的伤，跛脚行走。
verses.textZhCuv: 日头刚出来的时候，雅各经过毗努伊勒，他的大腿就瘸了。
verses.textEnNiv: The sun rose above him as he passed Peniel, and he was limping because of his hip.
verses.textEnEsv: The sun rose upon him as he passed Penuel, limping because of his hip.
verses.textEnNkjv: Just as he crossed over Penuel the sun rose on him, and he limped on his hip.
verses.textEnNlt: The sun was rising as Jacob left Peniel, and he was limping because of the injury to his hip.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sun rose upon him just as he crossed over Penuel, and he was limping on his hip.
verses.textEn: The sun rose above him as he passed Peniel, and he was limping because of his hip.

verses.textZh: 因此，以色列人直到现在都不吃大腿窝上的筋，因为那人在雅各的大腿窝上的筋打了一下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，以色列人直到现在都不吃大腿窝上的筋，因为那人在雅各的大腿窝上的筋打了一下。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，以色列人不吃大腿窝的筋，直到今日，因为那人摸了雅各大腿窝的筋。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob’s hip was touched near the tendon.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore to this day the people of Israel do not eat the sinew of the thigh that is on the hip socket, because he touched the socket of Jacob’s hip on the sinew of the thigh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore to this day the children of Israel do not eat the muscle that shrank, which is on the hip socket, because He touched the socket of Jacob’s hip in the muscle that shrank.
verses.textEnNlt: (Even today the people of Israel don’t eat the tendon near the hip socket because of what happened that night when the man strained the tendon of Jacob’s hip.)
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, to this day the sons of Israel do not eat the tendon of the hip which is on the socket of the hip, because he touched the socket of Jacob’s hip in the tendon of the hip.
verses.textEn: Therefore to this day the Israelites do not eat the tendon attached to the socket of the hip, because the socket of Jacob’s hip was touched near the tendon.

verses.textZh: 雅各举目观看，见以扫带着四百人来了；他就把孩子分开三队，交给利亚、拉结和两个婢女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各举目观看，见以扫带着四百人来了；他就把孩子分开三队，交给利亚、拉结和两个婢女。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各举目观看，见以扫来了，后头跟着四百人，他就把孩子们分开交给利亚、拉结，和两个使女，
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob looked up and there was Esau, coming with his four hundred men; so he divided the children among Leah, Rachel and the two female servants.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold, Esau was coming, and four hundred men with him. So he divided the children among Leah and Rachel and the two female servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jacob lifted his eyes and looked, and there, Esau was coming, and with him were four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two maidservants.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob looked up and saw Esau coming with his 400 men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and his two servant wives.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob raised his eyes and looked, and behold, Esau was coming, and four hundred men with him. So he divided the children among Leah and Rachel, and the two slave women.
verses.textEn: Jacob looked up and there was Esau, coming with his four hundred men; so he divided the children among Leah, Rachel and the two female servants.

verses.textZh: 他叫两个婢女和她们的孩子走在前头，利亚和她的孩子跟着，拉结和约瑟走在最后。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他叫两个婢女和她们的孩子走在前头，利亚和她的孩子跟着，拉结和约瑟走在最后。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且叫两个使女和她们的孩子在前头，利亚和她的孩子在后头，拉结和约瑟在尽后头。
verses.textEnNiv: He put the female servants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph in the rear.
verses.textEnEsv: And he put the servants with their children in front, then Leah with her children, and Rachel and Joseph last of all.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he put the maidservants and their children in front, Leah and her children behind, and Rachel and Joseph last.
verses.textEnNlt: He put the servant wives and their children at the front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph last.
verses.textEnNasb: He put the slave women and their children in front, and Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph last.
verses.textEn: He put the female servants and their children in front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph in the rear.

verses.textZh: 他自己却走在他们前面，七次俯伏在地，直到走近他哥哥跟前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他自己却走在他们前面，七次俯伏在地，直到走近他哥哥跟前。
verses.textZhCuv: 他自己在他们前头过去，一连七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。
verses.textEnNiv: He himself went on ahead and bowed down to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.
verses.textEnEsv: He himself went on before them, bowing himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he crossed over before them and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob went on ahead. As he approached his brother, he bowed to the ground seven times before him.
verses.textEnNasb: But he himself passed on ahead of them and bowed down to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.
verses.textEn: He himself went on ahead and bowed down to the ground seven times as he approached his brother.

verses.textZh: 以扫跑来迎接他，拥抱他，伏在他颈项上，与他亲吻；两个人都哭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫跑来迎接他，拥抱他，伏在他颈项上，与他亲吻；两个人都哭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫跑来迎接他，将他抱住，又搂着他的颈项，与他亲嘴，两个人就哭了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept.
verses.textEnEsv: But Esau ran to meet him and embraced him and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Esau ran to meet him and embraced him, threw his arms around his neck, and kissed him. And they both wept.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Esau ran to meet him and embraced him, and fell on his neck and kissed him, and they wept.
verses.textEn: But Esau ran to meet Jacob and embraced him; he threw his arms around his neck and kissed him. And they wept.

verses.textZh: 以扫举目观看，看见妇人和孩子，就问："这些与你同来的人是谁？"雅各回答："是神赐给你仆人的孩子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫举目观看，看见妇人和孩子，就问："这些与你同来的人是谁？"雅各回答："是神赐给你仆人的孩子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫举目看见妇人孩子，就说：「这些和你同行的是谁呢？」雅各说：「这些孩子是神施恩给你的仆人的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Esau looked up and saw the women and children. "Who are these with you?" he asked. Jacob answered, "They are the children God has graciously given your servant."
verses.textEnEsv: And when Esau lifted up his eyes and saw the women and children, he said, "Who are these with you?" Jacob said, "The children whom God has graciously given your servant."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he lifted his eyes and saw the women and children, and said, "Who are these with you?" So he said, "The children whom God has graciously given your servant."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Esau looked at the women and children and asked, "Who are these people with you?" "These are the children God has graciously given to me, your servant," Jacob replied.
verses.textEnNasb: He raised his eyes and saw the women and the children, and said, " Who are these with you?" So he said, "The children whom God has graciously given your servant."
verses.textEn: Then Esau looked up and saw the women and children. "Who are these with you?" he asked. Jacob answered, "They are the children God has graciously given your servant."

verses.textZh: 于是，两个婢女和她们的孩子上前下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，两个婢女和她们的孩子上前下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是两个使女和她们的孩子前来下拜；
verses.textEnNiv: Then the female servants and their children approached and bowed down.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the servants drew near, they and their children, and bowed down.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the maidservants came near, they and their children, and bowed down.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the servant wives came forward with their children and bowed before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the slave women came forward with their children, and they bowed down.
verses.textEn: Then the female servants and their children approached and bowed down.

verses.textZh: 利亚和她的孩子也上前下拜，随后，约瑟和拉结也上前下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚和她的孩子也上前下拜，随后，约瑟和拉结也上前下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚和她的孩子也前来下拜；随后约瑟和拉结也前来下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down. Last of all came Joseph and Rachel, and they too bowed down.
verses.textEnEsv: Leah likewise and her children drew near and bowed down. And last Joseph and Rachel drew near, and they bowed down.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Leah also came near with her children, and they bowed down. Afterward Joseph and Rachel came near, and they bowed down.
verses.textEnNlt: Next came Leah with her children, and they bowed before him. Finally, Joseph and Rachel came forward and bowed before him.
verses.textEnNasb: And Leah likewise came forward with her children, and they bowed down; and afterward Joseph came forward with Rachel, and they bowed down.
verses.textEn: Next, Leah and her children came and bowed down. Last of all came Joseph and Rachel, and they too bowed down.

verses.textZh: 以扫又问："我遇见的这一群牲畜，是甚么意思呢？"雅各回答："是要讨我主喜悦的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫又问："我遇见的这一群牲畜，是甚么意思呢？"雅各回答："是要讨我主喜悦的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫说：「我所遇见的这些群畜是什么意思呢？」雅各说：「是要在我主面前蒙恩的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Esau asked, "What’s the meaning of all these flocks and herds I met?" "To find favor in your eyes, my lord," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: Esau said, "What do you mean by all this company that I met?" Jacob answered, "To find favor in the sight of my lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Esau said, "What do you meanby all this company which I met?" And he said, "Theseare to find favor in the sight of my lord."
verses.textEnNlt: "And what were all the flocks and herds I met as I came?" Esau asked. Jacob replied, "They are a gift, my lord, to ensure your friendship."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "What do you mean by all this company which I have met?" And he said, "To find favor in the sight of my lord."
verses.textEn: Esau asked, "What’s the meaning of all these flocks and herds I met?" "To find favor in your eyes, my lord," he said.

verses.textZh: 以扫说："弟弟啊，我已经很富有了，你的仍归你吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫说："弟弟啊，我已经很富有了，你的仍归你吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫说：「兄弟啊，我的已经够了，你的仍归你吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: But Esau said, "I already have plenty, my brother. Keep what you have for yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: But Esau said, "I have enough, my brother; keep what you have for yourself."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Esau said, "I have enough, my brother; keep what you have for yourself."
verses.textEnNlt: "My brother, I have plenty," Esau answered. "Keep what you have for yourself."
verses.textEnNasb: But Esau said, "I have plenty, my brother; let what you have be your own."
verses.textEn: But Esau said, "I already have plenty, my brother. Keep what you have for yourself."

verses.textZh: 雅各说："请不要这样，我若得你的喜悦，就求你从我手里收下这些礼物吧；因为我看见了你的面，就好象见了神的面；你实在恩待了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各说："请不要这样，我若得你的喜悦，就求你从我手里收下这些礼物吧；因为我看见了你的面，就好象见了神的面；你实在恩待了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各说：「不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你从我手里收下这礼物；因为我见了你的面，如同见了神的面，并且你容纳了我。
verses.textEnNiv: "No, please!" said Jacob. "If I have found favor in your eyes, accept this gift from me. For to see your face is like seeing the face of God, now that you have received me favorably.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob said, "No, please, if I have found favor in your sight, then accept my present from my hand. For I have seen your face, which is like seeing the face of God, and you have accepted me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob said, "No, please, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present from my hand, inasmuch as I have seen your face as though I had seen the face of God, and you were pleased with me.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jacob insisted, "No, if I have found favor with you, please accept this gift from me. And what a relief to see your friendly smile. It is like seeing the face of God!
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob said, "No, please, if now I have found favor in your sight, then accept my gift from my hand, for I see your face as one sees the face of God, and you have received me favorably.
verses.textEn: "No, please!" said Jacob. "If I have found favor in your eyes, accept this gift from me. For to see your face is like seeing the face of God, now that you have received me favorably.

verses.textZh: 请你收下我带来给你的礼物，因为神施恩给我，我甚么都有了。"雅各再三恳求他，他才收下了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你收下我带来给你的礼物，因为神施恩给我，我甚么都有了。"雅各再三恳求他，他才收下了。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你收下我带来给你的礼物；因为神恩待我，使我充足。」雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。
verses.textEnNiv: Please accept the present that was brought to you, for God has been gracious to me and I have all I need." And because Jacob insisted, Esau accepted it.
verses.textEnEsv: Please accept my blessing that is brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough." Thus he urged him, and he took it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Please, take my blessing that is brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough." So he urged him, and he took it.
verses.textEnNlt: Please take this gift I have brought you, for God has been very gracious to me. I have more than enough." And because Jacob insisted, Esau finally accepted the gift.
verses.textEnNasb: Please accept my gift which has been brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me and because I have plenty." So he urged him, and he accepted it.
verses.textEn: Please accept the present that was brought to you, for God has been gracious to me and I have all I need." And because Jacob insisted, Esau accepted it.

verses.textZh: 以扫说："我们起程前行吧，我和你一起走。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫说："我们起程前行吧，我和你一起走。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫说：「我们可以起身前往，我在你前头走。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Esau said, "Let us be on our way; I’ll accompany you."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Esau said, "Let us journey on our way, and I will go ahead of you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Esau said, "Let us take our journey; let us go, and I will go before you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well," Esau said, "let’s be going. I will lead the way."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Esau said, "Let’s journey on and go, and I will go ahead of you."
verses.textEn: Then Esau said, "Let us be on our way; I’ll accompany you."

verses.textZh: 雅各对他说："我主知道孩子们还年幼娇嫩；牛羊也正在乳养的时候，需要我的照顾；如果要催赶牠们走一天的路，恐怕所有牲畜都要死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各对他说："我主知道孩子们还年幼娇嫩；牛羊也正在乳养的时候，需要我的照顾；如果要催赶牠们走一天的路，恐怕所有牲畜都要死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各对他说：「我主知道孩子们年幼娇嫩，牛羊也正在乳养的时候，若是催赶一天，群畜都必死了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are tender and that I must care for the ewes and cows that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard just one day, all the animals will die.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are frail, and that the nursing flocks and herds are a care to me. If they are driven hard for one day, all the flocks will die.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are weak, and the flocks and herds which are nursing are with me. And if the men should drive them hard one day, all the flock will die.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jacob replied, "You can see, my lord, that some of the children are very young, and the flocks and herds have their young, too. If they are driven too hard, even for one day, all the animals could die.
verses.textEnNasb: But he said to him, "My lord knows that the children are frail and that the flocks and herds that are nursing are a matter of concern to me. And if they are driven hard just one day, all the flocks will die.
verses.textEn: But Jacob said to him, "My lord knows that the children are tender and that I must care for the ewes and cows that are nursing their young. If they are driven hard just one day, all the animals will die.

verses.textZh: 请我主在仆人前头先行；我要照着在我面前群畜和孩子们的速度，慢慢前行，直走到西珥我主那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 请我主在仆人前头先行；我要照着在我面前群畜和孩子们的速度，慢慢前行，直走到西珥我主那里去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求我主在仆人前头走，我要量着在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到西珥我主那里。」
verses.textEnNiv: So let my lord go on ahead of his servant, while I move along slowly at the pace of the flocks and herds before me and the pace of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir."
verses.textEnEsv: Let my lord pass on ahead of his servant, and I will lead on slowly, at the pace of the livestock that are ahead of me and at the pace of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir."
verses.textEnNkjv: Please let my lord go on ahead before his servant. I will lead on slowly at a pace which the livestock that go before me, and the children, are able to endure, until I come to my lord in Seir."
verses.textEnNlt: Please, my lord, go ahead of your servant. We will follow slowly, at a pace that is comfortable for the livestock and the children. I will meet you at Seir."
verses.textEnNasb: Please let my lord pass on ahead of his servant, and I will proceed at my leisure, at the pace of the cattle that are ahead of me and at the pace of the children, until I come to my lord at Seir."
verses.textEn: So let my lord go on ahead of his servant, while I move along slowly at the pace of the flocks and herds before me and the pace of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir."

verses.textZh: 以扫说："让我把跟随我的人留几个在你这里吧。"雅各说："为甚么要这样呢？只要我得我主的喜悦就是了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫说："让我把跟随我的人留几个在你这里吧。"雅各说："为甚么要这样呢？只要我得我主的喜悦就是了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫说：「容我把跟随我的人留几个在你这里。」雅各说：「何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Esau said, "Then let me leave some of my men with you." "But why do that?" Jacob asked. "Just let me find favor in the eyes of my lord."
verses.textEnEsv: So Esau said, "Let me leave with you some of the people who are with me." But he said, "What need is there? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Esau said, "Now let me leave with you some of the people who are with me." But he said, "What need is there? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord."
verses.textEnNlt: "All right," Esau said, "but at least let me assign some of my men to guide and protect you." Jacob responded, "That’s not necessary. It’s enough that you’ve received me warmly, my lord!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Esau said, "Please let me leave with you some of the people who are with me." But he said, " What need is there? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord."
verses.textEn: Esau said, "Then let me leave some of my men with you." "But why do that?" Jacob asked. "Just let me find favor in the eyes of my lord."

verses.textZh: 于是，以扫在那一天回西珥去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以扫在那一天回西珥去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，以扫当日起行，回往西珥去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir.
verses.textEnEsv: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
verses.textEnNlt: So Esau turned around and started back to Seir that same day.
verses.textEnNasb: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
verses.textEn: So that day Esau started on his way back to Seir.

verses.textZh: 雅各却起程到疏割去，在那里为自己建造了一座房子，又为牲畜搭了些草棚，因此给那地方起名叫疏割。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各却起程到疏割去，在那里为自己建造了一座房子，又为牲畜搭了些草棚，因此给那地方起名叫疏割。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就往疏割去，在那里为自己盖造房屋，又为牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫疏割 。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob, however, went to Sukkoth, where he built a place for himself and made shelters for his livestock. That is why the place is called Sukkoth.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built himself a house and made booths for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth, built himself a house, and made booths for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob, on the other hand, traveled on to Succoth. There he built himself a house and made shelters for his livestock. That is why the place was named Succoth (which means "shelters").
verses.textEnNasb: But Jacob journeyed to Succoth, and built for himself a house and made booths for his livestock; therefore the place is named Succoth.
verses.textEn: Jacob, however, went to Sukkoth, where he built a place for himself and made shelters for his livestock. That is why the place is called Sukkoth.

verses.textZh: 雅各从巴旦．亚兰回来的时候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示剑城，在城的对面支搭了帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各从巴旦．亚兰回来的时候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示剑城，在城的对面支搭了帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各从巴旦‧亚兰回来的时候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示剑城，在城东支搭帐棚，
verses.textEnNiv: After Jacob came from Paddan Aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in Canaan and camped within sight of the city.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob came safely to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, on his way from Paddan-aram, and he camped before the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob came safely to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Padan Aram; and he pitched his tent before the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Later, having traveled all the way from Paddan-aram, Jacob arrived safely at the town of Shechem, in the land of Canaan. There he set up camp outside the town.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jacob came safely to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan-aram, and camped before the city.
