verses.textEn: After Jacob came from Paddan Aram, he arrived safely at the city of Shechem in Canaan and camped within sight of the city.

verses.textZh: 他支搭帐棚的那块地，是他用一百块银子向示剑的父亲哈抹的子孙买来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他支搭帐棚的那块地，是他用一百块银子向示剑的父亲哈抹的子孙买来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就用一百块银子向示剑的父亲、哈抹的子孙买了支帐棚的那块地，
verses.textEnNiv: For a hundred pieces of silver, he bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, the plot of ground where he pitched his tent.
verses.textEnEsv: And from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, he bought for a hundred pieces of money the piece of land on which he had pitched his tent.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he bought the parcel of land, where he had pitched his tent, from the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob bought the plot of land where he camped from the family of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for 100 pieces of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: He bought the plot of land where he had pitched his tent from the hand of the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for a hundred pieces of money.
verses.textEn: For a hundred pieces of silver, he bought from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, the plot of ground where he pitched his tent.

verses.textZh: 在那里雅各建了一座坛，给它起名叫伊利．伊罗伊．以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里雅各建了一座坛，给它起名叫伊利．伊罗伊．以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里筑了一座坛，起名叫伊利‧伊罗伊‧以色列 。
verses.textEnNiv: There he set up an altar and called it El Elohe Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: There he erected an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he erected an altar there and called it El Elohe Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: And there he built an altar and named it El-Elohe-Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he erected there an altar and called it El-Elohe-Israel.
verses.textEn: There he set up an altar and called it El Elohe Israel.

verses.textZh: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿底拿，出去要看看当地的女子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿底拿，出去要看看当地的女子。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿底拿出去，要见那地的女子们。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the women of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the women of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: One day Dinah, the daughter of Jacob and Leah, went to visit some of the young women who lived in the area.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the daughters of the land.
verses.textEn: Now Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to visit the women of the land.

verses.textZh: 当地的首长，希未人哈抹的儿子示剑，看见她，就拉住她，把她强奸，污辱了她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当地的首长，希未人哈抹的儿子示剑，看见她，就拉住她，把她强奸，污辱了她。
verses.textZhCuv: 那地的主－希未人、哈抹的儿子示剑看见她，就拉住她，与她行淫，玷辱她。
verses.textEnNiv: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the ruler of that area, saw her, he took her and raped her.
verses.textEnEsv: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her, he seized her and lay with her and humiliated her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her and lay with her, and violated her.
verses.textEnNlt: But when the local prince, Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, saw Dinah, he seized her and raped her.
verses.textEnNasb: When Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her, he took her and lay with her and raped her.
verses.textEn: When Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite, the ruler of that area, saw her, he took her and raped her.

verses.textZh: 示剑的心恋慕雅各的女儿底拿，他深爱这少女，就用甜言蜜语安慰她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示剑的心恋慕雅各的女儿底拿，他深爱这少女，就用甜言蜜语安慰她。
verses.textZhCuv: 示剑的心系恋雅各的女儿底拿，喜爱这女子，甜言蜜语地安慰她。
verses.textEnNiv: His heart was drawn to Dinah daughter of Jacob; he loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her.
verses.textEnEsv: And his soul was drawn to Dinah the daughter of Jacob. He loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her.
verses.textEnNkjv: His soul was strongly attracted to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young woman and spoke kindly to the young woman.
verses.textEnNlt: But then he fell in love with her, and he tried to win her affection with tender words.
verses.textEnNasb: But he was deeply attracted to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the girl and spoke tenderly to her.
verses.textEn: His heart was drawn to Dinah daughter of Jacob; he loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her.

verses.textZh: 示剑对他父亲哈抹说："求你为我聘这女子为妻。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 示剑对他父亲哈抹说："求你为我聘这女子为妻。"
verses.textZhCuv: 示剑对他父亲哈抹说：「求你为我聘这女子为妻。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Shechem said to his father Hamor, "Get me this girl as my wife."
verses.textEnEsv: So Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, "Get me this girl for my wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, "Get me this young woman as a wife."
verses.textEnNlt: He said to his father, Hamor, "Get me this young girl. I want to marry her."
verses.textEnNasb: So Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, "Get me this young woman as a wife."
verses.textEn: And Shechem said to his father Hamor, "Get me this girl as my wife."

verses.textZh: 雅各听见示剑奸污了他的女儿底拿；但那时他的儿子正在田间看守他的牲畜，所以他没有作声，只等他们回来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各听见示剑奸污了他的女儿底拿；但那时他的儿子正在田间看守他的牲畜，所以他没有作声，只等他们回来。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各听见示剑玷污了他的女儿底拿。那时他的儿子们正和群畜在田野，雅各就闭口不言，等他们回来。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jacob heard that his daughter Dinah had been defiled, his sons were in the fields with his livestock; so he did nothing about it until they came home.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled his daughter Dinah. But his sons were with his livestock in the field, so Jacob held his peace until they came.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter. Now his sons were with his livestock in the field; so Jacob held his peace until they came.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled his daughter, Dinah. But since his sons were out in the fields herding his livestock, he said nothing until they returned.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled his daughter Dinah; but his sons were with his livestock in the field, so Jacob said nothing until they came in.
verses.textEn: When Jacob heard that his daughter Dinah had been defiled, his sons were in the fields with his livestock; so he did nothing about it until they came home.

verses.textZh: 示剑的父亲哈抹出来见雅各，要与他商议。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示剑的父亲哈抹出来见雅各，要与他商议。
verses.textZhCuv: 示剑的父亲哈抹出来见雅各，要和他商议。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Shechem’s father Hamor went out to talk with Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Hamor, Shechem’s father, came to discuss the matter with Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.
verses.textEn: Then Shechem’s father Hamor went out to talk with Jacob.

verses.textZh: 雅各的儿子听见了这事，就从田间回来；各人都感到非常悲痛和忿怒，因为示剑在以色列中作了丑事，就是把雅各的女儿奸污了，这是不应该作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各的儿子听见了这事，就从田间回来；各人都感到非常悲痛和忿怒，因为示剑在以色列中作了丑事，就是把雅各的女儿奸污了，这是不应该作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的儿子们听见这事，就从田野回来，人人忿恨，十分恼怒；因示剑在以色列家做了丑事，与雅各的女儿行淫，这本是不该做的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, Jacob’s sons had come in from the fields as soon as they heard what had happened. They were shocked and furious, because Shechem had done an outrageous thing in Israel by sleeping with Jacob’s daughter—a thing that should not be done.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jacob had come in from the field as soon as they heard of it, and the men were indignant and very angry, because he had done an outrageous thing in Israel by lying with Jacob’s daughter, for such a thing must not be done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it; and the men were grieved and very angry, because he had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing which ought not to be done.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, Jacob’s sons had come in from the field as soon as they heard what had happened. They were shocked and furious that their sister had been raped. Shechem had done a disgraceful thing against Jacob’s family, something that should never be done.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard about it; and the men were grieved, and they were very angry because he had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by sleeping with Jacob’s daughter, for such a thing ought not to be done.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, Jacob’s sons had come in from the fields as soon as they heard what had happened. They were shocked and furious, because Shechem had done an outrageous thing in Israel by sleeping with Jacob’s daughter—a thing that should not be done.

verses.textZh: 哈抹与他们商议说："我儿子示剑的心依恋你们家的女儿，请你们把她给我的儿子为妻吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈抹与他们商议说："我儿子示剑的心依恋你们家的女儿，请你们把她给我的儿子为妻吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈抹和他们商议说：「我儿子示剑的心恋慕这女子，求你们将她给我的儿子为妻。
verses.textEnNiv: But Hamor said to them, "My son Shechem has his heart set on your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: But Hamor spoke with them, saying, "The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him to be his wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Hamor spoke with them, saying, "The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
verses.textEnNlt: Hamor tried to speak with Jacob and his sons. "My son Shechem is truly in love with your daughter," he said. "Please let him marry her.
verses.textEnNasb: But Hamor spoke with them, saying, "The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter; please give her to him in marriage.
verses.textEn: But Hamor said to them, "My son Shechem has his heart set on your daughter. Please give her to him as his wife.

verses.textZh: 你们与我们可以彼此结亲；你们可以把女儿嫁给我们，也可以娶我们的女儿为妻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们与我们可以彼此结亲；你们可以把女儿嫁给我们，也可以娶我们的女儿为妻。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们与我们彼此结亲；你们可以把女儿给我们，也可以娶我们的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: And make marriages with us; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters to yourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, let’s arrange other marriages, too. You give us your daughters for our sons, and we will give you our daughters for your sons.
verses.textEnNasb: And intermarry with us; give your daughters to us and take our daughters for yourselves.
verses.textEn: Intermarry with us; give us your daughters and take our daughters for yourselves.

verses.textZh: 这样，你们可以与我们同住；这地就摆在你们面前，只管在其中居住，来往作买卖，购置产业吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你们可以与我们同住；这地就摆在你们面前，只管在其中居住，来往作买卖，购置产业吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们与我们同住吧！这地都在你们面前，只管在此居住，做买卖，置产业。」
verses.textEnNiv: You can settle among us; the land is open to you. Live in it, trade in it, and acquire property in it."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall dwell with us, and the land shall be open to you. Dwell and trade in it, and get property in it."
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall dwell with us, and the land shall be before you. Dwell and trade in it, and acquire possessions for yourselves in it."
verses.textEnNlt: And you may live among us; the land is open to you! Settle here and trade with us. And feel free to buy property in the area."
verses.textEnNasb: So you will live with us, and the land shall be open to you; live and trade in it and acquire property in it."
verses.textEn: You can settle among us; the land is open to you. Live in it, trade in it, and acquire property in it."

verses.textZh: 示剑对底拿的父亲和她的兄弟说："但愿我得你们的喜悦，无论你们要甚么，我必给你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 示剑对底拿的父亲和她的兄弟说："但愿我得你们的喜悦，无论你们要甚么，我必给你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 示剑对女儿的父亲和弟兄们说：「但愿我在你们眼前蒙恩，你们向我要什么，我必给你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father and brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and I will give you whatever you ask.
verses.textEnEsv: Shechem also said to her father and to her brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you say to me I will give.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Shechem said to her father and her brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you say to me I will give.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Shechem himself spoke to Dinah’s father and brothers. "Please be kind to me, and let me marry her," he begged. "I will give you whatever you ask.
verses.textEnNasb: Shechem also said to her father and to her brothers, "Let me find favor in your sight, and I will give whatever you tell me.
verses.textEn: Then Shechem said to Dinah’s father and brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and I will give you whatever you ask.

verses.textZh: 任由你们向我要多重的聘金和多大的礼物，我必照你们所说的给你们，只要你们把这少女给我为妻就是了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 任由你们向我要多重的聘金和多大的礼物，我必照你们所说的给你们，只要你们把这少女给我为妻就是了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 任凭向我要多重的聘金和礼物，我必照你们所说的给你们；只要把女子给我为妻。」
verses.textEnNiv: Make the price for the bride and the gift I am to bring as great as you like, and I’ll pay whatever you ask me. Only give me the young woman as my wife."
verses.textEnEsv: Ask me for as great a bride-price and gift as you will, and I will give whatever you say to me. Only give me the young woman to be my wife."
verses.textEnNkjv: Ask me ever so much dowry and gift, and I will give according to what you say to me; but give me the young woman as a wife."
verses.textEnNlt: No matter what dowry or gift you demand, I will gladly pay it—just give me the girl as my wife."
verses.textEnNasb: Demand of me ever so much bridal payment and gift, and I will give whatever you tell me; but give me the girl in marriage."
verses.textEn: Make the price for the bride and the gift I am to bring as great as you like, and I’ll pay whatever you ask me. Only give me the young woman as my wife."

verses.textZh: 雅各的众子，因为示剑奸污了他们的妹妹底拿，就用欺诈的话回答示剑和他父亲哈抹，
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各的众子，因为示剑奸污了他们的妹妹底拿，就用欺诈的话回答示剑和他父亲哈抹，
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的儿子们因为示剑玷污了他们的妹子底拿，就用诡诈的话回答示剑和他父亲哈抹，
verses.textEnNiv: Because their sister Dinah had been defiled, Jacob’s sons replied deceitfully as they spoke to Shechem and his father Hamor.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and his father Hamor deceitfully, because he had defiled their sister Dinah.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father, and spoke deceitfully, because he had defiled Dinah their sister.
verses.textEnNlt: But since Shechem had defiled their sister, Dinah, Jacob’s sons responded deceitfully to Shechem and his father, Hamor.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jacob’s sons answered Shechem and his father Hamor with deceit, because he had defiled their sister Dinah.
verses.textEn: Because their sister Dinah had been defiled, Jacob’s sons replied deceitfully as they spoke to Shechem and his father Hamor.

verses.textZh: 对他们说："我们不能把妹妹给一个没有受割礼的人为妻，因为那是我们的耻辱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 对他们说："我们不能把妹妹给一个没有受割礼的人为妻，因为那是我们的耻辱。
verses.textZhCuv: 对他们说：「我们不能把我们的妹子给没有受割礼的人为妻，因为那是我们的羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: They said to them, "We can’t do such a thing; we can’t give our sister to a man who is not circumcised. That would be a disgrace to us.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to them, "We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised, for that would be a disgrace to us.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to them, "We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised, for that wouldbe a reproach to us.
verses.textEnNlt: They said to them, "We couldn’t possibly allow this, because you’re not circumcised. It would be a disgrace for our sister to marry a man like you!
verses.textEnNasb: They said to them, "We cannot do this thing, that is, give our sister to a man who is uncircumcised, for that would be a disgrace to us.
verses.textEn: They said to them, "We can’t do such a thing; we can’t give our sister to a man who is not circumcised. That would be a disgrace to us.

verses.textZh: 只有一个条件，我们才可以答允你们，就是你们当中所有的男子都受割礼，像我们一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有一个条件，我们才可以答允你们，就是你们当中所有的男子都受割礼，像我们一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有一件才可以应允：若你们所有的男丁都受割礼，和我们一样，
verses.textEnNiv: We will enter into an agreement with you on one condition only: that you become like us by circumcising all your males.
verses.textEnEsv: Only on this condition will we agree with you—that you will become as we are by every male among you being circumcised.
verses.textEnNkjv: But on this condition we will consent to you: If you will become as we are, if every male of you is circumcised,
verses.textEnNlt: But here is a solution. If every man among you will be circumcised like we are,
verses.textEnNasb: Only on this condition will we consent to you: if you will become like us, in that every male of you will be circumcised,
verses.textEn: We will enter into an agreement with you on one condition only: that you become like us by circumcising all your males.

verses.textZh: 我们就可以把女儿嫁给你们，也可以娶你们的女儿为妻；我们可以与你们同住，大家成为一族人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们就可以把女儿嫁给你们，也可以娶你们的女儿为妻；我们可以与你们同住，大家成为一族人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们就把女儿给你们，也娶你们的女儿；我们便与你们同住，两下成为一样的人民。
verses.textEnNiv: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We’ll settle among you and become one people with you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then we will give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to ourselves, and we will dwell with you and become one people.
verses.textEnNkjv: then we will give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us; and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.
verses.textEnNlt: then we will give you our daughters, and we’ll take your daughters for ourselves. We will live among you and become one people.
verses.textEnNasb: then we will give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters for ourselves, and we will live with you and become one people.
verses.textEn: Then we will give you our daughters and take your daughters for ourselves. We’ll settle among you and become one people with you.

verses.textZh: 但如果你们不肯听从我们受割礼，我就要把我们家的女儿带走了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果你们不肯听从我们受割礼，我就要把我们家的女儿带走了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若你们不听从我们受割礼，我们就带着妹子走了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, we’ll take our sister and go."
verses.textEnEsv: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our daughter, and we will be gone."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you will not heed us and be circumcised, then we will take our daughter and be gone."
verses.textEnNlt: But if you don’t agree to be circumcised, we will take her and be on our way."
verses.textEnNasb: But if you do not listen to us to be circumcised, then we will take our daughter and go."
verses.textEn: But if you will not agree to be circumcised, we’ll take our sister and go."

verses.textZh: 哈抹和他儿子示剑觉得他们的提议很好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈抹和他儿子示剑觉得他们的提议很好。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈抹和他的儿子示剑喜欢这话。
verses.textEnNiv: Their proposal seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.
verses.textEnEsv: Their words pleased Hamor and Hamor’s son Shechem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
verses.textEnNlt: Hamor and his son Shechem agreed to their proposal.
verses.textEnNasb: Now their words seemed reasonable to Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
verses.textEn: Their proposal seemed good to Hamor and his son Shechem.

verses.textZh: 那少年就立刻照着去作，因为他喜爱雅各的女儿；他在他父亲的全家中又是最受尊敬的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那少年就立刻照着去作，因为他喜爱雅各的女儿；他在他父亲的全家中又是最受尊敬的。
verses.textZhCuv: 那少年人做这事并不迟延，因为他喜爱雅各的女儿；他在他父亲家中也是人最尊重的。
verses.textEnNiv: The young man, who was the most honored of all his father’s family, lost no time in doing what they said, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter.
verses.textEnEsv: And the young man did not delay to do the thing, because he delighted in Jacob’s daughter. Now he was the most honored of all his father’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the young man did not delay to do the thing, because he delighted in Jacob’s daughter. He was more honorable than all the household of his father.
verses.textEnNlt: Shechem wasted no time in acting on this request, for he wanted Jacob’s daughter desperately. Shechem was a highly respected member of his family,
verses.textEnNasb: The young man did not delay to do this, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter. Now he was more respected than all the household of his father.
verses.textEn: The young man, who was the most honored of all his father’s family, lost no time in doing what they said, because he was delighted with Jacob’s daughter.

verses.textZh: 哈抹和他儿子示剑来到自己的城的门口，对城里的人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈抹和他儿子示剑来到自己的城的门口，对城里的人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 哈抹和他儿子示剑到本城的门口，对本城的人说：
verses.textEnNiv: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city to speak to the men of their city.
verses.textEnEsv: So Hamor and his son Shechem came to the gate of their city and spoke to the men of their city, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke with the men of their city, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: and he went with his father, Hamor, to present this proposal to the leaders at the town gate.
verses.textEnNasb: So Hamor and his son Shechem came to the gate of their city and spoke to the people of their city, saying,
verses.textEn: So Hamor and his son Shechem went to the gate of their city to speak to the men of their city.

verses.textZh: "这些人与我们和平相处，不如让他们在这地居住，来往作买卖吧。这地两边都很宽阔，可以容纳他们；我们可以娶他们的女儿为妻，也可以把我们的女儿嫁给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这些人与我们和平相处，不如让他们在这地居住，来往作买卖吧。这地两边都很宽阔，可以容纳他们；我们可以娶他们的女儿为妻，也可以把我们的女儿嫁给他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这些人与我们和睦，不如许他们在这地居住，做买卖；这地也宽阔，足可容下他们。我们可以娶他们的女儿为妻，也可以把我们的女儿嫁给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: "These men are friendly toward us," they said. "Let them live in our land and trade in it; the land has plenty of room for them. We can marry their daughters and they can marry ours.
verses.textEnEsv: "These men are at peace with us; let them dwell in the land and trade in it, for behold, the land is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters as wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These men are at peace with us. Therefore let them dwell in the land and trade in it. For indeed the land is large enough for them. Let us take their daughters to us as wives, and let us give them our daughters.
verses.textEnNlt: "These men are our friends," they said. "Let’s invite them to live here among us and trade freely. Look, the land is large enough to hold them. We can take their daughters as wives and let them marry ours.
verses.textEnNasb: "These men are friendly to us; therefore let them live in the land and trade in it, for behold, the land is large enough for them. We will take their daughters in marriage, and give our daughters to them.
verses.textEn: "These men are friendly toward us," they said. "Let them live in our land and trade in it; the land has plenty of room for them. We can marry their daughters and they can marry ours.

verses.textZh: 但是只有一个条件，这些人才应允与我们同住，大家成为一族人，就是我们中间所有的男子都受割礼，好象他们受了割礼一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是只有一个条件，这些人才应允与我们同住，大家成为一族人，就是我们中间所有的男子都受割礼，好象他们受了割礼一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有一件事我们必须做，他们才肯应允和我们同住，成为一样的人民：就是我们中间所有的男丁都要受割礼，和他们一样。
verses.textEnNiv: But the men will agree to live with us as one people only on the condition that our males be circumcised, as they themselves are.
verses.textEnEsv: Only on this condition will the men agree to dwell with us to become one people—when every male among us is circumcised as they are circumcised.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only on this condition will the men consent to dwell with us, to be one people: if every male among us is circumcised as they are circumcised.
verses.textEnNlt: But they will consider staying here and becoming one people with us only if all of our men are circumcised, just as they are.
verses.textEnNasb: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people: that every male among us be circumcised just as they are circumcised.
verses.textEn: But the men will agree to live with us as one people only on the condition that our males be circumcised, as they themselves are.

verses.textZh: 这样他们的牲畜、财产和所有的牲口，不都要归我们所有吗？只要我们应允他们的条件，他们就与我们同住了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样他们的牲畜、财产和所有的牲口，不都要归我们所有吗？只要我们应允他们的条件，他们就与我们同住了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的群畜、货财，和一切的牲口岂不都归我们吗？只要依从他们，他们就与我们同住。」
verses.textEnNiv: Won’t their livestock, their property and all their other animals become ours? So let us agree to their terms, and they will settle among us."
verses.textEnEsv: Will not their livestock, their property and all their beasts be ours? Only let us agree with them, and they will dwell with us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Will not their livestock, their property, and every animal of theirs be ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell with us."
verses.textEnNlt: But if we do this, all their livestock and possessions will eventually be ours. Come, let’s agree to their terms and let them settle here among us."
verses.textEnNasb: Will their livestock and their property and all their animals not be ours? Let’s just consent to them, and they will live with us."
verses.textEn: Won’t their livestock, their property and all their other animals become ours? So let us agree to their terms, and they will settle among us."

verses.textZh: 所有从城门出入的人，都听从了哈抹和他儿子示剑的话。于是，所有从城门出入的男子，都受了割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有从城门出入的人，都听从了哈抹和他儿子示剑的话。于是，所有从城门出入的男子，都受了割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡从城门出入的人就都听从哈抹和他儿子示剑的话；于是凡从城门出入的男丁都受了割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: All the men who went out of the city gate agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male in the city was circumcised.
verses.textEnEsv: And all who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all who went out of the gate of his city heeded Hamor and Shechem his son; every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
verses.textEnNlt: So all the men in the town council agreed with Hamor and Shechem, and every male in the town was circumcised.
verses.textEnNasb: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor and to his son Shechem, and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
verses.textEn: All the men who went out of the city gate agreed with Hamor and his son Shechem, and every male in the city was circumcised.

verses.textZh: 到了第三天，他们正在疼痛的时候，雅各的两个儿子，就是底拿的哥哥西缅和利未拿着刀剑，趁着他们想不到的时候，进了那城，把所有的男子都杀了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第三天，他们正在疼痛的时候，雅各的两个儿子，就是底拿的哥哥西缅和利未拿着刀剑，趁着他们想不到的时候，进了那城，把所有的男子都杀了。
verses.textZhCuv: 到第三天，众人正在疼痛的时候，雅各的两个儿子，就是底拿的哥哥西缅和利未，各拿刀剑，趁着众人想不到的时候来到城中，把一切男丁都杀了，
verses.textEnNiv: Three days later, while all of them were still in pain, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, took their swords and attacked the unsuspecting city, killing every male.
verses.textEnEsv: On the third day, when they were sore, two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, took their swords and came against the city while it felt secure and killed all the males.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass on the third day, when they were in pain, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword and came boldly upon the city and killed all the males.
verses.textEnNlt: But three days later, when their wounds were still sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, who were Dinah’s full brothers, took their swords and entered the town without opposition. Then they slaughtered every male there,
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about on the third day, when they were in pain, that two of Jacob’s sons—Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers—each took his sword and came upon the city undetected, and killed every male.
verses.textEn: Three days later, while all of them were still in pain, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, took their swords and attacked the unsuspecting city, killing every male.

verses.textZh: 又用刀剑杀了哈抹和他儿子示剑，然后从示剑的家里把底拿带走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又用刀剑杀了哈抹和他儿子示剑，然后从示剑的家里把底拿带走。
verses.textZhCuv: 又用刀杀了哈抹和他儿子示剑，把底拿从示剑家里带出来就走了。
verses.textEnNiv: They put Hamor and his son Shechem to the sword and took Dinah from Shechem’s house and left.
verses.textEnEsv: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with the sword and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house and went away.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they killed Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah from Shechem’s house, and went out.
verses.textEnNlt: including Hamor and his son Shechem. They killed them with their swords, then took Dinah from Shechem’s house and returned to their camp.
verses.textEnNasb: They killed Hamor and his son Shechem with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah from Shechem’s house, and left.
verses.textEn: They put Hamor and his son Shechem to the sword and took Dinah from Shechem’s house and left.

verses.textZh: 雅各的儿子因为他们的妹妹被人奸污了，就来到被杀的人那里，抢掠那城，
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各的儿子因为他们的妹妹被人奸污了，就来到被杀的人那里，抢掠那城，
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的儿子们因为他们的妹子受了玷污，就来到被杀的人那里，掳掠那城，
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Jacob came upon the dead bodies and looted the city where their sister had been defiled.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because their sister had been defiled.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the rest of Jacob’s sons arrived. Finding the men slaughtered, they plundered the town because their sister had been defiled there.
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob’s sons came upon those killed and looted the city, because they had defiled their sister.
verses.textEn: The sons of Jacob came upon the dead bodies and looted the city where their sister had been defiled.

verses.textZh: 夺去他们的羊群、牛群和驴，以及城里和田间所有的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 夺去他们的羊群、牛群和驴，以及城里和田间所有的，
verses.textZhCuv: 夺了他们的羊群、牛群，和驴，并城里田间所有的；
verses.textEnNiv: They seized their flocks and herds and donkeys and everything else of theirs in the city and out in the fields.
verses.textEnEsv: They took their flocks and their herds, their donkeys, and whatever was in the city and in the field.
verses.textEnNkjv: They took their sheep, their oxen, and their donkeys, what was in the city and what was in the field,
verses.textEnNlt: They seized all the flocks and herds and donkeys—everything they could lay their hands on, both inside the town and outside in the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: They took their flocks, their herds, and their donkeys, and that which was in the city and that which was in the field;
verses.textEn: They seized their flocks and herds and donkeys and everything else of theirs in the city and out in the fields.

verses.textZh: 又把他们所有的财物、孩子和妇女都掳去。屋里所有的东西，都抢掠一空。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又把他们所有的财物、孩子和妇女都掳去。屋里所有的东西，都抢掠一空。
verses.textZhCuv: 又把他们一切货财、孩子、妇女，并各房中所有的，都掳掠去了。
verses.textEnNiv: They carried off all their wealth and all their women and children, taking as plunder everything in the houses.
verses.textEnEsv: All their wealth, all their little ones and their wives, all that was in the houses, they captured and plundered.
verses.textEnNkjv: and all their wealth. All their little ones and their wives they took captive; and they plundered even all that was in the houses.
verses.textEnNlt: They looted all their wealth and plundered their houses. They also took all their little children and wives and led them away as captives.
verses.textEnNasb: and they captured and looted all their wealth and all their little ones and their wives, even everything that was in the houses.
verses.textEn: They carried off all their wealth and all their women and children, taking as plunder everything in the houses.

verses.textZh: 雅各对西缅和利未说："你们连累了我，使我在这地的居民，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中间，成了可憎的人。我们人数不多，如果他们联合起来对付我，攻击我，我和我的家就必灭绝了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各对西缅和利未说："你们连累了我，使我在这地的居民，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中间，成了可憎的人。我们人数不多，如果他们联合起来对付我，攻击我，我和我的家就必灭绝了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各对西缅和利未说：「你们连累我，使我在这地的居民中，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中，有了臭名。我的人丁既然稀少，他们必聚集来击杀我，我和全家的人都必灭绝。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have brought trouble on me by making me obnoxious to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people living in this land. We are few in number, and if they join forces against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have brought trouble on me by making me stink to the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites and the Perizzites. My numbers are few, and if they gather themselves against me and attack me, I shall be destroyed, both I and my household."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have troubled me by making me obnoxious among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites; and since I am few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and kill me. I shall be destroyed, my household and I."
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have ruined me! You’ve made me stink among all the people of this land—among all the Canaanites and Perizzites. We are so few that they will join forces and crush us. I will be ruined, and my entire household will be wiped out!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have brought trouble on me by making me repulsive among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites; and since my men are few in number, they will band together against me and attack me, and I will be destroyed, I and my household!"
verses.textEn: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have brought trouble on me by making me obnoxious to the Canaanites and Perizzites, the people living in this land. We are few in number, and if they join forces against me and attack me, I and my household will be destroyed."

verses.textZh: 他们回答说："他怎可以待我们的妹妹好象妓女一样呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答说："他怎可以待我们的妹妹好象妓女一样呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「他岂可待我们的妹子如同妓女吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But they replied, "Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?"
verses.textEnEsv: But they said, "Should he treat our sister like a prostitute?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But they said, "Should he treat our sister like a harlot?"
verses.textEnNlt: "But why should we let him treat our sister like a prostitute?" they retorted angrily.
verses.textEnNasb: But they said, "Should he treat our sister like a prostitute?"
verses.textEn: But they replied, "Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?"

verses.textZh: 神对雅各说："起来，上伯特利去，住在那里；你要在那里筑一座坛给神，就是从前你逃避你哥哥以扫的时候，向你显现的那一位。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对雅各说："起来，上伯特利去，住在那里；你要在那里筑一座坛给神，就是从前你逃避你哥哥以扫的时候，向你显现的那一位。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神对雅各说：「起来！上伯特利去，住在那里；要在那里筑一座坛给神，就是你逃避你哥哥以扫的时候向你显现的那位。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then God said to Jacob, "Go up to Bethel and settle there, and build an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you were fleeing from your brother Esau."
verses.textEnEsv: God said to Jacob, "Arise, go up to Bethel and dwell there. Make an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said to Jacob, "Arise, go up to Bethel and dwell there; and make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother."
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said to Jacob, "Get ready and move to Bethel and settle there. Build an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother, Esau."
verses.textEnNasb: Then God said to Jacob, "Arise, go up to Bethel and live there, and make an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau."
verses.textEn: Then God said to Jacob, "Go up to Bethel and settle there, and build an altar there to God, who appeared to you when you were fleeing from your brother Esau."

verses.textZh: 雅各就对他的家人，和所有与他在一起的人说："你们要除去你们中间外族人的神像，你们要洁净自己，更换你们的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各就对他的家人，和所有与他在一起的人说："你们要除去你们中间外族人的神像，你们要洁净自己，更换你们的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就对他家中的人并一切与他同在的人说：「你们要除掉你们中间的外邦神，也要自洁，更换衣裳。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Get rid of the foreign gods you have with you, and purify yourselves and change your clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Put away the foreign gods that are among you and purify yourselves and change your garments.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob told everyone in his household, "Get rid of all your pagan idols, purify yourselves, and put on clean clothing.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Remove the foreign gods which are among you, and purify yourselves and change your garments;
verses.textEn: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, "Get rid of the foreign gods you have with you, and purify yourselves and change your clothes.

verses.textZh: 我们要起程，上伯特利去；我要在那里给神筑一座祭坛，他就是在我遭患难的时候应允我的呼求，在我所行的路上与我同行的那一位。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要起程，上伯特利去；我要在那里给神筑一座祭坛，他就是在我遭患难的时候应允我的呼求，在我所行的路上与我同行的那一位。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要起来，上伯特利去，在那里我要筑一座坛给神，就是在我遭难的日子应允我的祷告、在我行的路上保佑我的那位。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then come, let us go up to Bethel, where I will build an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and who has been with me wherever I have gone."
verses.textEnEsv: Then let us arise and go up to Bethel, so that I may make there an altar to the God who answers me in the day of my distress and has been with me wherever I have gone."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then let us arise and go up to Bethel; and I will make an altar there to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and has been with me in the way which I have gone."
verses.textEnNlt: We are now going to Bethel, where I will build an altar to the God who answered my prayers when I was in distress. He has been with me wherever I have gone."
verses.textEnNasb: and let’s arise and go up to Bethel, and I will make an altar there to God, who answered me on the day of my distress and has been with me wherever I have gone."
verses.textEn: Then come, let us go up to Bethel, where I will build an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress and who has been with me wherever I have gone."

verses.textZh: 他们就把自己手中所有外族人的神像，和自己耳朵上的环子，都交给雅各；雅各把这些东西埋在示剑附近的橡树底下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就把自己手中所有外族人的神像，和自己耳朵上的环子，都交给雅各；雅各把这些东西埋在示剑附近的橡树底下。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就把外邦人的神像和他们耳朵上的环子交给雅各；雅各都藏在示剑那里的橡树底下。
verses.textEnNiv: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods they had and the rings in their ears, and Jacob buried them under the oak at Shechem.
verses.textEnEsv: So they gave to Jacob all the foreign gods that they had, and the rings that were in their ears. Jacob hid them under the terebinth tree that was near Shechem.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the earrings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the terebinth tree which was by Shechem.
verses.textEnNlt: So they gave Jacob all their pagan idols and earrings, and he buried them under the great tree near Shechem.
verses.textEnNasb: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods which they had and the rings which were in their ears, and Jacob hid them under the oak which was near Shechem.
verses.textEn: So they gave Jacob all the foreign gods they had and the rings in their ears, and Jacob buried them under the oak at Shechem.

verses.textZh: 他们出发了，神使周围的城市都非常惧怕，他们就不追赶雅各的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们出发了，神使周围的城市都非常惧怕，他们就不追赶雅各的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们便起行前往。神使那周围城邑的人都甚惊惧，就不追赶雅各的众子了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they set out, and the terror of God fell on the towns all around them so that no one pursued them.
verses.textEnEsv: And as they journeyed, a terror from God fell upon the cities that were around them, so that they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they journeyed, and the terror of God was upon the cities that were all around them, and they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: As they set out, a terror from God spread over the people in all the towns of that area, so no one attacked Jacob’s family.
verses.textEnNasb: As they journeyed, there was a great terror upon the cities which were around them, and they did not pursue the sons of Jacob.
verses.textEn: Then they set out, and the terror of God fell on the towns all around them so that no one pursued them.

verses.textZh: 于是雅各和与他在一起的人，到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是雅各和与他在一起的人，到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是雅各和一切与他同在的人到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob and all the people with him came to Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Eventually, Jacob and his household arrived at Luz (also called Bethel) in Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
verses.textEn: Jacob and all the people with him came to Luz (that is, Bethel) in the land of Canaan.

verses.textZh: 他在那里筑了一座坛，就称那地方为伊勒．伯特利，因为他逃避他哥哥的时候，神曾经在那里向他显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他在那里筑了一座坛，就称那地方为伊勒．伯特利，因为他逃避他哥哥的时候，神曾经在那里向他显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 他在那里筑了一座坛，就给那地方起名叫伊勒‧伯特利 ；因为他逃避他哥哥的时候，神在那里向他显现。
verses.textEnNiv: There he built an altar, and he called the place El Bethel, because it was there that God revealed himself to him when he was fleeing from his brother.
verses.textEnEsv: and there he built an altar and called the place El-bethel, because there God had revealed himself to him when he fled from his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he built an altar there and called the place El Bethel, because there God appeared to him when he fled from the face of his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob built an altar there and named the place El-bethel (which means "God of Bethel"), because God had appeared to him there when he was fleeing from his brother, Esau.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he built an altar there, and called the place El-bethel, because there God had revealed Himself to him when he fled from his brother.
verses.textEn: There he built an altar, and he called the place El Bethel, because it was there that God revealed himself to him when he was fleeing from his brother.

verses.textZh: 利百加的乳母底波拉死了，葬在伯特利下边的橡树底下，所以给那棵树起名叫亚伦．巴古。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利百加的乳母底波拉死了，葬在伯特利下边的橡树底下，所以给那棵树起名叫亚伦．巴古。
verses.textZhCuv: 利百加的奶母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下边橡树底下；那棵树名叫亚伦‧巴古。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak outside Bethel. So it was named Allon Bakuth.
verses.textEnEsv: And Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried under an oak below Bethel. So he called its name Allon-bacuth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the terebinth tree. So the name of it was called Allon Bachuth.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon after this, Rebekah’s old nurse, Deborah, died. She was buried beneath the oak tree in the valley below Bethel. Ever since, the tree has been called Allon-bacuth (which means "oak of weeping").
verses.textEnNasb: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and it was named Allon-bacuth.
verses.textEn: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried under the oak outside Bethel. So it was named Allon Bakuth.

verses.textZh: 雅各从巴旦．亚兰回来以后，神再次向他显现，赐福给他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各从巴旦．亚兰回来以后，神再次向他显现，赐福给他。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各从巴旦‧亚兰回来，神又向他显现，赐福与他，
verses.textEnNiv: After Jacob returned from Paddan Aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.
verses.textEnEsv: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan-aram, and blessed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Padan Aram, and blessed him.
verses.textEnNlt: Now that Jacob had returned from Paddan-aram, God appeared to him again at Bethel. God blessed him,
verses.textEnNasb: Then God appeared to Jacob again when he came from Paddan-aram, and He blessed him.
verses.textEn: After Jacob returned from Paddan Aram, God appeared to him again and blessed him.

verses.textZh: 神对他说： "你的名原是雅各， 但以后不要再叫雅各， 以色列才是你的名。" 这样，神给他改名叫以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对他说： "你的名原是雅各， 但以后不要再叫雅各， 以色列才是你的名。" 这样，神给他改名叫以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 且对他说：「你的名原是雅各，从今以后不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。」这样，他就改名叫以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: God said to him, "Your name is Jacob, but you will no longer be called Jacob; your name will be Israel. " So he named him Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said to him, "Your name is Jacob; no longer shall your name be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name." So he called his name Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God said to him, "Your name is Jacob; your name shall not be called Jacob anymore, but Israel shall be your name." So He called his name Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: saying, "Your name is Jacob, but you will not be called Jacob any longer. From now on your name will be Israel." So God renamed him Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: God said to him, "Your name is Jacob; You shall no longer be called Jacob, But Israel shall be your name." So He called him Israel.
verses.textEn: God said to him, "Your name is Jacob, but you will no longer be called Jacob; your name will be Israel. " So he named him Israel.

verses.textZh: 神对他说： "我是全能的神， 你要繁衍增多， 必有一国和众国从你而生， 又必有很多君王从你而出。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神对他说： "我是全能的神， 你要繁衍增多， 必有一国和众国从你而生， 又必有很多君王从你而出。
verses.textZhCuv: 神又对他说：「我是全能的神；你要生养众多，将来有一族和多国的民从你而生，又有君王从你而出。
verses.textEnNiv: And God said to him, "I am God Almighty ; be fruitful and increase in number. A nation and a community of nations will come from you, and kings will be among your descendants.
verses.textEnEsv: And God said to him, "I am God Almighty: be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations shall come from you, and kings shall come from your own body.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also God said to him: "I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply; a nation and a company of nations shall proceed from you, and kings shall come from your body.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said, "I am El-Shaddai—‘God Almighty.’ Be fruitful and multiply. You will become a great nation, even many nations. Kings will be among your descendants!
verses.textEnNasb: God also said to him, "I am God Almighty; Be fruitful and multiply; A nation and a multitude of nations shall come from you, And kings shall come from you.
verses.textEn: And God said to him, "I am God Almighty ; be fruitful and increase in number. A nation and a community of nations will come from you, and kings will be among your descendants.

verses.textZh: 我赐给亚伯拉罕和以撒的地， 我要赐给你， 我也要把这地赐给你的后裔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我赐给亚伯拉罕和以撒的地， 我要赐给你， 我也要把这地赐给你的后裔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我所赐给亚伯拉罕和以撒的地，我要赐给你与你的后裔。」
verses.textEnNiv: The land I gave to Abraham and Isaac I also give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you."
verses.textEnEsv: The land that I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give the land to your offspring after you."
verses.textEnNkjv: The land which I gave Abraham and Isaac I give to you; and to your descendants after you I give this land."
verses.textEnNlt: And I will give you the land I once gave to Abraham and Isaac. Yes, I will give it to you and your descendants after you."
verses.textEnNasb: "And the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give to you, And I will give the land to your descendants after you."
verses.textEn: The land I gave to Abraham and Isaac I also give to you, and I will give this land to your descendants after you."

verses.textZh: 神从与雅各谈话的地方，离开他上升去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神从与雅各谈话的地方，离开他上升去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神就从那与雅各说话的地方升上去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then God went up from him at the place where he had talked with him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then God went up from him in the place where he had spoken with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God went up from him in the place where He talked with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then God went up from the place where he had spoken to Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: Then God went up from him at the place where He had spoken with him.
verses.textEn: Then God went up from him at the place where he had talked with him.

verses.textZh: 雅各就在神与他谈话的地方，立了一根石柱；在柱上浇了奠祭和油。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各就在神与他谈话的地方，立了一根石柱；在柱上浇了奠祭和油。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各便在那里立了一根石柱，在柱子上奠酒，浇油。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob set up a stone pillar at the place where God had talked with him, and he poured out a drink offering on it; he also poured oil on it.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he had spoken with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it and poured oil on it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He talked with him, a pillar of stone; and he poured a drink offering on it, and he poured oil on it.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob set up a stone pillar to mark the place where God had spoken to him. Then he poured wine over it as an offering to God and anointed the pillar with olive oil.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob set up a memorial stone in the place where He had spoken with him, a memorial of stone, and he poured out a drink offering on it; he also poured oil on it.
verses.textEn: Jacob set up a stone pillar at the place where God had talked with him, and he poured out a drink offering on it; he also poured oil on it.

verses.textZh: 雅各给神与他谈话的地方起名叫伯特利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各给神与他谈话的地方起名叫伯特利。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就给那地方起名叫伯特利。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob called the place where God had talked with him Bethel.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jacob called the name of the place where God had spoken with him Bethel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him, Bethel.
verses.textEnNlt: And Jacob named the place Bethel (which means "house of God"), because God had spoken to him there.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jacob named the place where God had spoken with him, Bethel.
verses.textEn: Jacob called the place where God had talked with him Bethel.

verses.textZh: 他们从伯特利起程，离以法他还有一段路程的时候，拉结产期到了；但她遇到难产。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们从伯特利起程，离以法他还有一段路程的时候，拉结产期到了；但她遇到难产。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从伯特利起行，离以法他还有一段路程，拉结临产甚是艰难。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they moved on from Bethel. While they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth and had great difficulty.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they journeyed from Bethel. When they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel went into labor, and she had hard labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they journeyed from Bethel. And when there was but a little distance to go to Ephrath, Rachel labored inchildbirth, and she had hard labor.
verses.textEnNlt: Leaving Bethel, Jacob and his clan moved on toward Ephrath. But Rachel went into labor while they were still some distance away. Her labor pains were intense.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they journeyed on from Bethel; but when there was still some distance to go to Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth and she suffered severe difficulties in her labor.
verses.textEn: Then they moved on from Bethel. While they were still some distance from Ephrath, Rachel began to give birth and had great difficulty.

verses.textZh: 她正在极辛苦的时候，接生婆对她说："不要怕，你这次又得了一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她正在极辛苦的时候，接生婆对她说："不要怕，你这次又得了一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 正在艰难的时候，收生婆对她说：「不要怕，你又要得一个儿子了。」
verses.textEnNiv: And as she was having great difficulty in childbirth, the midwife said to her, "Don’t despair, for you have another son."
verses.textEnEsv: And when her labor was at its hardest, the midwife said to her, "Do not fear, for you have another son."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, when she was in hard labor, that the midwife said to her, "Do not fear; you will have this son also."
verses.textEnNlt: After a very hard delivery, the midwife finally exclaimed, "Don’t be afraid—you have another son!"
verses.textEnNasb: And when she was suffering severe difficulties in her labor, the midwife said to her, "Do not fear, for you have another son!"
verses.textEn: And as she was having great difficulty in childbirth, the midwife said to her, "Don’t despair, for you have another son."

verses.textZh: 拉结快要死了，正要断气的时候，她给她儿子起名叫便．俄尼；他的父亲却叫他便雅悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结快要死了，正要断气的时候，她给她儿子起名叫便．俄尼；他的父亲却叫他便雅悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 她将近于死，灵魂要走的时候，就给她儿子起名叫便‧俄尼；他父亲却给他起名叫便雅悯。
verses.textEnNiv: As she breathed her last—for she was dying—she named her son Ben-Oni. But his father named him Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: And as her soul was departing (for she was dying), she called his name Ben-oni; but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, as her soul was departing (for she died), that she called his name Ben-Oni; but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.textEnNlt: Rachel was about to die, but with her last breath she named the baby Ben-oni (which means "son of my sorrow"). The baby’s father, however, called him Benjamin (which means "son of my right hand").
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, as her soul was departing (for she died), that she named him Ben-oni; but his father called him Benjamin.
verses.textEn: As she breathed her last—for she was dying—she named her son Ben-Oni. But his father named him Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 拉结死了，葬在通往以法他的路旁。以法他就是伯利恒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结死了，葬在通往以法他的路旁。以法他就是伯利恒。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结死了，葬在以法他的路旁；以法他就是伯利恒。
verses.textEnNiv: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
verses.textEnEsv: So Rachel died, and she was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem),
verses.textEnNkjv: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
verses.textEnNlt: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
verses.textEnNasb: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
verses.textEn: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).

verses.textZh: 雅各在她的坟墓上立了一根柱子，就是拉结的墓碑，到今天还在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各在她的坟墓上立了一根柱子，就是拉结的墓碑，到今天还在。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各在她的坟上立了一统碑，就是拉结的墓碑，到今日还在。
verses.textEnNiv: Over her tomb Jacob set up a pillar, and to this day that pillar marks Rachel’s tomb.
verses.textEnEsv: and Jacob set up a pillar over her tomb. It is the pillar of Rachel’s tomb, which is there to this day.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob set a pillar on her grave, which is the pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob set up a stone monument over Rachel’s grave, and it can be seen there to this day.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jacob set up a memorial stone over her grave; that is the memorial stone of Rachel’s grave to this day.
verses.textEn: Over her tomb Jacob set up a pillar, and to this day that pillar marks Rachel’s tomb.

verses.textZh: 以色列又起程前行，在以得台那边支搭了帐棚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列又起程前行，在以得台那边支搭了帐棚。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列起行前往，在以得台那边支搭帐棚。
verses.textEnNiv: Israel moved on again and pitched his tent beyond Migdal Eder.
verses.textEnEsv: Israel journeyed on and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel journeyed and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob traveled on and camped beyond Migdal-eder.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Israel journeyed on and pitched his tent beyond the tower of Eder.
verses.textEn: Israel moved on again and pitched his tent beyond Migdal Eder.

verses.textZh: 以色列在那地居住的时候，流本竟去与他父亲的妾辟拉同睡；这事以色列也听见了。雅各共有十二个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列在那地居住的时候，流本竟去与他父亲的妾辟拉同睡；这事以色列也听见了。雅各共有十二个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列住在那地的时候，吕便去与他父亲的妾辟拉同寝，以色列也听见了。 雅各共有十二个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard of it. Jacob had twelve sons:
verses.textEnEsv: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine. And Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when Israel dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine; and Israel heard aboutit. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:
verses.textEnNlt: While he was living there, Reuben had intercourse with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Jacob soon heard about it. These are the names of the twelve sons of Jacob:
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about, while Israel was living in that land, that Reuben went and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard about it. Now there were twelve sons of Jacob—
verses.textEn: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard of it. Jacob had twelve sons:

verses.textZh: 利亚的儿子有：雅各的长子流本，以及西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦和西布伦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚的儿子有：雅各的长子流本，以及西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦和西布伦。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚所生的是雅各的长子吕便，还有西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、西布伦。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Leah: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
verses.textEnNkjv: the sons of Leah were Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, and Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun;
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Leah were Reuben (Jacob’s oldest son), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
verses.textEnNasb: the sons of Leah were Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn, then Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun;
verses.textEn: The sons of Leah: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar and Zebulun.

verses.textZh: 拉结的儿子有：约瑟和便雅悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结的儿子有：约瑟和便雅悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结所生的是约瑟、便雅悯。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.textEnNkjv: the sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin;
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: the sons of Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin;
verses.textEn: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 拉结的婢女辟拉的儿子有：但和拿弗他利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拉结的婢女辟拉的儿子有：但和拿弗他利。
verses.textZhCuv: 拉结的使女辟拉所生的是但、拿弗他利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Rachel’s servant Bilhah: Dan and Naphtali.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s servant: Dan and Naphtali.
verses.textEnNkjv: the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s maidservant, were Dan and Naphtali;
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, were Dan and Naphtali.
verses.textEnNasb: and the sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s female slave, were Dan and Naphtali;
verses.textEn: The sons of Rachel’s servant Bilhah: Dan and Naphtali.

verses.textZh: 利亚的婢女悉帕的儿子有：迦得和亚设。这些都是雅各在巴旦．亚兰所生的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利亚的婢女悉帕的儿子有：迦得和亚设。这些都是雅各在巴旦．亚兰所生的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 利亚的使女悉帕所生的是迦得、亚设。这是雅各在巴旦‧亚兰所生的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Leah’s servant Zilpah: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Zilpah, Leah’s servant: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Paddan-aram.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s maidservant, were Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Padan Aram.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Zilpah, Leah’s servant, were Gad and Asher. These are the names of the sons who were born to Jacob at Paddan-aram.
verses.textEnNasb: and the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s female slave, were Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob who were born to him in Paddan-aram.
verses.textEn: The sons of Leah’s servant Zilpah: Gad and Asher. These were the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

verses.textZh: 雅各来到基列．亚巴的幔利他父亲以撒那里，基列．亚巴就是希伯仑，是亚伯拉罕和以撒寄居过的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各来到基列．亚巴的幔利他父亲以撒那里，基列．亚巴就是希伯仑，是亚伯拉罕和以撒寄居过的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各来到他父亲以撒那里，到了基列‧亚巴的幔利，乃是亚伯拉罕和以撒寄居的地方；基列‧亚巴就是希伯仑。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob came home to his father Isaac in Mamre, near Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, or Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had sojourned.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, or Kirjath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had dwelt.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob returned to his father, Isaac, in Mamre, which is near Kiriath-arba (now called Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had both lived as foreigners.
verses.textEnNasb: Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre of Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had resided.
verses.textEn: Jacob came home to his father Isaac in Mamre, near Kiriath Arba (that is, Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac had stayed.

verses.textZh: 以撒一生的年日共一百八十岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒一生的年日共一百八十岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒共活了一百八十岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Isaac lived a hundred and eighty years.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the days of Isaac were 180 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the days of Isaac were one hundred and eighty years.
verses.textEnNlt: Isaac lived for 180 years.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the days of Isaac were 180 years.
verses.textEn: Isaac lived a hundred and eighty years.

verses.textZh: 以撒年纪老迈，享尽天年，就气绝而死，归到他的亲族那里去了；他儿子以扫和雅各把他葬了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以撒年纪老迈，享尽天年，就气绝而死，归到他的亲族那里去了；他儿子以扫和雅各把他葬了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以撒年纪老迈，日子满足，气绝而死，归到他列祖 那里。他两个儿子以扫、雅各把他埋葬了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaac breathed his last, and he died and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Isaac breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people, being old and full of days. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he breathed his last and died at a ripe old age, joining his ancestors in death. And his sons, Esau and Jacob, buried him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Isaac breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people, an old man of ripe age; and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.textEn: Then he breathed his last and died and was gathered to his people, old and full of years. And his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

verses.textZh: 以下是以扫的后代 ：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是以扫的后代 ：
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫就是以东，他的后代记在下面。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of the family line of Esau (that is, Edom).
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
verses.textEnNkjv: Now this is the genealogy of Esau, who is Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of the descendants of Esau (also known as Edom).
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the records of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
verses.textEn: This is the account of the family line of Esau (that is, Edom).

verses.textZh: 以扫娶了迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大，和希未人祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫娶了迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大，和希未人祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛；
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫娶迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大和希未人祭便的孙女、亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛，
verses.textEnNiv: Esau took his wives from the women of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite—
verses.textEnEsv: Esau took his wives from the Canaanites: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, Oholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
verses.textEnNkjv: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite; Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.textEnNlt: Esau married two young women from Canaan: Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite; and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite.
verses.textEnNasb: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.textEn: Esau took his wives from the women of Canaan: Adah daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon the Hivite—

verses.textZh: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿、尼拜约的妹妹巴实抹。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿、尼拜约的妹妹巴实抹。
verses.textZhCuv: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿、尼拜约的妹子巴实抹。
verses.textEnNiv: also Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.
verses.textEnEsv: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.
verses.textEnNkjv: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
verses.textEnNlt: He also married his cousin Basemath, who was the daughter of Ishmael and the sister of Nebaioth.
verses.textEnNasb: also Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.
verses.textEn: also Basemath daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebaioth.

verses.textZh: 亚大给以扫生了以利法；巴实抹生了流珥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚大给以扫生了以利法；巴实抹生了流珥。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚大给以扫生了以利法；巴实抹生了流珥；
verses.textEnNiv: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath bore Reuel,
verses.textEnEsv: And Adah bore to Esau, Eliphaz; Basemath bore Reuel;
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel.
verses.textEnNlt: Adah gave birth to a son named Eliphaz for Esau. Basemath gave birth to a son named Reuel.
verses.textEnNasb: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath gave birth to Reuel,
verses.textEn: Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, Basemath bore Reuel,

verses.textZh: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施、雅兰和可拉。这些都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施、雅兰和可拉。这些都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。这都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。
verses.textEnNiv: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Aholibamah bore Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah. These were the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: Oholibamah gave birth to sons named Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. All these sons were born to Esau in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: and Oholibamah gave birth to Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEn: and Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the sons of Esau, who were born to him in Canaan.

verses.textZh: 以扫带着他的众妻子、儿女和家中所有的人，以及他的牲畜、所有的牲口和他在迦南地所得的一切财产，离开他的弟弟雅各到别的地方去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫带着他的众妻子、儿女和家中所有的人，以及他的牲畜、所有的牲口和他在迦南地所得的一切财产，离开他的弟弟雅各到别的地方去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫带着他的妻子、儿女，与家中一切的人口，并他的牛羊、牲畜，和一切货财，就是他在迦南地所得的，往别处去，离了他兄弟雅各。
verses.textEnNiv: Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the members of his household, as well as his livestock and all his other animals and all the goods he had acquired in Canaan, and moved to a land some distance from his brother Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, his livestock, all his beasts, and all his property that he had acquired in the land of Canaan. He went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the persons of his household, his cattle and all his animals, and all his goods which he had gained in the land of Canaan, and went to a country away from the presence of his brother Jacob.
verses.textEnNlt: Esau took his wives, his children, and his entire household, along with his livestock and cattle—all the wealth he had acquired in the land of Canaan—and moved away from his brother, Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all his household, and his livestock and all his cattle, and all his property which he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and went to another land away from his brother Jacob.
verses.textEn: Esau took his wives and sons and daughters and all the members of his household, as well as his livestock and all his other animals and all the goods he had acquired in Canaan, and moved to a land some distance from his brother Jacob.

verses.textZh: 因为他们都有很多财物，所以不能住在一起；又因他们牲畜很多的缘故，他们寄居的地方也容不下他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们都有很多财物，所以不能住在一起；又因他们牲畜很多的缘故，他们寄居的地方也容不下他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为二人的财物群畜甚多，寄居的地方容不下他们，所以不能同居。
verses.textEnNiv: Their possessions were too great for them to remain together; the land where they were staying could not support them both because of their livestock.
verses.textEnEsv: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together. The land of their sojournings could not support them because of their livestock.
verses.textEnNkjv: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together, and the land where they were strangers could not support them because of their livestock.
verses.textEnNlt: There was not enough land to support them both because of all the livestock and possessions they had acquired.
verses.textEnNasb: For their possessions had become too great for them to live together, and the land where they resided could not support them because of their livestock.
verses.textEn: Their possessions were too great for them to remain together; the land where they were staying could not support them both because of their livestock.

verses.textZh: 于是，以扫住在西珥山上。以扫就是以东。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，以扫住在西珥山上。以扫就是以东。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以扫住在西珥山里；以扫就是以东。
verses.textEnNiv: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.
verses.textEnEsv: So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir. ( Esau is Edom.)
verses.textEnNkjv: So Esau dwelt in Mount Seir. Esau is Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: So Esau (also known as Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.
verses.textEnNasb: So Esau lived in the hill country of Seir; Esau is Edom.
verses.textEn: So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the hill country of Seir.

verses.textZh: 以下是西珥山以东人的始祖以扫的后代：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是西珥山以东人的始祖以扫的后代：
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫是西珥山里以东人的始祖，他的后代记在下面。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of the family line of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.
verses.textEnNkjv: And this is the genealogy of Esau the father of the Edomites in Mount Seir.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of Esau’s descendants, the Edomites, who lived in the hill country of Seir.
verses.textEnNasb: These then are the records of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.
verses.textEn: This is the account of the family line of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir.

verses.textZh: 这些是以扫众子的名称：以利法是以扫的妻子亚大的儿子，流珥是以扫的妻子巴实抹的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些是以扫众子的名称：以利法是以扫的妻子亚大的儿子，流珥是以扫的妻子巴实抹的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫众子的名字如下。以扫的妻子亚大生以利法；以扫的妻子巴实抹生流珥。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, and Reuel the son of Basemath the wife of Esau.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau’s wife Adah; and Reuel, the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz the son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.textEn: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.

verses.textZh: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦和基纳斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦和基纳斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.textEn: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam and Kenaz.

verses.textZh: 亭纳是以扫的儿子以利法的妾；她给以利法生了亚玛力。以上这些人是以扫的妻子亚大的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亭纳是以扫的儿子以利法的妾；她给以利法生了亚玛力。以上这些人是以扫的妻子亚大的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 亭纳是以扫儿子以利法的妾；她给以利法生了亚玛力。这是以扫的妻子亚大的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: Esau’s son Eliphaz also had a concubine named Timna, who bore him Amalek. These were grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah.
verses.textEnEsv: (Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz, Esau’s son; she bore Amalek to Eliphaz.) These are the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Timna was the concubine of Eliphaz, Esau’s son, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These were the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
verses.textEnNlt: Timna, the concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, gave birth to a son named Amalek. These are the descendants of Esau’s wife Adah.
verses.textEnNasb: Timna was a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the sons of Esau’s wife Adah.
verses.textEn: Esau’s son Eliphaz also had a concubine named Timna, who bore him Amalek. These were grandsons of Esau’s wife Adah.

verses.textZh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛和米撒。这些人是以扫的妻子巴实抹的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛和米撒。这些人是以扫的妻子巴实抹的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛、米撒。这是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the descendants of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.textEn: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.

verses.textZh: 以下是祭便的孙女、亚拿的女儿、以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的儿子：她给以扫生了耶乌施、雅兰和可拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是祭便的孙女、亚拿的女儿、以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的儿子：她给以扫生了耶乌施、雅兰和可拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛是祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿；她给以扫生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam and Korah.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Aholibamah, Esau’s wife, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon. And she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.textEnNlt: Esau also had sons through Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon. Their names were Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.textEnNasb: And these were the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the granddaughter of Zibeon: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah and granddaughter of Zibeon, whom she bore to Esau: Jeush, Jalam and Korah.

verses.textZh: 以下是以扫子孙中的族长：以扫的长子以利法的子孙中，有提幔族长、阿抹族长、洗玻族长、基纳斯族长、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是以扫子孙中的族长：以扫的长子以利法的子孙中，有提幔族长、阿抹族长、洗玻族长、基纳斯族长、
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫子孙中作族长的记在下面。以扫的长子以利法的子孙中，有提幔族长、阿抹族长、洗玻族长、基纳斯族长、
verses.textEnNiv: These were the chiefs among Esau’s descendants: The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
verses.textEnEsv: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: the chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn son of Esau, were Chief Teman, Chief Omar, Chief Zepho, Chief Kenaz,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the descendants of Esau who became the leaders of various clans: The descendants of Esau’s oldest son, Eliphaz, became the leaders of the clans of Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
verses.textEnNasb: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn of Esau, are chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
verses.textEn: These were the chiefs among Esau’s descendants: The sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: Chiefs Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

verses.textZh: 可拉族长、迦坦族长、亚玛力族长。这些人是以东地以利法的族长，都是亚大的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可拉族长、迦坦族长、亚玛力族长。这些人是以东地以利法的族长，都是亚大的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 可拉族长、迦坦族长、亚玛力族长。这是在以东地从以利法所出的族长，都是亚大的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: Korah, Gatam and Amalek. These were the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in Edom; they were grandsons of Adah.
verses.textEnEsv: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek; these are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Chief Korah, Chief Gatam, and Chief Amalek. These were the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. They were the sons of Adah.
verses.textEnNlt: Korah, Gatam, and Amalek. These are the clan leaders in the land of Edom who descended from Eliphaz. All these were descendants of Esau’s wife Adah.
verses.textEnNasb: chief Korah, chief Gatam, and chief Amalek. These are the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
verses.textEn: Korah, Gatam and Amalek. These were the chiefs descended from Eliphaz in Edom; they were grandsons of Adah.

verses.textZh: 以扫的儿子流珥的子孙中，有拿哈族长、谢拉族长、沙玛族长和米撒族长。这些人是以东地流珥的族长，都是以扫的妻子巴实抹的子孙。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫的儿子流珥的子孙中，有拿哈族长、谢拉族长、沙玛族长和米撒族长。这些人是以东地流珥的族长，都是以扫的妻子巴实抹的子孙。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫的儿子流珥的子孙中，有拿哈族长、谢拉族长、沙玛族长、米撒族长。这是在以东地从流珥所出的族长，都是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the chiefs descended from Reuel in Edom; they were grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: the chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah; these are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: Chief Nahath, Chief Zerah, Chief Shammah, and Chief Mizzah. These were the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Esau’s son Reuel became the leaders of the clans of Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These are the clan leaders in the land of Edom who descended from Reuel. All these were descendants of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, and chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs descended from Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.textEn: The sons of Esau’s son Reuel: Chiefs Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah. These were the chiefs descended from Reuel in Edom; they were grandsons of Esau’s wife Basemath.

verses.textZh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的子孙中，有耶乌施族长、雅兰族长和可拉族长。这些人是亚拿的女儿、以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的族长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的子孙中，有耶乌施族长、雅兰族长和可拉族长。这些人是亚拿的女儿、以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的族长。
verses.textZhCuv: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的子孙中，有耶乌施族长、雅兰族长、可拉族长。这是从以扫妻子，亚拿的女儿，阿何利巴玛子孙中所出的族长。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: the chiefs Jeush, Jalam, and Korah; these are the chiefs born of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, Esau’s wife: Chief Jeush, Chief Jaalam, and Chief Korah. These were the chiefs whodescended from Aholibamah, Esau’s wife, the daughter of Anah.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Esau and his wife Oholibamah became the leaders of the clans of Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the clan leaders who descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, and chief Korah. These are the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
verses.textEn: The sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah: Chiefs Jeush, Jalam and Korah. These were the chiefs descended from Esau’s wife Oholibamah daughter of Anah.

verses.textZh: 以上这些人就是以扫的子孙和他们的族长。以扫就是以东。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些人就是以扫的子孙和他们的族长。以扫就是以东。
verses.textZhCuv: 以上的族长都是以扫的子孙；以扫就是以东。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Esau ( that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
