verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these were their chiefs.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the clans descended from Esau (also known as Edom), identified by their clan leaders.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
verses.textEn: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.

verses.textZh: 以下是那地原有的居民，何利人西珥的儿子：罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是那地原有的居民，何利人西珥的儿子：罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、
verses.textZhCuv: 那地原有的居民－何利人西珥的子孙记在下面：就是罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、
verses.textEnNiv: These were the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the region: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Seir the Horite who inhabited the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of the tribes that descended from Seir the Horite. They lived in the land of Edom: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.textEn: These were the sons of Seir the Horite, who were living in the region: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

verses.textZh: 底顺、以察和底珊。这些人是以东地何利人西珥子孙中的族长。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底顺、以察和底珊。这些人是以东地何利人西珥子孙中的族长。
verses.textZhCuv: 底顺、以察、底珊。这是从以东地的何利人西珥子孙中所出的族长。
verses.textEnNiv: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These sons of Seir in Edom were Horite chiefs.
verses.textEnEsv: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan; these are the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir, in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNlt: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These were the Horite clan leaders, the descendants of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom.
verses.textEnNasb: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs descended from the Horites, the sons of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.textEn: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These sons of Seir in Edom were Horite chiefs.

verses.textZh: 罗坍的儿子是何利和希幔；罗坍的妹妹是亭纳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罗坍的儿子是何利和希幔；罗坍的妹妹是亭纳。
verses.textZhCuv: 罗坍的儿子是何利、希幔；罗坍的妹子是亭纳。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Lotan were Hori and Hemam. Lotan’s sister was named Timna.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.textEn: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. Timna was Lotan’s sister.

verses.textZh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文、玛拿辖、以巴录、示玻和阿南。
verses.textZhCnvs: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文、玛拿辖、以巴录、示玻和阿南。
verses.textZhCuv: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文、玛拿辖、以巴录、示玻、阿南。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Shobal were Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.textEn: The sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho and Onam.

verses.textZh: 祭便的儿子是亚雅和亚拿。当年在旷野牧放他父亲祭便的驴，发现了温泉的，就是亚拿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 祭便的儿子是亚雅和亚拿。当年在旷野牧放他父亲祭便的驴，发现了温泉的，就是亚拿。
verses.textZhCuv: 祭便的儿子是亚雅、亚拿（当时在旷野放他父亲祭便的驴，遇着温泉的，就是这亚拿）。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the desert while he was grazing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah; he is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he pastured the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Zibeon: both Ajah and Anah. This wasthe Anah who found the water in the wilderness as he pastured the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah. (This is the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the wilderness while he was grazing his father’s donkeys.)
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah—he is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness when he was pasturing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.
verses.textEn: The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who discovered the hot springs in the desert while he was grazing the donkeys of his father Zibeon.

verses.textZh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺；亚拿的女儿是阿何利巴玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚拿的儿子是底顺；亚拿的女儿是阿何利巴玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚拿的儿子是底顺；亚拿的女儿是阿何利巴玛。
verses.textEnNiv: The children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the children of Anah: Dishon and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Anah were his son, Dishon, and his daughter, Oholibamah.
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon, and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
verses.textEn: The children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah daughter of Anah.

verses.textZh: 底顺的儿子是欣但、伊是班、益兰和基兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底顺的儿子是欣但、伊是班、益兰和基兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 底顺的儿子是欣但、伊是班、益兰、基兰。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Dishon : Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Dishon:Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Dishon were Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.
verses.textEnNasb: And these are the sons of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.textEn: The sons of Dishon : Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran and Keran.

verses.textZh: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番和亚干。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番和亚干。
verses.textZhCuv: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番、亚干。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Ezer were Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.textEn: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan and Akan.

verses.textZh: 底珊的儿子是乌斯和亚兰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底珊的儿子是乌斯和亚兰。
verses.textZhCuv: 底珊的儿子是乌斯、亚兰。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.textEnNlt: The descendants of Dishan were Uz and Aran.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.textEn: The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

verses.textZh: 以下是何利人的族长：罗坍族长、朔巴族长、祭便族长、亚拿族长、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是何利人的族长：罗坍族长、朔巴族长、祭便族长、亚拿族长、
verses.textZhCuv: 从何利人所出的族长记在下面：就是罗坍族长、朔巴族长、祭便族长、亚拿族长、
verses.textEnNiv: These were the Horite chiefs: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.textEnEsv: These are the chiefs of the Horites: the chiefs Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the chiefs of the Horites: Chief Lotan, Chief Shobal, Chief Zibeon, Chief Anah,
verses.textEnNlt: So these were the leaders of the Horite clans: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.textEnNasb: These are the chiefs descended from the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
verses.textEn: These were the Horite chiefs: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

verses.textZh: 底顺族长、以察族长、底珊族长。这些都是何利人的族长，在西珥地按着他们的宗族作族长的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 底顺族长、以察族长、底珊族长。这些都是何利人的族长，在西珥地按着他们的宗族作族长的。
verses.textZhCuv: 底顺族长、以察族长、底珊族长。这是从何利人所出的族长，都在西珥地，按着宗族作族长。
verses.textEnNiv: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These were the Horite chiefs, according to their divisions, in the land of Seir.
verses.textEnEsv: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan; these are the chiefs of the Horites, chief by chief in the land of Seir.
verses.textEnNkjv: Chief Dishon, Chief Ezer, and Chief Dishan. These were the chiefs of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
verses.textEnNlt: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. The Horite clans are named after their clan leaders, who lived in the land of Seir.
verses.textEnNasb: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs descended from the Horites, according to their various chiefs in the land of Seir.
verses.textEn: Dishon, Ezer and Dishan. These were the Horite chiefs, according to their divisions, in the land of Seir.

verses.textZh: 以色列人还没有君王统治之前，在以东地作王的记在下面：
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人还没有君王统治之前，在以东地作王的记在下面：
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人未有君王治理以先，在以东地作王的记在下面。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned:
verses.textEnEsv: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the Israelites.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these were the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel:
verses.textEnNlt: These are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before any king ruled over the Israelites :
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the sons of Israel.
verses.textEn: These were the kings who reigned in Edom before any Israelite king reigned:

verses.textZh: 比珥的儿子比拉在以东作王，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比珥的儿子比拉在以东作王，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
verses.textZhCuv: 比珥的儿子比拉在以东作王，他的京城名叫亭哈巴。
verses.textEnNiv: Bela son of Beor became king of Edom. His city was named Dinhabah.
verses.textEnEsv: Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, the name of his city being Dinhabah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.textEnNlt: Bela son of Beor, who ruled in Edom from his city of Dinhabah.
verses.textEnNasb: Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.textEn: Bela son of Beor became king of Edom. His city was named Dinhabah.

verses.textZh: 比拉死后，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接替他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 比拉死后，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接替他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Bela died, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 约巴死后，从提幔地来的户珊接替他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约巴死后，从提幔地来的户珊接替他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jobab died, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 户珊死后，比达的儿子哈达接替他作王；这哈达就是在摩押原野上击败了米甸人的；他的京城名叫亚未得。
verses.textZhCnvs: 户珊死后，比达的儿子哈达接替他作王；这哈达就是在摩押原野上击败了米甸人的；他的京城名叫亚未得。
verses.textZhCuv: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王；这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的京城名叫亚未得。
verses.textEnNiv: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.
verses.textEnEsv: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place, the name of his city being Avith.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Husham died, Hadad the son of Bedad, who attacked Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. And the name of his city was Avith.
verses.textEnNlt: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad became king in his place and ruled from the city of Avith. He was the one who defeated the Midianites in the land of Moab.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the field of Moab, became king in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.textEn: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, succeeded him as king. His city was named Avith.

verses.textZh: 哈达死后，玛士利加人桑拉接替他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 哈达死后，玛士利加人桑拉接替他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Hadad died, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Hadad died, Samlah from the city of Masrekah became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 桑拉死后，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接替他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 桑拉死后，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接替他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Samlah died, Saul of Rehoboth-by-the-River reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Samlah died, Shaul from the city of Rehoboth-on-the-River became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the river succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 扫罗死后，亚革波的儿子巴勒．哈南接替他作王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 扫罗死后，亚革波的儿子巴勒．哈南接替他作王。
verses.textZhCuv: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒‧哈南接续他作王。
verses.textEnNiv: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.
verses.textEnEsv: Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Saul died, Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.textEnNlt: When Shaul died, Baal-hanan son of Acbor became king in his place.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Shaul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor became king in his place.
verses.textEn: When Shaul died, Baal-Hanan son of Akbor succeeded him as king.

verses.textZh: 亚革波的儿子巴勒．哈南死后，哈达接替他作王；他的京城名叫巴乌；他的妻子名叫米希他别，是米．萨合的孙女、玛特列的女儿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚革波的儿子巴勒．哈南死后，哈达接替他作王；他的京城名叫巴乌；他的妻子名叫米希他别，是米．萨合的孙女、玛特列的女儿。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚革波的儿子巴勒‧哈南死了，哈达接续他作王，他的京城名叫巴乌；他的妻子名叫米希她别，是米‧萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。
verses.textEnNiv: When Baal-Hanan son of Akbor died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.
verses.textEnEsv: Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place, the name of his city being Pau; his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Baal-Hanan the son of Achbor died, Hadar reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.textEnNlt: When Baal-hanan son of Acbor died, Hadad became king in his place and ruled from the city of Pau. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Me-zahab.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar became king in his place; and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezahab.
verses.textEn: When Baal-Hanan son of Akbor died, Hadad succeeded him as king. His city was named Pau, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-Zahab.

verses.textZh: 以下是以扫所出族长的名字 ：亭纳族长、亚勒瓦族长、耶帖族长、
verses.textZhCnvs: 以下是以扫所出族长的名字 ：亭纳族长、亚勒瓦族长、耶帖族长、
verses.textZhCuv: 从以扫所出的族长，按着他们的宗族、住处、名字记在下面：就是亭纳族长、亚勒瓦族长、耶帖族长、
verses.textEnNiv: These were the chiefs descended from Esau, by name, according to their clans and regions: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
verses.textEnEsv: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their clans and their dwelling places, by their names: the chiefs Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
verses.textEnNkjv: And these were the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families and their places, by their names: Chief Timnah, Chief Alvah, Chief Jetheth,
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of the leaders of the clans descended from Esau, who lived in the places named for them: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the names of the chiefs descended from Esau, according to their families and their localities, by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
verses.textEn: These were the chiefs descended from Esau, by name, according to their clans and regions: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

verses.textZh: 阿何利巴玛族长、以拉族长、比嫩族长、
verses.textZhCnvs: 阿何利巴玛族长、以拉族长、比嫩族长、
verses.textZhCuv: 阿何利巴玛族长、以拉族长、比嫩族长、
verses.textEnNiv: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
verses.textEnEsv: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
verses.textEnNkjv: Chief Aholibamah, Chief Elah, Chief Pinon,
verses.textEnNlt: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
verses.textEnNasb: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.textEn: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

verses.textZh: 基纳斯族长、提幔族长、米比萨族长、
verses.textZhCnvs: 基纳斯族长、提幔族长、米比萨族长、
verses.textZhCuv: 基纳斯族长、提幔族长、米比萨族长、
verses.textEnNiv: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
verses.textEnEsv: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
verses.textEnNkjv: Chief Kenaz, Chief Teman, Chief Mibzar,
verses.textEnNlt: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
verses.textEnNasb: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.textEn: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

verses.textZh: 玛基叠族长和以兰族长。这些都是以东人的族长，在所得作为产业的地上，按着他们的住处作族长。以东的始祖就是以扫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛基叠族长和以兰族长。这些都是以东人的族长，在所得作为产业的地上，按着他们的住处作族长。以东的始祖就是以扫。
verses.textZhCuv: 玛基叠族长、以兰族长。这是以东人在所得为业的地上，按着他们的住处。（所有的族长都是以东人的始祖以扫的后代。）
verses.textEnNiv: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they occupied. This is the family line of Esau, the father of the Edomites.
verses.textEnEsv: Magdiel, and Iram; these are the chiefs of Edom (that is, Esau, the father of Edom), according to their dwelling places in the land of their possession.
verses.textEnNkjv: Chief Magdiel, and Chief Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their dwelling places in the land of their possession. Esau was the father of the Edomites.
verses.textEnNlt: Magdiel, and Iram. These are the leaders of the clans of Edom, listed according to their settlements in the land they occupied. They all descended from Esau, the ancestor of the Edomites.
verses.textEnNasb: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom (that is, Esau, the father of the Edomites), according to their settlements in the land of their possession.
verses.textEn: Magdiel and Iram. These were the chiefs of Edom, according to their settlements in the land they occupied. This is the family line of Esau, the father of the Edomites.

verses.textZh: 雅各住在他父亲寄居的地方，就是迦南地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各住在他父亲寄居的地方，就是迦南地。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各住在迦南地，就是他父亲寄居的地。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob lived in the land where his father had stayed, the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s sojournings, in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Jacob dwelt in the land where his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob settled again in the land of Canaan, where his father had lived as a foreigner.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jacob lived in the land where his father had lived as a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEn: Jacob lived in the land where his father had stayed, the land of Canaan.

verses.textZh: 雅各的历史记在下面：约瑟十七岁的时候，与他的哥哥们一同牧羊。他是个孩童，与他父亲的妾，辟拉和悉帕的众子，常在一起。约瑟把他们的恶行报告给父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各的历史记在下面：约瑟十七岁的时候，与他的哥哥们一同牧羊。他是个孩童，与他父亲的妾，辟拉和悉帕的众子，常在一起。约瑟把他们的恶行报告给父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的记略如下。 约瑟十七岁与他哥哥们一同牧羊。他是个童子，与他父亲的妾辟拉、悉帕的儿子们常在一处。约瑟将他哥哥们的恶行报给他们的父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the account of Jacob’s family line. Joseph, a young man of seventeen, was tending the flocks with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives, and he brought their father a bad report about them.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was pasturing the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. And Joseph brought a bad report of them to their father.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the history of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. And the lad was with the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives; and Joseph brought a bad report of them to his father.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the account of Jacob and his family. When Joseph was seventeen years old, he often tended his father’s flocks. He worked for his half brothers, the sons of his father’s wives Bilhah and Zilpah. But Joseph reported to his father some of the bad things his brothers were doing.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the records of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, when he was seventeen years of age, was pasturing the flock with his brothers, while he was still a youth, along with the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives. And Joseph brought back a bad report about them to their father.
verses.textEn: This is the account of Jacob’s family line. Joseph, a young man of seventeen, was tending the flocks with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives, and he brought their father a bad report about them.

verses.textZh: 以色列爱约瑟过于爱其他的儿子，因为约瑟是他年老时生的。他给约瑟做了一件彩色长衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列爱约瑟过于爱其他的儿子，因为约瑟是他年老时生的。他给约瑟做了一件彩色长衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列原来爱约瑟过于爱他的众子，因为约瑟是他年老生的；他给约瑟做了一件彩衣。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any of his other sons, because he had been born to him in his old age; and he made an ornate robe for him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any other of his sons, because he was the son of his old age. And he made him a robe of many colors.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age. Also he made him a tunic of many colors.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob loved Joseph more than any of his other children because Joseph had been born to him in his old age. So one day Jacob had a special gift made for Joseph—a beautiful robe.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his other sons, because he was the son of his old age; and he made him a multicolored tunic.
verses.textEn: Now Israel loved Joseph more than any of his other sons, because he had been born to him in his old age; and he made an ornate robe for him.

verses.textZh: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲爱约瑟过于爱他们，就恨约瑟，不能与他和和气气地说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲爱约瑟过于爱他们，就恨约瑟，不能与他和和气气地说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲爱约瑟过于爱他们，就恨约瑟，不与他说和睦的话。
verses.textEnNiv: When his brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.
verses.textEnEsv: But when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him and could not speak peacefully to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him and could not speak peaceably to him.
verses.textEnNlt: But his brothers hated Joseph because their father loved him more than the rest of them. They couldn’t say a kind word to him.
verses.textEnNasb: And his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers; and so they hated him and could not speak to him on friendly terms.
verses.textEn: When his brothers saw that their father loved him more than any of them, they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.

verses.textZh: 约瑟作了一个梦，把梦告诉哥哥们，他们就越发恨他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟作了一个梦，把梦告诉哥哥们，他们就越发恨他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟做了一梦，告诉他哥哥们，他们就越发恨他。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him all the more.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers they hated him even more.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joseph had a dream, and he told it to his brothers; and they hated him even more.
verses.textEnNlt: One night Joseph had a dream, and when he told his brothers about it, they hated him more than ever.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him even more.
verses.textEn: Joseph had a dream, and when he told it to his brothers, they hated him all the more.

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他们说："请听我所作的这个梦：
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对他们说："请听我所作的这个梦：
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟对他们说：「请听我所做的梦：
verses.textEnNiv: He said to them, "Listen to this dream I had:
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Hear this dream that I have dreamed:
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to them, "Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:
verses.textEnNlt: "Listen to this dream," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: He said to them, "Please listen to this dream which I have had;
verses.textEn: He said to them, "Listen to this dream I had:

verses.textZh: 我们正在田间捆麦子，我的麦捆忽然站立起来，你们的麦捆都来围着我的下拜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们正在田间捆麦子，我的麦捆忽然站立起来，你们的麦捆都来围着我的下拜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们在田里捆禾稼，我的捆起来站着，你们的捆来围着我的捆下拜。」
verses.textEnNiv: We were binding sheaves of grain out in the field when suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around mine and bowed down to it."
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and stood upright. And behold, your sheaves gathered around it and bowed down to my sheaf."
verses.textEnNkjv: There we were, binding sheaves in the field. Then behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and indeed your sheaves stood all around and bowed down to my sheaf."
verses.textEnNlt: "We were out in the field, tying up bundles of grain. Suddenly my bundle stood up, and your bundles all gathered around and bowed low before mine!"
verses.textEnNasb: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf stood up and also remained standing; and behold, your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to my sheaf."
verses.textEn: We were binding sheaves of grain out in the field when suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around mine and bowed down to it."

verses.textZh: 他的哥哥们对他说："你真的要作我们的王吗？真的要管辖我们吗？"他们就为了约瑟的梦和他的话，越发恨他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的哥哥们对他说："你真的要作我们的王吗？真的要管辖我们吗？"他们就为了约瑟的梦和他的话，越发恨他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的哥哥们回答说：「难道你真要作我们的王吗？难道你真要管辖我们吗？」他们就因为他的梦和他的话越发恨他。
verses.textEnNiv: His brothers said to him, "Do you intend to reign over us? Will you actually rule us?" And they hated him all the more because of his dream and what he had said.
verses.textEnEsv: His brothers said to him, "Are you indeed to reign over us? Or are you indeed to rule over us?" So they hated him even more for his dreams and for his words.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his brothers said to him, "Shall you indeed reign over us? Or shall you indeed have dominion over us?" So they hated him even more for his dreams and for his words.
verses.textEnNlt: His brothers responded, "So you think you will be our king, do you? Do you actually think you will reign over us?" And they hated him all the more because of his dreams and the way he talked about them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then his brothers said to him, "Are you actually going to reign over us? Or are you really going to rule over us?" So they hated him even more for his dreams and for his words.
verses.textEn: His brothers said to him, "Do you intend to reign over us? Will you actually rule us?" And they hated him all the more because of his dream and what he had said.

verses.textZh: 后来约瑟又作了一个梦，也把梦向哥哥们述说了。他说："我又作了一个梦，我梦见太阳、月亮和十一颗星向我下拜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来约瑟又作了一个梦，也把梦向哥哥们述说了。他说："我又作了一个梦，我梦见太阳、月亮和十一颗星向我下拜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 后来他又做了一梦，也告诉他的哥哥们说：「看哪，我又做了一梦，梦见太阳、月亮，与十一个星向我下拜。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he had another dream, and he told it to his brothers. "Listen," he said, "I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me."
verses.textEnEsv: Then he dreamed another dream and told it to his brothers and said, "Behold, I have dreamed another dream. Behold, the sun, the moon, and eleven stars were bowing down to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he dreamed still another dream and told it to his brothers, and said, "Look, I have dreamed another dream. And this time, the sun, the moon, and the eleven stars bowed down to me."
verses.textEnNlt: Soon Joseph had another dream, and again he told his brothers about it. "Listen, I have had another dream," he said. "The sun, moon, and eleven stars bowed low before me!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he had yet another dream, and informed his brothers of it, and said, "Behold, I have had yet another dream; and behold, the sun and the moon, and eleven stars were bowing down to me."
verses.textEn: Then he had another dream, and he told it to his brothers. "Listen," he said, "I had another dream, and this time the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me."

verses.textZh: 约瑟把梦向他父亲和哥哥们述说了，他父亲就斥责他，说："你所作的这梦是甚么梦呢？我和你母亲，以及你的兄弟，真的要来俯伏在地向你下拜吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟把梦向他父亲和哥哥们述说了，他父亲就斥责他，说："你所作的这梦是甚么梦呢？我和你母亲，以及你的兄弟，真的要来俯伏在地向你下拜吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟将这梦告诉他父亲和他哥哥们，他父亲就责备他说：「你做的这是什么梦！难道我和你母亲、你弟兄果然要来俯伏在地，向你下拜吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: When he told his father as well as his brothers, his father rebuked him and said, "What is this dream you had? Will your mother and I and your brothers actually come and bow down to the ground before you?"
verses.textEnEsv: But when he told it to his father and to his brothers, his father rebuked him and said to him, "What is this dream that you have dreamed? Shall I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves to the ground before you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So he told it to his father and his brothers; and his father rebuked him and said to him, "What is this dream that you have dreamed? Shall your mother and I and your brothers indeed come to bow down to the earth before you?"
verses.textEnNlt: This time he told the dream to his father as well as to his brothers, but his father scolded him. "What kind of dream is that?" he asked. "Will your mother and I and your brothers actually come and bow to the ground before you?"
verses.textEnNasb: He also told it to his father as well as to his brothers; and his father rebuked him and said to him, "What is this dream that you have had? Am I and your mother and your brothers actually going to come to bow down to the ground before you?"
verses.textEn: When he told his father as well as his brothers, his father rebuked him and said, "What is this dream you had? Will your mother and I and your brothers actually come and bow down to the ground before you?"

verses.textZh: 他哥哥们都嫉妒他，他父亲却把这事记在心里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他哥哥们都嫉妒他，他父亲却把这事记在心里。
verses.textZhCuv: 他哥哥们都嫉妒他，他父亲却把这话存在心里。
verses.textEnNiv: His brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the matter in mind.
verses.textEnEsv: And his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the saying in mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his brothers envied him, but his father kept the matter inmind.
verses.textEnNlt: But while his brothers were jealous of Joseph, his father wondered what the dreams meant.
verses.textEnNasb: And his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the matter in mind.
verses.textEn: His brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the matter in mind.

verses.textZh: 约瑟的哥哥们去了示剑，牧放他们父亲的羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟的哥哥们去了示剑，牧放他们父亲的羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的哥哥们往示剑去放他们父亲的羊。
verses.textEnNiv: Now his brothers had gone to graze their father’s flocks near Shechem,
verses.textEnEsv: Now his brothers went to pasture their father’s flock near Shechem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.
verses.textEnNlt: Soon after this, Joseph’s brothers went to pasture their father’s flocks at Shechem.
verses.textEnNasb: Then his brothers went to pasture their father’s flock in Shechem.
verses.textEn: Now his brothers had gone to graze their father’s flocks near Shechem,

verses.textZh: 以色列对约瑟说："你的哥哥们不是在示剑牧放羊群吗？来吧，我要派你到他们那里去。"约瑟回答他："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列对约瑟说："你的哥哥们不是在示剑牧放羊群吗？来吧，我要派你到他们那里去。"约瑟回答他："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列对约瑟说：「你哥哥们不是在示剑放羊吗？你来，我要打发你往他们那里去。」约瑟说：「我在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: and Israel said to Joseph, "As you know, your brothers are grazing the flocks near Shechem. Come, I am going to send you to them." "Very well," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And Israel said to Joseph, "Are not your brothers pasturing the flock at Shechem? Come, I will send you to them." And he said to him, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Israel said to Joseph, "Are not your brothers feeding theflock in Shechem? Come, I will send you to them." So he said to him, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNlt: When they had been gone for some time, Jacob said to Joseph, "Your brothers are pasturing the sheep at Shechem. Get ready, and I will send you to them." "I’m ready to go," Joseph replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And Israel said to Joseph, "Are your brothers not pasturing the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them." And he said to him, " I will go."
verses.textEn: and Israel said to Joseph, "As you know, your brothers are grazing the flocks near Shechem. Come, I am going to send you to them." "Very well," he replied.

verses.textZh: 以色列对他说："你去看看你的哥哥们是不是平安，羊群是不是平安，就回来告诉我。"于是打发他离开希伯仑谷，他就到示剑去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列对他说："你去看看你的哥哥们是不是平安，羊群是不是平安，就回来告诉我。"于是打发他离开希伯仑谷，他就到示剑去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列说：「你去看看你哥哥们平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回来报信给我。」于是打发他出希伯仑谷，他就往示剑去了。

verses.textEnEsv: So he said to him, "Go now, see if it is well with your brothers and with the flock, and bring me word." So he sent him from the Valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to him, "Please go and see if it is well with your brothers and well with the flocks, and bring back word to me." So he sent him out of the Valley of Hebron, and he went to Shechem.
verses.textEnNlt: "Go and see how your brothers and the flocks are getting along," Jacob said. "Then come back and bring me a report." So Jacob sent him on his way, and Joseph traveled to Shechem from their home in the valley of Hebron.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to him, "Go now and see about the welfare of your brothers and the welfare of the flock, and bring word back to me." So he sent him from the Valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

verses.textZh: 有人遇见约瑟在田间迷了路，就问他说："你找甚么？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人遇见约瑟在田间迷了路，就问他说："你找甚么？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人遇见他在田野走迷了路，就问他说：「你找什么？」
verses.textEnNiv: a man found him wandering around in the fields and asked him, "What are you looking for?"
verses.textEnEsv: And a man found him wandering in the fields. And the man asked him, "What are you seeking?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now a certain man found him, and there he was, wandering in the field. And the man asked him, saying, "What are you seeking?"
verses.textEnNlt: When he arrived there, a man from the area noticed him wandering around the countryside. "What are you looking for?" he asked.
verses.textEnNasb: A man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field; and the man asked him, " What are you looking for?"
verses.textEn: a man found him wandering around in the fields and asked him, "What are you looking for?"

verses.textZh: 他回答："我正在找我的哥哥们，请你告诉我他们在哪里牧放羊群。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："我正在找我的哥哥们，请你告诉我他们在哪里牧放羊群。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「我找我的哥哥们，求你告诉我，他们在何处放羊。」
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "I’m looking for my brothers. Can you tell me where they are grazing their flocks?"
verses.textEnEsv: "I am seeking my brothers," he said. "Tell me, please, where they are pasturing the flock."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said, "I am seeking my brothers. Please tell me where they are feeding theirflocks."
verses.textEnNlt: "I’m looking for my brothers," Joseph replied. "Do you know where they are pasturing their sheep?"
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "I am looking for my brothers; please tell me where they are pasturing the flock."
verses.textEn: He replied, "I’m looking for my brothers. Can you tell me where they are grazing their flocks?"

verses.textZh: 那人说："他们已经离开了这里；我听见他们说：‘我们要到多坍去。’"于是约瑟去追寻哥哥们，结果在多坍找到了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人说："他们已经离开了这里；我听见他们说：‘我们要到多坍去。’"于是约瑟去追寻哥哥们，结果在多坍找到了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 那人说：「他们已经走了，我听见他们说要往多坍去。」约瑟就去追赶他哥哥们，遇见他们在多坍。
verses.textEnNiv: "They have moved on from here," the man answered. "I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’ " So Joseph went after his brothers and found them near Dothan.
verses.textEnEsv: And the man said, "They have gone away, for I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’" So Joseph went after his brothers and found them at Dothan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the man said, "They have departed from here, for I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’ " So Joseph went after his brothers and found them in Dothan.
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," the man told him. "They have moved on from here, but I heard them say, ‘Let’s go on to Dothan.’" So Joseph followed his brothers to Dothan and found them there.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the man said, "They have moved from here; for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’ " So Joseph went after his brothers and found them at Dothan.
verses.textEn: "They have moved on from here," the man answered. "I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’ " So Joseph went after his brothers and found them near Dothan.

verses.textZh: 他们远远就看见了他；趁他还没有走近，大家就谋害他，要把他杀死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们远远就看见了他；趁他还没有走近，大家就谋害他，要把他杀死。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们远远地看见他，趁他还没有走到跟前，大家就同谋要害死他，
verses.textEnNiv: But they saw him in the distance, and before he reached them, they plotted to kill him.
verses.textEnEsv: They saw him from afar, and before he came near to them they conspired against him to kill him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they saw him afar off, even before he came near them, they conspired against him to kill him.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joseph’s brothers saw him coming, they recognized him in the distance. As he approached, they made plans to kill him.
verses.textEnNasb: When they saw him from a distance, and before he came closer to them, they plotted against him to put him to death.
verses.textEn: But they saw him in the distance, and before he reached them, they plotted to kill him.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此说："看哪，那作梦的人来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此说："看哪，那作梦的人来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 彼此说：「你看！那做梦的来了。
verses.textEnNiv: "Here comes that dreamer!" they said to each other.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to one another, "Here comes this dreamer.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to one another, "Look, this dreamer is coming!
verses.textEnNlt: "Here comes the dreamer!" they said.
verses.textEnNasb: They said to one another, " Here comes this dreamer!
verses.textEn: "Here comes that dreamer!" they said to each other.

verses.textZh: 来吧，我们把他杀了，丢在一个枯井里，就说有猛兽把他吃了。我们要看看他的梦将来要怎么样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 来吧，我们把他杀了，丢在一个枯井里，就说有猛兽把他吃了。我们要看看他的梦将来要怎么样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 来吧！我们将他杀了，丢在一个坑里，就说有恶兽把他吃了。我们且看他的梦将来怎么样。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Come now, let’s kill him and throw him into one of these cisterns and say that a ferocious animal devoured him. Then we’ll see what comes of his dreams."
verses.textEnEsv: Come now, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits. Then we will say that a fierce animal has devoured him, and we will see what will become of his dreams."
verses.textEnNkjv: Come therefore, let us now kill him and cast him into some pit; and we shall say, ‘Some wild beast has devoured him.’ We shall see what will become of his dreams!"
verses.textEnNlt: "Come on, let’s kill him and throw him into one of these cisterns. We can tell our father, ‘A wild animal has eaten him.’ Then we’ll see what becomes of his dreams!"
verses.textEnNasb: Now then, come and let’s kill him, and throw him into one of the pits; and we will say, ‘A vicious animal devoured him.’ Then we will see what will become of his dreams!"
verses.textEn: "Come now, let’s kill him and throw him into one of these cisterns and say that a ferocious animal devoured him. Then we’ll see what comes of his dreams."

verses.textZh: 流本听见了，要救约瑟脱离他们的手。他说："我们不可取他的性命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本听见了，要救约瑟脱离他们的手。他说："我们不可取他的性命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便听见了，要救他脱离他们的手，说：「我们不可害他的性命」；
verses.textEnNiv: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue him from their hands. "Let’s not take his life," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: But when Reuben heard it, he rescued him out of their hands, saying, "Let us not take his life."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands, and said, "Let us not kill him."
verses.textEnNlt: But when Reuben heard of their scheme, he came to Joseph’s rescue. "Let’s not kill him," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: But Reuben heard this and rescued him out of their hands by saying, "Let’s not take his life."
verses.textEn: When Reuben heard this, he tried to rescue him from their hands. "Let’s not take his life," he said.

verses.textZh: 流本又对他们说："不可流他的血，可以把他丢在这旷野的枯井里，不可下手害他。"流本的意思是要救他脱离他们的手，把他带回去给他的父亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本又对他们说："不可流他的血，可以把他丢在这旷野的枯井里，不可下手害他。"流本的意思是要救他脱离他们的手，把他带回去给他的父亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「不可流他的血，可以把他丢在这野地的坑里，不可下手害他。」吕便的意思是要救他脱离他们的手，把他归还他的父亲。
verses.textEnNiv: "Don’t shed any blood. Throw him into this cistern here in the wilderness, but don’t lay a hand on him." Reuben said this to rescue him from them and take him back to his father.
verses.textEnEsv: And Reuben said to them, "Shed no blood; throw him into this pit here in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him"— that he might rescue him out of their hand to restore him to his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Reuben said to them, "Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit which is in the wilderness, and do not lay a hand on him"—that he might deliver him out of their hands, and bring him back to his father.
verses.textEnNlt: "Why should we shed any blood? Let’s just throw him into this empty cistern here in the wilderness. Then he’ll die without our laying a hand on him." Reuben was secretly planning to rescue Joseph and return him to his father.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Reuben said to them, "Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him"—so that later he might rescue him out of their hands, to return him to his father.
verses.textEn: "Don’t shed any blood. Throw him into this cistern here in the wilderness, but don’t lay a hand on him." Reuben said this to rescue him from them and take him back to his father.

verses.textZh: 约瑟到了哥哥们那里，他们就脱去他的外衣，就是他穿在身上的那件彩衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟到了哥哥们那里，他们就脱去他的外衣，就是他穿在身上的那件彩衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟到了他哥哥们那里，他们就剥了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，
verses.textEnNiv: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe—the ornate robe he was wearing—
verses.textEnEsv: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe, the robe of many colors that he wore.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it came to pass, when Joseph had come to his brothers, that they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him.
verses.textEnNlt: So when Joseph arrived, his brothers ripped off the beautiful robe he was wearing.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about, when Joseph reached his brothers, that they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the multicolored tunic that was on him;
verses.textEn: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his robe—the ornate robe he was wearing—

verses.textZh: 他们拿住约瑟，把他丢在枯井里。那井是空的，里面没有水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们拿住约瑟，把他丢在枯井里。那井是空的，里面没有水。
verses.textZhCuv: 把他丢在坑里；那坑是空的，里头没有水。
verses.textEnNiv: and they took him and threw him into the cistern. The cistern was empty; there was no water in it.
verses.textEnEsv: And they took him and threw him into a pit. The pit was empty; there was no water in it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they took him and cast him into a pit. And the pit was empty; therewas no water in it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then they grabbed him and threw him into the cistern. Now the cistern was empty; there was no water in it.
verses.textEnNasb: and they took him and threw him into the pit. Now the pit was empty, without any water in it.
verses.textEn: and they took him and threw him into the cistern. The cistern was empty; there was no water in it.

verses.textZh: 他们坐下吃饭，举目观看，见有一群以实玛利人从基列来。他们的骆驼载着香料、乳香和没药，要带下埃及去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们坐下吃饭，举目观看，见有一群以实玛利人从基列来。他们的骆驼载着香料、乳香和没药，要带下埃及去。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们坐下吃饭，举目观看，见有一伙米甸的以实玛利人从基列来，用骆驼驮着香料、乳香、没药，要带下埃及去。
verses.textEnNiv: As they sat down to eat their meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were loaded with spices, balm and myrrh, and they were on their way to take them down to Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they sat down to eat. And looking up they saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing gum, balm, and myrrh, on their way to carry it down to Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they sat down to eat a meal. Then they lifted their eyes and looked, and there was a company of Ishmaelites, coming from Gilead with their camels, bearing spices, balm, and myrrh, on their way to carry them down to Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, just as they were sitting down to eat, they looked up and saw a caravan of camels in the distance coming toward them. It was a group of Ishmaelite traders taking a load of gum, balm, and aromatic resin from Gilead down to Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they sat down to eat a meal. But as they raised their eyes and looked, behold, a caravan of Ishmaelites was coming from Gilead, with their camels carrying labdanum resin, balsam, and myrrh, on their way to bring them down to Egypt.
verses.textEn: As they sat down to eat their meal, they looked up and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead. Their camels were loaded with spices, balm and myrrh, and they were on their way to take them down to Egypt.

verses.textZh: 犹大对他的众兄弟说："我们杀了我们的兄弟，把他的血隐藏起来，究竟有甚么益处呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大对他的众兄弟说："我们杀了我们的兄弟，把他的血隐藏起来，究竟有甚么益处呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大对众弟兄说：「我们杀我们的兄弟，藏了他的血有什么益处呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Judah said to his brothers, "What will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?
verses.textEnEsv: Then Judah said to his brothers, "What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
verses.textEnNkjv: So Judah said to his brothers, "What profit isthere if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?
verses.textEnNlt: Judah said to his brothers, "What will we gain by killing our brother? We’d have to cover up the crime.
verses.textEnNasb: And Judah said to his brothers, "What profit is it for us to kill our brother and cover up his blood?
verses.textEn: Judah said to his brothers, "What will we gain if we kill our brother and cover up his blood?

verses.textZh: 我们不如把他卖给以实玛利人，不要下手害他，因为他是我们的兄弟，我们的骨肉。"众兄弟就听从了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们不如把他卖给以实玛利人，不要下手害他，因为他是我们的兄弟，我们的骨肉。"众兄弟就听从了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们不如将他卖给以实玛利人，不可下手害他；因为他是我们的兄弟，我们的骨肉。」众弟兄就听从了他。
verses.textEnNiv: Come, let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay our hands on him; after all, he is our brother, our own flesh and blood." His brothers agreed.
verses.textEnEsv: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him, for he is our brother, our own flesh." And his brothers listened to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come and let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him, for he is our brother and our flesh." And his brothers listened.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead of hurting him, let’s sell him to those Ishmaelite traders. After all, he is our brother—our own flesh and blood!" And his brothers agreed.
verses.textEnNasb: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay our hands on him, for he is our brother, our own flesh." And his brothers listened to him.
verses.textEn: Come, let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites and not lay our hands on him; after all, he is our brother, our own flesh and blood." His brothers agreed.

verses.textZh: 有些米甸的商人经过那里，约瑟的哥哥们就把约瑟从枯井里拉上来，以二十块银子把他卖给以实玛利人。以实玛利人就把约瑟带到埃及去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有些米甸的商人经过那里，约瑟的哥哥们就把约瑟从枯井里拉上来，以二十块银子把他卖给以实玛利人。以实玛利人就把约瑟带到埃及去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有些米甸的商人从那里经过，哥哥们就把约瑟从坑里拉上来，讲定二十舍客勒银子，把约瑟卖给以实玛利人。他们就把约瑟带到埃及去了。
verses.textEnNiv: So when the Midianite merchants came by, his brothers pulled Joseph up out of the cistern and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Midianite traders passed by. And they drew Joseph up and lifted him out of the pit, and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver. They took Joseph to Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Midianite traders passed by; so thebrothers pulled Joseph up and lifted him out of the pit, and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver. And they took Joseph to Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So when the Ishmaelites, who were Midianite traders, came by, Joseph’s brothers pulled him out of the cistern and sold him to them for twenty pieces of silver. And the traders took him to Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then some Midianite traders passed by, so they pulled him out and lifted Joseph out of the pit, and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver. So they brought Joseph into Egypt.
verses.textEn: So when the Midianite merchants came by, his brothers pulled Joseph up out of the cistern and sold him for twenty shekels of silver to the Ishmaelites, who took him to Egypt.

verses.textZh: 流本回到枯井那里，见约瑟不在井里，就撕裂自己的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本回到枯井那里，见约瑟不在井里，就撕裂自己的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便回到坑边，见约瑟不在坑里，就撕裂衣服，
verses.textEnNiv: When Reuben returned to the cistern and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: When Reuben returned to the pit and saw that Joseph was not in the pit, he tore his clothes
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Reuben returned to the pit, and indeed Joseph was not in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later, Reuben returned to get Joseph out of the cistern. When he discovered that Joseph was missing, he tore his clothes in grief.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Reuben returned to the pit, and behold, Joseph was not in the pit; so he tore his garments.
verses.textEn: When Reuben returned to the cistern and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes.

verses.textZh: 他回到兄弟们那里去，说："孩子不见了，我可到哪里去呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回到兄弟们那里去，说："孩子不见了，我可到哪里去呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 回到兄弟们那里，说：「童子没有了。我往哪里去才好呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: He went back to his brothers and said, "The boy isn’t there! Where can I turn now?"
verses.textEnEsv: and returned to his brothers and said, "The boy is gone, and I, where shall I go?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he returned to his brothers and said, "The lad is no more; and I, where shall I go?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then he went back to his brothers and lamented, "The boy is gone! What will I do now?"
verses.textEnNasb: He returned to his brothers and said, "The boy is not there; as for me, where am I to go?"
verses.textEn: He went back to his brothers and said, "The boy isn’t there! Where can I turn now?"

verses.textZh: 于是，他们宰了一只公山羊，把约瑟的长衣蘸在血里；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，他们宰了一只公山羊，把约瑟的长衣蘸在血里；
verses.textZhCuv: 他们宰了一只公山羊，把约瑟的那件彩衣染了血，
verses.textEnNiv: Then they got Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they took Joseph’s robe and slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took Joseph’s tunic, killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the tunic in the blood.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the brothers killed a young goat and dipped Joseph’s robe in its blood.
verses.textEnNasb: So they took Joseph’s tunic, and slaughtered a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood;
verses.textEn: Then they got Joseph’s robe, slaughtered a goat and dipped the robe in the blood.

verses.textZh: 然后打发人把彩衣送到他们父亲那里，说："这是我们找到的。请你认一认，是你儿子的长衣不是？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后打发人把彩衣送到他们父亲那里，说："这是我们找到的。请你认一认，是你儿子的长衣不是？"
verses.textZhCuv: 打发人送到他们的父亲那里，说：「我们捡了这个；请认一认是你儿子的外衣不是？」
verses.textEnNiv: They took the ornate robe back to their father and said, "We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son’s robe."
verses.textEnEsv: And they sent the robe of many colors and brought it to their father and said, "This we have found; please identify whether it is your son’s robe or not."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they sent the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father and said, "We have found this. Do you know whether it is your son’s tunic or not?"
verses.textEnNlt: They sent the beautiful robe to their father with this message: "Look at what we found. Doesn’t this robe belong to your son?"
verses.textEnNasb: and they sent the multicolored tunic and brought it to their father and said, "We found this; please examine it to see whether it is your son’s tunic or not."
verses.textEn: They took the ornate robe back to their father and said, "We found this. Examine it to see whether it is your son’s robe."

verses.textZh: 他认出这件长衣，就说："是我儿子的长衣，有猛兽把他吃了。约瑟真的被撕碎了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他认出这件长衣，就说："是我儿子的长衣，有猛兽把他吃了。约瑟真的被撕碎了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他认得，就说：「这是我儿子的外衣。有恶兽把他吃了，约瑟被撕碎了！撕碎了！」
verses.textEnNiv: He recognized it and said, "It is my son’s robe! Some ferocious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces."
verses.textEnEsv: And he identified it and said, "It is my son’s robe. A fierce animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn to pieces."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he recognized it and said, "Itis my son’s tunic. A wild beast has devoured him. Without doubt Joseph is torn to pieces."
verses.textEnNlt: Their father recognized it immediately. "Yes," he said, "it is my son’s robe. A wild animal must have eaten him. Joseph has clearly been torn to pieces!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then he examined it and said, "It is my son’s tunic. A vicious animal has devoured him; Joseph has surely been torn to pieces!"
verses.textEn: He recognized it and said, "It is my son’s robe! Some ferocious animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces."

verses.textZh: 雅各就撕裂自己的衣服，腰束麻布，为他儿子哀悼了很多日子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各就撕裂自己的衣服，腰束麻布，为他儿子哀悼了很多日子。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各便撕裂衣服，腰间围上麻布，为他儿子悲哀了多日。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and mourned for his son many days.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob tore his garments and put sackcloth on his loins and mourned for his son many days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob tore his clothes and dressed himself in burlap. He mourned deeply for his son for a long time.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob tore his clothes, and put on a sackcloth undergarment over his waist, and mourned for his son many days.
verses.textEn: Then Jacob tore his clothes, put on sackcloth and mourned for his son many days.

verses.textZh: 他所有的儿女都起来安慰他，他却不肯接受他们的安慰，说："我要悲悲哀哀地下到阴间，到我的儿子那里去。"约瑟的父亲就为他哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他所有的儿女都起来安慰他，他却不肯接受他们的安慰，说："我要悲悲哀哀地下到阴间，到我的儿子那里去。"约瑟的父亲就为他哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的儿女都起来安慰他，他却不肯受安慰，说：「我必悲哀着下阴间，到我儿子那里。」约瑟的父亲就为他哀哭。
verses.textEnNiv: All his sons and daughters came to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. "No," he said, "I will continue to mourn until I join my son in the grave." So his father wept for him.
verses.textEnEsv: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted and said, "No, I shall go down to Sheol to my son, mourning." Thus his father wept for him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And all his sons and all his daughters arose to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted, and he said, "For I shall go down into the grave to my son in mourning." Thus his father wept for him.
verses.textEnNlt: His family all tried to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. "I will go to my grave mourning for my son," he would say, and then he would weep.
verses.textEnNasb: Then all his sons and all his daughters got up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. And he said, "Surely I will go down to Sheol in mourning for my son." So his father wept for him.
verses.textEn: All his sons and daughters came to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. "No," he said, "I will continue to mourn until I join my son in the grave." So his father wept for him.

verses.textZh: 米甸人后来把约瑟卖到埃及去，卖给法老的一个臣宰，军长波提乏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 米甸人后来把约瑟卖到埃及去，卖给法老的一个臣宰，军长波提乏。
verses.textZhCuv: 米甸人带约瑟到埃及，把他卖给法老的内臣－护卫长波提乏。
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard.
verses.textEnEsv: Meanwhile the Midianites had sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, the captain of the guard.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Midianites had sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh and captain of the guard.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the Midianite traders arrived in Egypt, where they sold Joseph to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. Potiphar was captain of the palace guard.
verses.textEnNasb: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, Pharaoh’s officer, the captain of the bodyguard.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard.

verses.textZh: 那时，犹大离开他的众兄弟下去，到一个亚杜兰人的家里居住，那人名叫希拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，犹大离开他的众兄弟下去，到一个亚杜兰人的家里居住，那人名叫希拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，犹大离开他弟兄下去，到一个亚杜兰人名叫希拉的家里去。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time, Judah left his brothers and went down to stay with a man of Adullam named Hirah.
verses.textEnEsv: It happened at that time that Judah went down from his brothers and turned aside to a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.textEnNkjv: It came to pass at that time that Judah departed from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite whose name was Hirah.
verses.textEnNlt: About this time, Judah left home and moved to Adullam, where he stayed with a man named Hirah.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about at that time, that Judah departed from his brothers and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.
verses.textEn: At that time, Judah left his brothers and went down to stay with a man of Adullam named Hirah.

verses.textZh: 犹大在那里看见迦南人书亚的女儿，就娶了她，与她亲近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大在那里看见迦南人书亚的女儿，就娶了她，与她亲近。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大在那里看见一个迦南人名叫书亚的女儿，就娶她为妻，与她同房，
verses.textEnNiv: There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and made love to her;
verses.textEnEsv: There Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua. He took her and went in to her,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua, and he married her and went in to her.
verses.textEnNlt: There he saw a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua, and he married her. When he slept with her,
verses.textEnNasb: Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite whose name was Shua; and he took her as a wife and had relations with her.
verses.textEn: There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and made love to her;

verses.textZh: 她就怀了孕，生了一个儿子，犹大给他起名叫珥。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她就怀了孕，生了一个儿子，犹大给他起名叫珥。
verses.textZhCuv: 她就怀孕生了儿子，犹大给他起名叫珥。
verses.textEnNiv: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, who was named Er.
verses.textEnEsv: and she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Er.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she conceived and bore a son, and he called his name Er.
verses.textEnNlt: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, and he named the boy Er.
verses.textEnNasb: And she conceived and gave birth to a son, and he named him Er.
verses.textEn: she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, who was named Er.

verses.textZh: 她又怀孕，生了一个儿子，给他起名叫俄南。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她又怀孕，生了一个儿子，给他起名叫俄南。
verses.textZhCuv: 她又怀孕生了儿子，母亲给他起名叫俄南。
verses.textEnNiv: She conceived again and gave birth to a son and named him Onan.
verses.textEnEsv: She conceived again and bore a son, and she called his name Onan.
verses.textEnNkjv: She conceived again and bore a son, and she called his name Onan.
verses.textEnNlt: Then she became pregnant again and gave birth to another son, and she named him Onan.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she conceived again and gave birth to a son, and she named him Onan.
verses.textEn: She conceived again and gave birth to a son and named him Onan.

verses.textZh: 她再怀孕，又生了一个儿子，就给他起名叫示拉。她生示拉的时候，犹大正在基悉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她再怀孕，又生了一个儿子，就给他起名叫示拉。她生示拉的时候，犹大正在基悉。
verses.textZhCuv: 她复又生了儿子，给他起名叫示拉。她生示拉的时候，犹大正在基悉。
verses.textEnNiv: She gave birth to still another son and named him Shelah. It was at Kezib that she gave birth to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet again she bore a son, and she called his name Shelah. Judah was in Chezib when she bore him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And she conceived yet again and bore a son, and called his name Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.
verses.textEnNlt: And when she gave birth to a third son, she named him Shelah. At the time of Shelah’s birth, they were living at Kezib.
verses.textEnNasb: She gave birth to yet another son and named him Shelah; and it was at Chezib that she gave birth to him.
verses.textEn: She gave birth to still another son and named him Shelah. It was at Kezib that she gave birth to him.

verses.textZh: 犹大为自己的长子珥娶妻，名叫他玛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大为自己的长子珥娶妻，名叫他玛。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大为长子珥娶妻，名叫她玛。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah got a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
verses.textEnNlt: In the course of time, Judah arranged for his firstborn son, Er, to marry a young woman named Tamar.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
verses.textEn: Judah got a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

verses.textZh: 犹大的长子珥，在耶和华眼中是个恶人，所以耶和华取去他的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的长子珥，在耶和华眼中是个恶人，所以耶和华取去他的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就叫他死了。
verses.textEnNiv: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.
verses.textEnEsv: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord , and the Lord put him to death.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the sight of the Lord, and the Lord killed him.
verses.textEnNlt: But Er was a wicked man in the Lord ’s sight, so the Lord took his life.
verses.textEnNasb: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was evil in the sight of the Lord, so the Lord took his life.
verses.textEn: But Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death.

verses.textZh: 于是犹大对俄南说："你去与你哥哥的妻子亲近，向她尽你作弟弟的本分，替你的哥哥立后。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是犹大对俄南说："你去与你哥哥的妻子亲近，向她尽你作弟弟的本分，替你的哥哥立后。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大对俄南说：「你当与你哥哥的妻子同房，向她尽你为弟的本分，为你哥哥生子立后。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Judah said to Onan, "Sleep with your brother’s wife and fulfill your duty to her as a brother-in-law to raise up offspring for your brother."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Judah said to Onan, "Go in to your brother’s wife and perform the duty of a brother-in-law to her, and raise up offspring for your brother."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Judah said to Onan, "Go in to your brother’s wife and marry her, and raise up an heir to your brother."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Judah said to Er’s brother Onan, "Go and marry Tamar, as our law requires of the brother of a man who has died. You must produce an heir for your brother."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Judah said to Onan, "Have relations with your brother’s wife and perform your duty as a brother-in-law to her, and raise up a child for your brother."
verses.textEn: Then Judah said to Onan, "Sleep with your brother’s wife and fulfill your duty to her as a brother-in-law to raise up offspring for your brother."

verses.textZh: 俄南知道生下来的孩子不会归自己，所以每次与哥哥的妻子亲近的时候，都遗精在地上，免得替自己的哥哥立后。
verses.textZhCnvs: 俄南知道生下来的孩子不会归自己，所以每次与哥哥的妻子亲近的时候，都遗精在地上，免得替自己的哥哥立后。
verses.textZhCuv: 俄南知道生子不归自己，所以同房的时候便遗在地，免得给他哥哥留后。
verses.textEnNiv: But Onan knew that the child would not be his; so whenever he slept with his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground to keep from providing offspring for his brother.
verses.textEnEsv: But Onan knew that the offspring would not be his. So whenever he went in to his brother’s wife he would waste the semen on the ground, so as not to give offspring to his brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Onan knew that the heir would not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in to his brother’s wife, that he emitted on the ground, lest he should give an heir to his brother.
verses.textEnNlt: But Onan was not willing to have a child who would not be his own heir. So whenever he had intercourse with his brother’s wife, he spilled the semen on the ground. This prevented her from having a child who would belong to his brother.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Onan knew that the child would not be his; so when he had relations with his brother’s wife, he wasted his seed on the ground so that he would not give a child to his brother.
verses.textEn: But Onan knew that the child would not be his; so whenever he slept with his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground to keep from providing offspring for his brother.

verses.textZh: 俄南所作的，在耶和华眼中是件恶事，所以耶和华也取去他的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 俄南所作的，在耶和华眼中是件恶事，所以耶和华也取去他的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 俄南所做的在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华也就叫他死了。
verses.textEnNiv: What he did was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death also.
verses.textEnEsv: And what he did was wicked in the sight of the Lord , and he put him to death also.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the thing which he did displeased the Lord; therefore He killed him also.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord considered it evil for Onan to deny a child to his dead brother. So the Lord took Onan’s life, too.
verses.textEnNasb: But what he did was displeasing in the sight of the Lord; so He took his life also.
verses.textEn: What he did was wicked in the Lord ’s sight; so the Lord put him to death also.

verses.textZh: 于是，犹大对他的媳妇他玛说："你回到你父亲家里去守寡，等我的儿子示拉长大。"因为他心里想："恐怕示拉也像他两个哥哥一样死去。"他玛就回去，住在她父亲的家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，犹大对他的媳妇他玛说："你回到你父亲家里去守寡，等我的儿子示拉长大。"因为他心里想："恐怕示拉也像他两个哥哥一样死去。"他玛就回去，住在她父亲的家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大心里说：「恐怕示拉也死，像他两个哥哥一样」，就对他儿妇她玛说：「你去，在你父亲家里守寡，等我儿子示拉长大。」她玛就回去，住在她父亲家里。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah then said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, "Live as a widow in your father’s household until my son Shelah grows up." For he thought, "He may die too, just like his brothers." So Tamar went to live in her father’s household.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Judah said to Tamar his daughter-in-law, "Remain a widow in your father’s house, till Shelah my son grows up"—for he feared that he would die, like his brothers. So Tamar went and remained in her father’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judah said to Tamar his daughter-in-law, "Remain a widow in your father’s house till my son Shelah is grown." For he said, "Lest he also die like his brothers." And Tamar went and dwelt in her father’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, "Go back to your parents’ home and remain a widow until my son Shelah is old enough to marry you." (But Judah didn’t really intend to do this because he was afraid Shelah would also die, like his two brothers.) So Tamar went back to live in her father’s home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, "Remain a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up"; for he thought, "I am afraid that he too may die like his brothers." So Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
verses.textEn: Judah then said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, "Live as a widow in your father’s household until my son Shelah grows up." For he thought, "He may die too, just like his brothers." So Tamar went to live in her father’s household.

verses.textZh: 过了很多日子，犹大的妻子，书亚的女儿死了。守丧的时间过了以后，犹大就和他的朋友亚杜兰人希拉上亭拿去，到替他羊群剪毛的人那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了很多日子，犹大的妻子，书亚的女儿死了。守丧的时间过了以后，犹大就和他的朋友亚杜兰人希拉上亭拿去，到替他羊群剪毛的人那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了许久，犹大的妻子书亚的女儿死了。犹大得了安慰，就和他朋友亚杜兰人希拉上亭拿去，到他剪羊毛的人那里。
verses.textEnNiv: After a long time Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had recovered from his grief, he went up to Timnah, to the men who were shearing his sheep, and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went with him.
verses.textEnEsv: In the course of time the wife of Judah, Shua’s daughter, died. When Judah was comforted, he went up to Timnah to his sheepshearers, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the process of time the daughter of Shua, Judah’s wife, died; and Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.textEnNlt: Some years later Judah’s wife died. After the time of mourning was over, Judah and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went up to Timnah to supervise the shearing of his sheep.
verses.textEnNasb: Now after a considerable time Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died; and when the time of mourning was ended, Judah went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah, he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.textEn: After a long time Judah’s wife, the daughter of Shua, died. When Judah had recovered from his grief, he went up to Timnah, to the men who were shearing his sheep, and his friend Hirah the Adullamite went with him.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉他玛说："你的公公现在上亭拿去剪羊毛。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉他玛说："你的公公现在上亭拿去剪羊毛。"
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉她玛说：「你的公公上亭拿剪羊毛去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Tamar was told, "Your father-in-law is on his way to Timnah to shear his sheep,"
verses.textEnEsv: And when Tamar was told, "Your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep,"
verses.textEnNkjv: And it was told Tamar, saying, "Look, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep."
verses.textEnNlt: Someone told Tamar, "Look, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep."
verses.textEnNasb: And Tamar was told, "Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep."
verses.textEn: When Tamar was told, "Your father-in-law is on his way to Timnah to shear his sheep,"

verses.textZh: 他玛见示拉已经长大了，还没有娶她为妻，就脱去守寡的衣服，用帕子蒙脸，遮蔽自己，坐在亭拿路上，伊拿印的城门口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他玛见示拉已经长大了，还没有娶她为妻，就脱去守寡的衣服，用帕子蒙脸，遮蔽自己，坐在亭拿路上，伊拿印的城门口。
verses.textZhCuv: 她玛见示拉已经长大，还没有娶她为妻，就脱了她作寡妇的衣裳，用帕子蒙着脸，又遮住身体，坐在亭拿路上的伊拿印城门口。
verses.textEnNiv: she took off her widow’s clothes, covered herself with a veil to disguise herself, and then sat down at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah. For she saw that, though Shelah had now grown up, she had not been given to him as his wife.
verses.textEnEsv: she took off her widow’s garments and covered herself with a veil, wrapping herself up, and sat at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah. For she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she had not been given to him in marriage.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she took off her widow’s garments, covered herself with a veil and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place which was on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given to him as a wife.
verses.textEnNlt: Tamar was aware that Shelah had grown up, but no arrangements had been made for her to come and marry him. So she changed out of her widow’s clothing and covered herself with a veil to disguise herself. Then she sat beside the road at the entrance to the village of Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah.
verses.textEnNasb: So she removed her widow’s garments and covered herself with a veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gateway of Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah had grown up, and she had not been given to him as a wife.
verses.textEn: she took off her widow’s clothes, covered herself with a veil to disguise herself, and then sat down at the entrance to Enaim, which is on the road to Timnah. For she saw that, though Shelah had now grown up, she had not been given to him as his wife.

verses.textZh: 犹大看见她，以为她是个妓女，因为她蒙着脸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大看见她，以为她是个妓女，因为她蒙着脸。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大看见她，以为是妓女，因为她蒙着脸。
verses.textEnNiv: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
verses.textEnEsv: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
verses.textEnNkjv: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a harlot, because she had covered her face.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah noticed her and thought she was a prostitute, since she had covered her face.
verses.textEnNasb: When Judah saw her, he assumed she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.
verses.textEn: When Judah saw her, he thought she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

verses.textZh: 犹大就过到她那边去，说："来吧，让我与你亲近。"原来他不知道她就是自己的媳妇。他玛说："你与我亲近要给我甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大就过到她那边去，说："来吧，让我与你亲近。"原来他不知道她就是自己的媳妇。他玛说："你与我亲近要给我甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大就转到她那里去，说：「来吧！让我与你同寝。」他原不知道是他的儿妇。她玛说：「你要与我同寝，把什么给我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her by the roadside and said, "Come now, let me sleep with you." "And what will you give me to sleep with you?" she asked.
verses.textEnEsv: He turned to her at the roadside and said, "Come, let me come in to you," for he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, "What will you give me, that you may come in to me?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he turned to her by the way, and said, "Please let me come in to you"; for he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. So she said, "What will you give me, that you may come in to me?"
verses.textEnNlt: So he stopped and propositioned her. "Let me have sex with you," he said, not realizing that she was his own daughter-in-law. "How much will you pay to have sex with me?" Tamar asked.
verses.textEnNasb: So he turned aside to her by the road, and said, " Here now, let me have relations with you"; for he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, "What will you give me, that you may have relations with me?"
verses.textEn: Not realizing that she was his daughter-in-law, he went over to her by the roadside and said, "Come now, let me sleep with you." "And what will you give me to sleep with you?" she asked.

verses.textZh: 犹大说："我从羊群中拿一只小山羊送给你。"他玛说："在你没有送来以前，你可以留些东西作为保证吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大说："我从羊群中拿一只小山羊送给你。"他玛说："在你没有送来以前，你可以留些东西作为保证吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大说：「我从羊群里取一只山羊羔，打发人送来给你。」她玛说：「在未送以先，你愿意给我一个当头吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: "I’ll send you a young goat from my flock," he said. "Will you give me something as a pledge until you send it?" she asked.
verses.textEnEsv: He answered, "I will send you a young goat from the flock." And she said, "If you give me a pledge, until you send it—"
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "I will send a young goat from the flock." So she said, "Will you give me a pledge till you send it?"
verses.textEnNlt: "I’ll send you a young goat from my flock," Judah promised. "But what will you give me to guarantee that you will send the goat?" she asked.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, therefore, "I will send you a young goat from the flock." She then said, "Will you give a pledge until you send it?"
verses.textEn: "I’ll send you a young goat from my flock," he said. "Will you give me something as a pledge until you send it?" she asked.

verses.textZh: 犹大问："你要我给你甚么作保证呢？"他玛回答："你的印戒，连同印的带子，以及你手里的杖。"犹大就给了她，与她亲近，她就从犹大怀了孕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大问："你要我给你甚么作保证呢？"他玛回答："你的印戒，连同印的带子，以及你手里的杖。"犹大就给了她，与她亲近，她就从犹大怀了孕。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「我给你什么当头呢？」她玛说：「你的印、你的带子，和你手里的杖。」犹大就给了她，与她同寝，她就从犹大怀了孕。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "What pledge should I give you?" "Your seal and its cord, and the staff in your hand," she answered. So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "What pledge shall I give you?" She replied, "Your signet and your cord and your staff that is in your hand." So he gave them to her and went in to her, and she conceived by him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "What pledge shall I give you?" So she said, "Your signet and cord, and your staff that is in your hand." Then he gave them to her, and went in to her, and she conceived by him.
verses.textEnNlt: "What kind of guarantee do you want?" he replied. She answered, "Leave me your identification seal and its cord and the walking stick you are carrying." So Judah gave them to her. Then he had intercourse with her, and she became pregnant.
verses.textEnNasb: He said, "What pledge shall I give you?" And she said, "Your seal and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand." So he gave them to her and had relations with her, and she conceived by him.
verses.textEn: He said, "What pledge should I give you?" "Your seal and its cord, and the staff in your hand," she answered. So he gave them to her and slept with her, and she became pregnant by him.

verses.textZh: 他玛起来走了，脱去帕子，再穿上守寡的衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他玛起来走了，脱去帕子，再穿上守寡的衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 她玛起来走了，除去帕子，仍旧穿上作寡妇的衣裳。
verses.textEnNiv: After she left, she took off her veil and put on her widow’s clothes again.
verses.textEnEsv: Then she arose and went away, and taking off her veil she put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.textEnNkjv: So she arose and went away, and laid aside her veil and put on the garments of her widowhood.
verses.textEnNlt: Afterward she went back home, took off her veil, and put on her widow’s clothing as usual.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she got up and departed, and removed her veil and put on her widow’s garments.
verses.textEn: After she left, she took off her veil and put on her widow’s clothes again.

verses.textZh: 犹大托自己的朋友亚杜兰人，把一只小山羊送去，要从那女人手中取回保证物，却找不着她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大托自己的朋友亚杜兰人，把一只小山羊送去，要从那女人手中取回保证物，却找不着她。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大托他朋友亚杜兰人送一只山羊羔去，要从那女人手里取回当头来，却找不着她，
verses.textEnNiv: Meanwhile Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite in order to get his pledge back from the woman, but he did not find her.
verses.textEnEsv: When Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite to take back the pledge from the woman’s hand, he did not find her.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend the Adullamite, to receive his pledge from the woman’s hand, but he did not find her.
verses.textEnNlt: Later Judah asked his friend Hirah the Adullamite to take the young goat to the woman and to pick up the things he had given her as his guarantee. But Hirah couldn’t find her.
verses.textEnNasb: When Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, he did not find her.
verses.textEn: Meanwhile Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite in order to get his pledge back from the woman, but he did not find her.

verses.textZh: 希拉问那地方的人说："伊拿印路旁的妓女在哪里呢？"他们回答："这里是没有妓女的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 希拉问那地方的人说："伊拿印路旁的妓女在哪里呢？"他们回答："这里是没有妓女的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就问那地方的人说：「伊拿印路旁的妓女在哪里？」他们说：「这里并没有妓女。」
verses.textEnNiv: He asked the men who lived there, "Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?" "There hasn’t been any shrine prostitute here," they said.
verses.textEnEsv: And he asked the men of the place, "Where is the cult prostitute who was at Enaim at the roadside?" And they said, "No cult prostitute has been here."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he asked the men of that place, saying, "Where is the harlot who was openly by the roadside?" And they said, "There was no harlot in this place."
verses.textEnNlt: So he asked the men who lived there, "Where can I find the shrine prostitute who was sitting beside the road at the entrance to Enaim?" "We’ve never had a shrine prostitute here," they replied.
verses.textEnNasb: He asked the people of her place, saying, "Where is the temple prostitute who was by the road at Enaim?" But they said, "There has been no temple prostitute here."
verses.textEn: He asked the men who lived there, "Where is the shrine prostitute who was beside the road at Enaim?" "There hasn’t been any shrine prostitute here," they said.

verses.textZh: 那人回去见犹大，说："我找不着她，并且那地的人都说：‘这里是没有妓女的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那人回去见犹大，说："我找不着她，并且那地的人都说：‘这里是没有妓女的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 他回去见犹大说：「我没有找着她，并且那地方的人说：『这里没有妓女。』」
