verses.textEnNiv: So he went back to Judah and said, "I didn’t find her. Besides, the men who lived there said, ‘There hasn’t been any shrine prostitute here.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: So he returned to Judah and said, "I have not found her. Also, the men of the place said, ‘No cult prostitute has been here.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: So he returned to Judah and said, "I cannot find her. Also, the men of the place said there was no harlot in this place."
verses.textEnNlt: So Hirah returned to Judah and told him, "I couldn’t find her anywhere, and the men of the village claim they’ve never had a shrine prostitute there."
verses.textEnNasb: So he returned to Judah, and said, "I did not find her; and furthermore, the people of the place said, ‘There has been no temple prostitute here.’ "
verses.textEn: So he went back to Judah and said, "I didn’t find her. Besides, the men who lived there said, ‘There hasn’t been any shrine prostitute here.’ "

verses.textZh: 犹大说："那些东西任她拿去吧，免得我们被人嗤笑。我已经把这小山羊送了去，可是你找不着她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大说："那些东西任她拿去吧，免得我们被人嗤笑。我已经把这小山羊送了去，可是你找不着她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大说：「我把这山羊羔送去了，你竟找不着她。任凭她拿去吧，免得我们被羞辱。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Judah said, "Let her keep what she has, or we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you didn’t find her."
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah replied, "Let her keep the things as her own, or we shall be laughed at. You see, I sent this young goat, and you did not find her."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judah said, "Let her take them for herself, lest we be shamed; for I sent this young goat and you have not found her."
verses.textEnNlt: "Then let her keep the things I gave her," Judah said. "I sent the young goat as we agreed, but you couldn’t find her. We’d be the laughingstock of the village if we went back again to look for her."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Judah said, "Let her keep them, otherwise we will become a laughingstock. After all, I sent this young goat, but you did not find her."
verses.textEn: Then Judah said, "Let her keep what she has, or we will become a laughingstock. After all, I did send her this young goat, but you didn’t find her."

verses.textZh: 大约过了三个月，有人告诉犹大说："你的媳妇他玛作了妓女，并且因此怀了孕。"犹大说："把她拉出来，烧死她。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 大约过了三个月，有人告诉犹大说："你的媳妇他玛作了妓女，并且因此怀了孕。"犹大说："把她拉出来，烧死她。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约过了三个月，有人告诉犹大说：「你的儿妇她玛作了妓女，且因行淫有了身孕。」犹大说：「拉出她来，把她烧了！」
verses.textEnNiv: About three months later Judah was told, "Your daughter-in-law Tamar is guilty of prostitution, and as a result she is now pregnant." Judah said, "Bring her out and have her burned to death!"
verses.textEnEsv: About three months later Judah was told, "Tamar your daughter-in-law has been immoral. Moreover, she is pregnant by immorality." And Judah said, "Bring her out, and let her be burned."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, about three months after, that Judah was told, saying, "Tamar your daughter-in-law has played the harlot; furthermore she is with child by harlotry." So Judah said, "Bring her out and let her be burned!"
verses.textEnNlt: About three months later, Judah was told, "Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has acted like a prostitute. And now, because of this, she’s pregnant." "Bring her out, and let her be burned!" Judah demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it was about three months later that Judah was informed, "Your daughter-in-law Tamar has prostituted herself, and behold, she is also pregnant by prostitution." Then Judah said, "Bring her out and have her burned!"
verses.textEn: About three months later Judah was told, "Your daughter-in-law Tamar is guilty of prostitution, and as a result she is now pregnant." Judah said, "Bring her out and have her burned to death!"

verses.textZh: 他玛被拉出来的时候，派人去见她的公公说："这些东西是谁的，我就是从谁怀了孕。"她又说："请你认一认，这印戒、印的带子和手杖是谁的？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他玛被拉出来的时候，派人去见她的公公说："这些东西是谁的，我就是从谁怀了孕。"她又说："请你认一认，这印戒、印的带子和手杖是谁的？"
verses.textZhCuv: 她玛被拉出来的时候便打发人去见她公公，对他说：「这些东西是谁的，我就是从谁怀的孕。请你认一认，这印和带子并杖都是谁的？」
verses.textEnNiv: As she was being brought out, she sent a message to her father-in-law. "I am pregnant by the man who owns these," she said. And she added, "See if you recognize whose seal and cord and staff these are."
verses.textEnEsv: As she was being brought out, she sent word to her father-in-law, "By the man to whom these belong, I am pregnant." And she said, "Please identify whose these are, the signet and the cord and the staff."
verses.textEnNkjv: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, "By the man to whom these belong, I am with child." And she said, "Please determine whose these are—the signet and cord, and staff."
verses.textEnNlt: But as they were taking her out to kill her, she sent this message to her father-in-law: "The man who owns these things made me pregnant. Look closely. Whose seal and cord and walking stick are these?"
verses.textEnNasb: It was while she was being brought out that she sent word to her father-in-law, saying, "I am pregnant by the man to whom these things belong." She also said, "Please examine and see, whose signet ring and cords and staff are these?"
verses.textEn: As she was being brought out, she sent a message to her father-in-law. "I am pregnant by the man who owns these," she said. And she added, "See if you recognize whose seal and cord and staff these are."

verses.textZh: 犹大认出那些东西，就说："她比我更有理，因为我没有把她给我的儿子示拉为妻。"从此犹大就不再与她亲近了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大认出那些东西，就说："她比我更有理，因为我没有把她给我的儿子示拉为妻。"从此犹大就不再与她亲近了。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大承认说：「她比我更有义，因为我没有将她给我的儿子示拉。」从此犹大不再与她同寝了。
verses.textEnNiv: Judah recognized them and said, "She is more righteous than I, since I wouldn’t give her to my son Shelah." And he did not sleep with her again.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Judah identified them and said, "She is more righteous than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah." And he did not know her again.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Judah acknowledged them and said, "She has been more righteous than I, because I did not give her to Shelah my son." And he never knew her again.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah recognized them immediately and said, "She is more righteous than I am, because I didn’t arrange for her to marry my son Shelah." And Judah never slept with Tamar again.
verses.textEnNasb: And Judah recognized them, and said, "She is more righteous than I, since I did not give her to my son Shelah." And he did not have relations with her again.
verses.textEn: Judah recognized them and said, "She is more righteous than I, since I wouldn’t give her to my son Shelah." And he did not sleep with her again.

verses.textZh: 到了他玛将要生产的时候，腹中竟是一对双胎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了他玛将要生产的时候，腹中竟是一对双胎。
verses.textZhCuv: 她玛将要生产，不料她腹里是一对双生。
verses.textEnNiv: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.
verses.textEnEsv: When the time of her labor came, there were twins in her womb.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass, at the time for giving birth, that behold, twins were in her womb.
verses.textEnNlt: When the time came for Tamar to give birth, it was discovered that she was carrying twins.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about at the time she was giving birth, that behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.textEn: When the time came for her to give birth, there were twin boys in her womb.

verses.textZh: 她正在生产的时候，一个孩子伸出一只手来。接生婆拿了一根朱红线，系在他的手上，说："这一个是先出生的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 她正在生产的时候，一个孩子伸出一只手来。接生婆拿了一根朱红线，系在他的手上，说："这一个是先出生的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 到生产的时候，一个孩子伸出一只手来；收生婆拿红线拴在他手上，说：「这是头生的。」
verses.textEnNiv: As she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on his wrist and said, "This one came out first."
verses.textEnEsv: And when she was in labor, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, "This one came out first."
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when she was giving birth, that theone put out his hand; and the midwife took a scarlet thread and bound it on his hand, saying, "This one came out first."
verses.textEnNlt: While she was in labor, one of the babies reached out his hand. The midwife grabbed it and tied a scarlet string around the child’s wrist, announcing, "This one came out first."
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, it took place while she was giving birth, that one baby put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, "This one came out first."
verses.textEn: As she was giving birth, one of them put out his hand; so the midwife took a scarlet thread and tied it on his wrist and said, "This one came out first."

verses.textZh: 他把手收回去的时候，他的哥哥就出来了。接生婆说："你为甚么抢着出来呢？"因此，给他起名叫法勒斯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他把手收回去的时候，他的哥哥就出来了。接生婆说："你为甚么抢着出来呢？"因此，给他起名叫法勒斯。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后这孩子把手收回去，他哥哥生出来了；收生婆说：「你为什么抢着来呢？」因此给他起名叫法勒斯。
verses.textEnNiv: But when he drew back his hand, his brother came out, and she said, "So this is how you have broken out!" And he was named Perez.
verses.textEnEsv: But as he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out. And she said, "What a breach you have made for yourself!" Therefore his name was called Perez.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, as he drew back his hand, that his brother came out unexpectedly; and she said, "How did you break through? This breach be upon you!" Therefore his name was called Perez.
verses.textEnNlt: But then he pulled back his hand, and out came his brother! "What!" the midwife exclaimed. "How did you break out first?" So he was named Perez.
verses.textEnNasb: But it came about as he drew back his hand that behold, his brother came out. Then she said, "What a breach you have made for yourself!" So he was named Perez.
verses.textEn: But when he drew back his hand, his brother came out, and she said, "So this is how you have broken out!" And he was named Perez.

verses.textZh: 接着，手上系着一根朱红线的弟弟也出来了。因此，给他起名叫谢拉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着，手上系着一根朱红线的弟弟也出来了。因此，给他起名叫谢拉。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来，他兄弟那手上有红线的也生出来，就给他起名叫谢拉。
verses.textEnNiv: Then his brother, who had the scarlet thread on his wrist, came out. And he was named Zerah.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward his brother came out with the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Afterward his brother came out who had the scarlet thread on his hand. And his name was called Zerah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the baby with the scarlet string on his wrist was born, and he was named Zerah.
verses.textEnNasb: Afterward his brother came out who had the scarlet thread on his hand; and he was named Zerah.
verses.textEn: Then his brother, who had the scarlet thread on his wrist, came out. And he was named Zerah.

verses.textZh: 约瑟被带下埃及去了。有一个埃及人，是法老的臣宰，军长波提乏，从那些带约瑟下来的以实玛利人手里买了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟被带下埃及去了。有一个埃及人，是法老的臣宰，军长波提乏，从那些带约瑟下来的以实玛利人手里买了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟被带下埃及去。有一个埃及人，是法老的内臣－护卫长波提乏，从那些带下他来的以实玛利人手下买了他去。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt. Potiphar, an Egyptian who was one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Joseph had been brought down to Egypt, and Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, had bought him from the Ishmaelites who had brought him down there.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt. And Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him down there.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joseph was taken to Egypt by the Ishmaelite traders, he was purchased by Potiphar, an Egyptian officer. Potiphar was captain of the guard for Pharaoh, the king of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt; and Potiphar, an Egyptian officer of Pharaoh, the captain of the bodyguard, bought him from the Ishmaelites, who had taken him down there.
verses.textEn: Now Joseph had been taken down to Egypt. Potiphar, an Egyptian who was one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.

verses.textZh: 耶和华与约瑟同在，约瑟就事事顺利，住在他主人埃及人的家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华与约瑟同在，约瑟就事事顺利，住在他主人埃及人的家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟住在他主人埃及人的家中，耶和华与他同在，他就百事顺利。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered, and he lived in the house of his Egyptian master.
verses.textEnEsv: The Lord was with Joseph, and he became a successful man, and he was in the house of his Egyptian master.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Lord was with Joseph, and he was a successful man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord was with Joseph, so he succeeded in everything he did as he served in the home of his Egyptian master.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord was with Joseph, so he became a successful man. And he was in the house of his master, the Egyptian.
verses.textEn: The Lord was with Joseph so that he prospered, and he lived in the house of his Egyptian master.

verses.textZh: 他的主人见耶和华与他同在，又见耶和华使他手里所作的尽都顺利，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的主人见耶和华与他同在，又见耶和华使他手里所作的尽都顺利，
verses.textZhCuv: 他主人见耶和华与他同在，又见耶和华使他手里所办的尽都顺利，
verses.textEnNiv: When his master saw that the Lord was with him and that the Lord gave him success in everything he did,
verses.textEnEsv: His master saw that the Lord was with him and that the Lord caused all that he did to succeed in his hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: And his master saw that the Lordwas with him and that the Lord made all he did to prosper in his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: Potiphar noticed this and realized that the Lord was with Joseph, giving him success in everything he did.
verses.textEnNasb: Now his master saw that the Lord was with him and that the Lord made all that he did prosper in his hand.
verses.textEn: When his master saw that the Lord was with him and that the Lord gave him success in everything he did,

verses.textZh: 约瑟就得主人的欢心，服事他的主人。他主人指派他管理他的家，把自己所有的一切都交在他手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟就得主人的欢心，服事他的主人。他主人指派他管理他的家，把自己所有的一切都交在他手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟就在主人眼前蒙恩，伺候他主人，并且主人派他管理家务，把一切所有的都交在他手里。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph found favor in his eyes and became his attendant. Potiphar put him in charge of his household, and he entrusted to his care everything he owned.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joseph found favor in his sight and attended him, and he made him overseer of his house and put him in charge of all that he had.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joseph found favor in his sight, and served him. Then he made him overseer of his house, and all that he had he put under his authority.
verses.textEnNlt: This pleased Potiphar, so he soon made Joseph his personal attendant. He put him in charge of his entire household and everything he owned.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joseph found favor in his sight and became his personal servant; and he made him overseer over his house, and put him in charge of all that he owned.
verses.textEn: Joseph found favor in his eyes and became his attendant. Potiphar put him in charge of his household, and he entrusted to his care everything he owned.

verses.textZh: 自从主人指派约瑟管理他的家，和他所有的一切，耶和华就因约瑟的缘故，赐福给那埃及人的家。他家里和田间所有的一切，都蒙耶和华赐福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 自从主人指派约瑟管理他的家，和他所有的一切，耶和华就因约瑟的缘故，赐福给那埃及人的家。他家里和田间所有的一切，都蒙耶和华赐福。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从主人派约瑟管理家务和他一切所有的，耶和华就因约瑟的缘故赐福与那埃及人的家；凡家里和田间一切所有的都蒙耶和华赐福。
verses.textEnNiv: From the time he put him in charge of his household and of all that he owned, the Lord blessed the household of the Egyptian because of Joseph. The blessing of the Lord was on everything Potiphar had, both in the house and in the field.
verses.textEnEsv: From the time that he made him overseer in his house and over all that he had, the Lord blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; the blessing of the Lord was on all that he had, in house and field.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, from the time that he had made him overseer of his house and all that he had, that the Lord blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of the Lord was on all that he had in the house and in the field.
verses.textEnNlt: From the day Joseph was put in charge of his master’s household and property, the Lord began to bless Potiphar’s household for Joseph’s sake. All his household affairs ran smoothly, and his crops and livestock flourished.
verses.textEnNasb: It came about that from the time he made him overseer in his house and over all that he owned, the Lord blessed the Egyptian’s house on account of Joseph; so the Lord’s blessing was upon all that he owned, in the house and in the field.
verses.textEn: From the time he put him in charge of his household and of all that he owned, the Lord blessed the household of the Egyptian because of Joseph. The blessing of the Lord was on everything Potiphar had, both in the house and in the field.

verses.textZh: 波提乏把自己所有的一切，都交在约瑟的手里。除了自己所吃的饭以外，其他的事他一概不管。约瑟生来体格壮健，容貌俊美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波提乏把自己所有的一切，都交在约瑟的手里。除了自己所吃的饭以外，其他的事他一概不管。约瑟生来体格壮健，容貌俊美。
verses.textZhCuv: 波提乏将一切所有的都交在约瑟的手中，除了自己所吃的饭，别的事一概不知。 约瑟原来秀雅俊美。
verses.textEnNiv: So Potiphar left everything he had in Joseph’s care; with Joseph in charge, he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Now Joseph was well-built and handsome,
verses.textEnEsv: So he left all that he had in Joseph’s charge, and because of him he had no concern about anything but the food he ate. Now Joseph was handsome in form and appearance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus he left all that he had in Joseph’s hand, and he did not know what he had except for the bread which he ate. Now Joseph was handsome in form and appearance.
verses.textEnNlt: So Potiphar gave Joseph complete administrative responsibility over everything he owned. With Joseph there, he didn’t worry about a thing—except what kind of food to eat! Joseph was a very handsome and well-built young man,
verses.textEnNasb: So he left Joseph in charge of everything that he owned; and with him there he did not concern himself with anything except the food which he ate. Now Joseph was handsome in form and appearance.
verses.textEn: So Potiphar left everything he had in Joseph’s care; with Joseph in charge, he did not concern himself with anything except the food he ate. Now Joseph was well-built and handsome,

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，约瑟主人的妻子以目传情给约瑟，说："与我同睡吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，约瑟主人的妻子以目传情给约瑟，说："与我同睡吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，约瑟主人的妻以目送情给约瑟，说：「你与我同寝吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: and after a while his master’s wife took notice of Joseph and said, "Come to bed with me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And after a time his master’s wife cast her eyes on Joseph and said, "Lie with me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass after these things that his master’s wife cast longing eyes on Joseph, and she said, "Lie with me."
verses.textEnNlt: and Potiphar’s wife soon began to look at him lustfully. "Come and sleep with me," she demanded.
verses.textEnNasb: And it came about after these events that his master’s wife had her eyes on Joseph, and she said, "Sleep with me."
verses.textEn: and after a while his master’s wife took notice of Joseph and said, "Come to bed with me!"

verses.textZh: 约瑟不肯，对他主人的妻子说："你看，家中的事我主人一概不管；他把他所有的一切，都交在我的手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟不肯，对他主人的妻子说："你看，家中的事我主人一概不管；他把他所有的一切，都交在我的手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟不从，对他主人的妻说：「看哪，一切家务，我主人都不知道；他把所有的都交在我手里。
verses.textEnNiv: But he refused. "With me in charge," he told her, "my master does not concern himself with anything in the house; everything he owns he has entrusted to my care.
verses.textEnEsv: But he refused and said to his master’s wife, "Behold, because of me my master has no concern about anything in the house, and he has put everything that he has in my charge.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he refused and said to his master’s wife, "Look, my master does not know what is with me in the house, and he has committed all that he has to my hand.
verses.textEnNlt: But Joseph refused. "Look," he told her, "my master trusts me with everything in his entire household.
verses.textEnNasb: But he refused and said to his master’s wife, "Look, with me here, my master does not concern himself with anything in the house, and he has put me in charge of all that he owns.
verses.textEn: But he refused. "With me in charge," he told her, "my master does not concern himself with anything in the house; everything he owns he has entrusted to my care.

verses.textZh: 在这家里没有比我大的。除你以外，我主人没有留下一样不交给我，因为你是他的妻子。我怎可以作这极恶的事，得罪神呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在这家里没有比我大的。除你以外，我主人没有留下一样不交给我，因为你是他的妻子。我怎可以作这极恶的事，得罪神呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 在这家里没有比我大的；并且他没有留下一样不交给我，只留下了你，因为你是他的妻子。我怎能作这大恶，得罪神呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: No one is greater in this house than I am. My master has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. How then could I do such a wicked thing and sin against God?"
verses.textEnEsv: He is not greater in this house than I am, nor has he kept back anything from me except you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness and sin against God?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis no one greater in this house than I, nor has he kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?"
verses.textEnNlt: No one here has more authority than I do. He has held back nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. How could I do such a wicked thing? It would be a great sin against God."
verses.textEnNasb: There is no one greater in this house than I, and he has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. How then could I do this great evil, and sin against God?"
verses.textEn: No one is greater in this house than I am. My master has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. How then could I do such a wicked thing and sin against God?"

verses.textZh: 她虽然天天对约瑟这样说，约瑟却不听从她，不肯与她同睡，也不与她在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她虽然天天对约瑟这样说，约瑟却不听从她，不肯与她同睡，也不与她在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来她天天和约瑟说，约瑟却不听从她，不与她同寝，也不和她在一处。
verses.textEnNiv: And though she spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be with her.
verses.textEnEsv: And as she spoke to Joseph day after day, he would not listen to her, to lie beside her or to be with her.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, as she spoke to Joseph day by day, that he did not heed her, to lie with her or to be with her.
verses.textEnNlt: She kept putting pressure on Joseph day after day, but he refused to sleep with her, and he kept out of her way as much as possible.
verses.textEnNasb: Though she spoke to Joseph day after day, he did not listen to her to lie beside her or be with her.
verses.textEn: And though she spoke to Joseph day after day, he refused to go to bed with her or even be with her.

verses.textZh: 有一天，约瑟到屋里办事，家里的人没有一个在屋里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一天，约瑟到屋里办事，家里的人没有一个在屋里。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一天，约瑟进屋里去办事，家中人没有一个在那屋里，
verses.textEnNiv: One day he went into the house to attend to his duties, and none of the household servants was inside.
verses.textEnEsv: But one day, when he went into the house to do his work and none of the men of the house was there in the house,
verses.textEnNkjv: But it happened about this time, when Joseph went into the house to do his work, and none of the men of the house was inside,
verses.textEnNlt: One day, however, no one else was around when he went in to do his work.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened one day that he went into the house to do his work, and none of the people of the household was there inside.
verses.textEn: One day he went into the house to attend to his duties, and none of the household servants was inside.

verses.textZh: 妇人就抓住约瑟的衣服，说："与我同睡吧。"约瑟把自己的衣服留在妇人的手里，跑到外面去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人就抓住约瑟的衣服，说："与我同睡吧。"约瑟把自己的衣服留在妇人的手里，跑到外面去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人就拉住他的衣裳，说：「你与我同寝吧！」约瑟把衣裳丢在妇人手里，跑到外边去了。
verses.textEnNiv: She caught him by his cloak and said, "Come to bed with me!" But he left his cloak in her hand and ran out of the house.
verses.textEnEsv: she caught him by his garment, saying, "Lie with me." But he left his garment in her hand and fled and got out of the house.
verses.textEnNkjv: that she caught him by his garment, saying, "Lie with me." But he left his garment in her hand, and fled and ran outside.
verses.textEnNlt: She came and grabbed him by his cloak, demanding, "Come on, sleep with me!" Joseph tore himself away, but he left his cloak in her hand as he ran from the house.
verses.textEnNasb: So she grabbed him by his garment, saying, "Sleep with me!" But he left his garment in her hand and fled, and went outside.
verses.textEn: She caught him by his cloak and said, "Come to bed with me!" But he left his cloak in her hand and ran out of the house.

verses.textZh: 妇人见约瑟把衣服留在她手里，跑到外面去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人见约瑟把衣服留在她手里，跑到外面去，
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人看见约瑟把衣裳丢在她手里跑出去了，
verses.textEnNiv: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and had fled out of the house,
verses.textEnNkjv: And so it was, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and fled outside,
verses.textEnNlt: When she saw that she was holding his cloak and he had fled,
verses.textEnNasb: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and had fled outside,
verses.textEn: When she saw that he had left his cloak in her hand and had run out of the house,

verses.textZh: 就把家里的人都叫了来，对他们说："你们看，我丈夫带回家来的希伯来人想调戏我们。他进到我这里来，要与我同睡，我就大声呼叫。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就把家里的人都叫了来，对他们说："你们看，我丈夫带回家来的希伯来人想调戏我们。他进到我这里来，要与我同睡，我就大声呼叫。
verses.textZhCuv: 就叫了家里的人来，对他们说：「你们看！他带了一个希伯来人进入我们家里，要戏弄我们。他到我这里来，要与我同寝，我就大声喊叫。
verses.textEnNiv: she called her household servants. "Look," she said to them, "this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us! He came in here to sleep with me, but I screamed.
verses.textEnEsv: she called to the men of her household and said to them, "See, he has brought among us a Hebrew to laugh at us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried out with a loud voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: that she called to the men of her house and spoke to them, saying, "See, he has brought in to us a Hebrew to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried out with a loud voice.
verses.textEnNlt: she called out to her servants. Soon all the men came running. "Look!" she said. "My husband has brought this Hebrew slave here to make fools of us! He came into my room to rape me, but I screamed.
verses.textEnNasb: she called to the men of her household and said to them, "See, he has brought in a Hebrew to us to make fun of us; he came in to me to sleep with me, and I screamed.
verses.textEn: she called her household servants. "Look," she said to them, "this Hebrew has been brought to us to make sport of us! He came in here to sleep with me, but I screamed.

verses.textZh: 他一听见我高声呼叫，就把衣服留在我身边，跑到外面去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一听见我高声呼叫，就把衣服留在我身边，跑到外面去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他听见我放声喊起来，就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑到外边去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried out, he left his garment beside me and fled and got out of the house."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when he heard that I lifted my voice and cried out, that he left his garment with me, and fled and went outside."
verses.textEnNlt: When he heard me scream, he ran outside and got away, but he left his cloak behind with me."
verses.textEnNasb: When he heard that I raised my voice and screamed, he left his garment beside me and fled and went outside."
verses.textEn: When he heard me scream for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."

verses.textZh: 妇人把约瑟的衣服放在她身边，等她的主人回家。
verses.textZhCnvs: 妇人把约瑟的衣服放在她身边，等她的主人回家。
verses.textZhCuv: 妇人把约瑟的衣裳放在自己那里，等着他主人回家，
verses.textEnNiv: She kept his cloak beside her until his master came home.
verses.textEnEsv: Then she laid up his garment by her until his master came home,
verses.textEnNkjv: So she kept his garment with her until his master came home.
verses.textEnNlt: She kept the cloak with her until her husband came home.
verses.textEnNasb: So she left his garment beside her until his master came home.
verses.textEn: She kept his cloak beside her until his master came home.

verses.textZh: 她又用同样的话对他说："你带回家来的希伯来奴隶，竟进到这里来，要调戏我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她又用同样的话对他说："你带回家来的希伯来奴隶，竟进到这里来，要调戏我。
verses.textZhCuv: 就对他如此如此说：「你所带到我们这里的那希伯来仆人进来要戏弄我，
verses.textEnNiv: Then she told him this story: "That Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me.
verses.textEnEsv: and she told him the same story, saying, "The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought among us, came in to me to laugh at me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then she spoke to him with words like these, saying, "The Hebrew servant whom you brought to us came in to me to mock me;
verses.textEnNlt: Then she told him her story. "That Hebrew slave you’ve brought into our house tried to come in and fool around with me," she said.
verses.textEnNasb: Then she spoke to him with these words: "The Hebrew slave, whom you brought to us, came in to me to make fun of me;
verses.textEn: Then she told him this story: "That Hebrew slave you brought us came to me to make sport of me.

verses.textZh: 我高声呼叫，他就把衣服留在我身边，跑到外面去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我高声呼叫，他就把衣服留在我身边，跑到外面去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我放声喊起来，他就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑出去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But as soon as I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."
verses.textEnEsv: But as soon as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment beside me and fled out of the house."
verses.textEnNkjv: so it happened, as I lifted my voice and cried out, that he left his garment with me and fled outside."
verses.textEnNlt: "But when I screamed, he ran outside, leaving his cloak with me!"
verses.textEnNasb: but when I raised my voice and screamed, he left his garment beside me and fled outside."
verses.textEn: But as soon as I screamed for help, he left his cloak beside me and ran out of the house."

verses.textZh: 约瑟的主人听了他妻子对他所说的话，说："你的仆人就是这样对待我。"他就非常生气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟的主人听了他妻子对他所说的话，说："你的仆人就是这样对待我。"他就非常生气。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的主人听见他妻子对他所说的话，说「你的仆人如此如此待我」，他就生气，
verses.textEnNiv: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, "This is how your slave treated me," he burned with anger.
verses.textEnEsv: As soon as his master heard the words that his wife spoke to him, "This is the way your servant treated me," his anger was kindled.
verses.textEnNkjv: So it was, when his master heard the words which his wife spoke to him, saying, "Your servant did to me after this manner," that his anger was aroused.
verses.textEnNlt: Potiphar was furious when he heard his wife’s story about how Joseph had treated her.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when his master heard the words of his wife which she spoke to him, saying, " This is what your slave did to me," his anger burned.
verses.textEn: When his master heard the story his wife told him, saying, "This is how your slave treated me," he burned with anger.

verses.textZh: 于是，约瑟的主人拿住约瑟，把他关在监里，就是王的囚犯被监禁的地方；约瑟就在那里坐监。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约瑟的主人拿住约瑟，把他关在监里，就是王的囚犯被监禁的地方；约瑟就在那里坐监。
verses.textZhCuv: 把约瑟下在监里，就是王的囚犯被囚的地方。于是约瑟在那里坐监。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph’s master took him and put him in prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined. But while Joseph was there in the prison,
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph’s master took him and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined, and he was there in prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph’s master took him and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were confined. And he was there in the prison.
verses.textEnNlt: So he took Joseph and threw him into the prison where the king’s prisoners were held, and there he remained.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joseph’s master took him and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined; and he was there in the prison.
verses.textEn: Joseph’s master took him and put him in prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined. But while Joseph was there in the prison,

verses.textZh: 但是，耶和华与约瑟同在，向他施慈爱，使他得到监狱长的欢心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，耶和华与约瑟同在，向他施慈爱，使他得到监狱长的欢心。
verses.textZhCuv: 但耶和华与约瑟同在，向他施恩，使他在司狱的眼前蒙恩。
verses.textEnNiv: the Lord was with him; he showed him kindness and granted him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord was with Joseph and showed him steadfast love and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord was with Joseph and showed him mercy, and He gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord was with Joseph in the prison and showed him his faithful love. And the Lord made Joseph a favorite with the prison warden.
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord was with Joseph and extended kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the warden of the prison.
verses.textEn: the Lord was with him; he showed him kindness and granted him favor in the eyes of the prison warden.

verses.textZh: 因此，监狱长把监里所有的囚犯都交在约瑟手里；他们在那里所作的一切事务，都由约瑟负责处理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，监狱长把监里所有的囚犯都交在约瑟手里；他们在那里所作的一切事务，都由约瑟负责处理。
verses.textZhCuv: 司狱就把监里所有的囚犯都交在约瑟的手下；他们在那里所办的事都是经他的手。
verses.textEnNiv: So the warden put Joseph in charge of all those held in the prison, and he was made responsible for all that was done there.
verses.textEnEsv: And the keeper of the prison put Joseph in charge of all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever was done there, he was the one who did it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison; whatever they did there, it was his doing.
verses.textEnNlt: Before long, the warden put Joseph in charge of all the other prisoners and over everything that happened in the prison.
verses.textEnNasb: And the warden of the prison put Joseph in charge of all the prisoners who were in the prison; so that whatever was done there, he was responsible for it.
verses.textEn: So the warden put Joseph in charge of all those held in the prison, and he was made responsible for all that was done there.

verses.textZh: 凡交在约瑟手里的事务，监狱长一概不闻不问；因为耶和华与约瑟同在，使他所作的尽都顺利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡交在约瑟手里的事务，监狱长一概不闻不问；因为耶和华与约瑟同在，使他所作的尽都顺利。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡在约瑟手下的事，司狱一概不察，因为耶和华与约瑟同在；耶和华使他所做的尽都顺利。
verses.textEnNiv: The warden paid no attention to anything under Joseph’s care, because the Lord was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.
verses.textEnEsv: The keeper of the prison paid no attention to anything that was in Joseph’s charge, because the Lord was with him. And whatever he did, the Lord made it succeed.
verses.textEnNkjv: The keeper of the prison did not look into anything thatwas under Joseph’s authority, because the Lord was with him; and whatever he did, the Lord made it prosper.
verses.textEnNlt: The warden had no more worries, because Joseph took care of everything. The Lord was with him and caused everything he did to succeed.
verses.textEnNasb: The warden of the prison did not supervise anything under Joseph’s authority, because the Lord was with him; and, the Lord made whatever he did prosper.
verses.textEn: The warden paid no attention to anything under Joseph’s care, because the Lord was with Joseph and gave him success in whatever he did.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，埃及王的酒政和膳长，得罪了他们的主人埃及王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，埃及王的酒政和膳长，得罪了他们的主人埃及王。

verses.textEnNiv: Some time later, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their master, the king of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Some time after this, the cupbearer of the king of Egypt and his baker committed an offense against their lord the king of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: It came to pass after these things that the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Some time later, Pharaoh’s chief cup-bearer and chief baker offended their royal master.
verses.textEnNasb: Then it came about after these things, that the cupbearer and the baker for the king of Egypt offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Some time later, the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt offended their master, the king of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 法老就恼怒酒政和膳长这两个臣宰，
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老就恼怒酒政和膳长这两个臣宰，

verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief butler and the chief baker.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh became angry with these two officials,

verses.textEn: Pharaoh was angry with his two officials, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker,

verses.textZh: 把他们关在军长府内的监房里，就是约瑟被囚禁的地方。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把他们关在军长府内的监房里，就是约瑟被囚禁的地方。
verses.textZhCuv: 把他们下在护卫长府内的监里，就是约瑟被囚的地方。

verses.textEnEsv: and he put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the prison where Joseph was confined.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the prison, the place where Joseph was confined.
verses.textEnNlt: and he put them in the prison where Joseph was, in the palace of the captain of the guard.

verses.textEn: and put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, in the same prison where Joseph was confined.

verses.textEnNkjv: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them, and he served them; so they were in custody for a while.
verses.textEnNlt: They remained in prison for quite some time, and the captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, who looked after them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the captain of the bodyguard put Joseph in charge of them, and he took care of them; and they were in confinement for some time.

verses.textZh: 他们二人，就是被关在监里的埃及王的酒政和膳长，同一夜各作了一个梦，二人的梦各有不同的解释。

verses.textZhCuv: 被囚在监之埃及王的酒政和膳长二人同夜各做一梦，各梦都有讲解。
verses.textEnNiv: each of the two men—the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were being held in prison—had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.
verses.textEnEsv: And one night they both dreamed—the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were confined in the prison—each his own dream, and each dream with its own interpretation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were confined in the prison, had a dream, both of them, each man’s dream in one night and each man’s dream with its own interpretation.
verses.textEnNlt: While they were in prison, Pharaoh’s cup-bearer and baker each had a dream one night, and each dream had its own meaning.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the cupbearer and the baker for the king of Egypt, who were confined in the prison, both had a dream the same night, each man with his own dream and each dream with its own interpretation.
verses.textEn: each of the two men—the cupbearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were being held in prison—had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，约瑟进去到他们那里，见他们神色不安，

verses.textEn: When Joseph came to them the next morning, he saw that they were dejected.

verses.textZh: 就问法老的两个臣宰，就是与他一同关在他主人府内的监房里的，说："今天你们的脸色为甚么这样难看呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 就问法老的两个臣宰，就是与他一同关在他主人府内的监房里的，说："今天你们的脸色为甚么这样难看呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他便问法老的二臣，就是与他同囚在他主人府里的，说：「你们今日为什么面带愁容呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So he asked Pharaoh’s officials who were in custody with him in his master’s house, "Why do you look so sad today?"
verses.textEnEsv: So he asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, "Why are your faces downcast today?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So he asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in the custody of his lord’s house, saying, "Why do you look so sad today?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why do you look so worried today?" he asked them.
verses.textEnNasb: So he asked Pharaoh’s officials who were with him in confinement in his master’s house, " Why are your faces so sad today?"
verses.textEn: So he asked Pharaoh’s officials who were in custody with him in his master’s house, "Why do you look so sad today?"

verses.textZh: 他们回答他："我们各人作了一个梦，但没有人能够解释。"约瑟对他们说："解梦不是出于神吗？请把梦告诉我吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答他："我们各人作了一个梦，但没有人能够解释。"约瑟对他们说："解梦不是出于神吗？请把梦告诉我吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对他说：「我们各人做了一梦，没有人能解。」约瑟说：「解梦不是出于神吗？请你们将梦告诉我。」
verses.textEnNiv: "We both had dreams," they answered, "but there is no one to interpret them." Then Joseph said to them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams."
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "We have had dreams, and there is no one to interpret them." And Joseph said to them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Please tell them to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to him, "We each have had a dream, and thereis no interpreter of it." So Joseph said to them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Tell them to me, please."
verses.textEnNlt: And they replied, "We both had dreams last night, but no one can tell us what they mean." "Interpreting dreams is God’s business," Joseph replied. "Go ahead and tell me your dreams."
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to him, "We have had a dream, and there is no one to interpret it." Then Joseph said to them, "Do interpretations not belong to God? Tell it to me, please."
verses.textEn: "We both had dreams," they answered, "but there is no one to interpret them." Then Joseph said to them, "Do not interpretations belong to God? Tell me your dreams."

verses.textZh: 法老的杯在我手里，我拿了葡萄挤在法老的杯中，把杯递在法老的手里。"

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他说："这梦的解释是这样：三根枝子就是三天。

verses.textZh: 三天之内，法老必使你抬起头来，恢复你原来的职位；你仍要把杯递在法老的手里，好象先前作他的酒政时一样。

verses.textEn: Within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your position, and you will put Pharaoh’s cup in his hand, just as you used to do when you were his cupbearer.

verses.textZh: 不过，你一切顺利的时候，求你记念我，施恩给我，在法老面前提拔我，救我脱离这监狱。

verses.textEnNlt: And please remember me and do me a favor when things go well for you. Mention me to Pharaoh, so he might let me out of this place.
verses.textEnNasb: Only keep me in mind when it goes well for you, and please do me a kindness by mentioning me to Pharaoh, and get me out of this prison.
verses.textEn: But when all goes well with you, remember me and show me kindness; mention me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison.

verses.textZh: 我实在是从希伯来人之地被拐来；就是在这里，我也没有作过甚么事该被关在监牢里的。"

verses.textZhCnvs: 但是酒政并不记念约瑟，竟把他忘记了。
verses.textZhCuv: 酒政却不记念约瑟，竟忘了他。
verses.textEnNiv: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot him.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet the chief butler did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh’s chief cup-bearer, however, forgot all about Joseph, never giving him another thought.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.
verses.textEn: The chief cupbearer, however, did not remember Joseph; he forgot him.

verses.textZh: 过了两年，法老作了一个梦，梦见自己站在河边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了两年，法老作了一个梦，梦见自己站在河边。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了两年，法老做梦，梦见自己站在河边，
verses.textEnNiv: When two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing by the Nile,
verses.textEnEsv: After two whole years, Pharaoh dreamed that he was standing by the Nile,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it came to pass, at the end of two full years, that Pharaoh had a dream; and behold, he stood by the river.
verses.textEnNlt: Two full years later, Pharaoh dreamed that he was standing on the bank of the Nile River.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it happened at the end of two full years that Pharaoh had a dream, and behold, he was standing by the Nile.
verses.textEn: When two full years had passed, Pharaoh had a dream: He was standing by the Nile,

verses.textZh: 有七头母牛从河里上来，又健美又肥壮，在芦苇中吃草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有七头母牛从河里上来，又健美又肥壮，在芦苇中吃草。
verses.textZhCuv: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又美好又肥壮，在芦荻中吃草。
verses.textEnNiv: when out of the river there came up seven cows, sleek and fat, and they grazed among the reeds.
verses.textEnEsv: and behold, there came up out of the Nile seven cows, attractive and plump, and they fed in the reed grass.
verses.textEnNkjv: Suddenly there came up out of the river seven cows, fine looking and fat; and they fed in the meadow.
verses.textEnNlt: In his dream he saw seven fat, healthy cows come up out of the river and begin grazing in the marsh grass.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, from the Nile seven cows came up, fine-looking and fat; and they grazed in the marsh grass.
verses.textEn: when out of the river there came up seven cows, sleek and fat, and they grazed among the reeds.

verses.textZh: 接着，又有另外七头母牛从河里上来，又丑陋又瘦弱，站在岸上其他母牛旁边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着，又有另外七头母牛从河里上来，又丑陋又瘦弱，站在岸上其他母牛旁边。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后又有七只母牛从河里上来，又丑陋又干瘦，与那七只母牛一同站在河边。
verses.textEnNiv: After them, seven other cows, ugly and gaunt, came up out of the Nile and stood beside those on the riverbank.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, seven other cows, ugly and thin, came up out of the Nile after them, and stood by the other cows on the bank of the Nile.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then behold, seven other cows came up after them out of the river, ugly and gaunt, and stood by the other cows on the bank of the river.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he saw seven more cows come up behind them from the Nile, but these were scrawny and thin. These cows stood beside the fat cows on the riverbank.
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, seven other cows came up after them from the Nile, ugly and thin, and they stood by the other cows on the bank of the Nile.
verses.textEn: After them, seven other cows, ugly and gaunt, came up out of the Nile and stood beside those on the riverbank.

verses.textZh: 这些丑陋瘦弱的母牛，竟把那七只健美肥壮的母牛吃掉，法老就醒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些丑陋瘦弱的母牛，竟把那七只健美肥壮的母牛吃掉，法老就醒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这又丑陋又干瘦的七只母牛吃尽了那又美好又肥壮的七只母牛。法老就醒了。
verses.textEnNiv: And the cows that were ugly and gaunt ate up the seven sleek, fat cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.
verses.textEnEsv: And the ugly, thin cows ate up the seven attractive, plump cows. And Pharaoh awoke.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the ugly and gaunt cows ate up the seven fine looking and fat cows. So Pharaoh awoke.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the scrawny, thin cows ate the seven healthy, fat cows! At this point in the dream, Pharaoh woke up.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the ugly and thin cows ate the seven fine-looking and fat cows. Then Pharaoh awoke.
verses.textEn: And the cows that were ugly and gaunt ate up the seven sleek, fat cows. Then Pharaoh woke up.

verses.textZh: 他又睡着，作了第二个梦，梦见一根麦茎，长出七个麦穗，又肥壮又美好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又睡着，作了第二个梦，梦见一根麦茎，长出七个麦穗，又肥壮又美好。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又睡着，第二回做梦，梦见一棵麦子长了七个穗子，又肥大又佳美，
verses.textEnNiv: He fell asleep again and had a second dream: Seven heads of grain, healthy and good, were growing on a single stalk.
verses.textEnEsv: And he fell asleep and dreamed a second time. And behold, seven ears of grain, plump and good, were growing on one stalk.
verses.textEnNkjv: He slept and dreamed a second time; and suddenly seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, plump and good.
verses.textEnNlt: But he fell asleep again and had a second dream. This time he saw seven heads of grain, plump and beautiful, growing on a single stalk.
verses.textEnNasb: But he fell asleep and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven ears of grain came up on a single stalk, plump and good.
verses.textEn: He fell asleep again and had a second dream: Seven heads of grain, healthy and good, were growing on a single stalk.

verses.textZh: 接着，又长出七个麦穗，又干瘦又被东风吹焦了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着，又长出七个麦穗，又干瘦又被东风吹焦了。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后又长了七个穗子，又细弱又被东风吹焦了。
verses.textEnNiv: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted—thin and scorched by the east wind.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, after them sprouted seven ears, thin and blighted by the east wind.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then behold, seven thin heads, blighted by the east wind, sprang up after them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then seven more heads of grain appeared, but these were shriveled and withered by the east wind.
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, seven ears, thin and scorched by the east wind, sprouted up after them.
verses.textEn: After them, seven other heads of grain sprouted—thin and scorched by the east wind.

verses.textZh: 这些干瘦的麦穗，竟把那七个又肥壮又饱满的麦穗吞下去，法老就醒了，原来是一个梦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些干瘦的麦穗，竟把那七个又肥壮又饱满的麦穗吞下去，法老就醒了，原来是一个梦。
verses.textZhCuv: 这细弱的穗子吞了那七个又肥大又饱满的穗子。法老醒了，不料是个梦。
verses.textEnNiv: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy, full heads. Then Pharaoh woke up; it had been a dream.
verses.textEnEsv: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven plump, full ears. And Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the seven thin heads devoured the seven plump and full heads. So Pharaoh awoke, and indeed, itwas a dream.
verses.textEnNlt: And these thin heads swallowed up the seven plump, well-formed heads! Then Pharaoh woke up again and realized it was a dream.
verses.textEnNasb: And the thin ears swallowed the seven plump and full ears. Then Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
verses.textEn: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy, full heads. Then Pharaoh woke up; it had been a dream.

verses.textZh: 到了早晨，法老心里烦乱，就派人去把埃及所有的术士和智慧人都召了来；法老把自己的梦告诉他们，但是没有人能替法老解梦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了早晨，法老心里烦乱，就派人去把埃及所有的术士和智慧人都召了来；法老把自己的梦告诉他们，但是没有人能替法老解梦。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了早晨，法老心里不安，就差人召了埃及所有的术士和博士来；法老就把所做的梦告诉他们，却没有人能给法老圆解。
verses.textEnNiv: In the morning his mind was troubled, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.
verses.textEnEsv: So in the morning his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt and all its wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was none who could interpret them to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt and all its wise men. And Pharaoh told them his dreams, but therewas no one who could interpret them for Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: The next morning Pharaoh was very disturbed by the dreams. So he called for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. When Pharaoh told them his dreams, not one of them could tell him what they meant.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the morning his spirit was troubled, so he sent messengers and called for all the soothsayer priests of Egypt, and all its wise men. And Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them for Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: In the morning his mind was troubled, so he sent for all the magicians and wise men of Egypt. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but no one could interpret them for him.

verses.textZh: 那时酒政告诉法老说："我今日想起了我的过错。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时酒政告诉法老说："我今日想起了我的过错。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时酒政对法老说：「我今日想起我的罪来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, "Today I am reminded of my shortcomings.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, "I remember my offenses today.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the chief butler spoke to Pharaoh, saying: "I remember my faults this day.
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, the king’s chief cup-bearer spoke up. "Today I have been reminded of my failure," he told Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the chief cupbearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, "I would make mention today of my own offenses.
verses.textEn: Then the chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, "Today I am reminded of my shortcomings.

verses.textZh: 从前法老恼怒臣仆，把我和膳长关在军长府的监房里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前法老恼怒臣仆，把我和膳长关在军长府的监房里。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前法老恼怒臣仆，把我和膳长下在护卫长府内的监里。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he imprisoned me and the chief baker in the house of the captain of the guard.
verses.textEnEsv: When Pharaoh was angry with his servants and put me and the chief baker in custody in the house of the captain of the guard,
verses.textEnNkjv: When Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, both me and the chief baker,
verses.textEnNlt: "Some time ago, you were angry with the chief baker and me, and you imprisoned us in the palace of the captain of the guard.
verses.textEnNasb: Pharaoh was furious with his servants, and he put me in confinement in the house of the captain of the bodyguard, both me and the chief baker.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh was once angry with his servants, and he imprisoned me and the chief baker in the house of the captain of the guard.

verses.textZh: 我们二人在同一夜都作了梦；我们的梦各有不同的解释。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们二人在同一夜都作了梦；我们的梦各有不同的解释。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们二人同夜各做一梦，各梦都有讲解。
verses.textEnNiv: Each of us had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.
verses.textEnEsv: we dreamed on the same night, he and I, each having a dream with its own interpretation.
verses.textEnNkjv: we each had a dream in one night, he and I. Each of us dreamed according to the interpretation of his own dream.
verses.textEnNlt: One night the chief baker and I each had a dream, and each dream had its own meaning.
verses.textEnNasb: Then we had a dream one night, he and I; each of us dreamed according to the interpretation of his own dream.
verses.textEn: Each of us had a dream the same night, and each dream had a meaning of its own.

verses.textZh: 在那里有一个希伯来的少年人与我们在一起，他是军长的仆人，我们把梦告诉了他，他就替我们解梦，各人的梦有不同的解释。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在那里有一个希伯来的少年人与我们在一起，他是军长的仆人，我们把梦告诉了他，他就替我们解梦，各人的梦有不同的解释。
verses.textZhCuv: 在那里同着我们有一个希伯来的少年人，是护卫长的仆人，我们告诉他，他就把我们的梦圆解，是按着各人的梦圆解的。
verses.textEnNiv: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams, and he interpreted them for us, giving each man the interpretation of his dream.
verses.textEnEsv: A young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. When we told him, he interpreted our dreams to us, giving an interpretation to each man according to his dream.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now there was a young Hebrew man with us there, a servant of the captain of the guard. And we told him, and he interpreted our dreams for us; to each man he interpreted according to his own dream.
verses.textEnNlt: There was a young Hebrew man with us in the prison who was a slave of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams, and he told us what each of our dreams meant.
verses.textEnNasb: Now a Hebrew youth was there with us, a servant of the captain of the bodyguard, and we told him the dreams, and he interpreted our dreams for us. For each man he interpreted according to his own dream.
verses.textEn: Now a young Hebrew was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams, and he interpreted them for us, giving each man the interpretation of his dream.

verses.textZh: 结果，事情都照着他给我们的解释实现了：我恢复了原职，膳长却被挂起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 结果，事情都照着他给我们的解释实现了：我恢复了原职，膳长却被挂起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 后来正如他给我们圆解的成就了：我官复原职，膳长被挂起来了。」
verses.textEnNiv: And things turned out exactly as he interpreted them to us: I was restored to my position, and the other man was impaled."
verses.textEnEsv: And as he interpreted to us, so it came about. I was restored to my office, and the baker was hanged."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, just as he interpreted for us, so it happened. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him."
verses.textEnNlt: And everything happened just as he had predicted. I was restored to my position as cup-bearer, and the chief baker was executed and impaled on a pole."
verses.textEnNasb: And just as he interpreted for us, so it happened; Pharaoh restored me in my office, but he hanged the chief baker."
verses.textEn: And things turned out exactly as he interpreted them to us: I was restored to my position, and the other man was impaled."

verses.textZh: 法老于是派人去召约瑟。他们就急忙把约瑟从监里带出来。他剃了头、刮了脸、换了衣服，就进去见法老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老于是派人去召约瑟。他们就急忙把约瑟从监里带出来。他剃了头、刮了脸、换了衣服，就进去见法老。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老遂即差人去召约瑟，他们便急忙带他出监，他就剃头，刮脸，换衣裳，进到法老面前。
verses.textEnNiv: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and he was quickly brought from the dungeon. When he had shaved and changed his clothes, he came before Pharaoh.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they quickly brought him out of the pit. And when he had shaved himself and changed his clothes, he came in before Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him quickly out of the dungeon; and he shaved, changed his clothing, and came to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh sent for Joseph at once, and he was quickly brought from the prison. After he shaved and changed his clothes, he went in and stood before Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh sent word and called for Joseph, and they hurriedly brought him out of the dungeon; and when he had shaved himself and changed his clothes, he came to Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: So Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and he was quickly brought from the dungeon. When he had shaved and changed his clothes, he came before Pharaoh.

verses.textZh: 法老对约瑟说："我作了一个梦，没有人能够解释。我听见人说，你听了梦，就能解释。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老对约瑟说："我作了一个梦，没有人能够解释。我听见人说，你听了梦，就能解释。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对约瑟说：「我做了一梦，没有人能解；我听见人说，你听了梦就能解。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I had a dream, and no one can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it."
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I have had a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I have had a dream, and thereis no one who can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that you can understand a dream, to interpret it."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I had a dream last night, and no one here can tell me what it means. But I have heard that when you hear about a dream you can interpret it."
verses.textEnNasb: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I have had a dream, but no one can interpret it; and I have heard it said about you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it."
verses.textEn: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I had a dream, and no one can interpret it. But I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream you can interpret it."

verses.textZh: 约瑟回答法老，说："解梦不在于我，但神必给法老一个吉祥的解答。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟回答法老，说："解梦不在于我，但神必给法老一个吉祥的解答。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟回答法老说：「这不在乎我，神必将平安的话回答法老。」
verses.textEnNiv: "I cannot do it," Joseph replied to Pharaoh, "but God will give Pharaoh the answer he desires."
verses.textEnEsv: Joseph answered Pharaoh, "It is not in me; God will give Pharaoh a favorable answer."
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, "Itis not in me; God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace."
verses.textEnNlt: "It is beyond my power to do this," Joseph replied. "But God can tell you what it means and set you at ease."
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph then answered Pharaoh, saying, " It has nothing to do with me; God will give Pharaoh an answer for his own good."
verses.textEn: "I cannot do it," Joseph replied to Pharaoh, "but God will give Pharaoh the answer he desires."

verses.textZh: 法老告诉约瑟："在梦里我看见我站在河边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老告诉约瑟："在梦里我看见我站在河边。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对约瑟说：「我梦见我站在河边，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "In my dream I was standing on the bank of the Nile,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Behold, in my dream I was standing on the banks of the Nile.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph: "Behold, in my dream I stood on the bank of the river.
verses.textEnNlt: So Pharaoh told Joseph his dream. "In my dream," he said, "I was standing on the bank of the Nile River,
verses.textEnNasb: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, "In my dream, there I was, standing on the bank of the Nile;
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "In my dream I was standing on the bank of the Nile,

verses.textZh: 有七头母牛从河里上来，又肥壮又健美，在芦苇中吃草。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有七头母牛从河里上来，又肥壮又健美，在芦苇中吃草。
verses.textZhCuv: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又肥壮又美好，在芦荻中吃草。
verses.textEnNiv: when out of the river there came up seven cows, fat and sleek, and they grazed among the reeds.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven cows, plump and attractive, came up out of the Nile and fed in the reed grass.
verses.textEnNkjv: Suddenly seven cows came up out of the river, fine looking and fat; and they fed in the meadow.
verses.textEnNlt: and I saw seven fat, healthy cows come up out of the river and begin grazing in the marsh grass.
verses.textEnNasb: and behold, seven cows, fat and fine-looking came up out of the Nile, and they grazed in the marsh grass.
verses.textEn: when out of the river there came up seven cows, fat and sleek, and they grazed among the reeds.

verses.textZh: 接着，又有另外七头母牛上来，又软弱又消瘦又十分丑陋，在埃及全地我没有见过这样丑陋的牛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着，又有另外七头母牛上来，又软弱又消瘦又十分丑陋，在埃及全地我没有见过这样丑陋的牛。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后又有七只母牛上来，又软弱又丑陋又干瘦，在埃及遍地，我没有见过这样不好的。
verses.textEnNiv: After them, seven other cows came up—scrawny and very ugly and lean. I had never seen such ugly cows in all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven other cows came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I had never seen in all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then behold, seven other cows came up after them, poor and very ugly and gaunt, such ugliness as I have never seen in all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: But then I saw seven sick-looking cows, scrawny and thin, come up after them. I’ve never seen such sorry-looking animals in all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, seven other cows came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I had never seen for ugliness in all the land of Egypt;
verses.textEn: After them, seven other cows came up—scrawny and very ugly and lean. I had never seen such ugly cows in all the land of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 这又消瘦又丑陋的母牛，竟把先前七头肥壮的母牛吃掉。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这又消瘦又丑陋的母牛，竟把先前七头肥壮的母牛吃掉。
verses.textZhCuv: 这又干瘦又丑陋的母牛吃尽了那以先的七只肥母牛，
verses.textEnNiv: The lean, ugly cows ate up the seven fat cows that came up first.
verses.textEnEsv: And the thin, ugly cows ate up the first seven plump cows,
verses.textEnNkjv: And the gaunt and ugly cows ate up the first seven, the fat cows.
verses.textEnNlt: These thin, scrawny cows ate the seven fat cows.
verses.textEnNasb: and the thin and ugly cows ate the first seven fat cows.
verses.textEn: The lean, ugly cows ate up the seven fat cows that came up first.

verses.textZh: 牠们吃了以后，却看不出牠们是吃掉了肥牛，因为牠们丑陋的样子仍是与先前一样。我就醒了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠们吃了以后，却看不出牠们是吃掉了肥牛，因为牠们丑陋的样子仍是与先前一样。我就醒了。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃了以后却看不出是吃了，那丑陋的样子仍旧和先前一样。我就醒了。
verses.textEnNiv: But even after they ate them, no one could tell that they had done so; they looked just as ugly as before. Then I woke up.
verses.textEnEsv: but when they had eaten them no one would have known that they had eaten them, for they were still as ugly as at the beginning. Then I awoke.
verses.textEnNkjv: When they had eaten them up, no one would have known that they had eaten them, for they were just as ugly as at the beginning. So I awoke.
verses.textEnNlt: But afterward you wouldn’t have known it, for they were still as thin and scrawny as before! Then I woke up.
verses.textEnNasb: Yet when they had devoured them, it could not be detected that they had devoured them, for they were just as ugly as before. Then I awoke.
verses.textEn: But even after they ate them, no one could tell that they had done so; they looked just as ugly as before. Then I woke up.

verses.textZh: 在梦里我又看见一根麦茎，长出七个麦穗，又饱满又美好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在梦里我又看见一根麦茎，长出七个麦穗，又饱满又美好。
verses.textZhCuv: 我又梦见一棵麦子，长了七个穗子，又饱满又佳美，
verses.textEnNiv: "In my dream I saw seven heads of grain, full and good, growing on a single stalk.
verses.textEnEsv: I also saw in my dream seven ears growing on one stalk, full and good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also I saw in my dream, and suddenly seven heads came up on one stalk, full and good.
verses.textEnNlt: "In my dream I also saw seven heads of grain, full and beautiful, growing on a single stalk.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw also in my dream, and behold, seven ears of grain, full and good, came up on a single stalk;
verses.textEn: "In my dream I saw seven heads of grain, full and good, growing on a single stalk.

verses.textZh: 接着，又长出了七个麦穗，又枯干又干瘦又被东风吹焦了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着，又长出了七个麦穗，又枯干又干瘦又被东风吹焦了。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后又长了七个穗子，枯槁细弱，被东风吹焦了。
verses.textEnNiv: After them, seven other heads sprouted—withered and thin and scorched by the east wind.
verses.textEnEsv: Seven ears, withered, thin, and blighted by the east wind, sprouted after them,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then behold, seven heads, withered, thin, and blighted by the east wind, sprang up after them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then seven more heads of grain appeared, but these were blighted, shriveled, and withered by the east wind.
verses.textEnNasb: and behold, seven ears, withered, thin, and scorched by the east wind sprouted up after them;
verses.textEn: After them, seven other heads sprouted—withered and thin and scorched by the east wind.

verses.textZh: 这些干瘦的麦穗，竟把那七个美好的麦穗吞下去。我把梦告诉了术士，但是没有人能替我解答。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些干瘦的麦穗，竟把那七个美好的麦穗吞下去。我把梦告诉了术士，但是没有人能替我解答。"
verses.textZhCuv: 这些细弱的穗子吞了那七个佳美的穗子。我将这梦告诉了术士，却没有人能给我解说。」
verses.textEnNiv: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads. I told this to the magicians, but none of them could explain it to me."
verses.textEnEsv: and the thin ears swallowed up the seven good ears. And I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the thin heads devoured the seven good heads. So I told this to the magicians, but therewas no one who could explain it to me."
verses.textEnNlt: And the shriveled heads swallowed the seven healthy heads. I told these dreams to the magicians, but no one could tell me what they mean."
verses.textEnNasb: and the thin ears swallowed the seven good ears. Then I told it to the soothsayer priests, but there was no one who could explain it to me."
verses.textEn: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads. I told this to the magicians, but none of them could explain it to me."

verses.textZh: 约瑟对法老说："法老的梦都是同一个意思，神已经把所要作的事告诉法老了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对法老说："法老的梦都是同一个意思，神已经把所要作的事告诉法老了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟对法老说：「法老的梦乃是一个。神已将所要做的事指示法老了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one; God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one; God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do:
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph responded, "Both of Pharaoh’s dreams mean the same thing. God is telling Pharaoh in advance what he is about to do.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph said to Pharaoh, "Pharaoh’s dreams are one and the same; God has told to Pharaoh what He is about to do.
verses.textEn: Then Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one and the same. God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do.

verses.textZh: 七头美好的母牛是七年，七个美好的麦穗也是七年；两个梦都是同一个意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: 七头美好的母牛是七年，七个美好的麦穗也是七年；两个梦都是同一个意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 七只好母牛是七年，七个好穗子也是七年；这梦乃是一个。
verses.textEnNiv: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years; it is one and the same dream.
verses.textEnEsv: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good ears are seven years; the dreams are one.
verses.textEnNkjv: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads are seven years; the dreams are one.
verses.textEnNlt: The seven healthy cows and the seven healthy heads of grain both represent seven years of prosperity.
verses.textEnNasb: The seven good cows are seven years; and the seven good ears are seven years; the dreams are one and the same.
verses.textEn: The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years; it is one and the same dream.

verses.textZh: 那接着上来的七头又消瘦又丑陋的母牛是七年，那七个不结实、被东风吹焦了的麦穗也是七年，都是七年饥荒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那接着上来的七头又消瘦又丑陋的母牛是七年，那七个不结实、被东风吹焦了的麦穗也是七年，都是七年饥荒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那随后上来的七只又干瘦又丑陋的母牛是七年，那七个虚空、被东风吹焦的穗子也是七年，都是七个荒年。
verses.textEnNiv: The seven lean, ugly cows that came up afterward are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind: They are seven years of famine.
verses.textEnEsv: The seven lean and ugly cows that came up after them are seven years, and the seven empty ears blighted by the east wind are also seven years of famine.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the seven thin and ugly cows which came up after them are seven years, and the seven empty heads blighted by the east wind are seven years of famine.
verses.textEnNlt: The seven thin, scrawny cows that came up later and the seven thin heads of grain, withered by the east wind, represent seven years of famine.
verses.textEnNasb: The seven thin and ugly cows that came up after them are seven years, and the seven thin ears scorched by the east wind will be seven years of famine.
verses.textEn: The seven lean, ugly cows that came up afterward are seven years, and so are the seven worthless heads of grain scorched by the east wind: They are seven years of famine.

verses.textZh: 这就是我对法老所说：神要作的事，他已经向法老显明了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是我对法老所说：神要作的事，他已经向法老显明了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是我对法老所说，神已将所要做的事显明给法老了。
verses.textEnNiv: "It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.textEnEsv: It is as I told Pharaoh; God has shown to Pharaoh what he is about to do.
verses.textEnNkjv: This is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.
verses.textEnNlt: "This will happen just as I have described it, for God has revealed to Pharaoh in advance what he is about to do.
verses.textEnNasb: It is as I have spoken to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what He is about to do.
verses.textEn: "It is just as I said to Pharaoh: God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

verses.textZh: 看哪，埃及全地必有七年大丰收。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，埃及全地必有七年大丰收。
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及遍地必来七个大丰年，
verses.textEnNiv: Seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: There will come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed seven years of great plenty will come throughout all the land of Egypt;
verses.textEnNlt: The next seven years will be a period of great prosperity throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, seven years of great abundance are coming in all the land of Egypt;
verses.textEn: Seven years of great abundance are coming throughout the land of Egypt,

verses.textZh: 接着又必有七年饥荒；甚至埃及地所有的丰收都被人忘记了，饥荒必把这地毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 接着又必有七年饥荒；甚至埃及地所有的丰收都被人忘记了，饥荒必把这地毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后又要来七个荒年，甚至在埃及地都忘了先前的丰收，全地必被饥荒所灭。
verses.textEnNiv: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will ravage the land.
verses.textEnEsv: but after them there will arise seven years of famine, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,
verses.textEnNkjv: but after them seven years of famine will arise, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine will deplete the land.
verses.textEnNlt: But afterward there will be seven years of famine so great that all the prosperity will be forgotten in Egypt. Famine will destroy the land.
verses.textEnNasb: and after them seven years of famine will come, and all the abundance will be forgotten in the land of Egypt, and the famine will ravage the land.
verses.textEn: but seven years of famine will follow them. Then all the abundance in Egypt will be forgotten, and the famine will ravage the land.

verses.textZh: 因为接着而来的饥荒太严重了，使人不觉得这地有过丰收。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为接着而来的饥荒太严重了，使人不觉得这地有过丰收。
verses.textZhCuv: 因那以后的饥荒甚大，便不觉得先前的丰收了。
verses.textEnNiv: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, because the famine that follows it will be so severe.
verses.textEnEsv: and the plenty will be unknown in the land by reason of the famine that will follow, for it will be very severe.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the plenty will not be known in the land because of the famine following, for it willbe very severe.
verses.textEnNlt: This famine will be so severe that even the memory of the good years will be erased.
verses.textEnNasb: So the abundance will be unknown in the land because of that subsequent famine; for it will be very severe.
verses.textEn: The abundance in the land will not be remembered, because the famine that follows it will be so severe.

verses.textZh: 至于法老两次作梦，是因为神已经命定这事，并且要快快地实行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于法老两次作梦，是因为神已经命定这事，并且要快快地实行。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于法老两回做梦，是因神命定这事，而且必速速成就。
verses.textEnNiv: The reason the dream was given to Pharaoh in two forms is that the matter has been firmly decided by God, and God will do it soon.
verses.textEnEsv: And the doubling of Pharaoh’s dream means that the thing is fixed by God, and God will shortly bring it about.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the dream was repeated to Pharaoh twice because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.textEnNlt: As for having two similar dreams, it means that these events have been decreed by God, and he will soon make them happen.
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for the repeating of the dream to Pharaoh twice, it means that the matter is confirmed by God, and God will quickly bring it about.
verses.textEn: The reason the dream was given to Pharaoh in two forms is that the matter has been firmly decided by God, and God will do it soon.

verses.textZh: 因此，法老要找一个有见识有智慧的人，派他管理埃及地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，法老要找一个有见识有智慧的人，派他管理埃及地。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，法老当拣选一个有聪明有智慧的人，派他治理埃及地。
verses.textEnNiv: "And now let Pharaoh look for a discerning and wise man and put him in charge of the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore let Pharaoh select a discerning and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, let Pharaoh select a discerning and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: "Therefore, Pharaoh should find an intelligent and wise man and put him in charge of the entire land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: So now let Pharaoh look for a man discerning and wise, and appoint him over the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: "And now let Pharaoh look for a discerning and wise man and put him in charge of the land of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 法老要这样行，在国中指派官员，当七年丰收的时候，征收埃及地出产的五分之一。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老要这样行，在国中指派官员，当七年丰收的时候，征收埃及地出产的五分之一。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老当这样行，又派官员管理这地。当七个丰年的时候，征收埃及地的五分之一，
verses.textEnNiv: Let Pharaoh appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.
verses.textEnEsv: Let Pharaoh proceed to appoint overseers over the land and take one-fifth of the produce of the land of Egypt during the seven plentiful years.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint officers over the land, to collect one-fifth oftheproduce of the land of Egypt in the seven plentiful years.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh should appoint supervisors over the land and let them collect one-fifth of all the crops during the seven good years.
verses.textEnNasb: Let Pharaoh take action to appoint overseers in charge of the land, and let him take a fifth of the produce of the land of Egypt as a tax in the seven years of abundance.
verses.textEn: Let Pharaoh appoint commissioners over the land to take a fifth of the harvest of Egypt during the seven years of abundance.

verses.textZh: 又叫他们把将要来的七个丰年的粮食收集起来，积蓄五谷归在法老的手下，收在各城里作粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又叫他们把将要来的七个丰年的粮食收集起来，积蓄五谷归在法老的手下，收在各城里作粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫他们把将来丰年一切的粮食聚敛起来，积蓄五谷，收存在各城里做食物，归于法老的手下。
verses.textEnNiv: They should collect all the food of these good years that are coming and store up the grain under the authority of Pharaoh, to be kept in the cities for food.
verses.textEnEsv: And let them gather all the food of these good years that are coming and store up grain under the authority of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And let them gather all the food of those good years that are coming, and store up grain under the authority of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
verses.textEnNlt: Have them gather all the food produced in the good years that are just ahead and bring it to Pharaoh’s storehouses. Store it away, and guard it so there will be food in the cities.
verses.textEnNasb: Then have them collect all the food of these good years that are coming, and store up the grain for food in the cities under Pharaoh’s authority, and have them guard it.
verses.textEn: They should collect all the food of these good years that are coming and store up the grain under the authority of Pharaoh, to be kept in the cities for food.

verses.textZh: 这些粮食要储存起来，可以应付将来埃及地的七年饥荒，免得这地被饥荒所灭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些粮食要储存起来，可以应付将来埃及地的七年饥荒，免得这地被饥荒所灭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所积蓄的粮食可以防备埃及地将来的七个荒年，免得这地被饥荒所灭。」
verses.textEnNiv: This food should be held in reserve for the country, to be used during the seven years of famine that will come upon Egypt, so that the country may not be ruined by the famine."
verses.textEnEsv: That food shall be a reserve for the land against the seven years of famine that are to occur in the land of Egypt, so that the land may not perish through the famine."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then that food shall be as a reserve for the land for the seven years of famine which shall be in the land of Egypt, that the land may not perish during the famine."
verses.textEnNlt: That way there will be enough to eat when the seven years of famine come to the land of Egypt. Otherwise this famine will destroy the land."
verses.textEnNasb: Let the food be used as a reserve for the land for the seven years of famine which will occur in the land of Egypt, so that the land will not perish during the famine."
verses.textEn: This food should be held in reserve for the country, to be used during the seven years of famine that will come upon Egypt, so that the country may not be ruined by the famine."

verses.textZh: 法老和他的臣仆，都赞同这件事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老和他的臣仆，都赞同这件事。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老和他一切臣仆都以这事为妙。
verses.textEnNiv: The plan seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his officials.
verses.textEnEsv: This proposal pleased Pharaoh and all his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the advice was good in the eyes of Pharaoh and in the eyes of all his servants.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph’s suggestions were well received by Pharaoh and his officials.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the proposal seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his servants.
verses.textEn: The plan seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his officials.

verses.textZh: 于是法老对臣仆说："像这样的人，有神的灵在他里面，我们怎能找得着呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是法老对臣仆说："像这样的人，有神的灵在他里面，我们怎能找得着呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对臣仆说：「像这样的人，有神的灵在他里头，我们岂能找得着呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: So Pharaoh asked them, "Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God ?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh said to his servants, "Can we find a man like this, in whom is the Spirit of God?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh said to his servants, "Can we find suchaone as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?"
verses.textEnNlt: So Pharaoh asked his officials, "Can we find anyone else like this man so obviously filled with the spirit of God?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh said to his servants, "Can we find a man like this, in whom there is a divine spirit?"
verses.textEn: So Pharaoh asked them, "Can we find anyone like this man, one in whom is the spirit of God ?"

verses.textZh: 法老对约瑟说："神既然把这事指示了你，就再没有人像你这样有见识有智慧了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老对约瑟说："神既然把这事指示了你，就再没有人像你这样有见识有智慧了。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对约瑟说：「神既将这事都指示你，可见没有人像你这样有聪明有智慧。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one so discerning and wise as you.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Since God has shown you all this, there is none so discerning and wise as you are.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Inasmuch as God has shown you all this, thereis no one as discerning and wise as you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Since God has revealed the meaning of the dreams to you, clearly no one else is as intelligent or wise as you are.
verses.textEnNasb: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Since God has informed you of all this, there is no one as discerning and wise as you are.
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Since God has made all this known to you, there is no one so discerning and wise as you.
