verses.textZh: 你可以掌管我的家，我的人民都要听从你的话；只有在王位上我比你大。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你可以掌管我的家，我的人民都要听从你的话；只有在王位上我比你大。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你可以掌管我的家；我的民都必听从你的话。惟独在宝座上我比你大。」
verses.textEnNiv: You shall be in charge of my palace, and all my people are to submit to your orders. Only with respect to the throne will I be greater than you."
verses.textEnEsv: You shall be over my house, and all my people shall order themselves as you command. Only as regards the throne will I be greater than you."
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall be over my house, and all my people shall be ruled according to your word; only in regard to the throne will I be greater than you."
verses.textEnNlt: You will be in charge of my court, and all my people will take orders from you. Only I, sitting on my throne, will have a rank higher than yours."
verses.textEnNasb: You shall be in charge of my house, and all my people shall be obedient to you; only regarding the throne will I be greater than you."
verses.textEn: You shall be in charge of my palace, and all my people are to submit to your orders. Only with respect to the throne will I be greater than you."

verses.textZh: 法老又对约瑟说："你看，我任命你治理埃及全地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老又对约瑟说："你看，我任命你治理埃及全地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老又对约瑟说：「我派你治理埃及全地。」
verses.textEnNiv: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I hereby put you in charge of the whole land of Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I hereby put you in charge of the entire land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNasb: Pharaoh also said to Joseph, "See, I have placed you over all the land of Egypt."
verses.textEn: So Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I hereby put you in charge of the whole land of Egypt."

verses.textZh: 于是，法老脱下他手上打印的戒指，戴在约瑟的手上；给他穿上细麻的衣服，把金颈炼挂在他的颈项上；
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，法老脱下他手上打印的戒指，戴在约瑟的手上；给他穿上细麻的衣服，把金颈炼挂在他的颈项上；
verses.textZhCuv: 法老就摘下手上打印的戒指，戴在约瑟的手上，给他穿上细麻衣，把金链戴在他的颈项上，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring from his finger and put it on Joseph’s finger. He dressed him in robes of fine linen and put a gold chain around his neck.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring from his hand and put it on Joseph’s hand, and clothed him in garments of fine linen and put a gold chain about his neck.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring off his hand and put it on Joseph’s hand; and he clothed him in garments of fine linen and put a gold chain around his neck.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh removed his signet ring from his hand and placed it on Joseph’s finger. He dressed him in fine linen clothing and hung a gold chain around his neck.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand and put it on Joseph’s hand, and clothed him in garments of fine linen, and put the gold necklace around his neck.
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh took his signet ring from his finger and put it on Joseph’s finger. He dressed him in robes of fine linen and put a gold chain around his neck.

verses.textZh: 又叫约瑟坐在他的副车里，有人在他前面喊着："跪下。"这样，法老任命了约瑟治理埃及全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又叫约瑟坐在他的副车里，有人在他前面喊着："跪下。"这样，法老任命了约瑟治理埃及全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 又叫约瑟坐他的副车，喝道的在前呼叫说：「跪下。」这样，法老派他治理埃及全地。
verses.textEnNiv: He had him ride in a chariot as his second-in-command, and people shouted before him, "Make way !" Thus he put him in charge of the whole land of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And he made him ride in his second chariot. And they called out before him, "Bow the knee!" Thus he set him over all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he had him ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried out before him, "Bow the knee!" So he set him over all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he had Joseph ride in the chariot reserved for his second-in-command. And wherever Joseph went, the command was shouted, "Kneel down!" So Pharaoh put Joseph in charge of all Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: And he had him ride in his second chariot; and they proclaimed ahead of him, " Bow the knee!" And he placed him over all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: He had him ride in a chariot as his second-in-command, and people shouted before him, "Make way !" Thus he put him in charge of the whole land of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 法老对约瑟说："我是法老，但在埃及全地，如果没有你的许可，没有人可以随意作事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老对约瑟说："我是法老，但在埃及全地，如果没有你的许可，没有人可以随意作事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对约瑟说：「我是法老，在埃及全地，若没有你的命令，不许人擅自办事 。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I am Pharaoh, but without your word no one will lift hand or foot in all Egypt."
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I am Pharaoh, and without your consent no one shall lift up hand or foot in all the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNkjv: Pharaoh also said to Joseph, "I am Pharaoh, and without your consent no man may lift his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt."
verses.textEnNlt: And Pharaoh said to him, "I am Pharaoh, but no one will lift a hand or foot in the entire land of Egypt without your approval."
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Though I am Pharaoh, yet without your permission no one shall raise his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt."
verses.textEn: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "I am Pharaoh, but without your word no one will lift hand or foot in all Egypt."

verses.textZh: 法老给约瑟起名叫撒发那忒．巴内亚，又把安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳，给约瑟为妻。约瑟出去巡行埃及全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老给约瑟起名叫撒发那忒．巴内亚，又把安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳，给约瑟为妻。约瑟出去巡行埃及全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 法老赐名给约瑟，叫撒发那忒‧巴内亚，又将安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给他为妻。约瑟就出去巡行埃及地。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-Paneah and gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph went throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-paneah. And he gave him in marriage Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On. So Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphnath-Paaneah. And he gave him as a wife Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On. So Joseph went out over all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh gave Joseph a new Egyptian name, Zaphenath-paneah. He also gave him a wife, whose name was Asenath. She was the daughter of Potiphera, the priest of On. So Joseph took charge of the entire land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh named Joseph Zaphenath-paneah; and he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh gave Joseph the name Zaphenath-Paneah and gave him Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, to be his wife. And Joseph went throughout the land of Egypt.

verses.textZh: 约瑟侍立在埃及王法老面前的时候，年三十岁。约瑟从法老面前出来，遍行埃及全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟侍立在埃及王法老面前的时候，年三十岁。约瑟从法老面前出来，遍行埃及全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟见埃及王法老的时候年三十岁。他从法老面前出去，遍行埃及全地。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh and went through all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: He was thirty years old when he began serving in the court of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. And when Joseph left Pharaoh’s presence, he inspected the entire land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joseph was thirty years old when he stood in the presence of Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh and went through all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from Pharaoh’s presence and traveled throughout Egypt.

verses.textZh: 在七个丰年的时候，地里的出产非常丰盛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在七个丰年的时候，地里的出产非常丰盛。
verses.textZhCuv: 七个丰年之内，地的出产极丰极盛 ，
verses.textEnNiv: During the seven years of abundance the land produced plentifully.
verses.textEnEsv: During the seven plentiful years the earth produced abundantly,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the seven plentiful years the ground brought forth abundantly.
verses.textEnNlt: As predicted, for seven years the land produced bumper crops.
verses.textEnNasb: During the seven years of plenty the land produced abundantly.
verses.textEn: During the seven years of abundance the land produced plentifully.

verses.textZh: 约瑟把埃及七个丰年的一切粮食都收集起来，把粮食存放在城中；各城周围田地所出的粮食，也存放在各城中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟把埃及七个丰年的一切粮食都收集起来，把粮食存放在城中；各城周围田地所出的粮食，也存放在各城中。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟聚敛埃及地七个丰年一切的粮食，把粮食积存在各城里；各城周围田地的粮食都积存在本城里。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph collected all the food produced in those seven years of abundance in Egypt and stored it in the cities. In each city he put the food grown in the fields surrounding it.
verses.textEnEsv: and he gathered up all the food of these seven years, which occurred in the land of Egypt, and put the food in the cities. He put in every city the food from the fields around it.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities; he laid up in every city the food of the fields which surrounded them.
verses.textEnNlt: During those years, Joseph gathered all the crops grown in Egypt and stored the grain from the surrounding fields in the cities.
verses.textEnNasb: So he collected all the food of these seven years which occurred in the land of Egypt and put the food in the cities; he put in every city the food from its own surrounding fields.
verses.textEn: Joseph collected all the food produced in those seven years of abundance in Egypt and stored it in the cities. In each city he put the food grown in the fields surrounding it.

verses.textZh: 约瑟积蓄了极多的五谷，好象海沙那样多，甚至他不再记下数量，因为实在无法计算。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟积蓄了极多的五谷，好象海沙那样多，甚至他不再记下数量，因为实在无法计算。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟积蓄五谷甚多，如同海边的沙，无法计算，因为谷不可胜数。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph stored up huge quantities of grain, like the sand of the sea; it was so much that he stopped keeping records because it was beyond measure.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph stored up grain in great abundance, like the sand of the sea, until he ceased to measure it, for it could not be measured.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joseph gathered very much grain, as the sand of the sea, until he stopped counting, for itwas immeasurable.
verses.textEnNlt: He piled up huge amounts of grain like sand on the seashore. Finally, he stopped keeping records because there was too much to measure.
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph stored up grain in great abundance like the sand of the sea, until he stopped measuring it, for it was beyond measure.
verses.textEn: Joseph stored up huge quantities of grain, like the sand of the sea; it was so much that he stopped keeping records because it was beyond measure.

verses.textZh: 在荒年还没有来到以前，约瑟生了两个儿子，是安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在荒年还没有来到以前，约瑟生了两个儿子，是安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 荒年未到以前，安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生了两个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: Before the years of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
verses.textEnEsv: Before the year of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph. Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore them to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And to Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On, bore to him.
verses.textEnNlt: During this time, before the first of the famine years, two sons were born to Joseph and his wife, Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, the priest of On.
verses.textEnNasb: Now before the year of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
verses.textEn: Before the years of famine came, two sons were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.

verses.textZh: 约瑟给长子起名叫玛拿西，因为他说："神使我忘记我所有的困苦，以及我父的全家。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟给长子起名叫玛拿西，因为他说："神使我忘记我所有的困苦，以及我父的全家。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟给长子起名叫玛拿西 ，因为他说：「神使我忘了一切的困苦和我父的全家。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph named his firstborn Manasseh and said, "It is because God has made me forget all my trouble and all my father’s household."
verses.textEnEsv: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh. "For," he said, "God has made me forget all my hardship and all my father’s house."
verses.textEnNkjv: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: "For God has made me forget all my toil and all my father’s house."
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph named his older son Manasseh, for he said, "God has made me forget all my troubles and everyone in my father’s family."
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh; "For," he said, "God has made me forget all my trouble and all of my father’s household."
verses.textEn: Joseph named his firstborn Manasseh and said, "It is because God has made me forget all my trouble and all my father’s household."

verses.textZh: 他给次子起名叫以法莲，因为他说："神使我在受苦之地繁盛起来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他给次子起名叫以法莲，因为他说："神使我在受苦之地繁盛起来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他给次子起名叫以法莲 ，因为他说：「神使我在受苦的地方昌盛。」
verses.textEnNiv: The second son he named Ephraim and said, "It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering."
verses.textEnEsv: The name of the second he called Ephraim, "For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the name of the second he called Ephraim: "For God has caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction."
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph named his second son Ephraim, for he said, "God has made me fruitful in this land of my grief."
verses.textEnNasb: And he named the second Ephraim; "For," he said, "God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction."
verses.textEn: The second son he named Ephraim and said, "It is because God has made me fruitful in the land of my suffering."

verses.textZh: 埃及地的七年丰收一结束，
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及地的七年丰收一结束，
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及地的七个丰年一完，
verses.textEnNiv: The seven years of abundance in Egypt came to an end,
verses.textEnEsv: The seven years of plenty that occurred in the land of Egypt came to an end,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the seven years of plenty which were in the land of Egypt ended,
verses.textEnNlt: At last the seven years of bumper crops throughout the land of Egypt came to an end.
verses.textEnNasb: When the seven years of plenty which had taken place in the land of Egypt came to an end,
verses.textEn: The seven years of abundance in Egypt came to an end,

verses.textZh: 七年饥荒就随着来了，正像约瑟所说的一样。各地都有饥荒，只有埃及全地仍有粮食，
verses.textZhCnvs: 七年饥荒就随着来了，正像约瑟所说的一样。各地都有饥荒，只有埃及全地仍有粮食，
verses.textZhCuv: 七个荒年就来了。正如约瑟所说的，各地都有饥荒；惟独埃及全地有粮食。
verses.textEnNiv: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all the other lands, but in the whole land of Egypt there was food.
verses.textEnEsv: and the seven years of famine began to come, as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the seven years of famine began to come, as Joseph had said. The famine was in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had predicted. The famine also struck all the surrounding countries, but throughout Egypt there was plenty of food.
verses.textEnNasb: and the seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said, then there was famine in all the lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
verses.textEn: and the seven years of famine began, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all the other lands, but in the whole land of Egypt there was food.

verses.textZh: 等到埃及全地也要挨饿的时候，人民就向法老求粮。法老对所有的埃及人说："你们到约瑟那里去，他吩咐你们甚么，你们就作甚么。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到埃及全地也要挨饿的时候，人民就向法老求粮。法老对所有的埃及人说："你们到约瑟那里去，他吩咐你们甚么，你们就作甚么。"
verses.textZhCuv: 及至埃及全地有了饥荒，众民向法老哀求粮食，法老对他们说：「你们往约瑟那里去，凡他所说的，你们都要做。」
verses.textEnNiv: When all Egypt began to feel the famine, the people cried to Pharaoh for food. Then Pharaoh told all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph and do what he tells you."
verses.textEnEsv: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread. Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread. Then Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph; whatever he says to you, do."
verses.textEnNlt: Eventually, however, the famine spread throughout the land of Egypt as well. And when the people cried out to Pharaoh for food, he told them, "Go to Joseph, and do whatever he tells you."
verses.textEnNasb: So when all the land of Egypt suffered famine, the people cried out to Pharaoh for bread; and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph; whatever he says to you, you shall do."
verses.textEn: When all Egypt began to feel the famine, the people cried to Pharaoh for food. Then Pharaoh told all the Egyptians, "Go to Joseph and do what he tells you."

verses.textZh: 当时饥荒遍及全国，约瑟就开了所有的粮仓，把粮食卖给埃及人，因为埃及地的饥荒非常严重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时饥荒遍及全国，约瑟就开了所有的粮仓，把粮食卖给埃及人，因为埃及地的饥荒非常严重。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时饥荒遍满天下，约瑟开了各处的仓，粜粮给埃及人；在埃及地饥荒甚大。
verses.textEnNiv: When the famine had spread over the whole country, Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe throughout Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: So when the famine had spread over all the land, Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: The famine was over all the face of the earth, and Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold to the Egyptians. And the famine became severe in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So with severe famine everywhere, Joseph opened up the storehouses and distributed grain to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: When the famine was spread over the entire face of the earth, then Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians; and the famine was severe in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: When the famine had spread over the whole country, Joseph opened all the storehouses and sold grain to the Egyptians, for the famine was severe throughout Egypt.

verses.textZh: 各地的人都到埃及去，向约瑟买粮，因为各地的饥荒都非常严重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 各地的人都到埃及去，向约瑟买粮，因为各地的饥荒都非常严重。
verses.textZhCuv: 各地的人都往埃及去，到约瑟那里籴粮，因为天下的饥荒甚大。
verses.textEnNiv: And all the world came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe everywhere.
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, all the earth came to Egypt to Joseph to buy grain, because the famine was severe over all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So all countries came to Joseph in Egypt to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all lands.
verses.textEnNlt: And people from all around came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph because the famine was severe throughout the world.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the people of all the earth came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe in all the earth.
verses.textEn: And all the world came to Egypt to buy grain from Joseph, because the famine was severe everywhere.

verses.textZh: 雅各见埃及有粮食，就对儿子们说："你们为甚么彼此对望呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各见埃及有粮食，就对儿子们说："你们为甚么彼此对望呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各见埃及有粮，就对儿子们说：「你们为什么彼此观望呢？
verses.textEnNiv: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, "Why do you just keep looking at each other?"
verses.textEnEsv: When Jacob learned that there was grain for sale in Egypt, he said to his sons, "Why do you look at one another?"
verses.textEnNkjv: When Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, Jacob said to his sons, "Why do you look at one another?"
verses.textEnNlt: When Jacob heard that grain was available in Egypt, he said to his sons, "Why are you standing around looking at one another?
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, "Why are you staring at one another?"
verses.textEn: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt, he said to his sons, "Why do you just keep looking at each other?"

verses.textZh: 他又说："我听说埃及有粮食，你们下到那里去，给我们买些粮食，使我们可以活下去，不至饿死。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又说："我听说埃及有粮食，你们下到那里去，给我们买些粮食，使我们可以活下去，不至饿死。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见埃及有粮，你们可以下去，从那里为我们籴些来，使我们可以存活，不至于死。」
verses.textEnNiv: He continued, "I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Behold, I have heard that there is grain for sale in Egypt. Go down and buy grain for us there, that we may live and not die."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Indeed I have heard that there is grain in Egypt; go down to that place and buy for us there, that we may live and not die."
verses.textEnNlt: I have heard there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy enough grain to keep us alive. Otherwise we’ll die."
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Look, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt; go down there and buy some for us from that place, so that we may live and not die."
verses.textEn: He continued, "I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there and buy some for us, so that we may live and not die."

verses.textZh: 于是，约瑟的十个哥哥就下去了，要从埃及买五谷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约瑟的十个哥哥就下去了，要从埃及买五谷。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，约瑟的十个哥哥都下埃及籴粮去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: So ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain in Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joseph’s ten older brothers went down to Egypt to buy grain.
verses.textEnNasb: So ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.
verses.textEn: Then ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

verses.textZh: 但雅各并没有打发约瑟的弟弟便雅悯与哥哥们同去，因为雅各说："恐怕他会遇到灾害。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但雅各并没有打发约瑟的弟弟便雅悯与哥哥们同去，因为雅各说："恐怕他会遇到灾害。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但约瑟的兄弟便雅悯，雅各没有打发他和哥哥们同去，因为雅各说：「恐怕他遭害。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with the others, because he was afraid that harm might come to him.
verses.textEnEsv: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers, for he feared that harm might happen to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he said, "Lest some calamity befall him."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jacob wouldn’t let Joseph’s younger brother, Benjamin, go with them, for fear some harm might come to him.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers, for he said, "I am afraid that harm may happen to him."
verses.textEn: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with the others, because he was afraid that harm might come to him.

verses.textZh: 以色列的众子也在前来买粮的人群中，因为迦南地也有饥荒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的众子也在前来买粮的人群中，因为迦南地也有饥荒。
verses.textZhCuv: 来籴粮的人中有以色列的儿子们，因为迦南地也有饥荒。
verses.textEnNiv: So Israel’s sons were among those who went to buy grain, for there was famine in the land of Canaan also.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus the sons of Israel came to buy among the others who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Israel went to buy grain among those who journeyed, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob’s sons arrived in Egypt along with others to buy food, for the famine was in Canaan as well.
verses.textEnNasb: So the sons of Israel came to buy grain among those who were coming, because the famine was also in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEn: So Israel’s sons were among those who went to buy grain, for there was famine in the land of Canaan also.

verses.textZh: 当时治理埃及地的官长是约瑟，卖粮给那地所有的人民的就是他。所以，约瑟的哥哥们来俯伏在地向他下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时治理埃及地的官长是约瑟，卖粮给那地所有的人民的就是他。所以，约瑟的哥哥们来俯伏在地向他下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时治理埃及地的是约瑟；粜粮给那地众民的就是他。约瑟的哥哥们来了，脸伏于地，向他下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Joseph was the governor of the land, the person who sold grain to all its people. So when Joseph’s brothers arrived, they bowed down to him with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Now Joseph was governor over the land. He was the one who sold to all the people of the land. And Joseph’s brothers came and bowed themselves before him with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now Joseph was governor over the land; and it was he who sold to all the people of the land. And Joseph’s brothers came and bowed down before him with their faces to the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Since Joseph was governor of all Egypt and in charge of selling grain to all the people, it was to him that his brothers came. When they arrived, they bowed before him with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joseph was the ruler over the land; he was the one who sold grain to all the people of the land. And Joseph’s brothers came and bowed down to him with their faces to the ground.
verses.textEn: Now Joseph was the governor of the land, the person who sold grain to all its people. So when Joseph’s brothers arrived, they bowed down to him with their faces to the ground.

verses.textZh: 约瑟看见他的哥哥们，就认得他们，可是他装作陌生人，对他们说严厉的话，问他们："你们是哪里来的？"他们回答："我们是迦南地来买粮食的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟看见他的哥哥们，就认得他们，可是他装作陌生人，对他们说严厉的话，问他们："你们是哪里来的？"他们回答："我们是迦南地来买粮食的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟看见他哥哥们，就认得他们，却装作生人，向他们说些严厉话，问他们说：「你们从哪里来？」他们说：「我们从迦南地来籴粮。」
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he pretended to be a stranger and spoke harshly to them. "Where do you come from?" he asked. "From the land of Canaan," they replied, "to buy food."
verses.textEnEsv: Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he treated them like strangers and spoke roughly to them. "Where do you come from?" he said. They said, "From the land of Canaan, to buy food."
verses.textEnNkjv: Joseph saw his brothers and recognized them, but he acted as a stranger to them and spoke roughly to them. Then he said to them, "Where do you come from?" And they said, "From the land of Canaan to buy food."
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph recognized his brothers instantly, but he pretended to be a stranger and spoke harshly to them. "Where are you from?" he demanded. "From the land of Canaan," they replied. "We have come to buy food."
verses.textEnNasb: When Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he disguised himself to them and spoke to them harshly. He said to them, "Where have you come from?" And they said, "From the land of Canaan, to buy food."
verses.textEn: As soon as Joseph saw his brothers, he recognized them, but he pretended to be a stranger and spoke harshly to them. "Where do you come from?" he asked. "From the land of Canaan," they replied, "to buy food."

verses.textZh: 约瑟认得他的哥哥们，他们却不认得他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟认得他的哥哥们，他们却不认得他。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟认得他哥哥们，他们却不认得他。
verses.textEnNiv: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joseph recognized his brothers, but they did not recognize him.
verses.textEnNlt: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they didn’t recognize him.
verses.textEnNasb: But Joseph had recognized his brothers, although they did not recognize him.
verses.textEn: Although Joseph recognized his brothers, they did not recognize him.

verses.textZh: 约瑟想起从前所作关于他们的两个梦，就对他们说："你们是间谍，是来侦察本地的虚实。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟想起从前所作关于他们的两个梦，就对他们说："你们是间谍，是来侦察本地的虚实。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟想起从前所做的那两个梦，就对他们说：「你们是奸细，来窥探这地的虚实。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he remembered his dreams about them and said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see where our land is unprotected."
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph remembered the dreams that he had dreamed of them. And he said to them, "You are spies; you have come to see the nakedness of the land."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph remembered the dreams which he had dreamed about them, and said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land!"
verses.textEnNlt: And he remembered the dreams he’d had about them many years before. He said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see how vulnerable our land has become."
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he had about them, and he said to them, "You are spies; you have come to look at the undefended parts of our land."
verses.textEn: Then he remembered his dreams about them and said to them, "You are spies! You have come to see where our land is unprotected."

verses.textZh: 他们对他说："我主啊，不是这样，仆人们实在是来买粮食的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对他说："我主啊，不是这样，仆人们实在是来买粮食的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对他说：「我主啊，不是的。仆人们是籴粮来的。
verses.textEnNiv: "No, my lord," they answered. "Your servants have come to buy food.
verses.textEnEsv: They said to him, "No, my lord, your servants have come to buy food.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to him, "No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.
verses.textEnNlt: "No, my lord!" they exclaimed. "Your servants have simply come to buy food.
verses.textEnNasb: And they said to him, "No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.
verses.textEn: "No, my lord," they answered. "Your servants have come to buy food.

verses.textZh: 我们都是一个人的儿子，是诚实人；仆人们并不是间谍。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们都是一个人的儿子，是诚实人；仆人们并不是间谍。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们都是一个人的儿子，是诚实人；仆人们并不是奸细。」
verses.textEnNiv: We are all the sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies."
verses.textEnEsv: We are all sons of one man. We are honest men. Your servants have never been spies."
verses.textEnNkjv: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men; your servants are not spies."
verses.textEnNlt: We are all brothers—members of the same family. We are honest men, sir! We are not spies!"
verses.textEnNasb: We are all sons of one man; we are honest men, your servants are not spies."
verses.textEn: We are all the sons of one man. Your servants are honest men, not spies."

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他们说："不是的，你们实在是来侦察本地的虚实。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对他们说："不是的，你们实在是来侦察本地的虚实。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟说：「不然，你们必是窥探这地的虚实来的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "No!" he said to them. "You have come to see where our land is unprotected."
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "No, it is the nakedness of the land that you have come to see."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said to them, "No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land."
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes, you are!" Joseph insisted. "You have come to see how vulnerable our land has become."
verses.textEnNasb: Yet he said to them, "No, but you have come to look at the undefended parts of our land!"
verses.textEn: "No!" he said to them. "You have come to see where our land is unprotected."

verses.textZh: 他们说："仆人们本是兄弟十二人，我们都是迦南地一个人的儿子。最小的现在与我们的父亲在一起，还有一个不在了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："仆人们本是兄弟十二人，我们都是迦南地一个人的儿子。最小的现在与我们的父亲在一起，还有一个不在了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「仆人们本是弟兄十二人，是迦南地一个人的儿子，顶小的现今在我们的父亲那里，有一个没有了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But they replied, "Your servants were twelve brothers, the sons of one man, who lives in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan, and behold, the youngest is this day with our father, and one is no more."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said, "Your servants are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and in fact, the youngest is with our father today, and one is no more."
verses.textEnNlt: "Sir," they said, "there are actually twelve of us. We, your servants, are all brothers, sons of a man living in the land of Canaan. Our youngest brother is back there with our father right now, and one of our brothers is no longer with us."
verses.textEnNasb: But they said, "Your servants are twelve brothers in all, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is with our father today, and one is no longer alive."
verses.textEn: But they replied, "Your servants were twelve brothers, the sons of one man, who lives in the land of Canaan. The youngest is now with our father, and one is no more."

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他们说："我刚才对你们说：‘你们是间谍。’这话实在不错。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对他们说："我刚才对你们说：‘你们是间谍。’这话实在不错。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟说：「我才说你们是奸细，这话实在不错。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph said to them, "It is just as I told you: You are spies!
verses.textEnEsv: But Joseph said to them, "It is as I said to you. You are spies.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Joseph said to them, "It is as I spoke to you, saying, ‘You are spies!’
verses.textEnNlt: But Joseph insisted, "As I said, you are spies!
verses.textEnNasb: Yet Joseph said to them, "It is as I said to you, you are spies;
verses.textEn: Joseph said to them, "It is just as I told you: You are spies!

verses.textZh: 我要这样试试你们：我指着法老的性命起誓，如果你们最小的弟弟不到这里来，你们就决不得离开这里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要这样试试你们：我指着法老的性命起誓，如果你们最小的弟弟不到这里来，你们就决不得离开这里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我指着法老的性命起誓，若是你们的小兄弟不到这里来，你们就不得出这地方，从此就可以把你们证验出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you will not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
verses.textEnEsv: By this you shall be tested: by the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go from this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
verses.textEnNkjv: In this manner you shall be tested: By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.
verses.textEnNlt: This is how I will test your story. I swear by the life of Pharaoh that you will never leave Egypt unless your youngest brother comes here!
verses.textEnNasb: by this you will be tested: by the life of Pharaoh, you shall not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here!
verses.textEn: And this is how you will be tested: As surely as Pharaoh lives, you will not leave this place unless your youngest brother comes here.

verses.textZh: 你们可以派你们中间一个人回去，把你们的弟弟带来；其余的人都要囚禁起来，好证明你们的话真实不真实。如果不真实，我指着法老的性命起誓，你们就是间谍。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们可以派你们中间一个人回去，把你们的弟弟带来；其余的人都要囚禁起来，好证明你们的话真实不真实。如果不真实，我指着法老的性命起誓，你们就是间谍。"
verses.textZhCuv: 须要打发你们中间一个人去，把你们的兄弟带来。至于你们，都要囚在这里，好证验你们的话真不真，若不真，我指着法老的性命起誓，你们一定是奸细。」
verses.textEnNiv: Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are telling the truth. If you are not, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!"
verses.textEnEsv: Send one of you, and let him bring your brother, while you remain confined, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you. Or else, by the life of Pharaoh, surely you are spies."
verses.textEnNkjv: Send one of you, and let him bring your brother; and you shall be kept in prison, that your words may be tested to see whether thereis any truth in you; or else, by the life of Pharaoh, surely you are spies!"
verses.textEnNlt: One of you must go and get your brother. I’ll keep the rest of you here in prison. Then we’ll find out whether or not your story is true. By the life of Pharaoh, if it turns out that you don’t have a younger brother, then I’ll know you are spies."
verses.textEnNasb: Send one of you and have him get your brother, while you remain confined, so that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you. But if not, by the life of Pharaoh, you are certainly spies!"
verses.textEn: Send one of your number to get your brother; the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are telling the truth. If you are not, then as surely as Pharaoh lives, you are spies!"

verses.textZh: 于是，约瑟把他们收在监房里三天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约瑟把他们收在监房里三天。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约瑟把他们都下在监里三天。
verses.textEnNiv: And he put them all in custody for three days.
verses.textEnEsv: And he put them all together in custody for three days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he put them all together in prison three days.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joseph put them all in prison for three days.
verses.textEnNasb: So he put them all together in prison for three days.
verses.textEn: And he put them all in custody for three days.

verses.textZh: 到了第三天，约瑟对他们说："我是敬畏神的，你们要这样作，就可以活着；
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了第三天，约瑟对他们说："我是敬畏神的，你们要这样作，就可以活着；
verses.textZhCuv: 到第三天，约瑟对他们说：「我是敬畏神的；你们照我的话行就可以存活。
verses.textEnNiv: On the third day, Joseph said to them, "Do this and you will live, for I fear God:
verses.textEnEsv: On the third day Joseph said to them, "Do this and you will live, for I fear God:
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph said to them the third day, "Do this and live, for I fear God:
verses.textEnNlt: On the third day Joseph said to them, "I am a God-fearing man. If you do as I say, you will live.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joseph said to them on the third day, "Do this and live, for I fear God:
verses.textEn: On the third day, Joseph said to them, "Do this and you will live, for I fear God:

verses.textZh: 如果你们是诚实人，就叫你们兄弟中一个人囚禁在监里，你们其余的人可以带着粮食回去，解救你们家人的饥荒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们是诚实人，就叫你们兄弟中一个人囚禁在监里，你们其余的人可以带着粮食回去，解救你们家人的饥荒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们如果是诚实人，可以留你们中间的一个人囚在监里，但你们可以带着粮食回去，救你们家里的饥荒。
verses.textEnNiv: If you are honest men, let one of your brothers stay here in prison, while the rest of you go and take grain back for your starving households.
verses.textEnEsv: if you are honest men, let one of your brothers remain confined where you are in custody, and let the rest go and carry grain for the famine of your households,
verses.textEnNkjv: If you are honest men, let one of your brothers be confined to your prison house; but you, go and carry grain for the famine of your houses.
verses.textEnNlt: If you really are honest men, choose one of your brothers to remain in prison. The rest of you may go home with grain for your starving families.
verses.textEnNasb: if you are honest men, let one of your brothers be confined in your prison; but as for the rest of you, go, carry grain for the famine of your households,
verses.textEn: If you are honest men, let one of your brothers stay here in prison, while the rest of you go and take grain back for your starving households.

verses.textZh: 然后把你们最小的弟弟带到我这里来，这样，就可以证明你们的话是真实的，你们就不必死了。"他们就照样作了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后把你们最小的弟弟带到我这里来，这样，就可以证明你们的话是真实的，你们就不必死了。"他们就照样作了。
verses.textZhCuv: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，如此，你们的话便有证据，你们也不至于死。」他们就照样而行。
verses.textEnNiv: But you must bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words may be verified and that you may not die." This they proceeded to do.
verses.textEnEsv: and bring your youngest brother to me. So your words will be verified, and you shall not die." And they did so.
verses.textEnNkjv: And bring your young est brother to me; so your words will be verified, and you shall not die." And they did so.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must bring your youngest brother back to me. This will prove that you are telling the truth, and you will not die." To this they agreed.
verses.textEnNasb: and bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words may be verified, and you will not die." And they did so.
verses.textEn: But you must bring your youngest brother to me, so that your words may be verified and that you may not die." This they proceeded to do.

verses.textZh: 他们彼此说："我们在对待弟弟的事上实在有罪。他向我们求情的时候，我们看见他心里的痛苦，却不肯听他，所以这次苦难临到我们身上了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们彼此说："我们在对待弟弟的事上实在有罪。他向我们求情的时候，我们看见他心里的痛苦，却不肯听他，所以这次苦难临到我们身上了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们彼此说：「我们在兄弟身上实在有罪。他哀求我们的时候，我们见他心里的愁苦，却不肯听，所以这场苦难临到我们身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: They said to one another, "Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw how distressed he was when he pleaded with us for his life, but we would not listen; that’s why this distress has come on us."
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said to one another, "In truth we are guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us and we did not listen. That is why this distress has come upon us."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to one another, "We are truly guilty concerning our brother, for we saw the anguish of his soul when he pleaded with us, and we would not hear; therefore this distress has come upon us."
verses.textEnNlt: Speaking among themselves, they said, "Clearly we are being punished because of what we did to Joseph long ago. We saw his anguish when he pleaded for his life, but we wouldn’t listen. That’s why we’re in this trouble."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to one another, "Truly we are guilty concerning our brother, because we saw the distress of his soul when he pleaded with us, yet we would not listen; for that reason this distress has happened to us."
verses.textEn: They said to one another, "Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw how distressed he was when he pleaded with us for his life, but we would not listen; that’s why this distress has come on us."

verses.textZh: 流本回答他们，说："我不是对你们说过：‘不要伤害那孩子’吗？可是你们不肯听，现在流他血的罪要向我们追讨。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本回答他们，说："我不是对你们说过：‘不要伤害那孩子’吗？可是你们不肯听，现在流他血的罪要向我们追讨。"
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便说：「我岂不是对你们说过，不可伤害那孩子吗？只是你们不肯听，所以流他血的罪向我们追讨。」
verses.textEnNiv: Reuben replied, "Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you wouldn’t listen! Now we must give an accounting for his blood."
verses.textEnEsv: And Reuben answered them, "Did I not tell you not to sin against the boy? But you did not listen. So now there comes a reckoning for his blood."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Reuben answered them, saying, "Did I not speak to you, saying, ‘Do not sin against the boy’; and you would not listen? Therefore behold, his blood is now required of us."
verses.textEnNlt: "Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy?" Reuben asked. "But you wouldn’t listen. And now we have to answer for his blood!"
verses.textEnNasb: Reuben answered them, saying, "Did I not tell you, ‘Do not sin against the boy’; and you would not listen? Now justice for his blood is required."
verses.textEn: Reuben replied, "Didn’t I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you wouldn’t listen! Now we must give an accounting for his blood."

verses.textZh: 他们不知道约瑟听得明白，因为他们中间有人当传译。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们不知道约瑟听得明白，因为他们中间有人当传译。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们不知道约瑟听得出来，因为在他们中间用通事传话。
verses.textEnNiv: They did not realize that Joseph could understand them, since he was using an interpreter.
verses.textEnEsv: They did not know that Joseph understood them, for there was an interpreter between them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But they did not know that Joseph understood them, for he spoke to them through an interpreter.
verses.textEnNlt: Of course, they didn’t know that Joseph understood them, for he had been speaking to them through an interpreter.
verses.textEnNasb: They did not know, however, that Joseph understood, for there was an interpreter between them.
verses.textEn: They did not realize that Joseph could understand them, since he was using an interpreter.

verses.textZh: 约瑟转身离开他们，哭了一阵，又回到他们那里，与他们说话。然后从他们中间拉出西缅来，在他们眼前把他捆绑起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟转身离开他们，哭了一阵，又回到他们那里，与他们说话。然后从他们中间拉出西缅来，在他们眼前把他捆绑起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟转身退去，哭了一场，又回来对他们说话，就从他们中间挑出西缅来，在他们眼前把他捆绑。
verses.textEnNiv: He turned away from them and began to weep, but then came back and spoke to them again. He had Simeon taken from them and bound before their eyes.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he turned away from them and wept. And he returned to them and spoke to them. And he took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he turned himself away from them and wept. Then he returned to them again, and talked with them. And he took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: Now he turned away from them and began to weep. When he regained his composure, he spoke to them again. Then he chose Simeon from among them and had him tied up right before their eyes.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he turned away from them and wept. But when he returned to them and spoke to them, he took Simeon from them and bound him before their eyes.
verses.textEn: He turned away from them and began to weep, but then came back and spoke to them again. He had Simeon taken from them and bound before their eyes.

verses.textZh: 约瑟吩咐人把五谷装满他们的袋，把他们的银子放回各人的布袋里；又给他们路上用的食物。一切就照样办了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟吩咐人把五谷装满他们的袋，把他们的银子放回各人的布袋里；又给他们路上用的食物。一切就照样办了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟吩咐人把粮食装满他们的器具，把各人的银子归还在各人的口袋里，又给他们路上用的食物，人就照他的话办了。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to put each man’s silver back in his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. After this was done for them,
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, and to replace every man’s money in his sack, and to give them provisions for the journey. This was done for them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their sacks with grain, to restore every man’s money to his sack, and to give them provisions for the journey. Thus he did for them.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph then ordered his servants to fill the men’s sacks with grain, but he also gave secret instructions to return each brother’s payment at the top of his sack. He also gave them supplies for their journey home.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, but also to return every man’s money in his sack, and to give them provisions for the journey. And that is what was done for them.
verses.textEn: Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain, to put each man’s silver back in his sack, and to give them provisions for their journey. After this was done for them,

verses.textZh: 他们把粮食驮在他们的驴上，离开那里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把粮食驮在他们的驴上，离开那里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就把粮食驮在驴上，离开那里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: they loaded their grain on their donkeys and left.
verses.textEnEsv: Then they loaded their donkeys with their grain and departed.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they loaded their donkeys with the grain and departed from there.
verses.textEnNlt: So the brothers loaded their donkeys with the grain and headed for home.
verses.textEnNasb: So they loaded their donkeys with their grain and departed from there.
verses.textEn: they loaded their grain on their donkeys and left.

verses.textZh: 到了住宿的地方，他们其中的一个人打开了布袋，要拿饲料喂驴的时候，才发现自己的银子还在袋口那里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了住宿的地方，他们其中的一个人打开了布袋，要拿饲料喂驴的时候，才发现自己的银子还在袋口那里。
verses.textZhCuv: 到了住宿的地方，他们中间有一个人打开口袋，要拿料喂驴，才看见自己的银子仍在口袋里，
verses.textEnNiv: At the place where they stopped for the night one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of his sack.
verses.textEnEsv: And as one of them opened his sack to give his donkey fodder at the lodging place, he saw his money in the mouth of his sack.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as one ofthem opened his sack to give his donkey feed at the encampment, he saw his money; and there it was, in the mouth of his sack.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they stopped for the night and one of them opened his sack to get grain for his donkey, he found his money in the top of his sack.
verses.textEnNasb: But when one of them opened his sack to give his donkey feed at the overnight campsite, he saw his money; and behold, it was in the opening of his sack!
verses.textEn: At the place where they stopped for the night one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey, and he saw his silver in the mouth of his sack.

verses.textZh: 于是对兄弟们说："我的银子都归还了。你们看，就在我的布袋里。"他们就心里惊慌，彼此战战兢兢地说："神向我们作的是甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是对兄弟们说："我的银子都归还了。你们看，就在我的布袋里。"他们就心里惊慌，彼此战战兢兢地说："神向我们作的是甚么呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 就对弟兄们说：「我的银子归还了，看哪，仍在我口袋里！」他们就提心吊胆，战战兢兢地彼此说：「这是神向我们做什么呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: "My silver has been returned," he said to his brothers. "Here it is in my sack." Their hearts sank and they turned to each other trembling and said, "What is this that God has done to us?"
verses.textEnEsv: He said to his brothers, "My money has been put back; here it is in the mouth of my sack!" At this their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, "What is this that God has done to us?"
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to his brothers, "My money has been restored, and there it is, in my sack!" Then their hearts failed them and they were afraid, saying to one another, "What is this that God has done to us?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Look!" he exclaimed to his brothers. "My money has been returned; it’s here in my sack!" Then their hearts sank. Trembling, they said to each other, "What has God done to us?"
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to his brothers, "My money has been returned, and look, it is right in my sack!" Then their hearts sank, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, "What is this that God has done to us?"
verses.textEn: "My silver has been returned," he said to his brothers. "Here it is in my sack." Their hearts sank and they turned to each other trembling and said, "What is this that God has done to us?"

verses.textZh: 他们回到迦南地他们的父亲雅各那里，把他们遭遇的一切事都告诉了他，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回到迦南地他们的父亲雅各那里，把他们遭遇的一切事都告诉了他，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 他们来到迦南地、他们的父亲雅各那里，将所遭遇的事都告诉他，说：
verses.textEnNiv: When they came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them. They said,
verses.textEnEsv: When they came to Jacob their father in the land of Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they went to Jacob their father in the land of Canaan and told him all that had happened to them, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: When the brothers came to their father, Jacob, in the land of Canaan, they told him everything that had happened to them.
verses.textEnNasb: When they came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they told him everything that had happened to them, saying,
verses.textEn: When they came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan, they told him all that had happened to them. They said,

verses.textZh: "那地的主人对我们说了一些严厉的话，把我们当作侦察那地的间谍。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那地的主人对我们说了一些严厉的话，把我们当作侦察那地的间谍。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那地的主对我们说严厉的话，把我们当作窥探那地的奸细。
verses.textEnNiv: "The man who is lord over the land spoke harshly to us and treated us as though we were spying on the land.
verses.textEnEsv: "The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly to us and took us to be spies of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "The man whois lord of the land spoke roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.textEnNlt: "The man who is governor of the land spoke very harshly to us," they told him. "He accused us of being spies scouting the land.
verses.textEnNasb: "The man, the lord of the land, spoke harshly with us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.textEn: "The man who is lord over the land spoke harshly to us and treated us as though we were spying on the land.

verses.textZh: 我们对他说：‘我们是诚实人，并不是间谍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们对他说：‘我们是诚实人，并不是间谍。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们对他说：『我们是诚实人，并不是奸细。
verses.textEnNiv: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we are not spies.
verses.textEnEsv: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we have never been spies.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we are not spies.
verses.textEnNlt: But we said, ‘We are honest men, not spies.
verses.textEnNasb: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we are not spies.
verses.textEn: But we said to him, ‘We are honest men; we are not spies.

verses.textZh: 我们本是兄弟十二人，都是一个父亲的儿子；有一个不在了，最小的现在与我们的父亲一起在迦南地。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们本是兄弟十二人，都是一个父亲的儿子；有一个不在了，最小的现在与我们的父亲一起在迦南地。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我们本是弟兄十二人，都是一个父亲的儿子，有一个没有了，顶小的如今同我们的父亲在迦南地。』
verses.textEnNiv: We were twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in Canaan.’
verses.textEnEsv: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father. One is no more, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan.’
verses.textEnNkjv: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is with our father this day in the land of Canaan.’
verses.textEnNlt: We are twelve brothers, sons of one father. One brother is no longer with us, and the youngest is at home with our father in the land of Canaan.’
verses.textEnNasb: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no longer alive, and the youngest is with our father today in the land of Canaan.’
verses.textEn: We were twelve brothers, sons of one father. One is no more, and the youngest is now with our father in Canaan.’

verses.textZh: 那地的主人对我们说：‘我用这个办法就可以知道你们是不是诚实人：你们兄弟中要留下一人在我这里，其余的人可以带着粮食回去，解救你们家人的饥荒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地的主人对我们说：‘我用这个办法就可以知道你们是不是诚实人：你们兄弟中要留下一人在我这里，其余的人可以带着粮食回去，解救你们家人的饥荒。
verses.textZhCuv: 那地的主对我们说：『若要我知道你们是诚实人，可以留下你们中间的一个人在我这里，你们可以带着粮食回去，救你们家里的饥荒。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then the man who is lord over the land said to us, ‘This is how I will know whether you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me, and take food for your starving households and go.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I shall know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your households, and go your way.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the man, the lord of the country, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me, take foodfor the famine of your households, and be gone.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then the man who is governor of the land told us, ‘This is how I will find out if you are honest men. Leave one of your brothers here with me, and take grain for your starving families and go on home.
verses.textEnNasb: But the man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me and take grain for the famine of your households, and go.
verses.textEn: "Then the man who is lord over the land said to us, ‘This is how I will know whether you are honest men: Leave one of your brothers here with me, and take food for your starving households and go.

verses.textZh: 然后把你们最小的弟弟带到我这里来，我就知道你们不是间谍，而是诚实人了。这样，我就把你们的兄弟交还给你们，你们也可以在这地自由来往。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后把你们最小的弟弟带到我这里来，我就知道你们不是间谍，而是诚实人了。这样，我就把你们的兄弟交还给你们，你们也可以在这地自由来往。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，我便知道你们不是奸细，乃是诚实人。这样，我就把你们的弟兄交给你们，你们也可以在这地做买卖。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But bring your youngest brother to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I shall know that you are not spies but honest men, and I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: And bring your youngest brother to me; so I shall know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. I will grant your brother to you, and you may trade in the land.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But you must bring your youngest brother back to me. Then I will know you are honest men and not spies. Then I will give you back your brother, and you may trade freely in the land.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But bring your youngest brother to me so that I may know that you are not spies, but honest men. I will give your brother to you, and you may trade in the land.’ "
verses.textEn: But bring your youngest brother to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men. Then I will give your brother back to you, and you can trade in the land.’ "

verses.textZh: 后来他们倒布袋的时候，不料各人的银包仍然在各人的布袋里。他们和他们的父亲看见了银包，就都惧怕起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来他们倒布袋的时候，不料各人的银包仍然在各人的布袋里。他们和他们的父亲看见了银包，就都惧怕起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 后来他们倒口袋，不料，各人的银包都在口袋里；他们和父亲看见银包就都害怕。
verses.textEnNiv: As they were emptying their sacks, there in each man’s sack was his pouch of silver! When they and their father saw the money pouches, they were frightened.
verses.textEnEsv: As they emptied their sacks, behold, every man’s bundle of money was in his sack. And when they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened as they emptied their sacks, that surprisingly each man’s bundle of money was in his sack; and when they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.textEnNlt: As they emptied out their sacks, there in each man’s sack was the bag of money he had paid for the grain! The brothers and their father were terrified when they saw the bags of money.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about, as they were emptying their sacks, that behold, every man’s bag of money was in his sack; and when they and their father saw their bags of money, they were afraid.
verses.textEn: As they were emptying their sacks, there in each man’s sack was his pouch of silver! When they and their father saw the money pouches, they were frightened.

verses.textZh: 他们的父亲雅各对他们说："你们总是使我丧失儿子：约瑟没有了，西缅也没有了，你们还要把便雅悯带走；每一件事都是针对我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的父亲雅各对他们说："你们总是使我丧失儿子：约瑟没有了，西缅也没有了，你们还要把便雅悯带走；每一件事都是针对我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的父亲雅各对他们说：「你们使我丧失我的儿子：约瑟没有了，西缅也没有了，你们又要将便雅悯带去；这些事都归到我身上了。」
verses.textEnNiv: Their father Jacob said to them, "You have deprived me of my children. Joseph is no more and Simeon is no more, and now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is against me!"
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob their father said to them, "You have bereaved me of my children: Joseph is no more, and Simeon is no more, and now you would take Benjamin. All this has come against me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob their father said to them, "You have bereaved me: Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin. All these things are against me."
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob exclaimed, "You are robbing me of my children! Joseph is gone! Simeon is gone! And now you want to take Benjamin, too. Everything is going against me!"
verses.textEnNasb: And their father Jacob said to them, "You have deprived me of my sons: Joseph is gone, and Simeon is gone, and now you would take Benjamin; all these things are against me."
verses.textEn: Their father Jacob said to them, "You have deprived me of my children. Joseph is no more and Simeon is no more, and now you want to take Benjamin. Everything is against me!"

verses.textZh: 流本对他父亲说："如果我不把他带回来给你，你可以杀死我的两个儿子；只管把他交给我吧，我必把他带回来给你。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本对他父亲说："如果我不把他带回来给你，你可以杀死我的两个儿子；只管把他交给我吧，我必把他带回来给你。"
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便对他父亲说：「我若不带他回来交给你，你可以杀我的两个儿子。只管把他交在我手里，我必带他回来交给你。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Reuben said to his father, "You may put both of my sons to death if I do not bring him back to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him back."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Reuben said to his father, "Kill my two sons if I do not bring him back to you. Put him in my hands, and I will bring him back to you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Reuben spoke to his father, saying, "Kill my two sons if I do not bring him back to you; put him in my hands, and I will bring him back to you."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Reuben said to his father, "You may kill my two sons if I don’t bring Benjamin back to you. I’ll be responsible for him, and I promise to bring him back."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Reuben spoke to his father, saying, "You may put my two sons to death if I do not bring him back to you; put him in my care, and I will return him to you."
verses.textEn: Then Reuben said to his father, "You may put both of my sons to death if I do not bring him back to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him back."

verses.textZh: 雅各说："我的儿子不可与你们一同下去，因为他的哥哥死了，只剩下他一个；如果他在你们所走的路上遇到不幸，你们就使我这白发老人愁愁苦苦地下阴间去了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各说："我的儿子不可与你们一同下去，因为他的哥哥死了，只剩下他一个；如果他在你们所走的路上遇到不幸，你们就使我这白发老人愁愁苦苦地下阴间去了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各说：「我的儿子不可与你们一同下去；他哥哥死了，只剩下他，他若在你们所行的路上遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。」
verses.textEnNiv: But Jacob said, "My son will not go down there with you; his brother is dead and he is the only one left. If harm comes to him on the journey you are taking, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in sorrow."
verses.textEnEsv: But he said, "My son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead, and he is the only one left. If harm should happen to him on the journey that you are to make, you would bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol."
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said, "My son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead, and he is left alone. If any calamity should befall him along the way in which you go, then you would bring down my gray hair with sorrow to the grave."
verses.textEnNlt: But Jacob replied, "My son will not go down with you. His brother Joseph is dead, and he is all I have left. If anything should happen to him on your journey, you would send this grieving, white-haired man to his grave. "
verses.textEnNasb: But Jacob said, "My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he alone is left. If harm should happen to him on the journey you are taking, then you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow."
verses.textEn: But Jacob said, "My son will not go down there with you; his brother is dead and he is the only one left. If harm comes to him on the journey you are taking, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in sorrow."

verses.textZh: 那地的饥荒十分严重。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那地的饥荒十分严重。
verses.textZhCuv: 那地的饥荒甚大。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the famine was still severe in the land.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the famine was severe in the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the famine was severe in the land.
verses.textEnNlt: But the famine continued to ravage the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the famine was severe in the land.
verses.textEn: Now the famine was still severe in the land.

verses.textZh: 他们把从埃及带回来的粮食都吃完了。他们的父亲就对他们说："你们再去替我们买些粮食回来吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们把从埃及带回来的粮食都吃完了。他们的父亲就对他们说："你们再去替我们买些粮食回来吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从埃及带来的粮食吃尽了，他们的父亲就对他们说：「你们再去给我籴些粮来。」
verses.textEnNiv: So when they had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, "Go back and buy us a little more food."
verses.textEnEsv: And when they had eaten the grain that they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, "Go again, buy us a little food."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it came to pass, when they had eaten up the grain which they had brought from Egypt, that their father said to them, "Go back, buy us a little food."
verses.textEnNlt: When the grain they had brought from Egypt was almost gone, Jacob said to his sons, "Go back and buy us a little more food."
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about, when they had finished eating the grain which they had brought from Egypt, that their father said to them, "Go back, buy us a little food."
verses.textEn: So when they had eaten all the grain they had brought from Egypt, their father said to them, "Go back and buy us a little more food."

verses.textZh: 犹大对他说："那人认真地警告我们说：‘如果你们的弟弟不与你们一起来，你们就不得见我的面。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大对他说："那人认真地警告我们说：‘如果你们的弟弟不与你们一起来，你们就不得见我的面。’
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大对他说：「那人谆谆地告诫我们说：『你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。』
verses.textEnNiv: But Judah said to him, "The man warned us solemnly, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’
verses.textEnEsv: But Judah said to him, "The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But Judah spoke to him, saying, "The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.’
verses.textEnNlt: But Judah said, "The man was serious when he warned us, ‘You won’t see my face again unless your brother is with you.’
verses.textEnNasb: Judah spoke to him, however, saying, "The man sternly warned us, ‘You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.’
verses.textEn: But Judah said to him, "The man warned us solemnly, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’

verses.textZh: 如果你让我们的弟弟与我们同去，我们就下去替你买粮食。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你让我们的弟弟与我们同去，我们就下去替你买粮食。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若打发我们的兄弟与我们同去，我们就下去给你籴粮；
verses.textEnNiv: If you will send our brother along with us, we will go down and buy food for you.
verses.textEnEsv: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food.
verses.textEnNlt: If you send Benjamin with us, we will go down and buy more food.
verses.textEnNasb: If you send our brother with us, we will go down and buy you food.
verses.textEn: If you will send our brother along with us, we will go down and buy food for you.

verses.textZh: 如果你不让他去，我们也不下去，因为那人对我们说：‘如果你们的弟弟不与你们一起来，你们就不得见我的面。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你不让他去，我们也不下去，因为那人对我们说：‘如果你们的弟弟不与你们一起来，你们就不得见我的面。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你若不打发他去，我们就不下去，因为那人对我们说：『你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。』」
verses.textEnNiv: But if you will not send him, we will not go down, because the man said to us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But if you will not send him, we will not go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you will not send him, we will not go down; for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face unless your brother is with you.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: But if you don’t let Benjamin go, we won’t go either. Remember, the man said, ‘You won’t see my face again unless your brother is with you.’"
verses.textEnNasb: But if you do not send him, we will not go down; for the man said to us, ‘You will not see my face unless your brother is with you.’ "
verses.textEn: But if you will not send him, we will not go down, because the man said to us, ‘You will not see my face again unless your brother is with you.’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列说："你们为甚么这样害我，告诉那人你们还有个弟弟呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列说："你们为甚么这样害我，告诉那人你们还有个弟弟呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列说：「你们为什么这样害我，告诉那人你们还有兄弟呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Israel asked, "Why did you bring this trouble on me by telling the man you had another brother?"
verses.textEnEsv: Israel said, "Why did you treat me so badly as to tell the man that you had another brother?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Israel said, "Why did you deal so wrongfully with me as to tell the man whether you had still another brother?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why were you so cruel to me?" Jacob moaned. "Why did you tell him you had another brother?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Israel said, "Why did you treat me so badly, by telling the man whether you still had another brother?"
verses.textEn: Israel asked, "Why did you bring this trouble on me by telling the man you had another brother?"

verses.textZh: 他们回答："那人确实查问有关我们和我们亲属的事，说：‘你们的父亲还活着吗？你们还有其他的兄弟吗？’我们就照着这些话回答他。我们怎么知道他会说：‘你们必要把你们的弟弟带下来’呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们回答："那人确实查问有关我们和我们亲属的事，说：‘你们的父亲还活着吗？你们还有其他的兄弟吗？’我们就照着这些话回答他。我们怎么知道他会说：‘你们必要把你们的弟弟带下来’呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们回答说：「那人详细问到我们和我们的亲属，说：『你们的父亲还在吗？你们还有兄弟吗？』我们就按着他所问的告诉他，焉能知道他要说『必须把你们的兄弟带下来』呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "The man questioned us closely about ourselves and our family. ‘Is your father still living?’ he asked us. ‘Do you have another brother?’ We simply answered his questions. How were we to know he would say, ‘Bring your brother down here’?"
verses.textEnEsv: They replied, "The man questioned us carefully about ourselves and our kindred, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Do you have another brother?’ What we told him was in answer to these questions. Could we in any way know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But they said, "The man asked us pointedly about ourselves and our family, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ And we told him according to these words. Could we possibly have known that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?"
verses.textEnNlt: "The man kept asking us questions about our family," they replied. "He asked, ‘Is your father still alive? Do you have another brother?’ So we answered his questions. How could we know he would say, ‘Bring your brother down here’?"
verses.textEnNasb: But they said, "The man specifically asked about us and our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ So we answered his questions. Could we possibly know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?"
verses.textEn: They replied, "The man questioned us closely about ourselves and our family. ‘Is your father still living?’ he asked us. ‘Do you have another brother?’ We simply answered his questions. How were we to know he would say, ‘Bring your brother down here’?"

verses.textZh: 犹大对他父亲以色列说："你若打发那孩子与我同去，我们就立刻起程，好叫我们和你，以及我们的孩子都可以存活，不至饿死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大对他父亲以色列说："你若打发那孩子与我同去，我们就立刻起程，好叫我们和你，以及我们的孩子都可以存活，不至饿死。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大又对他父亲以色列说：「你打发童子与我同去，我们就起身下去，好叫我们和你，并我们的妇人孩子，都得存活，不至于死。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Judah said to Israel his father, "Send the boy along with me and we will go at once, so that we and you and our children may live and not die.
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah said to Israel his father, "Send the boy with me, and we will arise and go, that we may live and not die, both we and you and also our little ones.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judah said to Israel his father, "Send the lad with me, and we will arise and go, that we may live and not die, both we and you and also our little ones.
verses.textEnNlt: Judah said to his father, "Send the boy with me, and we will be on our way. Otherwise we will all die of starvation—and not only we, but you and our little ones.
verses.textEnNasb: So Judah said to his father Israel, "Send the boy with me and we will arise and go, so that we may live and not die, we as well as you and our little ones.
verses.textEn: Then Judah said to Israel his father, "Send the boy along with me and we will go at once, so that we and you and our children may live and not die.

verses.textZh: 我愿意亲自担保他的安全，你可以从我手里追回他。如果我不把他带回来给你，交在你面前，我愿终生承担这罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我愿意亲自担保他的安全，你可以从我手里追回他。如果我不把他带回来给你，交在你面前，我愿终生承担这罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 我为他作保；你可以从我手中追讨，我若不带他回来交在你面前，我情愿永远担罪。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself will guarantee his safety; you can hold me personally responsible for him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him here before you, I will bear the blame before you all my life.
verses.textEnEsv: I will be a pledge of his safety. From my hand you shall require him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever.
verses.textEnNkjv: I myself will be surety for him; from my hand you shall require him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever.
verses.textEnNlt: I personally guarantee his safety. You may hold me responsible if I don’t bring him back to you. Then let me bear the blame forever.
verses.textEnNasb: I myself will take responsibility for him! You may demand him back from me. If I do not bring him back to you and present him to you, then you can let me take the blame forever.
verses.textEn: I myself will guarantee his safety; you can hold me personally responsible for him. If I do not bring him back to you and set him here before you, I will bear the blame before you all my life.

verses.textZh: 要不是我们耽延，现在第二次也回来了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 要不是我们耽延，现在第二次也回来了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若没有耽搁，如今第二次都回来了。」
verses.textEnNiv: As it is, if we had not delayed, we could have gone and returned twice."
verses.textEnEsv: If we had not delayed, we would now have returned twice."
verses.textEnNkjv: For if we had not lingered, surely by now we would have returned this second time."
verses.textEnNlt: If we hadn’t wasted all this time, we could have gone and returned twice by now."
verses.textEnNasb: For if we had not delayed, surely by now we could have returned twice."
verses.textEn: As it is, if we had not delayed, we could have gone and returned twice."

verses.textZh: 他们的父亲以色列对他们说："如果必须如此，你们就这样作：你们把本地最好的出产放在袋里，带下去给那人作礼物，就是一点乳香、一点蜂蜜、香料、没药、粟子和杏仁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的父亲以色列对他们说："如果必须如此，你们就这样作：你们把本地最好的出产放在袋里，带下去给那人作礼物，就是一点乳香、一点蜂蜜、香料、没药、粟子和杏仁。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的父亲以色列说：「若必须如此，你们就当这样行：可以将这地土产中最好的乳香、蜂蜜、香料、没药、榧子、杏仁都取一点，收在器具里，带下去送给那人作礼物，
verses.textEnNiv: Then their father Israel said to them, "If it must be, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your bags and take them down to the man as a gift—a little balm and a little honey, some spices and myrrh, some pistachio nuts and almonds.
verses.textEnEsv: Then their father Israel said to them, "If it must be so, then do this: take some of the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry a present down to the man, a little balm and a little honey, gum, myrrh, pistachio nuts, and almonds.
verses.textEnNkjv: And their father Israel said to them, "If itmustbe so, then do this: Take some of the best fruits of the land in your vessels and carry down a present for the man—a little balm and a little honey, spices and myrrh, pistachio nuts and almonds.
verses.textEnNlt: So their father, Jacob, finally said to them, "If it can’t be avoided, then at least do this. Pack your bags with the best products of this land. Take them down to the man as gifts—balm, honey, gum, aromatic resin, pistachio nuts, and almonds.
verses.textEnNasb: Then their father Israel said to them, "If it must be so, then do this: take some of the best products of the land in your bags, and carry down to the man as a gift, a little balsam and a little honey, labdanum resin and myrrh, pistachio nuts and almonds.
verses.textEn: Then their father Israel said to them, "If it must be, then do this: Put some of the best products of the land in your bags and take them down to the man as a gift—a little balm and a little honey, some spices and myrrh, some pistachio nuts and almonds.

verses.textZh: 你们手里要多带一倍银子，因为你们要把那放回在你们袋口里的银子带回去，那可能是弄错了的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们手里要多带一倍银子，因为你们要把那放回在你们袋口里的银子带回去，那可能是弄错了的。
verses.textZhCuv: 又要手里加倍地带银子，并将归还在你们口袋内的银子仍带在手里；那或者是错了。
verses.textEnNiv: Take double the amount of silver with you, for you must return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.
verses.textEnEsv: Take double the money with you. Carry back with you the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take double money in your hand, and take back in your hand the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks; perhaps it was an oversight.
verses.textEnNlt: Also take double the money that was put back in your sacks, as it was probably someone’s mistake.
verses.textEnNasb: And take double the money in your hand, and take back in your hand the money that was returned in the opening of your sacks; perhaps it was a mistake.
verses.textEn: Take double the amount of silver with you, for you must return the silver that was put back into the mouths of your sacks. Perhaps it was a mistake.

verses.textZh: 你们带着你们的弟弟，起程再到那人那里去吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们带着你们的弟弟，起程再到那人那里去吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 也带着你们的兄弟，起身去见那人。
verses.textEnNiv: Take your brother also and go back to the man at once.
verses.textEnEsv: Take also your brother, and arise, go again to the man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Take your brother also, and arise, go back to the man.
verses.textEnNlt: Then take your brother, and go back to the man.
verses.textEnNasb: Take your brother also, and arise, return to the man;
verses.textEn: Take your brother also and go back to the man at once.

verses.textZh: 愿全能的神使那人怜悯你们，给你们释放你们那个兄弟和便雅悯。至于我，如果要丧失儿子，就丧失了吧。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿全能的神使那人怜悯你们，给你们释放你们那个兄弟和便雅悯。至于我，如果要丧失儿子，就丧失了吧。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿全能的神使你们在那人面前蒙怜悯，释放你们的那弟兄和便雅悯回来。我若丧了儿子，就丧了吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: And may God Almighty grant you mercy before the man so that he will let your other brother and Benjamin come back with you. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved."
verses.textEnEsv: May God Almighty grant you mercy before the man, and may he send back your other brother and Benjamin. And as for me, if I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved."
verses.textEnNkjv: And may God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved, I am bereaved!"
verses.textEnNlt: May God Almighty give you mercy as you go before the man, so that he will release Simeon and let Benjamin return. But if I must lose my children, so be it."
verses.textEnNasb: and may God Almighty grant you compassion in the sight of the man, so that he will release to you your other brother and Benjamin. And as for me, if I am bereaved of my sons, I am bereaved!"
verses.textEn: And may God Almighty grant you mercy before the man so that he will let your other brother and Benjamin come back with you. As for me, if I am bereaved, I am bereaved."

verses.textZh: 于是，他们带着这些礼物，手里拿着多一倍的银子，并且带着便雅悯，起程下到埃及去，站在约瑟面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，他们带着这些礼物，手里拿着多一倍的银子，并且带着便雅悯，起程下到埃及去，站在约瑟面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，他们拿着那礼物，又手里加倍地带银子，并且带着便雅悯，起身下到埃及，站在约瑟面前。
verses.textEnNiv: So the men took the gifts and double the amount of silver, and Benjamin also. They hurried down to Egypt and presented themselves to Joseph.
verses.textEnEsv: So the men took this present, and they took double the money with them, and Benjamin. They arose and went down to Egypt and stood before Joseph.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the men took that present and Benjamin, and they took double money in their hand, and arose and went down to Egypt; and they stood before Joseph.
verses.textEnNlt: So the men packed Jacob’s gifts and double the money and headed off with Benjamin. They finally arrived in Egypt and presented themselves to Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: So the men took this gift, and they took double the money in their hand, and Benjamin; then they set out and went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.
verses.textEn: So the men took the gifts and double the amount of silver, and Benjamin also. They hurried down to Egypt and presented themselves to Joseph.

verses.textZh: 约瑟见便雅悯与他们同来，就对管家说："把这些人带到我家里，要宰杀牲畜，预备筵席，因为在正午的时候，这些人要与我一起吃饭。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟见便雅悯与他们同来，就对管家说："把这些人带到我家里，要宰杀牲畜，预备筵席，因为在正午的时候，这些人要与我一起吃饭。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟见便雅悯和他们同来，就对家宰说：「将这些人领到屋里。要宰杀牲畜，预备筵席，因为晌午这些人同我吃饭。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, "Take these men to my house, slaughter an animal and prepare a meal; they are to eat with me at noon."
verses.textEnEsv: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, "Bring the men into the house, and slaughter an animal and make ready, for the men are to dine with me at noon."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, "Take these men to my home, and slaughter an animal and make ready; for these men will dine with me at noon."
verses.textEnNlt: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the manager of his household, "These men will eat with me this noon. Take them inside the palace. Then go slaughter an animal, and prepare a big feast."
verses.textEnNasb: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to his house steward, "Bring the men into the house, and slaughter an animal and make preparations; for the men are to dine with me at noon."
verses.textEn: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, "Take these men to my house, slaughter an animal and prepare a meal; they are to eat with me at noon."

verses.textZh: 管家就照着约瑟所吩咐的去作，把这些人带到约瑟的家里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 管家就照着约瑟所吩咐的去作，把这些人带到约瑟的家里。
verses.textZhCuv: 家宰就遵着约瑟的命去行，领他们进约瑟的屋里。
verses.textEnNiv: The man did as Joseph told him and took the men to Joseph’s house.
verses.textEnEsv: The man did as Joseph told him and brought the men to Joseph’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the man did as Joseph ordered, and the man brought the men into Joseph’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: So the man did as Joseph told him and took them into Joseph’s palace.
verses.textEnNasb: So the man did as Joseph said, and brought the men to Joseph’s house.
verses.textEn: The man did as Joseph told him and took the men to Joseph’s house.

verses.textZh: 他们因为被领到约瑟的家里，就害怕起来，说："我们被领到这里来，必定是为了头一次放回在我们袋里的银子，现在他们想攻击我们，制伏我们，逼我们作奴仆，又夺去我们的驴。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们因为被领到约瑟的家里，就害怕起来，说："我们被领到这里来，必定是为了头一次放回在我们袋里的银子，现在他们想攻击我们，制伏我们，逼我们作奴仆，又夺去我们的驴。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们因为被领到约瑟的屋里，就害怕，说：「领我们到这里来，必是因为头次归还在我们口袋里的银子，找我们的错缝，下手害我们，强取我们为奴仆，抢夺我们的驴。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now the men were frightened when they were taken to his house. They thought, "We were brought here because of the silver that was put back into our sacks the first time. He wants to attack us and overpower us and seize us as slaves and take our donkeys."
