verses.textEnEsv: And the men were afraid because they were brought to Joseph’s house, and they said, "It is because of the money, which was replaced in our sacks the first time, that we are brought in, so that he may assault us and fall upon us to make us servants and seize our donkeys."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the men were afraid because they were brought into Joseph’s house; and they said, "Itis because of the money, which was returned in our sacks the first time, that we are brought in, so that he may make a case against us and seize us, to take us as slaves with our donkeys."
verses.textEnNlt: The brothers were terrified when they saw that they were being taken into Joseph’s house. "It’s because of the money someone put in our sacks last time we were here," they said. "He plans to pretend that we stole it. Then he will seize us, make us slaves, and take our donkeys."
verses.textEnNasb: Now the men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, "It is because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time that we are being brought in, so that he may attack us and overpower us, and take us as slaves with our donkeys."
verses.textEn: Now the men were frightened when they were taken to his house. They thought, "We were brought here because of the silver that was put back into our sacks the first time. He wants to attack us and overpower us and seize us as slaves and take our donkeys."

verses.textZh: 管家说："你们可以放心，不要害怕，是你们的神，你们父亲的神，把财宝赐给你们，放在你们的布袋里。你们的银子我早已收到了。"接着他把西缅带出来交给他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 管家说："你们可以放心，不要害怕，是你们的神，你们父亲的神，把财宝赐给你们，放在你们的布袋里。你们的银子我早已收到了。"接着他把西缅带出来交给他们。

verses.textEnNiv: "It’s all right," he said. "Don’t be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks; I received your silver." Then he brought Simeon out to them.
verses.textEnEsv: He replied, "Peace to you, do not be afraid. Your God and the God of your father has put treasure in your sacks for you. I received your money." Then he brought Simeon out to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he said, "Peace be with you, do not be afraid. Your God and the God of your father has given you treasure in your sacks; I had your money." Then he brought Simeon out to them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Relax. Don’t be afraid," the household manager told them. "Your God, the God of your father, must have put this treasure into your sacks. I know I received your payment." Then he released Simeon and brought him out to them.
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "Peace be to you, do not be afraid. Your God and the God of your father has given you treasure in your sacks; your money was in my possession." Then he brought Simeon out to them.
verses.textEn: "It’s all right," he said. "Don’t be afraid. Your God, the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks; I received your silver." Then he brought Simeon out to them.

verses.textZh: 约瑟先向他们问安，然后又问："你们的父亲，就是你们所说的那老人家平安吗？他还在吗？"

verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟问他们好，又问：「你们的父亲－就是你们所说的那老人家平安吗？他还在吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: He asked them how they were, and then he said, "How is your aged father you told me about? Is he still living?"

verses.textEnNiv: They replied, "Your servant our father is still alive and well." And they bowed down, prostrating themselves before him.

verses.textZh: 约瑟举目观看，看见自己同母所生的弟弟便雅悯，就问："这就是你们向我提过那最小的弟弟吗？"又说："我儿啊，愿神赐恩给你。"

verses.textZh: 约瑟爱弟弟之情激动起来，就急忙去找个可哭的地方。于是他进了自己的内室，在那里哭了一阵。

verses.textEnNiv: Deeply moved at the sight of his brother, Joseph hurried out and looked for a place to weep. He went into his private room and wept there.

verses.textZh: 他洗了面，然后出来，抑制着自己的感情，吩咐人说："开饭吧。"

verses.textEnNiv: They served him by himself, the brothers by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because Egyptians could not eat with Hebrews, for that is detestable to Egyptians.

verses.textEnNlt: The waiters served Joseph at his own table, and his brothers were served at a separate table. The Egyptians who ate with Joseph sat at their own table, because Egyptians despise Hebrews and refuse to eat with them.

verses.textZh: 约瑟使众兄弟在他面前排列坐下，都是照着他们长幼的次序。众兄弟就彼此对望，惊奇不已。

verses.textEnNiv: When portions were served to them from Joseph’s table, Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as anyone else’s. So they feasted and drank freely with him.

verses.textZh: 你看，我们从前在袋口发现的银子，尚且从迦南地带来还给你，我们又怎会从你主人的家里偷取金银呢？

verses.textZh: 犹大说："我们对我主可以说甚么呢？我们还有甚么可说的呢？我们怎能证明自己是清白的呢？神已经查出你仆人们的罪孽了。看哪，我们和那在他手里搜出杯来的，都是我主的奴仆了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大说："我们对我主可以说甚么呢？我们还有甚么可说的呢？我们怎能证明自己是清白的呢？神已经查出你仆人们的罪孽了。看哪，我们和那在他手里搜出杯来的，都是我主的奴仆了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大说：「我们对我主说什么呢？还有什么话可说呢？我们怎能自己表白出来呢？神已经查出仆人的罪孽了。我们与那在他手中搜出杯来的都是我主的奴仆。」
verses.textEnNiv: "What can we say to my lord?" Judah replied. "What can we say? How can we prove our innocence? God has uncovered your servants’ guilt. We are now my lord’s slaves—we ourselves and the one who was found to have the cup."
verses.textEnEsv: And Judah said, "What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak? Or how can we clear ourselves? God has found out the guilt of your servants; behold, we are my lord’s servants, both we and he also in whose hand the cup has been found."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judah said, "What shall we say to my lord? What shall we speak? Or how shall we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants; here we are, my lord’s slaves, both we and he also with whom the cup was found."
verses.textEnNlt: Judah answered, "Oh, my lord, what can we say to you? How can we explain this? How can we prove our innocence? God is punishing us for our sins. My lord, we have all returned to be your slaves—all of us, not just our brother who had your cup in his sack."
verses.textEnNasb: So Judah said, "What can we say to my lord? What words can we speak? And how can we justify ourselves? God has found out the guilt of your servants; behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and the one in whose possession the cup has been found."
verses.textEn: "What can we say to my lord?" Judah replied. "What can we say? How can we prove our innocence? God has uncovered your servants’ guilt. We are now my lord’s slaves—we ourselves and the one who was found to have the cup."

verses.textZh: 约瑟说："我绝不能这样作。在谁的手里搜出杯来，谁就要作我的奴仆；你们其余的人，可以平平安安地上你们父亲那里去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟说："我绝不能这样作。在谁的手里搜出杯来，谁就要作我的奴仆；你们其余的人，可以平平安安地上你们父亲那里去。"

verses.textEnNlt: "No," Joseph said. "I would never do such a thing! Only the man who stole the cup will be my slave. The rest of you may go back to your father in peace."
verses.textEnNasb: But he said, "Far be it from me to do this. The man in whose possession the cup has been found, he shall be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father."
verses.textEn: But Joseph said, "Far be it from me to do such a thing! Only the man who was found to have the cup will become my slave. The rest of you, go back to your father in peace."

verses.textEnNiv: Then Judah went up to him and said: "Pardon your servant, my lord, let me speak a word to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, though you are equal to Pharaoh himself.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Judah went up to him and said, "Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and let not your anger burn against your servant, for you are like Pharaoh himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Judah came near to him and said: "O my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s hearing, and do not let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even like Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Judah stepped forward and said, "Please, my lord, let your servant say just one word to you. Please, do not be angry with me, even though you are as powerful as Pharaoh himself.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Judah approached him and said, "Oh my lord, may your servant please speak a word in my lord’s ears, and do not be angry with your servant; for you are equal to Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: Then Judah went up to him and said: "Pardon your servant, my lord, let me speak a word to my lord. Do not be angry with your servant, though you are equal to Pharaoh himself.

verses.textEnNlt: "My lord, previously you asked us, your servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’
verses.textEnNasb: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father or a brother?’
verses.textEn: My lord asked his servants, ‘Do you have a father or a brother?’

verses.textZh: 我们曾经回答我主：‘我们还有年老的父亲和最小的弟弟，是他年老时所生的。他的哥哥死了，他母亲只剩下他一个孩子，他父亲非常爱他。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们曾经回答我主：‘我们还有年老的父亲和最小的弟弟，是他年老时所生的。他的哥哥死了，他母亲只剩下他一个孩子，他父亲非常爱他。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我们对我主说：『我们有父亲，已经年老，还有他老年所生的一个小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母亲只撇下他一人，他父亲疼爱他。』
verses.textEnNiv: And we answered, ‘We have an aged father, and there is a young son born to him in his old age. His brother is dead, and he is the only one of his mother’s sons left, and his father loves him.’
verses.textEnEsv: And we said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a young brother, the child of his old age. His brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother’s children, and his father loves him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And we said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, whois young; his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother’s children, and his father loves him.’
verses.textEnNlt: And we responded, ‘Yes, my lord, we have a father who is an old man, and his youngest son is a child of his old age. His full brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother’s children, and his father loves him very much.’
verses.textEnNasb: And we said to my lord, ‘We have an old father and a little boy born in our father’s old age. Now his brother is dead, so he alone is left of his mother, and his father loves him.’
verses.textEn: And we answered, ‘We have an aged father, and there is a young son born to him in his old age. His brother is dead, and he is the only one of his mother’s sons left, and his father loves him.’

verses.textZh: 你就对仆人们说：‘把他带下来到我这里，我要亲眼看看他。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就对仆人们说：‘把他带下来到我这里，我要亲眼看看他。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你对仆人说：『把他带到我这里来，叫我亲眼看看他。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so I can see him for myself.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’
verses.textEnNlt: "And you said to us, ‘Bring him here so I can see him with my own eyes.’
verses.textEnNasb: Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so that I may set my eyes on him.’
verses.textEn: "Then you said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me so I can see him for myself.’

verses.textZh: 我们对我主说：‘那孩子是不能离开他父亲的；如果离开了，他父亲必定死。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们对我主说：‘那孩子是不能离开他父亲的；如果离开了，他父亲必定死。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我们对我主说：『童子不能离开他父亲，若是离开，他父亲必死。』
verses.textEnNiv: And we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father; if he leaves him, his father will die.’
verses.textEnEsv: We said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And we said to my lord, ‘The lad cannot leave his father, for if he should leave his father, hisfather would die.’
verses.textEnNlt: But we said to you, ‘My lord, the boy cannot leave his father, for his father would die.’
verses.textEnNasb: But we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’
verses.textEn: And we said to my lord, ‘The boy cannot leave his father; if he leaves him, his father will die.’

verses.textZh: 你对仆人们说：‘如果你们最小的弟弟不与你们一同下来，你们就不得见我的面。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 你对仆人们说：‘如果你们最小的弟弟不与你们一同下来，你们就不得见我的面。’
verses.textZhCuv: 你对仆人说：『你们的小兄弟若不与你们一同下来，你们就不得再见我的面。』
verses.textEnNiv: But you told your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then you said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall not see my face again.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But you said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you shall see my face no more.’
verses.textEnNlt: But you told us, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes with you, you will never see my face again.’
verses.textEnNasb: You said to your servants, however, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’
verses.textEn: But you told your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will not see my face again.’

verses.textZh: 于是，我们上到你仆人我们的父亲那里，就把我主的话告诉了他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，我们上到你仆人我们的父亲那里，就把我主的话告诉了他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们上到你仆人－我们父亲那里，就把我主的话告诉了他。
verses.textEnNiv: When we went back to your servant my father, we told him what my lord had said.
verses.textEnEsv: "When we went back to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: "So it was, when we went up to your servant my father, that we told him the words of my lord.
verses.textEnNlt: "So we returned to your servant, our father, and told him what you had said.
verses.textEnNasb: So it came about when we went up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.
verses.textEn: When we went back to your servant my father, we told him what my lord had said.

verses.textZh: 后来我们的父亲说：‘你们再去替我们买些粮食回来吧。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来我们的父亲说：‘你们再去替我们买些粮食回来吧。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的父亲说：『你们再去给我籴些粮来。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy a little more food.’
verses.textEnEsv: And when our father said, ‘Go again, buy us a little food,’
verses.textEnNkjv: And our father said, ‘Go back and buy us a little food.’
verses.textEnNlt: Later, when he said, ‘Go back again and buy us more food,’
verses.textEnNasb: And our father said, ‘Go back, buy us a little food.’
verses.textEn: "Then our father said, ‘Go back and buy a little more food.’

verses.textZh: 我们就说：‘我们不能下去，如果有我们最小的弟弟与我们同去，我们就下去；因为我们最小的弟弟不与我们同去，我们就不得见那人的面。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们就说：‘我们不能下去，如果有我们最小的弟弟与我们同去，我们就下去；因为我们最小的弟弟不与我们同去，我们就不得见那人的面。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我们就说：『我们不能下去。我们的小兄弟若和我们同往，我们就可以下去。因为，小兄弟若不与我们同往，我们必不得见那人的面。』
verses.textEnNiv: But we said, ‘We cannot go down. Only if our youngest brother is with us will we go. We cannot see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.’
verses.textEnEsv: we said, ‘We cannot go down. If our youngest brother goes with us, then we will go down. For we cannot see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But we said, ‘We cannot go down; if our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down; for we may not see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.’
verses.textEnNlt: we replied, ‘We can’t go unless you let our youngest brother go with us. We’ll never get to see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.’
verses.textEnNasb: But we said, ‘We cannot go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down; for we cannot see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.’
verses.textEn: But we said, ‘We cannot go down. Only if our youngest brother is with us will we go. We cannot see the man’s face unless our youngest brother is with us.’

verses.textZh: 你仆人我的父亲对我们说：‘你们知道我的妻子只给我生了两个儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你仆人我的父亲对我们说：‘你们知道我的妻子只给我生了两个儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你仆人－我父亲对我们说：『你们知道我的妻子给我生了两个儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: "Your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
verses.textEnEsv: Then your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons;
verses.textEnNlt: "Then my father said to us, ‘As you know, my wife had two sons,
verses.textEnNasb: Then your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons;
verses.textEn: "Your servant my father said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.

verses.textZh: 一个已经离开我去了，我想他必定是被野兽撕碎了；直到现在，我也没有见过他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一个已经离开我去了，我想他必定是被野兽撕碎了；直到现在，我也没有见过他。
verses.textZhCuv: 一个离开我出去了；我说他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也没有见他。
verses.textEnNiv: One of them went away from me, and I said, "He has surely been torn to pieces." And I have not seen him since.
verses.textEnEsv: One left me, and I said, "Surely he has been torn to pieces," and I have never seen him since.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the one went out from me, and I said, "Surely he is torn to pieces"; and I have not seen him since.
verses.textEnNlt: and one of them went away and never returned. Doubtless he was torn to pieces by some wild animal. I have never seen him since.
verses.textEnNasb: and the one left me, and I said, "Surely he is torn to pieces," and I have not seen him since.
verses.textEn: One of them went away from me, and I said, "He has surely been torn to pieces." And I have not seen him since.

verses.textZh: 现在你们又要把这个从我面前带去，如果他遇到不幸，你们就使我这个白发老人，悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们又要把这个从我面前带去，如果他遇到不幸，你们就使我这个白发老人，悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们又要把这个带去离开我，倘若他遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。』
verses.textEnNiv: If you take this one from me too and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in misery.’
verses.textEnEsv: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs in evil to Sheol.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But if you take this one also from me, and calamity befalls him, you shall bring down my gray hair with sorrow to the grave.’
verses.textEnNlt: Now if you take his brother away from me, and any harm comes to him, you will send this grieving, white-haired man to his grave. ’
verses.textEnNasb: If you also take this one from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow.’
verses.textEn: If you take this one from me too and harm comes to him, you will bring my gray head down to the grave in misery.’

verses.textZh: 我父亲的命与这孩子的命，是相连在一起的。现在我回到你仆人我的父亲那里，如果没有孩子与我们在一起，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我父亲的命与这孩子的命，是相连在一起的。现在我回到你仆人我的父亲那里，如果没有孩子与我们在一起，
verses.textZhCuv: 我父亲的命与这童子的命相连。如今我回到你仆人－我父亲那里，若没有童子与我们同在，
verses.textEnNiv: "So now, if the boy is not with us when I go back to your servant my father, and if my father, whose life is closely bound up with the boy’s life,
verses.textEnEsv: "Now therefore, as soon as I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us, then, as his life is bound up in the boy’s life,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now therefore, when I come to your servant my father, and the lad is not with us, since his life is bound up in the lad’s life,
verses.textEnNlt: "And now, my lord, I cannot go back to my father without the boy. Our father’s life is bound up in the boy’s life.
verses.textEnNasb: So now, when I come to your servant, my father, and the boy is not with us—since our father’s life is so attached to the boy’s life—
verses.textEn: "So now, if the boy is not with us when I go back to your servant my father, and if my father, whose life is closely bound up with the boy’s life,

verses.textZh: 他一见没有孩子，就必定死；这样，你仆人们就使你仆人我们的父亲，这个白发老人，愁愁苦苦地下阴间去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他一见没有孩子，就必定死；这样，你仆人们就使你仆人我们的父亲，这个白发老人，愁愁苦苦地下阴间去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的父亲见没有童子，他就必死。这便是我们使你仆人－我们的父亲白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。
verses.textEnNiv: sees that the boy isn’t there, he will die. Your servants will bring the gray head of our father down to the grave in sorrow.
verses.textEnEsv: as soon as he sees that the boy is not with us, he will die, and your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant our father with sorrow to Sheol.
verses.textEnNkjv: it will happen, when he sees that the lad is not withus, that he will die. So your servants will bring down the gray hair of your servant our father with sorrow to the grave.
verses.textEnNlt: If he sees that the boy is not with us, our father will die. We, your servants, will indeed be responsible for sending that grieving, white-haired man to his grave.
verses.textEnNasb: when he sees that the boy is not with us, he will die. So your servants will bring the gray hair of your servant, our father, down to Sheol in sorrow.
verses.textEn: sees that the boy isn’t there, he will die. Your servants will bring the gray head of our father down to the grave in sorrow.

verses.textZh: 因为仆人曾经向父亲担保这孩子的安全，说：‘如果我不把他带回来交还给你，我就在父亲面前终生承担这罪。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为仆人曾经向父亲担保这孩子的安全，说：‘如果我不把他带回来交还给你，我就在父亲面前终生承担这罪。’
verses.textZhCuv: 因为仆人曾向我父亲为这童子作保，说：『我若不带他回来交给父亲，我便在父亲面前永远担罪。』
verses.textEnNiv: Your servant guaranteed the boy’s safety to my father. I said, ‘If I do not bring him back to you, I will bear the blame before you, my father, all my life!’
verses.textEnEsv: For your servant became a pledge of safety for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I do not bring him back to you, then I shall bear the blame before my father all my life.’
verses.textEnNkjv: For your servant became surety for the lad to my father, saying, ‘If I do not bring him back to you, then I shall bear the blame before my father forever.’
verses.textEnNlt: My lord, I guaranteed to my father that I would take care of the boy. I told him, ‘If I don’t bring him back to you, I will bear the blame forever.’
verses.textEnNasb: For your servant accepted responsibility for the boy from my father, saying, ‘If I do not bring him back to you, then my father can let me take the blame forever.’
verses.textEn: Your servant guaranteed the boy’s safety to my father. I said, ‘If I do not bring him back to you, I will bear the blame before you, my father, all my life!’

verses.textZh: 现在求你容许仆人留下，代替这孩子作我主的奴仆，让这孩子与他的哥哥们一同上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在求你容许仆人留下，代替这孩子作我主的奴仆，让这孩子与他的哥哥们一同上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在求你容仆人住下，替这童子作我主的奴仆，叫童子和他哥哥们一同上去。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, please let your servant remain here as my lord’s slave in place of the boy, and let the boy return with his brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, please let your servant remain instead of the boy as a servant to my lord, and let the boy go back with his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, please let your servant remain instead of the lad as a slave to my lord, and let the lad go up with his brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: "So please, my lord, let me stay here as a slave instead of the boy, and let the boy return with his brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: So now, please let your servant remain as a slave to my lord instead of the boy, and let the boy go up with his brothers.
verses.textEn: "Now then, please let your servant remain here as my lord’s slave in place of the boy, and let the boy return with his brothers.

verses.textZh: 因为如果孩子没有与我同去，我怎能上去见我的父亲呢？恐怕我会看见灾祸临到我父亲身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为如果孩子没有与我同去，我怎能上去见我的父亲呢？恐怕我会看见灾祸临到我父亲身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去见我父亲呢？恐怕我看见灾祸临到我父亲身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: How can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? No! Do not let me see the misery that would come on my father."
verses.textEnEsv: For how can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? I fear to see the evil that would find my father."
verses.textEnNkjv: For how shall I go up to my father if the lad is not with me, lest perhaps I see the evil that would come upon my father?"
verses.textEnNlt: For how can I return to my father if the boy is not with me? I couldn’t bear to see the anguish this would cause my father!"
verses.textEnNasb: For how shall I go up to my father if the boy is not with me? I fear that I may see the evil that would overtake my father."
verses.textEn: How can I go back to my father if the boy is not with me? No! Do not let me see the misery that would come on my father."

verses.textZh: 约瑟在所有侍立在他左右的人面前，不能自制，就喊叫说："叫各人都离开我出去。"这样，约瑟向他的兄弟们表白自己身分的时候，没有别人在场。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟在所有侍立在他左右的人面前，不能自制，就喊叫说："叫各人都离开我出去。"这样，约瑟向他的兄弟们表白自己身分的时候，没有别人在场。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟在左右站着的人面前情不自禁，吩咐一声说：「人都要离开我出去！」约瑟和弟兄们相认的时候并没有一人站在他面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, "Have everyone leave my presence!" So there was no one with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph could not control himself before all those who stood by him. He cried, "Make everyone go out from me." So no one stayed with him when Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph could not restrain himself before all those who stood by him, and he cried out, "Make everyone go out from me!" So no one stood with him while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph could stand it no longer. There were many people in the room, and he said to his attendants, "Out, all of you!" So he was alone with his brothers when he told them who he was.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph could not control himself in front of everyone standing before him, and he shouted, "Have everyone leave me!" So there was no one with him when Joseph made himself known to his brothers.
verses.textEn: Then Joseph could no longer control himself before all his attendants, and he cried out, "Have everyone leave my presence!" So there was no one with Joseph when he made himself known to his brothers.

verses.textZh: 于是他放声大哭，埃及人听到了；法老一家也听闻这事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他放声大哭，埃及人听到了；法老一家也听闻这事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就放声大哭；埃及人和法老家中的人都听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: And he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household heard about it.
verses.textEnEsv: And he wept aloud, so that the Egyptians heard it, and the household of Pharaoh heard it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he wept aloud, and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he broke down and wept. He wept so loudly the Egyptians could hear him, and word of it quickly carried to Pharaoh’s palace.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard it, and the household of Pharaoh heard about it.
verses.textEn: And he wept so loudly that the Egyptians heard him, and Pharaoh’s household heard about it.

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他的兄弟们说："我就是约瑟，我的父亲还在吗？"他的兄弟们不能回答他，因为他们在约瑟面前都非常惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对他的兄弟们说："我就是约瑟，我的父亲还在吗？"他的兄弟们不能回答他，因为他们在约瑟面前都非常惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟对他弟兄们说：「我是约瑟。我的父亲还在吗？」他弟兄不能回答，因为在他面前都惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph! Is my father still living?" But his brothers were not able to answer him, because they were terrified at his presence.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?" But his brothers could not answer him, for they were dismayed at his presence.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph; does my father still live?" But his brothers could not answer him, for they were dismayed in his presence.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am Joseph!" he said to his brothers. "Is my father still alive?" But his brothers were speechless! They were stunned to realize that Joseph was standing there in front of them.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph! Is my father still alive?" But his brothers could not answer him, for they were terrified in his presence.
verses.textEn: Joseph said to his brothers, "I am Joseph! Is my father still living?" But his brothers were not able to answer him, because they were terrified at his presence.

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他的兄弟们说："请你们上前来。"他们就上前去。他说："我就是被你们卖到埃及的弟弟约瑟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对他的兄弟们说："请你们上前来。"他们就上前去。他说："我就是被你们卖到埃及的弟弟约瑟。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟又对他弟兄们说：「请你们近前来。」他们就近前来。他说：「我是你们的兄弟约瑟，就是你们所卖到埃及的。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "Come close to me." When they had done so, he said, "I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt!
verses.textEnEsv: So Joseph said to his brothers, "Come near to me, please." And they came near. And he said, "I am your brother, Joseph, whom you sold into Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph said to his brothers, "Please come near to me." So they came near. Then he said: "I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: "Please, come closer," he said to them. So they came closer. And he said again, "I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into slavery in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "Please come closer to me." And they came closer. And he said, "I am your brother Joseph, whom you sold to Egypt.
verses.textEn: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "Come close to me." When they had done so, he said, "I am your brother Joseph, the one you sold into Egypt!

verses.textZh: 现在你们不要因为把我卖到这里来，而自忧自责。这原是神差派我在你们以先来这里，为要保全性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们不要因为把我卖到这里来，而自忧自责。这原是神差派我在你们以先来这里，为要保全性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在，不要因为把我卖到这里自忧自恨。这是神差我在你们以先来，为要保全生命。
verses.textEnNiv: And now, do not be distressed and do not be angry with yourselves for selling me here, because it was to save lives that God sent me ahead of you.
verses.textEnEsv: And now do not be distressed or angry with yourselves because you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now, do not therefore be grieved or angry with yourselves because you sold me here; for God sent me before you to preserve life.
verses.textEnNlt: But don’t be upset, and don’t be angry with yourselves for selling me to this place. It was God who sent me here ahead of you to preserve your lives.
verses.textEnNasb: Now do not be grieved or angry with yourselves because you sold me here, for God sent me ahead of you to save lives.
verses.textEn: And now, do not be distressed and do not be angry with yourselves for selling me here, because it was to save lives that God sent me ahead of you.

verses.textZh: 现在这地的饥荒已经有两年了，还有五年不能耕种，也没有收成。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在这地的饥荒已经有两年了，还有五年不能耕种，也没有收成。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在这地的饥荒已经二年了，还有五年不能耕种，不能收成。
verses.textEnNiv: For two years now there has been famine in the land, and for the next five years there will be no plowing and reaping.
verses.textEnEsv: For the famine has been in the land these two years, and there are yet five years in which there will be neither plowing nor harvest.
verses.textEnNkjv: For these two years the famine hasbeen in the land, and thereare still five years in which therewillbe neither plowing nor harvesting.
verses.textEnNlt: This famine that has ravaged the land for two years will last five more years, and there will be neither plowing nor harvesting.
verses.textEnNasb: For the famine has been in the land these two years, and there are still five years in which there will be neither plowing nor harvesting.
verses.textEn: For two years now there has been famine in the land, and for the next five years there will be no plowing and reaping.

verses.textZh: 神差派我在你们以先来这里，为要给你们在地上留下余种，大大施行拯救，保全你们的性命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神差派我在你们以先来这里，为要给你们在地上留下余种，大大施行拯救，保全你们的性命。
verses.textZhCuv: 神差我在你们以先来，为要给你们存留余种在世上，又要大施拯救，保全你们的生命。
verses.textEnNiv: But God sent me ahead of you to preserve for you a remnant on earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verses.textEnEsv: And God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant on earth, and to keep alive for you many survivors.
verses.textEnNkjv: And God sent me before you to preserve a posterity for you in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.
verses.textEnNlt: God has sent me ahead of you to keep you and your families alive and to preserve many survivors.
verses.textEnNasb: So God sent me ahead of you to ensure for you a remnant on the earth, and to keep you alive by a great deliverance.
verses.textEn: But God sent me ahead of you to preserve for you a remnant on earth and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

verses.textZh: 这样看来，差派我到这里来的，不是你们，而是神。他立我作法老之父，作他全家之主，又作全埃及地的首相。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，差派我到这里来的，不是你们，而是神。他立我作法老之父，作他全家之主，又作全埃及地的首相。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，差我到这里来的不是你们，乃是神。他又使我如法老的父，作他全家的主，并埃及全地的宰相。
verses.textEnNiv: "So then, it was not you who sent me here, but God. He made me father to Pharaoh, lord of his entire household and ruler of all Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: So it was not you who sent me here, but God. He has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: So now itwas not you who sent me here, but God; and He has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So it was God who sent me here, not you! And he is the one who made me an adviser to Pharaoh—the manager of his entire palace and the governor of all Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: Now, therefore, it was not you who sent me here, but God; and He has made me a father to Pharaoh and lord of all his household, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.textEn: "So then, it was not you who sent me here, but God. He made me father to Pharaoh, lord of his entire household and ruler of all Egypt.

verses.textZh: 你们要赶快上到我父亲那里去，对他说：‘你的儿子约瑟这样说：神立我作了全埃及的主；请你下到我这里来，不要耽延。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要赶快上到我父亲那里去，对他说：‘你的儿子约瑟这样说：神立我作了全埃及的主；请你下到我这里来，不要耽延。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要赶紧上到我父亲那里，对他说：『你儿子约瑟这样说：神使我作全埃及的主，请你下到我这里来，不要耽延。
verses.textEnNiv: Now hurry back to my father and say to him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; don’t delay.
verses.textEnEsv: Hurry and go up to my father and say to him, ‘Thus says your son Joseph, God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; do not tarry.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Hurry and go up to my father, and say to him, ‘Thus says your son Joseph: "God has made me lord of all Egypt; come down to me, do not tarry.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now hurry back to my father and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me master over all the land of Egypt. So come down to me immediately!
verses.textEnNasb: Hurry and go up to my father, and say to him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: "God has made me lord of all Egypt; come down to me, do not delay.
verses.textEn: Now hurry back to my father and say to him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says: God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me; don’t delay.

verses.textZh: 你和你的众儿孙、牛羊，以及你一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，与我相近。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你和你的众儿孙、牛羊，以及你一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，与我相近。
verses.textZhCuv: 你和你的儿子孙子，连牛群羊群，并一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，与我相近。
verses.textEnNiv: You shall live in the region of Goshen and be near me—you, your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and all you have.
verses.textEnEsv: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near me, you and your children and your children’s children, and your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.
verses.textEnNkjv: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near to me, you and your children, your children’s children, your flocks and your herds, and all that you have.
verses.textEnNlt: You can live in the region of Goshen, where you can be near me with all your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and everything you own.
verses.textEnNasb: For you shall live in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near me, you and your children and your grandchildren, and your flocks and your herds and all that you have.
verses.textEn: You shall live in the region of Goshen and be near me—you, your children and grandchildren, your flocks and herds, and all you have.

verses.textZh: 我要在那里供养你，因为还有五年的饥荒，免得你和你的家人，以及你一切所有的，都陷入穷困里。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要在那里供养你，因为还有五年的饥荒，免得你和你的家人，以及你一切所有的，都陷入穷困里。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我要在那里奉养你；因为还有五年的饥荒，免得你和你的眷属，并一切所有的，都败落了。』
verses.textEnNiv: I will provide for you there, because five years of famine are still to come. Otherwise you and your household and all who belong to you will become destitute.’
verses.textEnEsv: There I will provide for you, for there are yet five years of famine to come, so that you and your household, and all that you have, do not come to poverty.’
verses.textEnNkjv: There I will provide for you, lest you and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty; for thereare still five years of famine." ’
verses.textEnNlt: I will take care of you there, for there are still five years of famine ahead of us. Otherwise you, your household, and all your animals will starve.’"
verses.textEnNasb: There I will also provide for you, for there are still five years of famine to come, and you and your household and all that you have would be impoverished." ’
verses.textEn: I will provide for you there, because five years of famine are still to come. Otherwise you and your household and all who belong to you will become destitute.’

verses.textZh: 看哪，你们和我弟弟便雅悯都亲眼看见，是我亲口对你们说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪，你们和我弟弟便雅悯都亲眼看见，是我亲口对你们说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 况且你们的眼和我兄弟便雅悯的眼都看见是我亲口对你们说话。
verses.textEnNiv: "You can see for yourselves, and so can my brother Benjamin, that it is really I who am speaking to you.
verses.textEnEsv: And now your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And behold, your eyes and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see that itis my mouth that speaks to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joseph added, "Look! You can see for yourselves, and so can my brother Benjamin, that I really am Joseph!
verses.textEnNasb: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see, that it is my mouth which is speaking to you.
verses.textEn: "You can see for yourselves, and so can my brother Benjamin, that it is really I who am speaking to you.

verses.textZh: 你们也要把我在埃及的一切尊荣，和你们所看见的一切，都告诉我的父亲，又要赶快把我的父亲接到这里来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也要把我在埃及的一切尊荣，和你们所看见的一切，都告诉我的父亲，又要赶快把我的父亲接到这里来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们也要将我在埃及一切的荣耀和你们所看见的事都告诉我父亲，又要赶紧地将我父亲搬到我这里来。」
verses.textEnNiv: Tell my father about all the honor accorded me in Egypt and about everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly."
verses.textEnEsv: You must tell my father of all my honor in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. Hurry and bring my father down here."
verses.textEnNkjv: So you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen; and you shall hurry and bring my father down here."
verses.textEnNlt: Go tell my father of my honored position here in Egypt. Describe for him everything you have seen, and then bring my father here quickly."
verses.textEnNasb: Now you must tell my father of all my splendor in Egypt, and all that you have seen; and you must hurry and bring my father down here."
verses.textEn: Tell my father about all the honor accorded me in Egypt and about everything you have seen. And bring my father down here quickly."

verses.textZh: 于是，约瑟伏在他弟弟便雅悯的颈项上，哭起来了；便雅悯也伏在约瑟的颈项上哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约瑟伏在他弟弟便雅悯的颈项上，哭起来了；便雅悯也伏在约瑟的颈项上哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约瑟伏在他兄弟便雅悯的颈项上哭，便雅悯也在他的颈项上哭。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin embraced him, weeping.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he fell upon his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept upon his neck.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
verses.textEnNlt: Weeping with joy, he embraced Benjamin, and Benjamin did the same.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.
verses.textEn: Then he threw his arms around his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin embraced him, weeping.

verses.textZh: 他又与众兄弟亲吻，拥抱着他们哭。然后，他的兄弟们就跟他说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又与众兄弟亲吻，拥抱着他们哭。然后，他的兄弟们就跟他说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又与众弟兄亲嘴，抱着他们哭，随后他弟兄们就和他说话。
verses.textEnNiv: And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. Afterward his brothers talked with him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he kissed all his brothers and wept upon them. After that his brothers talked with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover he kissed all his brothers and wept over them, and after that his brothers talked with him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joseph kissed each of his brothers and wept over them, and after that they began talking freely with him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he kissed all his brothers and wept on them, and afterward his brothers talked with him.
verses.textEn: And he kissed all his brothers and wept over them. Afterward his brothers talked with him.

verses.textZh: 消息传到法老的家里，说："约瑟的兄弟们来了。"法老和他的臣仆都很高兴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 消息传到法老的家里，说："约瑟的兄弟们来了。"法老和他的臣仆都很高兴。
verses.textZhCuv: 这风声传到法老的宫里，说：「约瑟的弟兄们来了。」法老和他的臣仆都很喜欢。
verses.textEnNiv: When the news reached Pharaoh’s palace that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and all his officials were pleased.
verses.textEnEsv: When the report was heard in Pharaoh’s house, "Joseph’s brothers have come," it pleased Pharaoh and his servants.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, "Joseph’s brothers have come." So it pleased Pharaoh and his servants well.
verses.textEnNlt: The news soon reached Pharaoh’s palace: "Joseph’s brothers have arrived!" Pharaoh and his officials were all delighted to hear this.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the news was heard in Pharaoh’s house that Joseph’s brothers had come, it pleased Pharaoh and his servants.
verses.textEn: When the news reached Pharaoh’s palace that Joseph’s brothers had come, Pharaoh and all his officials were pleased.

verses.textZh: 法老对约瑟说："你要对你的兄弟们说：‘你们要这样作：使你们的牲口载满货物，起程到迦南地去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老对约瑟说："你要对你的兄弟们说：‘你们要这样作：使你们的牲口载满货物，起程到迦南地去，
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对约瑟说：「你吩咐你的弟兄们说：『你们要这样行：把驮子抬在牲口上，起身往迦南地去。
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan,
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Say to your brothers, ‘Do this: load your beasts and go back to the land of Canaan,
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Say to your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals and depart; go to the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, ‘This is what you must do: Load your pack animals, and hurry back to the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Say to your brothers, ‘Do this: load your livestock and go to the land of Canaan,
verses.textEn: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals and return to the land of Canaan,

verses.textZh: 把你们的父亲和家人都接到我这里来；我要把埃及地美好的产物赐给你们，你们也可以吃这地肥美的食物。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 把你们的父亲和家人都接到我这里来；我要把埃及地美好的产物赐给你们，你们也可以吃这地肥美的食物。’
verses.textZhCuv: 将你们的父亲和你们的眷属都搬到我这里来，我要把埃及地的美物赐给你们，你们也要吃这地肥美的出产。
verses.textEnNiv: and bring your father and your families back to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt and you can enjoy the fat of the land.’
verses.textEnEsv: and take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Bring your father and your households and come to me; I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then get your father and all of your families, and return here to me. I will give you the very best land in Egypt, and you will eat from the best that the land produces.’"
verses.textEnNasb: and take your father and your households and come to me; and I will give you the best of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’
verses.textEn: and bring your father and your families back to me. I will give you the best of the land of Egypt and you can enjoy the fat of the land.’

verses.textZh: 现在我再吩咐你对他们说：‘你们要这样作：从埃及地带些车辆回去，用来接你们的孩子和妻子，并且把你们的父亲接来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我再吩咐你对他们说：‘你们要这样作：从埃及地带些车辆回去，用来接你们的孩子和妻子，并且把你们的父亲接来。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我吩咐你们要这样行：从埃及地带着车辆去，把你们的孩子和妻子，并你们的父亲都搬来。
verses.textEnNiv: "You are also directed to tell them, ‘Do this: Take some carts from Egypt for your children and your wives, and get your father and come.
verses.textEnEsv: And you, Joseph, are commanded to say, ‘Do this: take wagons from the land of Egypt for your little ones and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now you are commanded—do this: Take carts out of the land of Egypt for your little ones and your wives; bring your father and come.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Tell your brothers, ‘Take wagons from the land of Egypt to carry your little children and your wives, and bring your father here.
verses.textEnNasb: Now you are ordered, ‘Do this: take wagons from the land of Egypt for your little ones and for your wives, and bring your father and come.
verses.textEn: "You are also directed to tell them, ‘Do this: Take some carts from Egypt for your children and your wives, and get your father and come.

verses.textZh: 不要顾惜你们的家具，因为埃及全地美好的产物都是你们的。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要顾惜你们的家具，因为埃及全地美好的产物都是你们的。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们眼中不要爱惜你们的家具，因为埃及全地的美物都是你们的。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Never mind about your belongings, because the best of all Egypt will be yours.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: Have no concern for your goods, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: Also do not be concerned about your goods, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t worry about your personal belongings, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’"
verses.textEnNasb: And do not concern yourselves with your property, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.’ "
verses.textEn: Never mind about your belongings, because the best of all Egypt will be yours.’ "

verses.textZh: 以色列的儿子们就照样作了。约瑟照着法老所吩咐的，给了他们一些车辆和路上用的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的儿子们就照样作了。约瑟照着法老所吩咐的，给了他们一些车辆和路上用的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的儿子们就如此行。约瑟照着法老的吩咐给他们车辆和路上用的食物，
verses.textEnNiv: So the sons of Israel did this. Joseph gave them carts, as Pharaoh had commanded, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the command of Pharaoh, and gave them provisions for the journey.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the sons of Israel did so; and Joseph gave them carts, according to the command of Pharaoh, and he gave them provisions for the journey.
verses.textEnNlt: So the sons of Jacob did as they were told. Joseph provided them with wagons, as Pharaoh had commanded, and he gave them supplies for the journey.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sons of Israel did so; and Joseph gave them wagons according to the command of Pharaoh, and gave them provisions for the journey.
verses.textEn: So the sons of Israel did this. Joseph gave them carts, as Pharaoh had commanded, and he also gave them provisions for their journey.

verses.textZh: 又给了他们各人一套新衣服，但是给便雅悯三千四百二十克银子和五套衣服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又给了他们各人一套新衣服，但是给便雅悯三千四百二十克银子和五套衣服。
verses.textZhCuv: 又给他们各人一套衣服，惟独给便雅悯三百银子，五套衣服；
verses.textEnNiv: To each of them he gave new clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.
verses.textEnEsv: To each and all of them he gave a change of clothes, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five changes of clothes.
verses.textEnNkjv: He gave to all of them, to each man, changes of garments; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of garments.
verses.textEnNlt: And he gave each of them new clothes—but to Benjamin he gave five changes of clothes and 300 pieces of silver.
verses.textEnNasb: To each of them he gave changes of garments, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of garments.
verses.textEn: To each of them he gave new clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred shekels of silver and five sets of clothes.

verses.textZh: 约瑟送去给他父亲的，有公驴十头，载着埃及美好的产物，以及母驴十头，载着五谷、饼和给他父亲在路上用的食物。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟送去给他父亲的，有公驴十头，载着埃及美好的产物，以及母驴十头，载着五谷、饼和给他父亲在路上用的食物。
verses.textZhCuv: 送给他父亲公驴十匹，驮着埃及的美物，母驴十匹，驮着粮食与饼和菜，为他父亲路上用。
verses.textEnNiv: And this is what he sent to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the best things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and other provisions for his journey.
verses.textEnEsv: To his father he sent as follows: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and provision for his father on the journey.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he sent to his father these things: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and food for his father for the journey.
verses.textEnNlt: He also sent his father ten male donkeys loaded with the finest products of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and other supplies he would need on his journey.
verses.textEnNasb: And to his father he sent the following: ten male donkeys loaded with the best things of Egypt, ten female donkeys loaded with grain, bread, and sustenance for his father on the journey.
verses.textEn: And this is what he sent to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the best things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and other provisions for his journey.

verses.textZh: 于是，约瑟打发他的兄弟们回去，他们走的时候，约瑟对他们说："你们在路上不要争吵。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约瑟打发他的兄弟们回去，他们走的时候，约瑟对他们说："你们在路上不要争吵。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约瑟打发他弟兄们回去，又对他们说：「你们不要在路上相争。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they were leaving he said to them, "Don’t quarrel on the way!"
verses.textEnEsv: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they departed, he said to them, "Do not quarrel on the way."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed; and he said to them, "See that you do not become troubled along the way."
verses.textEnNlt: So Joseph sent his brothers off, and as they left, he called after them, "Don’t quarrel about all this along the way!"
verses.textEnNasb: So he sent his brothers away, and as they departed, he said to them, "Do not quarrel on the journey."
verses.textEn: Then he sent his brothers away, and as they were leaving he said to them, "Don’t quarrel on the way!"

verses.textZh: 他们离开埃及，上到迦南地他们父亲雅各那里去，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们离开埃及，上到迦南地他们父亲雅各那里去，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们从埃及上去，来到迦南地、他们的父亲雅各那里，
verses.textEnNiv: So they went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: So they went up out of Egypt and came to the land of Canaan to their father Jacob.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they went up out of Egypt, and came to the land of Canaan to Jacob their father.
verses.textEnNlt: And they left Egypt and returned to their father, Jacob, in the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: Then they went up from Egypt, and came to the land of Canaan, to their father Jacob.
verses.textEn: So they went up out of Egypt and came to their father Jacob in the land of Canaan.

verses.textZh: 告诉他，说："约瑟还在，并且作了埃及全地的首相。"雅各的心冷淡麻木，因为他不相信他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 告诉他，说："约瑟还在，并且作了埃及全地的首相。"雅各的心冷淡麻木，因为他不相信他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 告诉他说：「约瑟还在，并且作埃及全地的宰相。」雅各心里冰凉，因为不信他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They told him, "Joseph is still alive! In fact, he is ruler of all Egypt." Jacob was stunned; he did not believe them.
verses.textEnEsv: And they told him, "Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt." And his heart became numb, for he did not believe them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they told him, saying, "Joseph is still alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt." And Jacob’s heart stood still, because he did not believe them.
verses.textEnNlt: "Joseph is still alive!" they told him. "And he is governor of all the land of Egypt!" Jacob was stunned at the news—he couldn’t believe it.
verses.textEnNasb: And they told him, saying, "Joseph is still alive, and indeed he is ruler over all the land of Egypt." But he was stunned, for he did not believe them.
verses.textEn: They told him, "Joseph is still alive! In fact, he is ruler of all Egypt." Jacob was stunned; he did not believe them.

verses.textZh: 他们就把约瑟对他们所说的一切话，都告诉了他。他们的父亲雅各看见了约瑟派来接他的车辆，心才苏醒过来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就把约瑟对他们所说的一切话，都告诉了他。他们的父亲雅各看见了约瑟派来接他的车辆，心才苏醒过来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们便将约瑟对他们说的一切话都告诉了他。他们父亲雅各又看见约瑟打发来接他的车辆，心就苏醒了。
verses.textEnNiv: But when they told him everything Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the carts Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob revived.
verses.textEnEsv: But when they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them, and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of their father Jacob revived.
verses.textEnNkjv: But when they told him all the words which Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the carts which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived.
verses.textEnNlt: But when they repeated to Jacob everything Joseph had told them, and when he saw the wagons Joseph had sent to carry him, their father’s spirits revived.
verses.textEnNasb: When they told him all the words of Joseph that he had spoken to them, and when he saw the wagons that Joseph had sent to carry him, then the spirit of their father Jacob revived.
verses.textEn: But when they told him everything Joseph had said to them, and when he saw the carts Joseph had sent to carry him back, the spirit of their father Jacob revived.

verses.textZh: 以色列说："够了！约瑟我的儿子还在；在我还没有死以前，我要去看看他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列说："够了！约瑟我的儿子还在；在我还没有死以前，我要去看看他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列说：「罢了！罢了！我的儿子约瑟还在，趁我未死以先，我要去见他一面。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Israel said, "I’m convinced! My son Joseph is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."
verses.textEnEsv: And Israel said, "It is enough; Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel said, "Itis enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob exclaimed, "It must be true! My son Joseph is alive! I must go and see him before I die."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Israel said, "It is enough; my son Joseph is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."
verses.textEn: And Israel said, "I’m convinced! My son Joseph is still alive. I will go and see him before I die."

verses.textZh: 以色列带着他所有的一切起程，到了别是巴，就向他父亲以撒的神献祭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列带着他所有的一切起程，到了别是巴，就向他父亲以撒的神献祭。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列带着一切所有的，起身来到别是巴，就献祭给他父亲以撒的神。
verses.textEnNiv: So Israel set out with all that was his, and when he reached Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
verses.textEnEsv: So Israel took his journey with all that he had and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Israel took his journey with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob set out for Egypt with all his possessions. And when he came to Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
verses.textEnNasb: So Israel set out with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.
verses.textEn: So Israel set out with all that was his, and when he reached Beersheba, he offered sacrifices to the God of his father Isaac.

verses.textZh: 神在夜间的异象中对以色列说："雅各，雅各。"雅各说："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神在夜间的异象中对以色列说："雅各，雅各。"雅各说："我在这里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 夜间，神在异象中对以色列说：「雅各！雅各！」他说：「我在这里。」
verses.textEnNiv: And God spoke to Israel in a vision at night and said, "Jacob! Jacob!" "Here I am," he replied.
verses.textEnEsv: And God spoke to Israel in visions of the night and said, "Jacob, Jacob." And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, "Jacob, Jacob!" And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEnNlt: During the night God spoke to him in a vision. "Jacob! Jacob!" he called. "Here I am," Jacob replied.
verses.textEnNasb: And God spoke to Israel in visions of the night and said, "Jacob, Jacob." And he said, "Here I am."
verses.textEn: And God spoke to Israel in a vision at night and said, "Jacob! Jacob!" "Here I am," he replied.

verses.textZh: 神说："我是神，就是你父亲的神；你不要怕下埃及去，因为我必使你在那里成为大国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神说："我是神，就是你父亲的神；你不要怕下埃及去，因为我必使你在那里成为大国。
verses.textZhCuv: 神说：「我是神，就是你父亲的神。你下埃及去不要害怕，因为我必使你在那里成为大族。
verses.textEnNiv: "I am God, the God of your father," he said. "Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "I am God, the God of your father. Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for there I will make you into a great nation.
verses.textEnNkjv: So He said, "I am God, the God of your father; do not fear to go down to Egypt, for I will make of you a great nation there.
verses.textEnNlt: "I am God, the God of your father," the voice said. "Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for there I will make your family into a great nation.
verses.textEnNasb: Then He said, "I am God, the God of your father; do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.
verses.textEn: "I am God, the God of your father," he said. "Do not be afraid to go down to Egypt, for I will make you into a great nation there.

verses.textZh: 我要亲自与你一同下到埃及去，也必把你带上来。约瑟要亲手合上你的眼给你送终。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要亲自与你一同下到埃及去，也必把你带上来。约瑟要亲手合上你的眼给你送终。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我要和你同下埃及去，也必定带你上来；约瑟必给你送终 。」
verses.textEnNiv: I will go down to Egypt with you, and I will surely bring you back again. And Joseph’s own hand will close your eyes."
verses.textEnEsv: I myself will go down with you to Egypt, and I will also bring you up again, and Joseph’s hand shall close your eyes."
verses.textEnNkjv: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will also surely bring you up again; and Joseph will put his hand on your eyes."
verses.textEnNlt: I will go with you down to Egypt, and I will bring you back again. You will die in Egypt, but Joseph will be with you to close your eyes."
verses.textEnNasb: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will also assuredly bring you up again; and Joseph will close your eyes."
verses.textEn: I will go down to Egypt with you, and I will surely bring you back again. And Joseph’s own hand will close your eyes."

verses.textZh: 雅各就从别是巴起程。以色列的众子，用法老为雅各送来的车辆，接载他们的父亲雅各，以及他们的孩子和妻子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各就从别是巴起程。以色列的众子，用法老为雅各送来的车辆，接载他们的父亲雅各，以及他们的孩子和妻子。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各就从别是巴起行。以色列的儿子们使他们的父亲雅各和他们的妻子、儿女都坐在法老为雅各送来的车上。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob left Beersheba, and Israel’s sons took their father Jacob and their children and their wives in the carts that Pharaoh had sent to transport him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob set out from Beersheba. The sons of Israel carried Jacob their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons that Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob arose from Beersheba; and the sons of Israel carried their father Jacob, their little ones, and their wives, in the carts which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob left Beersheba, and his sons took him to Egypt. They carried him and their little ones and their wives in the wagons Pharaoh had provided for them.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob left Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried their father Jacob and their little ones and their wives in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.
verses.textEn: Then Jacob left Beersheba, and Israel’s sons took their father Jacob and their children and their wives in the carts that Pharaoh had sent to transport him.

verses.textZh: 他们又带着牲畜，和他们在迦南地所得的财物，来到埃及。这样，雅各和他所有的子孙，都一同来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又带着牲畜，和他们在迦南地所得的财物，来到埃及。这样，雅各和他所有的子孙，都一同来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又带着迦南地所得的牲畜、货财来到埃及。雅各和他的一切子孙都一同来了。
verses.textEnNiv: So Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt, taking with them their livestock and the possessions they had acquired in Canaan.
verses.textEnEsv: They also took their livestock and their goods, which they had gained in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt, Jacob and all his offspring with him,
verses.textEnNkjv: So they took their livestock and their goods, which they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and went to Egypt, Jacob and all his descendants with him.
verses.textEnNlt: They also took all their livestock and all the personal belongings they had acquired in the land of Canaan. So Jacob and his entire family went to Egypt—
verses.textEnNasb: They also took their livestock and their possessions, which they had acquired in the land of Canaan, and came to Egypt, Jacob and all his descendants with him:
verses.textEn: So Jacob and all his offspring went to Egypt, taking with them their livestock and the possessions they had acquired in Canaan.

verses.textZh: 雅各把他的众儿子、孙子、女儿、孙女和他所有的后裔，都一同带到埃及去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各把他的众儿子、孙子、女儿、孙女和他所有的后裔，都一同带到埃及去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各把他的儿子、孙子、女儿、孙女，并他的子子孙孙，一同带到埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob brought with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons and his daughters and granddaughters—all his offspring.
verses.textEnEsv: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters. All his offspring he brought with him into Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: His sons and his sons’ sons, his daughters and his sons’ daughters, and all his descendants he brought with him to Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: sons and grandsons, daughters and granddaughters—all his descendants.
verses.textEnNasb: his sons and his grandsons with him, his daughters and his granddaughters, and all his descendants he brought with him to Egypt.
verses.textEn: Jacob brought with him to Egypt his sons and grandsons and his daughters and granddaughters—all his offspring.

verses.textZh: 来到埃及的以色列人，就是雅各和他的子孙，名单记在下面：雅各的长子是流本。
verses.textZhCnvs: 来到埃及的以色列人，就是雅各和他的子孙，名单记在下面：雅各的长子是流本。
verses.textZhCuv: 来到埃及的以色列人名字记在下面。雅各和他的儿孙：雅各的长子是吕便。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: Now these are the names of the descendants of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons. Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now these were the names of the children of Israel, Jacob and his sons, who went to Egypt: Reuben was Jacob’s firstborn.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the names of the descendants of Israel—the sons of Jacob—who went to Egypt: Reuben was Jacob’s oldest son.
verses.textEnNasb: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.
verses.textEn: These are the names of the sons of Israel (Jacob and his descendants) who went to Egypt: Reuben the firstborn of Jacob.

verses.textZh: 流本的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯仑和迦米。
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯仑和迦米。
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯伦、迦米。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Reuben: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.
verses.textEnEsv: and the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Reuben were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Reuben were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.textEn: The sons of Reuben: Hanok, Pallu, Hezron and Karmi.

verses.textZh: 西缅的儿子是耶母利、雅悯、阿辖、雅斤、琐辖和迦南女子所生的扫罗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西缅的儿子是耶母利、雅悯、阿辖、雅斤、琐辖和迦南女子所生的扫罗。
verses.textZhCuv: 西缅的儿子是耶母利、雅悯、阿辖、雅斤、琐辖，还有迦南女子所生的扫罗。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul, the son of a Canaanite woman.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Simeon were Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar, and Shaul. (Shaul’s mother was a Canaanite woman.)
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.
verses.textEn: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jakin, Zohar and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

verses.textZh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖和米拉利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖和米拉利。
verses.textZhCuv: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.textEn: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.

verses.textZh: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南、示拉、法勒斯和谢拉，但是珥和俄南都在迦南地死了。法勒斯的儿子是希斯伦和哈母勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南、示拉、法勒斯和谢拉，但是珥和俄南都在迦南地死了。法勒斯的儿子是希斯伦和哈母勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南、示拉、法勒斯、谢拉；惟有珥与俄南死在迦南地。法勒斯的儿子是希斯仑、哈母勒。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez and Zerah (but Er and Onan had died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah (but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan); and the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah (but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah (though Er and Onan had died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah (but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan). And the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
verses.textEn: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez and Zerah (but Er and Onan had died in the land of Canaan). The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

verses.textZh: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述 和伸仑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、雅述 和伸仑。
verses.textZhCuv: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、约伯、伸仑。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Yob, and Shimron.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Issachar were Tola, Puvah, Job, and Shimron.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Issachar were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvvah, Iob, and Shimron.
verses.textEn: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub and Shimron.

verses.textZh: 西布伦的儿子是西烈、以伦和雅利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西布伦的儿子是西烈、以伦和雅利。
verses.textZhCuv: 西布伦的儿子是西烈、以伦、雅利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon and Jahleel.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Zebulun were Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Zebulun were Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.
verses.textEn: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon and Jahleel.

verses.textZh: 以上这些人是利亚在巴旦．亚兰给雅各生的儿子，另外还有女儿底拿。这些子孙一共三十三人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些人是利亚在巴旦．亚兰给雅各生的儿子，另外还有女儿底拿。这些子孙一共三十三人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是利亚在巴旦‧亚兰给雅各所生的儿子，还有女儿底拿。儿孙共有三十三人。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the sons Leah bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, besides his daughter Dinah. These sons and daughters of his were thirty-three in all.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan-aram, together with his daughter Dinah; altogether his sons and his daughters numbered thirty-three.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Padan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the persons, his sons and his daughters, were thirty-three.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the sons of Leah and Jacob who were born in Paddan-aram, in addition to their daughter, Dinah. The number of Jacob’s descendants (male and female) through Leah was thirty-three.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan-aram, with his daughter Dinah; all his sons and his daughters numbered thirty-three.
verses.textEn: These were the sons Leah bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, besides his daughter Dinah. These sons and daughters of his were thirty-three in all.

verses.textZh: 迦得的儿子是洗非芸、哈基、书尼、以斯本、以利、亚罗底和亚列利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦得的儿子是洗非芸、哈基、书尼、以斯本、以利、亚罗底和亚列利。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦得的儿子是洗非芸、哈基、书尼、以斯本、以利、亚罗底、亚列利。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Gad: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi and Areli.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Gad were Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Gad were Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.
verses.textEn: The sons of Gad: Zephon, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi and Areli.

verses.textZh: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦和比利亚，还有他们的姊妹西拉。比利亚的儿子是希别和玛结。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦和比利亚，还有他们的姊妹西拉。比利亚的儿子是希别和玛结。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦、比利亚，还有他们的妹子西拉。比利亚的儿子是希别、玛结。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, with Serah their sister. And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Asher were Jimnah, Ishuah, Isui, Beriah, and Serah, their sister. And the sons of Beriah were Heber and Malchiel.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Asher were Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Their sister was Serah. Beriah’s sons were Heber and Malkiel.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah. And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
verses.textEn: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi and Beriah. Their sister was Serah. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malkiel.

verses.textZh: 以上这些人是拉班给女儿利亚作婢女的悉帕给雅各生的子孙，一共十六人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些人是拉班给女儿利亚作婢女的悉帕给雅各生的子孙，一共十六人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是拉班给他女儿利亚的婢女悉帕从雅各所生的儿孙，共有十六人。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the children born to Jacob by Zilpah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Leah—sixteen in all.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; and these she bore to Jacob—sixteen persons.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter; and these she bore to Jacob: sixteen persons.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the sons of Zilpah, the servant given to Leah by her father, Laban. The number of Jacob’s descendants through Zilpah was sixteen.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah; and she bore to Jacob these sixteen persons.
verses.textEn: These were the children born to Jacob by Zilpah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Leah—sixteen in all.

verses.textZh: 雅各的妻子拉结，生了约瑟和便雅悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各的妻子拉结，生了约瑟和便雅悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各之妻拉结的儿子是约瑟和便雅悯。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife, were Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel were Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.textEn: The sons of Jacob’s wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 约瑟在埃及地生了玛拿西和以法莲，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟在埃及地生了玛拿西和以法莲，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生的。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟在埃及地生了玛拿西和以法莲，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生的。
verses.textEnNiv: In Egypt, Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.
verses.textEnEsv: And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera the priest of On, bore to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-Pherah priest of On, bore to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph’s sons, born in the land of Egypt, were Manasseh and Ephraim. Their mother was Asenath, daughter of Potiphera, the priest of On.
verses.textEnNasb: Now to Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.
verses.textEn: In Egypt, Manasseh and Ephraim were born to Joseph by Asenath daughter of Potiphera, priest of On.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉、比结、亚实别、基拉、乃幔、以希、罗实、母平、户平和亚勒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉、比结、亚实别、基拉、乃幔、以希、罗实、母平、户平和亚勒。
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉、比结、亚实别、基拉、乃幔、以希、罗实、母平、户平、亚勒。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim and Ard.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Benjamin were Belah, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
verses.textEnNlt: Benjamin’s sons were Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
verses.textEn: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim and Ard.

verses.textZh: 以上这些人是拉结给雅各生的子孙，一共十四人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些人是拉结给雅各生的子孙，一共十四人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是拉结给雅各所生的儿孙，共有十四人。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob—fourteen in all.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob—fourteen persons in all.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: fourteen persons in all.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the sons of Rachel and Jacob. The number of Jacob’s descendants through Rachel was fourteen.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob; there were fourteen persons in all.
verses.textEn: These were the sons of Rachel who were born to Jacob—fourteen in all.

verses.textZh: 但的儿子是户伸。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但的儿子是户伸。
verses.textZhCuv: 但的儿子是户伸。
verses.textEnNiv: The son of Dan: Hushim.
verses.textEnEsv: The son of Dan: Hushim.
verses.textEnNkjv: The son of Dan was Hushim.
verses.textEnNlt: The son of Dan was Hushim.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Dan: Hushim.
verses.textEn: The son of Dan: Hushim.

verses.textZh: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色和示冷。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色和示冷。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、示冷。
verses.textEnNiv: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem.
verses.textEnEsv: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.textEnNkjv: The sons of Naphtali were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.textEnNlt: The sons of Naphtali were Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.textEnNasb: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
verses.textEn: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer and Shillem.

verses.textZh: 以上这些人是拉班给女儿拉结作婢女的辟拉给雅各生的子孙，一共七人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以上这些人是拉班给女儿拉结作婢女的辟拉给雅各生的子孙，一共七人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是拉班给他女儿拉结的婢女辟拉从雅各所生的儿孙，共有七人。
verses.textEnNiv: These were the sons born to Jacob by Bilhah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.
verses.textEnEsv: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob—seven persons in all.
verses.textEnNkjv: These were the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel his daughter, and she bore these to Jacob: seven persons in all.
verses.textEnNlt: These were the sons of Bilhah, the servant given to Rachel by her father, Laban. The number of Jacob’s descendants through Bilhah was seven.
verses.textEnNasb: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel, and she bore these to Jacob; there were seven persons in all.
verses.textEn: These were the sons born to Jacob by Bilhah, whom Laban had given to his daughter Rachel—seven in all.

verses.textZh: 所有从雅各所生、与雅各一同来到埃及的人，除了他的儿妇之外，一共六十六人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所有从雅各所生、与雅各一同来到埃及的人，除了他的儿妇之外，一共六十六人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那与雅各同到埃及的，除了他儿妇之外，凡从他所生的，共有六十六人。
verses.textEnNiv: All those who went to Egypt with Jacob—those who were his direct descendants, not counting his sons’ wives—numbered sixty-six persons.
verses.textEnEsv: All the persons belonging to Jacob who came into Egypt, who were his own descendants, not including Jacob’s sons’ wives, were sixty-six persons in all.
verses.textEnNkjv: All the persons who went with Jacob to Egypt, who came from his body, besides Jacob’s sons’ wives, were sixty-six persons in all.
verses.textEnNlt: The total number of Jacob’s direct descendants who went with him to Egypt, not counting his sons’ wives, was sixty-six.
verses.textEnNasb: All the people belonging to Jacob, who came to Egypt, his direct descendants, not including the wives of Jacob’s sons, were sixty-six persons in all,
verses.textEn: All those who went to Egypt with Jacob—those who were his direct descendants, not counting his sons’ wives—numbered sixty-six persons.

verses.textZh: 另外还有约瑟在埃及所生的两个儿子。雅各家来到埃及的所有成员，一共七十人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 另外还有约瑟在埃及所生的两个儿子。雅各家来到埃及的所有成员，一共七十人。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有约瑟在埃及所生的两个儿子。雅各家来到埃及的共有七十人。
verses.textEnNiv: With the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family, which went to Egypt, were seventy in all.
verses.textEnEsv: And the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two. All the persons of the house of Jacob who came into Egypt were seventy.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the sons of Joseph who were born to him in Egypt were two persons. All the persons of the house of Jacob who went to Egypt were seventy.
verses.textEnNlt: In addition, Joseph had two sons who were born in Egypt. So altogether, there were seventy members of Jacob’s family in the land of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: and the sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two; all the people of the house of Jacob, who came to Egypt, were seventy.
verses.textEn: With the two sons who had been born to Joseph in Egypt, the members of Jacob’s family, which went to Egypt, were seventy in all.

verses.textZh: 雅各派犹大先到约瑟那里去，请约瑟指教他去歌珊的路。于是他们来到歌珊地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各派犹大先到约瑟那里去，请约瑟指教他去歌珊的路。于是他们来到歌珊地。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各打发犹大先去见约瑟，请派人引路往歌珊去；于是他们来到歌珊地。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When they arrived in the region of Goshen,
verses.textEnEsv: He had sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to show the way before him in Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he sent Judah before him to Joseph, to point out before him theway to Goshen. And they came to the land of Goshen.
verses.textEnNlt: As they neared their destination, Jacob sent Judah ahead to meet Joseph and get directions to the region of Goshen. And when they finally arrived there,
verses.textEnNasb: Now Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph, to guide him to Goshen; and they came into the land of Goshen.
verses.textEn: Now Jacob sent Judah ahead of him to Joseph to get directions to Goshen. When they arrived in the region of Goshen,

verses.textZh: 约瑟预备了车，上去歌珊迎接他的父亲以色列。约瑟一看见他，就伏在他的颈项上，在他的颈项上哭了很久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟预备了车，上去歌珊迎接他的父亲以色列。约瑟一看见他，就伏在他的颈项上，在他的颈项上哭了很久。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟套车往歌珊去，迎接他父亲以色列，及至见了面，就伏在父亲的颈项上，哭了许久。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph had his chariot made ready and went to Goshen to meet his father Israel. As soon as Joseph appeared before him, he threw his arms around his father and wept for a long time.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph prepared his chariot and went up to meet Israel his father in Goshen. He presented himself to him and fell on his neck and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joseph made ready his chariot and went up to Goshen to meet his father Israel; and he presented himself to him, and fell on his neck and wept on his neck a good while.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph prepared his chariot and traveled to Goshen to meet his father, Jacob. When Joseph arrived, he embraced his father and wept, holding him for a long time.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph prepared his chariot and went up to Goshen to meet his father Israel; as soon as he appeared to him, Joseph threw himself on his neck and wept on his neck a long time.
verses.textEn: Joseph had his chariot made ready and went to Goshen to meet his father Israel. As soon as Joseph appeared before him, he threw his arms around his father and wept for a long time.

verses.textZh: 以色列对约瑟说："这一次我看见了你的面，知道你还在，我死了也甘心。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列对约瑟说："这一次我看见了你的面，知道你还在，我死了也甘心。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列对约瑟说：「我既得见你的面，知道你还在，就是死我也甘心。」
verses.textEnNiv: Israel said to Joseph, "Now I am ready to die, since I have seen for myself that you are still alive."
verses.textEnEsv: Israel said to Joseph, "Now let me die, since I have seen your face and know that you are still alive."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Israel said to Joseph, "Now let me die, since I have seen your face, because you are still alive."
verses.textEnNlt: Finally, Jacob said to Joseph, "Now I am ready to die, since I have seen your face again and know you are still alive."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Israel said to Joseph, "Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive."
