verses.textEn: Israel said to Joseph, "Now I am ready to die, since I have seen for myself that you are still alive."

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他的兄弟们和他的父家说："我要上去告诉法老，对他说：‘我在迦南地的兄弟们和我的父家，都到我这里来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对他的兄弟们和他的父家说："我要上去告诉法老，对他说：‘我在迦南地的兄弟们和我的父家，都到我这里来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟对他的弟兄和他父的全家说：「我要上去告诉法老，对他说：『我的弟兄和我父的全家从前在迦南地，现今都到我这里来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, "I will go up and speak to Pharaoh and will say to him, ‘My brothers and my father’s household, who were living in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
verses.textEnEsv: Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, "I will go up and tell Pharaoh and will say to him, ‘My brothers and my father’s household, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, "I will go up and tell Pharaoh, and say to him, ‘My brothers and those of my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.
verses.textEnNlt: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s entire family, "I will go to Pharaoh and tell him, ‘My brothers and my father’s entire family have come to me from the land of Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: But Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, "I will go up and tell Pharaoh, and will say to him, ‘My brothers and my father’s household, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me;
verses.textEn: Then Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s household, "I will go up and speak to Pharaoh and will say to him, ‘My brothers and my father’s household, who were living in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

verses.textZh: 这些人都是牧羊人，以牧养牲畜为生。他们把自己的牛羊和一切所有的，都带来了。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人都是牧羊人，以牧养牲畜为生。他们把自己的牛羊和一切所有的，都带来了。’
verses.textZhCuv: 他们本是牧羊的人，以养牲畜为业；他们把羊群牛群和一切所有的都带来了。』
verses.textEnNiv: The men are shepherds; they tend livestock, and they have brought along their flocks and herds and everything they own.’
verses.textEnEsv: And the men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks and their herds and all that they have.’
verses.textEnNkjv: And the men are shepherds, for their occupation has been to feed livestock; and they have brought their flocks, their herds, and all that they have.’
verses.textEnNlt: These men are shepherds, and they raise livestock. They have brought with them their flocks and herds and everything they own.’"
verses.textEnNasb: and the men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock; and they have brought their flocks and their herds and all that they have.’
verses.textEn: The men are shepherds; they tend livestock, and they have brought along their flocks and herds and everything they own.’

verses.textZh: 法老召见你们的时候，如果问你们：‘你们是作甚么的？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老召见你们的时候，如果问你们：‘你们是作甚么的？’
verses.textZhCuv: 等法老召你们的时候，问你们说：『你们以何事为业？』
verses.textEnNiv: When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’
verses.textEnEsv: When Pharaoh calls you and says, ‘What is your occupation?’
verses.textEnNkjv: So it shall be, when Pharaoh calls you and says, ‘What is your occupation?’
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "When Pharaoh calls for you and asks you about your occupation,
verses.textEnNasb: When Pharaoh calls for you and says, ‘What is your occupation?’
verses.textEn: When Pharaoh calls you in and asks, ‘What is your occupation?’

verses.textZh: 你们就要回答：‘仆人们从幼年直到现在，都是以牧养牲畜为生。我们和我们的祖先都是一样。’这样，你们就可以住在歌珊地，因为埃及人厌恶所有牧羊的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们就要回答：‘仆人们从幼年直到现在，都是以牧养牲畜为生。我们和我们的祖先都是一样。’这样，你们就可以住在歌珊地，因为埃及人厌恶所有牧羊的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们要说：『你的仆人，从幼年直到如今，都以养牲畜为业，连我们的祖宗也都以此为业。』这样，你们可以住在歌珊地，因为凡牧羊的都被埃及人所厌恶。」
verses.textEnNiv: you should answer, ‘Your servants have tended livestock from our boyhood on, just as our fathers did.’ Then you will be allowed to settle in the region of Goshen, for all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians."
verses.textEnEsv: you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we and our fathers,’ in order that you may dwell in the land of Goshen, for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians."
verses.textEnNkjv: that you shall say, ‘Your servants’ occupation has been with livestock from our youth even till now, both we and also our fathers,’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians."
verses.textEnNlt: you must tell him, ‘We, your servants, have raised livestock all our lives, as our ancestors have always done.’ When you tell him this, he will let you live here in the region of Goshen, for the Egyptians despise shepherds."
verses.textEnNasb: you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock since our youth even until now, both we and our fathers,’ so that you may live in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians."
verses.textEn: you should answer, ‘Your servants have tended livestock from our boyhood on, just as our fathers did.’ Then you will be allowed to settle in the region of Goshen, for all shepherds are detestable to the Egyptians."

verses.textZh: 约瑟进去禀告法老，说："我的父亲和兄弟们，带着他们的牛羊和他们所有的一切，都从迦南地来了，现在就在歌珊地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟进去禀告法老，说："我的父亲和兄弟们，带着他们的牛羊和他们所有的一切，都从迦南地来了，现在就在歌珊地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟进去告诉法老说：「我的父亲和我的弟兄带着羊群牛群，并一切所有的，从迦南地来了，如今在歌珊地。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph went and told Pharaoh, "My father and brothers, with their flocks and herds and everything they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen."
verses.textEnEsv: So Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, "My father and my brothers, with their flocks and herds and all that they possess, have come from the land of Canaan. They are now in the land of Goshen."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph went and told Pharaoh, and said, "My father and my brothers, their flocks and their herds and all that they possess, have come from the land of Canaan; and indeed they are in the land of Goshen."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joseph went to see Pharaoh and told him, "My father and my brothers have arrived from the land of Canaan. They have come with all their flocks and herds and possessions, and they are now in the region of Goshen."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, "My father and my brothers and their flocks and their herds and all that they have, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen."
verses.textEn: Joseph went and told Pharaoh, "My father and brothers, with their flocks and herds and everything they own, have come from the land of Canaan and are now in Goshen."

verses.textZh: 约瑟从他所有的兄弟当中，挑选了五个人，把他们带到法老面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟从他所有的兄弟当中，挑选了五个人，把他们带到法老面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟从他弟兄中挑出五个人来，引他们去见法老。
verses.textEnNiv: He chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.
verses.textEnEsv: And from among his brothers he took five men and presented them to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he took five men from among his brothers and presented them to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph took five of his brothers with him and presented them to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: And he took five men from among his brothers and presented them to Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: He chose five of his brothers and presented them before Pharaoh.

verses.textZh: 法老问约瑟的兄弟们说："你们是作甚么的？"他们回答法老："仆人们是牧羊人，我们和我们的祖先都是一样。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老问约瑟的兄弟们说："你们是作甚么的？"他们回答法老："仆人们是牧羊人，我们和我们的祖先都是一样。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老问约瑟的弟兄说：「你们以何事为业？」他们对法老说：「你仆人是牧羊的，连我们的祖宗也是牧羊的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh asked the brothers, "What is your occupation?" "Your servants are shepherds," they replied to Pharaoh, "just as our fathers were."
verses.textEnEsv: Pharaoh said to his brothers, "What is your occupation?" And they said to Pharaoh, "Your servants are shepherds, as our fathers were."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh said to his brothers, "What is your occupation?" And they said to Pharaoh, "Your servants are shepherds, both we and also our fathers."
verses.textEnNlt: And Pharaoh asked the brothers, "What is your occupation?" They replied, "We, your servants, are shepherds, just like our ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh said to his brothers, "What is your occupation?" So they said to Pharaoh, "Your servants are shepherds, both we and our fathers."
verses.textEn: Pharaoh asked the brothers, "What is your occupation?" "Your servants are shepherds," they replied to Pharaoh, "just as our fathers were."

verses.textZh: 他们又对法老说："我们来是要在这地寄居，因为迦南地的饥荒严重，你仆人们的羊群没有草吃，所以，现在求你容许你仆人住在歌珊地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们又对法老说："我们来是要在这地寄居，因为迦南地的饥荒严重，你仆人们的羊群没有草吃，所以，现在求你容许你仆人住在歌珊地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们又对法老说：「迦南地的饥荒甚大，仆人的羊群没有草吃，所以我们来到这地寄居。现在求你容仆人住在歌珊地。」
verses.textEnNiv: They also said to him, "We have come to live here for a while, because the famine is severe in Canaan and your servants’ flocks have no pasture. So now, please let your servants settle in Goshen."
verses.textEnEsv: They said to Pharaoh, "We have come to sojourn in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks, for the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. And now, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen."
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to Pharaoh, "We have come to dwell in the land, because your servants have no pasture for their flocks, for the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen."
verses.textEnNlt: We have come to live here in Egypt for a while, for there is no pasture for our flocks in Canaan. The famine is very severe there. So please, we request permission to live in the region of Goshen."
verses.textEnNasb: They also said to Pharaoh, "We have come to reside in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks, for the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now, therefore, please let your servants live in the land of Goshen."
verses.textEn: They also said to him, "We have come to live here for a while, because the famine is severe in Canaan and your servants’ flocks have no pasture. So now, please let your servants settle in Goshen."

verses.textZh: 法老对约瑟说："你的父亲和兄弟们到你这里来了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老对约瑟说："你的父亲和兄弟们到你这里来了；
verses.textZhCuv: 法老对约瑟说：「你父亲和你弟兄到你这里来了，
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Your father and your brothers have come to you,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Your father and your brothers have come to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, "Your father and your brothers have come to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Now that your father and brothers have joined you here,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Your father and your brothers have come to you.
verses.textEn: Pharaoh said to Joseph, "Your father and your brothers have come to you,

verses.textZh: 埃及地都在你面前，你只管叫你的父亲和兄弟们住在这地最好的地方，他们可以住在歌珊地。你如果知道他们中间有能干的人，可以派他们看管我的牲畜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及地都在你面前，你只管叫你的父亲和兄弟们住在这地最好的地方，他们可以住在歌珊地。你如果知道他们中间有能干的人，可以派他们看管我的牲畜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及地都在你面前，只管叫你父亲和你弟兄住在国中最好的地；他们可以住在歌珊地。你若知道他们中间有什么能人，就派他们看管我的牲畜。」
verses.textEnNiv: and the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and your brothers in the best part of the land. Let them live in Goshen. And if you know of any among them with special ability, put them in charge of my own livestock."
verses.textEnEsv: The land of Egypt is before you. Settle your father and your brothers in the best of the land. Let them settle in the land of Goshen, and if you know any able men among them, put them in charge of my livestock."
verses.textEnNkjv: The land of Egypt is before you. Have your father and brothers dwell in the best of the land; let them dwell in the land of Goshen. And if you know any competent men among them, then make them chief herdsmen over my livestock."
verses.textEnNlt: choose any place in the entire land of Egypt for them to live. Give them the best land of Egypt. Let them live in the region of Goshen. And if any of them have special skills, put them in charge of my livestock, too."
verses.textEnNasb: The land of Egypt is at your disposal; settle your father and your brothers in the best of the land, let them live in the land of Goshen; and if you know any capable men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock."
verses.textEn: and the land of Egypt is before you; settle your father and your brothers in the best part of the land. Let them live in Goshen. And if you know of any among them with special ability, put them in charge of my own livestock."

verses.textZh: 约瑟把他父亲雅各带到法老面前，雅各就给法老祝福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟把他父亲雅各带到法老面前，雅各就给法老祝福。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟领他父亲雅各进到法老面前，雅各就给法老祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob in and presented him before Pharaoh. After Jacob blessed Pharaoh,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph brought in Jacob his father and stood him before Pharaoh, and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph brought in his father Jacob and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joseph brought in his father, Jacob, and presented him to Pharaoh. And Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob and presented him to Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: Then Joseph brought his father Jacob in and presented him before Pharaoh. After Jacob blessed Pharaoh,

verses.textZh: 法老问雅各："你有多大年纪了？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老问雅各："你有多大年纪了？"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老问雅各说：「你平生的年日是多少呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh asked him, "How old are you?"
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh said to Jacob, "How many are the days of the years of your life?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Pharaoh said to Jacob, "How old are you?"
verses.textEnNlt: "How old are you?" Pharaoh asked him.
verses.textEnNasb: And Pharaoh said to Jacob, "How many years have you lived?"
verses.textEn: Pharaoh asked him, "How old are you?"

verses.textZh: 雅各回答法老："我寄居在世的年日是一百三十岁。我一生的年日又少又苦，不及我祖先寄居在世的年日。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各回答法老："我寄居在世的年日是一百三十岁。我一生的年日又少又苦，不及我祖先寄居在世的年日。"
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各对法老说：「我寄居在世的年日是一百三十岁，我平生的年日又少又苦，不及我列祖在世寄居的年日。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The years of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty. My years have been few and difficult, and they do not equal the years of the pilgrimage of my fathers."
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The days of the years of my sojourning are 130 years. Few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their sojourning."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The days of the years of my pilgrimage are one hundred and thirty years; few and evil have been the days of the years of my life, and they have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage."
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob replied, "I have traveled this earth for 130 hard years. But my life has been short compared to the lives of my ancestors."
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The years of my living abroad are 130; few and unpleasant have been the years of my life, nor have they attained the years that my fathers lived during the days of their living abroad."
verses.textEn: And Jacob said to Pharaoh, "The years of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty. My years have been few and difficult, and they do not equal the years of the pilgrimage of my fathers."

verses.textZh: 雅各又给法老祝福，然后离开法老出去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各又给法老祝福，然后离开法老出去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各又给法老祝福，就从法老面前出去了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from his presence.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh again before leaving his court.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from his presence.
verses.textEn: Then Jacob blessed Pharaoh and went out from his presence.

verses.textZh: 约瑟照着法老的吩咐安置他的父亲和兄弟们，把兰塞地，就是埃及地最好的地方，给他们作产业。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟照着法老的吩咐安置他的父亲和兄弟们，把兰塞地，就是埃及地最好的地方，给他们作产业。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟遵着法老的命，把埃及国最好的地，就是兰塞境内的地，给他父亲和弟兄居住，作为产业。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joseph settled his father and his brothers in Egypt and gave them property in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh directed.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph settled his father and his brothers and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph situated his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joseph assigned the best land of Egypt—the region of Rameses—to his father and his brothers, and he settled them there, just as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joseph settled his father and his brothers and gave them property in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had ordered.
verses.textEn: So Joseph settled his father and his brothers in Egypt and gave them property in the best part of the land, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh directed.

verses.textZh: 约瑟照着孩子的数目，用粮食供养他的父亲、兄弟们，以及父亲的家人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟照着孩子的数目，用粮食供养他的父亲、兄弟们，以及父亲的家人。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟用粮食奉养他父亲和他弟兄，并他父亲全家的眷属，都是照各家的人口奉养他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph also provided his father and his brothers and all his father’s household with food, according to the number of their children.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all his father’s household with food, according to the number of their dependents.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all his father’s household with bread, according to the number in their families.
verses.textEnNlt: And Joseph provided food for his father and his brothers in amounts appropriate to the number of their dependents, including the smallest children.
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph also provided his father and his brothers and all his father’s household with food, according to the number of their little ones.
verses.textEn: Joseph also provided his father and his brothers and all his father’s household with food, according to the number of their children.

verses.textZh: 那时，遍地都没有粮食，因为饥荒非常严重。埃及地和迦南地的人，因为饥荒的缘故都饿昏了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，遍地都没有粮食，因为饥荒非常严重。埃及地和迦南地的人，因为饥荒的缘故都饿昏了。
verses.textZhCuv: 饥荒甚大，全地都绝了粮，甚至埃及地和迦南地的人因那饥荒的缘故都饿昏了。
verses.textEnNiv: There was no food, however, in the whole region because the famine was severe; both Egypt and Canaan wasted away because of the famine.
verses.textEnEsv: Now there was no food in all the land, for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan languished by reason of the famine.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therewas no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan languished because of the famine.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the famine became so severe that all the food was used up, and people were starving throughout the lands of Egypt and Canaan.
verses.textEnNasb: Now there was no food in all the land, because the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan languished because of the famine.
verses.textEn: There was no food, however, in the whole region because the famine was severe; both Egypt and Canaan wasted away because of the famine.

verses.textZh: 约瑟收集了埃及地和迦南地所有的银子，就是众人买粮的银子；约瑟就把那些银子交到法老的王宫去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟收集了埃及地和迦南地所有的银子，就是众人买粮的银子；约瑟就把那些银子交到法老的王宫去。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟收聚了埃及地和迦南地所有的银子，就是众人籴粮的银子，约瑟就把那银子带到法老的宫里。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph collected all the money that was to be found in Egypt and Canaan in payment for the grain they were buying, and he brought it to Pharaoh’s palace.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, in exchange for the grain that they bought. And Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought; and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.textEnNlt: By selling grain to the people, Joseph eventually collected all the money in Egypt and Canaan, and he put the money in Pharaoh’s treasury.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph collected all the money that was found in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan in payment for the grain which they bought, and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.textEn: Joseph collected all the money that was to be found in Egypt and Canaan in payment for the grain they were buying, and he brought it to Pharaoh’s palace.

verses.textZh: 埃及地和迦南地的银子都用尽了，埃及众人就来到约瑟那里，说："银子已用完了。求你给我们粮食吧，我们为甚么要饿死在你面前呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 埃及地和迦南地的银子都用尽了，埃及众人就来到约瑟那里，说："银子已用完了。求你给我们粮食吧，我们为甚么要饿死在你面前呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 埃及地和迦南地的银子都花尽了，埃及众人都来见约瑟，说：「我们的银子都用尽了，求你给我们粮食，我们为什么死在你面前呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: When the money of the people of Egypt and Canaan was gone, all Egypt came to Joseph and said, "Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? Our money is all gone."
verses.textEnEsv: And when the money was all spent in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, "Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? For our money is gone."
verses.textEnNkjv: So when the money failed in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph and said, "Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For the money has failed."
verses.textEnNlt: When the people of Egypt and Canaan ran out of money, all the Egyptians came to Joseph. "Our money is gone!" they cried. "But please give us food, or we will die before your very eyes!"
verses.textEnNasb: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph saying, "Give us food, for why should we die in your presence? For our money is gone."
verses.textEn: When the money of the people of Egypt and Canaan was gone, all Egypt came to Joseph and said, "Give us food. Why should we die before your eyes? Our money is all gone."

verses.textZh: 约瑟回答："如果银子用完了，可以把你们的牲畜给我，我就把粮食给你们，交换你们的牲畜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟回答："如果银子用完了，可以把你们的牲畜给我，我就把粮食给你们，交换你们的牲畜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟说：「若是银子用尽了，可以把你们的牲畜给我，我就为你们的牲畜给你们粮食。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Then bring your livestock," said Joseph. "I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock, since your money is gone."
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph answered, "Give your livestock, and I will give you food in exchange for your livestock, if your money is gone."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph said, "Give your livestock, and I will give you bread for your livestock, if the money is gone."
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph replied, "Since your money is gone, bring me your livestock. I will give you food in exchange for your livestock."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph said, "Give up your livestock, and I will give you food for your livestock, since your money is gone."
verses.textEn: "Then bring your livestock," said Joseph. "I will sell you food in exchange for your livestock, since your money is gone."

verses.textZh: 于是，他们把牲畜带到约瑟那里，约瑟就把粮食给他们，交换他们的马匹、羊群、牛群和驴。那一年，约瑟就用粮食交换他们所有的牲畜，来养活他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，他们把牲畜带到约瑟那里，约瑟就把粮食给他们，交换他们的马匹、羊群、牛群和驴。那一年，约瑟就用粮食交换他们所有的牲畜，来养活他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是他们把牲畜赶到约瑟那里，约瑟就拿粮食换了他们的牛、羊、驴、马；那一年因换他们一切的牲畜，就用粮食养活他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their sheep and goats, their cattle and donkeys. And he brought them through that year with food in exchange for all their livestock.
verses.textEnEsv: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them food in exchange for the horses, the flocks, the herds, and the donkeys. He supplied them with food in exchange for all their livestock that year.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread inexchange for the horses, the flocks, the cattle of the herds, and for the donkeys. Thus he fed them with bread inexchange for all their livestock that year.
verses.textEnNlt: So they brought their livestock to Joseph in exchange for food. In exchange for their horses, flocks of sheep and goats, herds of cattle, and donkeys, Joseph provided them with food for another year.
verses.textEnNasb: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them food in exchange for the horses and the flocks and the herds and the donkeys; and he fed them with food in exchange for all their livestock that year.
verses.textEn: So they brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for their horses, their sheep and goats, their cattle and donkeys. And he brought them through that year with food in exchange for all their livestock.

verses.textZh: 那一年过后，第二年他们又来到约瑟那里，对他说："我们不向我主隐瞒，我们的银子都用尽了，牲畜也归了我主；在我主面前，除了我们的身体和田地以外，甚么也没有剩下了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一年过后，第二年他们又来到约瑟那里，对他说："我们不向我主隐瞒，我们的银子都用尽了，牲畜也归了我主；在我主面前，除了我们的身体和田地以外，甚么也没有剩下了。
verses.textZhCuv: 那一年过去，第二年他们又来见约瑟，说：「我们不瞒我主，我们的银子都花尽了，牲畜也都归了我主。我们在我主眼前，除了我们的身体和田地之外，一无所剩。
verses.textEnNiv: When that year was over, they came to him the following year and said, "We cannot hide from our lord the fact that since our money is gone and our livestock belongs to you, there is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land.
verses.textEnEsv: And when that year was ended, they came to him the following year and said to him, "We will not hide from my lord that our money is all spent. The herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord but our bodies and our land.
verses.textEnNkjv: When that year had ended, they came to him the next year and said to him, "We will not hide from my lord that our money is gone; my lord also has our herds of livestock. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord but our bodies and our lands.
verses.textEnNlt: But that year ended, and the next year they came again and said, "We cannot hide the truth from you, my lord. Our money is gone, and all our livestock and cattle are yours. We have nothing left to give but our bodies and our land.
verses.textEnNasb: But when that year ended, they came to him the next year and said to him, "We will not hide from my lord the fact that our money is all spent, and the livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left for my lord except our bodies and our lands.
verses.textEn: When that year was over, they came to him the following year and said, "We cannot hide from our lord the fact that since our money is gone and our livestock belongs to you, there is nothing left for our lord except our bodies and our land.

verses.textZh: 为甚么我们和我们的田地要在你面前消灭呢？求你用粮食买我们和我们的田地，我们和田地就必为法老效劳了。又求你给我们谷种，使我们可以活着，不至死亡，田地也不至荒芜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么我们和我们的田地要在你面前消灭呢？求你用粮食买我们和我们的田地，我们和田地就必为法老效劳了。又求你给我们谷种，使我们可以活着，不至死亡，田地也不至荒芜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你何忍见我们人死地荒呢？求你用粮食买我们和我们的地，我们和我们的地就要给法老效力。又求你给我们种子，使我们得以存活，不至死亡，地土也不至荒凉。」
verses.textEnNiv: Why should we perish before your eyes—we and our land as well? Buy us and our land in exchange for food, and we with our land will be in bondage to Pharaoh. Give us seed so that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate."
verses.textEnEsv: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for food, and we with our land will be servants to Pharaoh. And give us seed that we may live and not die, and that the land may not be desolate."
verses.textEnNkjv: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants of Pharaoh; give us seed, that we may live and not die, that the land may not be desolate."
verses.textEnNlt: Why should we die before your very eyes? Buy us and our land in exchange for food; we offer our land and ourselves as slaves for Pharaoh. Just give us grain so we may live and not die, and so the land does not become empty and desolate."
verses.textEnNasb: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for food, and we and our land will be slaves to Pharaoh. So give us seed, so that we may live and not die, and that the land may not be desolate."
verses.textEn: Why should we perish before your eyes—we and our land as well? Buy us and our land in exchange for food, and we with our land will be in bondage to Pharaoh. Give us seed so that we may live and not die, and that the land may not become desolate."

verses.textZh: 于是，约瑟为法老买了埃及所有的田地，因为埃及人遭遇了严重的饥荒，各人都卖了自己的田地。这样，那地就都归法老所有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约瑟为法老买了埃及所有的田地，因为埃及人遭遇了严重的饥荒，各人都卖了自己的田地。这样，那地就都归法老所有。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，约瑟为法老买了埃及所有的地，埃及人因被饥荒所迫，各都卖了自己的田地；那地就都归了法老。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joseph bought all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh. The Egyptians, one and all, sold their fields, because the famine was too severe for them. The land became Pharaoh’s,
verses.textEnEsv: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for all the Egyptians sold their fields, because the famine was severe on them. The land became Pharaoh’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe upon them. So the land became Pharaoh’s.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh. All the Egyptians sold him their fields because the famine was so severe, and soon all the land belonged to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every Egyptian sold his field, because the famine was severe upon them. So the land became Pharaoh’s.
verses.textEn: So Joseph bought all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh. The Egyptians, one and all, sold their fields, because the famine was too severe for them. The land became Pharaoh’s,

verses.textZh: 至于人民，约瑟使他们作奴仆 ，从埃及境内的一端，直到另一端。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于人民，约瑟使他们作奴仆 ，从埃及境内的一端，直到另一端。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于百姓，约瑟叫他们，从埃及这边直到埃及那边，都各归各城。
verses.textEnNiv: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude, from one end of Egypt to the other.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the people, he made servants of them from one end of Egypt to the other.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as for the people, he moved them into the cities, from one end of the borders of Egypt to the other end.
verses.textEnNlt: As for the people, he made them all slaves, from one end of Egypt to the other.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the people, he relocated them to the cities from one end of Egypt’s border to the other.
verses.textEn: and Joseph reduced the people to servitude, from one end of Egypt to the other.

verses.textZh: 只有祭司的田地，约瑟没有买，因为祭司有从法老所得的粮饷；他们可以吃法老所给的粮饷，所以没有卖自己的田地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有祭司的田地，约瑟没有买，因为祭司有从法老所得的粮饷；他们可以吃法老所给的粮饷，所以没有卖自己的田地。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有祭司的地，约瑟没有买，因为祭司有从法老所得的常俸。他们吃法老所给的常俸，所以他们不卖自己的地。
verses.textEnNiv: However, he did not buy the land of the priests, because they received a regular allotment from Pharaoh and had food enough from the allotment Pharaoh gave them. That is why they did not sell their land.
verses.textEnEsv: Only the land of the priests he did not buy, for the priests had a fixed allowance from Pharaoh and lived on the allowance that Pharaoh gave them; therefore they did not sell their land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Only the land of the priests he did not buy; for the priests had rations allottedtothem by Pharaoh, and they ate their rations which Pharaoh gave them; therefore they did not sell their lands.
verses.textEnNlt: The only land he did not buy was the land belonging to the priests. They received an allotment of food directly from Pharaoh, so they didn’t need to sell their land.
verses.textEnNasb: Only the land of the priests he did not buy, because the priests had an allotment from Pharaoh, and they lived off the allotment which Pharaoh gave them. Therefore, they did not sell their land.
verses.textEn: However, he did not buy the land of the priests, because they received a regular allotment from Pharaoh and had food enough from the allotment Pharaoh gave them. That is why they did not sell their land.

verses.textZh: 约瑟对人民说："看哪，我今日为法老买了你们和你们的田地。这里有谷种给你们，你们可以种地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对人民说："看哪，我今日为法老买了你们和你们的田地。这里有谷种给你们，你们可以种地。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟对百姓说：「我今日为法老买了你们和你们的地，看哪，这里有种子给你们，你们可以种地。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph said to the people, "Now that I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh, here is seed for you so you can plant the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph said to the people, "Behold, I have this day bought you and your land for Pharaoh. Now here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph said to the people, "Indeed I have bought you and your land this day for Pharaoh. Look, hereis seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joseph said to the people, "Look, today I have bought you and your land for Pharaoh. I will provide you with seed so you can plant the fields.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph said to the people, "Behold, today I have purchased you and your land for Pharaoh; now, here is seed for you, and you may sow the land.
verses.textEn: Joseph said to the people, "Now that I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh, here is seed for you so you can plant the ground.

verses.textZh: 到了收割的时候，你们要把五分之一给法老，其余四分可以归你们自己，作田里的种子，又作你们以及你们家人和孩子的食物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了收割的时候，你们要把五分之一给法老，其余四分可以归你们自己，作田里的种子，又作你们以及你们家人和孩子的食物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 后来打粮食的时候，你们要把五分之一纳给法老，四分可以归你们做地里的种子，也做你们和你们家口孩童的食物。」
verses.textEnNiv: But when the crop comes in, give a fifth of it to Pharaoh. The other four-fifths you may keep as seed for the fields and as food for yourselves and your households and your children."
verses.textEnEsv: And at the harvests you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four fifths shall be your own, as seed for the field and as food for yourselves and your households, and as food for your little ones."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it shall come to pass in the harvest that you shall give one-fifth to Pharaoh. Four-fifths shall be your own, as seed for the field and for your food, for those of your households and as food for your little ones."
verses.textEnNlt: Then when you harvest it, one-fifth of your crop will belong to Pharaoh. You may keep the remaining four-fifths as seed for your fields and as food for you, your households, and your little ones."
verses.textEnNasb: At the harvest you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four-fifths shall be your own for seed of the field and for your food, and for those of your households and as food for your little ones."
verses.textEn: But when the crop comes in, give a fifth of it to Pharaoh. The other four-fifths you may keep as seed for the fields and as food for yourselves and your households and your children."

verses.textZh: 他们说："你救了我们；愿我们在我主面前得蒙喜悦，我们就作法老的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们说："你救了我们；愿我们在我主面前得蒙喜悦，我们就作法老的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们说：「你救了我们的性命。但愿我们在我主眼前蒙恩，我们就作法老的仆人。」
verses.textEnNiv: "You have saved our lives," they said. "May we find favor in the eyes of our lord; we will be in bondage to Pharaoh."
verses.textEnEsv: And they said, "You have saved our lives; may it please my lord, we will be servants to Pharaoh."
verses.textEnNkjv: So they said, "You have saved our lives; let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants."
verses.textEnNlt: "You have saved our lives!" they exclaimed. "May it please you, my lord, to let us be Pharaoh’s servants."
verses.textEnNasb: So they said, "You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s slaves."
verses.textEn: "You have saved our lives," they said. "May we find favor in the eyes of our lord; we will be in bondage to Pharaoh."

verses.textZh: 于是，约瑟为埃及的田地立了一个法例，直到今日还有效，就是五分之一归给法老；只有祭司的田地不归给法老。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约瑟为埃及的田地立了一个法例，直到今日还有效，就是五分之一归给法老；只有祭司的田地不归给法老。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约瑟为埃及地定下常例，直到今日：法老必得五分之一，惟独祭司的地不归法老。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joseph established it as a law concerning land in Egypt—still in force today—that a fifth of the produce belongs to Pharaoh. It was only the land of the priests that did not become Pharaoh’s.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt, and it stands to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth; the land of the priests alone did not become Pharaoh’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have one-fifth, except for the land of the priests only, which did not become Pharaoh’s.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph then issued a decree still in effect in the land of Egypt, that Pharaoh should receive one-fifth of all the crops grown on his land. Only the land belonging to the priests was not given to Pharaoh.
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt, valid to this day, that Pharaoh was to have the fifth; only the land of the priests did not become Pharaoh’s.
verses.textEn: So Joseph established it as a law concerning land in Egypt—still in force today—that a fifth of the produce belongs to Pharaoh. It was only the land of the priests that did not become Pharaoh’s.

verses.textZh: 以色列人住在埃及国的歌珊地，他们在那里置业繁衍，人数非常众多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列人住在埃及国的歌珊地，他们在那里置业繁衍，人数非常众多。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列人住在埃及的歌珊地。他们在那里置了产业，并且生育甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Israelites settled in Egypt in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and were fruitful and increased greatly in number.
verses.textEnEsv: Thus Israel settled in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen. And they gained possessions in it, and were fruitful and multiplied greatly.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Israel dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions there and grew and multiplied exceedingly.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, the people of Israel settled in the region of Goshen in Egypt. There they acquired property, and they were fruitful, and their population grew rapidly.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in Goshen, and they acquired property in it and were fruitful and became very numerous.
verses.textEn: Now the Israelites settled in Egypt in the region of Goshen. They acquired property there and were fruitful and increased greatly in number.

verses.textZh: 雅各在埃及地住了十七年；他一生的寿数是一百四十七岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各在埃及地住了十七年；他一生的寿数是一百四十七岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各住在埃及地十七年，雅各平生的年日是一百四十七岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years, and the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were 147 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the length of Jacob’s life was one hundred and forty-seven years.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob lived for seventeen years after his arrival in Egypt, so he lived 147 years in all.
verses.textEnNasb: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt for seventeen years; so the length of Jacob’s life was 147 years.
verses.textEn: Jacob lived in Egypt seventeen years, and the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.

verses.textZh: 以色列的死期快到了，就把他儿子约瑟叫了来，对他说："如果我在你面前蒙你喜悦，请你把手放在我的大腿底下起誓，要以慈爱和诚实对待我，不要把我埋葬在埃及。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列的死期快到了，就把他儿子约瑟叫了来，对他说："如果我在你面前蒙你喜悦，请你把手放在我的大腿底下起誓，要以慈爱和诚实对待我，不要把我埋葬在埃及。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列的死期临近了，他就叫了他儿子约瑟来，说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你把手放在我大腿底下，用慈爱和诚实待我，请你不要将我葬在埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called for his son Joseph and said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise that you will show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,
verses.textEnEsv: And when the time drew near that Israel must die, he called his son Joseph and said to him, "If now I have found favor in your sight, put your hand under my thigh and promise to deal kindly and truly with me. Do not bury me in Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: When the time drew near that Israel must die, he called his son Joseph and said to him, "Now if I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please do not bury me in Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: As the time of his death drew near, Jacob called for his son Joseph and said to him, "Please do me this favor. Put your hand under my thigh and swear that you will treat me with unfailing love by honoring this last request: Do not bury me in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: When the time for Israel to die drew near, he called his son Joseph and said to him, "Please, if I have found favor in your sight, place your hand under my thigh now and deal with me in kindness and faithfulness: please do not bury me in Egypt,
verses.textEn: When the time drew near for Israel to die, he called for his son Joseph and said to him, "If I have found favor in your eyes, put your hand under my thigh and promise that you will show me kindness and faithfulness. Do not bury me in Egypt,

verses.textZh: 我与我的祖先同睡的时候，你要把我从埃及带出去，埋葬在他们的墓地里。"约瑟说："我必照着你的话去作。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我与我的祖先同睡的时候，你要把我从埃及带出去，埋葬在他们的墓地里。"约瑟说："我必照着你的话去作。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我与我祖我父同睡的时候，你要将我带出埃及，葬在他们所葬的地方。」约瑟说：「我必遵着你的命而行。」
verses.textEnNiv: but when I rest with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me where they are buried." "I will do as you say," he said.
verses.textEnEsv: but let me lie with my fathers. Carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their burying place." He answered, "I will do as you have said."
verses.textEnNkjv: but let me lie with my fathers; you shall carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their burial place." And he said, "I will do as you have said."
verses.textEnNlt: When I die, please take my body out of Egypt and bury me with my ancestors." So Joseph promised, "I will do as you ask."
verses.textEnNasb: but when I lie down with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt and bury me in their burial place." And he said, "I will do as you have said."
verses.textEn: but when I rest with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me where they are buried." "I will do as you say," he said.

verses.textZh: 雅各说："你要向我起誓。"约瑟就向他起了誓，于是以色列靠着床头 敬拜神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各说："你要向我起誓。"约瑟就向他起了誓，于是以色列靠着床头 敬拜神。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各说：「你要向我起誓。」约瑟就向他起了誓，于是以色列在床头上 敬拜神。
verses.textEnNiv: "Swear to me," he said. Then Joseph swore to him, and Israel worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "Swear to me"; and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself upon the head of his bed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Swear to me." And he swore to him. So Israel bowed himself on the head of the bed.
verses.textEnNlt: "Swear that you will do it," Jacob insisted. So Joseph gave his oath, and Jacob bowed humbly at the head of his bed.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Swear to me." So he swore to him. Then Israel bowed in worship at the head of the bed.
verses.textEn: "Swear to me," he said. Then Joseph swore to him, and Israel worshiped as he leaned on the top of his staff.

verses.textZh: 这些事以后，有人对约瑟说："你的父亲病了。"约瑟就带着两个儿子玛拿西和以法莲同去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些事以后，有人对约瑟说："你的父亲病了。"约瑟就带着两个儿子玛拿西和以法莲同去。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事以后，有人告诉约瑟说：「你的父亲病了。」他就带着两个儿子玛拿西和以法莲同去。
verses.textEnNiv: Some time later Joseph was told, "Your father is ill." So he took his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim along with him.
verses.textEnEsv: After this, Joseph was told, "Behold, your father is ill." So he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it came to pass after these things that Joseph was told, "Indeed your father is sick"; and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.textEnNlt: One day not long after this, word came to Joseph, "Your father is failing rapidly." So Joseph went to visit his father, and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.textEnNasb: Now it came about after these things that Joseph was told, "Behold, your father is sick." So he took his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim with him.
verses.textEn: Some time later Joseph was told, "Your father is ill." So he took his two sons Manasseh and Ephraim along with him.

verses.textZh: 有人告诉雅各，说："你的儿子约瑟到你这里来了。"以色列就勉强在床上坐起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人告诉雅各，说："你的儿子约瑟到你这里来了。"以色列就勉强在床上坐起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人告诉雅各说：「请看，你儿子约瑟到你这里来了。」以色列就勉强在床上坐起来。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jacob was told, "Your son Joseph has come to you," Israel rallied his strength and sat up on the bed.
verses.textEnEsv: And it was told to Jacob, "Your son Joseph has come to you." Then Israel summoned his strength and sat up in bed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob was told, "Look, your son Joseph is coming to you"; and Israel strengthened himself and sat up on the bed.
verses.textEnNlt: When Joseph arrived, Jacob was told, "Your son Joseph has come to see you." So Jacob gathered his strength and sat up in his bed.
verses.textEnNasb: When it was told to Jacob, "Behold, your son Joseph has come to you," Israel collected his strength and sat up in the bed.
verses.textEn: When Jacob was told, "Your son Joseph has come to you," Israel rallied his strength and sat up on the bed.

verses.textZh: 雅各对约瑟说："全能的神曾经在迦南地的路斯向我显现，赐福给我，
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各对约瑟说："全能的神曾经在迦南地的路斯向我显现，赐福给我，
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各对约瑟说：「全能的神曾在迦南地的路斯向我显现，赐福与我，
verses.textEnNiv: Jacob said to Joseph, "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there he blessed me
verses.textEnEsv: And Jacob said to Joseph, "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jacob said to Joseph: "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me,
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob said to Joseph, "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob said to Joseph, " God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan and blessed me,
verses.textEn: Jacob said to Joseph, "God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and there he blessed me

verses.textZh: 对我说：‘我必使你繁衍增多，成为一大族；我必把这地赐给你的后裔，作永远的产业。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 对我说：‘我必使你繁衍增多，成为一大族；我必把这地赐给你的后裔，作永远的产业。’
verses.textZhCuv: 对我说：『我必使你生养众多，成为多民，又要把这地赐给你的后裔，永远为业。』
verses.textEnNiv: and said to me, ‘I am going to make you fruitful and increase your numbers. I will make you a community of peoples, and I will give this land as an everlasting possession to your descendants after you.’
verses.textEnEsv: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’
verses.textEnNkjv: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful and multiply you, and I will make of you a multitude of people, and give this land to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession.’
verses.textEnNlt: He said to me, ‘I will make you fruitful, and I will multiply your descendants. I will make you a multitude of nations. And I will give this land of Canaan to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession.’
verses.textEnNasb: and He said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful and numerous, and I will make you a multitude of peoples, and will give this land to your descendants after you as an everlasting possession.’
verses.textEn: and said to me, ‘I am going to make you fruitful and increase your numbers. I will make you a community of peoples, and I will give this land as an everlasting possession to your descendants after you.’

verses.textZh: 我未到埃及见你之前，你在埃及地生了两个儿子，现在他们算是我的；以法莲和玛拿西是我的，好象流本和西缅是我的一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我未到埃及见你之前，你在埃及地生了两个儿子，现在他们算是我的；以法莲和玛拿西是我的，好象流本和西缅是我的一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 我未到埃及见你之先，你在埃及地所生的以法莲和玛拿西这两个儿子是我的，正如吕便和西缅是我的一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here will be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh will be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.
verses.textEnEsv: And now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you in Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, as Reuben and Simeon are.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you in Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now I am claiming as my own sons these two boys of yours, Ephraim and Manasseh, who were born here in the land of Egypt before I arrived. They will be my sons, just as Reuben and Simeon are.
verses.textEnNasb: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you in Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh shall be mine, as Reuben and Simeon are.
verses.textEn: "Now then, your two sons born to you in Egypt before I came to you here will be reckoned as mine; Ephraim and Manasseh will be mine, just as Reuben and Simeon are mine.

verses.textZh: 你在他们以后所生的子孙，都是你的；不过，在继承产业的事上，他们可以归在他们哥哥的名下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你在他们以后所生的子孙，都是你的；不过，在继承产业的事上，他们可以归在他们哥哥的名下。
verses.textZhCuv: 你在他们以后所生的就是你的，他们可以归于他们弟兄的名下得产业。
verses.textEnNiv: Any children born to you after them will be yours; in the territory they inherit they will be reckoned under the names of their brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: And the children that you fathered after them shall be yours. They shall be called by the name of their brothers in their inheritance.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your offspring whom you beget after them shall be yours; they will be called by the name of their brothers in their inheritance.
verses.textEnNlt: But any children born to you in the future will be your own, and they will inherit land within the territories of their brothers Ephraim and Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: But your children that you have fathered after them shall be yours; they shall be called by the names of their brothers in their inheritance.
verses.textEn: Any children born to you after them will be yours; in the territory they inherit they will be reckoned under the names of their brothers.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我从巴旦回来的时候，在迦南地的路上，那里到以法他还有一段路程，拉结就死在我身边；我在那里把她埋葬在以法他的路旁。以法他就是伯利恒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我从巴旦回来的时候，在迦南地的路上，那里到以法他还有一段路程，拉结就死在我身边；我在那里把她埋葬在以法他的路旁。以法他就是伯利恒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我，我从巴旦来的时候，拉结死在我眼前，在迦南地的路上，离以法他还有一段路程，我就把她葬在以法他的路上（以法他就是伯利恒）。」
verses.textEnNiv: As I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died in the land of Canaan while we were still on the way, a little distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath" (that is, Bethlehem).
verses.textEnEsv: As for me, when I came from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to go to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem)."
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when therewas but a little distance to go to Ephrath; and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem)."
verses.textEnNlt: "Long ago, as I was returning from Paddan-aram, Rachel died in the land of Canaan. We were still on the way, some distance from Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem). So with great sorrow I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath."
verses.textEnNasb: Now as for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died, to my sorrow, in the land of Canaan on the journey, when there was still some distance to go to Ephrath. I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem)."
verses.textEn: As I was returning from Paddan, to my sorrow Rachel died in the land of Canaan while we were still on the way, a little distance from Ephrath. So I buried her there beside the road to Ephrath" (that is, Bethlehem).

verses.textZh: 以色列看见约瑟的儿子，就问："他们是谁？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列看见约瑟的儿子，就问："他们是谁？"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列看见约瑟的两个儿子，就说：「这是谁？」
verses.textEnNiv: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, "Who are these?"
verses.textEnEsv: When Israel saw Joseph’s sons, he said, "Who are these?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, "Who are these?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob looked over at the two boys. "Are these your sons?" he asked.
verses.textEnNasb: When Israel saw Joseph’s sons, he said, "Who are these?"
verses.textEn: When Israel saw the sons of Joseph, he asked, "Who are these?"

verses.textZh: 约瑟回答父亲："他们是我的儿子，是神在这里赐给我的。"以色列说："把他们领到我这里来，我要给他们祝福。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟回答父亲："他们是我的儿子，是神在这里赐给我的。"以色列说："把他们领到我这里来，我要给他们祝福。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟对他父亲说：「这是神在这里赐给我的儿子。」以色列说：「请你领他们到我跟前，我要给他们祝福。」
verses.textEnNiv: "They are the sons God has given me here," Joseph said to his father. Then Israel said, "Bring them to me so I may bless them."
verses.textEnEsv: Joseph said to his father, "They are my sons, whom God has given me here." And he said, "Bring them to me, please, that I may bless them."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph said to his father, "They are my sons, whom God has given me in this place." And he said, "Please bring them to me, and I will bless them."
verses.textEnNlt: "Yes," Joseph told him, "these are the sons God has given me here in Egypt." And Jacob said, "Bring them closer to me, so I can bless them."
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph said to his father, "They are my sons, whom God has given me here." So he said, "Bring them to me, please, so that I may bless them."
verses.textEn: "They are the sons God has given me here," Joseph said to his father. Then Israel said, "Bring them to me so I may bless them."

verses.textZh: 以色列因为年老，眼睛昏花，看不清楚。约瑟领他们到他跟前去，他就与他们亲吻，拥抱他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列因为年老，眼睛昏花，看不清楚。约瑟领他们到他跟前去，他就与他们亲吻，拥抱他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列年纪老迈，眼睛昏花，不能看见。约瑟领他们到他跟前，他就和他们亲嘴，抱着他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Now Israel’s eyes were failing because of old age, and he could hardly see. So Joseph brought his sons close to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the eyes of Israel were dim with age, so that he could not see. So Joseph brought them near him, and he kissed them and embraced them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the eyes of Israel were dim with age, sothat he could not see. Then Joseph brought them near him, and he kissed them and embraced them.
verses.textEnNlt: Jacob was half blind because of his age and could hardly see. So Joseph brought the boys close to him, and Jacob kissed and embraced them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the eyes of Israel were so dim from age that he could not see. And Joseph brought them close to him, and he kissed them and embraced them.
verses.textEn: Now Israel’s eyes were failing because of old age, and he could hardly see. So Joseph brought his sons close to him, and his father kissed them and embraced them.

verses.textZh: 以色列对约瑟说："我想不到可以看见你的面，现在神竟使我见到你的后裔。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列对约瑟说："我想不到可以看见你的面，现在神竟使我见到你的后裔。"
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列对约瑟说：「我想不到得见你的面，不料，神又使我得见你的儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Israel said to Joseph, "I never expected to see your face again, and now God has allowed me to see your children too."
verses.textEnEsv: And Israel said to Joseph, "I never expected to see your face; and behold, God has let me see your offspring also."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Israel said to Joseph, "I had not thought to see your face; but in fact, God has also shown me your offspring!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob said to Joseph, "I never thought I would see your face again, but now God has let me see your children, too!"
verses.textEnNasb: And Israel said to Joseph, "I never expected to see your face, and behold, God has let me see your children as well!"
verses.textEn: Israel said to Joseph, "I never expected to see your face again, and now God has allowed me to see your children too."

verses.textZh: 约瑟把两个儿子从以色列膝上抱下来，自己脸伏在地下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟把两个儿子从以色列膝上抱下来，自己脸伏在地下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟把两个儿子从以色列两膝中领出来，自己就脸伏于地下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joseph removed them from Israel’s knees and bowed down with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph removed them from his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joseph brought them from beside his knees, and he bowed down with his face to the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph moved the boys, who were at their grandfather’s knees, and he bowed with his face to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph took them from his knees, and bowed with his face to the ground.
verses.textEn: Then Joseph removed them from Israel’s knees and bowed down with his face to the ground.

verses.textZh: 约瑟领着他们两个到以色列的跟前，以法莲在约瑟的右边对着以色列的左边；玛拿西在约瑟的左边对着以色列的右边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟领着他们两个到以色列的跟前，以法莲在约瑟的右边对着以色列的左边；玛拿西在约瑟的左边对着以色列的右边。
verses.textZhCuv: 随后，约瑟又拉着他们两个，以法莲在他的右手里，对着以色列的左手，玛拿西在他的左手里，对着以色列的右手，领他们到以色列的跟前。
verses.textEnNiv: And Joseph took both of them, Ephraim on his right toward Israel’s left hand and Manasseh on his left toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them close to him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim with his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh with his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he positioned the boys in front of Jacob. With his right hand he directed Ephraim toward Jacob’s left hand, and with his left hand he put Manasseh at Jacob’s right hand.
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim with his right hand toward Israel’s left, and Manasseh with his left hand toward Israel’s right, and brought them close to him.
verses.textEn: And Joseph took both of them, Ephraim on his right toward Israel’s left hand and Manasseh on his left toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them close to him.

verses.textZh: 但是，以色列两手交叉，右手按在次子以法莲的头上，左手按在长子玛拿西的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是，以色列两手交叉，右手按在次子以法莲的头上，左手按在长子玛拿西的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列伸出右手来，按在以法莲的头上（以法莲乃是次子），又剪搭过左手来，按在玛拿西的头上（玛拿西原是长子）。
verses.textEnNiv: But Israel reached out his right hand and put it on Ephraim’s head, though he was the younger, and crossing his arms, he put his left hand on Manasseh’s head, even though Manasseh was the firstborn.
verses.textEnEsv: And Israel stretched out his right hand and laid it on the head of Ephraim, who was the younger, and his left hand on the head of Manasseh, crossing his hands (for Manasseh was the firstborn).
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel stretched out his right hand and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jacob crossed his arms as he reached out to lay his hands on the boys’ heads. He put his right hand on the head of Ephraim, though he was the younger boy, and his left hand on the head of Manasseh, though he was the firstborn.
verses.textEnNasb: But Israel reached out his right hand and placed it on the head of Ephraim, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, crossing his hands, although Manasseh was the firstborn.
verses.textEn: But Israel reached out his right hand and put it on Ephraim’s head, though he was the younger, and crossing his arms, he put his left hand on Manasseh’s head, even though Manasseh was the firstborn.

verses.textZh: 他祝福约瑟，说： "愿我祖亚伯拉罕和以撒所侍候的神， 一生牧养我直到今日的神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他祝福约瑟，说： "愿我祖亚伯拉罕和以撒所侍候的神， 一生牧养我直到今日的神，
verses.textZhCuv: 他就给约瑟祝福说：「愿我祖亚伯拉罕和我父以撒所事奉的神，就是一生牧养我直到今日的神，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he blessed Joseph and said, "May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked faithfully, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,
verses.textEnEsv: And he blessed Joseph and said, "The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has been my shepherd all my life long to this day,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he blessed Joseph, and said: "God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, The God who has fed me all my life long to this day,
verses.textEnNlt: Then he blessed Joseph and said, "May the God before whom my grandfather Abraham and my father, Isaac, walked— the God who has been my shepherd all my life, to this very day,
verses.textEnNasb: And he blessed Joseph, and said, "The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, The God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,
verses.textEn: Then he blessed Joseph and said, "May the God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked faithfully, the God who has been my shepherd all my life to this day,

verses.textZh: 那救我脱离一切祸患的使者，赐福给这两个童子。 愿我的名，我祖亚伯拉罕和以撒的名，借着他们得以流传； 愿他们在地上生养众多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那救我脱离一切祸患的使者，赐福给这两个童子。 愿我的名，我祖亚伯拉罕和以撒的名，借着他们得以流传； 愿他们在地上生养众多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 救赎我脱离一切患难的那使者，赐福与这两个童子。愿他们归在我的名下和我祖亚伯拉罕、我父以撒的名下。又愿他们在世界中生养众多。」
verses.textEnNiv: the Angel who has delivered me from all harm —may he bless these boys. May they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and may they increase greatly on the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the boys; and in them let my name be carried on, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: The Angel who has redeemed me from all evil, Bless the lads; Let my name be named upon them, And the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; And let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: the Angel who has redeemed me from all harm— may he bless these boys. May they preserve my name and the names of Abraham and Isaac. And may their descendants multiply greatly throughout the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: The angel who has redeemed me from all evil, Bless the boys; And may my name live on in them, And the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; And may they grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth."
verses.textEn: the Angel who has delivered me from all harm —may he bless these boys. May they be called by my name and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac, and may they increase greatly on the earth."

verses.textZh: 约瑟见他父亲把右手按在以法莲的头上，心里就不高兴，于是拿住他父亲的手，要从以法莲的头上移到玛拿西的头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟见他父亲把右手按在以法莲的头上，心里就不高兴，于是拿住他父亲的手，要从以法莲的头上移到玛拿西的头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟见他父亲把右手按在以法莲的头上，就不喜悦，便提起他父亲的手，要从以法莲头上挪到玛拿西的头上。
verses.textEnNiv: When Joseph saw his father placing his right hand on Ephraim’s head he was displeased; so he took hold of his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
verses.textEnEsv: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him, and he took his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him; so he took hold of his father’s hand to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
verses.textEnNlt: But Joseph was upset when he saw that his father placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head. So Joseph lifted it to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
verses.textEnNasb: When Joseph saw that his father placed his right hand on Ephraim’s head, it displeased him; and he grasped his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.
verses.textEn: When Joseph saw his father placing his right hand on Ephraim’s head he was displeased; so he took hold of his father’s hand to move it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他父亲说："爸爸啊，不是这样，这个才是长子，请你把右手按在他的头上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对他父亲说："爸爸啊，不是这样，这个才是长子，请你把右手按在他的头上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟对他父亲说：「我父，不是这样。这本是长子，求你把右手按在他的头上。」
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph said to him, "No, my father, this one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head."
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph said to his father, "Not this way, my father; since this one is the firstborn, put your right hand on his head."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph said to his father, "Not so, my father, for this oneis the firstborn; put your right hand on his head."
verses.textEnNlt: "No, my father," he said. "This one is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head."
verses.textEnNasb: And Joseph said to his father, "Not so, my father, for this one is the firstborn. Place your right hand on his head."
verses.textEn: Joseph said to him, "No, my father, this one is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head."

verses.textZh: 他父亲却不肯，说："我知道，我儿啊，我知道，他也要成为一族，也要强大；只是他弟弟比他还要强大，他的后裔要成为多族。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他父亲却不肯，说："我知道，我儿啊，我知道，他也要成为一族，也要强大；只是他弟弟比他还要强大，他的后裔要成为多族。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他父亲不从，说：「我知道，我儿，我知道。他也必成为一族，也必昌大。只是他的兄弟将来比他还大；他兄弟的后裔要成为多族。」
verses.textEnNiv: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know. He too will become a people, and he too will become great. Nevertheless, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his descendants will become a group of nations."
verses.textEnEsv: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know. He also shall become a people, and he also shall be great. Nevertheless, his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his offspring shall become a multitude of nations."
verses.textEnNkjv: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know. He also shall become a people, and he also shall be great; but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his descendants shall become a multitude of nations."
verses.textEnNlt: But his father refused. "I know, my son; I know," he replied. "Manasseh will also become a great people, but his younger brother will become even greater. And his descendants will become a multitude of nations."
verses.textEnNasb: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know; he also will become a people and he also will be great. However, his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his descendants shall become a multitude of nations."
verses.textEn: But his father refused and said, "I know, my son, I know. He too will become a people, and he too will become great. Nevertheless, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his descendants will become a group of nations."

verses.textZh: 那一天，以色列给他们祝福，说： "以色列人要用你的名祝福人，说： ‘愿神使你像以法莲和玛拿西一样。’"于是，以色列立以法莲在玛拿西之上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那一天，以色列给他们祝福，说： "以色列人要用你的名祝福人，说： ‘愿神使你像以法莲和玛拿西一样。’"于是，以色列立以法莲在玛拿西之上。
verses.textZhCuv: 当日就给他们祝福说：「以色列人要指着你们祝福说：『愿神使你如以法莲、玛拿西一样。』」于是立以法莲在玛拿西以上。
verses.textEnNiv: He blessed them that day and said, "In your name will Israel pronounce this blessing: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.’ " So he put Ephraim ahead of Manasseh.
verses.textEnEsv: So he blessed them that day, saying, "By you Israel will pronounce blessings, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh.’" Thus he put Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he blessed them that day, saying, "By you Israel will bless, saying, ‘May God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh!’ " And thus he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob blessed the boys that day with this blessing: "The people of Israel will use your names when they give a blessing. They will say, ‘May God make you as prosperous as Ephraim and Manasseh.’" In this way, Jacob put Ephraim ahead of Manasseh.
verses.textEnNasb: So he blessed them that day, saying, "By you Israel will pronounce blessing, saying, ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh!’ " And so he put Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.textEn: He blessed them that day and said, "In your name will Israel pronounce this blessing: ‘May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh.’ " So he put Ephraim ahead of Manasseh.

verses.textZh: 以色列又对约瑟说："看哪，我快要死了，但是神必与你们同在，必领你们回到你们祖先的土地去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列又对约瑟说："看哪，我快要死了，但是神必与你们同在，必领你们回到你们祖先的土地去。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列又对约瑟说：「我要死了，但神必与你们同在，领你们回到你们列祖之地。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Israel said to Joseph, "I am about to die, but God will be with you and take you back to the land of your fathers.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Israel said to Joseph, "Behold, I am about to die, but God will be with you and will bring you again to the land of your fathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Israel said to Joseph, "Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you and bring you back to the land of your fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob said to Joseph, "Look, I am about to die, but God will be with you and will take you back to Canaan, the land of your ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Israel said to Joseph, "Behold, I am about to die, but God will be with you, and bring you back to the land of your fathers.
verses.textEn: Then Israel said to Joseph, "I am about to die, but God will be with you and take you back to the land of your fathers.

verses.textZh: 现在我把从前用刀和弓，从亚摩利人手中夺过来的那块山地赐给你，使你比众兄弟多得一份。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我把从前用刀和弓，从亚摩利人手中夺过来的那块山地赐给你，使你比众兄弟多得一份。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并且我从前用弓用刀从亚摩利人手下夺的那块地，我都赐给你，使你比众弟兄多得一分。」
verses.textEnNiv: And to you I give one more ridge of land than to your brothers, the ridge I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow."
verses.textEnEsv: Moreover, I have given to you rather than to your brothers one mountain slope that I took from the hand of the Amorites with my sword and with my bow."
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took from the hand of the Amorite with my sword and my bow."
verses.textEnNlt: And beyond what I have given your brothers, I am giving you an extra portion of the land that I took from the Amorites with my sword and bow."
verses.textEnNasb: And I give you one portion more than your brothers, which I took from the hand of the Amorite with my sword and my bow."
verses.textEn: And to you I give one more ridge of land than to your brothers, the ridge I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow."

verses.textZh: 雅各把他的众子叫来，说："你们要聚集在一起，我要把你们日后必遇到的事告诉你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各把他的众子叫来，说："你们要聚集在一起，我要把你们日后必遇到的事告诉你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各叫了他的儿子们来，说：「你们都来聚集，我好把你们日后必遇的事告诉你们。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Jacob called for his sons and said: "Gather around so I can tell you what will happen to you in days to come.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jacob called his sons and said, "Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you what shall happen to you in days to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jacob called his sons and said, "Gather together, that I may tell you what shall befall you in the last days:
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob called together all his sons and said, "Gather around me, and I will tell you what will happen to each of you in the days to come.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jacob summoned his sons and said, "Assemble yourselves, so that I may tell you what will happen to you in the days to come.
verses.textEn: Then Jacob called for his sons and said: "Gather around so I can tell you what will happen to you in days to come.

verses.textZh: 雅各的儿子们哪，你们要一起来听； 要听你们父亲以色列的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各的儿子们哪，你们要一起来听； 要听你们父亲以色列的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的儿子们，你们要聚集而听， 要听你们父亲以色列的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "Assemble and listen, O sons of Jacob, listen to Israel your father.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Gather together and hear, you sons of Jacob, And listen to Israel your father.
verses.textEnNlt: "Come and listen, you sons of Jacob; listen to Israel, your father.
verses.textEnNasb: "Gather together and listen, sons of Jacob; Yes, listen to Israel your father.
verses.textEn: "Assemble and listen, sons of Jacob; listen to your father Israel.

verses.textZh: 流本哪，你是我的长子， 是我的力量，是我的初生子； 你大有尊荣，权力超众；
verses.textZhCnvs: 流本哪，你是我的长子， 是我的力量，是我的初生子； 你大有尊荣，权力超众；
verses.textZhCuv: 吕便哪，你是我的长子， 是我力量强壮的时候生的， 本当大有尊荣，权力超众。
verses.textEnNiv: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, the first sign of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.
verses.textEnEsv: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the firstfruits of my strength, preeminent in dignity and preeminent in power.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, My might and the beginning of my strength, The excellency of dignity and the excellency of power.
verses.textEnNlt: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my strength, the child of my vigorous youth. You are first in rank and first in power.
verses.textEnNasb: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, My might and the beginning of my strength, Preeminent in dignity and preeminent in power.
verses.textEn: "Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, the first sign of my strength, excelling in honor, excelling in power.

verses.textZh: 但是你放纵情欲，好象水沸腾一样，你必不能居首位； 因为你上了你父亲的床； 上了我的榻，然后把它玷污了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是你放纵情欲，好象水沸腾一样，你必不能居首位； 因为你上了你父亲的床； 上了我的榻，然后把它玷污了。
verses.textZhCuv: 但你放纵情欲，滚沸如水， 必不得居首位； 因为你上了你父亲的床， 污秽了我的榻。
verses.textEnNiv: Turbulent as the waters, you will no longer excel, for you went up onto your father’s bed, onto my couch and defiled it.
verses.textEnEsv: Unstable as water, you shall not have preeminence, because you went up to your father’s bed; then you defiled it—he went up to my couch!
verses.textEnNkjv: Unstable as water, you shall not excel, Because you went up to your father’s bed; Then you defiled it— He went up to my couch.
verses.textEnNlt: But you are as unruly as a flood, and you will be first no longer. For you went to bed with my wife; you defiled my marriage couch.
verses.textEnNasb: " Uncontrollable as water, you shall not have preeminence, Because you went up to your father’s bed; Then you defiled it—he went up to my couch.
verses.textEn: Turbulent as the waters, you will no longer excel, for you went up onto your father’s bed, onto my couch and defiled it.

verses.textZh: 西缅和利未是兄弟； 他们的刀剑是强暴的武器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西缅和利未是兄弟； 他们的刀剑是强暴的武器。
verses.textZhCuv: 西缅和利未是弟兄； 他们的刀剑是残忍的器具。
verses.textEnNiv: "Simeon and Levi are brothers— their swords are weapons of violence.
verses.textEnEsv: "Simeon and Levi are brothers; weapons of violence are their swords.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Simeon and Levi are brothers; Instruments of cruelty arein their dwelling place.
verses.textEnNlt: "Simeon and Levi are two of a kind; their weapons are instruments of violence.
verses.textEnNasb: "Simeon and Levi are brothers; Their swords are implements of violence.
verses.textEn: "Simeon and Levi are brothers— their swords are weapons of violence.

verses.textZh: 我的灵啊，不可加入他们的阴谋； 我的心啊，不可参与他们的集会， 因为他们在怒中杀人， 任意砍断牛的腿筋。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的灵啊，不可加入他们的阴谋； 我的心啊，不可参与他们的集会， 因为他们在怒中杀人， 任意砍断牛的腿筋。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的灵啊，不要与他们同谋； 我的心哪，不要与他们联络； 因为他们趁怒杀害人命， 任意砍断牛腿大筋。
verses.textEnNiv: Let me not enter their council, let me not join their assembly, for they have killed men in their anger and hamstrung oxen as they pleased.
verses.textEnEsv: Let my soul come not into their council; O my glory, be not joined to their company. For in their anger they killed men, and in their willfulness they hamstrung oxen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let not my soul enter their council; Let not my honor be united to their assembly; For in their anger they slew a man, And in their self-will they hamstrung an ox.
verses.textEnNlt: May I never join in their meetings; may I never be a party to their plans. For in their anger they murdered men, and they crippled oxen just for sport.
verses.textEnNasb: "May my soul not enter into their council; May my glory not be united with their assembly; For in their anger they killed men, And in their self-will they lamed oxen.
verses.textEn: Let me not enter their council, let me not join their assembly, for they have killed men in their anger and hamstrung oxen as they pleased.

verses.textZh: 他们的怒气可咒，因为非常暴烈； 他们的烈怒可诅，因为十分凶猛； 我要把他们分散在雅各家； 把他们散居在以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的怒气可咒，因为非常暴烈； 他们的烈怒可诅，因为十分凶猛； 我要把他们分散在雅各家； 把他们散居在以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的怒气暴烈可咒； 他们的忿恨残忍可诅。 我要使他们分居在雅各家里， 散住在以色列地中。
verses.textEnNiv: Cursed be their anger, so fierce, and their fury, so cruel! I will scatter them in Jacob and disperse them in Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: Cursed be their anger, for it is fierce, and their wrath, for it is cruel! I will divide them in Jacob and scatter them in Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: Cursed be their anger, for itis fierce; And their wrath, for it is cruel! I will divide them in Jacob And scatter them in Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: A curse on their anger, for it is fierce; a curse on their wrath, for it is cruel. I will scatter them among the descendants of Jacob; I will disperse them throughout Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "Cursed be their anger, for it is fierce; And their wrath, for it is cruel. I will scatter them in Jacob, And disperse them among Israel.
verses.textEn: Cursed be their anger, so fierce, and their fury, so cruel! I will scatter them in Jacob and disperse them in Israel.

verses.textZh: 犹大啊，你的兄弟们要称赞你； 你的手必压住仇敌的颈项； 你父亲的众子必向你下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大啊，你的兄弟们要称赞你； 你的手必压住仇敌的颈项； 你父亲的众子必向你下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大啊，你弟兄们必赞美你； 你手必掐住仇敌的颈项； 你父亲的儿子们必向你下拜。
verses.textEnNiv: "Judah, your brothers will praise you; your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; your father’s sons will bow down to you.
verses.textEnEsv: "Judah, your brothers shall praise you; your hand shall be on the neck of your enemies; your father’s sons shall bow down before you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Judah, you arehe whom your brothers shall praise; Your hand shallbe on the neck of your enemies; Your father’s children shall bow down before you.
verses.textEnNlt: "Judah, your brothers will praise you. You will grasp your enemies by the neck. All your relatives will bow before you.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for you, Judah, your brothers shall praise you; Your hand shall be on the neck of your enemies; Your father’s sons shall bow down to you.
verses.textEn: "Judah, your brothers will praise you; your hand will be on the neck of your enemies; your father’s sons will bow down to you.

verses.textZh: 犹大是只小狮子； 我儿啊，你猎取了食物就上到洞穴去。 他屈身伏卧，好象公狮， 又像母狮，谁敢惊动他呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大是只小狮子； 我儿啊，你猎取了食物就上到洞穴去。 他屈身伏卧，好象公狮， 又像母狮，谁敢惊动他呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大是个小狮子； 我儿啊，你抓了食便上去。 你屈下身去，卧如公狮， 蹲如母狮，谁敢惹你？
verses.textEnNiv: You are a lion’s cub, Judah; you return from the prey, my son. Like a lion he crouches and lies down, like a lioness—who dares to rouse him?
verses.textEnEsv: Judah is a lion’s cub; from the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down; he crouched as a lion and as a lioness; who dares rouse him?
verses.textEnNkjv: Judah is a lion’s whelp; From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He bows down, he lies down as a lion; And as a lion, who shall rouse him?
verses.textEnNlt: Judah, my son, is a young lion that has finished eating its prey. Like a lion he crouches and lies down; like a lioness—who dares to rouse him?
verses.textEnNasb: "Judah is a lion’s cub; From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He crouches, he lies down as a lion, And as a lion, who dares to stir him up?
verses.textEn: You are a lion’s cub, Judah; you return from the prey, my son. Like a lion he crouches and lies down, like a lioness—who dares to rouse him?

verses.textZh: 权杖必不离开犹大， 王圭必不离他两脚之间， 直到细罗 来到， 万族都要臣服他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 权杖必不离开犹大， 王圭必不离他两脚之间， 直到细罗 来到， 万族都要臣服他。
verses.textZhCuv: 圭必不离犹大， 杖必不离他两脚之间， 直等细罗 来到， 万民都必归顺。
verses.textEnNiv: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he to whom it belongs shall come and the obedience of the nations shall be his.
verses.textEnEsv: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until tribute comes to him; and to him shall be the obedience of the peoples.
verses.textEnNkjv: The scepter shall not depart from Judah, Nor a lawgiver from between his feet, Until Shiloh comes; And to Him shallbe the obedience of the people.
verses.textEnNlt: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from his descendants, until the coming of the one to whom it belongs, the one whom all nations will honor.
verses.textEnNasb: "The scepter will not depart from Judah, Nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, Until Shiloh comes, And to him shall be the obedience of the peoples.
verses.textEn: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he to whom it belongs shall come and the obedience of the nations shall be his.

verses.textZh: 犹大把自己的驴驹拴在葡萄树旁， 把自己的小驴系在上等的葡萄树旁； 他在葡萄酒中洗净自己的衣服， 在血红的葡萄汁中洗衣袍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大把自己的驴驹拴在葡萄树旁， 把自己的小驴系在上等的葡萄树旁； 他在葡萄酒中洗净自己的衣服， 在血红的葡萄汁中洗衣袍。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大把小驴拴在葡萄树上， 把驴驹拴在美好的葡萄树上。 他在葡萄酒中洗了衣服， 在葡萄汁中洗了袍褂。
verses.textEnNiv: He will tether his donkey to a vine, his colt to the choicest branch; he will wash his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
