verses.textEnEsv: Binding his foal to the vine and his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine and his vesture in the blood of grapes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Binding his donkey to the vine, And his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, He washed his garments in wine, And his clothes in the blood of grapes.
verses.textEnNlt: He ties his foal to a grapevine, the colt of his donkey to a choice vine. He washes his clothes in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.
verses.textEnNasb: "He ties his foal to the vine, And his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; He washes his garments in wine, And his robes in the blood of grapes.
verses.textEn: He will tether his donkey to a vine, his colt to the choicest branch; he will wash his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

verses.textZh: 他因饮酒而双眼发红， 他因喝奶而牙齿雪白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他因饮酒而双眼发红， 他因喝奶而牙齿雪白。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的眼睛必因酒红润； 他的牙齿必因奶白亮。
verses.textEnNiv: His eyes will be darker than wine, his teeth whiter than milk.
verses.textEnEsv: His eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.
verses.textEnNkjv: His eyes are darker than wine, And his teeth whiter than milk.
verses.textEnNlt: His eyes are darker than wine, and his teeth are whiter than milk.
verses.textEnNasb: "His eyes are dull from wine, And his teeth white from milk.
verses.textEn: His eyes will be darker than wine, his teeth whiter than milk.

verses.textZh: 西布伦必在沿海地带居住， 他必成为船只停泊的港口， 他的边界必伸到西顿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 西布伦必在沿海地带居住， 他必成为船只停泊的港口， 他的边界必伸到西顿。
verses.textZhCuv: 西布伦必住在海口， 必成为停船的海口； 他的境界必延到西顿。
verses.textEnNiv: "Zebulun will live by the seashore and become a haven for ships; his border will extend toward Sidon.
verses.textEnEsv: "Zebulun shall dwell at the shore of the sea; he shall become a haven for ships, and his border shall be at Sidon.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Zebulun shall dwell by the haven of the sea; He shallbecome a haven for ships, And his border shall adjoin Sidon.
verses.textEnNlt: "Zebulun will settle by the seashore and will be a harbor for ships; his borders will extend to Sidon.
verses.textEnNasb: "Zebulun will reside at the seashore; And he shall be a harbor for ships, And his flank shall be toward Sidon.
verses.textEn: "Zebulun will live by the seashore and become a haven for ships; his border will extend toward Sidon.

verses.textZh: 以萨迦是一头粗壮的驴， 伏卧在羊圈 之间；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以萨迦是一头粗壮的驴， 伏卧在羊圈 之间；
verses.textZhCuv: 以萨迦是个强壮的驴， 卧在羊圈之中。
verses.textEnNiv: "Issachar is a rawboned donkey lying down among the sheep pens.
verses.textEnEsv: "Issachar is a strong donkey, crouching between the sheepfolds.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Issachar is a strong donkey, Lying down between two burdens;
verses.textEnNlt: "Issachar is a sturdy donkey, resting between two saddlepacks.
verses.textEnNasb: "Issachar is a strong donkey, Lying down between the sheepfolds.
verses.textEn: "Issachar is a rawboned donkey lying down among the sheep pens.

verses.textZh: 他看安居为美， 他看肥地为佳， 他屈肩负重， 成了服苦的奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他看安居为美， 他看肥地为佳， 他屈肩负重， 成了服苦的奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 他以安静为佳，以肥地为美， 便低肩背重，成为服苦的仆人。
verses.textEnNiv: When he sees how good is his resting place and how pleasant is his land, he will bend his shoulder to the burden and submit to forced labor.
verses.textEnEsv: He saw that a resting place was good, and that the land was pleasant, so he bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant at forced labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: He saw that rest was good, And that the land was pleasant; He bowed his shoulder to bear aburden, And became a band of slaves.
verses.textEnNlt: When he sees how good the countryside is and how pleasant the land, he will bend his shoulder to the load and submit himself to hard labor.
verses.textEnNasb: "When he saw that a resting place was good And that the land was pleasant, He bowed his shoulder to carry burdens, And became a slave at forced labor.
verses.textEn: When he sees how good is his resting place and how pleasant is his land, he will bend his shoulder to the burden and submit to forced labor.

verses.textZh: 但要审判自己的人民， 作以色列的一个支派。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但要审判自己的人民， 作以色列的一个支派。
verses.textZhCuv: 但必判断他的民， 作以色列支派之一。
verses.textEnNiv: "Dan will provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: "Dan shall judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Dan shall judge his people As one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: "Dan will govern his people, like any other tribe in Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: "Dan shall judge his people, As one of the tribes of Israel.
verses.textEn: "Dan will provide justice for his people as one of the tribes of Israel.

verses.textZh: 但要作路上的蛇， 道中的毒蛇， 他要咬伤马蹄， 使骑马的人向后坠落。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但要作路上的蛇， 道中的毒蛇， 他要咬伤马蹄， 使骑马的人向后坠落。
verses.textZhCuv: 但必作道上的蛇，路中的虺， 咬伤马蹄，使骑马的坠落于后。
verses.textEnNiv: Dan will be a snake by the roadside, a viper along the path, that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.
verses.textEnEsv: Dan shall be a serpent in the way, a viper by the path, that bites the horse’s heels so that his rider falls backward.
verses.textEnNkjv: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, A viper by the path, That bites the horse’s heels So that its rider shall fall backward.
verses.textEnNlt: Dan will be a snake beside the road, a poisonous viper along the path that bites the horse’s hooves so its rider is thrown off.
verses.textEnNasb: "Dan shall be a serpent in the way, A horned viper in the path, That bites the horse’s heels, So that its rider falls backward.
verses.textEn: Dan will be a snake by the roadside, a viper along the path, that bites the horse’s heels so that its rider tumbles backward.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊，我向来等候你的拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊，我向来等候你的拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，我向来等候你的救恩。
verses.textEnNiv: "I look for your deliverance, Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: I wait for your salvation, O Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: I have waited for your salvation, O Lord!
verses.textEnNlt: I trust in you for salvation, O Lord !
verses.textEnNasb: "For Your salvation I wait, Lord.
verses.textEn: "I look for your deliverance, Lord .

verses.textZh: 迦得必被侵略者追逼， 他却要追逼他们的脚跟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦得必被侵略者追逼， 他却要追逼他们的脚跟。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦得必被敌军追逼， 他却要追逼他们的脚跟。
verses.textEnNiv: "Gad will be attacked by a band of raiders, but he will attack them at their heels.
verses.textEnEsv: "Raiders shall raid Gad, but he shall raid at their heels.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Gad, a troop shall tramp upon him, But he shall triumph at last.
verses.textEnNlt: "Gad will be attacked by marauding bands, but he will attack them when they retreat.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for Gad, a band of raiders shall attack him, But he will attack at their heels.
verses.textEn: "Gad will be attacked by a band of raiders, but he will attack them at their heels.

verses.textZh: 至于亚设，他的食物必定肥美， 他有美食可以供奉君王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于亚设，他的食物必定肥美， 他有美食可以供奉君王。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚设之地必出肥美的粮食， 且出君王的美味。
verses.textEnNiv: "Asher’s food will be rich; he will provide delicacies fit for a king.
verses.textEnEsv: "Asher’s food shall be rich, and he shall yield royal delicacies.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Bread from Asher shallbe rich, And he shall yield royal dainties.
verses.textEnNlt: "Asher will dine on rich foods and produce food fit for kings.
verses.textEnNasb: " As for Asher, his food shall be rich, And he will yield royal delicacies.
verses.textEn: "Asher’s food will be rich; he will provide delicacies fit for a king.

verses.textZh: 拿弗他利是只得释放的母鹿， 发出优美的言语。
verses.textZhCnvs: 拿弗他利是只得释放的母鹿， 发出优美的言语。
verses.textZhCuv: 拿弗他利是被释放的母鹿； 他出嘉美的言语。
verses.textEnNiv: "Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.
verses.textEnEsv: "Naphtali is a doe let loose that bears beautiful fawns.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Naphtali is a deer let loose; He uses beautiful words.
verses.textEnNlt: "Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.
verses.textEnNasb: "Naphtali is a doe let loose; He utters beautiful words.
verses.textEn: "Naphtali is a doe set free that bears beautiful fawns.

verses.textZh: 约瑟是一根结果子的树枝， 是一根泉旁结果子的树枝， 他的枝条蔓延出墙外。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟是一根结果子的树枝， 是一根泉旁结果子的树枝， 他的枝条蔓延出墙外。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟是多结果子的树枝， 是泉旁多结果的枝子； 他的枝条探出墙外。
verses.textEnNiv: "Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine near a spring, whose branches climb over a wall.
verses.textEnEsv: "Joseph is a fruitful bough, a fruitful bough by a spring; his branches run over the wall.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Joseph is a fruitful bough, A fruitful bough by a well; His branches run over the wall.
verses.textEnNlt: "Joseph is the foal of a wild donkey, the foal of a wild donkey at a spring— one of the wild donkeys on the ridge.
verses.textEnNasb: "Joseph is a fruitful branch, A fruitful branch by a spring; Its branches hang over a wall.
verses.textEn: "Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine near a spring, whose branches climb over a wall.

verses.textZh: 弓箭手把他苦害， 向他射箭敌对他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弓箭手把他苦害， 向他射箭敌对他。
verses.textZhCuv: 弓箭手将他苦害， 向他射箭，逼迫他。
verses.textEnNiv: With bitterness archers attacked him; they shot at him with hostility.
verses.textEnEsv: The archers bitterly attacked him, shot at him, and harassed him severely,
verses.textEnNkjv: The archers have bitterly grieved him, Shot athim and hated him.
verses.textEnNlt: Archers attacked him savagely; they shot at him and harassed him.
verses.textEnNasb: "The archers provoked him, And shot at him and were hostile toward him;
verses.textEn: With bitterness archers attacked him; they shot at him with hostility.

verses.textZh: 但他的弓依然坚硬， 他的手臂仍旧敏捷， 这是出于雅各的大能者之手； 出于以色列的牧者，以色列的盘石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他的弓依然坚硬， 他的手臂仍旧敏捷， 这是出于雅各的大能者之手； 出于以色列的牧者，以色列的盘石。
verses.textZhCuv: 但他的弓仍旧坚硬； 他的手健壮敏捷。 这是因以色列的牧者，以色列的磐石－ 就是雅各的大能者。
verses.textEnNiv: But his bow remained steady, his strong arms stayed limber, because of the hand of the Mighty One of Jacob, because of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: yet his bow remained unmoved; his arms were made agile by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob (from there is the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel),
verses.textEnNkjv: But his bow remained in strength, And the arms of his hands were made strong By the hands of the Mighty God of Jacob (From there is the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel),
verses.textEnNlt: But his bow remained taut, and his arms were strengthened by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, by the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: But his bow remained firm, And his arms were agile, From the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob (From there is the Shepherd, the Stone of Israel),
verses.textEn: But his bow remained steady, his strong arms stayed limber, because of the hand of the Mighty One of Jacob, because of the Shepherd, the Rock of Israel,

verses.textZh: 是你父亲的神帮助你， 是那全能者赐给你； 他把从天上来的福， 地下深渊蕴藏着的福， 哺乳和生育的福，都赐给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是你父亲的神帮助你， 是那全能者赐给你； 他把从天上来的福， 地下深渊蕴藏着的福， 哺乳和生育的福，都赐给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你父亲的神必帮助你； 那全能者必将天上所有的福， 地里所藏的福，以及生产乳养的福，都赐给你。
verses.textEnNiv: because of your father’s God, who helps you, because of the Almighty, who blesses you with blessings of the skies above, blessings of the deep springs below, blessings of the breast and womb.
verses.textEnEsv: by the God of your father who will help you, by the Almighty who will bless you with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that crouches beneath, blessings of the breasts and of the womb.
verses.textEnNkjv: By the God of your father who will help you, And by the Almighty who will bless you With blessings of heaven above, Blessings of the deep that lies beneath, Blessings of the breasts and of the womb.
verses.textEnNlt: May the God of your father help you; may the Almighty bless you with the blessings of the heavens above, and blessings of the watery depths below, and blessings of the breasts and womb.
verses.textEnNasb: From the God of your father who helps you, And by the Almighty who blesses you With blessings of heaven above, Blessings of the deep that lies beneath, Blessings of the breasts and of the womb.
verses.textEn: because of your father’s God, who helps you, because of the Almighty, who blesses you with blessings of the skies above, blessings of the deep springs below, blessings of the breast and womb.

verses.textZh: 你父亲的祝福， 胜过我祖先的祝福 ，胜过永远山岭上的美物。 愿这些福都降在约瑟的头上， 降在兄弟中作王子的那一位头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你父亲的祝福， 胜过我祖先的祝福 ，胜过永远山岭上的美物。 愿这些福都降在约瑟的头上， 降在兄弟中作王子的那一位头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 你父亲所祝的福 胜过我祖先所祝的福， 如永世的山岭，至极的边界； 这些福必降在约瑟的头上， 临到那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。
verses.textEnNiv: Your father’s blessings are greater than the blessings of the ancient mountains, than the bounty of the age-old hills. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.
verses.textEnEsv: The blessings of your father are mighty beyond the blessings of my parents, up to the bounties of the everlasting hills. May they be on the head of Joseph, and on the brow of him who was set apart from his brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: The blessings of your father Have excelled the blessings of my ancestors, Up to the utmost bound of the everlasting hills. They shall be on the head of Joseph, And on the crown of the head of him who was separate from his brothers.
verses.textEnNlt: May my fatherly blessings on you surpass the blessings of my ancestors, reaching to the heights of the eternal hills. May these blessings rest on the head of Joseph, who is a prince among his brothers.
verses.textEnNasb: "The blessings of your father Have surpassed the blessings of my ancestors Up to the furthest boundary of the everlasting hills; May they be on the head of Joseph, And on the top of the head of the one distinguished among his brothers.
verses.textEn: Your father’s blessings are greater than the blessings of the ancient mountains, than the bounty of the age-old hills. Let all these rest on the head of Joseph, on the brow of the prince among his brothers.

verses.textZh: 便雅悯是只撕掠的豺狼， 早晨吞吃他的猎物， 晚上瓜分他的掳物。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 便雅悯是只撕掠的豺狼， 早晨吞吃他的猎物， 晚上瓜分他的掳物。"
verses.textZhCuv: 便雅悯是个撕掠的狼， 早晨要吃他所抓的， 晚上要分他所夺的。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder."
verses.textEnEsv: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf, in the morning devouring the prey and at evening dividing the spoil."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; In the morning he shall devour the prey, And at night he shall divide the spoil."
verses.textEnNlt: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf, devouring his enemies in the morning and dividing his plunder in the evening."
verses.textEnNasb: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; In the morning he devours the prey, And in the evening he divides the spoils."
verses.textEn: "Benjamin is a ravenous wolf; in the morning he devours the prey, in the evening he divides the plunder."

verses.textZh: 这些就是以色列的十二支派；以上是他们父亲对他们所说的话，是按着各人的福分给他们所祝的福。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些就是以色列的十二支派；以上是他们父亲对他们所说的话，是按着各人的福分给他们所祝的福。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切是以色列的十二支派；这也是他们的父亲对他们所说的话，为他们所祝的福，都是按着各人的福分为他们祝福。
verses.textEnNiv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them, giving each the blessing appropriate to him.
verses.textEnEsv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel. This is what their father said to them as he blessed them, blessing each with the blessing suitable to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them. And he blessed them; he blessed each one according to his own blessing.
verses.textEnNlt: These are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said as he told his sons good-bye. He blessed each one with an appropriate message.
verses.textEnNasb: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them. He blessed them, every one with the blessing appropriate to him.
verses.textEn: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father said to them when he blessed them, giving each the blessing appropriate to him.

verses.textZh: 雅各又嘱咐他们，对他们说："我快要归到我的亲族那里去，你们要把我埋葬在赫人以弗仑田间的洞里，与我的祖先在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各又嘱咐他们，对他们说："我快要归到我的亲族那里去，你们要把我埋葬在赫人以弗仑田间的洞里，与我的祖先在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又嘱咐他们说：「我将要归到我列祖 那里，你们要将我葬在赫人以弗仑田间的洞里，与我祖我父在一处，
verses.textEnNiv: Then he gave them these instructions: "I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.textEnEsv: Then he commanded them and said to them, "I am to be gathered to my people; bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he charged them and said to them: "I am to be gathered to my people; bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jacob instructed them, "Soon I will die and join my ancestors. Bury me with my father and grandfather in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he commanded them and said to them, "I am about to be gathered to my people; bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.textEn: Then he gave them these instructions: "I am about to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

verses.textZh: 这个洞在迦南地，在幔利前面的麦比拉的田间。那地方原是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买下来作坟地的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这个洞在迦南地，在幔利前面的麦比拉的田间。那地方原是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买下来作坟地的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是在迦南地幔利前、麦比拉田间的洞；那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买来为业，作坟地的。
verses.textEnNiv: the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, which Abraham bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.
verses.textEnEsv: in the cave that is in the field at Machpelah, to the east of Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite to possess as a burying place.
verses.textEnNkjv: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite as a possession for a burial place.
verses.textEnNlt: This is the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, that Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite as a permanent burial site.
verses.textEnNasb: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is opposite Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought along with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial site.
verses.textEn: the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in Canaan, which Abraham bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.

verses.textZh: 他们在那里埋葬了亚伯拉罕和他的妻子撒拉；又在那里埋葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那里埋葬了利亚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们在那里埋葬了亚伯拉罕和他的妻子撒拉；又在那里埋葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那里埋葬了利亚。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们在那里葬了亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉，又在那里葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那里葬了利亚。
verses.textEnNiv: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried, and there I buried Leah.
verses.textEnEsv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife, and there I buried Leah—
verses.textEnNkjv: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife, there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife, and there I buried Leah.
verses.textEnNlt: There Abraham and his wife Sarah are buried. There Isaac and his wife, Rebekah, are buried. And there I buried Leah.
verses.textEnNasb: There they buried Abraham and his wife Sarah, there they buried Isaac and his wife Rebekah, and there I buried Leah—
verses.textEn: There Abraham and his wife Sarah were buried, there Isaac and his wife Rebekah were buried, and there I buried Leah.

verses.textZh: 那块田和田间的洞，是向赫人买来的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那块田和田间的洞，是向赫人买来的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那块田和田间的洞原是向赫人买的。」
verses.textEnNiv: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites. "
verses.textEnEsv: the field and the cave that is in it were bought from the Hittites."
verses.textEnNkjv: The field and the cave that is there were purchased from the sons of Heth."
verses.textEnNlt: It is the plot of land and the cave that my grandfather Abraham bought from the Hittites."
verses.textEnNasb: the field and the cave that is in it, purchased from the sons of Heth."
verses.textEn: The field and the cave in it were bought from the Hittites. "

verses.textZh: 雅各对他的众子嘱咐完了，就把双脚收回床上，气绝而死，归到他的亲族那里去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各对他的众子嘱咐完了，就把双脚收回床上，气绝而死，归到他的亲族那里去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各嘱咐众子已毕，就把脚收在床上，气绝而死，归他列祖 那里去了。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed, breathed his last and was gathered to his people.
verses.textEnEsv: When Jacob finished commanding his sons, he drew up his feet into the bed and breathed his last and was gathered to his people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when Jacob had finished commanding his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed and breathed his last, and was gathered to his people.
verses.textEnNlt: When Jacob had finished this charge to his sons, he drew his feet into the bed, breathed his last, and joined his ancestors in death.
verses.textEnNasb: When Jacob finished commanding his sons, he drew his feet into the bed and breathed his last, and was gathered to his people.
verses.textEn: When Jacob had finished giving instructions to his sons, he drew his feet up into the bed, breathed his last and was gathered to his people.

verses.textZh: 约瑟伏在他父亲的脸上，为他哀哭，与他亲吻。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟伏在他父亲的脸上，为他哀哭，与他亲吻。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟伏在他父亲的面上哀哭，与他亲嘴。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph threw himself on his father and wept over him and kissed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph fell on his father’s face and wept over him and kissed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph fell on his father’s face, and wept over him, and kissed him.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph threw himself on his father and wept over him and kissed him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph fell on his father’s face, and wept over him and kissed him.
verses.textEn: Joseph threw himself on his father and wept over him and kissed him.

verses.textZh: 约瑟吩咐臣仆中作医生的，用香料包殓了他的父亲。他们就用香料包殓了以色列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟吩咐臣仆中作医生的，用香料包殓了他的父亲。他们就用香料包殓了以色列。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟吩咐伺候他的医生用香料薰他父亲，医生就用香料薰了以色列。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So the physicians embalmed him,
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father. So the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father. So the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joseph told the physicians who served him to embalm his father’s body; so Jacob was embalmed.
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father. So the physicians embalmed Israel.
verses.textEn: Then Joseph directed the physicians in his service to embalm his father Israel. So the physicians embalmed him,

verses.textZh: 这事足足费了四十天，因为用香料包殓尸体是需要这样长的时间。埃及人为他哀哭了七十天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事足足费了四十天，因为用香料包殓尸体是需要这样长的时间。埃及人为他哀哭了七十天。
verses.textZhCuv: 薰尸的常例是四十天；那四十天满了，埃及人为他哀哭了七十天。
verses.textEnNiv: taking a full forty days, for that was the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
verses.textEnEsv: Forty days were required for it, for that is how many are required for embalming. And the Egyptians wept for him seventy days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Forty days were required for him, for such are the days required for those who are embalmed; and the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.
verses.textEnNlt: The embalming process took the usual forty days. And the Egyptians mourned his death for seventy days.
verses.textEnNasb: Now forty days were required for it, for such is the period required for embalming. And the Egyptians wept for him seventy days.
verses.textEn: taking a full forty days, for that was the time required for embalming. And the Egyptians mourned for him seventy days.

verses.textZh: 为他哀哭的日子过了，约瑟就对法老家里的人说："我若在你们面前得蒙喜悦，请你们代我禀告法老说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 为他哀哭的日子过了，约瑟就对法老家里的人说："我若在你们面前得蒙喜悦，请你们代我禀告法老说：
verses.textZhCuv: 为他哀哭的日子过了，约瑟对法老家中的人说：「我若在你们眼前蒙恩，请你们报告法老说：
verses.textEnNiv: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh’s court, "If I have found favor in your eyes, speak to Pharaoh for me. Tell him,
verses.textEnEsv: And when the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to the household of Pharaoh, saying, "If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spoke to the household of Pharaoh, saying, "If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the hearing of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: When the period of mourning was over, Joseph approached Pharaoh’s advisers and said, "Please do me this favor and speak to Pharaoh on my behalf.
verses.textEnNasb: When the days of mourning for him were past, Joseph spoke to the household of Pharaoh, saying, "If now I have found favor in your sight, please speak to Pharaoh, saying,
verses.textEn: When the days of mourning had passed, Joseph said to Pharaoh’s court, "If I have found favor in your eyes, speak to Pharaoh for me. Tell him,

verses.textZh: ‘我父亲曾经叫我起誓，说："看哪，我快要死了；你要把我埋葬在迦南地，在我为自己所掘的坟墓里。"现在求你让我上去，埋葬我的父亲，之后我必定回来。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘我父亲曾经叫我起誓，说："看哪，我快要死了；你要把我埋葬在迦南地，在我为自己所掘的坟墓里。"现在求你让我上去，埋葬我的父亲，之后我必定回来。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 『我父亲要死的时候叫我起誓说：你要将我葬在迦南地，在我为自己所掘的坟墓里。』现在求你让我上去葬我父亲，以后我必回来。」
verses.textEnNiv: ‘My father made me swear an oath and said, "I am about to die; bury me in the tomb I dug for myself in the land of Canaan." Now let me go up and bury my father; then I will return.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: ‘My father made me swear, saying, "I am about to die: in my tomb that I hewed out for myself in the land of Canaan, there shall you bury me." Now therefore, let me please go up and bury my father. Then I will return.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘My father made me swear, saying, "Behold, I am dying; in my grave which I dug for myself in the land of Canaan, there you shall bury me." Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come back.’ "
verses.textEnNlt: Tell him that my father made me swear an oath. He said to me, ‘Listen, I am about to die. Take my body back to the land of Canaan, and bury me in the tomb I prepared for myself.’ So please allow me to go and bury my father. After his burial, I will return without delay."
verses.textEnNasb: ‘My father made me swear, saying, "Behold, I am about to die; in my grave which I dug for myself in the land of Canaan, there you shall bury me." Now then, please let me go up and bury my father; then I will return.’ "
verses.textEn: ‘My father made me swear an oath and said, "I am about to die; bury me in the tomb I dug for myself in the land of Canaan." Now let me go up and bury my father; then I will return.’ "

verses.textZh: 法老说："你可以上去，照着你父亲叫你起的誓，把他埋葬。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 法老说："你可以上去，照着你父亲叫你起的誓，把他埋葬。"
verses.textZhCuv: 法老说：「你可以上去，照着你父亲叫你起的誓，将他葬埋。」
verses.textEnNiv: Pharaoh said, "Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do."
verses.textEnEsv: And Pharaoh answered, "Go up, and bury your father, as he made you swear."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Pharaoh said, "Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear."
verses.textEnNlt: Pharaoh agreed to Joseph’s request. "Go and bury your father, as he made you promise," he said.
verses.textEnNasb: Pharaoh said, "Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear."
verses.textEn: Pharaoh said, "Go up and bury your father, as he made you swear to do."

verses.textZh: 于是，约瑟上去埋葬他的父亲。与他一同上去的，有法老所有的臣仆，法老家中的长老，和埃及地所有的长老，
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是，约瑟上去埋葬他的父亲。与他一同上去的，有法老所有的臣仆，法老家中的长老，和埃及地所有的长老，
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约瑟上去葬他父亲。与他一同上去的，有法老的臣仆和法老家中的长老，并埃及国的长老，
verses.textEnNiv: So Joseph went up to bury his father. All Pharaoh’s officials accompanied him—the dignitaries of his court and all the dignitaries of Egypt—
verses.textEnEsv: So Joseph went up to bury his father. With him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his household, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.textEnNlt: So Joseph went up to bury his father. He was accompanied by all of Pharaoh’s officials, all the senior members of Pharaoh’s household, and all the senior officers of Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joseph went up to bury his father, and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his household and all the elders of the land of Egypt,
verses.textEn: So Joseph went up to bury his father. All Pharaoh’s officials accompanied him—the dignitaries of his court and all the dignitaries of Egypt—

verses.textZh: 还有约瑟的全家，他的兄弟们和他父亲的家人；他们把孩子和牛羊留在歌珊地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有约瑟的全家，他的兄弟们和他父亲的家人；他们把孩子和牛羊留在歌珊地。
verses.textZhCuv: 还有约瑟的全家和他的弟兄们，并他父亲的眷属；只有他们的妇人孩子，和羊群牛群，都留在歌珊地。
verses.textEnNiv: besides all the members of Joseph’s household and his brothers and those belonging to his father’s household. Only their children and their flocks and herds were left in Goshen.
verses.textEnEsv: as well as all the household of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s household. Only their children, their flocks, and their herds were left in the land of Goshen.
verses.textEnNkjv: as well as all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds they left in the land of Goshen.
verses.textEnNlt: Joseph also took his entire household and his brothers and their households. But they left their little children and flocks and herds in the land of Goshen.
verses.textEnNasb: and all the household of Joseph and his brothers and his father’s household; they left only their little ones and their flocks and their herds in the land of Goshen.
verses.textEn: besides all the members of Joseph’s household and his brothers and those belonging to his father’s household. Only their children and their flocks and herds were left in Goshen.

verses.textZh: 又有车辆和马兵与他一同上去，成了一大队行列。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又有车辆和马兵与他一同上去，成了一大队行列。
verses.textZhCuv: 又有车辆马兵，和他一同上去；那一帮人甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: Chariots and horsemen also went up with him. It was a very large company.
verses.textEnEsv: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen. It was a very great company.
verses.textEnNkjv: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen, and it was a very great gathering.
verses.textEnNlt: A great number of chariots and charioteers accompanied Joseph.
verses.textEnNasb: Chariots with teams of horses also went up with him; and it was a very great company.
verses.textEn: Chariots and horsemen also went up with him. It was a very large company.

verses.textZh: 他们到了约旦河东岸的亚达禾场，就在那里大大地哀悼痛哭。约瑟为他父亲举哀七天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们到了约旦河东岸的亚达禾场，就在那里大大地哀悼痛哭。约瑟为他父亲举哀七天。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们到了约旦河外、亚达的禾场，就在那里大大地号咷痛哭。约瑟为他父亲哀哭了七天。
verses.textEnNiv: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, near the Jordan, they lamented loudly and bitterly; and there Joseph observed a seven-day period of mourning for his father.
verses.textEnEsv: When they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, they lamented there with a very great and grievous lamentation, and he made a mourning for his father seven days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and they mourned there with a great and very solemn lamentation. He observed seven days of mourning for his father.
verses.textEnNlt: When they arrived at the threshing floor of Atad, near the Jordan River, they held a very great and solemn memorial service, with a seven-day period of mourning for Joseph’s father.
verses.textEnNasb: When they came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, they mourned there with a very great and sorrowful lamentation; and he observed seven days of mourning for his father.
verses.textEn: When they reached the threshing floor of Atad, near the Jordan, they lamented loudly and bitterly; and there Joseph observed a seven-day period of mourning for his father.

verses.textZh: 住在那地的迦南人看见了亚达禾场的哀悼，就说："这是埃及人一场非常伤痛的哀悼。"因此，在约旦河东岸的那地方名叫亚伯．麦西。
verses.textZhCnvs: 住在那地的迦南人看见了亚达禾场的哀悼，就说："这是埃及人一场非常伤痛的哀悼。"因此，在约旦河东岸的那地方名叫亚伯．麦西。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦南的居民见亚达禾场上的哀哭，就说：「这是埃及人一场极大的哀哭。」因此那地方名叫亚伯‧麦西，是在约旦河东。
verses.textEnNiv: When the Canaanites who lived there saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, "The Egyptians are holding a solemn ceremony of mourning." That is why that place near the Jordan is called Abel Mizraim.
verses.textEnEsv: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning on the threshing floor of Atad, they said, "This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians." Therefore the place was named Abel-mizraim; it is beyond the Jordan.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, "This is a deep mourning of the Egyptians." Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
verses.textEnNlt: The local residents, the Canaanites, watched them mourning at the threshing floor of Atad. Then they renamed that place (which is near the Jordan) Abel-mizraim, for they said, "This is a place of deep mourning for these Egyptians."
verses.textEnNasb: Now when the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, "This is a grievous mourning for the Egyptians." Therefore it was named Abel-mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.
verses.textEn: When the Canaanites who lived there saw the mourning at the threshing floor of Atad, they said, "The Egyptians are holding a solemn ceremony of mourning." That is why that place near the Jordan is called Abel Mizraim.

verses.textZh: 雅各的众子就照着父亲嘱咐他们的去作，
verses.textZhCnvs: 雅各的众子就照着父亲嘱咐他们的去作，
verses.textZhCuv: 雅各的儿子们就遵着他父亲所吩咐的办了，
verses.textEnNiv: So Jacob’s sons did as he had commanded them:
verses.textEnEsv: Thus his sons did for him as he had commanded them,
verses.textEnNkjv: So his sons did for him just as he had commanded them.
verses.textEnNlt: So Jacob’s sons did as he had commanded them.
verses.textEnNasb: And so his sons did for him as he had commanded them;
verses.textEn: So Jacob’s sons did as he had commanded them:

verses.textZh: 把雅各运到迦南地，葬在麦比拉田间的洞里。那地方在幔利的前面，是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买下来作坟地的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 把雅各运到迦南地，葬在麦比拉田间的洞里。那地方在幔利的前面，是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买下来作坟地的。
verses.textZhCuv: 把他搬到迦南地，葬在幔利前、麦比拉田间的洞里；那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗仑买来为业，作坟地的。
verses.textEnNiv: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre, which Abraham had bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.
verses.textEnEsv: for his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave of the field at Machpelah, to the east of Mamre, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite to possess as a burying place.
verses.textEnNkjv: For his sons carried him to the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, before Mamre, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as property for a burial place.
verses.textEnNlt: They carried his body to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre. This is the cave that Abraham had bought as a permanent burial site from Ephron the Hittite.
verses.textEnNasb: for his sons carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah opposite Mamre, which Abraham had bought along with the field as a burial site from Ephron the Hittite.
verses.textEn: They carried him to the land of Canaan and buried him in the cave in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre, which Abraham had bought along with the field as a burial place from Ephron the Hittite.

verses.textZh: 约瑟埋葬了他父亲以后，就和他的众兄弟，以及所有与他一同上去埋葬他父亲的人都回埃及去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟埋葬了他父亲以后，就和他的众兄弟，以及所有与他一同上去埋葬他父亲的人都回埃及去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟葬了他父亲以后，就和众弟兄，并一切同他上去葬他父亲的人，都回埃及去了。
verses.textEnNiv: After burying his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, together with his brothers and all the others who had gone with him to bury his father.
verses.textEnEsv: After he had buried his father, Joseph returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had gone up with him to bury his father.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after he had buried his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brothers and all who went up with him to bury his father.
verses.textEnNlt: After burying Jacob, Joseph returned to Egypt with his brothers and all who had accompanied him to his father’s burial.
verses.textEnNasb: And after he had buried his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, he and his brothers, and all who had gone up with him to bury his father.
verses.textEn: After burying his father, Joseph returned to Egypt, together with his brothers and all the others who had gone with him to bury his father.

verses.textZh: 约瑟的哥哥们看见父亲死了，就说："或者约瑟仍然会怀恨我们，要报复我们从前向他所作的一切恶事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟的哥哥们看见父亲死了，就说："或者约瑟仍然会怀恨我们，要报复我们从前向他所作的一切恶事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲死了，就说：「或者约瑟怀恨我们，照着我们从前待他一切的恶足足地报复我们。」
verses.textEnNiv: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "What if Joseph holds a grudge against us and pays us back for all the wrongs we did to him?"
verses.textEnEsv: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "It may be that Joseph will hate us and pay us back for all the evil that we did to him."
verses.textEnNkjv: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "Perhaps Joseph will hate us, and may actually repay us for all the evil which we did to him."
verses.textEnNlt: But now that their father was dead, Joseph’s brothers became fearful. "Now Joseph will show his anger and pay us back for all the wrong we did to him," they said.
verses.textEnNasb: When Joseph’s brothers had seen that their father was dead, they said, "What if Joseph holds a grudge against us and pays us back in full for all the wrong which we did to him!"
verses.textEn: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, "What if Joseph holds a grudge against us and pays us back for all the wrongs we did to him?"

verses.textZh: 他们就打发人到约瑟那里，说："你父亲未死以前曾经嘱咐说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就打发人到约瑟那里，说："你父亲未死以前曾经嘱咐说：
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就打发人去见约瑟，说：「你父亲未死以先吩咐说：
verses.textEnNiv: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, "Your father left these instructions before he died:
verses.textEnEsv: So they sent a message to Joseph, saying, "Your father gave this command before he died:
verses.textEnNkjv: So they sent messengers to Joseph, saying, "Before your father died he commanded, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: So they sent this message to Joseph: "Before your father died, he instructed us
verses.textEnNasb: So they sent instructions to Joseph, saying, "Your father commanded us before he died, saying,
verses.textEn: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, "Your father left these instructions before he died:

verses.textZh: ‘你们要对约瑟这样说：从前你的哥哥们恶待你，求你饶恕他们的过犯和罪恶。现在求你饶恕你父亲的神之众仆人的过犯。’"约瑟听见这话就哭了。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘你们要对约瑟这样说：从前你的哥哥们恶待你，求你饶恕他们的过犯和罪恶。现在求你饶恕你父亲的神之众仆人的过犯。’"约瑟听见这话就哭了。
verses.textZhCuv: 『你们要对约瑟这样说：从前你哥哥们恶待你，求你饶恕他们的过犯和罪恶。』如今求你饶恕你父亲神之仆人的过犯。」他们对约瑟说这话，约瑟就哭了。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I ask you to forgive your brothers the sins and the wrongs they committed in treating you so badly.’ Now please forgive the sins of the servants of the God of your father." When their message came to him, Joseph wept.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘Say to Joseph, "Please forgive the transgression of your brothers and their sin, because they did evil to you."’ And now, please forgive the transgression of the servants of the God of your father." Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Thus you shall say to Joseph: "I beg you, please forgive the trespass of your brothers and their sin; for they did evil to you." ’ Now, please, forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of your father." And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
verses.textEnNlt: to say to you: ‘Please forgive your brothers for the great wrong they did to you—for their sin in treating you so cruelly.’ So we, the servants of the God of your father, beg you to forgive our sin." When Joseph received the message, he broke down and wept.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘This is what you shall say to Joseph: "Please forgive, I beg you, the offense of your brothers and their sin, for they did you wrong." ’ And now, please forgive the offense of the servants of the God of your father." And Joseph wept when they spoke to him.
verses.textEn: ‘This is what you are to say to Joseph: I ask you to forgive your brothers the sins and the wrongs they committed in treating you so badly.’ Now please forgive the sins of the servants of the God of your father." When their message came to him, Joseph wept.

verses.textZh: 他的哥哥们也亲自来了，俯伏在他面前，说："看哪，我们是你的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的哥哥们也亲自来了，俯伏在他面前，说："看哪，我们是你的奴仆。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他的哥哥们又来俯伏在他面前，说：「我们是你的仆人。」
verses.textEnNiv: His brothers then came and threw themselves down before him. "We are your slaves," they said.
verses.textEnEsv: His brothers also came and fell down before him and said, "Behold, we are your servants."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then his brothers also went and fell down before his face, and they said, "Behold, we are your servants."
verses.textEnNlt: Then his brothers came and threw themselves down before Joseph. "Look, we are your slaves!" they said.
verses.textEnNasb: Then his brothers also came and fell down before him and said, "Behold, we are your servants."
verses.textEn: His brothers then came and threw themselves down before him. "We are your slaves," they said.

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他们说："你们不要害怕，我怎能代替神呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对他们说："你们不要害怕，我怎能代替神呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟对他们说：「不要害怕，我岂能代替神呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But Joseph said to them, "Don’t be afraid. Am I in the place of God?
verses.textEnEsv: But Joseph said to them, "Do not fear, for am I in the place of God?
verses.textEnNkjv: Joseph said to them, "Do not be afraid, for am I in the place of God?
verses.textEnNlt: But Joseph replied, "Don’t be afraid of me. Am I God, that I can punish you?
verses.textEnNasb: But Joseph said to them, "Do not be afraid, for am I in God’s place?
verses.textEn: But Joseph said to them, "Don’t be afraid. Am I in the place of God?

verses.textZh: 从前你们有意要害我，但神有美好的意思在其中，为要成就今日的光景，使许多人的性命得以保全。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前你们有意要害我，但神有美好的意思在其中，为要成就今日的光景，使许多人的性命得以保全。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前你们的意思是要害我，但神的意思原是好的，要保全许多人的性命，成就今日的光景。
verses.textEnNiv: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.
verses.textEnEsv: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring it about that many people should be kept alive, as they are today.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for you, you meant evil against me; but God meant it for good, in order to bring it about as itis this day, to save many people alive.
verses.textEnNlt: You intended to harm me, but God intended it all for good. He brought me to this position so I could save the lives of many people.
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good in order to bring about this present result, to keep many people alive.
verses.textEn: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives.

verses.textZh: 现在你们不要害怕，我必供养你们和你们的孩子。"于是约瑟用仁慈的话安慰他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们不要害怕，我必供养你们和你们的孩子。"于是约瑟用仁慈的话安慰他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在你们不要害怕，我必养活你们和你们的妇人孩子。」于是约瑟用亲爱的话安慰他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your children." And he reassured them and spoke kindly to them.
verses.textEnEsv: So do not fear; I will provide for you and your little ones." Thus he comforted them and spoke kindly to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, do not be afraid; I will provide for you and your little ones." And he comforted them and spoke kindly to them.
verses.textEnNlt: No, don’t be afraid. I will continue to take care of you and your children." So he reassured them by speaking kindly to them.
verses.textEnNasb: So therefore, do not be afraid; I will provide for you and your little ones." So he comforted them and spoke kindly to them.
verses.textEn: So then, don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your children." And he reassured them and spoke kindly to them.

verses.textZh: 约瑟和他父亲的家人，都住在埃及。约瑟活了一百一十岁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟和他父亲的家人，都住在埃及。约瑟活了一百一十岁。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟和他父亲的眷属都住在埃及。约瑟活了一百一十岁。
verses.textEnNiv: Joseph stayed in Egypt, along with all his father’s family. He lived a hundred and ten years
verses.textEnEsv: So Joseph remained in Egypt, he and his father’s house. Joseph lived 110 years.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joseph dwelt in Egypt, he and his father’s household. And Joseph lived one hundred and ten years.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joseph and his brothers and their families continued to live in Egypt. Joseph lived to the age of 110.
verses.textEnNasb: Now Joseph stayed in Egypt, he and his father’s household, and Joseph lived 110 years.
verses.textEn: Joseph stayed in Egypt, along with all his father’s family. He lived a hundred and ten years

verses.textZh: 约瑟见到以法莲的第三代子孙；玛拿西的儿子玛吉的众子，也归在约瑟的膝下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟见到以法莲的第三代子孙；玛拿西的儿子玛吉的众子，也归在约瑟的膝下。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟得见以法莲第三代的子孙。玛拿西的孙子、玛吉的儿子也养在约瑟的膝上。
verses.textEnNiv: and saw the third generation of Ephraim’s children. Also the children of Makir son of Manasseh were placed at birth on Joseph’s knees.
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph saw Ephraim’s children of the third generation. The children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were counted as Joseph’s own.
verses.textEnNkjv: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were also brought up on Joseph’s knees.
verses.textEnNlt: He lived to see three generations of descendants of his son Ephraim, and he lived to see the birth of the children of Manasseh’s son Makir, whom he claimed as his own.
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph saw the third generation of Ephraim’s sons; also the sons of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.
verses.textEn: and saw the third generation of Ephraim’s children. Also the children of Makir son of Manasseh were placed at birth on Joseph’s knees.

verses.textZh: 约瑟对他的兄弟们说："我快要死了，但神必定眷顾你们，领你们从这地上到他起誓应许给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各之地去。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟对他的兄弟们说："我快要死了，但神必定眷顾你们，领你们从这地上到他起誓应许给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各之地去。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟对他弟兄们说：「我要死了，但神必定看顾你们，领你们从这地上去，到他起誓所应许给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各之地。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "I am about to die. But God will surely come to your aid and take you up out of this land to the land he promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob."
verses.textEnEsv: And Joseph said to his brothers, "I am about to die, but God will visit you and bring you up out of this land to the land that he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."
verses.textEnNkjv: And Joseph said to his brethren, "I am dying; but God will surely visit you, and bring you out of this land to the land of which He swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."
verses.textEnNlt: "Soon I will die," Joseph told his brothers, "but God will surely come to help you and lead you out of this land of Egypt. He will bring you back to the land he solemnly promised to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."
verses.textEnNasb: Joseph said to his brothers, "I am about to die, but God will assuredly take care of you and bring you up from this land to the land which He promised on oath to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."
verses.textEn: Then Joseph said to his brothers, "I am about to die. But God will surely come to your aid and take you up out of this land to the land he promised on oath to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob."

verses.textZh: 约瑟又叫以色列的子孙起誓，说："神必定眷顾你们，那时你们要把我的骸骨从这里带上去应许之地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟又叫以色列的子孙起誓，说："神必定眷顾你们，那时你们要把我的骸骨从这里带上去应许之地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟叫以色列的子孙起誓说：「神必定看顾你们；你们要把我的骸骨从这里搬上去。」
verses.textEnNiv: And Joseph made the Israelites swear an oath and said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up from this place."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Joseph made the sons of Israel swear, saying, "God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, "God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Joseph made the sons of Israel swear an oath, and he said, "When God comes to help you and lead you back, you must take my bones with you."
verses.textEnNasb: Then Joseph made the sons of Israel swear, saying, "God will assuredly take care of you, and you shall carry my bones up from here."
verses.textEn: And Joseph made the Israelites swear an oath and said, "God will surely come to your aid, and then you must carry my bones up from this place."

verses.textZh: 约瑟死了，享寿一百一十岁。人用香料把他包殓了，放在棺材里，停在埃及。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约瑟死了，享寿一百一十岁。人用香料把他包殓了，放在棺材里，停在埃及。
verses.textZhCuv: 约瑟死了，正一百一十岁。人用香料将他薰了，把他收殓在棺材里，停在埃及。
verses.textEnNiv: So Joseph died at the age of a hundred and ten. And after they embalmed him, he was placed in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.textEnEsv: So Joseph died, being 110 years old. They embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Joseph died, being one hundred and ten years old; and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.textEnNlt: So Joseph died at the age of 110. The Egyptians embalmed him, and his body was placed in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.textEnNasb: So Joseph died at the age of 110 years; and they embalmed him and placed him in a coffin in Egypt.
verses.textEn: So Joseph died at the age of a hundred and ten. And after they embalmed him, he was placed in a coffin in Egypt.
